ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Smash It All To Bits
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
ability.lore: As part of his crusade of vengeance against Sigmar, Brodd has charged his gargants with the complete destruction of any settlement, outpost or inhabited terrain that they come across on their march.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA-GARGANT** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a terrain feature within its combat range. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of that **MEGA-GARGANT** to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each friendly and enemy unit on the terrain feature that was picked. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. After rolling for all those units, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Swamp Staff
ability.lore: Hewn from a root of an ancient bogwood, this gnarled staff grants its bearer mastery over the swamps and can be used to ward off enemy magics.
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit’s power level.

ability.name: Incandescent Blaze
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: As the rune branded into the side of this Magmadroth ignites, the beast vomits forth a tide of flames hot enough to melt reinforced steel.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Roaring Fyrestream**.
• This unit’s **Roaring Fyrestream** has a Damage characteristic of 3.

ability.name: Waystone
ability.lore: This sliver of dark rock illuminates hidden paths around the bearer in stark relief.
ability.effect: Remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Aelementor Focus
ability.lore: Whether a shard of igneous rock rendered glittering by the weight of a soaring peak, a simple whistle that plays notes pleasing to mischievous air spirits, or a perfectly smooth pebble crafted by the millennia-long caress of a crystal rapid, this object acts as a more direct channel of communion with the spirits of the land.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by this unit from the target instead of from this unit.

ability.name: Relentless Discipline
ability.lore: The Ossiarchs are infamous for their cohesive discipline.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Make a **discipline roll** of D6. Add I to the roll if the target is wholly within 12" of your general. On a 4+, pick 1 of the effects below:

• **Your Movement Phase:** Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.

• **Your Charge Phase:** Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

• **Any Combat Phase:** Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by the target for the rest of the phase.

• **Any Combat Phase:** The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Phoenix Stone
ability.lore: This ancient crystal, at once hot and cold to the touch, shatters just as the bearer’s anima is about to flee their body, releasing swirling flames that reknit flesh rather than burn, granting the bearer a precious second chance to fulfil their destiny.
ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: The Celestial Realm
ability.lore: In High Azyr, the Stormcast Eternals await their call to deliver retribution.
ability.declare: If there are more friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Endless Growth
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: As the land itself is roused to wrath, life energies bloom and surge, filling the Sylvaneth with renewed vigour.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:

• **HEAL (X)** the target, where **X** is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.

ability.name: Corrupted Leystone
ability.lore: This obsidian stone is attuned to sites of arcane power, allowing the bearer to teleport between ley lines.
ability.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again contesting an objective and more than 7" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Putrefied Ground
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: The earth bubbles and liquefies beneath the enemy’s feet.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from the Move characteristic of enemy units.
• Subtract 1 from run rolls for enemy units.

ability.name: Gunhauler Escort
ability.lore: The threatening presence of a Grundstok Gunhauler overhead makes it difficult for enemies to focus their attacks on the Trailblazers’ ground forces.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Grundstok Gunhauler**.

ability.name: Skeletal Splintering
ability.lore: The magics weaved by the caster calcify the bones of their enemies, causing them to break as they try to move.
ability.declare: This spell can be cast by the same **WIZARD** more than once per phase. Pick the **Arkhan the Black** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

ability.name: World Runes
ability.lore: The aelementiri are particularly sensitive to the runes of the core elements that constitute the Hysh-Mhensa, for these sigils represent the natural forces to which they have dedicated their lives.
ability.effect:
Add 1 **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** to your **library** for each friendly **ALARITH** unit on the battlefield.

Add 1 **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** to your **library** for each friendly **HURAKAN** unit on the battlefield.

Add 1 **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** to your **library** for each friendly **YDRILAN** unit on the battlefield.

You can have a maximum of 6 of each type of rune in your **library**.

ability.name: Gnawhole Ambush
ability.lore: A pack of Skaven emerges onto the battlefield from a glowing green rift in reality.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the tunnels below** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a corner of the battlefield and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Transplanting
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The most proficient of Nurgle’s gardeners can coax a Feculent Gnarlmaw to their side.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE HERO** and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

ability.name: Champion of Raids
ability.lore: This Darkoath Warqueen is renowned for her lightning raids. With speed, momentum and swift violence, her forces surprise and overwhelm those who stand in her way.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can re-roll charge rolls for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Endless Swarm of Rats
ability.lore: From the many gnawholes that encircle the battlefield, more and more verminkin swarm forth without cease.
ability.effect: When a friendly **Clanrats** unit uses its ‘Seething Swarm’ ability, you can return D6 slain models to that unit instead of D3.

ability.name: Glowin' Tattooz
ability.lore: The beast spirits in these tattoos are so fierce that death itself shies away from them.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: Flask of Lethisian Darkwater
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: Sourced from the lakewaters of the city of Lethis, when this potion is carefully sipped, its black liquid soothes the body and soul.
ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** your general.

ability.name: Oaths of Darkness
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Darkoath are roving barbarian raiders who seek to prove their might by swearing oaths of bloodshed and murder to the Dark Gods.
ability.effect:
You can reveal 1 **battle tactic card** in your hand to your opponent. If you do so, that **battle tactic card becomes your oath** for the rest of the turn.

While this **battle tactic card is your oath**, you can still use the command on it, or attempt to score the battle tactic on it, as normal.

If you score the battle tactic on your oath this turn, your oath is **fulfilled.** Instead of discarding the card, it is placed to one side but you can still use the command on it. Once you do so, the card is discarded as normal. Fulfilled oaths placed to one side in this way do not count towards the 3 battle tactic cards you can have in your hand.

If you use the command on your oath before it is scored, it is discarded as normal. At the end of the turn, if the oath is still in your hand and that oath has not been fulfilled, it ceases to be your oath.

ability.name: Revered Monstrosity
ability.lore: This noble beast has long served the court and exerts a strange dominance
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by other friendly non‐**UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Steelshell Armour
ability.lore: This pearlescent armour offers uncanny protection, regardless of the strength behind the blows that strike it.
ability.effect: Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for your general (positive and negative).

ability.name: Quetzl the Preserver
ability.lore: Quetzl grants protection from the dangers of the physical realms.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons for attacks that target friendly **SERAPHON** units that are wholly within friendly territory.

ability.name: Breath of Contempt
ability.lore: This war machine has been fitted with chambers that store excess steam under pressure that can be released in scalding gouts at nearby foes.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: A Deluded Quest
ability.lore: The deluded Squires of the Everchosen think they have been sent on a personal mission by Archaon.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has the **ENEMY OF THE EVERCHOSEN** keyword.

ability.name: Legendary Vandals
ability.lore: Zoggrok’s Ironmongerz have inherited their boss’s taste for crushing not only their enemies but also their edifices and artifice too.
ability.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ** units have **Anti‑FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend)** and **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.

ability.name: Blood-river Chalice
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Archregent guzzles from a bloodstained chalice, roaring as their deathless form swells with restored vitality.
ability.effect: **Heal (2D3)** your general.

ability.name: Unbending Will
ability.lore: This immortal tyrant and their minions are a force of unliving conquest like no other.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Mega Bossy
ability.lore: This boss’s booming voice rings out across the battlefield, ‘encouraging’ their ladz to get krumpin’.
ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Swift Tide
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: The sheer rapidity of the sea’s advance sees the Idoneth outpace their foes.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Concealing Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units can use Run abilities and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

ability.name: Mark of Nurgle
ability.lore: The Father of Plagues has blessed your general with unnatural resilience.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target your general.

ability.name: Bolt of Tzeentch
ability.lore: This spell manifests as a prismatic beam of raw magic that tears its victims apart in a display of multispectral colour.
ability.declare: Pick the **Magister** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: A Duel, Good Sir!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: To refuse an honourable duel with Ushoran is always to one’s detriment.
ability.declare: You must use this ability if the friendly **Ushoran** is in combat with the enemy general. Pick the enemy general to be the target.
ability.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse Ushoran’s challenge.

***Accept***: For the rest of the turn, when the friendly **Ushoran** and the target are picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of their attacks must target each other.

***Refuse***: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Forward to Victory
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
ability.lore: With their charge faltering, a rousing command gives the unit renewed energy to reach their foes.
ability.effect: You can re-roll the **charge roll**.

ability.name: Bloodrage Pendant
ability.lore: Carved from the bones of savage reptilian megafauna, the Bloodrage Pendant spurs a warrior’s killing rage – all the more should they themselves shed gore.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. Add 2 instead if the number of damage points allocated to this unit is equal to or greater than half of this unit’s Health characteristic (rounding up).

ability.name: Ironclad Scrums
ability.lore: Ardboyz share Zoggrok’s brutally pragmatic views on war, enough to advance on a fortress wall or artillery battery in some sort of defensive formation.
ability.effect: Friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ** **Ardboyz** units with 3 or more models have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of a different friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ** **Ardboyz** unit with 3 or more models.

ability.name: Egomaniak
ability.lore: This self-important boss is willing to use anyone to protect their own hide.
ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Head of the Unworthy
ability.lore: This grim trophy is a bleak reminder that the gods’ favour, even if earned over centuries of battle, can be lost and bestowed on another in a heartbeat.
ability.effect: If a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO** with any **Dark Apotheosis** points is destroyed, give this unit 8 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

ability.name: Seed of Rebirth
ability.lore: Should the bearer of this seed ever fall, its rejuvenating energies will grant them new life.
ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Cheat Destiny
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You used a command on a battle tactic card
ability.lore: Can destiny truly be deceived, or are we pulled by strings we cannot see?
ability.effect: Instead of discarding that card, return it face down to the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

ability.name: Daemonheart
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Through a dark ritual, the heart of a daemon dwells within your general’s chest, where its dread power can be unleashed to greatly augment the strength of its host.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of your general.
ability.effect: Inflict an amount of **mortal damage** on that unit equal to the number of the current battle round.

ability.name: Murderous Strike
ability.lore: A Shadow Coven attacks without warning, seeking to cripple the enemy with the cruelty of their opening strike.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **INFANTRY** units that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Destined for Battle
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit in your turn
ability.lore: Hand-to-hand combat is a crude pursuit, but it has its uses.
ability.effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability.

ability.name: Powerful Resurgence
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units while they are contesting a **Gnarlroot** objective.

ability.name: Magical Intervention
ability.lore: A warrior learned in the mystic arts utters a rapid incantation to disrupt the enemy’s plans.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That friendly unit can use a **SPELL** or **PRAYER** ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from **casting rolls** or **chanting rolls** made as part of that ability.

ability.name: Banish Manifestation
ability.lore: The wizard or priest disrupts the arcane forces sustaining a manifestation, wiping it from existence.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** to use this ability, pick a manifestation within 30" of them to be the target, then make a **banishment roll** of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy manifestation on the battlefield after the first.
ability.effect: If the **banishment roll** equals or exceeds the **banishment** **value** listed on the manifestation’s warscroll, it is **banished** and removed from play. You cannot pick the same manifestation as the target of this ability more than once per turn.

ability.name: Shadowmasked
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: The umbral arts of the Khainite Shadowstalkers and the gore-smoke of the Cauldron are utilised to mask the movements of the Shadow Coven.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Ancient Burial Sites
ability.lore: Across the Mortal Realms stand time-worn mausoleums and barrows, housing the remains of the long dead.
ability.effect:
If there is a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note**: *The original* **Cursed Sepulchre** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

ability.name: Mirrorshield
ability.lore: This shield reflects the rays of Hysh in questing beams that seek out the eyes of enemy marksmen.
ability.effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

ability.name: Secure Investments
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The wise profiteer ensures that their assets are well protected.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if any enemy units that were within 3" of your **Zontari Endrin Dock** this turn were destroyed this turn.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly non-**INFANTRY PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.

ability.name: Broken Slumber
ability.lore: Disturbed by the approach of an enemy army, dozing troggoths – presumed till now to be part of the scenery – wake up in a blurry rage, fists and clubs swinging.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** unit that is a **living** **landmark**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Aerodynamism
ability.lore: Borne by state-of-the-art endrins, the speed and agility with which this duardin navigates the battlefield makes them a very difficult target.
ability.effect: If this unit moved this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Propa Grisly
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Covered in grotesque insect swarms and trained to enact frightening carnage, the monsters of the Murkvast Menagerie leave a gory mess wherever they go.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to the Health characteristic of that **MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER**. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Fyresteel Throwing Axes
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: These sidearms are deadly when hurled at close range.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly units that are not in combat and are within 10" of any enemy units.
ability.effect: For each of those units, pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: There's No Reward Without Risk
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit wholly within 12" of your general
ability.lore: Under the command of their Admiral, the crew close in on their prize without a moment’s hesitation.
ability.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability.

ability.name: Born of Butchery
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: So long as gore flows in rivers and hate chokes mortal souls, the Baleful Lords shall rise again and anew.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE** **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number plus the number of units (friendly and enemy) that have been destroyed this battle. If the roll contains 8 or more results of 3+, set up a replacement unit identical to the target on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: 'Fire, You Worms!'
ability.lore: A pitiless enforcer of discipline, this duardin expects their underlings to keep firing even as the foe bears down on them.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must have charged this phase. If the unmodified hit roll for any of those attacks is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

ability.name: Death Stalkers
ability.phaseDetails: Start of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: These spectral killers relentlessly hunt down quarry whose names have been whispered to them in darksome rites.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that unit.

ability.name: Amberstone Whetstone
ability.lore: This prized sharpening stone, laced with veins of realmstone, is found deep in the crags of Ghur. It is loved by the Ironjawz for its ability to make a weapon ‘ded sharp’.
ability.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons is 2.

ability.name: Call for Reinforcements
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: A second wave of troops enters the fray, replacing those lost to the rigours of battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **REINFORCEMENTS** unit that has been **destroyed**.
ability.effect:
Set up an identical **replacement unit** on the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and not in combat.

Each **REINFORCEMENTS** unit can only be replaced once. Replacement units cannot themselves be replaced.

ability.name: After It, Ladz!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: When Skumdrekk’s ladz set their sights on their prey, they do not let up.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

ability.name: Red Errantry Hosts
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Many banners of ‘knights’ jostle for a chance to fight at Ushoran’s side.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KNIGHTS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Shimmering Amulet
ability.lore: This void-pearl amulet conceals its wearer behind a shimmering cloak of refracted magic.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
ability.lore: The gods watch this warlord’s deeds particularly closely.
ability.effect: If this unit is picked as the target of the ‘Eye of the Gods’ ability, it gains 3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

ability.name: Stronger in Madness
ability.lore: The Boon of Ushoran has rendered this warrior’s physical form near indestructible.
ability.effect:
Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.
In addition, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks that target this unit have no effect.

ability.name: Counter-charge
ability.lore: Seeing the need for decisive action, the warriors charge forth to stall the enemy’s advance or enact a bold interception.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use a **CHARGE** ability as if it were your charge phase.

ability.name: Beacon of Azyr
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: This beacon is brimming with the magic of the Celestial Realm. When unleashed, holy lightning surges forth, empowering a nearby Stormcast Eternal who is attuned to the tempest.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** or **PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
The next time this turn that the target uses a **PRAYER** or **SPELL** ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.

**Designer’s Note:** *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*

ability.name: Glowy Lantern
ability.lore: Stolen from the aelves of Hysh after a botched alliance, this aetherquartz jar was at first carried around just because it was shiny; however, over time, it has granted this Mega-Gargant an innate power over malign sorceries.
ability.effect: This unit can use **SUMMON** abilities from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

ability.name: Nullstone Beads
ability.lore: These beads, each graven with the rune Danoi, are cold to the touch, and the owner risks drifting into a deep slumber should they wear them for too long. However, they possess powerful anti-magic properties and can cause enemy spells to wither and dissipate when brandished with purpose.
ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

ability.name: Unctuous Preacher
ability.lore: Even this hero’s brethren consider them to be far too enthusiastic in their preachings of Grandfather Nurgle’s blessings.
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **PRIEST**, it has **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit is already a **PRIEST**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Grinding Advance
ability.lore: The scions of Hashut do not come swiftly – but they are thorough, relentless and in time, all shall be ground to rubble before them.
ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Infernal Cohort** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Each target can immediately move up to 3" but cannot use **CHARGE** abilities in the first battle round.

ability.name: Flask of Shademist
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Filled with an obscuring mist harvested from the Ulguan coast, when this flask is shattered, the battlefield is plunged into darkness.
ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of your general.

ability.name: An Eye For Da Fight
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly IRONJAWZ unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: This orruk is among the most dangerous of their brutal kind: one who instinctively understands the flow of battle and knows just where the best fights are likely to kick off.
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Caustic Sap
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick an objective. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If you picked the **Heartwood** objective, roll a D6 for each target instead.

ability.name: Questing Tendrils
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: Snaking vines writhe through the undergrowth towards the quarry, driven by the urge to drag them down into the gore-soaked loam.
ability.declare: Pick the terrain feature that is closest to the **quarry** to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units are wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** while they are wholly within 6" of the target.

ability.name: Swoop In
ability.lore: Once the moment is right, Gronn and his crew strike hard and fast.
ability.declare: Pick the **Grundstok Gunhauler** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is **studying the battlefield**.
ability.effect: Set up the **Grundstok Gunhauler** on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units that have an artefact of power and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 3" of the **Grundstok Gunhauler** and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Jump Up and Down
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A gargant’s massive, stomping feet are devastating against smaller opponents.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** or **GARGANT** unit that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the unit using this ability is a **GARGANT**, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 6. If it is a **MEGA-GARGANT,** inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+.

ability.name: Karst-Bana Aether-Powered Combat Rig
ability.lore: This pioneer is a firm believer that wealth is be wrested from the Mortal Realms at gunpoint or at the business end of an aether-powered hammer. This has led to a custom-built combat harness, commissioned to provide overwhelming strength and protection in equal measure.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: The Hand of Gork
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, (Army) Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: A bizarre ritual worked before the battle calls down a ghostly green hand that can carry a mob to where they are most needed.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Get Krumpin'!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Watching this boss go to town on an unfortunate target gets the mobs under their command well up for a brawl.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword and a friendly unit has not used a **BRUTAL KUNNIN’** ability this turn.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BIG WAAAGH!** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Devolving Aura
ability.lore: Enemies that stray close to this hero are stricken by hideous malformations.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to the target this phase. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Banish Manifestation
ability.lore: The wizard or priest disrupts the arcane forces sustaining a manifestation, wiping it from existence.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** to use this ability, pick a **MANIFESTATION** within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a **banishment roll** of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy **MANIFESTATION** on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same **MANIFESTATION** to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
ability.effect: If the **banishment roll** equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

ability.name: Way of the Cresting Wave
ability.lore: The Thralls of this raiding party have been trained in techniques that see them strike like a tsunami.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Namarti Thralls** units that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Intense Piety
ability.lore: This hero’s intense and unwavering devotion to the Sigmar’s mission is one of such absolute focus that they can cause the followers of rival gods to hesitate and falter with a few well-chosen words or soul-piercing stare.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **PRIEST** or **WIZARD** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Bellowing Mockery
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Drunken gargants often holler incoherent insults to aggravate and taunt.
ability.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn, then pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Frenzied Exhortations
ability.lore: The Slaughter Queen atop the Cauldron of Blood howls a bloody liturgy that empowers nearby cultists.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Morrda's Talon
ability.lore: Enemies of the God-King know this weapon by name and fear its keen blade.
ability.effect: Your general’s **Hallowed Greataxe** has **Crit (Mortal)**.

ability.name: Heads Must Roll
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: A terrible hunger is awoken in the gore-slick weapons of the Bloodbound.
ability.declare: Spend 3 **blood tithe points** and pick up to 3 friendly units.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of those units’ melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Raging Animus
ability.lore: Within this Taurus is bound an especially diabolical spirit – one that takes any opportunity to violently burst free.
ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Arcane Taxonomy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The Convocation’s master is never found far from the objects of their magical studies, compelled to take notes and record observations even as battle rages around them.
ability.effect: Remove the **Scinari Calligrave** in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a friendly **MANIFESTATION** and more than 7" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Incandescent Rectrices
ability.lore: This vibrant plumage imbues the bearer with the restorative power of the heavens.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Deranged Transformation
ability.lore: The spellcaster causes the limbs of a nearby pack to bulge and lengthen, allowing the creatures to charge forwards at a furious pace and imbuing them with greater strength.
ability.declare: Pick the **Ushoran** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick another visible unit in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

ability.name: Quicksilver Draught
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This potion lends uncanny speed to the one who imbibes it.
ability.effect: Your general has **STRIKE-FIRST** this phase.

ability.name: Slitherwrack Helm
ability.lore: This war-helm was fashioned from the skull of an infamous toad dragon; its pure repulsiveness causes enemies to retch and reel, rendering them helpless in their disgust.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Wrath and Ruin
ability.lore: The very earth cracks before the priest, venting fire and sulphurous fumes that engulf the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick the **Runelord** in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
ability.effect: Roll 6 dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 9 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target as a result of those dice rolls, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Fuelled by Revenge
ability.lore: This general inspires a wrathful lust for vengeance in her Scáthborn kin.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Blood Stalkers** units while they are wholly within 12" of your general.

ability.name: Market Dominance
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Even if you have secured an unassailable monopoly, it is vital to aggressively defend your interests.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if you control every objective that is not wholly within enemy territory.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time you use your **Zontari Endrin Dock**’s ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, you can set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on a manufacturing roll of 3+ instead of 4+.

ability.name: Glareface's Grin
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: When this crescent-shaped shard of metal strikes the ground, it releases the concentrated Hyshian light trapped within it.
ability.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Sudden Ambush
ability.lore: The Whisperblade hides until it is the perfect moment to strike.
ability.effect: Set up this unit within 6" of an enemy unit and not in combat.

ability.name: Dilettante
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: This champion is always flitting to and fro, forever hungry to sample new horrors.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Twisted Grace
ability.lore: The favoured daemonic servants of Slaanesh move with a loathsome but hypnotic precision.
ability.effect: When your general makes a pile-in move, if they charged in the same turn, add D6" to the distance they can move.

ability.name: Khaine's Inheritor
ability.lore: Those imbued with Khaine’s potent blood who survive the ordeal soon learn to wield that power as a weapon, causing waves of unbearable agony in their foes.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: The Blood Saints
ability.lore: As the first and most revered of the Scáthborn, the loyalty of these creatures towards Morathi-Khaine is ironclad.
ability.effect: While the friendly **Shadow Queen** is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-**HERO ZAINTHAR KAI** unit, both that **Shadow Queen** and that non-**HERO** unit have **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Tales of Horror
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Desertions are all too common when battling this spectral terror.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit within 6" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target is replaced using the 'Call for Reinforcements' ability, halve the number of models in the replacement unit, rounding up.

ability.name: Roaring Headwind
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Hurakan call on the greater spirits of the wind to deliver one great gust to push back the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability, it must end that move closer to the **leeward** battlefield edge.

ability.name: Egomaniak
ability.lore: This self-important boss is willing to use anyone to protect his own hide.
ability.effect: If any other friendly units are within your general’s combat range, before you allocate a damage point to your general, roll a dice. On a 4+, you must allocate that damage point to one of those units instead.

ability.name: Amulet of Gnosis
ability.lore: This talisman contains the siphoned intellects of many esteemed martial leaders distilled into a single black gemstone, which bestows upon the bearer the knowledge of a thousand battles. Such military acumen ensures any troops under their command will act with supreme precision on the battlefield.
ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **OSSIARCH B0NEREAPERS** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Collar of Contempt
ability.lore: This thrice-damned brass collar is the bane of magical power.
ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Fate Slicer
ability.lore: This curving crystal blade can cut a victim’s soul from the tapestry of fate.
ability.effect: Gain 1 **fate point** if any models were slain by this unit this turn.

ability.name: Spring The Trap
ability.lore: When the prey is finally corralled, the Bonesplitterz launch themselves forward. The time for kunnin’ is over; now it’s time to get brutal!
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **BONESPLITTERZ** units that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Zonbarcorp 'Dealbreaker' Battle Ram
ability.lore: A vessel with this best-selling upgrade need not fear full-on collisions. The same cannot be said for those in its way, however.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Desperate Remedies
ability.lore: When fighters are afflicted with the plagues of Nurgle, all efforts must be made to stem the spread of those diseases.
ability.effect: If an ability would heal or return slain models to a **DISEASED** enemy unit, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, it no longer has the **DISEASED** keyword.

ability.name: Draught of the Finest Magmalt
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A single draught of this fiery beverage sends shivers of energy surging through a Fyreslayer from toes to crest.
ability.effect: Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Gargant Charge
ability.lore: A charging gargant will flatten anyone in their path.
ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **MEGA-GARGANT** or **GARGANT** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit that has not been picked as the target of this ability this turn and that is in combat with that unit to be the target.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability can be used by any number of friendly **MEGA-GARGANT** and **GARGANT** units that charged in each turn.*
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Muster Guard
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Cannibal nobles have the charisma to rally wavering troops.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly **NOBLES** to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following:

•  Return up to 3 slain models to a friendly **SERFS** unit wholly within 12" of it.
•  Return 1 slain model to a friendly **KNIGHTS** unit wholly within 12" of it.

The same unit cannot have models returned to it by this ability more than once per turn.

ability.name: Daredevil Deployment
ability.lore: Flynt’s crew lead the way with guns blazing.
ability.declare: Pick the **Arkanaut Frigate** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is **plying the winds**.
ability.effect: Set up the **Arkanaut Frigate** anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 6" of the **Arkanaut Frigate** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Killa Instinkt
ability.lore: This keen-eyed orruk knows exactly where to strike for maximum effect, even against the gargantuan beasts of the Mortal Realms.
ability.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.

ability.name: The Crimson Plate
ability.lore: This ancient armour bestows Khorne’s protection upon its wearer, provided it is burnished daily with the blood of champions.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Bellow of Gorkamorka
ability.lore: Goroan shamans who maintain the old ways channel the sense-blasting roars of Gorkamorka through their magic.
ability.declare: Pick the **Ogroid Thaumaturge** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn. In addition, while the target has the **BURNING** keyword, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Delusion of the Hunter
ability.lore: The ghouls opt to pounce on trespassers rather than hold ground.
ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units while no models in the unit are contesting an objective.

ability.name: Timberrrrr!
ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
ability.effect: When the **MEGA‑GARGANT** in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

ability.name: Dreaded Arrival
ability.lore: To the thunderous beating of flame-trailing hooves and clattering Chaos Armour, the knights arrive to shatter the enemy.
ability.effect: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Coatl Familiar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD within this unit’s combat range
ability.lore: Though only a juvenile example of the great feathered serpents, this winged creature is still sacred to the mage-god Tepok.
ability.effect: Add D6 to the casting roll for that spell.

ability.name: Dazzling Radiance
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Yndrasta’s god-touched brilliance can call stranded Stormcast souls into the fray once more.
ability.declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they were set up this phase.
ability.effect: You can return 1 slain model to each friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general.

ability.name: Aggressive Acquisitions
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: In war and profit, leave no avenue for your enemies to progress.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if there is a friendly **PIONEER** unit in each large quarter of the battlefield. Each of those units must be more than 6" from all other large quarters of the battlefield and not in combat.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, enemy units cannot be set up within your territory or within 9" of an objective that you control.

ability.name: Swift Erasure
ability.lore: With a dismissive flourish, the Calligrave nullifies the inelegantly wrought spells of the foe.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit that was picked to be a target of that **SPELL** ability and that is wholly within 12" of the **Scinari Calligrave** in this Regiment of Renown. On a 4+, that **SPELL** ability has no effect on that unit.

ability.name: Masters of all Terrain
ability.lore: These Dawnriders have been dispatched on multiple missions throughout the realms. Consequently, their steeds have become accustomed to traversing all kinds of terrain, be it scree, sand or swamp.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown and to their Move characteristic.

ability.name: Taktikal Cowering
ability.lore: Snerk can usually be found hurling insults from behind his mate’s solid, regenerating body.
ability.effect:
While the **Loonboss** in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of the **Dankhold Troggoth** in this Regiment of Renown:

• That **Loonboss** has **WARD** (4+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Loonboss**, allocate 1 damage point to that **Dankhold Troggoth** after the damage sequence for that **Loonboss** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Mend Constructs
ability.lore: The caster seeks to undo the damage that mars the surface of their creations.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 6+, **Heal (D3)** the target.

ability.name: Killing Pounce
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: When the moment to strike comes, Karanak leaps with unbridled force.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for your general, you can roll an additional dice, to a maximum of 3, but if you do, they must finish that charge in combat with the **quarry.**

ability.name: Brazier of Nagashizzar
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: Green flames billow from this brazier, lashing at nearby gheists and ensuring that there is no rest for the wicked.
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Tracer-fire Rounds
ability.phaseDetails: Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit
ability.lore: Imported Excelsian glimmerings have been worked into the casings of these rounds, causing them to subtly correct their trajectory to their target.
ability.effect: If all of the attacks target the same enemy unit, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls for those attacks.

ability.name: Da King's Guards
ability.lore: Skragrott keeps a personal retinue of troggoths to protect him and favoured members of his court.
ability.effect:
While a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit is within the combat range of a friendly **HERO**:

• That **HERO** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **HERO**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit within that **HERO**’s combat range after the damage sequence for that **HERO** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Timberrrrr!
ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **MEGA‐GARGANT** or **GARGANT** model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

ability.name: Drawn By Blood
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: For the Baleful Lords, nothing is more pressing than to commit atrocity.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect:
That unit can move D6". It can end that move in combat but only with units it was in combat with at the start of the phase.

If that unit destroyed any enemy units this turn, then instead:

That unit can move 2D6". It can end that move in combat with any units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn.

ability.name: Swiftfeather Talisman
ability.lore: This delicate talisman, in the form of a feather engraved with the rune Senlui, can instil sudden swiftness and lightness of step in the bearer or their chosen companions.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Merciful Strike
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: For those who join the divine hunt, the moment of the final, killing blow is one of momentous importance. It must be delivered swiftly and surely.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT MONSTER** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of damage points the target has. If the result exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

ability.name: Pendant of Slaanesh
ability.lore: This pendant burrows through the Shardspeaker’s rich fabrics and scarred chest before nestling next to their heart, invigorating them with sublime energy whenever they feel pain.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** your general.

ability.name: The Banner of Rage
ability.lore: Sewn from strings of congealed gore, this banner radiates bloodlust so strong that those beneath it are goaded into a state of permanent rage.
ability.effect:
This unit has the **PLEDGED TO KHORNE** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

ability.name: Blood-woken Runes
ability.lore: Fell runes of resilience are carved into the armour of these warriors, needing only the touch of a foe’s blood to be empowered.
ability.effect: Friendly units have **WARD (5+)** if they have used a **FIGHT** ability in the same phase.

ability.name: Come and Take it, Blaggards!
ability.lore: Though their city lies in ruin, these warriors defy any enemy who tries to prise the wreckage from them.
ability.effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**HERO** units while they are in combat with any enemy units that have 6 or more models or a Health characteristic of 3 or more.

ability.name: Master of Discipline
ability.lore: This duardin is popular amongst their crews but also knows when to crack the whip and remind them who pays their wages.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can re-roll the dice.

ability.name: Deploy Faction Terrain
ability.lore: The army has taken to the field surrounding an important and powerful landmark.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **faction terrain feature** that has not been **deployed** to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been **deployed**.

ability.name: The Price of Mercy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: Inaction is hateful to all Khorne's daemons, but to the Baleful Lords, it is utterly anathemic.
ability.declare: You must use this ability. Pick each friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that did not charge or use a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be a target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Instinctive Commander
ability.lore: *The saurus Sunblood has no need to utter orders, his warriors advancing with instinctive understanding.*
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general and not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Hallucinogenic Fungus Brew
ability.lore: Stolen from the shamans of the Gobbapalooza, this potent brew makes the imbiber almost impervious to pain. However, as the battle progresses, the effects start to wear off.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (4+)** in the first battle round, **WARD (5+)** in the second battle round, and **WARD (6+)** in the third and fourth battle rounds.

ability.name: Unparalleled Speed
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: They say the first blow struck is the sweetest…
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** this phase.

ability.name: Warpstone-laced Armour
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability and targeted your Stormfiends unit
ability.lore: Lurid green lightning begins to crackle across the armour of the Stormfiends, momentarily deflecting any blows levelled at them.
ability.effect: Your **Stormfiends** unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: 'Ere We Go!
ability.lore: The din of battle draws in Ironjawz from leagues around.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.
ability.subsectionRulesText: Your **Brutes** are not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, they can use the following ability:

ability.name: Hunger of Shesh'shan
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Possessed by a wild euphoria, these warriors launch themselves at the foe with abandon, gloating as they revel in the screams and arterial sprays of blood.
ability.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Toe to Toe
ability.lore: The duardin who follow Fjori into battle do not back down from any foe, no matter the size.
ability.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy **MONSTERS** while they are in combat with any units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Protection of Hysh
ability.lore: The caster opens their arms wide, creating a field of glowing energy that protects all of the caster’s allies that are nearby.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 7+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Rage of Arkhar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Unholy anger is stoked in the hearts of these warriors, filling them with hate-fuelled stamina.
ability.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Zealous Orator
ability.lore: Your general is a wild demagogue who inspires her followers to fight on in the face of impossible odds.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 9" of your general that is **not** in combat. Roll a dice for each slain model from that unit.
ability.effect: For each 5+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

ability.name: Carnivorous Flora
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick an objective to be **grasping**.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each unit contesting that objective. On a 3+, every model in that unit that is within the control zone of that objective is **entangled** for the rest of the battle round.

**Entangled** models must stay within the control zone of the **grasping** objective for the rest of the battle round. While a unit has any **entangled** models, it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield. That objective cannot be moved while there are any entangled models contesting it.

ability.name: Eye-biter Ash
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Stored in a heat-proof pouch, this strange ash never stops smouldering. The bearer can cast it at a foe, creating a cloud of blistering ash that blinds the targets and causes them terrible pain.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general and roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 1-4, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that unit for the rest of the phase. On a 5+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that unit for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Loyalty to the Magnate
ability.lore: Some call it loyalty; Brokk calls it ‘contractual motivation’.
ability.effect: While a friendly **Brokk Grungsson** is wholly within the combat range of another friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** unit, both those units have **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Lightning Reactions
ability.lore: Lumineth possess a natural alacrity beyond that of most rivals.
ability.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 units instead of 1. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

ability.name: Demands of the Dark Gods
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: Each of the Dark Gods covets Archaon’s service and that of the Swords of Chaos also. The Varanguard may exploit this to wrest boons from them – so long as their loyalty to the Everchosen remains paramount.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Demand of Khorne***: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units.

***Demand of Tzeentch***: Pick 1 visible enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that is not in combat and roll a D6. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

***Demand of Nurgle***: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit. Then pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that healed any damage points this turn. Until the start of the next battle round, that unit has **WARD (6+)**.

***Demand of Slaanesh***: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units until the start of the next battle round.

ability.name: Crypt Dagger
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Foul sorcery flickers and dances across the ancient iron of this cursed blade, and its bite can bring instant death.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Burst Pustules
ability.lore: As blighted flesh is pierced and hewn, quivering boils erupt, showering all with Nurgle’s glistening gifts.
ability.effect: Each time a **DISEASED** enemy unit is destroyed, before the last model in the unit is removed from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick another enemy unit within 9" of that model to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature. The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

ability.name: Skull Collector
ability.lore: Even other warriors of Khorne are in awe of this champion's fixation on decapitation.
ability.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **HERO** by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy **HERO** has been destroyed, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

ability.name: Retreat
ability.lore: The fighters disengage from combat, though at the cost of lowering their defences.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Inflict **D3 mortal damage** on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its **Move** characteristic. That unit **can** move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but **cannot** end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

ability.name: The Need For Perfection
ability.lore: This hero inspires a compulsive, self‐destructive desire in their allies to push themselves ever further, all thoughts of temperance and restraint dismissed from their minds.
ability.effect: The first time each turn that an unmodified charge roll, casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll for a friendly non-**EUPHORIC** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is 5 or less, that unit has the **EUPHORIC** keyword for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Bellowing Roar
ability.lore: An ear-splitting bellow let loose by a Mancrusher can send the enemy battleline into disarray.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target, then roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 2+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit this phase.

ability.name: Unseemly Vitality
ability.lore: No wound or exertion seems able to slow this libertine for long.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Anointed Ritualist
ability.lore: The skin of a worthy champion is smeared with oil and daubed with sacred blood runes, and they are granted the honour of leading those gory rituals beloved of Morathi-Khaine.
ability.declare: If there are no friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE HERO** on the battlefield to be the target.
ability.effect: The target is **anointed** for the rest of the battle, even if it has been destroyed. Friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield treat **EXALTED** abilities on the warscrolls of friendly **anointed** units that have been destroyed as if they were on their warscrolls.

ability.name: Pit Tinkerer
ability.lore: This mechanically minded Skaven has a compulsion to make ‘improvements’ to the Skryre devices under his command.
ability.effect: You can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for the Move characteristic of friendly **SKRYRE WAR MACHINES** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. In addition, each time a friendly **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** wholly within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rolling Doom’ or ‘Whirling Doom’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any.

ability.name: Royal Imperative
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Desperate to honour their liege, the Tide Guard strike a decisive blow.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round:

***Into Them!:*** Friendly units have **STRIKE-FIRST**.

***Strike Sure:*** Friendly units’ melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
ability.additionalRulesText: You can only use this ability in the third battle round.

ability.name: Celebrity Warlord
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: This hero has gained a cult following that seeks them out on the battlefield.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: All-out Defence
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
ability.lore: The soldiers close ranks to hold off an incoming attack.
ability.usedBy: A unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **save rolls** for that unit until that **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Wave of Terror
ability.lore: Many foes freeze in fear when faced by a swarming Nighthaunt charge.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability if it charged this phase and the charge roll was 10+. Then, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** this turn.

ability.name: Fight Another Day
ability.lore: This warlord has mastered the ignoble art of striking then running away before the enemy can hit back.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

ability.name: Mantle of Tusk and Horns
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Trophies taken from slain behemoths adorn the shoulders of this gargant, and through them they can channel the power of the Waaagh!.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Gossamid Champion
ability.lore: Elthwin directs her Gossamid kin to let fly volleys of suppressing shots.
ability.declare: Pick the **Arch-Revenant** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, the pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract X from charge rolls for the target, where X is the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by shooting attacks made by the **Gossamid Archers** unit in the Regiment of Renown, to a maximum of 6.

ability.name: Discorporate
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: If given the order, the Nighthaunt can flicker between the realms of the living and dead.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Summoner of Plaguebearers
ability.lore: Channelling a link to the Realm of Chaos, the Spoilpox Scrivener brings forth more minions.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit wholly within 14" of your general.
ability.effect: Return 1 slain model to that unit.

ability.name: Colossal Slam
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The Mega-Gargant hoicks the foe over their shoulder and slams them full force into the ground.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‐GARGANT** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy **MONSTER** or **WAR MACHINE** that has a unit size of 1 and is within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the unit using this ability. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Fold Reality
ability.lore: The sorcerer contorts the very fabric of the cosmos, allowing their minions to slip from hither to thither in an eye-blink.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 6+, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of your general and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Treesong
ability.lore: Your general implores the spirits of the wyldwoods to guide the blades of their allies.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 7+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Glowy Shield of Protectiness
ability.lore: While raiding a lair belonging to the ratty pipsqueaks, this gargant found a shield studded with sickly green rock – and promptly strapped it to their body. Enemies who get close sometimes have their heads explode, which is always good for a laugh.
ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Mawpits of Ghur
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: These highly aggressive, teeth-filled rents in the ground are drawn to the wider realms by the Butchers’ gastromantic magic.
ability.effect:
Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.

**2-3 – *Subdued*:**
No effect.

**4-5 – *Peckish*:**
Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.

**6-8 – *Rumbling*:**
Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

**9-11 – *Famished*:**
Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.

**12+ – *Ravenous*:**
Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Mighty Archaeossian
ability.lore: The fossilised bone from which this commander is formed is supernaturally hard.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+).**

ability.name: Lord of the Arcane Aegis
ability.lore: Even in undeath, this wight still recalls all manner of warding cantrips to protect his forces from the enemy.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following keywords:

• **INFANTRY**
• **CAVALRY**
• **MONSTER**
• **BEAST**
