For the rest of the battle, each time an attack targets this unit, if the attacking unit has the keyword you picked, an unmodified save roll of 4+ for that attack is always successful.

ability.name: Double Stomp
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: It is quite a sight to see a Mega-Gargant perform a precarious hop, bringing both enormous feet down with enough force to squash a Steam Tank flat.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: Roll a D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the **Almighty Stomp** or **Almightier Stomp** of the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Harness Daemonic Power
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Helsmiths of Hashut believe themselves above the fell influence of Chaos and readily harness daemonic power to embolden their spellcraft and ensorcelled weapons.
ability.effect:
You must use this ability at the start of each of your hero phases. Remove all **daemonic power points** from each friendly unit. Then, gain a number of **daemonic power points** equal to the current battle round number plus 1.

Then, allocate your **daemonic power points** to friendly units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 **daemonic power points**. Then, all unallocated **daemonic power points** are lost.

**Designer’s Note:** *Your units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each unit has.*

ability.name: Gnarled Warrior
ability.lore: This Sylvaneth’s battlescarred hide has turned aside countless blades.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for your general.

ability.name: Incessant Drive
ability.phaseDetails: End of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: As the Stampede moves ever faster, they accrue more and more power and momentum.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the momentum scores of friendly **MAW-GRUNTA** units.

ability.name: Hide-shelter!
ability.lore: Volt-Klaw is insanely protective of his arsenal - afact that his long- suffering underlings use as an excuse to shelter behind sturdier weapons when needed.
ability.effect: While a friendly **VOLT-KLAW'S ENGINECOVEN INFANTRY** unit is within the combat range of a friendly **VOLT-KLAW'S ENGINECOVEN Ratling Warpblaster**, it is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

ability.name: Fog of Despair
ability.lore: The advance of Phulgoth’s entourage is shrouded by miasmas of concentrated misery.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target units in this Regiment of Renown while they are wholly within 9" of the **Harbinger of Decay** in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Charge
ability.lore: With a mighty battle cry, the warriors charge into combat with the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** and has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a **charge roll** of 2D6.
ability.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the **charge** **roll**. That unit **can** move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and **must** end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has **charged**.

ability.name: Plucky Git
ability.lore: This swaggering boss radiates confidence, shouting encouragements' to the ladz and taunting the foe with obscene gestures. Confidence is a fragile thing for a grot, however...
ability.effect: While this unit has no damage points, friendly **DROGGZ'S** **GITMOB** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 9" of this unit.

ability.name: Sudden Emergence
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: Braggit and his ladz tend to turn up wherever they are least expected (and least desired).
ability.declare: If the **Rabble-Rowza** in this Regiment of Renown is **in a** **super-secret tunnel**, pick it to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up the target anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other friendly units that are **in a super-secret tunnel** within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Into Da Breach!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Zoggrok’s ladz live for the moment when it’s time to storm the enemy gates with every ounce of ferocity they can muster.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ** unit that is more than 9" from any enemy units and had any damage points allocated to it this turn.
ability.effect: That unit can move D6". It cannot pass through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Venomite Swarm
ability.lore: Lethal venom drips from the fangs and claws of Sotek's Venomites.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: If your general's **Venomites** token is on the battlefield, roll a D3. On a 1, remove that token from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Ply the Skies
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for an Arkanaut Frigate
ability.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
ability.usedBy: The **Arkanaut Frigate** that is using that **MOVE** ability.
ability.effect: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that is wholly within the combat range of that **Arkanaut Frigate** and not in combat to be transported. Remove that **INFANTRY** unit from the battlefield. Then, when the **Arkanaut Frigate** ends its move, set up the **INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield again, wholly within the combat range of the **Arkanaut Frigate** and not in combat. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

ability.name: Immortal Elite
ability.phaseDetails: Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Ossiarch legions march to war in perfect unison, efficiently and precisely enacting the will of their generals without the mortal inadequacies of doubt, fear or regret.
ability.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: You gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number after the target's **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **relentless discipline** points are lost.

ability.name: Blighted Growth
ability.lore: Gifted in the seeding of blighted earth, the Pustules can always coax part of the Grandfather’s rancid orchard into existence.
ability.effect: Set up this Regiment of Renown’s **Feculent Gnarlmaw** wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

ability.name: 'Orrible Leer
ability.lore: The awful grin of this orruk can send chills down the spine of even the most blood-crazed monsters.
ability.effect: Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Rune of Restored Hearth
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Upon striking this rune, Norgrimm and his kin are filled with a tenacious impulse to restore their people’s glory.
ability.effect: If the **Runelord** in the Regiment of Renown is contesting an objective, for the rest of the battle, units in this Regiment of Renown have **WARD (5+)** while they are contesting that objective.

ability.name: The Rising Dead
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Regrowth
ability.lore: Your general channels an invigorating bloom of magic.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 5+, **Heal (D6)** the target.

ability.name: Skavenbrew
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This foul concoction, brewed from blood and warpstone, is dispensed to expendable underlings to drive them into a short-lived but devastating killing frenzy.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Super-Secret Tunnels
ability.lore: Rabble-Rowzas have a knack for locating hidden passages beneath the earth.
ability.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in a **super-secret tunnel**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: All to Dust
ability.lore: Acting as a conduit to the Shyish Nadir, the death magic that swirls around this barrow legion’s tomb causes trespassers to atrophy and their armour to corrode under the weight of ages.
ability.effect: In the third and subsequent battle rounds, while a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** is on the battlefield, subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.

ability.name: Frenzied Violence
ability.lore: Zarxor's chanting inspires an insensate frenzy in his followers.
ability.declare: Pick the **Slaughterpriest** in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a visible unit in this Regiment of Renown wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target unit has **WARD (5+)** while every model in that unit is wholly within the combat range of an enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

ability.name: Stalking Blades
ability.lore: The enemy’s minds are filled with doubts as to their allies’ true loyalties, which manifest as tenebrous shades that stalk among their ranks. As soon as the victims’ backs are turned, these gheists dart forth to plunge spectral daggers between the shoulders of those overcome with paranoia.
ability.declare: Pick the **Mannfred von Carstein** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

ability.name: Mighty Destroyers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Ironjawz won’t let anything get between them and a good scrap.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

ability.name: Murderous Epiphany
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Khainites are struck by a terrible vision of the Bloody-Handed God that drives their zeal to ever greater heights.
ability.effect: All friendly units gain the **Blood Rites** passive ability they would have gained at the start of the next battle round (they keep this ability for the rest of the battle, but they do not gain it for a second time at the start of the next battle round).

ability.name: Unbind
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
ability.lore: The wizard saps the energy from an enemy’s spell, nullifying its effects.
ability.usedBy: A friendly **WIZARD** within 30" of the enemy **WIZARD** casting the spell.
ability.effect: Make an **unbinding roll** of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the **casting roll** for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per **casting roll**.

ability.name: Descent From Ruinous Skies
ability.lore: Riding down from fell portals torn open in the sky, the Swords of Chaos descend to unleash apocalyptic destruction upon the enemies of the Everchosen.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that is **in the Ruinous Skies**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Beastmaster
ability.lore: This mighty leader has a primal dominance over the beasts of the Seraphon hosts, driving them forward to battle.
ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SERAPHON CAVALRY** and **SERAPHON MONSTER** units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.

ability.name: Master of Temptation
ability.lore: Twisting the old adage, this hero demonstrates that good things do not come to those who wait.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if your opponent has any **temptation dice**. Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while your opponent has not used any of their **temptation dice** to replace a roll for the target this turn, the target can only use **CORE** abilities.

ability.name: Talisman of the Nadir
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
ability.lore: A tiny, spell-eating mote of the Shyish Nadir rages in this ornate hourglass, devouring enemy magics with eager abandon.
ability.effect: If a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability.

ability.name: Redeploy
ability.lore: Taking initiative, the warriors hastily reposition to respond to enemy movements.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move **cannot** pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

ability.name: Hallowed Scrolls
ability.lore: Sacred parchments inscribed with Sigmarite blessings adorn this warrior.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase, Enemy Movement Phase
ability.lore: The best-laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.
ability.effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Unholy Visage
ability.lore: Even the mightiest feel a glimmer of fear in the face of this creature's unutterably foul appearance.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target must immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were the enemy movement phase. Immediately after that ability has been resolved, if the target is in combat, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on it.

ability.name: Cover of Night
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Mannfred is a master of misdirection; few can predict where his hosts will strike from next.
ability.declare: Pick 1 friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Arcane Immunity
ability.lore: Forged to fight wars at the Perimeter Inimical, the Null Myriad are innately resistant to even the most potent magic.
ability.effect: Friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units have **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS.**

ability.name: Rituals of Ruin
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The mightiest of the beastmen worship the power of primeval Chaos, slaughtering and devouring in order to be blessed with strength or to force their opponents into throes of primal savagery.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Warping Curse:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO** or, if there is a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO** in reserve, within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

***Brand of Wild Fury:*** Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO** or, if there is a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO** in reserve, wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **WARD (6+)** for the rest of the turn.

***Bestial Instinct:*** Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO** or, if there is a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO** in reserve, wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Tepok the Seer
ability.lore: The sign of Tepok, resplendent in the stars above, enlivens the land with thrumming geomantic energy.
ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **SERAPHON** units.

ability.name: Ranu's Lamentiri
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
ability.lore: Even in death, Ranu lends sorcerous strength to their kin.
ability.effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

ability.name: Reckless Abandon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: With the death frenzy upon them, the Gnawhorde's warriors show a most unusual disregard for self-preservation.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target those friendly units.

ability.name: Greed Pistons
ability.lore: At great expense the Daemonsmiths have fitted this machine with advanced piston assemblies, enabling it to perform fearsome turns of speed.
ability.effect: When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

ability.name: Flying High
ability.lore: Often one skyvessel will hold back high above the battlefield, only to descend and deploy additional troops where and when they are most needed.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** that is in a regiment from which no units have been deployed, then pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are in its regiment.
ability.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve **in the clouds**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Feeding Frenzy
ability.lore: To witness an abhorrant at war spurs a mad hunger in the ghouls
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **HEROES** that have 6 **noble deeds points**.

ability.name: Helm of Tyranny
ability.lore: This helm radiates the oppressive will of the wearer, filling nearby foes with supernatural dread.
ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Ironweld Discipline
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Enemy Shooting Phase
ability.lore: With nerves of steel, the crew of the Great Cannon prepare to fire even as enemies close in on all sides.
ability.declare: Pick your **Ironweld Great Cannon** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, it can use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase.

ability.name: Godshadow Talisman
ability.lore: This unassuming amulet subtly alters the bearer’s form so that even the most determined strikes have a chance to harmlessly pass through them.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: Summon the Storm
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: With a voice of booming thunder, Bastian can call forth his warriors, bringing them down in the heart of the enemy army.
ability.declare: If a friendly **Bastian Carthalos** is on the battlefield and was not set up this turn, you can pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is **in the Celestial Realm**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Bastian** **Carthalos** and more than 3" from all enemy units. If the target is a unit of **Annihilators** or **Annihilators with Meteoric** **Grandhammers**, for the rest of the turn, the target counts as having used the 'Scions of the Storm' ability for the purposes of the 'Blazing Impact' ability.

ability.name: Guided by Morai-Heg
ability.lore: Morai-Heg guides her followers’ weapons into subtle chinks in the enemy’s armour.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of combat attacks made by friendly non-**HERO INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Krethusa**.

ability.name: A Quest Well Done
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: To excel in the Everchosen’s eyes brings Utgar and his followers a fleeting glee.
ability.effect: If the enemy **ENEMY OF THE EVERCHOSEN** unit is destroyed by a unit in this Regiment of Renown, add 10 to the control score of each unit in this Regiment of Renown for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Dread Marshal
ability.lore: This mighty warrior has proved their devotion to Be’lakor above all, and their loyalty has been rewarded with a host of warriors to command.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Sustained by Gore
ability.lore: Karanak can pursue a target endlessly, provided the blood keeps flowing.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** your general.

ability.name: Masterwrought Armour
ability.lore: This Admiral’s finely crafted suit of armour is the acme of the armourer’s art.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Power Through
ability.lore: The warriors use their sheer mass or resilience to drive through a group of weaker foes, leaving broken bodies in their wake.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit **in combat** with it to be the target. The target must have a lower **Health** characteristic than the unit using this ability.
ability.effect: Inflict **D3 mortal damage** on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its **Move** characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

ability.name: Blessed by the Old Ones
ability.lore: The Sunblood is whisked away by powers unseen moments before a fatal blow can fall, perhaps granting his indomitable spirit time enough to bring him to his feet once more.
ability.declare: Your general must use this ability if it has been destroyed. Roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 2+, you can set up a replacement unit with 1 **Sunblood** model anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Cycle Manifestation
ability.lore: With a deft gesture, the caster dismisses one manifestation and uses its power to summon another.
ability.declare:
Pick the **Scinari Calligrave** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Sanctum of Amyntok**
**• Hyshian Twinstones**
**• Rune of Petrification**
ability.effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished. Then, set up the Manifestation you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that **MANIFESTATION** is a **Sanctum of Amyntok**, it must instead be set up wholly within 12" of the caster, more than 3" from all enemy units, and with its 3 parts touching each other so that they form a ring.

ability.name: Deploy Unit
ability.lore: Additional forces take to the field.
ability.declare: Pick a **unit** from your army roster that has not been **deployed** to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been **deployed**.

ability.name: Leave the Land in Ruin
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: Both raw resources and esoteric pain are needed to fuel the Helsmiths’ forge-craft, demanding they lay lands to waste.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature or objective that does not have a friendly **desolation token** and is contested by a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: Give the target a **desolation token**.

ability.name: Propeller Downdraught
ability.lore: The buffeting air currents kicked up by the Gunhauler as it flies low mean that nearby foes seeking to engage the Kharadron find themselves charging into a headwind.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 9" of a friendly **Grundstok Gunhauler**.

ability.name: Standard Bearer
ability.lore: The unit’s standard provides a rallying point in the chaos of battle.
ability.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s **control score**.

ability.name: Ruler of the Spectral Hosts
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The deathly power of this spirit is like a siren call, an unseen signal that beckons to those who have passed beyond the grave.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.

ability.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
ability.lore: This officar has trained under and alongside all the myriad factions that dwell within the walls of the Cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. If this unit is **HUMAN**, pick up to 3 eligible units to be the targets instead.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:

• If the target is **HUMAN**, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• If the target is **DUARDIN**, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• If the target is **AELF**, add 3 to the target’s control score.

ability.name: Lash of the Sire
ability.lore: Such is the domineering force of this undead overlord’s willpower that it can imbue nearby vassals with sudden impetus.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:

•  If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
•  If the target is in combat, it can make a pile‑in move.

ability.name: The Ritual Dance
ability.lore: To properly welcome high summer and its magnificent king, the peasantfolk cavort and caper around grand maypoles and idols – even those that are carried by rival revellers.
ability.effect: In the third battle round, while a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit is in combat with an enemy unit that contains any champions, musicians or standard bearers, it can move 6" instead of 3" when it makes a pile-in move.

ability.name: Insubstantial
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits are nigh impossible to land a blow upon.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: A Prize Quarry is Sighted
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: When a mighty prey is sighted, the hunters of Kurnoth focus all their efforts upon taking it down, for only a successful kill will appease their master.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target becomes the **quarry** for the rest of the battle. If there was already a **quarry** on the battlefield when you declared this ability, that unit is no longer the **quarry**.

ability.name: Infested with Wonders
ability.lore: These foul warriors invite the most horrific and repulsive diseases into their flesh, and they cannot wait to share them.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly model is slain, before it is removed from play, you can pick an enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

ability.name: Life Begets Life
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has all of its models within 1" of a terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit.

ability.name: Close-Quarters Drill
ability.lore: Kreel has trained his Grenadiers to hold their fire until it can be unloaded right in their foes’ faces.
ability.effect: Friendly units’ ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat** but you must subtract 1 from hit rolls for their shooting attacks while they are in combat.

ability.name: Enemy of the Throne
ability.lore: Sent by royal decree against those known to have mocked or derided Kurdoss Valentian, the bolts of the Craven throne Executioners are guided by spite-filled sentence scribed on the mark's death warrant.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown for attacks that target a **SENTENCED** unit.

ability.name: Monstrous Momentum
ability.lore: The longer the Grunta Stampede goes on, the more it picks up speed…
ability.effect: Add the current battle round number to the Move characteristic of friendly **GRUNTA STAMPEDE** units.

ability.name: Dark Apotheosis
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Favoured by the Dark Gods, this champion is bestowed with fell glory.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit with 8 or more **Dark Apotheosis** points to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:

***Aura of Chaos***: **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to the target. In addition, the target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.

***Daemonhood***: Set up a **Daemon Prince** within 1" of the target. Then, remove the target from the battlefield. If the target is your general, the **Daemon Prince** becomes your general instead and is added to your general’s regiment. If the target has any enhancements, the **Daemon Prince** has those enhancements instead. If the target has a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword, the **Daemon Prince** has the same keyword. Otherwise, pick 1 **Pledge to Chaos** keyword for the **Daemon Prince** to have for the rest of the battle. If any **MANIFESTATIONS** that were summoned by the target are on the battlefield, those **MANIFESTATIONS** are removed from play.

ability.name: Pullin' Ahead
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: In their race across the realms, Zog and Goz will blithely pile on the speed and go crashing straight through enemy lines.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that charged this turn and has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move D6". It must end that move in combat. Then, add 1 to the target’s **momentum points**. After this ability has been resolved, the target cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Armour of Gork
ability.lore: This bashed-together armour is thick, heavy and possessed of its own fierce fighting spirit.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Deathly Possessor
ability.lore: In a flash ofbalefire, the Nighthaunt vanishes. An instant later, a nearby foe's eyes glow with spectral power and they lash out at their allies, cackling in a voice not their own.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target with that weapon against the victim.

ability.name: Brace!
ability.lore: With a keen eye for incoming attacks, this Ogor Warhulk is adept at rebuffing any and all threats made towards the Fusil-Major riding atop its gun platform.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+).**

ability.name: Contingent Arrival
ability.lore: Marching in perfect unison, a reinforcing unit of Mortek Guard arrives.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
ability.subsectionLore: The Ossiarch commanders will bolster their forces wherever battle is met.
ability.subsectionRulesText: One of your **Mortek Guard** units is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the third battle round onwards, it can use the Contingent Arrival ability.

ability.name: Cruising Into Position
ability.lore: The Aelsling’s speed and agility allow her to enter battle at the perfect moment.
ability.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that have not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up all of those units in reserve **plying the winds**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Booming Roar
ability.lore: Relishing the fight, your general roars a challenge to the enemy that makes the very earth beneath their feet tremble.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units this phase while they are within 9" of your general.

ability.name: Rearing Strike
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The Magmadroth raises itself up and comes crashing down on its prey, itsclaws lacerating flesh and its sheer weight cruising bones and metal.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll 2 dice. Add 2 to each roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. For each 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Bonesplitterz Waaagh!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Their warpaint blazing with ferocious energy, the Bonesplitterz surge forward under the potent mystical guidance of their shamans.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly **BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD** and **BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST** to be the targets.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the power level of each target for the rest of the turn. In addition, friendly **BONESPLITTERZ** units have **WARD** (**5+)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Spirit-eater
ability.lore: The souls of slain enemies are drawn into this king of undeath, imbuing him with unholy might.
ability.effect: If any models were slain by your general this turn, **Heal (D6)** your general.

ability.name: Scions of the Storm
ability.lore: Upon blessed bolts of lightning do the Stormcast Eternals ride to war, the furious rumble of thunder heralding their arrival.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is **in the** **Celestial Realm**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Re-form Ranks
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: A group of Bonereapers swiftly disengages from combat with flawless precision.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** unit in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use a **RETREAT** ability this phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

ability.name: Daemonfire Weapons
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: As if kissed by the breath of the Chimera, the weapons of these warriors blaze with black flames that make a mockery of armour.
ability.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit that has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Shield of Fate
ability.lore: There is little better protection than to be guided by destiny itself.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 6+, until the start of your next turn, that unit has **WARD (6+)**. If that unit already has a ward save, add 1 to ward rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn instead.

ability.name: Delusions and Madness
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Flesh‑eaters’ delusions can change on a whim.
ability.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round. If it is the first battle round, pick a **DELUSION**. Otherwise, make a delusion roll by rolling a D6.
ability.effect: On a 1-3, you must pick a different **DELUSION** to the one you picked last time. On a 4+, you must pick the same **DELUSION** as last time. For the rest of the battle round, you believe the **DELUSION** you picked.

ability.name: The Banner of Screaming Flesh
ability.lore: Fashioned from flayed aelven faces that scream in perpetual agony, the exhilarating pitch of this banner heightens the senses of the followers of the Dark Prince.
ability.effect:
This unit has the **PLEDGED TO SLAANESH** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, if this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Silver Summoner
ability.lore: This hero can channel an Argent Shard’s eldritch power to create uncanny simulacra of fallen warriors.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**WARFLOCK ARCANITE** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of a friendly **ARGENT SHARD** that is visible to this unit.

ability.name: Almost Lucid
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Delusions and Madness’ ability
ability.lore: This vampire has just enough sanity to faintly manipulate their madness.
ability.effect: You can re-roll the delusion roll.

ability.name: Wind Whisperer
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Hurakan Windmages have the greatest connection to the wind spirits, able to call on their aid to shift the weather to their advantage.
ability.declare: Pick a battlefield edge to be the target.
ability.effect: Change the **leeward** battlefield edge to the target battlefield edge.

ability.name: Nurgle's Embrace
ability.lore: The Grandfather’s generosity proves overwhelming for many…
ability.effect: Spend any number of your **disease points**. For each disease point you spend, pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any of your units and roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit (you can pick the same unit more than once).

ability.name: Infernal Gateway
ability.lore: The sorcerer opens a portal to the Realm of Chaos, pulling enemies to their doom.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 5+, roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of battle tactic cards you have discarded this battle. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Unbind
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
ability.lore: The wizard saps the energy from an enemy’s spell, nullifying its effects.
ability.usedBy: A friendly **WIZARD** within 30" of the enemy **WIZARD** casting the **spell**.
ability.effect: Make an **unbinding roll** of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the **casting roll** for the spell, then the spell is **unbound** and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per **casting roll**.

ability.name: Dutiful Souls
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Tide Guard will fight to protect their King even when gravely wounded.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: You can return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target is an **INFANTRY** unit, you can return D3 slain models to it instead.

ability.name: Wracked with Disease
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Maggotkin wage war with weeping wounds and pustulant boils as well as with rusted weapons.
ability.declare: Pick each **DISEASED** enemy unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

ability.name: Celestium-burst Bomblets
ability.lore: Long-standing trade agreements with Azyrheim have allowed the production of these munitions, which have a disruptive effect on supernatural defences.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Timberrrrr!
ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
ability.effect: When the **MEGA‑GARGANT** in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

ability.name: Clank, Clank, Clank
ability.lore: Da Red Gobbo puts the suit into overdrive, and off it goes!
ability.effect:
Roll 3D6. If Da Red Gobbo is within a number of inches of the **exit point** equal to the roll, he escapes, the battle ends immediately and both players **lose**.

Otherwise, pick a point on the battlefield within a number of inches of Da Red Gobbo equal to the roll. That point must be as near as possible to the **exit point**. Remove Da Red Gobbo from the battlefield and set him up again as near as possible to that point and more than 1" from all terrain features. If you are the **underdog**, set him up again within 6" of that point and more than 1" from all terrain features instead.

ability.name: The Clammy Cowl
ability.lore: This enchanted hood wreathes its wearer in damp gloom, causing enemies to swing wildly at their blurred outline and weapons to slip in suddenly moistened palms.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target your general.

ability.name: Mage-swallower
ability.lore: Ever since they ate an entire party of wizardly scholars, the mere presence of this ogor is enough to disrupt magical defences.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

ability.name: Respected Leader
ability.lore: On occasion, a brigade will attract more Wildercorps Hunters than normal, as word reaches their ears of a commander worthy of their loyalty.
ability.effect: Friendly **Wildercorps Hunters** units gain the **REINFORCEMENTS** keyword.

ability.name: All-out Defence
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
ability.lore: The soldiers close ranks to hold off an incoming attack.
ability.usedBy: A unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **save rolls** for that unit in this phase.

ability.name: What're You Lookin' At?
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: Bleary eyes narrowed, the gargant picks a fight with a cocky-looking target.
ability.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it charged this turn and has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn. Then, pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can pass through enemy models and must end that move in combat with the target.

ability.name: Black Ritual Dagger
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: Dark tendrils of chaotic magic coil around this obsidian blade. The bearer’s mind is filled with promises of arcane power if its thirst for blood is quenched.
ability.effect: Allocate 1 damage point to this unit. Then, you can re-roll the casting roll.

ability.name: Realmwarper's Twist-rune
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: One who bears this cursed rune can bind warped landscapes to their will. Ruptured chasms open as thick palls of dark energy obscure the favoured and their servants from view.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: If the target does not have the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability, it gains that ability until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a dice for each model (friendly and enemy) within 1" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.

ability.name: Shrewd Opportunist
ability.lore: This duardin’s mind is as sharp as a gem cutter. They are quick to see openings and do not hesitate to seize upon them. Such a quality is, of course, highly conducive to profit!
ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS** non-**HERO INFANTRY** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Each target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Shadowy Aura
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: A pall of gloom hangs over this champion, concealing the movements of nearby gheists and allowing them to ambush their victims.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Field Sergeant
ability.lore: This notable individual knows precisely how to complement the general’s style of leadership, ensuring the efficient manoeuvring of their ground forces.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**FLY** **INFANTRY HERO** in, but not leading, a regiment to be that regiment’s **honour guard**. You can pick a unit in reserve.
ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-**FLY INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of the **honour guard**.

ability.name: Cage of Warp Lightning
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A ‘gift’ to the Grey Seer from the Clans Skryre, when this unstable device works correctly, it can momentarily trap its victims in a prison of thrashing galvanic tendrils.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of your general and roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 2+, the enemy unit has **STRIKE-LAST** this phase. On a 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on your general.

ability.name: Sapwood Leader
ability.lore: This young and vibrant general flourishes with the life-giving magic of the Everqueen.
ability.effect: If you pick this unit to be a target of the 'Abundant Growth’ ability, **Heal (3)** this unit instead of **Heal (1)**.

ability.name: Urgent Missive
ability.lore: Sir Jerrion and his retainers are devoted to their holy duty, which sees them lope and scrabble across the battlefield with terrifying haste.
ability.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on units in this Regiment of Renown by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Driven By Starvation
ability.lore: Each offering the Head Butcher submits to the Mawpit is one fewer scrap for a ravening Gorger.
ability.effect: Friendly **Gorger Mawpack** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.

ability.name: Monsta-killa Chompa
ability.lore: No beast worth its bones can escape the bite of this boss’s chompa.
ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it is in combat with an enemy **BEAST** or **MONSTER**.

ability.name: Monster Hunters
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: Bonesplitterz mobs are adept at bringing down the many ferocious monsters that inhabit the Mortal Realms.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ** unit in combat with an enemy **MONSTER** to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for the target.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units, excluding **Nagash.**

ability.name: Chalice of the Blood Dragon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Said to have been possessed by the Crimson Keep’s first castellan, this chalice can be drained to renew a vampire’s vigour.
ability.effect: **Heal (3D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Da Loonking's Court
ability.lore: The vast hoards of looted treasure held in the deepest, darkest caverns of the Loonking’s empire are legendary.
ability.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly non-**UNIQUE KING’S GITZ HEROES** that do not have an enhancement.
ability.effect:
Give each **HERO** 1 enhancement from the ‘Da King’s Gitz’ Army of Renown rules.

**Designer’s Note**: *These enhancements are given to the* **HEROES** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: Heartwood Hunting Horn
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Grown in the forests of Kurnotheal, this horn emits a melody that naturally harmonises with the song of the hunt.
ability.effect: You gain 1 **chord**.

ability.name: Illusory Infiltration
ability.lore: Cunning glamours conceal the advance of Kairic cultists.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-reinforced **CHANGE-CULT KAIRIC ACOLYTES** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat.

ability.name: Bursting With Life
ability.lore: Guts roil and buboes weep before cheering Nurglings burst forth from the slain.
ability.effect: If a friendly non-**NURGLE’S GIFT** unit would be destroyed, before the last model is removed from play, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each other friendly non-**NURGLE’S GIFT** unit that has been destroyed this battle. On a 5+, pick a friendly unit that is **festering within** and set it up wholly within 6" of that model. It can be set up in combat.

ability.name: Ethereal Translocation
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The Nighthaunt appear and disappear from sight to torment their prey.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Supplies Dont Come Cheap
ability.lore: Profiteers will dispatch aid to beleaguered allies in exchange for payment.
ability.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the **Codewright** in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.

ability.name: Monstrously Tough
ability.lore: This greedy gargant always takes the juiciest spoils of battle and has an impressive gut as a result.
ability.effect: Your general has a Health characteristic of 15 instead of 12.

ability.name: Gun Butt Low Blow
ability.lore: Grizzled veterans all, the Grundcorps are used to fighting dirty if it means getting what they want.
ability.effect: While a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY** unit is contesting an objective that you control, its melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.

ability.name: Silver Simulacrum
ability.lore: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.
ability.effect:
If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

ability.name: Pledged to Nurgle
ability.lore: The Father of Plagues bestows gifts of rot and decay upon his followers.
ability.effect: Friendly **PLEDGED TO NURGLE** units have **WARD (6+).** If a unit already has **WARD (6+),** it has **WARD (5+)** instead.

ability.name: Rousing Oration
ability.lore: The Archregent looses a soul-chilling howl, which is perceived as an inspiring call to gallantry by their deranged followers.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general. Do not roll a dice for your general. For each 5+, give 1 **noble deeds point** to your general.

ability.name: Crunchy Shinies
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: When eaten, these glimmering crystal shards allow a troggoth to move with something approaching agility – a novel feeling for these naturally lumbering brutes.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Sickly Sores
ability.lore: The blighted seeds released by the Feculent Gnarlmaws invigorate those who tend the Garden.
ability.effect: While a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE INFANTRY** unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to it in each phase.

ability.name: Leave No Duardin Behind
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: With a rousing speech, the Admiral rallies his crew and steels their resolve.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of your general and roll a dice for each slain model from that unit.
ability.effect: For each 4+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

ability.name: Take Da Bait
ability.lore: When a group of enemies hurl themselves at a line of grinnin’ Bonesplitterz, too late they realise it was all a trap…
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **BONESPLITTERZ** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons while it is in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn, and so long as the target has not charged during the battle.

ability.name: The Rising Dead
ability.lore: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the grave**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: The Wrath of Chotec
ability.lore: An ancient relic removed from the deepest temple vaults, this gauntlet allows an Oldblood to channel the full might of the Seraphon’s solar god.
ability.effect: The Attacks characteristic of your general’s **Sunbolt** **Gauntlet** is 6 instead of D6.

ability.name: Voidchill Darkness
ability.lore: This breed can turn the ethersea around it ice-cold and dark.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit if this unit charged this turn.

ability.name: Fearless Fliers
ability.lore: Such is the bond between this rider and their mount that they can perform the most graceful aerial manoeuvres in order to close the distance on their prey.
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately make a D6" move and can end that move in combat.

ability.name: Pay Your Debts
ability.lore: Grungsson never forgets an insult and always settles the score with those who have done him wrong.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield or in reserve to be **indebted**.
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** units that target the **indebted** unit.

ability.name: Warpstone Charm
ability.lore: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units in combat with your general.

ability.name: Living Landmark
ability.lore: Despite their great size, when some troggoths lie down for a snooze, they are easy to mistake for just another part of the landscape…
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a **living landmark**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: The Blackstorm Apostates
ability.lore: These warriors are a rare prize indeed for the Everchosen: Azyrites who have embraced Chaos and speed themselves with imprisoned and tortured celestial winds.
ability.effect: Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly units.

ability.name: Arcane Ritualists
ability.lore: This host specialises in esoterically gruesome sorcerous rituals.
ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for your general while they are wholly within 6" of another friendly unit.

ability.name: Wotnot of Prestige
ability.lore: The bearer of this junk-like trinket doesn’t really know what it does. The Loonking assured them it holds great power, and they weren’t really in a position to refuse. Now the question is how to make it work…
ability.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit. Each visible enemy unit within 3" of that point is a target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Initial Investment
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Kharadron doctrine emphasises the importance of good reconaissance.
ability.effect: Each friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** can move 2D6" but cannot finish that move in combat.

ability.name: Ancient Might
ability.lore: Of unfathomable age, this gigantic elder Treelord pulverises all in their path.
ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it is in combat. If the charge roll is 3 or less when it does so, it does not count as having charged.

ability.name: Form of the Fangmora
ability.lore: This champion has mastered a defensive sword-art that mimics the fluid movements of the swift Fangmora Eels.
ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

ability.name: Ethersea Predators
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The deep-sea beasts these warriors ride are driven into a feeding frenzy during battle.
ability.effect: Pick a friendly **CAVALRY** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn. **Heal (D3)** that unit.

ability.name: Quicksilver Draught
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This potion lends uncanny speed to the one who imbibes it.
ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Revel in Battle
ability.lore: No tricks - no deceptions.
ability.effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by enemy units that charged this turn and that target a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit have no effect.
ability.additionalRulesText: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Punish the Pacifist'.

ability.name: Shard of Necris
ability.lore: This ancient shard is a fragment of the armour known as the Necris Infinus. Though it was shattered in a war long ago, the remaining piece is still imbued with the darkest of Shyishan sorceries. Once worn by Haakesh the Indomitable and Kheramet the Undying, its potent magics render the wearer almost invulnerable. Almost...
ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

ability.name: The Decree of Nagash
ability.lore: With this revered artefact, imbued with magics of command and tyranny, Vokmortian's authority is such that he can cow enemy warriors into submission.
ability.declare: Pick the friendly **Vokmortian** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, each time your opponent declares a **FIGHT** ability for the target, unless they spend 1 command point as a reaction, that **FIGHT** ability has no effect.

**Designer's Note:** *That* **FIGHT** *ability does not count as a command.*

ability.name: Head of the Hunt
ability.lore: This warrior venerates the Hunter God Kurnoth as much as Alarielle. To them, the pursuit of the prey is a sacred act.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons while the enemy **quarry** is within 9" of and visible to them.

ability.name: Propelled by Hate
ability.lore: This warrior’s insatiable urge to slaughter the enemies of Nagash drives their deathless soldiers forward with sudden haste.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Predict the Future
ability.lore: Foresighted is forearmed, as the old saying goes.
ability.effect: You can look at up to 3 cards from the top of your battle tactic deck without adding them to your hand. Then, in any order, return each card face down to either the top or the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

ability.name: Soul Tax
ability.lore: Part of the Ossiarchs’ tithe is inevitably a portion of their allies’ souls.
ability.declare:
Pick the **Mortisan Ossifector** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then:

• Pick a friendly unit, excluding units in this Regiment of Renown, to be the target.
• Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the **recipient**.

The target and the **recipient** must be wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• The target has a maximum control score of 1.
• Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the **recipient**’s combat attacks.

ability.name: Murderous Acrobatics
ability.lore: Glowing eyes locked on his target, Crixxit deftly weaves past and leaps across any who would impede him.
ability.effect: When your general uses the ‘Charge’ ability, they can pass through enemy models.

ability.name: Crimson Draught
ability.lore: This vile mixture grants the drinker incredible bursts of speed. Fatal in all but the most controlled of doses, it is often 'gifted' to those whom Morathi is keeping an eye on.
ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Blade of the Kraken
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: In a decisive moment, Kreel fights ferociously to avenge Embergard’s fall – and also to maintain his warrior reputation…
ability.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of your general’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Prevailing Tactician
ability.lore: As one of Zandtos's direct subordinates, this Liege-Kavalos knows well how to lead the host while their lord engages in the more pressing business of egregious slaughter.
ability.effect: If a friendly **Arch-Kavalos Zandtos** is not wholly within 12" of this unit, you gain 2 **relentless discipline** points.

ability.name: Veteran Hunter
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase.
ability.lore: This ogor hunter has a keen eye and even keener hunger, which combine to make him as dangerous as a sudden avalanche.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general's combat attacks that target that unit.

ability.name: Leering Gitshield
ability.lore: The spiteful enchantments woven into this hideous shield ensure terrible misfortune falls on any who dare attack its bearer.
ability.effect: Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Shield of Azyr
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Roaring oaths to Sigmar, these warriors are surrounded by an aura of divine protection.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, that unit has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Rebuild On The March
ability.lore: Ossiarch war-constructs can fashion new warriors at a fearsome rate if bone is in ample supply.
ability.declare: Pick the **Gothizzar Harvester** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it has 6 **bone-tithe points**. Then, pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Reset the **Gothizzar Harvester**’s **bone-tithe points** to 0. Then, set up a replacement of the target unit with half the number of models (rounding up) wholly within 9" of the **Gothizzar Harvester** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Spirit of the Dark Forest
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: This Sylvaneth’s grim aspect strikes atavistic terror into those who meet its gaze.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Savage Abomination
ability.lore: Any foe in reach of this beast’s snapping jaws and fearsome claws is unlikely to see another dawn.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons.

ability.name: Curved Shots
ability.lore: Hurakan Windmages are trained in using the winds to launch attacks along bewildering and unexpected trajectories.
ability.effect: You can measure the range and visibility of your general’s shooting attacks from any point on the **leeward** battlefield edge.

ability.name: Overtaken by Events
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Stricken by indecision, the enemy’s leader flails helplessly.
ability.declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE‑CULT HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Activate Place of Power
ability.lore: The hero draws on the power of a nearby mythical landmark.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** within 3" of any **Places of Power** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that **HERO**. On a 2+:
• If that **HERO** is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that **HERO** this turn.
• If that **HERO** is not a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, they can use the ‘Unbind’ or ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability this turn as if they had **WIZARD (1)**.

ability.name: Lead the Seething Horde
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Call for Reinforcements’ ability
ability.lore: With screeched war cries, this Clawlord directs their vermin underlings to swarm the enemy.
ability.effect: Instead of using the set-up instructions in the ‘Call for Reinforcements’ ability, the replacement unit can be set up wholly within 13" of this unit and not in combat.

ability.name: Too Quick To Hit-hit
ability.lore: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.
ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Loontouched
ability.lore: This warlord’s magical prowess is boosted by the Bad Moon’s light.
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it has **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Realmroot Guide
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The spirit paths offer swift egress to this realms-wise Sylvaneth, who has an intricate knowledge of their wending ways.
ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
ability.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: World-Mage
ability.lore: While they have dedicated themselves to one of the elements, this mage has meditated long on the Hysh-Mhensa as a whole, unlocking truths that allow them to draw power from all aspects of the World Rune.
ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each unique rune depicted on your **battle scripture**.

ability.name: The Crimson Keep
ability.lore: None can predict where the Crimson Keep will manifest next, but wherever it appears, the slaughter its occupants will wreak will be total.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Crimson Keep**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the Crimson Keep** than there are on the battlefield.

ability.name: Foulhide
ability.lore: Fashioned from the flensed flesh of Rat Ogors and soaked in cloying alchemical agents, this stinking armour sticks to its wearer like a bloated second skin and regrows as fast as it can be hacked apart.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Rewards of Valour
ability.lore: Recognising excellence is a core precept among the ranks of the Vanari. Their finest are often rewarded with powerful heirlooms in recognition of their deeds.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE VANARI HERO** that does not have an artefact of power to be the target.
ability.effect:
Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Vanari Paragons' Army of Renown rules.

**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the* **HERO** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: Sigil of Morrda
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command or a **RAMPAGE** ability for a unit in combat with this unit
ability.lore: This sigil is one of the god Morrda, a death god that escaped Nagash’s purge of Shyish. Their power, perhaps not what it once was, is still potent and to be rightly feared.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or **RAMPAGE** ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.

ability.name: The Scarring Blade
ability.lore: It is said that wounds caused by this dagger never cease leaking blood - and that one who turns it upon themselves in bleak reverence will earn great favour.
ability.effect:
Allocate D3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add **X** to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units for the rest of the turn, where **X** is equal to the number of damage points allocated to this unit this turn by this ability.

For the rest of the battle, this unit cannot use the ‘Hate-fuelled Killers’ ability and cannot be healed.

ability.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: The best laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRITTOK'S CLAWPACK** unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: The Flagship
ability.lore: Every fleet commander designates one of their vessels to be their flagship.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** to be the target. The target can be in reserve.
ability.effect:
The target has the **FLAGSHIP** keyword for the rest of the battle. If the target does not have a Great Endrinwork, give the target 1 Great Endrinwork.

**Designer’s Note:** *This Great Endrinwork is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: The Dread Banner
ability.lore: Marked with sigils of each of the Dark Gods, the bearers of this banner strike fear into those who oppose them.
ability.effect: While this unit includes any standard bearers, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Lightshard of the Harvest Moon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This lightshard is filled with a baleful gloom that, upon release, casts the battlefield in an eerie glow, readying the enemy for the reaping.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Dark Hunt
ability.lore: A dire animus clings to this beast.
ability.effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn, it must use the ‘Charge’ ability, and if the charge roll would allow it to end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit, it must do so.

ability.name: Wrath of Brodd
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: When Brodd’s faithful stride into the fray, the mountains themselves tremble in terror.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: If the unit using this ability charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat.

ability.name: Flask of Vintage Gorogna
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: This rare duardin drink is said to be good for whatever ails you.
ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** your general.

ability.name: Blessing of Khaine
ability.lore: Sacred rites have been performed on this Melusai Ironscale by the priestesses of the temple, and it is said that she can bestow the blessing of Khaine upon her sisters in battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general. You cannot pick your general.
ability.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for that unit this phase.

ability.name: Rabble Rouser
ability.lore: This Mega-Gargant bellows at their kin to race forward and pummel the enemy into the dust.
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Crown of Cold Command
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: This eldritch crown compels this king’s warriors from ages past to rise from their graves and fight once more.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BARROW LEGION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
•  If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

ability.name: The Seal of Nagash
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This sigil, magically seared into this gheist's spectral form, binds them to Nagash so that he may readily drain their power to sustain himself at a moment's notice.
ability.effect: Allocate 3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, **Heal (3)** the friendly **Nagash.**

ability.name: Entropic Screech
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Cocking its head back, the Morrgryph unleashes a soul-piercing screech that causes foes to wither and collapse under its necrotic onslaught.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER MONSTER** that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with it to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. The unit using this ability cannot use any more **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Moon-toughened Hide
ability.lore: The light of the Bad Moon illuminates the troggoths’ craggy hides, its madcap magic rendering them even more resilient than usual.
ability.effect: In battle rounds 2 and 3, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** units.

ability.name: Grimnir's Defiance
ability.lore: For these vengeful Fyreslayers, the bigger the enemy, the better.
ability.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown cannot be picked to be the target of **RAMPAGE** abilities used by enemy units.

ability.name: Masterful Daemonworks
ability.lore: Those engines marshalled by the First Daemonsmith are masterworks of cursed engineering.
ability.effect: Friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WAR MACHINES** have **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Hallowed Scrolls
