ability.lore: Parchments inscribed with Sigmarite blessings adorn this warrior's armour.
ability.effect: If this unit is **INFANTRY**, it has **WARD (5+)**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Flanking Fire
ability.lore: A master of tactics, this officer is an expert at orchestrating deadly crossfires, often boldly using themselves as the bait.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSELS** that target an enemy unit in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Flawless Commander
ability.lore: This aelf has dedicated their life to mastering battlefield manoeuvres. Infantry formations that march under their banner operate in perfect unison, swiftly making way for each other and allowing them to advance with awe-inspiring discipline.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Overdrive Switch
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability for this unit
ability.lore: Pushing this war engine beyond its normal limits will wreak devastation on the enemy but risks damaging blowbacks from the daemonfire bound within it.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the phase:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including those made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit within 9" of it.
• Each time an unmodified hit roll for an attack made by this unit is 1, allocate 1 damage point to this unit after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Glimmering
ability.lore: The glinting facets of this tiny fragment of Mallus offer fleeting glimpses of the future.
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 save roll made for your general.

ability.name: Glorious Combat or Naught
ability.lore: The air boils, charring arrows and melting musket shot.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units.
ability.additionalRulesText: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Divine Scorn' or 'Punish the Pacifist'.

ability.name: Smoke and Mirrors
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: With sudden and terrible clarity, Tzeentch’s foes realise they have been fighting the wrong enemy all along.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and was not set up using this ability in the previous turn to be the target, then pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the substitute.
ability.effect: Set up the substitute wholly within 6" of the target and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

ability.name: Bathed in Blood
ability.lore: Your general draws vigour from the gore that splatters over her in battle.
ability.effect: Each time a model is slain by your general, **Heal (1)** your general.

ability.name: Spell in a Bottle
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The bearer pops the rune-stamped cork of this bottle and unleashes an arcane manifestation previously sealed up for safekeeping.
ability.effect: This unit can use a **SUMMON** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that **SUMMON** ability, the casting roll is 7 and cannot be modified. That **SUMMON** ability cannot be unbound.

ability.name: Bitter Roots
ability.lore: Where Drycha’s Talons roam, thorned vines and strangling roots, grown fat on the gore spilled by the Outcasts, churn through the undergrowth with malign intent.
ability.effect: If they do not otherwise have one, terrain features have a friendly **overgrown token** while they are contested by a **Spite-Revenants** unit in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Depict Rune
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: Channelling the power of their temple’s runes, the aelementiri bring their extraordinary powers to bear against the foe.
ability.declare: You must use this ability.
ability.effect:
Remove all runes from your **battle scripture**. Then, pick any number of runes to remove from your **library** and depict them on your **battle scripture**. Runes removed from your library in this way are removed for the rest of the battle.

**Designer’s Note:** *Runes are used to activate powerful abilities on your units’ warscrolls.*

ability.name: Nauseous Revulsion
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

ability.name: Warpstone Charm
ability.lore: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy that can be directed at an enemy unit to erode their armour.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Blessed by the Plaguefather
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Each of the Maggotkin is a walking vector of disease, a willing incubator for maladies that ravage the body and spirit with horrific virulence.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Infect:*** Pick an enemy unit within 7" of any friendly Maggotkin of Nurgle units to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.
• If the target is in combat with any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.
• If the target is not in combat with any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units, roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

***Spread:*** Pick a **DISEASED** enemy unit to be the target. Each other enemy unit within the target’s combat range, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, has the **DISEASED** keyword.

***Mutate:*** If all enemy units on the battlefield, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, have the **DISEASED** keyword, inflict 1 mortal damage on each of them.

ability.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
ability.lore: Grots are always vicious little monsters, but depending on the face of the moon, they can become an order of magnitude more dangerous.
ability.effect:
During the battle, the effects below apply to friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units based on the current face of the Bad Moon:

***Frothing Zealots***: While the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** or **Grinnin’**, add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**SQUIG** **MOONCLAN** units.

***Spiderfang Venom***: While the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** or **Grinnin’**, combat attacks made by friendly **SPIDERFANG** units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. This also affects **Companion** weapons.

***Moonlit Hide***: While the Bad Moon is **Grinnin’** or **Scowlin’**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly **TROGGOTH** units.

***Lunar Squigs***: While the Bad Moon is **Scowlin’** or **Sulkin’**, instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly **SQUIG** unit, you can use a value of 4.

***Sneaky Snarlfangs***: While the Bad Moon is **Sulkin’** or **Cacklin’**, friendly **GITMOB** units can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Earthshaking Roar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A blast of this gargant’s hot, stinking breath delivered at volume bowls over those nearby.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** or **GARGANT** unit that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Arch-Ritualist
ability.lore: This general is a master at manipulating the ethersea to conceal the approach of their forces.
ability.effect: Add 1 to rolls for your general’s ‘Ritual of the Creeping Mist’ ability.

ability.name: Unholy Flames
ability.lore: The priest imbues the blades of their allies with daemonic fire, so that they may claim skulls with horrific ease.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16" of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6.
ability.effect: On a 4+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Surprise, Ya Gitz!
ability.lore: When the front lines are engaged, the Gitmob flanking forces launch their ambush.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that is **outflanking the enemy**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Gifts of Chaos
ability.lore: This daemon takes to the field redolent with god-given gifts.
ability.effect:
• If this unit has the **BLADES OF KHORNE** keyword, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Hellforged Weapons** and its **Hellforged Weapons** have the **Blood-Hungry** weapon ability.

• If this unit has the **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** keyword, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

• If this unit has the **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** keyword, it has **WARD (5+)**.

• If this unit has the **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** keyword, add 1 run rolls and charge rolls for it.

ability.name: The Last Living Cythai
ability.lore: High King Volturnos is the greatest Idoneth warrior to have ever lived, and few can match his blinding speed in battle.
ability.effect: The friendly **Volturnos** has **STRIKE-FIRST**.

ability.name: Ranger Doctrines
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for your general or a friendly non-**HERO** unit wholly within 12" of your general
ability.lore: Kreel was once a captain in the Wildercorps. While he now commands an eclectic assortment of forces, the fluid tactics he honed in his prior life can still be used to great effect.
ability.effect: Immediately after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of your general. Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point and not in combat.

ability.name: Behold My Genius!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: While setting Volt-Klaw's machines to maximum power quickly burns through their fuel, it also enhances their lethality to appalling levels.
ability.declare: Pick all friendly **VOLT-KLAW'S ENGINECOVEN** units to be the targets.
ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets' shooting attacks.
• Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.

ability.name: Shadow's Edge
ability.lore: It is impossible to tell if this ebon blade is corporeal or mere shadow, yet its touch tears through flesh and bone with ease.
ability.effect: Your general’s **Sword of Stolen Hours** has **Crit (Mortal)**.

ability.name: Call of Anarchy
ability.lore: As the uprising swells, its architect calls forth more cultists to join the anarchy.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit, then pick a friendly non-**HERO CHANGE-CULT** unit that is **masked by illusion** or that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect:
If you picked a unit that is **masked by illusion**, set it up wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

If you picked a unit that has been destroyed, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Units can be set up in reserve masked by illusion using the Fatemaster’s ‘Long in the Planning’ ability.*

ability.name: Cold Savagery
ability.lore: Perhaps tainted by beast-bone, this commander infects their troops with more than a hint of ferocity.
ability.declare: If your general has not charged this turn and is in combat, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: In the Shadow of the Ethersea
ability.lore: Though their allies may not understand the nature of the ethersea, they have come to rely on the advantages it provides in battle as the Idoneth advance out of sight of the enemy.
ability.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown instead of the Deploy Unit ability or the Deploy Regiment ability.
ability.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve **in the ethersea**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Temple-City Guardians
ability.lore: Patrolling the lands on the outskirts of their domain, these defenders will stop at nothing to see intruders driven back.
ability.effect: Friendly units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within friendly territory.

ability.name: Shard of Night
ability.lore: This undead lord’s armour was crafted using elements of an abyssal stalker and grants the bearer that awful creature’s shadowy aura.
ability.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).

ability.name: The Moon and The Loon
ability.lore: The Bad Moon’s gaze frequently falls upon the Loonking and his court.
ability.effect:
While a friendly unit is wholly within 9" of a friendly **Skragrott**, a friendly **Malevolent Moon** or a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine**:

•  Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** units.
•  Instead of rolling the dice to determine the Move characteristic of a friendly **SQUIG** unit, you can use a value of 4.

ability.name: Hallowed Presence
ability.lore: While fighting alongside the Ruination chambers, those of the Warrior chambers are granted a measure of the incorruptible nature of their solemn brethren.
ability.effect: While friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units are wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units, those friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units have **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Savagery Upon Savagery
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The harder one resists Karanak, the more furious the daemon grows.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons. If the target is a **HERO,** add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.

ability.name: Cloaked in Wyrdflame
ability.lore: The bearer is engulfed in a wyrdflame blaze so intense that enemies shrink before it.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Inconspicuous Manhole
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Embergard is built atop a warren of tunnels that can be traversed to gain a tactical advantage.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 3" of this relic to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within friendly territory and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Awaken the Runes
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
ability.lore: In battle, a Fyreslayer’s ur-gold runes are awakened, filling them with the blazing power of Grimnir.
ability.declare: Pick 1 of the ur-gold runes from the **ur-gold runes** table, then make an **activation roll** of D6. Each urgold rune can only be activated once per battle.
ability.effect: On a 1-5, the rune’s **standard effect** applies. On a 6, the rune’s **enhanced effect** applies as well. The effects last until the start of your next turn.
ability.altText: The Ur-gold Runes table. Rune of Fury. Standard Effect. Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units. Enhanced Effect. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of your units’ melee weapons. Rune of Searing Heat. Standard Effect. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your units’ melee weapons. Enhanced Effect. In addition, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of your units’ melee weapons. Rune of Fiery Determination. Standard Effect. Your units have Ward (5+). Enhanced Effect. In addition, add 1 to save rolls for friendly units. Rune of Relentless Zeal. Standard Effect. Add 2" to the Move characteristic of your units. Enhanced Effect. In addition, add 2 to charge rolls for your units.

ability.name: I Can Do That Better
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability for a friendly unit
ability.lore: King Brodd can outmatch and overpower even the most belligerent gargants in his Stomp, proving himself the biggest bully around.
ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability immediately after the ‘Wrath of Brodd’ ability used by the other friendly unit has been resolved. This unit can do so even if it has used another **RAMPAGE** ability this turn.

ability.name: A Proper Ruckus
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability
ability.lore: Delighted by the scrap before them, the orruks barge and jostle their way into the fray.
ability.effect: All friendly units on the battlefield that were not set up this turn are the targets of that ability instead.

ability.name: Recruitment Drive
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The butchery of a few peons yields a reserve of future ‘recruits’.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the **hunter** and an enemy unit with 5 or more models to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the **hunter**’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit. In addition, if the target is destroyed this turn by the **hunter**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the **hunter**’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Cleave Wide the Grin of Khorne
ability.lore: Gore begets gore, and death begets death.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units.
ability.additionalRulesText: You can only unlock this ability if you have already unlocked 'Revel in Battle' or 'Glorious Combat or Naught'.

ability.name: Glamourweave
ability.lore: The Glamourweave’s illusory enchantments both enhance the wearer’s forest camouflage and conceal their strikes when battle is joined.
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

ability.name: Ward Save
ability.lore: Whether through their uncanny reflexes, unnatural toughness or a source of mystical protection, these warriors can avoid otherwise lethal attacks.
ability.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a **ward roll** of D6 for each **damage point** in this unit’s **damage pool**. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s **ward value**, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

ability.name: The Lurking Vermintide
ability.lore: What scurries beneath the surface?
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.
ability.effect: The target unit is set up in reserve in the tunnels below. Units **in the tunnels below** that have not used the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’ ability by the end of the third battle round are destroyed.

ability.name: Putrescent Sap
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Vile black fluid oozes from bark-sores and withered tree limbs.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit within 3" of any friendly **Feculent** **Gnarlmaws** to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Blood-smeared Hooves
ability.lore: As the charge crashes home, Zandtos's rage infects even his warriors' mounts, who grind the enemy to pulp beneath their hooves.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons, including **Companion** weapons, for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Walkers of the Hidden Paths
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: These mysterious warriors walk the realmroots.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is within 3" of any terrain features and not in combat.
ability.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units. That unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Cacophonic Choir
ability.lore: The Shardspeaker summons a sanity‑shattering symphony of sound.
ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 6+, make a **cacophony roll** of D6. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit (roll for each) within 6" of your general that has a Control characteristic less than the cacophony roll.

ability.name: Daring Tamers
ability.lore: Vulkyn Flameseekers are professional corrallers of huge, wild creatures.
ability.effect: Enemy **MONSTERS** have **STRIKE-LAST** while they are in combat with 2 or more friendly **DROTHKEEPERS Vulkyn Flameseekers** units.

ability.name: Hatred For All
ability.lore: Skarbrand acknowledges no friend or ally - for in time, as sure as the cosmos wheels, all friendships fail, all love and trust dies, and all returns to blood and violence.
ability.declare: You must use this ability if this unit is not in combat and there are any other visible friendly units within this unit's combat range. You must pick 1 of those friendly units to be the target.
ability.effect: Resolve combat attacks for this unit against the target.

ability.name: Magical Intervention
ability.lore: A warrior learned in the mystic arts utters a rapid incantation to disrupt the enemy’s plans.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That friendly unit can use a **SPELL** or **PRAYER** ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from **casting rolls** or **chanting rolls** made as part of that ability.

ability.name: Terminus Clock
ability.lore: Created by a mad clockwright of Ulfenkarn, this bizarre cogwork piece ticks without rhyme or reason. Whenever its eclectic count ends, however, the power of magic seems to deaden across the field.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit.

ability.name: Skilled Manipulator
ability.lore: This Skaven warlord is particularly devious and selfserving, deftly ensuring that their minions are always conveniently positioned between themselves and potential threats.
ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Too Stubborn to Die
ability.lore: Long in the beard, your general shrugs off wounds that would fell a lesser duardin.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** your general.

ability.name: First-Damned Prince
ability.lore: Be’lakor courts the favour of all of the Chaos Gods to crush his foes. In battle, he surrounds himself with their lesser daemons to do his bidding.
ability.effect:
While a friendly **Be’lakor** is within the combat range of any friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON** units:

• That friendly **Be’lakor** has **WARD (4+)**.

• In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **Be’lakor**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON** unit within **Be’lakor**’s combat range after the damage sequence for **Be’lakor** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Staunch Defender
ability.lore: To contest the sacred grounds of Sigmar is to invoke the almighty power of Azyr.
ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units contesting that objective.

ability.name: Monstrous Entourage
ability.lore: Thanquol is well practised in getting Moulder mutants to die on his behalf.
ability.effect:
The **Companion** weapon ability has no effect on **MUTATED MENAGERIE** units. While a friendly **Thanquol** is within the combat range of another friendly Mutated Menagerie unit:

• That **Thanquol** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Thanquol**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.

ability.name: Target of Vengeance
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Spitewing Flight engages one foe at a time, swooping down to annihilate them before selecting a new target.
ability.declare: If there is no enemy **quarry** on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
ability.effect: The target is the **quarry** for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Stumbling Forth
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **lost** unit (see above) to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up the target on the battlefield, more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge.

ability.name: The Prime Huntress
ability.lore: Yndrasta relishes hunting the mightiest and most terrifying quarry.
ability.effect: The Damage characteristic of **Thengavar** (Yndrasta’s spear) is 2D6 for attacks that target a **MONSTER**.

ability.name: Skilled Skirmishers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: Doomfire Warlocks excel in strike-and-fade warfare, evading their foes while unleashing a hail of death.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS CAVALRY** unit that has not charged this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On 3+, the target can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **RETREAT** ability.

ability.name: Devoted Protector
ability.lore: With their final breath, the grove’s head guardian gives the last of their life energy to save their beloved haven.
ability.effect: If this unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove**, before removing this unit from the battlefield, **Heal (10)** your **Soulpod Grove**.

ability.name: Mighty Walloper
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The great beasts of the Godswallow Delta are practically endangered species, for the crazed Odo spends almost every waking second relentlessly hunting them before grinding their bones and caving their skulls in brutal displays of violence.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Glowering Light
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Those who are suddenly bathed in Glareface Frazzlegit’s light are momentarily stunned by his fearsome gloweriness.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that has charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot make a pile-in move when it is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability.

ability.name: Jade Haven
ability.lore: The trees and spirits of a soulpod grove radiate healing magic.
ability.effect: The Health characteristic of your **Soulpod Grove** is 18. The **creeping overgrowth** extends 12" from your **Soulpod Grove**.

ability.name: Proselyte of Morai-Heg
ability.lore: This general has heeded the words imparted by Morai-Heg’s vessel and can see the predicted patterns of battle.
ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: The Officar's Order
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: Reading the flow of battle, a ranking Freeguilder dispatches an order that could well turn the tide in the Sigmarites’ favour.
ability.declare: Pick a battle tactic card in your hand and place it face-down separately next to your other battle tactic cards. The information on it is still hidden from your opponent but make it clear which card is separate. The card stays separate until you use the command on it or score the battle tactic on it as described below.
ability.effect:
When you use the command on that card, it is not discarded but returns to your hand. Your opponent can check the information on it before it returns to your hand. The card goes back to being a normal battle tactic card, with the exception that you cannot use the command on it in the same phase it went back into your hand.

If you did not use the command on the card you separated, you can still score the battle tactic on it at the end of your turn as normal if you met its conditions. If you do so, discard it as normal. If you neither used the command nor scored the battle tactic on the card, it automatically returns to your hand at the end of your turn.

**Designer’s Note:** *This ability essentially lets you use a command ‘for free’, but you have to choose the command at the start of the battle round, so it requires some planning ahead!*

ability.name: Immortal Ego
ability.lore: Few mortals would claim to be the mightiest slayer in the Mortal Realms or to have a peerless mastery of the blade, given the existence of gods, daemons, demigods and more besides.
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

ability.name: Sneaky Distraction
ability.lore: The shaman’s unnaturally shrill cries and magical light-show hypnotically draw the attention of their foes.
ability.declare: Pick the **Gobbapalooza** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

ability.name: Hate-fuelled Killers
ability.lore: Anger, hate and violence run through the veins of the Gorechosen, allowing them to ignore otherwise fatal blows.
ability.effect: The first time each friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 5+, that unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** that unit.

ability.name: Tamers of Haradh's Torment
ability.lore: The steeds of these knights once roamed Haradh’s Torment, where a gargant warlord roused the beasts of the Eightpoints to challenge Archaon – and was later punished for it.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Sparks of Profane Potential
ability.lore: Thryx’s spells are powered by the stolen daemonic essences of the daemons bound to him.
ability.effect:
If the **Magister** in the Regiment of Renown has been deployed, set up one of the following **MANIFESTATIONS** within 1" of them:

• 1 **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
• 1 **Tome of Eyes**
• 1 **Daemonic Simulacrum**

ability.name: Priority Target
ability.lore: The general deploys their honour guard to eliminate the enemy commander.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in, but not leading, a regiment to be that regiment’s **honour guard**. You can pick a unit in reserve.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by that **honour guard** unit that target the enemy general, or the enemy **honour guard** if it is in the enemy general’s regiment, if the target of the attack is within 12".

ability.name: Crimson Victuals
ability.lore: Hissing an incantation, the Archregent saps the life essence of nearby foes.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, if your **Cryptguard** unit is within 6" of the target, you can return 1 slain model to your **Cryptguard** unit for each damage point allocated by this ability.

ability.name: Gutslugger
ability.lore: This ogor is usually found fighting in the thick of a melee and is renowned for their uncanny ability to come out on top.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks if it did not charge in the same turn.

ability.name: A Display of Falconry
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: As the ‘foreign revellers’ approach, the shrieking beasts that follow the ghouls swoop down to greet them.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability in the second battle round. Pick each enemy unit that used a **CHARGE** ability this phase to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units, excluding **Nagash.**

ability.name: Aetheric Cyclone
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The mighty Draconith whips its wings to create a ferocious squall that buffets the enemy lines, driving them to their knees.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING MONSTER** that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Mind Flare
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A brilliant pulse of bioluminescence suddenly illuminates the gloom of the ethersea, temporarily blinding those unprepared for it.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general.
ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, attacks made by that unit only score hits on unmodified hit rolls of 6.

ability.name: Punch Through
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: Like a plated fist, the warriors of the First-Forged drive deep into the enemy's ranks, smashing aside those in their path.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit in combat that has not charged this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can immediately use the 'Charge' ability and can move through enemy models when it does so.

ability.name: Heart of the Forest
ability.lore: Saturated as they are with restorative power, soulpod groves and their guardians are not easily destroyed.
ability.effect: You cannot allocate more than 10 damage points per phase to a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** unit while it is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** (remaining damage points inflicted on it in that phase have no effect).

ability.name: Scaled Aegis
ability.lore: The tenacity of the saurus Sunbloods is legendary, and that of the cohorts under their command equally so.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SAURUS** unit to be the target
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **WARD (6+)** until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Blade of Realities
ability.lore: Entrusted only to the most formidable Oldbloods, this pan-dimensional weapon exists to bring about the end of tyrants.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s **Relic** **Celestite Weapon**.

ability.name: Warmonger's Icon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The personal standard of a warhorde's master inspires a frenzied devotion.
ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to D3 friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
ability.effect: The targets have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Gnarlstaff of Morghur
ability.lore: Infused with the corrupting taint of the Shadowgave, the hideous mewling sounds emitted by this staff unmake the arcane wards of the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Brutal Lashmaster
ability.lore: A favoured Bloodstoker can drive even other champions to battle.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **Bloodstoker** uses the 'Whipped to Fury' ability, another friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO** within its combat range can be picked to be the target of that ability instead of a non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit.

ability.name: Hunt of the Bloodthirsty Shiver
ability.lore: Advancing in tandem, the Akhelian Allopexes either evade the foe in skilled formation or close in to deliver the killing bite.
ability.effect:
If both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Evasive Approach:*** While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target them.

***Ferocious Attack:*** While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, their **Allopex’s Ferocious Bites** have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Burgeoning Rejuvenation
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (D3)** every friendly unit contesting an **Oakenbrow** objective.
•  For the rest of the battle round, while a friendly unit is contesting a **Gnarlroot**
-  If it has a ward save, add 1 to ward rolls for that unit.
-  If it does not have a ward save, it has **WARD (6+).**

ability.name: Lucky Shiny Hat
ability.lore: Torn from the head of a defeated aelven lord – and barely large enough to be noticed – this tiny helmet somehow provides its bearer with mystical protection.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** and **PRAYER** abilities and by abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

ability.name: Child of the Stars
ability.lore: This warrior is made of pure star-matter, immortal and eternal.
ability.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Tough 'Un
ability.lore: This beast has endured the lash of its cruel masters for many a season, which has inured it to pain.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Pledged to Khorne
ability.lore: The Blood God instils a blind rage in his most frenzied adherents.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **PLEDGED TO KHORNE** units.

ability.name: All-out Attack
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
ability.lore: The warriors fight with frenzied vigour.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **hit rolls** for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability. This also affects weapons that have the **Companion** weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Fly
ability.lore: Soaring above the battlefield, this unit can reach destinations that are inaccessible to other troops.
ability.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

ability.name: Entreat Spirits
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Even should an aelementor’s war-form be vanquished, the spirit itself is not so easily undone. Amidst its natural environment, the combined power of multiple runes of the land can call it back to battle, seeing it return to inhabit the sacred armour that was forged for it.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if you have 3 or more runes in your **library**. Pick a friendly non- **UNIQUE MONSTER** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove any 3 runes from your **library**. Then, set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Allocate 6 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Spirit Gale
ability.lore: Your general calls forth spectral winds that tear the souls of the foe from their bodies.
ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 7+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit on the battlefield.

ability.name: Cursed Heritage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: Each Zainthar Kai warrior carries at least three drops of Khaine’s potent ichor in their veins, and they can call upon its simmering power to send boiling blood erupting from their foes’ eyes in an agonising torrent.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any non-**UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

ability.name: At the Double
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
ability.lore: At a command from their general, the warriors sprint to a key position on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Do not make a **run roll** as part of that **RUN** ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s **Move** characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that **RUN** ability.

ability.name: Companion of the Hunt
ability.lore: This vampire has oft excelled in their monarch’s hunting parties.
ability.effect: If your general is not in combat, they can move 3". They cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

ability.name: Murderous Duellist
ability.lore: This hero has trained extensively in gladiatorial arenas across the realms and is utterly dedicated to the art of single combat.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.

ability.name: Unrivalled Battlelust
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: With a terrifying roar, this marshal amongst Bloodthirsters goads their kin to even greater heights of carnage.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Unnatural Vitality
ability.effect: Friendly non-**MONSTER CYCLE OF CORRUPTION HEROES** have **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: Emergency Fuel Injection Pods
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: By flicking a rune-embossed switch concealed in their suit, this Endrinmaster can give their equipment a boost just when they need it.
ability.effect: Your general has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Supernatural Absorption
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The runes carved into the warriors of the Null Myriad flare into life, absorbing hostile manifestations to power the regeneration of damaged constructs.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** within a friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit's combat range to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• The target is banished and removed from play.
• If that friendly unit is damaged, **Heal (X)** that friendly unit, where **X** is the target's Health characteristic.
• If that friendly unit is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is the target's Health characteristic.

ability.name: Special Assignment
ability.lore: The honour guard are tasked with focusing their efforts on a specific element of the enemy’s forces.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in, but not leading, a regiment to be that regiment’s **honour guard**. You can pick a unit in reserve.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities:

• **Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend)**
• **Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
• **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)**
• **Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**
• **Anti-BEAST (+1 Rend)**

In any turn in which that **honour guard** charged, that unit’s melee weapons have the weapon ability you picked.

ability.name: Skilled Summoner
ability.lore: Thryx is a master at manipulating the arcane manifestations of the Change God.
ability.declare:
Pick the **Magister** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick 1 of the **MANIFESTATIONS** from the list below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6:

• 1 **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
• 1 **Tome of Eyes**
• 1 **Daemonic Simulacrum**
ability.effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that **MANIFESTATION** is a **Daemonic** **Simulacrum**, it must also be set up more than 9" away from all enemy units.

ability.name: Blood Rampage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The nightmarish behemoths that roost among the upper spires of the Crimson Keep tear through the enemy’s ranks, sending bloody chunks and gore flying in all directions.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP MONSTER** that is in combat and has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect:
This unit can make a move of 2D6". It must end that move in combat with the target unit. Then, roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Aura of Antiquity
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Prolonged exposure to the necrotic energies that animate these Deathrattle warriors can cause the equipment of their foes to corrode and crumble with unnatural speed.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly units to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Seeds of Discord
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Cunning lies and misdirections cause infighting amongst the foe.
ability.declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy model within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target’s combat range to be the victim.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.

ability.name: Dark Majesty
ability.lore: Morathi-Khaine’s charm, allure and sheer authority is near impossible to resist; to so much as raise a blade against such an exalted creature requires an effort of willpower beyond most mortals.
ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by a non‑**HERO** unit that targets the friendly **Morathi‑Khaine** is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

ability.name: Creeping Dread
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: The creaking of the trees and the oppressive hum of the spirit-song in their subconscious makes the enemy jumpy and distracted, causing them to hesitate and second- guess orders in the absence of clear leadership.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

ability.name: Coalbeard's Collapsible Bombrack
ability.lore: This munitions storage rig has a clever folding design that allows it to carry additional bombs.
ability.effect: Add 1 to each dice roll when using this unit’s ‘Heavy Bomb Racks’, ‘Medium Bomb Racks’ or ‘Light Bomb Racks’ ability.

ability.name: Serve the Enclave
ability.lore: With the fate of their people at stake, this hero inspires a fearless resolve in those Namarti under their command.
ability.effect: While this unit and a friendly **CHORRILEUM NAMARTI** unit are contesting the same objective, this unit has a control score of 10 that cannot be modified.

ability.name: Thorgsson's Universal Automaton Actuator
ability.lore: This portable cartridge radiates an energy field that gives nearby Auto-Endrins that extra bit of spark and verve. No batteries necessary.
ability.effect: Add 6" to the Move characteristic of friendly **AUTO-ENDRINS** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

ability.name: Dirge of Desolation
ability.lore: Thorzbuul has recovered only fragments of the script he searches for, but even these can cause the land to buckle and break.
ability.declare: Pick the **Ashen Elder** in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick a terrain feature on the battlefield to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting the target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick another terrain feature to be a second target.

ability.name: Deep Connection
ability.lore: These mounts are so attuned to their riders’ emotions that they can instinctively predict their next command.
ability.effect: Ignore the effect of the **Companion** weapon ability on this unit’s weapons.

ability.name: The Eroding Icon
ability.lore: As this fell icon arrives upon the enemy line, warriors find their weapons corroding and crumbling to rust.
ability.effect:
This unit has the **PLEDGED TO NURGLE** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

ability.name: Covered in Mud
ability.phaseDetails: Start of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: After some ‘hard finkin’, a group of orruks decides to slather themselves in muck so they can sneak up on the unwitting enemy.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: In this battle, that unit is not visible to enemy models that are more than 12" away from it.

ability.name: Guns For All Occasions
ability.lore: This canny duardin always has a backup plan in the form of a cleverly stowed aetherblaster.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Legend Among Graverobbers
ability.lore: Veremord’s reputation as a graverobber is unsurpassed.
ability.declare: Pick the **Corpse Cart** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability if it is within 3" of the **Deadwalker Zombies** unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, pick each enemy **INFANTRY**, **CAVALRY** and **BEAST** unit within 12" of the **Corpse Cart** to be the targets.
ability.effect: For each target that had any models slain this turn, you can return D3 slain models to the **Deadwalker Zombies** unit in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Unholy Draught
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Drinking deep provides incredible power, but at what cost?
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of a **Crypt of Blood** terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if you are the **underdog.** On a 4+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn. Otherwise, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A reeking miasma rises around the daemon Herald that drives nearby followers into a wild delirium.
ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 7" of your general.

ability.name: Noble Deeds
ability.lore: Each member of a ghoulish court is constantly seeking to prove their valour by performing worthy exploits on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **HERO** uses a **FIGHT** ability, after its attacks have been resolved, give that **HERO** a number of **noble deeds points** equal to the number of damage points allocated by that ability. Each **HERO** can have a maximum of 6 **noble deeds points** at any time.

ability.name: Harbinger of the Great Ascendancy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: In the eyes of this Skaven warlord, nothing can stop the Horned Rat's ascendancy and the ruination of the Mortal Realms.
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, you can use 2 different **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn instead of 1.

ability.name: Trophy Hunta
ability.lore: This heavily scarred orruk is always on the lookout for the largest and most ferocious beasts of the realms. After all, their skulls make the flashiest trophies!
ability.effect: This unit’s **Pig-hakka** has **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)** and **Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.

ability.name: Skilled Drothwranglers
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly MAGMADROTH
ability.lore: Only Lofnir Drothkeepers are bold enough to grab a charging Magmadroth’s saddle straps and be carried  into battle.
ability.effect:
Pick a friendly **Vulkyn Flameseekers** unit and/or a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS INFANTRY HERO** that are not in combat and are wholly within 6" of the **MAGMADROTH** to be the targets. Units that have **hitched a lift** this turn (see below) cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **MAGMADROTH** ends its move, you must set up each target on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of the **MAGMADROTH** and not in combat. The targets have **hitched a lift**. Units that **hitched a lift** cannot use **CHARGE** abilities in the same turn.

ability.name: Cloak of Stitched Victories
ability.lore: This cloak is made from the stitched pelts of traitors and inflicts a rabid paranoia upon the bearer, making them hard to hit and even harder to stab in the back.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Grievous Halitosis
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Drogg has dined well on the spoils of war, having smashed and eaten the contents of many a fortified town – yet he has never picked his teeth clean. His breath is so foul that it can stun an ox at ten paces.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Beacon of Nagashizzar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This malignant light summons departed souls.
ability.effect: Return 1 slain model to each friendly unit on the battlefield.

ability.name: The Blood Queen's Will
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: When Neferata takes to the field, she does so only to ensure the completion of plans long since spun.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit contesting an objective that the **Neferata** in this Regiment of Renown is contesting to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2-5, subtract 10 from the control score of the target for the rest of the turn. On a 6, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Grandfather's Blessing
ability.lore: This mighty Nurglite is so diseased that they are rejuvenated by decay and plague.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat with a **Diseased** enemy unit, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Lifecycle
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Second Battle Round
ability.effect: Pick either the **Oakenbrow** or the **Gnarlroot** objective to be the primary objective. At the start of each subsequent battle round, the next objective in the cycle becomes the primary objective. The objectives before and after the primary objective in the cycle order (see below) are the secondary objectives.

ability.name: Harvesters of Sorrow
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: For the handmaidens of the Unrequited Queen, only the choicest despair can alleviate their torment.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Gale Force
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability
ability.lore: Aligning their attacks with the direction of the wind allows the Hurakan to strike with deadlier force.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability if the target of that ability is closer to the **leeward** battlefield edge than the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Legendary Slayers
ability.lore: To be Gorechosen is to have slain hundreds, if not thousands.
ability.effect: **Blood-hungry** weapons used by friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.

ability.name: Amulet of Chaos
ability.lore: Life, death, creation, obliteration. Maddening potential swirls within the gemstone set in this talisman. It need only be loosed by belief.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **DARKOATH INFANTRY** unit in combat with that enemy unit to be the friendly target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• If there is a friendly target, return a number of slain models to it equal to the roll.

ability.name: Timberrrrr!
ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
ability.effect: When the **MEGA‑GARGANT** in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

ability.name: Mark of Tzeentch
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The Changer of the Ways shapes the destiny of your general and grants them the ability to twist and warp the realms around them.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield. You cannot pick your general.
ability.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of your general and more than 6" from all enemy units. It cannot use **Move** abilities for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Trampling Charge
ability.lore: The charge of bellowing ogors resembles a living avalanche of blubber and metal. Anything in their path is quickly squished into an edible paste.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Helm of Tyranny
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
ability.lore: This helm radiates the oppressive will of the wearer, filling nearby foes with supernatural dread.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target and roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 3+, subtract 3 from the control score of the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Corpulent Avalanche
ability.lore: As this hulk’s momentum builds, its bulk becomes nothing less than a blubbery, pus-filled battering ram.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Move characteristic. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

If any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, this unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

ability.name: Disengage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: At an officer’s command, the vessel disengages with all guns blazing.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Frigate** to use this ability.
ability.effect: If that unit uses a **RETREAT** ability this phase, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn.

ability.name: Notorious Bosses
ability.lore: It takes orruks of propa might and kunnin’ to keep a Big Waaagh! in line.
ability.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly non-**UNIQUE BIG WAAAGH! IRONJAWZ HERO** and up to 1 friendly non‑**UNIQUE BIG WAAAGH! KRULEBOYZ HERO** that do not have a heroic trait to be the targets.
ability.effect:
Give each target 1 heroic trait from the Big Waaagh! heroic traits.

**Designer’s Note**: *These heroic traits are given to the targets during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: Banner of Sigmar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The hero unfurls a mighty banner and plunges its pommel into the earth with the force of a falling comet, where it stands upright and proud, declaring Sigmar’s reckoning to all who bear witness to its majesty.
ability.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, your opponent cannot control the target objective while they have no units contesting it.

ability.name: Sigmar's Justice
ability.lore: Callis, Toll and their companions are single-minded in their purpose: the elimination of a high-priority target.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be **marked for justice**. You can pick a unit that is in reserve.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target a unit that is **marked for justice**.

ability.name: Savage Mauling
ability.lore: Once the saurus Sunblood begins the dismemberment of the enemy, even mystical defences crumble under his terrible strength
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Barrel of Emberstone
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Aqshian realmstone stokes the battle fervour of those in its vicinity, lending strength to their sword arms.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this relic to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Twisted Mirror
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: A Twisted Mirror tests the spirit of any who gaze into it, immobilising those who fall victim to its illusions.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of your general and roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 4+, subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Ancient Aura
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army) Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Storm-charged energy ebbs and flows around the warriors of the Ruination chambers, surrounding them in a scouring aura of power. Finding purchase with a weapon on these ancient heroes can be a difficult task for even the mightiest of mortal foes.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit.
ability.effect: That unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Mega Bossy
ability.lore: This boss’s booming voice constantly rings out across the battlefield, ‘encouraging’ their ladz to get krumpin’.
ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

ability.name: Strike Where Needed
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a RETREAT ability
ability.lore: Though often outnumbered by their foes, the Stormcast Eternals are accustomed to fighting on many fronts and focusing their efforts where they will have the greatest impact.
ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by that **RETREAT** ability. In addition, that unit can still use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even though it used a **RETREAT** ability.

ability.name: Butcher's Blade
ability.lore: One cut from this blade can see a target brutally exsanguinated.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Rune of Fiery Determination
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: A sliver of Grimnir’s awesome resolve courses through the Fyreslayers.
ability.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE** abilities this battle round.

Friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units have **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle round.

ability.name: Lightning-Strike Arrival
ability.lore: With a clap of thunder, Yndrasta and her allies strike down onto the battlefield.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Ceaseless Infectors
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Upon their deaths, Rotbringers’ bodies will purge their ‘gifts’, infecting those nearby and ensuring the continued propagation of Nurgle’s diseases.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was in combat with a friendly **ROTBRINGERS** unit that was destroyed this turn to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

ability.name: Voidstone Repulser Vents
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: A friendly unit within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of an enemy SPELL ability
ability.lore: Clouds of voidstone ground into a fine dust are released from these ports to nullify and deflect enemy spells.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:

• Ignore the effect of that spell on that friendly unit.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but you can only roll once for each friendly unit per spell cast.

ability.name: Frenzied Taskmaster
ability.lore: This champion does not allow their followers to shirk the slaughter.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit within this unit's combat range that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move D6" but cannot end that move in combat. If the target ends that move within this unit's combat range, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Storm Brewing
ability.declare: Pick a battlefield edge to be the target.
ability.effect: That battlefield edge is **leeward**. For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly **RIDE THE HURRICANE** ability is used, after that ability has been resolved, change the **leeward** battlefield edge to the next edge clockwise.

ability.name: Lethal Surprise
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: As the enemy charges into the Kruleboyz line, little do they know that they have been lured into a series of cunningly concealed traps.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability.

ability.name: Delicious Morsels
ability.lore: This general carries with them rare crustaceans favoured by Allopexes and Fangmora Eels.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each friendly **CAVALRY** unit within your general’s combat range.

ability.name: Lifekelp Pod
ability.lore: Radiant with Ghyranite energy, this golden seed pod bursts in a spray of vital power.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN CAVALRY** unit within this unit’s combat range.

ability.name: Betrayers of the Anvilking
ability.lore: To earn Archaon’s favour, these former apprentices of an ancient smith-lord betrayed their master but preserved his secrets of forgecraft.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Nature Aetheric
ability.lore: Rapid growth and abundant life follow the Evergreen Hunt.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature that is within friendly territory to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly units are wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** while they are wholly within 6" of the target.

ability.name: Grudgefire Rounds
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
ability.lore: This ammunition bursts into white-hot flames when it hits its target.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Skryre Connections
ability.lore: This Clawlord has tasked the Skryre engineers under their command to overcharge their ratling pistol.
ability.effect: Your general’s **Ratling Pistol** has an Attacks characteristic of 2D6 instead of D6.

ability.name: Punish the Pacifist
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: To shirk from combat is to sin against the War God.
ability.declare: Each unit (friendly and enemy) and enemy **MANIFESTATION** that is not in combat is a target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1-2, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target.

ability.name: Dokk Juice
ability.lore: A sip of this brew temporarily grants the imbiber the regenerative qualities of a troggoth – if they are able to keep it down for long enough, that is.
ability.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Goroan Forgecraft
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Goroans were renowned for their skill at smithery, and even orruks will acknowledge their general killiness.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DESTRUCTION HERO** that is within the combat range of a **HERO** in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
ability.effect: On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Unnatural Vitality
ability.lore: Disease may have ravaged this mage’s form, but somehow they never seem to succumb to it.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: All-Consuming Search
ability.lore: Thorzbuul will leave entire ley lines drained dry should it lead him to his goals.
ability.declare: Pick the **Ashen Elder** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability. Then, pick an objective or **Place of Power** that they are contesting and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this battle to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 5+, give this unit 1 ritual point.

ability.name: Phoenix Blade
ability.lore: This blade is imbued with a portion of the Lord Phoenix’s incandescent power; those who feel its bite have the potential to suddenly ignite in purifying flames.
ability.effect: This unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

ability.name: Fast 'Un
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This beast lurches forward at a speed that would take anyone by surprise.
ability.effect: If this unit was not set up this turn, it can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Ulguan Cloak
ability.lore: This Archregent is shrouded by an aura of darkness – holiness, as they would see it – which makes them difficult to target.
ability.effect: Your general is not visible to enemy models that are more than 12" away from them.

ability.name: Trophy Skulls
ability.lore: Festooned with the skulls of those who crossed them, be they ferocious beast or mighty warrior, there’s no doubt that this orruk means business.
ability.effect: Your general’s Control characteristic is 5.

ability.name: Horn of Grimnir
ability.lore: Inlaid with powerful runes of ur-gold, a blast from this horn inspires those bloody and bruised to continue the fight.
ability.declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they are not in combat.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each friendly unit on the battlefield that has any slain models. On a 3+, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

ability.name: Aura of Night
ability.lore: This black leather brigandine was crafted from the hide of an abyssal stalker and grants the wearer that creature’s shadowy aura.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.

ability.name: Maddening Radiance
ability.lore: The very presence of Ushoran sends his devoted subjects into a feeding frenzy.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by units in this Regiment of Renown while they are wholly within 12" of the **Ushoran** in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Storm's Wrath
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Woe to those caught in the path of the storm’s destructive fury.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Inexorable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.
ability.effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Lifted Drbris
ability.lore: The lesser spirits of the wind aid the battle by lifting chunks of debris and hurling them towards the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is closer to the **leeward** battlefield edge than the large terrain feature within friendly territory to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Go Dat Way!
ability.lore: Snerk makes sure to give his troggoth mate a jab if they get distracted. Which they do. Often.
ability.declare: Pick the **Dankhold Troggoth** in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is within 12" of the **Loonboss** in this Regiment of Renown.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can still use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Inexorable Tide
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: When the tide sweeps in, no force of nature or magic can keep it at bay.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for the rest of the battle round.

ability.name: Finishing Moves
ability.lore: The Crimson Lash cavort about their chosen arena with effortless grace, avoiding enemy blows and responding with elaborately deadly strikes.
ability.effect:
While each model in a unit in this Regiment of Renown is contesting the **amphitheatre**:

• That unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
• If you control the **amphitheatre**, if the unmodified hit roll or wound roll for an attack that targets that unit is a 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

ability.name: Amulet of the Bladed Queen
ability.lore: This prodigy has earned the blessing of Morathi-Khaine: a magnificent serpentine amulet through the goddess can both protect and keep a watchful eye on her subordinate.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**. Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Bladed Impact
ability.lore: The bladed carriage of a Cauldron of Blood can plough its way through enemy ranks with ease.
ability.declare: If your general charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of them to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Ruthless Extermination
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for a unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase
ability.lore: With the enemy fully engaged, the Ossiarchs send a hail of fire raining down on them with cold efficiency.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Subtract l from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **SHOOT** ability.
