ability.name: Grim Diet
ability.lore: Having ridden out the mind-breaking shudders that stem from biting down on poisonous bog-bugs, this orruk is largely blind to pain.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Strike and Fade
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: These warriors use the spirit paths to ambush the enemy before retreating back into the shadows.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within 3" of any terrain features, then roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 2+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again so that each model in the unit is within 3" of any terrain features and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Sotek's Gaze
ability.lore: The eyes of this gilded war-mask resonate with the pitiless hunger of the Serpent God. With it, the Oldblood brutally cows lesser foes.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add the roll to your general’s control score this turn.

ability.name: More-more Mutation!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The sponsorship of a Grey Seer gives Thanquol's flesh-grafting lackeys licence to pursue their most deranged experiments.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE** unit to be the target. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle:

• Add 2 to the target's Health characteristic.
• Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.
• The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• At the end of each turn, allocate D3+2 damage points to the target.

ability.name: Arena of Slaughter
ability.lore: This battlefield is dedicated to the havoc and murder beloved of Khaine, and his acolytes seek to drench it in arterial sprays of the most elaborate kind.
ability.effect:
If the number of units (friendly or enemy) that have been destroyed this battle equals or exceeds any of the numbers below, the corresponding effect applies to friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units for the rest of the battle. More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time.

**1** Add 1 to run rolls for those units.
**2** Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
**3**  Add 1 to hit rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
**4**  Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
**5**  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ melee weapons.

ability.name: Dead Cunning, For a Gargant
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The aelven artefact hanging from Bundo’s ear has increased his intellect, giving him brains as well as brawn. He can be uncannily patient, knowing just where and when to strike to cause maximum havoc. Some say his hoard even contains strange papery things called ‘books’…
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons.

Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Mark of Slaanesh
ability.lore: Your general is bound to the Dark Prince, who, for the price of their soul, gifts them inhuman grace and martial skill.
ability.effect: Your general has **STRIKE-FIRST**.

ability.name: Glare of Frazzlegit
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: With a yell, the Snarlboss releases the Hyshian light captured within his jaggedy blade.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: The Blood Tithe
ability.lore: Khorne’s warriors receive divine rewards when blood is shed; whether the sacrifice is theirs or that of their foes matters not.
ability.effect: Each time a unit is destroyed during the battle, you receive 1 **blood tithe point**.

ability.name: Draw Steel!
ability.lore: With a bellow, the officar lunges into battle, and their troops follow them with as much steel in their hearts as they wield in their clenched fists.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Aetherquartz Requisitioner
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD within this unit’s combat range
ability.lore: This aelf keeps an emergency supply of aetherquartz that can be used to enhance a critical spell.
ability.effect: Add 3 to the casting roll for that spell.

ability.name: Unpredictable Tide
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Only the Deepkin can anticipate the mercurial currents of the ocean.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round. Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Soulfire Ring
ability.lore: Gouts of lashing green flames leap forth from this ring as it consumes the souls of those slain by the wearer.
ability.effect: If any models were slain by your general this turn, **Heal (D6)** your general.

ability.name: Aetheric Nullifier
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT or FIGHT ability for a MANIFESTATION within 9" of the bearer
ability.lore: This unassuming cylindrical tool is fashioned from a potent anti-magic alloy.
ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. You cannot pick the same **MANIFESTATION** to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.

ability.name: Bodyguard
ability.lore: The honour guard stay by their general’s side to protect them from harm.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in, but not leading, a regiment to be that regiment’s **honour guard**. You can pick a unit in reserve.
ability.effect:
Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of enemy units’ melee weapons while they are in combat with the unit leading that regiment if both of the following are true:
• That regiment’s **honour guard** is wholly within 6" of the leader of that regiment.
• Neither that regiment’s **honour guard** nor the regiment’s leader charged this turn.

ability.name: Master Duellist
ability.lore: Not only is this warrior a paragon of single combat, landing multiple strikes before their opponent even has a chance to respond, but they have also studied an ancient technique of arcane unforging that robs the foe’s magical artefacts of their power.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• If the target has an artefact of power, it no longer has that artefact of power.
• The target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Strike with the Tempest's Rage
ability.lore: Yndrasta’s enemies know that to catch her gaze is to be marked for annihilation.
ability.effect: Your general has **STRIKE-FIRST** if they charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Skewer It Again!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Rather than gesture in the traditional way, Grikk uses his bolts to indicate which beastie he wants his ladz to bring down.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a shooting attack made by the **Beast-skewer Killbow** in this Regiment of Renown. Then, pick any number of **Man-skewer Boltboyz** units in this Regiment of Renown to **focus fire**.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the ranged weapons used by the units you picked to **focus** **fire** but all of their attacks must target the enemy **MONSTER** you picked.

ability.name: Trained Ranger
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The pathfinding skills he picked up in the jungles of the Charrwind Coast serve Kreel well in Embergard’s urban sprawl.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Beastherd Ambush
ability.lore: As the beasts close upon their foes, horn-blasts sound in every direction, signalling the launch of a deadly ambush.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** unit that is **in ambush**.
ability.effect:
Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for that unit.

ability.name: Crowned in Butchery
ability.lore: To yoke the lords of the Gorechosen demands a champion of singular, terrifying will.
ability.effect: Add 20 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

ability.name: Bellowing Arrival
ability.lore: A mighty roar echoes across the battlefield as more hungry ogors join the fray.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: This large-barrelled, stumpy weapon fires a mishmash of workshop swarf coated in phosphor-laced aether-gold that produces a blinding, bewildering display when the trigger is pulled – highly effective for stopping an advancing enemy in their tracks.
ability.effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a **bamboozling flak roll** of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.

ability.name: Fast and Furious
ability.lore: Riders of the Grunta Stampedes compete to be the first to slam into the enemy, urging their porcine steed on with kicks, curses and much incoherent bellowing
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO GRUNTA STAMPEDE** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: First of the Mortarchs
ability.lore: Arkhan the Black is the closest thing to a truly trustworthy agent of the Great Necromancer. His loyalty, never in question, has been rewarded with access to mystical power above and beyond his quarrelsome peers.
ability.effect:
Each time you make a casting roll for a friendly **Arkhan the Black,** if all the following are true, that spell cannot be unbound:

• The unmodified casting roll contains 2 or more results of the same value.
• The casting roll equals or exceeds the spell's casting value.
• The spell is not miscast.

ability.name: 'Grab Those Rocks and Chuck 'Em!'
ability.lore: Your general commands their fellow gargants to hurl as many rocks at the enemy as they can.
ability.declare: Pick your general to use this ability, then pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of them.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s **Throwin’ Rocks** this turn.

ability.name: Squigalanche
ability.lore: A curious, arrhythmic pounding and cackles of wicked glee in the distance signal the approach of a mob of manic Squig Hoppers!
ability.effect: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Murder the Mystic
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Those who cower behind conjured spellcraft will be punished severely.
ability.declare: Pick up to 4 enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** to be the target(s).
ability.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on that **MANIFESTATION**'s warscroll, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of it and then it is **banished** and removed from play.
ability.additionalRulesText: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Divine Scorn'.

ability.name: Cloud of Bats
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Your Vampire Lord dissolves into a swarm of bats before reappearing elsewhere.
ability.effect: Remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Bold Spirit
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Thrusting their glaive towards the foe with a strident war cry, the Arch-Revenant inspires their warriors to fight with all they have.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks while they are within your general’s combat range.

ability.name: Icon of Great-total Supremacy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Within this jagged brass reliquary lies a cutting from the Horned Rat's whiskers. It exerts a natural hold over the Skaven, drawing frothing warriors to it.
ability.effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to each friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit with a Health characteristic of up to 3.

ability.name: Loonstone Medallion
ability.lore: The medallion hanging around this grot’s neck grants them uncanny luck, which means they must be crucial to the Loonking’s plans. It probably won’t end well for them.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**. While this unit is contesting an objective that is not being contested by any other friendly units, it has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Shock and Awe
ability.lore: When this warrior and their Stormcasts take to the field, their shining visages strike fear into the foe.
ability.effect:
Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.

In addition, each time a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit is set up wholly within 12"of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

ability.name: Null Pendant
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: This dark amulet holds magic within that can sap the resolve of the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 5 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Rising Fire
ability.lore: The hosts of Urak Taar fight with obsessive precision instead of haste – but once the furnaces are lit, victory is inevitable.
ability.effect:
The following cumulative effects apply to friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST** units in each battle round after the first.

**Battle Round 2:**
***Daemonic Weaponry:*** Those units’ weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

**Battle Round 3:**
***Harnessed Sorcery:*** Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for those units.

**Battle Round 4:**
***Channelled Power:*** Attacks made by those units score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

**Battle Round 5:**
***Arcane Dominance:*** Add 1 to the power level of those units if they are a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**.

ability.name: A Kingdom Deluded
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: The mass delusions suffered by these cannibals are volatile but intense.
ability.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each turn. If it is the first turn of the battle, pick a **DELUSION** from these battle traits or, unless otherwise specified, from the warscroll of a friendly unit on the battlefield. If it is not the first turn, make a delusion roll of D6.
ability.effect:
On a delusion roll of 1-2, you must pick a different **DELUSION** to the one you picked last turn. 

On a 3-4, you must pick the same **DELUSION** as the one you picked last turn, even if it is on the warscroll of a unit that has been destroyed. In such cases, the effect of that **DELUSION** applies as if the unit had not been destroyed. 

On a 5-6, you must pick a **DELUSION** like you did in the first turn. For the rest of the turn, you believe the **DELUSION** you picked.

ability.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Typically used by the Grundstok ‘black marines’, this specialised anti-ethereal weapon can nullify magical wards.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Power of Hysh
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Vanari can use their innate arcane abilities to empower their sunmetal weapons.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, until the start of your next turn, attacks made by that unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

ability.name: Destined Arcana
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit
ability.lore: Tzeentch imbues the spell with a fraction of his limitless arcane might.
ability.effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the casting roll for that spell.

ability.name: At the Double
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
ability.lore: At a command from their general, the warriors sprint to a key position on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Do not make a **run roll** as part of that **RUN** ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s **Move** characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that **RUN** ability.

ability.name: The Lunatic Hordes
ability.lore: From out of caves and darkened lairs, a stream of ravening grots pours forth into the lurid light of the Bad Moon.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Moonclan Stabbas** unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to that unit.

ability.name: Deathly Invocation
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Skilled wielders of death magic can summon hordes of undead.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** units wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For each target:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

ability.name: Searing Claws
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A Magmadroth’s claws radiate such intense heat that they can melt steel. Even if an enemy is not slain by a raking blow, their armour will be left pitted and useless.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Armour Cruncher
ability.lore: The sheer heft and strength of this beast sees it crush and crumple well-protected foes in their own armour before it even gets around to tearing into them with tooth, horn and claw.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Searching for Remedies
ability.lore: The Twisted Branch are often found scouting ahead of their allies, looking for any clue that might offer hope of a cure for their curse.
ability.effect: Remove each unit in this Regiment of Renown from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Boiling Blood
ability.lore: A torrent of scalding blood is vomited forth by the Avatar of Khaine, reducing even polished sigmarite to molten slag.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn

ability.name: Magical Scorn
ability.lore: This warrior's loathing of the arcane and esoteric exudes from them in waves.
ability.effect:
Subtract 1 from casting rolls for **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.

Subtract 1 from chanting rolls for enemy **PRIESTS** while they are within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Master of Shadows
ability.lore: Swathed in darkness, Crixxit can slip in and out of the gloom with ease, his victims’ cooling corpses the only sign of his passing.
ability.effect: When your general uses the ‘Cloaked in Shadow’ ability, add 1 to the **shadow-travel roll**.

ability.name: Brayblast Trumpet
ability.lore: Carved from the bone of a Shaggoth, the thunderous blasts of this horn draw the true children of Chaos towards it.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE BEASTS OF CHAOS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Reinforce Pavise
ability.lore: Karahtet bolsters the shield attached to the front of the Mortek Crawler, providing his beloved creation with additional protection.
ability.declare: If the **Mortek Crawler** in this Regiment of Renown is wholly within 12" of and visible to the friendly **Mortisan Ossifector** in this Regiment of Renown, pick that **Mortisan Ossifector** to cast this spell, pick that **Mortek Crawler** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+).**

ability.name: The Hunger
ability.lore: Those who bear the Soulblight Curse constantly crave blood and are empowered by feasting upon their foes.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **VAMPIRE** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after all of its attacks have been resolved, **Heal (X)** that **VAMPIRE** unit where **X** is the number of damage points allocated by those attacks.

ability.name: Seek Worthy Blood
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Only the finest ichor will suffice for the vampires of Nulahmia. It is considered an art to eviscerate an enemy champion whilst collecting as much of their blood as possible.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)**. In addition, if the target destroys any enemy **HEROES** this turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: The Sacred Groves
ability.lore: Sentient trees abound in the sacred groves of the Sylvaneth, awakened by the bountiful magics of genesis.
ability.declare: You must use this ability.
ability.effect:
Set up 3 **Awakened Wyldwoods** (an Awakened Wyldwood is a single tree miniature with a crescent-shaped base) wholly within friendly territory, more than 1" from all other terrain features and more than 3" from all objectives. The tips of each crescent-shaped base must touch, forming a circle.

Once you have done so, for the rest of the battle, the 3 tree miniatures join to form 1 **Soulpod Grove** terrain feature. The area inside the circle formed by the trees is part of the terrain feature

ability.name: Peerless Lineage
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a RAMPAGE ability for this unit
ability.lore: This beast is of a mighty pedigree, even more regal and powerful than its potent kin.
ability.effect: You can pick another eligible unit to be a second target of that **RAMPAGE** ability. If the ability requires a roll, you must roll for each target.

ability.name: Rally
ability.lore: With an inspiring call to action, wounded soldiers get a second wind and fresh troops take the field to replace their fallen comrades.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Make 6 **rally rolls** of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 **rally point**. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:

•  For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** that unit.
•  You can spend a number of rally points equal to the **Health** characteristic of that unit to **return** a slain model to that unit.

You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

ability.name: Dread Ranks Unbroken
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Serried legions of duardin march in service to Urak Taar and the Forge Anathema.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO GRAND FORGEHOST INFANTRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up), wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: The Piper's Infectious Melodies
ability.lore: Driven into blissful delirium by the farts and squelches emanating from Fetorlux’s gutpipes, these Beasts of Nurgle are ever eager to find new playmates.
ability.effect: While a **Beast of Nurgle** in this Regiment of Renown is within 3" of this Regiment of Renown’s **Sloppity Bilepiper**, it can use the ‘Attention Seekers’ ability even if the other **Beast** **of Nurgle** in this Regiment of Renown has already used it this turn.

ability.name: Bestial Domination
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a unit in this Regiment of Renown
ability.lore: Their self-preserving instincts crushed by their master’s brute will, Hargax’s beasts attack without relent.
ability.effect: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

ability.name: Gift of Febrile Frenzy
ability.lore: This general can invigorate their usually sluggish minions by releasing a fever upon them that drives them into a wild delirium.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Shield of Scrap and Muscle
ability.lore: Zoggrok’s boyz believe it’s better to die fighting than to let anything distract their surly boss while he’s engaged in his destructive craft. After all, they’d suffer the consequences…
ability.effect:
While a friendly **Zoggrok Anvilsmasha** is within the combat range of a friendly **Ardboyz** unit:

• That **Zoggrok Anvilsmasha** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Zoggrok Anvilsmasha**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Ardboyz** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: A Proper Sneak
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: When they get their Mork muscles flexin’, this boss can even get the Ironjawz moving with a semblance of stealth.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword and a friendly unit has not used a **BRUTAL KUNNIN’** ability this turn.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **BIG WAAAGH!** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Kunnin' As A Snarlfang
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This general knows the perfect time for the ladz to stab their enemies in the middle of a fight.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of the bearer.

ability.name: Cunning Pursuer
ability.lore: The Arch-Revenant feigns weakness, baiting the enemy into being surrounded by the swarm.
ability.effect: While your general is in combat, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly units wholly within 12" of them. Add 2 instead while your general is in combat with the **quarry**.

ability.name: Descend from the Clouds
ability.lore: As a skyvessel swoops down to the battlefield, its Kharadron passengers scramble to disembark and storm the enemy lines.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL in the clouds** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Set up that **SKYVESSEL** anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units that were set up **in the clouds** with that **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Normal Move
ability.lore: The warriors advance across the battlefield.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its **Move** characteristic. That unit **cannot** move into combat during any part of that move.

ability.name: Hunter of Souls
ability.lore: This hero seeks neither glory nor territory; their only interest is the capture of potent soul-stuff.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit’s melee weapons to have this battle:
•  **Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)**

ability.name: Scurry Away
ability.lore: This Grey Seer is a staunch believer in the Skaven philosophy that prudent cowardice is a virtue, and they do not think twice about scampering to safety when things look to be going south.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase. If it does so, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

ability.name: Favoured of Khorne
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Start of Your Turn
ability.lore: These blood-marked warriors are the victors of many battles and court the favour of their patron.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, you receive 1 **blood tithe point**.

ability.name: Rampaging Demise
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Thanquol cares little for the survival of his beasts and is more than willing to have them sacrifice themselves in spasms of fury.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect:
This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Endless Legions
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: To the Gravelords, the dead are mere chattel to be raised and expended.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.

ability.name: A Worthy Challenge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The pinnacle of chivalry is a noble duel between virtuous warriors.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that started the battle with 3 or fewer models and is in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or refuse your general’s challenge. If they **accept**, for the rest of the phase, when your general and the target are picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of their attacks must target each other. If they **refuse**, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Burgeoning Filth
ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** units.

ability.name: Armour of Gork
ability.lore: This bashed-together armour is thick, heavy and possessed of its own fierce fighting spirit.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Frenzied Restoration
ability.lore: The powerful magics that emanate from a Shrine of Dark Tribute cause even gravely wounded aelves to stagger to their feet, gore pouring from open wounds and dripping from features made feral with frenzy.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Champions of the Arena Hero** that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of a friendly **Shrine of Dark Tribute** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Infernal Puppet
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: As it dances upon the aetheric winds, this eldritch marionette violently disrupts the spellcraft of enemy mages.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** within 24" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target is picked to use a **SPELL** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target as a reaction. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **SPELL** ability.

ability.name: Thegn of Bellicos
ability.lore: In their mortal life, this warrior fought alongside Bastian at the Battle of Burning Skies and still does so after their Reforging.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons while it is wholly within 6" of a friendly **Bastian** **Carthalos**.

ability.name: Chalice of Darkness
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Dread power spills from this vessel of ebon-black stone.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Battered Barricade
ability.lore: Though swiftly improvised and heavily patched up, this barrier can still provide protection from incoming fire.
ability.effect: Units wholly within 3" of this relic cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within their combat range.

ability.name: Death Razor
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
ability.lore: This blade absorbs the souls of those it kills, converting their energy into divine power.
ability.effect: After that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability, you can pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Instead of making a chanting roll for the next **PRAYER** ability used by the target, you can use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified, even if this unit has been destroyed.

ability.name: Constant Flux
ability.lore: Tzeentch’s plans often involve elements of self-sabotage to achieve the final goal.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly units while you are the underdog.

ability.name: Deathmonger
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Feared across the realms, this hero leaves naught in their wake but a trail of sun-bleached bones.
ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Timberrrrr!
ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** or **GARGANT** model is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

ability.name: Eldritch Illusions
ability.lore: The Disciples of Tzeentch delight in spreading confusion amongst their foes with cunningly woven glamours.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units on the battlefield to be the targets.
ability.effect:
Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

Friendly units that are **masked by illusion** are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.

ability.name: Fierce Competition
ability.lore: These Scáthborn are amongst the most cut-throat of their kind, endlessly seeking to outdo their peers as they compete for the attention of their murderous deity.
ability.effect:
Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown uses an ability and any enemy models were slain by that ability, after that ability has been resolved, the unit that used that ability is **pre‑eminent** and the other unit in this Regiment of Renown is **overlooked**.

Weapons used by an **overlooked** unit in this Regiment of Renown have **Crit (Auto‑wound)**.

ability.name: Locus of Fecundity
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Nurgle bestows a blessing of bountiful regrowth upon his children.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** that unit.

ability.name: The Spirit Paths Open
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick 2 objectives to be the targets.
ability.effect: All units, excluding faction terrain and **MANIFESTATIONS**, within 6" of any target objectives must be removed from the battlefield by their commander. Those units are **vanished**. Then, starting with you, players must take it in turns to set up each friendly **vanished** unit wholly within 3" of either target objective and more than 3" from all enemy units. Those units cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first movement phase of the battle round. If it is impossible for a unit to be set up in this way, it is set up in reserve as a **lost** unit.

ability.name: Unpredictable Evolution
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
ability.effect: The target objectives are no longer controlled by either player (if they were) and they cannot be controlled this battle round.

ability.name: Mutating Blade
ability.lore: An iridescent flamberge, an axe with nine edges, a lash ending in an eagle’stalon: the form of the bearer’s weapon constantly shifts, making its strikes impossible to predict.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons. That weapon’s Attacks characteristic is 2D6 for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: The Spear of Asphoren
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: Those Idoneth who wish to follow the example of legendary commander Asphoren must strike at the foe like the surging tide.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Run Roughshod
ability.lore: Only a fool believes they can stop Hashut’s chosen from going where they wish.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** unit in combat to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Overripe Death's Heads
ability.lore: After carefully weighing a death’s head in their palm, the bearer hurls it at a nearby foe.
ability.declare: If your general is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 7" of them to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Long-range Support
ability.lore: The Codewright can call in a long-range barrage to reduce a troublesome obstacle to dust.
ability.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the **Codewright** in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Blessing of Tyrion
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Those who uphold the Decree Tyrionic and the values of the Lord Phoenix shine with a radiant glory that repels evil.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have completed 3 **labours**.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units have **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Soul Stealer
ability.lore: This warrior is said to siphon the spirits of fallen foes to sustain them in battle.
ability.effect: If your general is in combat, **Heal (D3)** your general.

ability.name: Entrenchment Expert
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘All-out Defence’ command for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this HERO
ability.lore: This hero prefers to engage their foes from heavy cover, keeping their own losses to a minimum.
ability.effect: That friendly unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: The Blasted Standard
ability.lore: Woven from threads of dark magic, this standard is inscribed with writhing runes and surrounded with the coruscating fires of change.
ability.effect:
This unit has the **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH** keyword.

In addition, while this unit includes any standard bearers, this unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

ability.name: Predicted Strike
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
ability.lore: Few seers are more accomplished when it comes to predicting an enemy’s movements.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general and that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move D6". It cannot move through the combat ranges of enemy units or end that move in combat.

ability.name: The Celestial Realm
ability.lore: In High Azyr, the Stormcast Eternals await their call to deliver retribution.
ability.declare: If there are more friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Celestial Realm**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Merciless Raider
ability.lore: This aelf gives no quarter to the enemies of the Idoneth. When in the vicinity of a wounded foe, they surge forwards to finish the job.
ability.effect: If this unit is within 6" of a damaged enemy unit, this unit can move 6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit.

ability.name: Foetid Orchardist
ability.lore: Those who tend the copses of Feculent Gnarlmaws will fight vigorously to protect their arboreal charges.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks while it is wholly within 7" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**.

ability.name: Adept Tactician
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Assembling reinforcements into ad-hoe regiments is the hallmark of a seasoned, if a somewhat desperate, general.
ability.declare: Pick 2 friendly **Freeguild Fusiliers** units that have been destroyed and have not already been replaced.
ability.effect: Set up a **single** replacement **Freeguild Fusiliers** unit with **10** models more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Gauntlets of Punishment
ability.lore: Cooled in the blood of duardin who sought to betray their sworn overlords, a spiteful gesture from these gauntlets can wrack a soul with unbearable pain.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Justice Will Be Served
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: When her appointed target is within her grasp, Neave fights with the overwhelming fury of an Azyrite storm.
ability.declare: Pick the **Neave Blacktalon** in this Regiment of Renown to be the target if it is in combat with an enemy **HERO**.
ability.effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. Each time it does so, if it is in combat with an enemy **HERO**, all of its attacks must target an enemy **HERO**. In addition, after the first **FIGHT** ability is used, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Remorseless March
ability.lore: The Ossiarchs advance into battle swiftly and mercilessly.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use **RUN** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: The Head Gardener
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The daemon responsible for tending the Garden has no equal in the propagation of its blighted orchards.
ability.effect: The friendly **Horticulous Slimux** can use his ‘Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle’ ability this phase even if there are 1 or more friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield.

ability.name: Amberbone Whetstone
ability.lore: This prized sharpening stone, laced with veins of realmstone, is found deep in the crags of Ghur. It is loved by the Ironjawz for its ability to make a weapon ‘ded sharp’.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Hawk of the Celestial Skies
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The sight of Yndrasta’s seraphic form inspires her warriors with immeasurable resolve.
ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of your general.

ability.name: Redeploy
ability.lore: Taking initiative, the warriors hastily reposition to respond to enemy movements.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move **cannot** pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

ability.name: Ammonite Carnyx
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This war-horn is carved from pearlescent shell. When blown, its thundering call summons every nearby Idoneth to battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM NAMARTI** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Scions of the Storm
ability.lore: Upon blessed bolts of lightning do the Stormcast Eternals ride to war, the furious rumble of thunder heralding their arrival.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is **in the** **Celestial Realm**.
ability.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Grunta Waaagh!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: Just before the stampede crashes headlong into the enemy lines, the Tuskboss bellows a mighty ‘Waaagh!’, encouraging their steeds to cause as much carnage as possible with their impact.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if this Regiment of Renown’s **Tuskboss on Maw-grunta** is on the battlefield.
ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time a friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown finishes a charge move, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 1" of that unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. If that enemy unit is **INFANTRY**, add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted (if any).

ability.name: Spirits of the Chorrileum
ability.lore: The spirit matter that animates an Eidolon is a malleable force that ebbs and surges in power as battle ensues.
ability.effect:
Each turn, you can gain up to 1 **chorrileum spirit point**. You gain 1 **chorrileum spirit point** the first time 1 of the following occurs in a turn:

• You make an unmodified casting roll of 8 or more for a friendly **ISHARANN WIZARD**.
• An enemy unit is destroyed while it is within 12" of any friendly **ISHARANN** units.
• A friendly unit is destroyed while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **ISHARANN** units or while it is contesting an objective you control

ability.name: Daemonic Reinforcements
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: Lesser daemons bound to the Dark Master’s will are summoned forth from the Realm of Chaos to swell Be’lakor’s ranks.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **Be’lakor** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Mighty Destroyers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Ironjawz won’t let anything get between them and a good scrap.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

ability.name: Sneaky 'Un
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: This beast prefers to sneak up on its prey and skulk off when the going gets tough, traits its Kruleboyz masters darkly approve of.
ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities this phase.

ability.name: The Knight's Vow
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Ushoran’s chosen spawn are fanatical in defending what they deem to be his.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit that did not charge this turn to be the targets.
ability.effect: Start rolling dice, one at a time and one for each target, and stop when you roll a 6. The target you rolled a 6 for can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. If you rolled for each target and did not roll a 6, this ability has no effect.

ability.name: Foul Fauna
ability.lore: The creatures that inhabit the Garden of Nurgle are ebullient monstrosities…
ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE** **Beasts of Nurgle** and **Plague Drones** units while they are wholly within 6" of any friendly **Feculent** **Gnarlmaws**.

ability.name: Corven Lord
ability.lore: The souls of those who lead the Ruination chambers are anathema to malign influence.
ability.effect: If this unit has the 'Ruination Chamber', ability, it can use that ability once per turn regardless of whether another friendly unit has used it during the same turn.

ability.name: Ninefold Blessings
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
ability.lore: Nine is the sacred number of Tzeentch and presages great victories and glories for his servants.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if the total value of your unspent **destiny dice** is exactly 9.
ability.effect:
Re-roll all of your unspent **destiny dice**. Then, until the start of your next turn:

• Friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units have **WARD (5+)**.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Add together the values shown on each unspent destiny dice to find the total value.*

ability.name: Collect the Tithe
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Nothing may halt the tithe-harvest.
ability.declare: Pick the **Gothizzar Harvester** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick a non-**HERO INFANTRY** unit (friendly or enemy) within its combat range to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain, then give the unit using this ability 1 **bone-tithe point**.

ability.name: Warpstone-laced Bullets
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Saturated with the energies of ruin, these munitions pack a deadly punch.
ability.declare: Pick a ranged weapon a friendly unit is armed with.
ability.effect: That weapon has **Crit (Mortal)** this phase.

ability.name: Their Finest Hour
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Stormcast Eternals are bastions of hope for the forces of Order. In times of desperate need, each fighter does what is necessary to keep their enemies at bay.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that has not used this ability this battle to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.

ability.name: Royal Blood
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The blood coursing through an abhorrant’s veins has restorative properties.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly **ABHORRANTS** to be the targets.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.

ability.name: Snatch 'Em Up!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: Skumdrekk and his hobgrot toadies are constantly on the lookout for new victims and beasts to snatch up.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this Regiment of Renown’s **Swampboss Skumdrekk** to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

ability.name: Mounting Dread
ability.lore: The keening wails and harrowing shrieks of the Nighthaunt are a continuous assault on the courage of those who face them in battle, until their will to fight has all but crumbled.
ability.effect: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.

ability.name: Acorn of the Ages
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Within this unassuming acorn lies untold potential for life.
ability.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** have **WARD (5+).**

ability.name: Rustfang
ability.lore: Rustfang is a cursed battleaxe whose blade crawls with a thick layer of sentient corrosion. The slightest touch of this blade spreads its blight, chewing away the foe’s defences in moments.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Stave of Suffering
ability.lore: This staff drinks in the misery and pain of nearby living things and converts it into powerful magic that can be harnessed by Nighthaunt spellcasters.
ability.effect: While this unit is within 12" of any damaged enemy units or enemy units that have had any models slain, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: The Realm Hungers
ability.lore: None can tell where hungry, chomping Mawpits will next manifest in the ground.
ability.effect: Units and **MANIFESTATIONS** are **vulnerable** **to Mawpits** while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a **Mawpit**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.

ability.name: One Wiv Da Beast
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: This shaman has consumed the spirits of many a beast, strengthening his spiritual connection to the Twin‑Headed God.
ability.effect: The next time this phase that this unit uses a **SPELL** ability, instead of making a casting roll for this unit, you can use a value of 6 for the roll that cannot be modified.

ability.name: Naughty Or Nice?
ability.lore: Your ability to catch Da Red Gobbo will all depend on how good you were this year.
ability.effect:
If you are the **naughty player**, friendly units’ melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo.

If you are the **nice player**, friendly units have **Ward (6+)** while they are contesting Da Red Gobbo.

ability.name: Amulet of Burning Hate
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: A sacred relic of the Drazghar order, this amulet is said to contain the merest flicker of Hashut’s depthless spite.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, your general’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

ability.name: Servile Automaton
ability.lore: This paranoid overlord shuns traditional bodyguards, instead favouring a looming daemon engine entirely bound to them through burning Zharralid carvings.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT AUTOMATON** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit’s bodyguard and the following effects apply:

•  While this unit is in combat and its bodyguard is within its combat range, its bodyguard has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
•  If this unit is **INFANTRY**, it has **WARD (5+)** while its bodyguard is within its combat range.

ability.name: Shroud of the Pale Elk
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
ability.lore: A thick, shimmering miasma swirls around these warriors, surrounding them in fractal mirages that confuse the foe and cause them to strike at nothing but thin air.
ability.usedBy: A friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability, if you have 1 or more **oath points**.
ability.effect: If that friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit has not used an **OATH** ability this turn, spend 1 **oath point**. For the rest of the turn, that friendly unit has **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: Choirmaster
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: The shrieks of this Gorewarden further bolster the howls of their Crypt Flayers.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of friendly units’ ranged weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Calculated Feint
ability.lore: To the Ossiarch legions, battle is but a plan to be enacted, each part meticulously choreographed down to the last detail.
ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **CAVALRY** units by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Ominous Fog
ability.lore: A thick fog follows the Lost-Song Spirits, making them difficult to identify until it is too late.
ability.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while they are wholly within 9" of the **Treelord** in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: The best laid plans of the Skaven never go awry (or so they claim).
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER SKAVEN** unit that is not in combat and was not set up this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Rune of Relentless Zeal
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The hearts of the Fyreslayers swell with a fiery conviction that sees them bear down upon the foe with surprising swiftness.
ability.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE A**bilities this battle round.

For the rest of the battle round, friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Hero of the Killing Games
ability.lore: This hero has an infamous winning streak in the Khainite arenas and delights in eviscerating worthy foes.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, while this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES**:
• Add 1 to the Attacks, Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons.
• All of its combat attacks must target the same enemy **HERO**.

ability.name: Nauseating Convalescence
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Phulgoth and his minions are empowered by the spread of hopelessness and woe.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each unit in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Disciples of Vizzik
ability.lore: The clawpacks of the Great-grand Gnawhorde protect their daemon-prophet by any means necessary.
ability.effect:
While a friendly **Vizzik Skour** is within the combat range of another friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit:

• That **Vizzik Skour** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Vizzik** **Skour**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.

ability.name: Endless Wandering
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: The spirits of the Lost-Song Forest are ever in motion, desperately seeking the ancestral harmonies denied to them.
ability.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that is not in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: The Hounds Apocalyptus
ability.lore: These champions have ridden far across the realms and are rabid in seizing whatever the Everchosen deems a worthy prize.
ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within enemy territory, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Bloodthirsty Blade
ability.lore: The runes engraved upon this weapon hungrily absorb the lifeblood of those it bites into.
ability.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general’s **Rune-etched Axe** is 2.

ability.name: The Red God's Eye
ability.lore: When the Gorechosen fight in unity, the Blood God's gaze is drawn. None would dare falter under such scrutiny.
ability.effect: Friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS** units have **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Bulwark of the Necropolis
ability.lore: No meagre foe may exert their will over the warriors of Katakros’s elite guard, the Scions Praetoris.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 2D6 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Speed of Hysh
ability.lore: The Cathallar magically empowers their allies to move with light’s swiftness.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 5+, double the Move characteristic of that unit until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Pitiless Reapers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The chill blades of the Clattering Procession flash down and reap a deadly harvest as they pass through the enemy ranks.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that passed across any enemy units this phase to use this ability, then pick 1 of those enemy units to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that passed across the target. Add 1 to the roll if any friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION Black Coaches** passed across the target this phase. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Heightened Reflexes
ability.lore: The keen senses of these warriors are second to none.
ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units that use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after another friendly unit because of the ‘Lightning Reactions’ ability, until the end of the phase.

ability.name: Constant Barrage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Brokk’s expert gunners are so precise that they can bombard the enemy even as they move to engage nearby Kharadron infantry.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** unit’s attacks to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move within 10" of any friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW** units, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Cloaked in Shadow
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: By the time enemies have uncovered a band of Skaven assassins, the ratmen are already in place to strike.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** to use this ability. Then, pick a different friendly unit that has 2 or more models to be the target.
ability.effect: Make a **shadow-travel roll** of D6. On a 3+, remove the **HERO** using this ability from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 6" of the target. They can be set up in combat with any enemy units that are already in combat.

ability.name: Skilled Manipulator
ability.lore: This Grey Seer is particularly devious and self-serving, deftly ensuring that their minions are always conveniently positioned between themselves and potential threats.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (4+)** while they are within 1" of any friendly **Clanrats** units.

ability.name: Fury of Zandtos
ability.lore: Zandtos's ire burns so brightly that his warriors are fuelled by a bloodlust usually absent among the cold and brutal Ossiarchs.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that charged this turn and that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. The target's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Lanky Git
ability.lore: This long-legged gargant strides across the battlefield at a frightening pace.
ability.effect: When you make a charge roll for your general, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6.

ability.name: Marrowpact
ability.lore: The glyphs borne to war by your general bind those who view them in arcane pacts.
ability.effect: Each time your general uses a **FIGHT** ability, after all of their attacks have been resolved, **Heal (X)** your general where **X** is the number of damage points allocated by those attacks.

ability.name: Sacred Rites
ability.lore: The priest focuses on safely setting their ritual into motion.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **PRIEST** to use this ability, then make a **chanting roll** of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that **PRIEST** instead of D3.
ability.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the **PRIEST** equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the **PRIEST**’s ritual points to 0.

ability.name: Oath of Kinship
ability.lore: Before the eyes of their fellow tribe members, this chieftain has made a bold oath that they are compelled to honour in order to reaffirm their right to rule.
ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of another friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.

ability.name: Timberrrrr!
ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
ability.effect: When the **MEGA‑GARGANT** in this regiment of renown is slain, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of that model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than that model.

ability.name: Let the Blood Flow
ability.lore: As the bloodshed escalates, the power of the Shrine of Dark Tribute waxes stronger and stronger, ushering in communal and murderous rage.
ability.effect:
All effects of the ‘Arena of Slaughter’ ability apply to friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units while they are wholly within **X**" of a friendly **Shrine of Dark Tribute**, where **X** is determined by the current battle round, as follows:

**Battle Round** - **X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"

ability.name: It's a Hard Life
ability.lore: It doesn't take much to become lunch when the leader of this Scrapglutt is around. The best the gnoblars can hope for is that someone else is gobbled up first.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Gnoblars** unit within your general's combat range to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• **Heal (X)** your general where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.

• 1 model in that **Gnoblars** unit is slain.

ability.name: The Garden Grows
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The tendrils of decay reach ever outwards to find fresh places of purity to contaminate.
ability.effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

ability.name: Cloaked in Shadow
ability.lore: Eerily intangible, this spirit’s ethereal form fades in and out of existence like some wispy cloud of supernatural mist.
ability.effect: No more than 1 enemy unit can target your general with attacks (shooting or combat) per phase.

ability.name: Hand of Khaine
ability.lore: This murderer has mastered Khaine’s killing touch, a move so lethal it can sunder plate, body and soul in equal measure.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. If the target is destroyed by this ability, this unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Deathless Monstrosity
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Mannfred von Carstein has ever been a deathmage of terrifying power. This risen Draconith, which resides among the highest spires of Castle Sternieste, is a masterwork of his arcane talent and almost impossible to vanquish.
ability.effect: **Heal (3)** this unit

ability.name: Restless Tyrant
ability.lore: The skeletal warriors under this one’s command are driven ever forward.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BARROW LEGION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Resanguination
ability.lore: The Slaughterpriest calls upon Khorne’s favour to sear the wounds of an ally so that they can continue to shed the blood of the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 16" of your general, then make a chanting roll of D6.
ability.effect: On a 3+, **Heal (D3)** that unit.

ability.name: Rejuvenating Bloom
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
ability.effect: **Heal (3)** each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target objective.

ability.name: Silver Wand
ability.lore: This slender wand, unassuming in its delicate grace and simplicity, is covered with finely engraved, winding Lumineth runes. It is imbued with the quiet dignity of the one who crafted it, a power that can be channelled by the bearer to dispel wild outbursts of enemy magics and focus their own spellweaving.
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Earth-Shaking Charge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: The ground shakes as the colossal gargants charge head-first into the fray.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this phase to use this ability, then roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with it.
ability.effect: On a 3+, that enemy unit has **STRIKE-LAST** this turn.

ability.name: Too Quick To Hit-hit
ability.lore: These skittish ratmen dart and run in all directions, avoiding retribution as they flee from combat.
ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units when they use **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Beast of the Dark Jungles
ability.lore: The perilous jungles of the Seraphon are the hunting grounds of the mighty Carnosaur, a reptilian titan that strikes fear and awe into the hearts of its enemies.
ability.declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they are in combat.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:

***Gargantuan Jaws:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain.

***Roar:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general. Subtract D6 from that unit’s control score this turn.

ability.name: Corrupted Regrowth
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.effect:
**Heal (7)** each friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw**.

If there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

ability.name: Silent Overseer
ability.lore: With a gesture of a translucent finger, this gheist orders those spirits who have fled from their enemies to charge again, heedless of the cost.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the targets can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Soul-drain Pendant
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: When the cursed words of awakening are uttered, this amethyst pendant saps the vigour of the living.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Veiled Promises
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Agents of Neferata are everywhere, manipulating enemies far and wide for mysterious purposes.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 6" of an **Icon of Nulahmia** terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if you are the **underdog.** On a 4+, add 3 to the target's control score for the rest of the turn. Otherwise, subtract 3 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Invictunite-lined Hull
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: Only the Lord-Magnate could afford to line his ships’ hulls with the incredibly strong meteoric metal invictunite.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW SKYVESSEL** to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. For the rest of the turn, subtract **X** from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that **SKYVESSEL**, where **X** is equal to the roll.

ability.name: No Safe Haven
ability.lore: The firepower of the Grundcorps pelts the ground so aggressively that no cover can protect their targets for long.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the control score of that unit for each damage point allocated to it this turn by a shooting attack made by a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE** unit, to a maximum of 10 damage points.

ability.name: The Realms Fight Back
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The spirits of the land itself awaken to aid the Lumineth in their struggle against the powers of ruin.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature. Then, pick an enemy unit within 6" of that terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3 and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn.

**1.  Eruption of Earth:** Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.
**2.  Howling Winds:** Subtract 5 from the target’s control score.
**3.  Flash Flood:** The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.

ability.name: Sunder the Sorcerous
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Baleful Lords are veterans of impossible battles across the mind-bending vistas of the Realm of Chaos. No mere spell, nor its caster, can oppose them.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy **MANIFESTATION** within 3" of a friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit to be a target.
ability.effect:
Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value of the target:
• That target is banished and removed from play.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy unit that summoned the target.

ability.name: Vengeful Outriders
ability.lore: Zandtos hurls his forces towards the enemy with unchecked fury.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target
