ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Eat Your Fill!
ability.lore: Now comes the most anticipated part of the celebrations: the great banquet.
ability.effect:
In the fourth battle round, each time a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved:

• If that unit is damaged, **Heal (D3)** that unit.
•  If that unit is not damaged, return up to 3 slain models to it.

ability.name: Impassive Retreat
ability.lore: The Bonereapers disengage and charge back into the fray, heedless of any losses sustained by their own ranks.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Hunter's Cohesion
ability.lore: The Horizon Seekers have long roamed the wilderness together, operating in well-honed unison to run circles around the foe.
ability.effect:
Each time this Regiment of Renown's **Lord-Aquilor** uses its 'Ride the Winds Aetheric' ability, you can pick all units in this Regiment of Renown that are not in combat to be the targets.

In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this Regiment of Renown's **Lord-Aquilor** and **Vanguard-Palladors** units that target a **HUNTED** enemy unit.

**Designer's Note:** *See the 'Astral Compass' ability on the Vanguard-Hunters warscroll to see how an enemy unit can become* **HUNTED**.

ability.name: Chosen of Quetzl
ability.lore: This champion of Quetzl the Preserver is a master tactician, coordinating the movement of nimble skinks to outmanoeuvre the foe.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**MONSTER SKINK** unit that is in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move up to 8". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Furiously Territorial
ability.lore: Nothing infuriates this gargant more than pipsqueaks laying claim to the lands around them.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by your general that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

ability.name: Multitudinous Diseases
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The soil around the Pustules’ Feculent Gnarlmaw is so ripe with a slew of diseases that the pestilent and malodorous gain unclean succour from its presence.
ability.declare: If this Regiment of Renown’s **Plaguebearers** unit is wholly within 12" of this Regiment of Renown’s **Feculent Gnarlmaw**, pick that **Plaguebearers** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** the target. If the target is contesting an objective, you can also return 1 slain model to the target unit.

ability.name: Tombstone of the Penitent
ability.lore: This tombstone, chained to the gheist cursed to bear it, begins to burn with spectral flames as the land around them is suffused with deathly energies.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature that is being contested by friendly units, to a maximum of 8.

ability.name: Exemplars of Fury
ability.lore: The leaders of the Skywings urge their scaled companions to strike with devastating force, their bloody assault an inspiration to all who witness it.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING HEROES** while they are within 6" of 2 or more friendly **Stormdrake Guard** units.

ability.name: Crucible of Spite
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This charm, a hollowed and profane statuette of Grungni, contains raging daemon essences that can be drawn on for strength. Yet such eager blasphemy does not go unpunished…
ability.effect: Give up to 3 **daemonic power points** to this unit. However, you cannot allocate or give any more **daemonic power points** to this unit for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Carve A Bloody Path
ability.lore: With unstoppable force, a wedge of Blood Knights punches through the enemy’s lines leaving a trail of broken foes in their wake.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use a **CHARGE** ability even though it is in combat and even if it has already used a **CHARGE** ability this turn.

ability.name: Tread Carefully
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of First Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick an objective within friendly territory to be the target.
ability.effect: The target is no longer **stable**.

ability.name: Bellow of Hatred
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The enmity released by this blood-curdling scream stuns nearby enemies.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target. The target cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Cankerous Nail
ability.lore: This nail has been dipped in Nurgle’s cauldron and seethes with corruption.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Gruksson Wide-bore Cylinders
ability.lore: This modified endrin guzzles fuel like Jakkob Bugmansson XI samples his stock, and is similarly energised for doing so.
ability.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

ability.name: Storm of Blackened Blades
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Eternus commands the mortal legions sworn to Be’lakor to bring ruin to all who dare oppose the First Prince.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Eternus** that is in combat and up to 2 friendly non-**HERO** non-**DAEMON LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** units wholly within 12" of that **Eternus** to be the targets.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Rally
ability.lore: With an inspiring call to action, wounded soldiers get a second wind and fresh troops take the field to replace their fallen comrades.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Make 6 **rally rolls** of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 **rally point**. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:

• For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** that unit.
• You can spend a number of rally points equal to the **Health** characteristic of that unit to **return** a slain model to that unit.

You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

ability.name: Defend to the Last
ability.lore: These fearless warriors refuse to fall until their task is completed.
ability.effect: Friendly units have **WARD (6+)** while they are contesting an objective you control.

ability.name: Fiercely Competitive
ability.lore: This leader is incredibly stubborn and won’t back down from even the boldest of challenges.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that has **STRIKE-FIRST**, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**. If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Assault Boat
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The speed and manoeuvrability of the Arkanaut Frigate allows it to deliver Arkanaut Companies directly into the fray.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that was **transported** this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

ability.name: Rally The Warclans
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: With a great bellow, the boss encourages a mob from the seemingly endless hordes to get stuck in.
ability.declare: If your general is on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BIG WAAAGH!** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of your general and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
ability.lore: These vessels contains greasy, pungent fluids that squirted from a Mawpit as it gobbled down a victim. They have fortifying effects on those chomping sinkholes into which they are poured.
ability.effect: Friendly **Mawpits** within this unit’s combat range have **WARD** **(5+)**.

ability.name: You Call It Yours, I Call It Mine
ability.lore: Aether-gold is Drekki Flynt’s great love, but other treasures will do in a pinch.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown that target an enemy unit that is within 6" of an enemy unit that has an enhancement.

ability.name: Deathly Possessor
ability.lore: In a flash of balefire, the Nighthaunt vanishes. An instant later, a nearby foe's eyes glow with spectral power and they lash out at their allies, cackling in a voice not their own.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** within 12" of your general to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick one:

• Inflict mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict mortal damage on the victim equal to the roll.

ability.name: An Eye For Loot
ability.lore: The Exile Scavengers observe from above to locate the best spot to swoop in and ‘claim their fee’.
ability.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
ability.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve **studying the battlefield**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Glarejester
ability.lore: This grot thinks he’s the funniest in all of grotdom. Everyone else disagrees.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit within 3" of this unit and that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. Add the roll to the distance the target can move when using **MOVE** abilities this phase. If the target ends a move in this phase within 3" of this **HERO**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on this **HERO** equal to the roll.

ability.name: Musician
ability.lore: The beat of a drum or the blast of a horn drives the soldiers ever onward.
ability.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional **rally roll** of D6.

ability.name: Well Provisioned
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: This brigade has a quartermaster well versed in the art of keeping their troops, healthy, hale and supplied with plenty of arrows and blackpowder.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Rampant Disease
ability.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly non-**HERO CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Feted Coronet
ability.lore: This crown wards the wearer so long as all their warriors chant in adoration.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** until a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** unit is destroyed.

ability.name: Hot-Blooded Endurance
ability.lore: A lifetime spent in the wilderness has left Kreel an indefatigable warrior.
ability.effect: Your general can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn and no mortal damage is inflicted on them by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Flight of the Zephyrspites
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: In their effort to reach Alarielle’s court and be healed, Elthwin’s Thorns are carried by swift and loyal Zephyrspites.
ability.effect: If both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range and neither unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove both units from the battlefield, then set them up again within each other’s combat range, wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Natural Disaster
ability.lore: A mass of heavily armoured orruks hit an enemy line like a landslide if they gain enough momentum, leaving a trail of carnage and blazing ruin in their wake.
ability.effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: All-out Attack
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
ability.lore: The warriors fight with a frenzied vigour.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **hit rolls** for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability. This also affects weapons that have the **Companion** weapon ability.

ability.name: Transport Skyfarers
ability.phaseDetails: Your Movement Phase, Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
ability.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
ability.effect:
Pick a number of units up to that **SKYVESSEL**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **SKYVESSEL** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **SKYVESSEL** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

ability.name: Keeper of the Old Ways
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘Further the Great Plan’ ability
ability.lore: Having spent centuries poring over tablets of the Old Ones or in deep meditation, or perhaps through some primal intuition, this Seraphon possesses knowledge of ancient secrets concerning the workings of the cosmos.
ability.effect: You can pick 2 different **ASTERISM** abilities instead of 1. They are both used in addition to the one you picked in the deployment phase.

ability.name: Death-grip
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT ability that targeted a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit
ability.lore: As the enemy brings their firepower to bear, this general urges their kin to stay within claw’s grasp of their assailants.
ability.effect: If that friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** unit is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit, after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, that friendly unit can move 2D6". It can move into combat.

ability.name: Vitiating Vapours
ability.lore: By burning grains of grave-sand in his brazier, Veremord creates smoke that can corrode eldritch defences.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of the **Corpse Cart** in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: The Clammy Cowl
ability.lore: This enchanted hood wreathes its wearer in damp gloom, causing enemies to swing wildly at their blurred outline and weapons to slip in suddenly moistened palms.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Grave-sand Shard
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Skeleton Legion’ ability for a unit within 9" of your general
ability.lore: By crushing this gem of vitrified grave-sand, the Vampire Lord can draw upon a surge of death magic to reinvigorate their resurrected warriors.
ability.effect: Add 1 to each **legion roll** made for that unit.

ability.name: Darkling Elixir
ability.lore: Crafted from the blood of creatures best left unnamed, this wicked brew lends the imbiber’s outline a smoky, wispy appearance.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Song of the Hunt
ability.lore: The warriors of a Spitewing Flight are energised by the increasingly harmonious notes of the spirit-song as they fight, building momentum with every defeated foe.
ability.effect:
You gain 1 **chord** each time an enemy **quarry** is destroyed. The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of **chords** you have:

1 chord - **Simple**: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units while they are within 9" of the enemy **quarry**.
2 chords - **Tuneful**: Add 1 to hit rolls for friendly units’ attacks while they are within 9" of the enemy **quarry**.
3+ chords - **Melodic**: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly units’ attacks while they are within 9" of the enemy **quarry**.

ability.name: Mark of Khorne
ability.lore: This general serves the Blood God and promises to deliver endless carnage upon the battlefield in return for his dark gifts.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons if they charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Zephyrkin
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for your general
ability.lore: The bond that this Arch-Revenant has with their companion zephyrspite is so strong that they can perform hit-and-run attacks with bewildering agility.
ability.effect: If your general charged this turn, they can move up to 2D6" after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved. They cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Gaseous Emanation
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The sorcerer releases a vile cloud of gas that chokes their enemies.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within your general’s combat range to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: The Clammy Hand
ability.lore: This boss is obviously destined for great things and can call upon vast troglodytic hordes.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Voidstone Orb
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit
ability.lore: This small, unassuming black globe contains the power to disrupt enemy spells.
ability.effect: That spell is unbound.

ability.name: Revolution and Revulsion
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: Nurgle’s power and blessings follow a never-ending cycle of fecundity and decay.
ability.declare: You must use this ability at the start of each battle round.
ability.effect:
If it is the first battle round, roll a dice to determine which **CYCLE** ability is ripe for the rest of the battle round.

1 ‘Unnatural Vitality’
2 ‘Fecund Vigour’
3 ‘Burgeoning Filth’
4 ‘Plague of Misery’
5 ‘Nauseous Revulsion’
6 ‘Rampant Disease’
7 ‘Corrupted Regrowth’

If it is not the first battle round, the next **CYCLE** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round. If the ‘Corrupted Regrowth’ ability was ripe last battle round, the ‘Unnatural Vitality’ ability is ripe this battle round.

You can only use a **CYCLE** ability if it is ripe. Only 1 **CYCLE** ability is ripe each battle round.

ability.name: Power Through
ability.lore: The warriors use their sheer mass or resilience to drive through a group of weaker foes, leaving broken bodies in their wake.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

ability.name: Way of the Skittering Shade
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: It is said that a soul marked for death is never more than a few feet from lurking Eshin agents.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Timeslip Pendant
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Time is a mutable concept to the bearer of this amulet.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of your general.
ability.effect: That unit has **STRIKE-LAST** this phase.

ability.name: Pack Tactics
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Though insane with frenzy, the beasts of Thanquol's menagerie retain some of their predatory swarming instincts..
ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: The targets can each use the 'All-out Attack' or 'All-out Defence' command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.

ability.name: Grabby
ability.lore: If you have something this gargant wants, you won’t have it for long.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.

ability.name: Rapid Relocation
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The Gunhauler’s pilot assumes a high trajectory before looping around and rejoining the battle from a different direction.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit with **FLY** to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units. The target cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.

ability.name: Full of Life
ability.effect: Friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** have **STRIKE-FIRST**.

ability.name: The Shield of Ulchiss
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Mastery of the ebb and flow of battle is core to the teachings of Ulchiss, which state that a timely withdrawal can open up enemy vulnerabilities.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time that unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

ability.name: Living Plague
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: As this hero slams into the foe, they spread Nurgle’s potent gifts of contagion.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

ability.name: Sotek the Deliverer
ability.lore: The Asterism of Sotek emboldens the Seraphon with a war-hungry aggression.
ability.effect: Add 2 to the Move characteristic of friendly **SERAPHON** units.

ability.name: Spell-Eater Pendant
ability.lore: This amulet devours magic and channels it to empower its bearer.
ability.effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell or banishes an enemy **MANIFESTATION**, gain 1 **fate point**.

ability.name: Feeding Frenzy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The presence of an abhorrant drives their followers into a furore
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

ability.name: Powerful Presence
ability.lore: With a roaring voice and mighty displays of strength, your general is an imposing figure upon the battlefield.
ability.effect: Add 3 to your general’s control score.

ability.name: The Land Awakens
ability.lore: The spirit-song thrums with strident aggression and the shrill lamentations of the fallen, rousing dormant forest spirits in the vicinity and drawing them to battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO REVENANT INFANTRY** unit or friendly **DRYADS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Immaculate Generalship
ability.lore: The Ossiarch Bonereapers instantly understand the intent of their commander and seamlessly move to act upon it.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **discipline rolls** you make.

ability.name: In Their Sire's Shadow
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: When Ushoran himself takes to the field, his knights are seized by an irrepressible mania to follow at his monstrous heels.
ability.declare: If the friendly **Ushoran** is not in combat and has not used any **RUN** or **RETREAT** abilities this turn, pick him to use this ability. Then, pick up to 2 friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT KNIGHTS** units within his combat range that are not in combat and have not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn to be his **royal retinue**. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: The friendly **Ushoran** can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If he does so, he has charged. If he charged, then after this ability has been resolved, each unit in his **royal retinue** can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase and you can use the charge roll from this ability instead of making a charge roll when it does so, but it must end the charge move within 3" of the friendly **Ushoran**.

ability.name: Bred for Toughness
ability.lore: Ogors choose only the toughest and most thick-skinned beasts to carry them into battle.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Health characteristic of your **Ironblaster** and your **Mournfang Pack** unit.

ability.name: Sneaky Prowlin'
ability.lore: Letting their temporary allies grab the majority of the foe’s attention, the Shinestealaz circle around the flanks.
ability.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if none of them have been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **prowlin’ around**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Dark Resurrection
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Black Coach's occupant is fed the amethyst energies drawn by the slaughter, fuelling their return to undeath.
ability.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DEATH INFANTRY HERO** that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit. The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Subcutaneous Suppuration
ability.lore: The sheer abundance of pus beneath the sorcerer’s skin acts as another layer of armour.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target your general.

ability.name: The Ocean Conceals
ability.lore: Hidden by the froth and churn of the ethersea, an Eidolon of Mathlann can emerge in the very midst of its enemies.
ability.declare: This ability must be used to deploy the friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** instead of the ‘Deploy Unit’ ability or the ‘Deploy Regiment’ ability.
ability.effect: Set up the friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** in reserve **awaiting a summons**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Crest of the Ionrach
ability.lore: This crystal relic of the Ionrach is granted only to its greatest heroes and most rigorous defenders.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Delusion of the Sentinel
ability.lore: Convinced that they are the last line of defence, the ghouls fight on with a shrieking grit.
ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to ward rolls for friendly units while each model in the unit is contesting an objective.

ability.name: The Good Ship Aelsling
ability.lore: Flynt’s beloved skyship has endured all that the realms can throw at her with stubborn indifference.
ability.effect: The **AELSLING** has a Health characteristic of 17 instead of 14.

ability.name: Megagobbler
ability.lore: Surveying the enemies lined up before them as if considering items on a menu, this ogor chooses today’s main course.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following keywords:

• **INFANTRY**
• **CAVALRY**
• **MONSTER**
• **WAR MACHINE**
• **BEAST**

For the rest of the battle, each time any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit with that keyword by this unit’s combat attacks and that enemy unit is destroyed in the same turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. This effect is cumulative.

ability.name: Prodigy of the Asydrzor
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared an **ASYDRAZOR** ability for a friendly FIRST PHALANX unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: A true product of the Deepkin’s martial enlightenment, this warrior is renowned for their strategic brilliance.
ability.effect: No **asydrazor points** are spent to use that ability.

ability.name: Rhythm of the Chase
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Evergreen Hunt relentlessly tracks its prey, skilfully manoeuvring it into a killing ground to administer a fatal blow.
ability.declare: If there is no **quarry** on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
ability.effect: The target is the **quarry** for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Nightmare Legacy
ability.lore: The repressed horror of the Idoneth’s long incarceration emanates from this dark-visaged warrior in palpable waves of doom.
ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

ability.name: Longstrider
ability.lore: This warrior is said to be capable of running down a sprinting rhinox.
ability.effect: Your general has a Move characteristic of 8" instead of 6".

ability.name: Get Around 'Em
ability.lore: With a cackle, groups of Gitmob grots race off into the distance to surround and outflank the foe.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ’S GITMOB** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **outflanking the enemy**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Unhinged Rampager
ability.lore: This creature’s bestial hunger sees them close on the foe without hesitation.
ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.

ability.name: Imperious Commander
ability.lore: This general is unforgiving of failure, and their demands are met with incredible swiftness.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Immaculate Defender
ability.lore: This warlord knows precisely how to maximise the peerless resilience of the Ossiarch Bonereapers through defensive formations and overlapping shieldwalls.
ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Ravenous Shrieks
ability.lore: The power of this Terrorgheist’s sonic shrieks seems to magnify the more vigorously it feeds on flesh.
ability.effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by this unit’s shooting attacks, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Death Shriek** for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative).

ability.name: Storm Charge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: These warriors are driven forward by their faith, ever eager to bring Sigmar’s holy retribution to his enemies.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.
ability.effect: That unit can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Clarionbuds
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: These flowers, nestled in the undergrowth, are easily overlooked. Should any who bear hostile intent towards the grove draw near to them, they explosively unfurl in a puff of pollen and brilliant colour. Their true worth, however, lies in the strident resonance in the spirit-song when they do so, which alerts Sylvaneth defenders to the incursion.
ability.declare: If there is an enemy unit wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove**, pick up to 3 friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: The Queen's Prize
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: What Neferata desires, Neferata receives.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the target’s control score.

In addition, at the end of this turn, after determining control of objectives, if the target is contesting an objective that you control and that was controlled by your opponent at the start of this turn, add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Defenders of the Realm
ability.lore: These deluded ghouls see themselves as noble defenders, selling their lives dearly to drive back the invader from beyond.
ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units that are contesting an objective you control.

ability.name: Sepulchral Apparitions
ability.lore: Like sinister visions intruding upon reality, the haunted crypts of the Nighthaunt shimmer into existence wherever there are souls to be captured and tortured.
ability.effect:
If there is a friendly **Nexus of Grief** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Nexus of Grief** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

ability.name: Seed of Rebirth
ability.lore: Should its bearer ever fall, the seed will grant them new life.
ability.effect: If your general would be destroyed, before removing them from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, your general is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on them have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** your general. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Stinking Sporeseed
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Chewed by blackened teeth, this seed is ripe with putrescence. Once planted, it germinates into a pestilential bloom of magnificent proportions.
ability.effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** within 3" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

ability.name: Bold As Brass
ability.lore: Whether their roared oaths ring louder than the summons to Musterpress or the sheer audacity of their actions speaks volumes, this officer is an imposing presence on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score.

ability.name: Lifebringers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Hailing from the vast boughs of the Oak of Ages Past, the life-giving magic of Ghyran permeates the sap-blood of these warriors and their steeds, causing their wounds to heal nigh instantaneously.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly unit.

ability.name: The Shield of Ulchiss
ability.lore: Mastery of the ebb and flow of battle is core to the teachings of Ulchiss, which state that a timely withdrawal can open up enemy vulnerabilities.
ability.declare: You must spend 1 **asydrazor point** each time a friendly **FIRST PHALANX** unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

•  That unit can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Extraction Fail-safes
ability.lore: This Endrinmaster has fitted their Dirigible Suit with non-essential components that can be jettisoned to distract a pursuing foe.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the number of damage points inflicted on this unit when it uses a **RETREAT** ability.

ability.name: Praetorian Elite
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Lance of Ossia ride to war in perfect unison, efficiently and precisely enacting Zandtos's will without the mortal inadequacies of doubt, fear or regret.
ability.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA HEROES** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: You gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number shown after the target's **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **relentless discipline** points are lost.

ability.name: Run
ability.lore: The unit rushes into position.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Make a **run roll** of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its **Move** characteristic added to the **run roll**. That unit **cannot** move into combat during any part of that move.

ability.name: Temple Guardians
ability.lore: This Windmage has been assigned a dedicated Vanari bodyguard.
ability.effect: While any friendly **INFANTRY** units are within your general’s combat range, both your general and those **INFANTRY** units have **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Overwhelming Hordes
ability.lore: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly non-**HERO** units that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

ability.name: Song of the Hunt
ability.lore: The stirring battle-song of Kurnoth’s hunters grows in intensity with every foe slain, until the world resounds to a crescendo of deafening, harshly melodic notes.
ability.effect:
The following cumulative effects apply to friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** units depending on the number of **chords** you have:

**1 chord – *Simple***: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.

**2 chords – *Tuneful***: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks that target an enemy unit wholly within the same quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.

**3-5 chords – *Melodic***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly units while they are in combat with the quarry.

**6+ chords – *Mellifluous***: While a friendly unit is in combat with the quarry, the quarry has **STRIKE-LAST**.

ability.name: Eye of the Gods
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Slaves to Darkness seek to attract the notice of the gods by performing great deeds in battle.
ability.declare:
Pick one of the following friendly units to use this ability:

• A unit that is **contesting an objective not controlled by your opponent** and is not in combat.
• A unit that **destroyed an enemy unit** this turn.
ability.effect: Roll once on the **Eye of the Gods table** for that unit. That unit gains the **Eye of the Gods** passive ability that corresponds to the roll (the unit keeps all Eye of the Gods abilities gained in previous turns). If the same unit gains the same ability more than once in the battle, the effects are **not** cumulative.
ability.altText: D6 roll of 1. Snubbed by the Gods. No effect. D6 roll of 2. Ward of Tzeentch. This unit has Ward (6+). D6 roll of 3. Grace of Slaanesh. Add 1 to run rolls for this unit. D6 roll of 4. Blessing of Nurgle. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit. D6 roll of 5. Fury of Khorne. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. D6 roll of 6. Champion of Chaos. Pick any ability from the table.

ability.name: Extra-calloused Feet
ability.lore: This gargant has become so used to stomping on even the toughest enemies that their feet are legendary weapons in their own right.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic, Rend characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Almighty Stomp** or **Almightier Stomp**.

ability.name: Celestium Ensign
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The sight of this ancient heirloom spurs Draconith to draw upon hidden reserves of strength.
ability.effect: **Heal (3)** each friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Settling Accounts
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The artycles of engagement encourage the settling of one’s debts through the application of heavy explosives.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** was destroyed this turn by an enemy unit.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** is removed from the battlefield, before removing it, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of that **AUTO-ENDRIN**.

ability.name: Splinters of the Vermindoom
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: In the aftermath of the Vermindoom, reality continues to fracture and tear as gnawholes bore into reality, spewing forth endless tides of ratmen.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if there are fewer than 3 friendly **Gnawholes** on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Set up a **Gnawhole** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

ability.name: Bombz Away, Ladz!
ability.lore: Da Kountin’ Krew need only a single thumping drumbeat to start hurling their grenades.
ability.effect: Friendly units in this Regiment of Renown can use **RUN** abilities and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn while they are wholly within 12" of this Regiment of Renown’s **SWAMPBOSS SKUMDREKK**.

ability.name: A Glorious Banquet
ability.lore: As the court closes on its prey, the nobility signal for the feast to begin.
ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**.

ability.name: A Wastrel and a Vagabond
ability.lore: This spiteful creature is an embarrassment to their undead peers: perhaps a vampire fallen from favour, a wight who failed in their duty to their king, or a Necromancer who pushed their luck one time too many. Regardless of the reason, they seem to have an affinity with the basest undead minions.
ability.effect:
While a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** or **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Add 2 to run rolls for that unit.
• Add 3" to the distance that unit can move when it piles in.

ability.name: Masters of Destiny
ability.phaseDetails: Once per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and manipulate them at will.
ability.effect:
Roll 9 dice and put them to one side. These are your **destiny** **dice**. During the battle, instead of rolling the dice for 1 of the rolls from the list below, you can pick one of your **destiny** **dice** and use it as the roll. Once a destiny dice has been used, it is discarded.

If you want to replace a roll that uses more than one D6, you must use the same number of **destiny dice** (e.g. you would need to use 2 **destiny dice** in place of a 2D6 casting roll). Rolls that are replaced count as unmodified rolls and cannot be re-rolled or modified unless noted.

The following rolls can be replaced with **destiny dice**:

• Casting rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls – you must still modify the roll by the Rend characteristic of the attacking weapon.

ability.name: Kingslaughter Cowl
ability.lore: Those who wear this blood-encrusted leather hood make it their business to crush upstart monarchs and warlords across the realms.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit is in combat with an enemy **HERO**.

ability.name: Blubbergrub
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: These filthy and disturbingly large maggots are a favourite of the big beasties of the mawtribes.
ability.declare: Pick either your **Ironblaster** or your **Mournfang Pack** unit if it is within your general’s combat range.
ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** that unit.

ability.name: Blood-drenched
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: As blood gushes down blades, armour and teeth, the fervent warriors of the Blood God are driven into a divine frenzy.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that slew any enemy models using a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal).**

ability.name: Knights of the First Circle
ability.lore: The First Circle of the Varanguard comprises Archaon’s own elite retinue. When they strike from the Chaos-cursed skies, ruin surely follows.
ability.declare: If there are more friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** units on the battlefield than there are set up in reserve, pick a friendly **SWORDS OF CHAOS** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Ruinous Skies**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Fearless Invaders
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: These warriors are skilled raiders, riding into enemy settlements to plunder and pillage before retreating from more organised resistance.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: If the target uses a **RETREAT** ability this turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

ability.name: Crusading Army
ability.lore: The warriors of this court see themselves a crusading paladins venturing out into the realms with a holy cause.
ability.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units.

ability.name: Amulet of Waking Nightmares
ability.lore: This loathsome amulet afflicts harrowing visions on a chosen victim, whose subsequent throat- rending screams allow Nighthaunt marksmen to locate their target no matter where they hide.
ability.declare: Pick a enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target cannot be affected by the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability or the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability.

ability.name: Blood-drenched
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared the ‘Skulls for the Skull Throne’ ability
ability.lore: As blood gushes down blades, armour and teeth, the fervent warriors of the Blood God are driven into a divine frenzy.
ability.effect:
After that ability has been resolved, if you unlocked a **BLOOD TITHE** ability this turn, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit to be the target. The following effects apply to the target for the rest of the battle:
***Wild-eyed Brutality:*** Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
***Blood Haze:*** If the target is **BLOODBOUND**, its **Blood-hungry** weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
***Weapons of Murder:***  If the target is a non-**MONSTER DAEMON** unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its **Blood-hungry** weapons, including **Blood-hungry Companion** weapons.
***Bloodlords Supreme:*** If the target is a **MONSTER**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its **Blood-hungry** weapons.

ability.name: Defence of the Realm
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of friendly units’ melee weapons while they are contesting either of the target objectives.

ability.name: Talisman of Obsidian
ability.lore: The obsidian jewel set within this amulet shrouds the bearer and protects them from harm.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Feigned Retreat
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: At an unseen and unheard signal, the Kavalos Vanguard pivots effortlessly from one engagement to another.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Shadow Avatar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: The shadow of the Avatar of Khaine peels away and attacks the foe, every strike cleaving through both body and soul.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Punishment Fits the Crime
ability.lore: For Gormayne, the practice of law is quite simple. The crime is always life; the sentence is always death.
ability.effect: You believe the ‘Accusations of Regicide’ **DELUSION** (see Grand Justice Gormayne’s warscroll).

ability.name: Well-stocked Larder
ability.lore: This Butcher would never be caught lacking for tasty, bloody ‘treats’.
ability.effect: Your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron becomes **full**.

ability.name: Engulfing Shadows
ability.lore: Those who serve Mannfred von Carstein excel in the unforeseen strike.
ability.effect: Each time a unit in this Regiment of Renown is set up, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Immortal Dedication
ability.lore: Having spent centuries in undeath honing their martial skill, this Gravelord is a master of combat.
ability.effect:
This unit receives D3 **martial prowess tokens**. Each **martial prowess token** can be spent to do 1 of the following:

• Re-roll a hit roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a wound roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a save roll for this unit.

At the start of the next turn, remove all this unit’s **martial prowess tokens**.

ability.name: Dritchleech
ability.lore: Incredibly rare, these worms feed upon magic and are capable of draining arcane energies.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit.

ability.name: An Eye for Weakness
ability.lore: Whether bargaining a Wage of Toil or considering the press of battle, this duardin can readily sense vulnerability.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Mirror of Echoing Failures
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a WIZARD or PRIEST within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: To fail in front of this awful artefact is to have those miseries echoed in excruciating detail by a caterwauling reflection of your own face deriding your futile efforts.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy **WIZARD** and **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, for the rest of the phase:

• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the targets.
• Each time any of the targets fails to cast a spell or chant a prayer, inflict 1 mortal damage on that target.

ability.name: Blood for the Blood God
ability.lore: *Khorne cares not from where the blood flows...*
ability.effect: Earn 1 blood tithe point each time a unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed. Blood tithe points are spent to unlock **BLOOD TITHE** abilities. You can only use **BLOOD TITHE** abilities that are unlocked. Once a **BLOOD TITHE** ability is unlocked, you do not need to spend further blood tithe points to use it.

ability.name: Mutagenic Sorcery
ability.lore: As warriors fall around the Tzaangors, some mutate to become the creature that struck them down.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the enemy target. Then, pick a friendly Tzaangors unit in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.
• You can return 1 slain model to the friendly target.

ability.name: Fated Arrival
ability.lore: Followers of Tzeentch ride the waves of fate to ultimate victory.
ability.effect: Set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: 'Break Them, One and All...'
ability.lore: A Ziggurat Stampede is unleashed for one reason – to crush all in its path.
ability.effect: Any number of friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command in the same turn.

ability.name: No One Rides For Free
ability.lore: Kharadron can make a healthy profit transporting allies via the skyways.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the **Codewright** in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Ironclad Despoilers
ability.lore: Punching into the enemy lines like a mailed fist, once these warriors have taken a vital position on the battlefield, little can be done to wrest control from them.
ability.effect:
Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown while they are contesting an objective you control.

Add 1 to wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown while they are contesting an objective you do not control.

ability.name: Duty Bound
ability.lore: Hanniver Toll has assembled a formidable array of agents, bound by oath – or debt – to serve Sigmar unto death.
ability.effect: While every model in the same unit in the Regiment of Renown is contesting the same objective, add 1 to save rolls and ward rolls for that unit.

ability.name: Massive Bulk
ability.lore: Big, lumbering and nigh-on impossible to kill.
ability.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of your general.

ability.name: Blighted Regrowth
ability.lore: Feculent Gnarlmaws burst forth from contaminated lands like pus from a rotting wound.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if there are no friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws** on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield wholly within 12" of an objective you control and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

ability.name: Suppressive Bombardment
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Shows of extreme force are a favoured tactic of the Zharrdron.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn as a result of shooting attacks made by a friendly **Tormentor Bombard** to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

ability.name: Strident War Cry
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for an anointed unit
ability.lore: As the anointed champion unleashes a piercing battle cry, her faithful rush to join her in the crucible of combat.
ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of that **anointed** unit and has not charged this turn to be the target. If that **anointed** unit charges, after that **CHARGE** ability has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Glimpse the Future
ability.lore: By focusing on the skeins of potential fates, the sorcerer can glean hints of future events in time to manipulate them.
ability.declare: If you have fewer than 6 **destiny dice**, make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 7+, you can roll a dice and add it to your **destiny dice**.

ability.name: Tactical Gambit
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
ability.lore: You order your troops to seize an opportunity that has arisen amidst the flow of battle.
ability.effect: Pick 1 battle tactic that you have not yet attempted. You can attempt to complete that battle tactic this turn.
ability.additionalRulesText: You cannot use this ability if you went second in the previous battle round and chose to go first in the current battle round.

ability.name: Eatin' On Da Hoof
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: Maw-gruntas have mastered the art of feeding on the move, snatching up unlucky victims and mashing them between their oversized teeth as they hurtle onwards.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRUNTA STAMPEDE MONSTER** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice and add the momentum score of the unit using this ability to the roll. If the result exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

ability.name: Thaumic Realignment
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The seeding of deathly energies soon sees the fell winds rise…
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly **WIZARD** to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to casting rolls for the target. In addition, at the end of this turn, if the target successfully cast any spells this turn, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Ley Lines
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Sylvaneth draw strength from natural sites of mystical power.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each friendly unit that is within 3" of any terrain features.

ability.name: Furious Temper
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Nothing can stop this Mega-Gargant when the rage of battle clouds their mind.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Frenzied Momentum
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Hateful bells clanging in their minds, the swarms of the Great-grand Gnawhorde surge into the fray.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the targets.
• Subtract 1 from the targets' control scores.

ability.name: Grave-sand Pendant
ability.lore: When shattered, the Shyishan realmstone within this talisman can forestall the bearer’s final destruction, granting them one last chance to claim revenge.
ability.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Itzl the Tamer
ability.lore: Itzl is the most bestial of all the Old Ones and his asterism fills the Seraphon with ferocity.
ability.effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SERAPHON** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Masters of Destiny
ability.lore: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and be able to manipulate their potential to the fullest.
ability.effect:
Roll 9 dice and place them to one side. These are your **destiny dice**. **Destiny dice** can be spent during the battle to change certain dice rolls. You can never have more than 9 **destiny dice** at once.

During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** unit, you can spend your **destiny dice**. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the **destiny dice** you spend. If you want to replace a 2D6 roll, 3D6 roll, etc. you must spend a number of destiny dice equal to the number before ‘D6’. Any rolls that have been replaced count as unmodified rolls, and they cannot be re-rolled or modified by other friendly abilities except for those that apply negative modifiers (but they can be modified by enemy abilities). You cannot spend destiny dice to replace re-rolls.

**Destiny dice** can be spent in place of the following dice rolls:

• Casting rolls
• Unbinding rolls
• Banishment rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls in your turn
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls

ability.name: Glimpse The God
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Those who spy a shard of Zarxor's truths fight without human restraint.
ability.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be a target.
ability.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by the target's combat attacks this turn, that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, and no damage points were allocated to that enemy unit this turn by combat attacks made by a friendly unit that is not in this Regiment of Renown, for the rest of the battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Blood-hungry** weapons.

ability.name: Leaves on the Wind
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: These warriors attack swiftly and then retreat into the cover of the canopy.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase and no mortal damage is inflicted on it if it does so.

ability.name: Oi! Back To It!
ability.lore: A harsh bark from Zoggrok or his enforcers can put steel into the spine of any orruk.
ability.effect: If a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ Ardboyz** or **Brutes** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Blaze of Glory
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: As these warriors are struck down, Sigmar’s holy lightning wreaks devastation around them before they are called back to the heavens to be Reforged.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat.
ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit is slain, make a **vengeance roll** of D6. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit in combat with that unit.

ability.name: Abundant Growth
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Lush, restorative flora blossoms and blooms in the path of the Evergreen Hunt.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit that is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature to be the targets.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each target.

ability.name: Swift-Finned Skirmisher
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for this unit
ability.lore: These creatures react to subtle ripples in the ethersea to avoid danger.
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that this unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Numberless Pests
ability.lore: The Nurglites are obscured by flies.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units.

ability.name: Labour of Might
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Vanari vow to vanquish those who threaten the sanctity of the realms.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed this battle.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units.

ability.name: The Power of The Waaagh!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The power of Gorkamorka reaches a climax of violent energy when orruks gather as a Big Waaagh!.
ability.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **BIG WAAAGH! IRONJAWZ** unit and up to 1 friendly **BIG WAAAGH! KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: The targets have the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword for the rest of the battle round.

ability.name: Heirloom Blade
ability.lore: Wielded in countless battles, the edge of this blade is as keen as the day it was forged.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s **Master-forged Longsword**.

ability.name: Gothizzar Cartouche
ability.lore: Inscribed by Nagash himself, this cartouche is emblematic of the hatred the dead have for the living and stokes their desire for revenge.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Labour of Precision
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The Vanari seek to deliver a series of perfect strikes to unravel the cohesion of the foe, eliminating their commanders with precision and decisiveness.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if there are no enemy units with an artefact of power on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 10 to the control scores of friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units.

ability.name: Forward to Victory
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
ability.lore: With their charge faltering, a rousing command gives the unit renewed energy to reach their foes.
ability.effect: You can re-roll the **charge roll**.

ability.name: Slippery Skumbag
ability.lore: This wily boss has mastered the art of the feint, breaking away from fights that aren’t going his way and then coming back for another go when the odds are in his favour.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

ability.name: Thickened Scales
ability.lore: This beast’s hide is so tough that blades bend upon contact and conventional missiles simply bounce off it.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Gather Power
ability.lore: Nagash's formidable will gathers magical power to reinvest his divine spirit with corporeal raiment once more. During his unholy resurrection, there is a brief window where he is at his most vulnerable.
ability.effect:
The following effects apply to the friendly **Nagash** during the first and second battle rounds, as shown:

**Battle Round 1:**

• His Move characteristic is'-' and he cannot make pile-in moves.
• He has **WARD (3+).**
• He has a Control characteristic of 1.
• **Alakanash** and **Zefet-nebtar** each have an Attacks characteristic of 2 instead of 4.

**Battle Round 2:**

• His Move characteristic is 6".
• He cannot end a move more than 6" from the **ritual site.**
• He has **WARD (4+).**
• He has a Control characteristic of 5.
• **Alakanash** and **Zefet-nebtar** each have an Attacks characteristic of 2 instead of 4.

ability.name: Daemonic Summoning
ability.lore: The scions of Nurgle enter the battlefield through rifts torn in reality.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Ferocious Heat
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The hero stirs the rage of their Magmadroth, stoking its smouldering aura to such heights that it burns through arcane wards and enchantments.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS MONSTER** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Arcane Siphon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This enigmatic device can drain the animating force from nearby magical emanations and transmute it into a shimmering, rejuvenating tonic.
ability.declare: Pick a visible **MANIFESTATION** (friendly or enemy) that was not set up this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the target’s Health characteristic.

ability.name: Pledged to Slaanesh
ability.lore: The thrill of battle drives these warriors to charge at spectacular speed.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for friendly **PLEDGED TO SLAANESH** units, you can roll 1 additional dice (to a maximum of 3), but if you do, you must discard 1 dice of your choice.

ability.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
ability.lore: Soulreaper can call upon stolen life essence to bolster nadirite weapons.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Guard** unit wholly within 12" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 5+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Backstabber's Blade
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: A slitta made from pure shadow and malice, this blade always finds its victim’s weak spots.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Cackling Arrival
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Whether diving from the skies or rising suddenly from the very ground, a host of gheists catches the foe unaware.
ability.declare: Pick 1 of your units in reserve.
ability.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Da Great Wollopa
ability.lore: Infused with the arcane indignation of the Waaagh!, da Great Wollopa is good for krumpin’ whatever needs krumpin’.
ability.effect:
If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made by this unit, that enemy unit is **krump’d** until the start of your next turn.

While a unit is **krump’d**:

• Subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

ability.name: Possessed By The Power Of The Waaagh!
ability.lore: When a Waaagh! really gets going, the orruks become a terrifying force to be reckoned with.
ability.effect:
While a friendly unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword:

• If that unit has the **IRONJAWZ** keyword, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for that unit.

• If that unit has the **KRULEBOYZ** keyword, that unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

ability.name: Talisman of Obsidian
ability.lore: Bartered in exchange for years of gruelling service, this talisman renders its wearer impervious to all but the most grievous of wounds.
ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to your general in each phase.

ability.name: Hour of Retribution
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Aldus Valnir and Ortana dive down from the clouds into the midst of the reelingfoe, using the shock of their sudden assault to inflict maximum damage.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown.
• Add 1 to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Champion
ability.lore: A veteran fighter leads the charge.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the **Attacks** characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit.

ability.name: Wall of Hogflesh
ability.lore: It is no easy thing to pick your target when the ground is shaking and several dozen tonnes of ironclad meat are thundering in your direction.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRUNTA STAMPEDE HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target that **HERO** while it is wholly within 6" of a friendly non-**HERO GRUNTA STAMPEDE** unit.

ability.name: Spectral Swiftness
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The incorporeal cavalry of the Clattering Procession are impossible to surround and pin down.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that is in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Teachings of the Asydrazor
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: As part of their asydrazor training, Akhelians must study the strategic theorems and methods of war set down by the legendary Cythai heroes of yore.
ability.effect: You gain D3 **asydrazor points**.

ability.name: Fight Another Day
ability.lore: Your general has mastered the ignoble art of striking then running away before the enemy can hit back.
ability.declare: Pick your general to use this ability if they used a **FIGHT** ability this turn.
ability.effect: Your general can make a 2D6" move but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: The Hunger
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Those who bear the Soulblight curse constantly crave blood and are empowered by feasting upon their foes.
ability.effect: If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit. **Heal (2D3)** this unit instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability.

ability.name: Heavens-sent
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: More reinforcements are sent down from Azyr in their fellow warriors’ time of need.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Da Boom Skull
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a command for a friendly GRUNTA STAMPEDE unit wholly within 18" of this unit
ability.lore: The Waaagh! magic imbued within this grunta skull amplifies the bearer’s voice into a thunderous roar that shakes the battlefield.
ability.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Endless Legions
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: To the Soulblight aristocracy, the dead are mere chattel to be expended at will.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit that has been destroyed.
ability.effect: You can set up a replacement unit with D6 models in friendly territory more than 6" from enemy units.

ability.name: Eye-biter Ash
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Stored in a heatproof pouch, this strange ash never stops smouldering. The bearer can cast it at a foe, creating a blistering ash cloud that blinds the targets and causes them terrible pain.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can only be harmed by blows delivered with great conviction.
ability.effect: Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for friendly units (positive and negative).

ability.name: Kunnin' Plan
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This devious Killaboss likes to feign retreat to draw their prey into a deadly trap.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general.
ability.effect: If that unit uses a **RETREAT** ability this turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

ability.name: Sea's Embrace
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Those engulfed by the vast ocean can do nothing but await their fate.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Swift Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.
ability.effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Devious Backstabba
