ability.lore: This grot has a scary number of shivs secreted about their body, and they are always ready to stab anyone who they think is too bossy.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Unstoppable Commander
ability.lore: This Soulreaper’s animus contains the essence of a brilliant commander that can still urge their troops to victory.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** unit wholly within 12" your general, then roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 2+, add 3" to that unit’s Move characteristic this phase.

ability.name: Skyvessel Cover
ability.lore: With a mighty skyvessel floating above providing covering fire, Kharadron Overlords are much harder to target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units that have not charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Arkanaut Ironclad** or **Arkanaut Frigate** that has not charged in the same turn.

ability.name: The Lurking Vermintide
ability.lore: What scurries beneath the surface?
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the tunnels below**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Murderlust
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: All servants of Khorne feel the urge to kill, but when prey is near, the impulse becomes all-consuming.
ability.declare: Spend 1 **blood tithe point** and pick up to D3 friendly units.
ability.effect: Each of those units can move D6" (roll for each).

ability.name: Headhunter
ability.lore: Even Khorne’s priests will seek out the worthiest of foes against which to test their martial prowess.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with your general.
ability.effect: Your general has **STRIKE-FIRST** this phase, but all attacks made by them this phase must target that enemy **HERO**.

ability.name: Noisy Racket
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: After a sustained barrage of hurled insults and the clanging of weapons on shields, the Kruleboyz have driven some of their foes to distraction.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Drive Them Back
ability.lore: Not an inch is given to the enemies of Sigmar.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly units that are both contesting an objective and in combat.
ability.effect: Each of those units can make a pile-in move (Core Rules, 15.3). For each unit that did so, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: Burgeoning Filth
ability.lore: Nurgle’s followers grow bolder as their infestations multiply.
ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly units.

ability.name: Point-Blank Volley
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Enemy Combat Phase
ability.lore: A deadly round of shots are fired off at close range.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Takin' Names
ability.lore: The best way to keep your position at the head of a rowdy orruk horde is by duffing up anyone who looks like a challenge.
ability.effect: If an enemy **HERO** is destroyed by this unit, this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: The Hunger
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Soulblight vampires are revitalised by feasting upon the blood of their foes.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly **VAMPIRE** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the targets.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target. **Heal (2D3)** the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability.

ability.name: The Scent of Blood
ability.lore: The iron stink of gore sends Karanak's pack into a feral frenzy.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn.

ability.name: Nightshade Mushroom
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
ability.lore: This black-capped fungus bursts into a cloud of pitch darkness when tossed into the air.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within your general’s combat range.
ability.effect: That unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks in the next shooting phase.

ability.name: Delusion of the Great Feast
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: In victory’s wake, the ghouls gorge upon their ‘bounty’…
ability.declare: If you believe this **DELUSION**, pick each friendly unit on the battlefield to be the targets.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each target. If the target is a **SERFS** unit, return D3 slain models to it instead.

ability.name: Bloodmist Skull
ability.lore: A thick sanguine pall spills from the mouth of this rune-carved skull, burning enemy projectiles to ash mid-flight.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against damage inflicted by shooting attacks.

ability.name: Spirit of Grimnir
ability.lore: The very presence of your general sets ur-gold ablaze.
ability.effect: You can re-roll **activation rolls** you make for the ‘Ur-gold Runes’ ability (see Battle Traits).

ability.name: Bestial Cunning
ability.lore: Bestial warlords might lack the tactical nous of trained soldiers, but there are few creatures more adept at sniffing out an enemy’s weakness and violently exploiting it.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** units wholly within 12" of this unit that were set up this turn using the ‘Beastherd Ambush’ ability to be the targets.
ability.effect: Each target can immediately move D3". The targets cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

ability.name: Ulguan Steel Caltrops
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: These wicked traps are difficult to spot – but they certainly leave a mark.
ability.declare: You must use this ability if this relic is within 3" of any units (friendly or enemy) that charged this turn. Pick those units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Ancient Defender
ability.lore: This venerable beast has seen countless battles, as evidenced by its heavily scarred hide.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Ruinous Chargers
ability.lore: The Blood Knights of this army leave a trail of destruction as they trample anything that lies between them and their prey.
ability.declare: Pick your **Blood Knights** unit to use this ability if it charged this turn.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit it passed across during that **CHARGE** ability.

ability.name: The Unquiet Dead
ability.lore: Animated by necromancy, the undead rise from their graves, balefire eyes blazing with dark purpose.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the grave**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the grave** than there are on the battlefield.

ability.name: Keeper of the Royal Menagerie
ability.lore: Those vampires who maintain the bleak menageries of Nulahmia have an instinctive bond with undead beasts.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Big 'Un
ability.lore: This beast is noticeably more muscular and krumpier than others of its kind.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Fortify Position
ability.lore: Heavy pavises are slammed into the dirt, forming a wall of oak and iron as strong as a fortification.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **CASTELITE** units if they did not use a **MOVE** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Murder-won Trophies
ability.lore: The Gorechosen have ripped countless trophies from the carcasses of worthy foes.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect:
Give the target 1 artefact of power from the 'Gorechosen Champions' Army of Renown rules.

**Designer's Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the **HERO** during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: Cruel Taskmaster
ability.lore: The warriors under this courtier’s command instantly obey their summons.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target.

ability.name: Rage of Arkhar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Unholy anger is stoked in the hearts of these warriors, filling them with hate-fuelled stamina.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

**Designer’s Note:** *This does not affect* **Companion** *weapons.*

ability.name: Savage Instincts
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for your general
ability.lore: As this ogor lays into the enemy, nearby allies can't help but get enthusiastic about the feast to come.
ability.effect: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within your general's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by your general has been resolved.

ability.name: Masters of the Wilderness
ability.lore: The wild lands of the Mortal Realms are the territory of the Beasts of Chaos, and they have dwelt in these places for longer than can be remembered.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect:
Set up that unit in reserve **in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

**Designer’s Note:** *Any number of friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** units can start the battle in reserve – even your entire Beasts of Chaos army!*

ability.name: Incubation Period
ability.lore: Nurgle’s gifts can incubate slowly within the afflicted, gaining a malign sentience.
ability.declare: This ability must be used to deploy this Regiment of Renown.
ability.effect: Set up the units in this Regiment of Renown in reserve **festering within**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Grandiose Fuselage
ability.lore: Whether emblazoned with gaudy runic slogans advocating guild sponsors or bearing a particularly impressive figurehead, this vessel is doubly imposing to foes.
ability.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s Control characteristic.

ability.name: Droth-helm
ability.lore: This ancient helm is said to have been worn by the first Zharrgrim priest to tame a Magmadroth.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for **Companion** weapons used by friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Hour of Glory
ability.lore: This hero’s hour has come; their deeds will shatter the wicked, deliver the weak and protect the Mortal Realms themselves from any evil that would see them undone.
ability.effect: This unit can be picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the ‘Their Finest Hour’ ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Airborne Cohesion
ability.lore: These warriors fly in tight formation, their dragonspites perfectly attuned to the movements of their kin.
ability.effect: Friendly units have a coherency range of 2".

ability.name: Astute Tactician
ability.lore: This Sigmarite has spent as much time with their nose in military tomes as they have knee-deep in the spilled guts of their foes. Their erudition in the subject of battlefield manoeuvres is highly regarded.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target and add 2 to run rolls for the target.

ability.name: Gardener of Nurgle
ability.lore: This daemon seeks to expand the borders of Nurgle’s Garden.
ability.declare: If your general is contesting an objective not contested by any enemy models, roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 3+, that objective is considered by you to be **desecrated**. Friendly units have **WARD (4+)** while they are contesting a desecrated objective. If your opponent gains control of a desecrated objective, it is no longer desecrated.

ability.name: Shining Company
ability.lore: Numinous light shines from this aelven formation, bedazzling the foe.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls that target friendly units.

ability.name: Reptilian Cunning
ability.lore: With cold-blooded calculation, this general looks for opportunities to strike.
ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.

ability.name: Pulled by Winds
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: The Hurakan allow themselves to be pulled by the winds to more tactical locations.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move D6" but must end that move closer to the **leeward** battlefield edge. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Martial Perfectionist
ability.lore: This aelf expects their warriors to commit fully to each and every task; they will accept no half measures.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit that is damaged or that had any models slain this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Scurry Away
ability.lore: This Skaven chief does not think twice about scampering to safety when things look to be going south. Perhaps that’s why they have lived so long.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Crown of the Slaughterborn
ability.lore: A prize won on the battlefields of the Great Game, this spiked circlet of brass and iron torments stirring souls and ensures bloody wounds shall not heal.
ability.effect: Enemy units within 12" of this unit cannot be healed and cannot have slain models returned to them.

ability.name: Null Pendant
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: This dark amulet holds magic within that can sap the resolve of the enemy.
ability.declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit contesting the same objective as your general.
ability.effect: On a 2+, subtract the roll from the control score of that enemy unit this turn.

ability.name: Blade of the Nadir
ability.lore: Compressed to a barely visible sliver by the metaphysical weight of the Shyish Nadir itself, this weapon is so incomparably sharp that flesh and steel dissolves around it as it sweeps through enemy ranks.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Let The Realms Tremble
ability.lore: The onslaught of Hashutite war machines are a tide of annihilation that cannot be resisted.
ability.effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** units that have already charged this phase.

ability.name: Transport Skyfarers
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
ability.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
ability.effect:
Pick a number of units up to that **SKYVESSEL**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **SKYVESSEL** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **SKYVESSEL** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

ability.name: Summon Deluded Throngs
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Ushoran travels with a seething entourage of cannibals, all of whom wait upon his howled summons.
ability.declare: Pick the **Ushoran** in this Regiment of Renown to use this ability, then pick another unit in this Regiment of Renown that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. The replacement unit is part of this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Rune of Fury
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: The rune of fury grants the Fyreslayers a portion of their god’s battle rage.
ability.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE A**bilities this battle round.

For the rest of the battle round, friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** while they are in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Diseased
ability.lore: Each of the Maggotkin is a walking vector of diseases that ravage both body and spirit.
ability.effect: Each time an attack made by a friendly model scores a critical hit, you receive 1 **disease point**, to a maximum of 7.

ability.name: Warpstone Innards
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: A 'gift' from Thanquol, these warpstone-studded organs have been inserted into a prized warbeast to augment its power.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the battle. However, at the end of each turn, allocate D3 damage points to the target.

ability.name: Kruleboyz Waaagh!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: In typically Morky fashion, Kruleboyz wait until they have the enemy surrounded before calling a Waaagh! – and when they do, the enemy’s fate is usually sealed.
ability.declare: Pick your general to use this ability, then pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target.
ability.effect: Your general and the target have **STRIKE-FIRST** this phase.

ability.name: Blood of the Berzerker
ability.lore: In this noble duardin is fiery aggression given form.
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Chameleon Ambush
ability.lore: The Hunters of Huanchi and the Spawn of Chotec emerge from hiding to unleash a hail of potent poisoned projectiles.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Frenzied Artillery
ability.lore: The gnoblars of this Scrapglutt's Scraplauncher are known for getting a bit carried away.
ability.effect: If the unmodified charge roll for a friendly **Gnoblar Scraplauncher** is 6+, add 3 the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Companion** weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Nauseous Revulsion
ability.lore: These revolting warriors are too hideous to gaze upon for too long.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units.

ability.name: Evasive Hunter
ability.lore: Karanak's natural speed and the bloody aura that surrounds him, makes him difficult to target from afar.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for shooting attacks that target your general.

ability.name: Rooted in the Realm
ability.effect: Friendly units’ weapons have **Anti‑MANIFESTATION (+1 Rend)** while those units are a contesting an objective that is both controlled by you and on a **linked ley line** (see below).

ability.name: Ghostly Paths
ability.lore: Guided by the sorrowful wails of the dead, the Sorrowmourn Choir rapidly traverse the battlefield along unseen pathways.
ability.declare: This spell can be cast by the same **WIZARD** more than once per phase. Pick the **Lady Olynder** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit in this Regiment of Renown that is wholly within 12" of them, that is not in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Swoop Down
ability.lore: The sky darkens as the Vargheists descend.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Plague of Misery
ability.lore: A pall of despair covers the battlefield.
ability.effect: While enemy units are within 6" of any friendly units, they cannot use abilities that heal or return slain models to a unit.

ability.name: Mega-Grump
ability.lore: This gargant’s stubbornness and refusal to die in the face of adversity is the subject of local legend.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it has 25 or more damage points.

ability.name: Covering Fire
ability.lore: The warriors unleash a quick volley at a nearby enemy unit before it charges into combat.
ability.declare:
Pick a friendly unit that did not use a **RUN** ability this turn and that is **not in combat** to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target.

You cannot pick **MANIFESTATIONS** or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
ability.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

ability.name: Locus of Diversion
ability.lore: These warriors release perfumed mists that fill the foes’ minds with everything but the matter at hand.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, that unit can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

ability.name: Skinwriggla Larvae
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Taken from the marshes of Chitinia, these venomous and swiftly multiplying bugs will infest every nook and cranny they can.
ability.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be **infested with bugs** for the rest of the battle.
ability.effect:
While an enemy unit is contesting an objective that is **infested with bugs**:

• Subtract 3 from that unit’s control score.
• Ignore positive modifiers to that unit’s control score.

ability.name: Bloody Succession
ability.lore: As one anointed champion falls, the runes painted on their skin fade away, only to reappear upon the body of another faithful soul.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed, after removing it from play, you can immediately use the ‘Anointed Ritualist’ ability as if it were the start of the first battle round.

ability.name: Lode of Saturation
ability.lore: This ingot of nadirite-iron alloy, when pressed against a bone construct, renders its structure nigh invulnerable.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used for combat attacks that target this general.

ability.name: The Equinox Parade
ability.lore: Clad in tatterdemalion garments of flayed flesh and swaying to the sound of shrieks and bone flutes, the serfs of the ghoul kingdoms skitter as a mad, jubilant procession.
ability.effect:
In the first battle round:

•  Add 1 to run rolls for friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units for each other friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit that has used a **RUN** ability this phase.

•  Add D6" to the distance friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units can move when they use a **RETREAT** ability.

ability.name: The Sword of Gwynnar
ability.lore: To emulate Queen Gwynnar is to anticipate the enemy’s next move and gain the upper hand in combat.
ability.declare: You must spend 1 **asydrazor point** each time a friendly **FIRST PHALANX** unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Blinding Charge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: As they bear down on the foe with great swiftness, the aetherquartz in the Dawnriders’ armour reacts, causing it to blaze with a fierce radiance that makes their enemies flinch at a critical moment.
ability.declare: Pick a unit in this Regiment of Renown that charged this turn. Then, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of that unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

ability.name: Murderous Blade
ability.lore: *Said to have been wielded by Patru Zandtos before he took up the Dark Lance, this blade is utterly lethal.*
ability.effect: Your general's **Commander's Blade** has **Crit (2 Hits).**

ability.name: Messengers of the Gods
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.declare: If you have 1 or more **oath points**, pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS Darkoath Marauders** or **Fellriders** unit that has been destroyed and has not used an **OATH** ability this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 2 **oath points**. Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Pledges to the Dark Gods
ability.lore: Few Darkoath tribes swear such grand and terrible oaths as those of the Snow Peaks. Fewer still fulfil so many of their brutal pledges.
ability.effect:
Each time a friendly **SNOW PEAKS** unit uses 1 of the following abilities and the effect of that ability is resolved, gain 1 **oath point**.

• ‘Oath of Bloodshed’
• ‘Oath of Murder’
• ‘Oath of Supremacy’
• ‘Oath of the Marauder’
• ‘Oath of the Raider’
• ‘Oath of Conquest’

**Designer’s Note**: *The abilities listed above are abilities on* **DARKOATH** *warscrolls. By using those abilities (i.e. completing the oaths), the player gains* **oath points**, *which can then be spent to use the* **OATH** *abilities in these Army of Renown rules.*

ability.name: Lord of Storm and Sea
ability.lore: This hero is a living embodiment of the glory of Mathlann and an inspiration to all those who still worship the Lord of the Deep.
ability.effect: Each time an ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

ability.name: Endless Legions of Bone
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: When the Deathrattle armies are roused to war, their numbers are unending.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE BARROW LEGION** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect:
Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **BARROW LEGION HERO** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.

ability.name: Way of the Fiendish Claw
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Veteran Deathmasters are experts in many wicked martial arts that harness their natural twitchy agility.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Throwing Knives
ability.lore: Jorvan Kreel has, over the course of his adventures, acquired an assortment of deadly blades ready to be hurled into a chest, stomach or skull.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Just Another Shadow
ability.lore: Crixxit is adept at stalking unseen until the moment to strike arrives.
ability.effect: While your general is wholly within the combat range of a friendly unit that has 3 or more models, your general has **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: Projectile Vomit
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Better out than in, as they say...
ability.declare: Pick this unit to use this ability if it has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn. Then, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and pick each enemy unit within 3" of that point to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Bubbles of Unreality
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Seekers make use of an Argent Shard’s unstable magic field to redirect their spells and evocations.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature with the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability to be the target.
ability.effect: The next time a friendly **WIZARD** in this Regiment of Renown uses a **SUMMON SPELL** ability this phase, you can measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from the target instead of from the caster.

ability.name: Brazier of Holy Flame
ability.lore: The torch borne by this champion symbolises the light of civilisation being carried forth into the darkness of the wilds, a sacred act that emboldens those who march alongside them.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Freeguild Steelhelms** unit within your general’s combat range.
ability.effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to that unit.

ability.name: Shake the Earth
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Grunnock has learnt that the best way to break an enemy army is to send its soldiers flying. His signature move – leaping high before stomping down to cause a small earthquake – is feared for good reason.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is **INFANTRY**, double the amount of mortal damage inflicted.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Watch This!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Eager to prove themself the meanest titan around, this Mega-Gargant embarks on an ungainly – yet terrifyingly destructive – rampage.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect:
If the target is a **HERO**, **BEAST**, **MONSTER** or **WAR MACHINE**, roll 6 dice. Otherwise, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each roll that is equal to or greater than the target’s Save characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

The **MEGA‑GARGANT** using this **RAMPAGE** has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.

ability.name: Delusion of the Knightly Host
ability.lore: The earth shakes and the sky screams as the ghouls charge.
ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, if the unmodified charge roll for a friendly **HERO** or **KNIGHTS** unit is 8+, add 1 to hit rolls for that unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Activate Place of Power
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: The pulsing confluences of life scattered across Neos are eager and vital. A champion of sufficient will need only focus on them to harness their power – perhaps causing them to eject clouds of choking or soothing pollen, or erupt in thick tangles of verdant growth.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** within 3" of a **Place of Power** to use this ability, then pick that **Place of Power** to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• ***Cauterising Pollen:*** Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any **Places of Power**. On a 3+, **Heal (2)** each unit (friendly and enemy) wholly within 6" of the target.

• ***Rapid Sprouting:*** Pick a Ghyranite objective or visible non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature within 12" of that **HERO** and roll a dice. On a 3+, that objective or terrain feature has the ‘Obscuring’ ability (see 1.2) for the rest of the battle.

• ***Tap the Ley Lines:*** For the rest of the turn, if that **HERO** is not a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, they can use the ‘Unbind’ or ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had **WIZARD (1)**.

ability.name: Shoot
ability.lore: The warriors take aim and unleash a deadly volley.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
ability.effect: Resolve **shooting attacks** against the target unit(s).

ability.name: Flask of Stonehorn Blood
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability and targeted your general
ability.lore: This icy-blue liquid imbues the one who drinks it with the toughness of a Stonehorn.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (3+)** this phase.

ability.name: Mad 'Un
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Once this crazed beast starts its rampage, it will keep going until everything nearby has been smashed into a red paste.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, after those models are removed from the battlefield, if this unit is still in combat, this unit can immediately use this ability again.

ability.name: Divine Scorn
ability.phaseDetails: Once per Turn, Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: The battlefield is Khorne's temple, and Khorne's alone.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy **WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS** within 6" of any friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units to be the target(s).
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the target's power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of the next turn.

ability.name: Trophy Skulls
ability.lore: Festooned with the skulls of those who crossed them, be they ferocious beast or mighty warrior, there’s no doubt that this orruk means business.
ability.effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.

ability.name: Dread Descent
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: There are fewer more unwelcome sights to an enemy than the arrival of one of the Great Necromancer's heralds.
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Silver Simulacrum
ability.lore: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.
ability.effect:
If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

ability.name: Godmarked Legion
ability.lore: The mightiest of warriors in the godmarked legions of Chaos can be elevated to daemonhood should their patron deem them worthy.
ability.effect:
The unit in this Regiment of Renown gains the ‘Gifts of Chaos’ ability and one of the following faction keywords that matches your army’s faction:

• **BLADES OF KHORNE**
• **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH**
• **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE**
• **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH**

ability.name: First In His Sight
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
ability.lore: Of all Khorne's daemon legions the Baleful Lords are highest in his favour, and the inferno of his rage burns hot in their immortal veins.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **BALEFUL LORDS HERO** that is in combat.

ability.name: Being of the Stars
ability.lore: This hero has a particularly strong connection to their astral heritage, causing their corporeality to wax and wane.
ability.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).

ability.name: Ironjawz Waaagh!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: With a roar that shakes the battlefield, the Ironjawz charge as one, eager to crack skulls.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ HERO** to be the target. You cannot pick the same **HERO** to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of the target:

• Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ melee weapons.

ability.name: Wychwood Glaive
ability.lore: The blade of this polearm, which glows dully with the bleak white- grey of a snow-laden sky, inflicts a bone-deep chill on those it does not slay outright.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.

ability.name: Fickle Motives
ability.lore: Krittok has built his reputation on an impressive stack of victories, in part down to the ferocity of his Stormvermin elite and in part because of his willingness to cut his losses.
ability.effect:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **KRITTOK'S CLAWPACK** units while you have more victory points than your opponent.

Subtract 3 from the control scores of friendly **KRITTOK'S CLAWPACK** units while you have fewer victory points than your opponent.

ability.name: Display of Total Power
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: The first salvo from Gurok’s engines comes free of charge. Should clients show a taste for such power, subsequent bombardments demand a price…
ability.declare: If neither **WAR MACHINE** unit in this Regiment of Renown used any **SHOOT** abilities this turn, pick an enemy unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
•  While that enemy unit is on the battlefield, the **WAR MACHINE** units in this Regiment of Renown can only pick that enemy unit to be the target of their shooting attacks.
•  Each of those **WAR MACHINE** units counts as if it had 3 **daemonic power points**.

The first time you use this ability, you can use it without any command points being spent.

ability.name: Site of Slaughter
ability.lore: The Crimson Lash choose the location of their gladiatorial bloodletting carefully, selecting sites from which their enemies will not easily escape.
ability.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be the **amphitheatre**.

ability.name: Murderous Drive
ability.lore: This Soulreaper is animated by especially vicious and warlike spirits.
ability.effect: Your general’s **Soulreaper Scythe** has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Harness Daemonic Power
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
ability.lore: The Helsmiths of Hashut believe themselves above the fell influence of Chaos and readily harness daemonic power to embolden their spellcraft and ensorcelled weapons.
ability.effect:
You must use this ability at the start of each of your turns. Remove all **daemonic power points** from each friendly unit. Then, gain 1 **daemonic power point** for each friendly **desolation token** on the battlefield.

Then, allocate your daemonic power points to friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 **daemonic power points**. Then, all unallocated **daemonic power points** are lost.

**Designer’s Note:** *Non*-**HOBGROT** *units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each unit has.*

ability.name: Our Reach is Long
ability.lore: These heroes of old are not simply content with holding on to what they have; they would claim back all that has been lost.
ability.effect:
The **creeping overgrowth** (referenced by other abilities) extends 6" from each terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token**.

Increase this range by 1" for each friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN** unit that is wholly outside friendly territory.

ability.name: Guarded Hero
ability.lore: The leader is shielded by their warriors, who close ranks around them to protect them from harm.
ability.effect:
If this **HERO** is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is **not** a **HERO**:

• Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for **shooting attacks** that target this **HERO**.
• If this **HERO** is **INFANTRY**, they cannot be picked as the target of **shooting attacks** made by models more than 12" from them.

ability.name: The Speed of Death
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: With terrifying speed, the ethereal steeds of the Clattering Procession climb into darkened skies, leaving a steep trail of burning spectral hoofprints in the air.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit that used a **CHARGE** or **RETREAT** ability this turn, is not in combat and is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge to use this ability.
ability.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Territorial Trailblazer
ability.lore: This stubborn and audacious duardin is surrounded by an almost tangible aura of defiance that makes enemies think twice about challenging them for control of resources.
ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Secure the Gateway
ability.effect: While you control the **Place of Power** wholly within friendly territory, friendly units’ melee weapons have **Anti‑charge (+1 Rend)** while they are contesting an objective you control.

ability.name: Dormant Heroes
ability.lore: Throughout the Age of Chaos, many forests were devastated. The spirits that inhabited them fell into deep slumber, awaiting the call to awaken and fight once more.
ability.declare: If there are more friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN** units on the battlefield than there are in reserve, pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER** unit that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up that unit in reserve as a **dormant forest spirit**. It has now been deployed.

ability.name: Skitterleap
ability.lore: The Grey Seer vanishes in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, reappearing elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.
ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 6+, remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units. They cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the following movement phase.

ability.name: Unstoppable Warp-volley
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
ability.lore: The Warlocks of the Gnawhorde are no less aggressive than their Verminus kin - they are simply able to strike from further away.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.
• The targets cannot use commands.

ability.name: Blade of Prophetic Doom
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Some weapons are in thrall to the grimmest prophecies imaginable, and are fated to cause untold disaster with a single strike.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:

• If the target is not damaged, inflict 1 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is damaged, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.

ability.name: Mastery Over Monsters
ability.lore: This ur-gold icon identifies the bearer as an authority on behemoths and an expert at breaking their will.
ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective, enemy **MONSTERS** contesting that objective each have a maximum control score of 2.

ability.name: Short-tempered
ability.lore: This twitching and irascible Skaven has succeeded in making their minions more afraid of their displeasure than of the enemy.
ability.effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

ability.name: Vengeful Spirits of the Land
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The realm-spirits lingering around the ancient sites are roused to wrath and unleashed upon the Sylvaneth’s enemies.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective and roll a dice.
ability.effect: On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: Rockbuster Charges
ability.lore: Dropped from on high, these drill-tipped bomblets bore into the ground before detonating in shredding storms of rock and shrapnel.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature that this unit passed across this turn. Each enemy unit within 1" of that terrain feature is a target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

ability.name: Eye of the Gods
ability.lore: The mortal champions of Chaos seek to attract the notice of the gods by performing great deeds in battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE WARRIORS OF CHAOS** or **DARKOATH HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect:
During the battle, the target gains **Dark Apotheosis** points as follows:

• Each time the target uses a **FIGHT** ability, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.
• At the end of each of your turns, if the target is contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory, it gains D3 **Dark Apotheosis** points.

ability.name: Shield of Skjordamar
ability.lore: Said to have been forged with a sliver of the Great Bolt Skjordamar, this shield delivers a blast of celestial energy that can banish the corruption spread by malign magics.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Overpowering Stench
ability.lore: This general exudes an odour so wretched that even Nurgle’s daemons cannot adequately describe it. Enemies recoil, choking on their own vomit at the slightest whiff, rendered speechless as their senses are overwhelmed.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
You and your opponent must roll off. If your roll is higher, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.

ability.name: Hostile Takeover
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The simplest route to profit is the elimination of one’s main rivals.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if an enemy **HERO** was destroyed by shooting attacks made by a friendly **PIONEER** unit this turn.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.

ability.name: Foe-Chompers
ability.lore: The Mancrushers hoist hapless enemies up into the air mid-battle, letting them tumble into their cavernous jaws before giving a mighty belch of satisfaction.
ability.effect: Each time an enemy model is slain by a friendly unit’s ‘Stuff ’Em In Me Bag’ ability, **Heal (D3)** that unit.

ability.name: Fell Ritualist
ability.lore: On the eve of battle, the tribe’s Godspeakers gather to enact a fell ritual to deliver prophecies of the battle to come.
ability.effect: Each time you draw battle tactic cards, if your general is on the battlefield, you can choose to draw 1 additional battle tactic card, then put 1 of your battle tactic cards in your hand back at the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

ability.name: Determined Defenders
ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

ability.name: Violent Tremor
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
ability.effect: The **stable** target objective is no longer **stable**. The other target objective is **stable** instead.

ability.name: Musician
ability.lore: The beat of a drum or the blast of a horn drives the soldiers ever onward.
ability.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional **rally roll** of D6.

ability.name: What Happens If I Press...
ability.lore: Da Red Gobbo doesn’t know what he’s doing any more than the rest, but he’s nothing if not enthusiastic.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. If any enemy units are contesting Da Red Gobbo, you can add or subtract 1 from the roll (to a minimum of 1).

**1  …Da Green Button?:** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each unit’s melee weapons (friendly and enemy) for the rest of the turn.

**2  …Da Blue Button?:** Each player can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll or 1 random characteristic roll for a weapon’s Damage characteristic this turn.

**3  …Da Yellow Button?:** Each player gains 1 command point.

**4  …Da Orange Button?:** Each unit (friendly and enemy) on the battlefield has a Move characteristic of 3D6" for the rest of the turn.

**5  …Da Purple Button?:** Units (friendly and enemy) are not visible to other units outside their combat range for the rest of the turn.

**6  …Da Red Button?:** You must immediately use the ‘Clank, Clank, Clank’ ability as if it were the end of your turn.

**7+  ...Da Whirly Button?:** Pick an enemy unit within 18" of Da Red Gobbo. Remove that unit from the battlefield. Then your opponent picks a point on the battlefield. Set up that enemy unit within 1" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units. Each model in that enemy unit that cannot be set up in this way is automatically slain.

ability.name: Tip of the King's Lance
ability.lore: This champion’s bulk sees them smash through defensive formations.
ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units, but it must end that move in combat.

ability.name: Raised Around Beasts
ability.lore: This general knows the precise weak points of the mightiest creatures of the Mortal Realms.
ability.effect: The melee weapons of friendly non-**MONSTER** units have **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 9" of this unit.

ability.name: Crate of Aqua Ghyranis
ability.lore: Smuggled from distant Ghyran, the precious liquid in these vials grants the imbiber great vigour and resilience.
ability.effect: Units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this relic.

ability.name: Nightmarish Charge
ability.lore: The sight of hulking ghoul-breeds crashing into the fray can stun any foe.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT** units that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Hulking Brute
ability.lore: Even by orruk standards, this boss is huge, and he is ever eager to throw his immense weight around in battle.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If this unit’s unmodified charge roll this turn was 8+, roll a D6 instead of a D3.

ability.name: Murderlust
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
ability.lore: When worthy opponents are near, the impulse to kill becomes all-consuming.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace one of the dice in the charge roll with that value. If you do so, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit using that **CHARGE** ability after that ability is resolved.
ability.additionalRulesText: You do not need to unlock this ability to use it. It is already unlocked.

ability.name: All Part of the Plan
ability.lore: Tzeentch is all-seeing and all-knowing, and even setbacks may ultimately serve his destined ends.
ability.effect:
You start the battle with 0 **fate points**.
Gain 1 **fate point** each time:

• You lose the priority roll.
• A spell cast by a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit is unbound.
• A friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit miscasts a spell.
• Your opponent gains control of an objective that you controlled at the start of the turn.
• A friendly **Argent Shard** is **demolished**.

ability.name: Destined to Serve
ability.lore: Those chosen by the Change God are not permitted to fall until they have served their fated purpose.
ability.effect: Before allocating damage points to a friendly **DISCIPLES OF** **TZEENTCH** unit, you can spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, remove 1 damage point in that unit’s damage pool.

ability.name: Mean 'Un
ability.lore: This beast is a kunnin’ and ruthless predator, targeting vulnerable areas and vital spots with a hunter’s eye.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Amulet of Nightmares
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The nightmares of the bearer, who endures a torturous existence trapped in their mouldering undead form, are projected into the minds of the living by this onyx talisman.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** this phase.

ability.name: Nexus of Fate
ability.lore: Tzeentch’s favoured servants manipulate what mortals consider ‘destiny’ as if it were a puppet.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If you have 9 unspent **destiny dice**, you must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll. Otherwise, place that dice to one side as a **destiny dice**.

ability.name: Scattered to the Winds
ability.lore: The strong winds that accompany the Windmage throw their enemies to the side to disorientate them.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the control scores of enemy units within 6" of your general for each friendly **RIDE THE HURRICANE** ability used this battle round.

ability.name: Splinters of Sorcery
ability.lore: Fragments of an Argent Shard embed themselves in surrounding terrain, unleashing deadly waves of magic.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 12" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: If the target does not have the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability, it gains that ability for the rest of the battle. If the target has the ‘Place of Power’ terrain ability, pick an enemy unit within 12" of it and roll 9 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: Backstabba
ability.lore: When their enemy’s back is turned, this boss has no qualms about sticking a dagger in it.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **KRULEBOYZ** units.

ability.name: The Witherstave
ability.lore: Carved from the heartwood of a tormented Treelord, the Witherstave thrums with a soured mockery of the Sylvaneth spirit-song. Those that hear it feel a terrible weakness shiver their limbs as a jarring dirge of despair clouds their minds.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Chorus of Terror
ability.lore: Warriors are frozen in place by the shrieks of the Nighthaunt as they wash over the enemy lines in a wave of terror.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target a friendly unit that charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Stronger Together
ability.lore: Fighting shoulder to shoulder, the saviours of the Jade Abbey are nigh unstoppable.
ability.effect: While each unit in this Regiment of Renown is wholly within 6" of each other unit in this Regiment of Renown, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Transient Forms
ability.lore: Some Kairic Acolytes actively seek transformation into Tzaangors, whom they revere as beings closer in nature to their mercurial deity.
ability.effect: Roll a dice each time a friendly **Kairic Acolytes** model is slain in the combat phase. On a 4+, you can return 1 slain model to a friendly **Tzaangors** unit within 9" of the slain model.

ability.name: For Sigmar, Charge!
ability.lore: With their blade raised high, the Marshal signals the charge of the Cavaliers.
ability.effect: Friendly **CAVALRY** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** if they charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Unholy Vessel
ability.lore: As Nagash gathers his power, a tiny portion of his godly might is invested in the Nexus of Grief that plays host to his disembodied spirit.
ability.effect: The **ritual site** has **WARD (4+)** and cannot use the 'Hungry Crypts' ability.

ability.name: The Ritual Begins
ability.lore: Nagash's potent spirit anchors itself to a nearby Nexus of Grief, and it is from here that his form shall be remade once more in all its macabre glory.
ability.declare: You must use this ability to set up the friendly **Nagash.** Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief** wholly within friendly territory to be the **ritual site.**
ability.effect: Set up the friendly **Nagash** within 1" of the **ritual site** and wholly within friendly territory. After you have done so, he has been **deployed.** That **Nexus of Grief** is the **ritual site** for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Amberglade Nectar
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Collected from the fearsome elder trees of Ghur, the scent of this sticky sap sends spites into a feral frenzy.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SYLVANETH** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Bold Moves
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Massive profits alone have not taken Brokk Grungsson to the apex of Kharadron society. His uncanny ability to take his foes off-guard has proven just as valuable.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly **MAGNATE’S CREW INFANTRY** units that are in combat to be the targets. Make an **emergency launch roll** of 3D6 for each target.
ability.effect:
Each target can move a distance up to the value of its **emergency launch roll**. It **can** move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but **cannot** end that move in combat with an enemy unit that it was not in combat with at the start of the phase.

The target(s) cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Fierce Conquerors
ability.lore: These warriors are hell‑bent on desecrating the territory and holdings of any who dare oppose them.
ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **Chaos Warriors** units.

ability.name: Shields of the Warden
ability.lore: Ionus often goes into battle accompanied by an elite band of Stormdrake Guard whose sole duty is to protect their commander.
ability.effect:
While any friendly **Stormdrake Guard** units are within a friendly **Ionus Cryptborn**’s combat range:

• That friendly **Ionus Cryptborn** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **Ionus Cryptborn**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **Ionus Cryptborn** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Da Old One-Two
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This boss and their boyz are the masters at piling on the pain.
ability.declare: You can use this ability if this unit has the **POWER OF THE WAAAGH!** keyword and a friendly unit has not used a **BRUTAL KUNNIN’** ability this turn.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **BIG WAAAGH!** units’ melee weapons have **CRIT (2 HITS)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Devious Underling
ability.lore: Sly in the extreme, this ratman has mastered the art of biding his time, content to wait until his superiors’ demise before violently seizing control for himself.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly **SKAVEN HERO** on the battlefield with a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle:

• While the target has not been slain, friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
• Once the target has been slain, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

ability.name: Masterful Tactician
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: This shrewd commander has a crystal-clear understanding of the flow of battle, knowing precisely when to direct their warriors to bolster a weak point in their line or exploit one in that of the enemy.
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: From A Quarter Unseen
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: Prince Vhordrai has mastered the art of trapping the foe between his main force and reserves that sally forth from the Crimson Keep at his signal.
ability.declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick each friendly unit that is **in the Crimson Keep** to be the targets.
ability.effect: Set up each target wholly within 9" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you set up any units using this ability in the third or a subsequent battle round, do not spend any command points when using the ‘Carve a Bloody Path’ command this turn.

ability.name: Dis Fight's Not Fer Me
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
ability.lore: Gitmob grots are hard to pin down in combat, whether they are riding Snarlfangs or chariots - or just not up for a fight when the odds are against them.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROGGZ'S GITMOB** unit that is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn and is not in combat with any enemy units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Premeditated Demise
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Neferata’s guile has already ensured that her foe’s defences will falter at a critical point.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of the **Neferata** in this Regiment of Renown to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on the target by attacks made by units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Armour of the Cythai
ability.lore: This gleaming panoply was given by Teclis to the ancestors of the Idoneth. Upon the command of its bearer, it can radiate the power of Hysh – a fitting property for a gift from the Great Illuminator.
ability.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Vengeance of Azyr
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The celestite weapons carried by the warriors of a Sun blooded Prowlers host are supercharged with the power of Azyr.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with a friendly **SAURUS** unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
ability.lore: Ghouls flock to their vampiric masters.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** with any **noble deeds points** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Spend any number of that **HERO**’s **noble deeds points** as follows:

Pick a friendly **Cryptguard** unit within 9" of this unit and spend 1 **noble deeds point** to return 1 model to that unit.

Pick a friendly **Morbheg Knights** unit within 9" of this unit and spend 2 **noble deeds points** to return 1 model to that unit.

ability.name: Visage of the Great Bull
ability.lore: This graven, gilded mask is wrought in the visage of a Taurus, supplanting the bearer’s will with Hashut’s crushing purpose.
ability.effect: In your charge phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

ability.name: Matriarch of the Zainthar Kai
ability.lore: Surrounded by beings soul-crafted to be her perfect bodyguards, Morathi-Khaine can unleash her true power, safe in the knowledge that no jealous rival nor so-called ally will seek to do her harm.
ability.declare: Pick the friendly **Morathi-Khaine** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Until the start of your next turn, this unit has a Move characteristic of 12" and has **FLY**.
• This unit can use the ‘Iron Heart of Khaine’ ability as if you had performed a blood rite.
• Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
• Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE ZAINTHAR KAI HERO** that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 3" of this unit.

ability.name: Acolyte of the Runes
ability.lore: This aelf regularly meditates upon the aelven runic scripture. Over time, they have become particularly sensitive to the sigils’ power.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: That **HERO** can be picked as an additional target the next time you use the ‘Depict Rune’ ability.

ability.name: Amberbone Totem
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: Somewhere along the way, this gargant has picked up a totem of Ghurish realmstone. No matter how long they run for, the urge to hunt burns within them.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Spiteful Swarms
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Always one for a cunning trick, churning rat-swarms have been stitched into the guts of Thanquol's beasts, ready to burst free in a wave of disorienting fangs and claws when their host is slain.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MUTATED MENAGERIE MONSTER** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect:
This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. However, at the end of the turn, this unit is destroyed. When this unit would be destroyed, before it is removed from play, roll a dice for each enemy unit within 6" of this unit. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of that enemy unit's melee weapons for the rest of the battle.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Crafty Creepers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: These mischievous critters scrabble down the limbs of their massive host when the enemy is near, pilfering the valuables of the foe.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEGA‑GARGANT** that has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy **HERO** that has an artefact of power and is in combat with that **MEGA‑GARGANT** to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

ability.name: Inpenetrable Ranks
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: If given the order, Ossiarch warriors will snap into an unyielding defensive line.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to ward rolls for that unit.

ability.name: Let's Get Stuck In
ability.lore: The Ironguts start to arrive, and woe betide whoever gets in their way.
ability.effect: Set up this unit wholly within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, and not in combat.

ability.name: Fury of the Forest
ability.lore: The Sylvaneth are overcome with rage at the presence of interlopers in their sacred forest homes.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: The unit using this ability has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Covering Fire
ability.lore: The warriors unleash a quick volley at a nearby enemy unit before it charges into combat.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a **RUN** ability this turn and that is **not in combat** to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick **MANIFESTATIONS** or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
ability.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

ability.name: Hegsson Solutions 'Old Reliable' Hullplates
ability.lore: These hull plates are renowned for their ability to absorb damage without failing.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** against damage inflicted by **SHOOT** abilities.

ability.name: Opening Horn Blast
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The ear-shattering peal of a hunting horn signals the coming of Kurnoth’s faithful, and foretells the bloody death of their prey.
ability.declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round.
ability.effect:
Your chords are reset to 0. Then, you gain 1 **chord**:

• If a friendly **Belthanos** is on the battlefield.
• For each friendly **EVERGREEN HUNT** unit that is wholly within the same large quarter of the battlefield as the quarry.
• For each quarry destroyed so far during the battle.

ability.name: Prospector and Pioneer
ability.lore: Whether they are a cranky taskmaster or a charismatic maverick, this general is a force of nature when it comes to staking new claims for their sky-port.
ability.effect: Add 2 to your general’s control score.

ability.name: Death Screech
ability.lore: When needs must, Crixxit can unleash a deafening screech to stun foes.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

ability.name: Herd Healing
ability.lore: When troggoths gather in larger numbers, the sheer troggness of the herd serves as a catalyst for their regenerative abilities.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.

ability.name: Ambush Time!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: At a howl from their Snarlboss’s alpha wolf, the Shinestealaz launch their attack, pelting towards the weak spots in the enemy line.
ability.declare: Pick all units in this Regiment of Renown if they are **prowlin’ around**.
ability.effect: Set up those units anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Envoy of the Heavens
ability.lore: When a Stormcast Eternal is laid low, the light that carries the warrior’s soul back to Azyr invigorates those who fight on.
ability.declare: If a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12"of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Launch the Attack
ability.lore: There is a sudden blur of movement as these Namarti warriors burst forth from an unseen quarter.
ability.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is **in the ethersea**.
ability.effect: Set up each unit on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, more than 9" from all enemy units and within the combat range of another unit in this Regiment of Renown. Then, each unit can immediately move D3". The units cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

ability.name: Pledged to Tzeentch
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Reality twists and weaves around these warriors as they become intertwined in the machinations of the Change God.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll 2D6. Then pick a point within a number of inches of the target equal to the roll. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that point and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Roused to Fury
ability.lore: The presence of these powerful Sylvaneth is accompanied by booming reverberations in the spirit-song that alert powerful forest spirits to the enemy’s incursion.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following units:

• A friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN** unit that is in reserve as a **dormant forest spirit**.
• A friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER** that has been destroyed.

Set up the unit you picked, or a replacement unit if you picked a destroyed unit, within 9" of the target, wholly within 6" of that friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and not in combat. If you set up a replacement unit, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

Then, remove that friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** from the battlefield.

ability.name: Favour of the Gods
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Whether it pleases him or not, Gunnar Brand has attracted the notice of the Chaos Gods. With each worthy kill he makes, he draws down their blessings.
ability.effect:
If any enemy **HEROES** were slain this turn by the **Gunnar** **Brand** in this Regiment of Renown:

• **Heal (5)** each unit in this Regiment of Renown.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by units in this Regiment of Renown for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Flankin' Force
ability.lore: The Snarlboss has sent some of his warriors to sneakily outflank the enemy.
ability.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly units. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: The Carrion Dirge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: When blown, this filth-encrusted horn shrieks with the tongues of seven hundred and seventy-seven carrion crows. Those outside Nurgle’s favour who hear it are struck with a deep despondency. Why stand defiant? Why seek victory? Why do anything at all?
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Subtract 5 from each target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Wrath of Mathlann
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Calling upon every vestige its of strength and rage, the Eidolon comes crashing down upon the foe.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM EIDOLON** unit that has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability.
