ability.effect: That unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, that unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn. The unit using this ability cannot use any other **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Terrifying Hulk
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Your opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a visible non-MONSTER enemy unit within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: As the enemy rushes forward, a raised eyebrow and an even bigger raised club causes them to seriously re-think the choices that brought them to confront this notably fierce-looking example of gargant kind.
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can change one of the dice in that charge roll to a 1.

ability.name: On Da Moon's Trail
ability.lore: Skulkrik and his grots are constantly on the hunt for signs of the Bad Moon’s last position, and they will become extra stubborn and stabby when defending sites touched by their god’s light, lest the trail go cold.
ability.effect: The melee weapons of units in this Regiment of Renown have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are contesting an objective you control.

ability.name: Under the Light of the Bad Moon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: Grots are always vicious little monsters, but when their god’s light falls upon them, they become an order of magnitude more dangerous.
ability.declare:
Pick a territory (either friendly territory or enemy territory) to be **under the Light of the Bad Moon**. If both players can use this ability, the players roll off and the winner picks a territory to be under the Light of the Bad Moon.

The territory picked remains under the Light of the Bad Moon in the first and second battle rounds. In the third and fourth battle rounds, the other territory is under the Light of the Bad Moon.
ability.effect:
While a friendly unit is wholly within the territory that is **under the Light of the Bad Moon**, the appropriate effect below applies to it:

***Frothing Zealots:*** If the unit is a **Moonclan Stabbas** unit, add 3 to its control score.

***Lunar Squigs:*** If the unit is a **Squig Hoppers** unit, no mortal damage is inflicted on it when it uses **Retreat** abilities.

***Moonlit Hide:*** If the unit is a **Rockgut Troggoths** unit, add 1 to save rolls for it.

ability.name: Explosive Fury
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Led by their Slaughter Queens and the Blood Hags, these aelves rush into battle with astounding speed.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Slaughter Queen** to use this ability, then pick each friendly **Blood Hags** unit on the battlefield and each visible friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** unit wholly within 12" of that **Slaughter Queen** to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a target makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

ability.name: Grave Sentinels
ability.lore: Unwavering in their eternal vigilance, the deathly warriors of this legion’s overlord guard his ancient resting place.
ability.effect: The melee weapons used by friendly **BARROW LEGION** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**.

ability.name: The Spear of Asphoren
ability.lore: Those Idoneth who wish to follow the example of legendary commander Asphoren must strike at the foe like the surging tide.
ability.declare: You must spend 1 **asydrazor point** each time a friendly **FIRST PHALANX** unit uses this ability. Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for that unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Inviolate Legions
ability.lore: Ossiarch warriors snap into defensive formations that grant them even greater resilience.
ability.usedBy: A friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability. Friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units can use this ability more than once per phase.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. That unit has **WARD (5+)** against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability.

ability.name: Amulet of Graves
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The bearer of this amulet can call upon a long-dead soul in Shyish, manifesting their final resting place onto the battlefield in a storm of necromantic energy.
ability.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield, set up a **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

ability.name: Lord of Revelries
ability.lore: This cackling creature is consumed by the feast’s joys and inured to pain.
ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

ability.name: Counter-charge
ability.lore: Seeing the need for decisive action, the warriors charge forth to stall the enemy’s advance or enact a bold interception.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use a **CHARGE** ability as if it were your charge phase.

ability.name: Mage-Eaters
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability.
ability.lore: Those who dare wield spells in the presence of these daemons are soon punished.
ability.usedBy: A friendly **BALEFUL LORDS** unit targeted by that **SPELL** ability.
ability.effect: Make a magic-eater roll of D6. On a 3+, that spell is unbound. If the spell was unbound and the magic-eater roll was 5+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

ability.name: Witchbrew
ability.lore: This holy potion drives the imbiber into such an ecstasy of destruction that they will fight on in the face of impossible odds.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Propagator of Ruin
ability.lore: This general seethes with anarchic power and with their every action seeks to promulgate the majesty of Chaos.
ability.effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, you can use the ‘Rituals of Ruin’ ability twice per turn in your hero phase instead of once per turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per turn.

ability.name: Gifts to the Petty Kingdoms
ability.lore: To each of his vassal kingdoms, this legion’s monarch bestowed a gift bearing a curse that bound them to his service for evermore.
ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**UNIQUE BARROW LEGION HEROES** that do not have an artefact of power to be the targets (you can pick units in reserve).
ability.effect:
Give each target 1 artefact of power from the ‘Barrow Legion’ Army of Renown rules.

**Designer’s Note**: *These artefacts of power are given to the* **HEROES** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

ability.name: Skulls for the Skull Throne
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: ...only that it flows.
ability.effect: Pick a **BLOOD TITHE** ability that you have not unlocked and spend the number of blood tithe points required to unlock that ability (shown in the top-right corner of the ability). That **BLOOD TITHE** ability is now unlocked for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Radiance of Dark Glory
ability.lore: In the presence of this champion, the mutative energies of Chaos can seal shut even the most grievous of wounds.
ability.declare: Pick each damaged friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, **Heal (1)** the target. **Heal** **(3)** the target instead if it is a **MONSTER**.

ability.name: Furious Bites
ability.lore: All three of Karanak's monstrous heads hunger to tear apart flesh and soul.
ability.effect: If your general is in combat with the **quarry,** inflict D3 mortal damage on the **quarry.**

ability.name: The Conqueror's Crown
ability.lore: This blasphemous diadem grants the bearer dominion over the minds of lesser mortals.
ability.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **INFANTRY** units while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: The Varanite Shackle
ability.lore: This writhing torque radiates an aura that twists reality, aiding those who serve the will of the Dark Gods yet are blind or indifferent to the import of their actions.
ability.effect: Friendly non-**WARRIORS OF CHAOS SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Silent Menace
ability.lore: As the thundering charge of the Lance of Ossia bears down upon the foe, their unblinking witchlight stares and deathly silence can unnerve even the most stalwart of enemies.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. The target cannot use the 'Redeploy' command for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Pulsing Life Energies
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick an objective you control and 1 other objective (whether you control it or not). Draw a line between the centres of those objectives. Then, choose **propagation** or **corruption**.
ability.effect:
Apply the appropriate effect:

***Propagation:*** Add 1 to casting rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for each unit crossed by the line for the rest of the battle round.

***Corruption:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit crossed by the line.

ability.name: Labour of Control
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: As proof of their mastery of battle, the Vanari task themselves with dominating all corners of the battlefield.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if there is at least 1 different friendly unit within 6" of each battlefield edge.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of **labours** you have completed. For the rest of the battle, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units.

ability.name: Sceptre of Domination
ability.lore: The staff carried by this Shardspeaker contains magic that can seduce the minds of their foes.
ability.declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with your general.
ability.effect: On a 5+, the unit being rolled for has **STRIKE‑LAST** this phase.

ability.name: Stick 'Em and Run
ability.lore: This grot might not be known for their bravery, but they're still alive - which is more than can be said for most of their rivals.
ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **RETREAT** ability or the ‘Frazzlegit’s Flame Stream’ ability, before moving this unit, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Loonstone Teef
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This troggoth once jammed shards of loonstone into their gums to replace missing teeth. They have since been driven mad by a constant cackling that echoes around their skull, rendering them particularly irascible and dangerous.
ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Kavalos Lance
ability.lore: Those who fight with Zandtos want nothing more than to carve a red path through those who would defile their lord's domain.
ability.effect: When a friendly **LANCE OF OSSIA** unit uses the 'Power Through' command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than that friendly unit.

ability.name: Moonhoned Shiv
ability.lore: This grot is either the most or least trusted in Skragrott’s court, as the Loonking has gifted them a stabby thing that has been quenched in the light of the Bad Moon.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. In addition, each time this unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

ability.name: Bleed Them Pale
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: These aelves delight in bleeding their enemies slowly, darting away before they are attacked in turn.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that is in combat and did not charge this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move 6" but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Extra-big Bag
ability.lore: Made from the tattered remains of enemy banners, even more screaming warriors can be stuffed into this large and garish bag.
ability.effect: When your general uses their ‘Stuff ’Em In Me Bag’ ability, you can pick 2 enemy units instead of 1 (roll for each).

ability.name: Slaughter Triumphant
ability.lore: Khorne's fury floods the field, burning out all thought but to slay.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units that charged in the same turn.
ability.additionalRulesText: You can only unlock this ability if you have unlocked 'Glorious Combat or Naught' or 'Murder the Mystic'.

ability.name: Shard Storm
ability.lore: The caster conjures forth a great cloud of bone-shards and hurls them at the foe.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 7+, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Pulverising Girth
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase, Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: There are few armies in the Mortal Realms that can withstand the charge of ravenous ogors.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly units that charged this phase.
ability.effect: For each of those units, pick an enemy unit in combat with it and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: Corruption of the Land
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: The mere presence of Nurgle’s followers sees the land defiled.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature, then roll a dice for each enemy unit within 3" of that terrain feature.
ability.effect: On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: Reinforce Daemonsteel
ability.lore: The black runes Gurok has carved into his armour and war machines allow him to bolster their resilience through sorcerous means.
ability.declare: Pick the **Daemonsmith** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit in each phase while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

ability.name: Gnawhole Ambush
ability.lore: Emerging from a green, glowing rift, the Skaventide pours onto the battlefield.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN** unit that is **in the** **tunnels below** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Noisy Racket
ability.lore: On the eve of battle, the Kruleboyz make sure the enemy receives no respite as their war drums and rattle-skulls ring out into the night.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units in the first battle round.

ability.name: Broken Sceptre of the Solstice
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: An image of the bone sunburst crown atop this staff burns in the ghouls’ minds, drawing more of them into the fray.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit that has been destroyed to be the target. This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed, but if it does, this unit must be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Prized Beast
ability.lore: Whether feared or favoured by the troops that accompany it into battle, this mighty creature stands apart from its peers.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE MONSTER** unit that has not been reinforced and which is in, but not leading, a regiment to be that regiment’s **honour guard**. You can pick a unit in reserve.
ability.effect: That unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the **honour guard**. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Peerless Cohesion
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'Relentless Discipline' ability
ability.lore: With coordination that would be the envy of any mortal commander, the Ossiarch Bonereapers act in effortless tandem.
ability.effect: You can use the 'Relentless Discipline' ability for a second time this phase but you must pick a different target to the one you picked the first time.

ability.name: Ring of Stricken Souls
ability.lore: Violet clouds swirl within the Shyishan amethyst set in this ring, which grants the bearer uncanny protection.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Skryre Payloads
ability.lore: Krittok has made great effort to secure an arsenal of deadly Doom-Flayers, and he expects his minions to protect his investment with their lives.
ability.effect: Friendly **KRITTOK'S CLAWPACK Doom-Flayers** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are within the combat range of a friendly **KRITTOK'S CLAWPACK Stormvermin** unit.

ability.name: Temper the Flaw
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The warriors of the Ruination chambers must be shepherded by the mentors of the Bleak Citadels, else they risk losing what little remains of their soul.
ability.declare: You must use this ability at the end of each turn. Each friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn is a target.
ability.effect:
For each target, pick 1 of the following effects:

• ***Guided:*** If the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER HEROES**, return 1 slain model to it.
• ***Tormented:*** If the target is not wholly within 12" of any friendly **RUINATIONS CHAMBER HEROES**, it becomes tormented until the end of the next turn. While a unit is tormented, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons but it cannot contest objectives or use commands.

ability.name: Grand Offering
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: Before the battle, sacrifices were heaped before the lair of a particularly dreaded Wilderfiend known to haunt the region.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SNOW PEAKS Wilderfiend** within 9" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Give the target D6 **sacrifice points**.

ability.name: Nullstone Galvanisation
ability.lore: Thanks to metalwork treated with an anti-magic coating, arcane conjurations that linger in proximity to this ship are gradually undone.
ability.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** within this unit’s combat range.

ability.name: Deathmarch
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: With rusted armour clattering, the skeletons advance in eerie lockstep, unburdened by pain or doubt.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1" to the target’s Move characteristic and add 3 to its control score.

ability.name: Emberstone Cache
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
ability.effect: Give the target an **emberstone sliver**.

ability.name: Facets of War
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The arts of war practised by the Lumineth are subtle, precise and devastating.
ability.effect: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. Pick 1 **FACET OF WAR** ability. That **FACET OF WAR** ability can be used this battle round but the other two cannot.

ability.name: Eternal Conflagration
ability.lore: Some cults of Tzeentch seek to set the very cosmos aflame with the ever-burning fires of change.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **Flamers of Tzeentch** units.

ability.name: Amulet of Leeches
ability.lore: This ancient and corroded talisman allows the wielder to draw upon the necromantic energies of their minions for protection.
ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire** **Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell** **Bats** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Horribly Resilient
ability.lore: Grown strong on great lakes of death magic that coalesced around the remains of a butchered empire, the desiccated form of this monstrosity is nearly impossible to destroy.
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit. If this unit is not a **HERO**, **Heal (2D3)** this unit instead.

ability.name: Blazebeard and Sons Ejector Pod
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This incredible device provides a potent fail-safe for any shrewd Kharadron leader. However after use, the warranty for the device is void, making subsequent uses a risk no sane Kharadron would ever take!
ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Concealing Tide
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Freezing and impenetrable mists descend across the battlefield.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that did not use any **CHARGE** abilities in the same turn.

ability.name: Grunta Waaagh!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: Just before the stampede crashes headlong into the enemy lines, the Tuskboss bellows a mighty ‘Waaagh!’, encouraging the ladz and their steeds cause as much carnage as possible with their impact.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRUNTA STAMPEDE HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to friendly **GRUNTA STAMPEDE** units while they are wholly within 18" of the target:

• You can re-roll charge rolls for those units.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ **Maw-grunta’s Trotters**.
• Roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted by the ‘Goregrunta Charge’ ability of those units.

ability.name: Reclaimed by Nature
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: In twisting profusions of unfurling branches, shivering leaves and billowing pollen, trees that would normally take many cycles to reach maturity attain their full, bountiful potential in mere moments.
ability.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** and more than 1" from all other terrain features.

ability.name: Frightening Vitality
ability.lore: This deathless champion is an undead juggernaut, capable of a type of regeneration that is rare even amongst the ranks of the unliving.
ability.effect: Each time an ability would heal exactly 1 or 2 of this unit’s damage points, heal 3 damage points instead.

ability.name: Summon Loyal Subjects
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: To the ghouls, an abhorrant’s howl is a call to defend their lands.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ABHORRANT** to use this ability, then pick a friendly **SERFS** or **KNIGHTS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Venom-encrusted Weapons
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: These weapons are smeared with a lethal mix of toxins extracted from poison sludge, venomous swamp creatures and spit.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

ability.name: Waters of the Everspring
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: A single drop from the shimmering depths of the Everspring can cure sickness and heal suppurating wounds.
ability.effect: **Heal (1)** each unit in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: Make Merry 'Til the Morn
ability.lore: Sated, the revellers toast, staggering about in cackling mobs as they quaff the finest ‘red wines’…
ability.effect: In the fifth battle round, friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units have **WARD (4+)** while they are within 3" of 2 or more other visible friendly **EQUINOX FEAST** units.

ability.name: Waystone
ability.lore: This small sliver of dark rock hovers above the bearer’s outstretched palm, leading them along hidden paths towards that which they desire. Its use requires exceptional discipline or stillness of the mind, for what one thinks one desires is ever elusive – often perilously so.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Kavalos Lance
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: These warriors form the tip of the spear, crashing through enemy formations with terrifying ease.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can pass across enemy models as if it had **FLY.**

ability.name: Unholy Sacraments
ability.lore: Such is Arkhan’s command of necromancy that even magic withers in his presence.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making banishment rolls for the **Arkhan the Black** in this Regiment of Renown, to a maximum of 3.

ability.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
ability.lore: When rubbed, this dark-grey rock produces a swirling bank of thick fog that protects the bearer and their allies from harm.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **WARD** **(5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Aura of Enervation
ability.lore: Ending magics shroud this hero, sapping the force from arrows and other projectiles.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **NULL MYRIAD** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Bestow Favour
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Great Game plays out in the blackened skies above the First Prince’s legions as oaths are sworn, enemies are crushed, and dark rewards are granted.
ability.declare: If a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield, pick a non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 5 to the target’s control score.
• If the target is a **DAEMON** unit, add 1 to save rolls for the target.
• If the target is a non-**DAEMON** unit, it has **WARD (6+)**.

ability.name: Spell-Catcher Amulet
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This amulet, in the shape of an unblinking eye, devours the residual energies of arcane manifestations that have been unravelled, re-imagining them in forms more pleasing to the Changer of the Ways.
ability.declare: This unit can use this ability if any enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** were banished this phase.
ability.effect: This unit can use a **SUMMON** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition. That **SUMMON** ability does not count towards the total number of **SPELL** or **BANISH** abilities this unit can use this phase.

ability.name: Ar'gath, The King of Blades
ability.lore: This daemonic blade hungers for the flesh of champions and will not be denied by trickery or magic.
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy **HEROES** while they are in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Combat Grafter
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Knuckling down and cracking skulls is what this officer does best.
ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase.

ability.name: Followers of Huanchi
ability.lore: Huanchi guides the shots of the skinks and their bestial companions.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKINK** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target's ranged weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn, including **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Aura of Haywire Magic
ability.lore: Those who trudge beside the Troggoth King on his long march are imbued with the same mysterious powers their liege unwittingly channels.
ability.effect: The effects of a friendly **Trugg**’s ‘Malfunctioning Leystone’ ability affect friendly **TRUGG’S TROGGHERD** units anywhere on the battlefield instead of only those wholly within 12" of that friendly **Trugg**.

ability.name: Da King's Adjutant
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: This grot is tasked with cajoling as many of the Loonking’s followers into battle as possible.
ability.declare: You cannot use this ability and the **Bad Moon Loonshrine**’s ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability in the same turn. If this unit is within 12" of a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine**, pick a friendly non-reinforced, non-**HERO**, non-**MONSTER KING’S GITZ** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine** and more than 3" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Fecund Vigour
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.effect: **HEAL (D3)** each friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** unit.

ability.name: The Creeping Overgrowth
ability.lore: As children of Ghyran, the Sylvaneth are redolent with the energies of life, which cause the ambient flora to rapidly grow and spread.
ability.effect:
The **creeping overgrowth** is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token. The range of the **creeping overgrowth** is based on the number of friendly **overgrown tokens** on the battlefield as shown:

Overgrown Tokens - Creeping Overgrowth Range
0-2 - 6"
3-5 - 9"
6-8 - 12"
9+ - Whole battlefield

**Designer’s Note:** *Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to do so too.*

ability.name: Overwhelming Heat
ability.lore: The Cathallar summons oppressive heat to sap their foes’ strength.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: On a 7+, halve the Move characteristic of that unit until the start of your next turn and roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds that unit’s Save characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

ability.name: Elder Authority
ability.lore: Even the trees themselves respect the authority of the Sylvaneth’s regal ancients.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if there is a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield.
ability.effect:
You can set up up to 2 additional **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield (an **Awakened Wyldwood** is a single tree miniature with a crescent- shaped base). The first can be set up anywhere on the battlefield more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second can be set up anywhere on the battlefield wholly outside of enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Awakened Wyldwood** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the 'Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: With a bellow, the Ogor Warhulk drives their shield forward, forcing the enemy back.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY, WAR MACHINE** or **CAVALRY** unit in combat with your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target must immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were the enemy movement phase.

ability.name: Soulpike
ability.lore: The caster places a hex on a group of foes so that, should they move too hastily or aggressively, they risk impaling their own souls on a shimmering forest of purple-black spears.
ability.declare: Pick the **Neferata** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **CHARGE** ability, immediately after that ability has been resolved, roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll for that ability. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Stolen Animus
ability.lore: This Wight King draws their unholy vitality from spilling blood in great measure.
ability.effect: Each time your general scores a critical hit, **Heal (2)** your general after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: The Faces of the Bad Moon
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Bad Moon hurtles erratically around the realms in madcap orbits, empowering its worshippers and troubling all others with insane visions.
ability.declare: You must use this ability at the start of the battle round. If multiple players are commanding a Gloomspite Gitz army, then instead, at the start of the battle round, those players roll off and only the winner declares and uses this ability this battle round.
ability.effect: If it is the first battle round, pick the starting face of the Bad Moon (**Grinnin’**, **Scowlin’**, **Sulkin’** or **Cacklin’**). If it is not the first battle round, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face in the sequence.

ability.name: Rune of Searing Heat
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The edges of the Fyreslayers’ weapons glow with the heat of the forge.
ability.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE** abilities this battle round.

Melee weapons used by friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units have **Crit** **(Mortal)** for the rest of the battle round.

ability.name: Ancient Strategist
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
ability.lore: This Oldblood has centuries of experience in commanding their cohorts.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general. You cannot pick your general.
ability.effect: That unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Tangling Tendrils
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, units (friendly and enemy) have **STRIKE‑LAST** while they are contesting either target objective.

ability.name: Shyishan Blade
ability.lore: Sorcerous shadows dance across the deadly sharp edge of this obsidian sword.
ability.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general’s **Baleful Tomb Blade** is 2.

ability.name: Ethereal
ability.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

ability.name: The Grimroot Order
ability.lore: Corruption suffuses these warriors so deeply that it is said they can endure wounds that would slay even fellow Varanguard.
ability.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s Health characteristic.

ability.name: Frazzleboom
ability.lore: When a Sunsteala Wheela is destroyed, the metal shards hammered into it become unstable, burning nearby enemies as the Hyshian energies trapped within them are released.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **WAR MACHINE** is destroyed, before removing it from play, pick an enemy unit within 3" of that **WAR MACHINE** and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Pestilent Breath
ability.lore: This Spoilpox Scrivener has breath so foul that it can stun a full-grown rhinox.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 7" of your general and roll a dice for each model in that unit.
ability.effect: For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

ability.name: Magmic Tunnels
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: Tunnels carved by runic magic enable a band of Fyreslayers to attack from an unseen quarter.
ability.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly units. Remove them from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Grand Illusionist
ability.lore: This hero is a supreme mountebank, able to fabricate convincing illusions that allow them to slip away undetected.
ability.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

ability.name: Crawly Swarm
ability.lore: The beasts of the Murkvast Menagerie are riddled with parasites and other gnashing creepy crawlies.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE MONSTER** that has not charged this turn.

ability.name: To the Ships!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick the **Heldenhain** or a **Sun Seekers** objective to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

ability.name: Soothing Pulse
ability.lore: The Branchwych who shepherds these cursed Sylvaneth magically soothes her paraspite-afflicted kin while they await a true cure to their ailments.
ability.declare: Pick the **Branchwych** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect: **Heal (3)** the target.

ability.name: The World Titan's Prophet
ability.lore: Brodd is a living legend amongst his towering kin, the only being in existence they would risk themselves to protect.
ability.effect:
While any other friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** units are within a friendly **King Brodd**’s combat range:

• That friendly **King Brodd** has **WARD (5+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **King Brodd**, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** unit within its combat range after the damage sequence for that friendly **King Brodd** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Legendary Tenacity
ability.lore: This hero might well be struck down, but there is little in the Mortal Realms that can stop them from rising again, bloodied but unbowed.
ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Shadow-Blooded
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: This hero hails from one of the darkest parts of Ulgu, and their heritage grants them a significant aptitude for deception.
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: What's Yours Is Mine
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
ability.lore: Gronn has always had a cavalier attitude when it comes to ownership.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the target. Then, pick an artefact of power the target has.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll for each unit in this Regiment of Renown that is in combat with the target. On a 6+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

ability.name: Scroll of Petrification
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Though they cannot control the stone-flesh curse, the Zharrdron still believe it can be harnessed. This scroll is the result of such a belief. One who reads from it can transform themselves or their minions into stone for a fleeting moment.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

•  The target has **WARD (2+)**.
•  The target cannot use non-passive abilities or be picked to be the target of friendly abilities.
•  Enemy units can ignore the target’s combat range for the purposes of movement and charging.
• Enemy units can ignore the target for the purposes of setting up on the battlefield but cannot be set up on the target.

ability.name: Fleshmeddler
ability.lore: This Skaven carries syringe darts filled with warpstone serum that can be fired into the patchwork hides of nearby Moulder creations to give them a ‘bit of extra bite’.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Depict Rune
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: The Lumineth magically inscribe runes of power into the lands themselves to enhance their armies and heal the realms of Chaos corruption.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following runes to depict on your **battle scripture**. The effect and conditional enhanced effects of that rune last for the rest of the battle round. Each rune remains on your **battle scripture** for the rest of the battle or until it is removed or replaced by another ability.

**Varinor, Rune of Strength:** Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for each target. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks.
• While **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

**Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**: Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Each target has **WARD (5+)**. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, the targets’ melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
• While **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets.

**Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**: Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by the targets.
• If **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, each target can immediately move up to 3". They can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

**Oreali, Rune of the Wind**: Pick up to 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units for each instance of this rune depicted on your **battle scripture** to be the targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any of the targets. In addition, the following enhanced effects apply:
• While **Varinor, Rune of Strength** is depicted on your battle scripture, add 4" to each target’s Move characteristic.
• While **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** is depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 5 to each target’s control score.

**Thalari, Rune of the Zenith**: Add 2 to casting rolls for friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units. In addition, if you have 4 or more unique runes depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 4" to the Move characteristic of friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units and friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units’ attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

**Designer’s Note:** *We recommend noting the runes you have inscribed in each battle round on a piece of paper to keep track of which are currently depicted on your **battle scripture.** Feel free to note them by type (Strength, River, Mountain etc.), by initial (each has a different first letter) or, if you are feeling particularly adventurous, you can try your hand at aelven calligraphy and learn to draw each rune!*

ability.name: Flawless Commander
ability.lore: Under this aelf’s command, the serried ranks of the Lumineth advance in a perfect march.
ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Titan of the Land
ability.lore: This warbeast has absorbed so much of its environment’s latent magic that it has become a locus of the natural energies of the Mortal Realms.
ability.effect: This unit counts as a terrain piece for the purpose of picking targets for the friendly **Realmshaper Engine**’s ‘Power Unleashed’ ability. Do not inflict any mortal damage on this unit as part of that ability.

ability.name: Fast As Frazzlegit
ability.lore: The Gitmob packs are always on the move, a speeding melange of howling Snarlfangs and cackling grots.
ability.effect: Friendly units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Reinforced Constructs
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: These mastercrafted Bonereapers were created by some of the finest bone-sculptors of the Ossiarch Empire.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: The Dread Banner
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of the First Battle Round
ability.lore: Marked with sigils of each of the Dark Gods, those who bear this banner seek ruinous blessings whatever their provenance.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Chaos Warriors** unit.
ability.effect: You can immediately roll on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit.

ability.name: Arcane Prowess
ability.lore: The Cathallar of this Glittering Phalanx keeps a hidden reserve of aetherquartz to bolster their sorcery in battle.
ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for your general.

ability.name: Savage Beyond Reason
ability.lore: The fury of battle drives this general into an intense rage.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, if it did not use a **FIGHT** ability in the previous turn. Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those weapons instead while this unit has not used a **FIGHT** ability this battle.

ability.name: Form Up!
ability.lore: Once the order is given, shieldwalls and cannon batteries link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Cannonade Cogfort’.*

ability.name: Take Aim!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: While their shield-slogging comrades keep the foe at bay, sharpshooters rain down punishing volumes of fire on helpless foes.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Sound the Attack!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit that is under orders
ability.lore: As the piercing note of a war-horn sounds, shields shift aside to permit cavalry and hollering assault troops to sally forth and engage the foe.
ability.effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.

ability.name: Hurl Them Back!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: After the enemy has spent their fury, the Sigmarites heave forward, shoving their foes off balance and leaving them open to a killing blow.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **under orders** and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Stentorian General
ability.lore: This hero’s bellowed threats are so intense that the enemy cowers before them.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

ability.name: Grizzled Drillmaster
ability.lore: This warrior is a grim-faced veteran who mercilessly drills regiments under their command, not out of cruelty but from a desire to ensure their survival.
ability.effect: Other visible friendly units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

ability.name: Beloved Leader
ability.lore: Such is the esteem in which this officer is held that their soldiers would march into the jaws of death without fear.
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

ability.name: The Last Blade of Embergard
ability.lore: This chipped and scratched blade grows steadily hotter as allies and enemies fall, fuelled by the fury of battle.
ability.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon’s Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Bones of Saint Ignifus
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** or **PRAYER** ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders
ability.lore: The seventh Supreme Pontifex of the Sigmarite faith, Ignifus perished in the act of slaying the Nightmare of Vandium. His bones thrum with righteous power.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.

ability.name: Castle Up!
ability.lore: Reinholt’s warriors retain their training in spite of their years as a mercenary group.
ability.effect: While a non-**HERO** unit in this Regiment of Renown is within the combat range of and visible to this Regiment of Renown’s **HERO**, those units are **under orders**.

ability.name: Simmering Rage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: A wild fury burns in the soul of this commander, threatening to explode at any moment.
ability.declare: You must use this ability.
ability.effect: Gain a number of **rage dice** equal to your **fury level**. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **rage dice** are lost.

ability.name: Into Them, You Dogs!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Sigmarite officers demand remarkable feats from their warriors, leading them into the furnace of battle with a rousing speech and a sword held high.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** that is **under orders** to use this ability. That unit is the **field officer** for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non‑**HERO** units that are **under orders** and wholly within 12" of the **field officer** to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the **field officer** uses a **FIGHT** ability, you can pick a target that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn. That target is **inspirited** and the other target is **emboldened**. The **inspirited** target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by the **field officer** has been resolved. Then, if the **emboldened** target has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, it can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **inspirited** target’s **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Prototype Arco-Combustor Uninhibitor
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: This device accelerates the burning of a Cogfort’s emberstone fuel, allowing sudden and shocking bursts of motion.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 3" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
• This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
•No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Emergency Bellows
ability.lore: This cogwork mechanism pumps cool air into an overheating arco-combustor.
ability.effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.

ability.name: Spell Hunters
ability.lore: Having enlisted local Wildercorpsmen to aid them in hunting down and destroying rogue manifestations in the local area, the Ven Densts ensure they are armed for the task.
ability.effect: While both units in this Regiment of Renown are within each other’s combat range, enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot be set up within 12" of either of those units.

ability.name: Friendly Competition
ability.lore: When one of the company claims a kill, the others redouble their efforts to even the score.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by non-**HERO** units in this Regiment of Renown if any enemy models were slain by shooting attacks made by non-**HERO** units in this Regiment of Renown in the same turn.

ability.name: Grapple-Net Launcher
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Combat Phase
ability.lore: This hull-mounted defensive device flings a steel-mesh net at onrushing foes, trapping them fast and nullifying their attacks.
ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Lady of the Wheel
ability.lore: Zenestra’s followers will defend her with a strength that can cow even a follower of the Dark Gods.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly model is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to that model’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Fervent Rush
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Singing righteous hymns and prepared to give their lives for the cause, these Sigmarites charge forward to battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability.
ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Fierce Zealots
ability.lore: Should Zenestra demand it, these followers will fight tooth and nail for even the meanest patch of dirt.
ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **Freeguild Steelhelms** units.

ability.name: Devout Commander
ability.lore: This faithful commander strikes with a ferocity born of utter conviction.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of your general’s **Master‑forged Weapon**.

ability.name: Step to it!
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **RUN** ability for a non-**HERO** unit wholly within 12" of your general
ability.lore: The Marshal tells their men to heft their weapons and get moving!
ability.effect: Do not make a run roll as part of that **RUN** ability. Instead, add 6" to that non-**HERO** unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that **RUN** ability.

ability.name: Stand Fast, Comrades
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The general calls upon their soldiers to hold the line, no matter the cost and no matter the foe.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO** unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: The target has **WARD (4+)** until the start of the next battle round.

ability.name: Ardent Demand
ability.lore: With a bellowed order, the Marshal ignites the passion and fury of the Freeguilders, and they lay into the enemy furiously.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO** unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn

ability.name: Castellan-Captain Vyan Philsin
ability.lore: Infamous for launching amphibious assaults on Kruleboyz camps in the swamps of Ghyran, those who board Philsin’s Cogfort are well versed in close combat.
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IRON MARCH INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**.

ability.name: Commodore De Graçon
ability.lore: De Graçon is an intrepid commander known for her lightning raids on enemy positions. She has a reputation for burning through fuel at a fearsome pace.
ability.effect: This unit and up to 1 other friendly **IRON MARCH WAR MACHINE** within this unit’s combat range can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Castellan-Captain Regan Vandercloud
ability.lore: Vandercloud prefers to smash their Cogfort into the foe like a stone battering ram.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Engineer Kirsta Loudren
ability.lore: Loudren is ferociously protective of her Cogfort’s arco-combustor, and she would rather see it utterly destroyed than have it fall into unworthy hands.
ability.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each visible unit (friendly and enemy) within its combat range. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

ability.name: Engineer Gurrn Ashbrow
ability.lore: Ashbrow is one of the Ironweld’s most senior Cogfort experts. His tireless repairs are as ingenious as they are swift.
ability.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Engineer Bartel Holst
ability.lore: Holst believes that a powerful defence is a Cogfort’s greatest boon. His war machine is clad in duardin-forged steel plate; to him, the Cogfort’s severely reduced manoeuvrability and speed is an acceptable cost.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)** and **STRIKE-LAST**.

ability.name: Battle-Priest Solantra Whyl
ability.lore: Whyl is a veteran battle-priest who suffered crippling injuries during a Skaven artillery barrage. Since then, she has strapped herself into any Cogfort willing to give her berth, using the titan as her mobile pulpit.
ability.effect: This unit has **PRIEST (1)**.

ability.name: Broadmoore and Louse
ability.lore: The notoriously foul-tempered Marshal Hans Broadmoore and his downtrodden Relic Envoy ‘Louse’ Renlik often ride to battle atop a Cogfort. Should foes attempt to board, the pair fight back fiercely with sabre and pistol.
ability.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters**. In addition, if this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can set up a **Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy** wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. That unit has the **IRON MARCH** keyword.

ability.name: Master Sapper Gravelock Fiske
ability.lore: Whether directing the fire of a realmscorcher or the bombardment of a godbreaker cannon, Fiske can pinpoint the weak spot of any enemy fortification.
ability.effect: This unit’s ranged weapons have **Anti‑FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend)** and **Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**.

ability.name: Form up, Allies!
ability.lore: Once the order is given, humans, aelves and duardin alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard’.*

ability.name: Forces of Order
ability.lore: The soldiers who stand shoulder to shoulder against the evil ravaging the Mortal Realms are hardy and bold, and they take strength from their shared bonds of fellowship.
ability.effect:
While 3 friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the **AELF** keyword, 1 of those units has the **DUARDIN** keyword and 1 of those units has the **SIGMARITE** keyword:

• Those units have **WARD (5+)** against shooting attacks.
• Add 3 to those units’ control scores.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.

ability.name: Respected Commander
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 18" of this unit
ability.lore: This commander is hailed as a paragon of virtue by all goodly beings, and their orders are followed with the utmost haste.
ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Signet of the City
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: This piece of jewellery is bestowed upon those who have performed a great service to one of Sigmar’s cities, giving their opinion considerable weight in matters military. The bearers do tend to overstep their authority, however, countermanding earlier orders and sowing confusion.
ability.declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• The targets are **under orders**.
• The targets have **WARD (6+)**.
• The targets have a maximum control score of 1.

ability.name: Plumes of Auspicious Smoke
ability.lore: The mists that spill from the Croneseer’s cauldrons are thick with augury and omen, and those who inhale them are forewarned of imminent danger.
ability.effect:
Friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** units are either **empty** or **full**. They start the battle **empty**. While a friendly **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** unit is **full**:

• That **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by shooting attacks.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** units while they are wholly within 9" of that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**.

ability.name: Laden with Prophecy
ability.lore: The viscera collected in a Cauldron of Blood and burned to enhance Krethusa’s haruspicy shroud all those nearby in a blood-tinged pall.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **empty Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**.
ability.effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit'**s combat attacks, it becomes **full**.

ability.name: The Blood Reveals All
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: It matters not from which body the entrails are taken.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS HERO** within the combat range of a friendly **empty** **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit**. Then, pick another unit within the combat range of that **HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Allocate a number of damage points to the target equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood unit** becomes **full**.

ability.name: Mounting Dread
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: The wails and shrieks of the Nighthaunt are a continuous assault on the courage of those who face them in battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn, subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with the target.

ability.name: Vengeance for the Lost
ability.lore: Should they witness the desecration of their sacred groves, the Sylvaneth will attack with a merciless and frenzied aggression.
ability.effect: If your **Soulpod Grove** has been demolished this battle, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** units’ melee weapons.

ability.name: Form Up, Iron March!
ability.lore: Once the order is given, Cogforts and infantry alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH** unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly **IRON MARCH** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:

• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort’ or ‘Mallus Forgepriest’.*

ability.name: Raising the Heat
ability.lore: The battlefields of Aqshy awaken a burning rage deep within all warriors and beasts, the flames of which are stoked should the enemy seek to intimidate or threaten them.
ability.effect: If you are the attacker, set your **fury level** to 1. If you are the defender, set your **fury level** to 2.

ability.name: Fall From Grace
ability.lore: Slaanesh is a capricious patron, and he can quickly lose interest…
ability.effect:
A friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** immediately loses the **PARAGON** keyword when any of the following happen:

• That **PARAGON** has 3 or more damage points allocated to it by the same use of a non‑**ATTACK** ability.
• That **PARAGON** uses a **CHARGE** ability and the unmodified charge roll is 5 or less (after any re‑rolls).
• A spell cast by that **PARAGON** is **miscast** (after any re-rolls).

ability.name: Sensuous Arcana
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Those who please Slaanesh are granted mystical secrets of excess.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** that has successfully cast a spell this turn and has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Cutting Barbs
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: This champion releases a wave of snide vitriol that pierces to their foe’s core.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that **HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

***Rise to the Insults***: For the rest of the turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.

***Turn Aside from the Insults***: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Chief of Revels
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: Slaanesh’s champions earn favour through locating and embracing new debaucheries at a voracious pace.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** that charged this turn and has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Enthralling Vanity
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: When a Hedonite champion calls for adoration, it is difficult to resist.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** unit that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON**, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.

***Mesmerised***: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units for attacks that target that unit, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***Break their Gaze***: For the rest of the turn, other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by the target have no effect.

ability.name: Excess of Agility
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: When truly ‘inspired’, the servants of Slaanesh are almost impossible to strike, twisting around blows with mocking laughter.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE PARAGON** that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the unit using this ability is a **PARAGON** and is in combat, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Centre of Attention
ability.lore: Such is the dazzling self-possession of this champion that many enemies cannot help but be stupefied around them.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while this unit is wholly within 12" of the centre of the battlefield and visible to the target:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Bashful Visage
ability.lore: Those who meet the gaze of this delicate mask are compelled to turn away in shame as they are confronted with sudden awareness of their own basest desires.
ability.effect: While they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

ability.name: Beguiling Glance
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
ability.lore: One glance from Slaanesh’s chosen can ensnare a wayward soul.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** unit that has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that **HERO** to be the target.

ability.name: Crown of the Ur-Slaanesh
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Once worn by Luxcious, the first Pretender, this majestic crown draws in devoted followers by the score.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO INFANTRY** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Bringers of Degradation
ability.lore: Daemonettes are always competing to inflict the most inventive ends.
ability.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly **Daemonettes** units instead of 1 unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

ability.name: Daemonic Onslaught
ability.lore: Utterly in thrall to their base urges, Slaanesh’s most bestial daemons move with impossible haste.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Seekers** or **Fiends** unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Excess of Violence
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: The Heralds that lead this daemonic warband are well practised in inspiring killing frenzies. Not that it takes much inspiring…
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Fight Through the Pain
ability.lore: Anger can grant one the resilience to shrug off grievous wounds – if the promise of vengeance is close at hand.
ability.effect: Before allocating damage to a friendly unit, you can spend any number of **rage dice**. For each **rage dice** spent, reduce your **fury level** by 1, to a minimum of 0, then roll a dice. On a 3+, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool.

ability.name: Eruption of Fury
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Stoked by the ongoing battle, this warrior’s wrath erupts in a display of bone-splintering violence.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that friendly unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the melee weapons that the unit using this ability is armed with. Then, spend up to 3 **rage dice**.

Resolve a number of combat attacks against the target using the melee weapon you picked equal to the number of **rage dice** you spent.

Those attacks cannot score critical hits. Instead, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for those attacks:

• Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the unit using this ability.

• Your opponent must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for those attacks, allocate D3 mortal damage to this unit after the damage sequence has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

**Designer’s Note:** ***Rage dice** do not add to the Attacks characteristic of the weapon you pick; if you spend 3* **rage dice** *to use this ability, you only make 3 combat attacks.*

ability.name: Favour Most Fickle
ability.lore: The Dark Prince smiles only on those who perform for his twisted amusement.
ability.effect:
The following effects apply based on the number of friendly units on the battlefield. These effects are not cumulative: 

**• 5 or more units:** Add 2 to the Control characteristic of friendly units.
**• 4 units:** Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for friendly units’ combat attacks, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons.
**• 3 units:** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly units.
**• 2 units:** Friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
