**• 1 unit:** Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly units’ melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: High Courtiers
ability.lore: The leaders of this warband are exalted in the Court of Pleasure, and their followers inherit this favour.
ability.effect: While your general is wholly within the combat range of a friendly **Daemonettes** unit, both units have **WARD (5+)**.

ability.name: Irresistible Soul-Musk
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: The scent of vice and agony that surrounds these chosen daemons draws wilder underlings to their side.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Seekers** or **Fiends** unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Perfection Made Manifest
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: To witness Sigvald at war is to witness a martial skill so magnificent that onlookers are entranced even as they are cut down.
ability.declare: Pick the friendly **Sigvald** to use this ability then pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of him to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each model slain by this ability this turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the friendly **Sigvald**’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Petulant Wrath
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Woe betide the hapless Hedonite who looks liable to upstage Sigvald in their eagerness to reach combat…
ability.declare: If the friendly **Sigvald** is not in combat and did not charge this turn, pick him to use this ability, then pick another friendly **DECADENT HOST** unit within 1" of him to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Before removing any slain models from play, remove the friendly **Sigvald** from the battlefield then set him up again within 1" of the target.

ability.name: Infernal Handmaidens
ability.lore: Sigvald is often accompanied by throngs of adulating daemons who delight in the Prince’s utter unrighteous conviction.
ability.effect: While the friendly **Sigvald** is within 3" of and visible to any friendly **DECADENT HOST DAEMON** units, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by those **DAEMON** units.

ability.name: All for the Prince
ability.lore: Sigvald is the centre of his libertine followers’ world – they would rather be rent limb from limb than allow a single blade to mar his immaculate flesh.
ability.effect:
While the friendly **Sigvald** is within the combat range of another friendly **DECADENT HOST SYBARITE** unit:

• He has **WARD (2+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for him, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly **DECADENT HOST** unit within his combat range after the damage sequence for him has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Important People Have Important Places To Be
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Sigvald is easily bored and easily distracted – but when something does catch his eye, he moves with incredible haste.
ability.effect: If the friendly **Sigvald** is not contesting an objective, he can move 2D6" but must end that move contesting an objective. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Protégé
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the 'The Prince in the Mirror' ability
ability.lore: Sigvald took a liking to this champion, to the point of binding their souls in a one-sided ritual of great power. Of course, the Prince has ways of using this bond…
ability.effect: You can set up a replacement **Sigvald** within 1" of this unit instead of within 6" of a friendly **Contorted Epitome**. If you do so, after setting up that replacement unit, this unit is automatically destroyed.

ability.name: Mirror-Plate
ability.lore: One who wears this polished armour is a member of the vaunted Mirror Guard. Their duty is not to fight but to ensure the Prince can always admire his favourite sight: himself.
ability.effect:
Weapons used by this unit have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 1.

While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the friendly **Sigvald**, add 20 to the friendly **Sigvald**’s control score.

ability.name: The Great Plan
ability.lore: The Seraphon look to the heavens for guidance, scrying the stars above in the hope that the Great Plan is revealed to them.
ability.declare: You must use this ability. Pick an **ASTERISM** ability to be prophesied.
ability.effect: That **ASTERISM** ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the ‘Further the Great Plan’ ability.

ability.name: The Voice and the Talon
ability.lore: For all their mutual and endless antipathy, Slaanesh’s twin heirs are most deadly when they work in tandem.
ability.effect: The friendly **Synessa** and **Dexcessa** have the **TWIN** keyword.

ability.name: All the Rage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the **coveted** pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.

ability.name: Forward to Victory
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a Charge ability
ability.lore: With their charge faltering, a rousing command gives the unit renewed energy to reach their foes.
ability.effect: You can re-roll the **charge roll**.

ability.name: Standard Bearer
ability.lore: The unit’s standard provides a rallying point in the chaos of battle.
ability.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s **control score**.

ability.name: Artycle 25, Point 6
ability.lore: Crew members must ensure the adequate defence of their superiors during perilous expeditions.
ability.effect: Friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** while they are within this unit’s combat range.

ability.name: The More Glorious Slaughter
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: In a flush of vainglory, one of the Twins boasts extravagantly of their superior acts of death-dealing, goading their sibling and their entourage to new heights of lethality in their efforts not to be overshadowed.
ability.declare: If a friendly **TWIN** destroyed an enemy unit in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this ability.

ability.name: The Longer Shadow
ability.lore: Both Synessa and Dexcessa are forever competing to prove themselves the more domineering of their god-father’s spawn.
ability.declare: If a friendly **TWIN** is contesting an objective you control and the other is not, pick the one that is not to use this ability.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is contesting an objective you control, add 5 to the control scores of units in its regiment.

ability.name: The Grander Visage
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Should one of the Twins show a sign of weakening, the other will seize the chance to better display their own immaculacy.
ability.declare: If either friendly **TWIN** is damaged, pick the one with fewer or no damage points to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit using this ability has **WARD (4+)**.

ability.name: The Swifter Surge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: To be the first into the fray is a mark of honour between the vindictive Twins. Should one of them fall behind for even a moment, they will act swiftly lest they leave themselves open to their sibling’s ridicule.
ability.declare: If a friendly **TWIN** charged in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

ability.name: The More Cunning Ruse
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Strategic intellect is another arena of mastery – one that both Twins are eager to prove the superior in.
ability.declare: If both friendly **TWINS** are within 12" of and visible to each other, pick one of them to use this ability.
ability.effect: Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Tethered to the Twins
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This daemon is a vassal of Synessa or Dexcessa – or both. So long as they persist, so will the accursed Twins.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **TWIN** that has been destroyed to be the target.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: The Sphere Celestial
ability.lore: By cranking the dials on this incredibly sophisticated artefact, the bearer can manipulate space and time on a local level, swapping the position of themselves and another willing ally.
ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY HERO** that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use **MOVE** abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).

ability.name: Lurking Threat
ability.lore: The swirling, sweetly scented mists that drift across the battlefield hide a deadly enemy.
ability.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown if none of those units have been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **lurking in the mists**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: The Mists Part
ability.lore: Cruel laughter and the soft sigh of drawn bowstrings heralds the arrival of Hycantha and her fellow Sybarites.
ability.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown if they are **lurking in the mists**.
ability.effect: Set up the **Shardspeaker of Slaanesh** in this Regiment of Renown on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the **Blissbarb Archers** unit in this Regiment of Renown on the battlefield wholly within 6" of that **Shardspeaker of Slaanesh**, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Blood Rites
ability.lore: Manifold are the Khainite blood rituals, but no offering holds greater weight than the spilling of gore in a ritualistic bacchanal.
ability.effect:
You perform a blood rite each time:

• An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly **anointed** unit’s combat attacks in the same turn.
• A friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed.
• A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed.
• An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit’s attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase.
• A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a **Place of Power** at the start of the phase.

Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.

ability.name: Emberstone-Augmented Weapons
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any **emberstone slivers** to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

•Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
•Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

Then, if you are the **underdog**, remove all of the target’s **emberstone slivers**. Otherwise, remove all **emberstone slivers** from each friendly unit.

ability.name: Creeping Gloom
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The Gloomspite Gitz seek to plunge the realms into an eternal, clammy gloaming known as the Everdank. The icky fungal growths and obscuring spore clouds that follow them are very conducive to such conditions.
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while friendly non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units are wholly within 3" of that terrain feature, they are not visible to enemy units more than 9" away.

ability.name: Reserves of Daemonic Power
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: When venturing forth into the untainted reaches of the realms, the Helsmiths of Hashut draw upon reserves of daemonic power to establish a foothold.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that has no **daemonic power points** to be the target.
ability.effect: Give 2 **daemonic power points** to the target.

ability.name: Echoes of Blight City
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) contesting the target equal to the **instability level**. Then, reset the **instability level** to 1.

ability.name: Twin Tides
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability for a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit
ability.lore: Though the Idoneth’s military structure is uncompromisingly rigid, their fluidity in battle is astounding. The Akhelians lead; the Namarti follow. Such discipline, alloyed to aelven speed and grace, has spelled the doom of numberless foes.
ability.usedBy: The friendly **AKHELIAN** unit using that **ATTACK** ability.
ability.effect:
Pick a visible friendly **NAMARTI** unit that has not used an **ATTACK** ability this phase to be the target.

•  If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability, immediately after the **SHOOT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase.

•  If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability, immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s attacks.

ability.name: Collapsing Pass
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick each objective to be the targets. Then, pick 1 of the targets to be the **focus**.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. Add 1 to the roll for each unit (friendly and enemy) that is contesting it. If the target is the **focus**, you can add 3 to or subtract 3 from the roll. On a 8+, remove the target from the battlefield.

ability.name: Shifting Passages
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick 2 non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain features to be the targets.
ability.effect: Remove all **hidden passage tokens** from the battlefield (if any). Then, give each target a **hidden passage token**.

ability.name: Navigate the Tunnels
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of a terrain feature that has a **hidden passage token** to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a different terrain feature that has a **hidden passage token** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Rolling Ash-Clouds
ability.effect:
While the ash-clouds are **low-lying**:
•  Units and **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot be set up in neutral territory.
•  Units and **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot end a move within neutral territory unless they started that move wholly within neutral territory.
•  Models and **MANIFESTATIONS** are not visible to other models more than 3" away unless a straight line can be drawn between any points on their bases that does not cross neutral territory.

ability.name: Spreading Warpfire
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: If there are no **flaming** terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non‑**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non‑**Faction Terrain** terrain feature that is not **flaming** and that is within 12" of a **flaming** terrain feature to be the target.
ability.effect: The target is **flaming** for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any **flaming** terrain features.

ability.name: Search the Ruin
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that does not have an **emberstone nugget** and is contesting a **Sun Seekers** objective to be the target.
ability.effect: Give the target an **emberstone nugget**. If you are the **underdog**, the target can immediately move 6" but cannot end that move in combat. The target cannot use the ‘Back to Base Camp’ or ‘Power Through’ ability for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Back to Base Camp
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has an **emberstone nugget**, was not set up this turn and is contesting a **Golden Lions** objective to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target's **emberstone nugget**.

ability.name: Champion
ability.lore: A veteran fighter leads the charge.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the **Attacks** characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a **BEAST**, this ability affects this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Arcane Charge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.declare: Pick a **Place of Power** you control to be the target.
ability.effect: Draw a straight line from the centre of the **primary** objective to the target. If that line crosses any **secondary** objectives, the first **secondary** objective that the line crosses is now the **primary** objective and all other objectives are now **secondary** objectives.

ability.name: Dirty Tricks
ability.lore: Kruleboyz will use whatever devious means they can to gain the upper hand over the foe.
ability.effect: The effect of a **DIRTY TRICK** ability is only applied if you make a successful dirty trick roll. The success of a dirty trick roll depends on the number of **DIRTY TRICK** abilities your army has already used this battle round.
ability.altText: A table that has two columns with the headers Dirty Trick and Dirty Trick Roll. It has four rows as follows: First, 2+. Second, 3+. Third, 4+. Fourth or subsequent, 5+.

ability.name: Kairic Tome
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 6" of this unit
ability.lore: Said to be penned by the Fateweaver himself, this tome is filled with all manner of eldritch secrets.
ability.effect: Add 1 to or subtract 1 from the casting roll for that spell. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

ability.name: Charnel Vestments
ability.lore: Strips of flayed skin and crudely stitched sinew form a gruesome parody of priestly robes.
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **PRIEST**, it has **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit is already a **PRIEST**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit. If this unit is a **WIZARD**, it cannot use **SPELL** abilities and **PRAYER** abilities in the same phase.

ability.name: The Grisly Pennant
ability.lore: This raggedy flag of flesh, recently torn from an unfortunate victim, is an icon of purity and nobility to the cannibal army but a terrifying spectacle to their enemies.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is greater than the target’s Control characteristic or is a 6, the following effects apply for the rest of the turn:

•  Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
•  Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: The Splintered Femur
ability.lore: A venerated relic of the infamous Spell-eater Queen, this club can easily break not only limbs but also the arcane.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following:

•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  Subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.
•  If the target is a **MANIFESTATION**, it is banished and removed from play.

ability.name: Imperious Will
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for a non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: The exacting leadership of this commander inspires their cohorts of Ossiarch soldiery to fight with a ruthless determination to utterly vanquish the enemy.
ability.effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-**HERO** unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **FIGHT** ability.

ability.name: Paragons of Slaanesh
ability.lore: Those who serve their own dark desires earn Slaanesh’s favour.
ability.declare: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **PARAGONS** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that does not have the **PARAGON** keyword and has not had the **PARAGON** keyword this battle to be the target.
ability.effect:
The target gains the **PARAGON** keyword.

**Designer’s Note:** *Friendly units with the **PARAGON*** *keyword on their warscroll count towards the* *number of friendly **PARAGONS** on the battlefield.* *If there are more than 3 friendly **PARAGONS** on the* *battlefield at the same time, you must immediately* *remove those units from the battlefield one at a time* *until there are only 3 friendly **PARAGONS** left on* *the battlefield.*

ability.name: The Triplet Trinket
ability.lore: This bipartite charm is given to the Twins’ latest plaything – a supposed mark of favour that protects the godlings also.
ability.effect:
While a friendly **TWIN** is within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that **TWIN** and this unit.
While 2 friendly **TWINS** are within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target those **TWINS** and this unit instead.

ability.name: Spew Forth Sin
ability.lore: The Accursed Reflection is bathed in seductive sorceries and readily spits forth manifestations of excess.
ability.declare: Pick the **Contorted Epitome** in this Regiment of Renown to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
ability.effect:
Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

ability.name: Pyrotechnic Souls
ability.lore: When these warriors discorporate, it makes for a spectacularly explosive display.
ability.effect: When this unit is destroyed, gain 3 **rage dice**.

ability.name: Quick 'Un
ability.lore: Getting the drop on this hot‐tempered creature is nigh on impossible.
ability.effect: Add half your **fury level** (rounding up) to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Magical Intervention
ability.lore: A warrior learned in the mystic arts utters a rapid incantation to disrupt the enemy’s plans.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That friendly unit can use a **SPELL**, **PRAYER** or **BANISH** ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from **casting rolls** or **chanting rolls** made as part of that ability.

ability.name: Redeploy
ability.lore: Taking initiative, the warriors hastily reposition to respond to enemy movements.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move **cannot** pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

ability.name: At the Double
ability.lore: At a command from their general, the warriors sprint to a key position on the battlefield.
ability.effect: Do not make a **run roll** as part of that **RUN** ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s **MOVE** characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that **RUN** ability.

ability.name: Covering Fire
ability.lore: The warriors unleash a quick volley at a nearby enemy unit before it charges into combat.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a **RUN** ability this turn and that is **not in combat** to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick **MANIFESTATIONS** or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
ability.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

ability.name: All-Out Defence
ability.lore: The soldiers close ranks to hold off an incoming attack.
ability.usedBy: A unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **save rolls** for that unit until that **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Counter-Charge
ability.lore: Seeing the need for decisive action, the warriors charge forth to stall the enemy’s advance or enact a bold interception.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect: That unit can use a **CHARGE** ability as if it were your charge phase.

ability.name: Power Through
ability.lore: The warriors use their sheer mass or resilience to drive through a group of weaker foes, leaving broken bodies in their wake.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit **in combat** with it to be the target. The target must have a lower **Health** characteristic than the unit using this ability.
ability.effect: Inflict **D3 mortal damage** on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its **Move** characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

ability.name: All-Out Attack
ability.lore: The warriors fight with frenzied vigour.
ability.effect: Add 1 to **hit rolls** for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability. This also affects weapons that have the **Companion** weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from **save rolls** for the unit using this ability.

ability.name: Activate Place of Power
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: There are many locus points of volcanic magic in Aqshy. From these simmering fonts of passion and fury, one can draw great strength or unleash a dizzying wave of anger that causes spellcasters to lose control of their magic.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HERO** within 3" of any **Places of Power** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that **HERO**. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• *I**gnite Fury:*** Gain 2 **rage dice**, then increase your **fury level** by 2, to a maximum of 7.

• ***Channel Wrath:*** If that **HERO** is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that **HERO** for the rest of the turn.

• ***Dizzying Rage:*** For the rest of the turn, if that **HERO** is not a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, they can use the ‘Unbind’ or ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had **WIZARD (1)**.

ability.name: Rune of Farsight
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
ability.lore: Empowered by this rune, the Fyreslayers hurl their throwing axes into the enemy with devastating accuracy.
ability.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **UR-GOLD RUNE** abilities this battle round. Pick any number of enemy units within 10" of and visible to any friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units to be targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. In addition, for the rest of the battle round, ranged weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Sacred Rites
ability.lore: The priest focuses on safely setting their ritual into motion.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **PRIEST** to use this ability, then make a **chanting roll** of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that **PRIEST** instead of D3.
ability.effect: Give a number of ritual points to the **PRIEST** equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the **PRIEST**'s ritual points total to 0.

ability.name: Unbind
ability.lore: The wizard saps the energy from an enemy’s spell, nullifying its effects.
ability.usedBy: A friendly **WIZARD** within 30" of the enemy **WIZARD** casting the spell.
ability.effect: Make an **unbinding roll** of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the **casting roll** for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per **casting roll**.

ability.name: Banish Manifestation
ability.lore: The wizard or priest disrupts the arcane forces sustaining a manifestation, wiping it from existence.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** to use this ability, pick a **MANIFESTATION** within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the **banishment roll** for each additional enemy **MANIFESTATION** on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same **MANIFESTATION** to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
ability.effect: If the **banishment roll** equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

ability.name: Rally
ability.lore: With an inspiring call to action, wounded soldiers get a second wind and fresh troops take the field to replace their fallen comrades.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **not in combat** to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Make 6 **rally rolls** of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 **rally point**. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:

• For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** that unit.
• You can spend a number of rally points equal to the **Health** characteristic of that unit to **return** a slain model to that unit.

You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

ability.name: The Rod of Misrule
ability.lore: This bejewelled staff bestows a lunatic charisma, with which champions bid their warriors achieve the impossible.
ability.declare: Pick another visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, when the target uses the ‘Power Through’ command, you can pick an enemy target for that command that does not have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using that command.

ability.name: The Five Verses of Volarian
ability.lore: Upon reciting these stanzas, the reader is granted the gift of flight. Some acquire a Disc of Tzeentch; others sprout iridescent wings; others still find themselves propelled through the aether by an invisible force.
ability.effect: This unit has a Move characteristic of 14" and has **FLY**.

ability.name: The Searing Eye
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: This unblinking orb is said to be the eye of a Lord of Change, its purpose as much to spy on potential rivals as to reward minions with foresight of future events.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. If the roll is the same as any of the dice in the casting roll, that spell is miscast. Otherwise, add the roll to the casting roll.

ability.name: Scholar of the Sigils
ability.lore: This aelf has dedicated their life to the study of runic scripture; few are as knowledgeable as they.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following runes and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the battle. That rune cannot be depicted on your battle scripture for the rest of the battle.

***Varinor, Rune of Strength***: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.

***Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

***Ydriliqi, Rune of the River***: This unit’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge** **(+1 Rend)** and this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.

***Oreali, Rune of the Wind***: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target this unit.

***Thalari, Rune of the Zenith***: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Scorpion Tails
ability.lore: With their powerful arachnoid stingers, these warriors inject deadly venom into the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from wound rolls for its combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Vision of Defiant Supremacy
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: As the tide of battle turns, you and your brethren will find yourselves in the thick of the fighting, but you will have the upper hand.
ability.effect: If you won the priority roll this battle round and chose for your opponent to take the first turn or if your opponent seized the initiative this battle round, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Vision of Arcane Sacrifice
ability.lore: All around you, incantations will wither on lips and spells will backfire catastrophically – until the moment of your fated demise.
ability.effect:
While units (friendly or enemy) are within 6" of this unit:

• Add 1 to unbinding rolls for those units.
• Spells cast by those units are miscast on an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less.

The first time this unit is destroyed, gain D6 **fate points**.

ability.name: Tome of Scorched Insight
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a non-SUMMON SPELL ability for this unit
ability.lore: This book is a double-edged gift: it grants incredible arcane prowess but at a steep price, as the book slowly consumes the bearer’s own knowledge of magic.
ability.effect: Change the casting roll for that spell to a value of 12 that cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound and this unit cannot use that **SPELL** ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Vision of Destined Conquest
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Your Turn
ability.lore: The winds of fate will blow strong as you and your warriors overrun a site of import deep in enemy lands.
ability.effect:
If this unit is contesting an objective that you control that is wholly outside friendly territory:

• If you are the **underdog**, gain 1 **fate point** for each command point you have.
• If you are not the **underdog**, roll a dice for each command point you have. For each 3+, gain 1 **fate point**.

ability.name: Peerless Swordsman
ability.lore: This warrior’s skill with their favoured weapon is such that deflecting even the most grievous of blows is as child’s play to them.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit with a starting size of 1 that is in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the **parrying blade**.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the Attacks characteristic of the **parrying blade**. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s non‐**Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, for each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Dispassionate Soul
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
ability.lore: So impassive is this aelf that they can pacify others with their mere presence.
ability.effect: If this unit is in combat with an enemy **HERO**, reduce your opponent’s **fury level** by **X**, where **X** is the number of unique runes depicted on your battle scripture.

ability.name: Persistent Drillbill
ability.lore: This avian cog-familiar is relentless; once it has a foe in its sights, it will harry and peck them to the exclusion of all else.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Experimental Aether-Powered Ejector Rig
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: This pioneer firmly believes that combat is for other duardin.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Heat-Seeking Auto-Endrin
ability.lore: Designed to home in on sources of rage-induced heat – of which there are no shortage in fiery Aqshy – this tiny auto-endrin harasses and distracts the incensed foe.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract your opponent’s **fury level** from the target’s control score.

***Designer’s Note**: Use your opponent’s fury level at the point the unit’s control score is determined.*

ability.name: Tattermask
ability.lore: Patched together from assorted flaps of flayed skin, this enchanted mask has the unsurprisingly off-putting effect of turning the wearer’s bellows into keening cries for help in the native tongues of nearby enemies.
ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, that attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

ability.name: Spell in a Rattle
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: With a shake of this unassuming, knobbly rattle, the bearer releases the spell stored within.
ability.effect: This unit can use a non‐**SUMMON SPELL** ability from a spell lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 9 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound.

ability.name: Woggly Bogstikk
ability.lore: Plucked from the grasp of a bog-drowned shaman, this gnarled staff can turn the earth beneath a foe’s feet into acidic slime.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Artycle 15, Point 4
ability.lore: All duardin should be well versed in multiple combat techniques that can be employed against airborne and ground‐based enemies.
ability.effect:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has **FLY**.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that does not have **FLY**.

ability.name: Perfect Footwork
ability.lore: These warriors can seamlessly shift their position on key sites.
ability.effect: If each model in this unit is contesting the same objective, this unit can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end that move in combat. It must end that move with each of its models contesting the same objective. Then, this unit cannot use **RUN** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Patient Strike
ability.lore: The implacable focus of these Lumineth grants them the discipline required to wait for the enemy’s inevitable misstep.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is in combat with the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Dazzling Phalanx
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a **CHARGE** ability for a unit within 9" of and visible to this unit
ability.lore: These warriors angle the light emitted by their sunmetal weapons to blind and disorientate the foe as they bear down upon them.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target the enemy unit using that **CHARGE** ability.

ability.name: Artycle 20, Amendment 2
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Charge Phase
ability.lore: Flare guns may be used in extremis to disorientate marauders and others with sinister motives.
ability.declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target’s attacks cannot score critical hits for the rest of the turn (treat them as regular hits instead).

ability.name: Sly 'Un
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Whether covered in mud or submerged in a mire, this brute emerges from the muck with little warning, ready to ambush the enemy.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Dancing Mystflies
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for an unit within 30" of this unit
ability.lore: Their abdomens aglow with jade magic, these spites flutter across the battlefield, intercepting and absorbing arcane outbursts. In areas redolent with life energies, they have power enough to twist these captured spells and fire them back at the caster.
ability.effect:
• If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the
'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.

• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.

ability.name: Masterclan Connections
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** or **UNBIND** ability for a visible **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit
ability.lore: This Skaven’s obsequious nature has allowed them to curry favour with a member of the sorcerous Masterclan.
ability.effect: Add D3 to that casting roll or unbinding roll.

ability.name: Amulet of Resonance
ability.lore: This charm serves to amplify the spirit-song, ensuring it cuts through even the most furious tumult of battle.
ability.effect: If this unit used the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability this turn or you spent **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Glamourweave
ability.lore: The Glamourweave’s illusory enchantments both enhance the wearer’s forest camouflage and conceal their strikes when battle is joined.
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

ability.name: Aspect of Ironbark
ability.lore: These Sylvaneth can rapidly draw forth minerals from the earth in order to grant their barkflesh greater durability.
ability.effect:
When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit’s damage pool.

After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle

ability.name: Aspect of Heartwood
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endless Growth’ ability
ability.lore: Brave and true, these warriors are loyal to all Sylvaneth, regardless of glade, and seek to aid them however they can.
ability.effect:
If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:

•  When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would **Heal (3)** the target instead of rolling a dice, **Heal (6)** the target instead.
•  If the target is **KURNOTHI**, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.

ability.name: Snuggling Sickness
ability.lore: Pathologically affectionate, these Nurglites envelop their foes in near-immobilising hugs.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Each time the target uses a **RETREAT** ability, if it is in combat with this unit, roll 2D6 as a reaction and add the target’s Control characteristic to the roll. On an 8+, that **RETREAT** ability has no effect.
• The target cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.

ability.name: Chuckling Murrain
ability.lore: These cheerful Nurglites are afflicted with a minor variant of the Chortling Murrain; to be near them is to see one’s anger dissipate into snorting giggles.
ability.effect:
Your opponent must spend 1 additional **rage dice** for a unit to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability while it is in combat with this unit.

When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with this unit, each time your opponent would spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, they must spend 1 additional **rage dice**.

In both cases, that additional dice does not count towards the number of **rage dice** spent for the purposes of the ability.

ability.name: The Weeping Flux
ability.lore: These Nurglites constantly secrete liberal amounts of noxious ooze from their pores. The ‘splashback’ from landing a telling blow against them is highly injurious to health.
ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a number of dice equal to this unit’s Health characteristic. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

ability.name: Aspect of Harvestboon
ability.lore: These forest spirits are possessed of a youthful energy and vibrant enthusiasm.
ability.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth.**

ability.name: Murder Manifested
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: This unit used the 'Activate Place of Power' ability
ability.lore: This warrior can use sacrificial magics in order to summon avatars of the Bloody‐Handed God.
ability.effect:
Apply the effect below instead of the effect of that ‘Activate Place of Power’ ability.

Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. On a 2+, if there are no friendly **Avatars of Khaine** on the battlefield, set up an **Avatar of Khaine** wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that **MANIFESTATION**.

ability.name: Loyal Unto Death
ability.lore: Some amongst the sisterhood are devoutly loyal to the point of self-sacrifice.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE HERO** that has a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit’s Health characteristic to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, if this unit is within the target’s combat range when the target would be destroyed, the target is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** the target. Then, this unit is destroyed.

ability.name: Honoured Among Sects
ability.lore: This warrior is uniquely favoured by Khaine, granting them impressive abilities.
ability.effect: If this unit is **anointed**, the effect of all blessings from the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability apply to this unit as if they were **active**.

ability.name: Gem of Utorak
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Utorak created many of these crystals, each of which grants a measure, albeit fleeting, of arcane power. His censure and eradication followed swiftly after.
ability.effect:
If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it has **WIZARD (2)** until the start of your next turn.

If this unit is a **WIZARD**, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• Add D3 to casting rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Casque of Belittlement
ability.lore: The wearer of this helm hears a constant scornful voice in their ear, one that sneers at and derides them until they explode in a fit of pique.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to each roll. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Up For It
ability.lore: This gargant is loud, rowdy and absolutely ready to dish out some serious damage.
ability.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

ability.name: Master of the Swarm
ability.lore: This warlord understands the importance of numbers, ensuring their burrows are teeming with fresh warriors.
ability.effect: Each time an ability returns 1 or more slain models to a friendly **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

ability.name: Serrated Bone Protrusions
ability.lore: The jagged shards of bone that jut out from these abominations can inflict nasty injuries on careless attackers.
ability.effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Spittin' 'Un
ability.lore: This beast has specialised glands that allow it to spit corrosive saliva that can burn flesh and eat through armour. The more riled up the creature is, the greater the volume of spittle it produces.
ability.effect:
This unit is armed with the ranged weapon below, where **X** is equal to your **fury level**.

Ranged Weapon
**Caustic Saliva**
Rng: 12"
Atk: X
Hit: 4+
Wnd: 3+
Rnd: 2
Dmg: D3

ability.name: Ulguan Reactions
ability.lore: Their preternatural movements obscured, these warriors can deflect incoming blows and visit them back upon the attacker.
ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Talismans of Shadow
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SPELL, PRAYER or UNBIND ability for a unit within 3" of this unit
ability.lore: In the presence of these blessed warriors, the potency of shadow magic is amplified and beseechments to Khaine are often answered.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to that casting roll, chanting roll or unbinding roll.

ability.name: Anabolic Accelerators
ability.lore: The limbs of these mutants have been injected with a serum that promotes rapid tissue growth, giving them a monstrous – if short-lived – burst of speed.
ability.effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

ability.name: Transplanted Brains
ability.lore: The grey matter of various ‘willing’ Moulder volunteers has been grafted onto these mutants’ brains, allowing them to change their personalities in an instant.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:

***Warpstone Addict’s Brain***:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

***Warlock Whelp’s Brain***: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.

ability.name: Pennant of Azyrite Majesty
ability.lore: This banner pulses with celestial energies; to look upon it is to be either empowered by or overwhelmed by the glory of Sigmar and the heavens.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target, then you can pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn, while it is visible to this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the enemy target.
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the friendly target.

ability.name: Thickened Scales
ability.lore: This beast’s hide is so tough that blades bend upon contact and ordinary missiles simply bounce off it.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Fractured Astral Jewel
ability.lore: Touched by a spark from the Anvil of Apotheosis, this gem once released waves of fortifying energy. Now irreparably cracked, its aura has an antithetical effect.
ability.effect: If an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while it is within 6" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

ability.name: Uncaged Lightning
ability.lore: The divine lightning wrought into these warriors’ forms has become unstable; it leaps forth from them unexpectedly, usually towards those who try to escape their wrath.
ability.effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit moves or is removed from the battlefield, after that ability has been resolved, if that enemy unit is on the battlefield and not in combat with this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

ability.name: Veterans of Amberstone Watch
ability.lore: Practised at fighting cunning foes, these warriors ensure they always have the upper hand.
ability.effect:
Enemy units do not have the **STRIKE-FIRST** keyword while they are in combat with this unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *Enemy units that have* **STRIKE-LAST** *would still have* **STRIKE-LAST***; they would not be treated as having neither* **STRIKE-FIRST** *nor* **STRIKE-LAST.**

ability.name: Agonisingly Elusive
ability.lore: Sinuous and graceful, this Hedonite leaps and twirls around their opponents, inflicting delicious pain before nimbly springing out of reach.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
If it is your turn, apply the effect below. If it is your opponent’s turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below:

Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit must move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Incensed
ability.lore: By burning a mixture of tree resin and aromatic leaves, this champion envelops a key location in an eye‐stingingly pungent cloud of smoke.
ability.declare: Pick an objective within 6" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 9" from them while all models in those friendly units are contesting the target objective.

ability.name: Arcane Magnetism
ability.lore: Though they are no natural mage, something about this hero’s blood attracts errant motes of magic and renders them ripe for exploitation.
ability.effect: If this unit has 3 or more damage points, it can use a **SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **UNLIMITED** keyword and as if this unit had **WIZARD (1)**.

ability.name: Aureate Hide
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
ability.lore: This Magmadroth is revered by the Zharrgrim priesthood for its glittering scales, which evoke the divine essence of Grimnir.
ability.effect: After that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by that **FIGHT** ability, you can pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit. Give that **PRIEST** D3 ritual points.

ability.name: Intense Fyrestream
ability.lore: The potency of this beast’s scalding breath is incomparable, melting both nearby and distant foes into blackened slurry.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn:

• Add **X**" to the Range characteristic and **X** to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** ranged weapons, where X is equal to your **fury level**.

• This unit’s **Companion** ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.

ability.name: Infernal Motivators
ability.lore: The daemonic matter that powers this machine consistently provides it with feverish animation.
ability.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

ability.name: Obsession with Form
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the 'RUN' ability for this unit
ability.lore: Instead of sprinting, these warriors skip and spin their way across the battlefield with acrobatic grace.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Obsession with Pain
ability.lore: The throbbing of a fresh wound coupled with the feeling of blood trickling over their skin sends these warriors into apoplexy.
ability.effect: If this unit is damaged, spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Obsession with Control
ability.lore: Once these Hedonites have acquired the object of their desire, they simply will not relinquish it.
ability.declare: Pick an objective to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while this unit is contesting the target objective:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• Add 5 to this unit’s control score.

ability.name: Horn of the Bullfather
ability.lore: Using this dread clarion, duardin warriors and disposable lackeys across the battlefield can be sent to outflank the enemy.
ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit to be the target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **Hobgrot Vandalz** unit to be a second target.
ability.effect: Remove each target from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Chimeric Mantle
ability.lore: Crudely stitched together from the pelts and hides of myriad different creatures, this orruk’s ragged cloak causes beasts to recoil in fear.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract D3 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons while it is in combat with this unit.

ability.name: Weird Skullz
ability.lore: Originally belonging to Weirdnobs who died of ‘unknown causes’, these caved-in skulls exude Waaagh! energy that can give nearby foes pounding headaches, making it difficult for them to focus.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the target is within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the roll. On a 4+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• Subtract 1 from the target’s power level until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Immortal Ego
ability.lore: Few mortals would claim to be the mightiest slayer in the Mortal Realms or to have a peerless mastery of the blade, given the existence of gods, daemons, demigods and more besides. This unliving paragon’s ego has no such frailties.
ability.effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.

ability.name: Furious Endings
ability.lore: This being can harness the power created when Shyishan and Aqshian magics mingle, which often occurs when arcane manifestations meet their end in the Bright Realm.
ability.effect: Each time a **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit is removed from play, gain 1 **rage dice**.

ability.name: Arcane Determination
ability.lore: Their body thrumming with celestial energies, this Seraphon draws strength from nearby spell-forms in order to see the will of the Old Ones done.
ability.effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **MANIFESTATION**.

ability.name: Calm and Collected
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
ability.lore: Pure tranquillity radiates from this Seraphon, causing anger to dissipate across the battlefield.
ability.effect: Reduce your and your opponent’s **fury levels** by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players’ **fury levels** by the same amount.

ability.name: The Empty Graveyard
ability.lore: Folks tell of a cemetery where the day after a mass funeral, each newly filled burial plot was found empty, with footprints leading away from them into the wilds...
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 7" of a terrain feature or wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge. This unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.

ability.name: The Never-Dead
ability.lore: It is said that there is a rampaging band of warriors who yearn for the sweet release of death, but as punishment for transgressions past, Elder Bones refuses to let them die.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends

ability.name: Earthwrack Stabilisers
ability.lore: Large metal rods embedded in this war machine’s frame plunge deep into the earth, reducing its mobility but providing incredible stability while attacking.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it has not charged in the same turn.

ability.name: Bullfather's Scorn
ability.lore: This war machine has been stamped with infernal runes of contempt that grant immense power on command.
ability.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If each of this unit’s ranged weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, this unit’s shooting attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.

ability.name: Horn of Shattatusk
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the 'Ironjawz Waaagh!' ability and picked this unit to be the target
ability.lore: Purportedly crafted from one of the godbeast’s tusks, a blast from this horn imbues the Ironjawz’ charging beasts with the same bellicosity as their riders.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

ability.name: Fast 'Un
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: The beast lurches forward at a speed that would take anyone by surprise.
ability.effect: If this unit was not set up this turn, it can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Angry 'Un
ability.lore: Particularly irascible, this beast takes its rage out on anything that gets in its way.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: The Incarnadine Killers
ability.lore: Beware the Incarnadine Killers, for they are cursed with an insatiable lust for slaughter. Do not think that distance shall keep you safe; should you spy their bloodied forms upon the horizon one moment, their blades will be lodged in your throat the next.
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.

ability.name: Aelfskin Scroll
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 18" of this unit
ability.lore: Upon reciting the words on this unholy scroll, the aelf-soul bound to it is twisted into the perfect fuel for the foulest of magic.
ability.effect: Pick a visible friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** within 18" of this unit. After that **SPELL** ability has been resolved, that friendly **WIZARD** can use a **SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, and the casting roll for that spell is equal to the casting roll for that enemy spell. Do not count that spell towards the number of **SPELL** abilities that friendly **WIZARD** can use this phase.

ability.name: Darkflame Pendant
ability.lore: This unsettling-looking necklace wreathes the wearer in shadowy flames that see arrows lose momentum and blades dull upon impact.
ability.effect: Weapons used for attacks that target this unit have a maximum Damage characteristic of 1.

ability.name: Rune of Murder
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Tracing their fingers over the symbol etched on this stone, the bearer feels their muscles swell with fell strength. Should they smear their own blood over the rune, the power intensifies.
ability.declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, double the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.
• Add D6 to the target weapon’s Attacks characteristic for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: That Boy's not Right
ability.lore: This gargant is just plain barmy. They bellow at rocks, flap their arms like a bird and do weird little dances, all to the amusement of their bigger cousins. When the spirit of Behemat appears to answer such seemingly inane antics, that laughter is usually cut short.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, this unit can use a Prayer ability from the prayer lore you picked during army composition as if it had **PRIEST (1)**. Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, the chanting roll is 5 and cannot be modified.

ability.name: Always on Guard
ability.lore: This gargant is especially wary around their biggers and betters, for they are always expecting a quick clip on the ear from their surly bosses.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **MEGA-GARGANT**.

ability.name: Pious Veteran
ability.lore: The quiet strength of this warrior’s faith is such that tiny miracles manifest around them wherever they go.
ability.effect: Each time you pick targets while declaring a **PRAYER** ability used by a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST**, if this unit is eligible to be picked, you can pick it to be an additional target.

ability.name: Extremely Obstinate
ability.lore: Once this beast has laid claim to something, there is no shifting it.
ability.effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.

ability.name: Titanic Slam
ability.lore: Whether because of an earth-shaking charge or the swipe of a colossal tail, the enemy is thrown to the ground.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Armour Cruncher
ability.lore: The sheer heft and strength of this beast sees it crush and crumple well‐protected foes in their own armour before it even gets around to tearing into them with tooth, horn and claw.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, apply the effect below.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Chameleonic Camouflage
ability.lore: This beast’s scales are iridescent while it is mobile, but they quickly change to blend in with the environment when the creature comes to a halt.
ability.effect: While this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability in the same turn, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.

ability.name: Brand of Unbreakable Bonds
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: This brand binds those who bear it to a site of corrupted earth. As yet, none know what importance this forsaken land holds.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of an objective you control and not in combat. This unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Brand of Apoplexy
ability.lore: When those marked with this brand see red, all hell breaks loose.
ability.effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons.

ability.name: Brand of the Unaligned
ability.lore: The warriors bearing this brand are beholden to no single deity; they regularly shift their allegiance depending on which Dark God’s power is in ascendancy.
ability.effect:
Remove all of this unit’s **Pledge to Chaos** keywords. Then, pick 1 of the following **Pledge to Chaos** keywords. You cannot pick a keyword you picked for this unit earlier in the battle.

**• Pledged to Khorne**
**• Pledged to Tzeentch**
**• Pledged to Nurgle**
**• Pledged to Slaanesh**

This unit has that keyword for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Bristling Attitude
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a **CHARGE** ability for a visible unit within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: Many enemy assaults falter in the face of this general’s fiery yet determined resistance.
ability.effect: Spend any number of **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, roll **X** dice, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. For each 3+, subtract 1 from the charge roll.

ability.name: Cosmopolitan Leader
ability.lore: This veteran has trained under and alongside soldiers from all walks of life across the cities of Sigmar. Their knowledge of many different fighting styles and disciplines is a rare quality.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non‐**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice** for each target. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to wound rolls for each target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

ability.name: Fool's Cap
ability.lore: This warrior has manipulated the bones of a Mancrusher Gargant’s skeletal hand into the shape of a jester’s hat. Prancing about with it on their head ensures they acquire an audience...
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Each time the target uses a **CHARGE** ability, if possible, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of this unit.
• While the target is in combat with this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks that do not target this unit.

ability.name: Flayed Flags
ability.lore: When these mighty banners are unfurled in the name of Ushoran, foes find themselves losing heart. Mostly because they are made of rotting skin.
ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when resolving the damage sequence for enemy units contesting the target objective, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.

ability.name: Ring of Nightmarish Visions
ability.lore: This ring enhances the wearer’s delusion, twisting foes into even more hideous monsters that they attack in a rabid frenzy.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. Add 1 to each roll if this unit charged this turn. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Banner of Old Ossia
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Rally’ command for a visible **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
ability.lore: Imbued with a similar enchantment to Katakros’s personal standard, the bearer of this banner can direct the repair and reconstruction of Ossiarch warriors across the battlefield, ensuring that each cohort is at optimal strength.
ability.effect:
When resolving that command, you can spend rally points in the following additional ways:

•  For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** another visible friendly non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
•  You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Scarabaean Cloak
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: This writhing mantle is formed of thousands of osseous scarabs that can take flight as one, carrying the wearer into the air.
ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Twin-Tailed Comet of Honour
ability.lore: Bearing one of the holiest symbols of Sigmar, this medal is awarded for exemplary acts of gallantry.
ability.effect: While this unit has any champions, add 5 to this unit’s control score.

ability.name: The Living City Cross
ability.lore: Having spent many years deployed in the wilds of Ghyran, this warrior has trained their troops to use camouflage and guerrilla-style survival techniques.
ability.effect: While this unit has any champions, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Aqshian Order of Merit
ability.lore: Awarded to distinguished veterans of battle in the Realm of Fire, this medal marks out those who have protected their allies against Aqshy’s rage-inducing effects.
ability.effect: While this unit has any champions, if an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, when resolving attacks as part of that ability, on an unmodified hit roll of 6, do not inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on each unit in combat with that unit.

ability.name: Brass Flesh
ability.lore: Arrows and blades alike simply glance off the burnished, metallic skin of these warriors.
ability.effect: Unmodified save rolls of 5+ for this unit cannot fail.

ability.name: Defenders of Chivalry
ability.lore: With righteous anger, these ghouls set upon those who flout the chivalric code with bone clubs and filthy talons.
ability.effect: While your **fury level** is 7, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

ability.name: Gruesome Devourers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: Enemies struggle to escape the grasp of hungry ogors.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by a friendly **MEATFIST** unit’s combat attacks to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.

ability.name: Loyal Squires
ability.lore: These ghouls follow their holy paladins into battle, seeking to aid them however they can.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **Varghulf Courtier** to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
• Add 2 to charge rolls for this unit.
• If this unit uses a **CHARGE** ability, it must end the charge move in combat with the target.

ability.name: Fried Limbs
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: These crunchy limbs – some still clad in scraps of armour – are the perfect snack to enthuse a marauding band of Mawseekers.
ability.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
