ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 3 to charge rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

ability.name: Soulweb Gem
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: This construct bears a mastercrafted soultrap gem that has been magically bound to that of a chosen vassal. Should they fall, their animus can inhabit their subordinate’s form, usually at a safer distance from the foe.
ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it was destroyed this turn.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to this unit on the battlefield wholly within friendly territory and not in combat. Then, allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to its Health characteristic minus 1 (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

ability.name: Perpetually Empowered Weapons
ability.lore: The Mortisans have permanently imbued these constructs’ and their steeds’ weapons with deadly power.
ability.effect: This unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

ability.name: Elongated Tibias
ability.lore: These Bonereapers have considerably longer leg bones than many other constructs, allowing for greater bursts of speed on the charge.
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Utterly Unquestioning
ability.lore: The spirit-essence in these Ossiarchs’ soultrap gems is derived from the most loyal of ancient seneschals.
ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, subtract 1 from the number of **relentless discipline** points that must be spent to use that ability.

ability.name: A Choice Cut
ability.lore: The sight of this colossal slab of meat being awkwardly hefted across the battlefield inspires nearby ogors to fight through the pain – the quicker they flatten the foe, the quicker they can get to feasting.
ability.effect:
• This unit cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit each phase while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

ability.name: Rusty Grater
ability.lore: By attaching this crudely perforated metal sheet to their favoured blade, this ogor is gifted a snack of shredded flesh when they wield their weapon with enough ferocity.
ability.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

ability.name: Key to the Larder
ability.lore: This ogor has promised their favoured warriors access to one of the legendary larders in the Great Gutfort – if they are suitably impressive in battle.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

ability.name: Horn Toss
ability.lore: Dipping its head against an onrushing foe, with an effortless flick of its horns, this beast sends its attacker flying into the air.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Grumpy Alpha
ability.lore: Having established its dominance, this irascible beast can bring another member of the herd to its side with a single bellow.
ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly **OGOR MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.

ability.name: Abyssal Dweller
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Hailing from the lightless depths, this champion can manipulate the ethersea so as to plunge areas into total darkness.
ability.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while enemy units are contesting the target objective:
• Subtract the current battle round number from those units’ Move characteristic.
• Those units cannot use **RUN**, **RETREAT** or **CHARGE** abilities.

ability.name: Cursed Lineage
ability.lore: This Idoneth channels the profound despair once felt by the Cythai and reflects it back at the foe, causing soul-deep wounds.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your opponent’s **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Spoofshrooms
ability.lore: These warriors carry a large number of these light, powdery fungi, which can be hurled on the ground for a quick, bouncy getaway.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is **GITMOB**, roll D3+3 instead. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Big 'Un
ability.lore: This beast is noticeably more muscular and krumpier than others of its kind.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.

ability.name: Adherent of Kir-Nadarr
ability.lore: This Idoneth has embraced the bellicose Way of the Storm, and so too do their warriors seek to embody the surging force of destruction.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Tome of the Restless Crypts
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: This volume holds the secrets to calling forth more hungering mausoleums.
ability.effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield, set up a **Nexus of Grief** within 3" of a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

ability.name: Ethereal Fetters
ability.lore: Spectral chains erupt from this Nighthaunt’s form to temporarily shackle the souls of nearby foes, ensuring they cannot escape.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, if possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.

ability.name: Vociferous Defamers
ability.lore: These wretches denied the Great Necromancer’s arcane might; as punishment, they are beholden to Nagash’s mages.
ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit. Add 2 to casting rolls instead if this unit is also in combat with an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**.

ability.name: Backstabbing Betrayers
ability.lore: Condemned to eternal solitude for their traitorous deeds, these spectres take out their loneliness on the enemy.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is more than 12" from all other friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.

ability.name: Cowards and Deserters
ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
ability.lore: Fearful and craven in life, these gheists continue to flee from their enemies beyond the grave.
ability.effect:
After that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Add 1 to the roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Blade of the Six Smiths
ability.lore: Crafted by the demigod apprentices of the Great Maker, the strikes of this burnished weapon are truly potent.
ability.declare: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-**Companion** melee weapons to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Halve the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon (rounding up).
• Double the Damage characteristic of the target weapon.
• Attacks made with the target weapon score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 3+.

ability.name: Eternal Thrall
ability.lore: Such is this warlord’s notoriety that they have acquired something of a cult following. One of their most ardent supporters is renowned in their own right, and they bask in the adulation of this follower the most.
ability.declare: Pick another friendly non-**UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HERO** to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while the target is on the battlefield:
• If this unit is a **Necromancer**, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• If this unit is a **VAMPIRE**, add 1 to unbinding rolls for this unit.
• If this unit is **DEATHRATTLE**, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

ability.name: Ironshell Barnacles
ability.lore: Attaching themselves to hides and armour, the extra durability granted by these crustaceans is welcomed.
ability.effect:
• If this unit is **INFANTRY**, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is **CAVALRY**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is a **MONSTER**, ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for it.

ability.name: Stonefoot Anemone
ability.lore: The toxins in this creature’s sting render foes briefly immobile.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Aqshian Sea Nettles
ability.lore: Floating around their owners, these jellyfish instinctively lash out at nearby foes, causing panic and confusion.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Other enemy units cannot use **FIGHT** abilities if the target is eligible to be picked.
• If possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability does not override the* **STRIKE-FIRST** *or* **STRIKE-LAST** *constraints.*

ability.name: The Unstoppable Feast
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
ability.lore: When their blood is up and the promise of imminent butchery is in the air, Meatfist warriors become an all but overwhelming force.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEATFIST** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this battle to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability earlier in the same turn.

ability.name: Thick Blubber
ability.lore: An exemplar of their girthy kind, this ogor has a particularly thick layer of blubber that cushions their vital organs from arrows and bullets.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Indomitable Guts
ability.lore: Many, many esoteric (and ill-advised) feasts in worship of their hungry god has granted this ogor a truly prodigious resistance to damage.
ability.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Urn of Despondency
ability.lore: From this funerary urn emerge swirling spirits that feed upon negative emotions. Empowered by resentment, they become as a spectral whirlwind, speeding the bearer to new sources of suffering.
ability.effect:
Spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll **X**D6, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit and/or an enemy unit that has fewer models than its starting size.

ability.name: Lord of Space and Time
ability.lore:
Having mastered temporal manipulation, this slann can store time before bending it to their will.

This enhancement can only be given to **Slann Starmasters**.
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly **SERAPHON** units wholly within 12" of this unit that have not used a **MOVE** ability this turn to be the targets.
ability.effect:
This unit gains a number of **stored time points** equal to the number of targets picked. 
Then, if this unit has 5 or more **stored time points**, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent’s next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Blade-Limbs
ability.lore: Fashioned into living engines of destruction, these warriors have secondary limbs that end in razor-sharp blades.
ability.effect: Each time this unit is picked to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 6 for the attacks made as part of that ability, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.

ability.name: Homage and Fealty
ability.lore: Just as in the feudal days of yore, where lord and vassal made commitments to one another, so do these cannibals make similar reciprocal arrangements.
ability.declare: If this unit is a **KNIGHT**, pick a friendly **SERF** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the target. If this unit is a **SERF**, pick a friendly **KNIGHT** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to save rolls for this unit and the target while they are within 3" of and visible to each other.

ability.name: Fizzcap
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Upon eating this fungus, the ingester’s brain fizzes and pops, and an arcane conjuration bursts out of their mouth, usually with fatal effect.
ability.effect: This unit can use a **SUMMON SPELL** ability from the manifestation lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 12 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound. Then, if this unit is not **MOONCLAN**, roll a dice. On a 1-4, 1 model in this unit is automatically slain.

ability.name: Glitzy Bitz Rolla
ability.lore: The owner of this highly polished dice often rolls it to see if today is a ‘lucky’ day. Troggoths, being as dumb as a bag of hammers, are especially susceptible to the effects.
ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

If this unit is a non-**TROGGOTH** unit, add 1 to wound rolls for its attacks for the rest of the turn.

If this unit is a **TROGGOTH**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Colossal Boulder Club** to 6.
• Set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Throwin’ Boulders** to 3.
• Set the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Noxious Vomit** to 3.

ability.name: Ash-cloud Rune
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
ability.lore: The bearer of this rune can call down a column of soot that blankets the battlefield.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **INFANTRY** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Ash-beard
ability.lore: So great is this priest’s mastery of magmic energies that they smoulder eternally with Grimnir’s power.
ability.effect: If this unit is not a **PRIEST**, they have **PRIEST (1)**. If this unit was already a **PRIEST**, add 1 to this unit’s chanting rolls.

ability.name: The Quarry
ability.lore: Karanak's hunt is eternal, for there is no end to those who offend Khorne's creed.
ability.effect: If no enemy units are the **quarry**, pick an enemy unit to be the **quarry** (you can pick an enemy unit in reserve).

ability.name: Overpowering Mass
ability.lore: It is said that this absolute goliath of an ogor has some gargant blood in their veins. No one’s stupid enough to argue the point.
ability.effect: When making meaty charge rolls for this unit, you can re-roll unmodified rolls of 1.

ability.name: Tenebrous Aura
ability.lore: The darkling nature of these sistren is so unsettling that foes find themselves utterly transfixed... and ultimately vulnerable.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

ability.name: Gluttonous Conquerors
ability.lore: At the command of their Overtyrant Morga, the Meatfist aim to establish a great ogor empire – and they believe that domination is best proved by bone-crunching violence.
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Control characteristic of friendly **MEATFIST** units while they are in combat.

ability.name: Snott, Gnoblar Thief
ability.lore: Said to be a descendant (don’t ask…) of the legendary Head Honcho of Skrappa Spill, the gnoblar Snott is a skilled pickpocket. His talents for purloining enemy gewgaws even in the press of battle amuses Morga the Mighty, and so her spawn and chieftains have to put up with him hanging around.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** that has any artefacts of power to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or lower than the current battle round number, the target no longer has any artefacts of power.

ability.name: Overflowing Larder
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: This faithful Mawseeker is never seen without a wide collection of mystical, grotesque ‘offerings’ ready to contribute to the feast.
ability.effect: Gain D6 **raw ingredients**. If this unit is a **Feastmaster**, gain D3+3 **raw ingredients** instead.

ability.name: Further the Great Plan
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: As the battle unfolds, so do the machinations of the Old Ones.
ability.declare:
You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick an **ASTERISM** that you have prophesied. You cannot pick an **ASTERISM** that you have previously picked this battle. If you do not meet the condition below that corresponds to that Asterism, this ability has no effect.

***Itzl the Tamer:*** 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed.

***Quetzl the Preserver:*** There are no enemy units wholly within friendly territory.

***Sotek the Deliverer:*** The enemy general is in combat or has been destroyed.

***Tepok the Seer:*** There are any friendly **SLANN** units on the battlefield and no friendly **SLANN** units are in combat or have been destroyed.
ability.effect: Pick an **ASTERISM** ability to be prophesied. Its effects apply in addition to those of all other prophesied **ASTERISM** abilities.

ability.name: Sneaky Sneakin'
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Cloying swamp-mists mask the Kruleboyz’ movements.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit that has 10 or fewer models, is not in combat and has not been the target of a **DIRTY TRICK** ability this turn to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Deploy Regiment
ability.lore: A mighty hero leads their retinue into battle.
ability.declare: Pick a **regiment** from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been **deployed**.
ability.effect: Keep using **DEPLOY** abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been **deployed**. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those **DEPLOY** abilities.

ability.name: Essence of the Gnaw
ability.lore: A cursed combination of warpstone and daemonic power allows this rodent to twist reality.
ability.declare: Pick another visible friendly **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit and in combat to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** and the target has **STRIKE-LAST**.

ability.name: The Prince in the Mirror
ability.lore: It is said that all mirrors are enthralled by Sigvald’s beauty. Should he fall, they readily allow his soul back to the field.
ability.declare: If the friendly **Sigvald** has been destroyed, pick him to be the target. He can be replaced even if he is a replacement unit.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly **Contorted Epitome** and not in combat.

ability.name: Force of Savage Personality
ability.lore: Such is the fell and bellicose reputation of this ogor that it is said that even the power of magic doesn’t dare draw too close to them.
ability.effect: Enemy units and enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Trapper's Arsenal
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: Having run with the Beastclaw for a time – perhaps even being sired by one – this ogor maintains a collection of vicious-looking snaptraps to hobble and waylay their enemies.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Damned Vessel
ability.lore: With a wretched wail, a gheist's will is temporarily eclipsed as Nagash channels his power through their ragged shape.
ability.effect: Whenever you declare a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **Nagash** within 18" of this unit, you can measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from this unit instead of that **Nagash**.

ability.name: Eat 'Em Alive
ability.lore: For ogors, there is no real distinction between fighting and feasting.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability that targeted a unit, excluding **FACTION TERRAIN**, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
ability.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly **OGOR** unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.

• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.

• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non‑**Companion** weapons.

• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.

• ***Crunchy Bones***: That unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**. If that unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** instead.

• ***Slick Innards***: That unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

• ***Mystery Meat***: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.

**Designer’s Note**: *Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*

ability.name: Greedy Chompers
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
ability.lore: A Meatfist ogor won’t miss an opportunity to take a bite from warm flesh.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **MEATFIST** units that are in combat to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is equal to the roll.

ability.name: Wallwrecker
ability.lore: Their enemies see a defensive fortification; this bulky Tyrant sees a minor impediment.
ability.effect: Your general can pass across terrain features as if they had **FLY**.

ability.name: Bull Charge
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.lore: The bulk and surprising speed of ogors can see them trample right over enemies.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect:
Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.

After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a **GUTBUSTERS** unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile‑in move.

**Designer’s Note**: *Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*

ability.name: Jaws of the Beast
ability.lore: Beastclaw ogors are inevitably skilled hunters and trackers.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-**HERO** unit in that **HERO**'s regiment that has not been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **tracking the prey**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Closing the Jaws
ability.lore: The chieftains of the Beastclaw signal when it is time to strike.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is **tracking the prey**.
ability.effect: Set up that **HERO** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is **tracking the prey** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that **HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Leave Not a Morsel
ability.lore: If it’s eaten, so says this ogor, then it stays eaten.
ability.effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.

ability.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
ability.lore: Terrifying tales cross the frontiers of the atrocities perpetrated by this ogor; their shadow looms large both literally and psychologically.
ability.effect:
Ignore negative modifiers to:

• This unit’s control score.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s non‑**Companion** attacks.
• Charge rolls for this unit.
• The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.

ability.name: The Crusherguts
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: An ogor who has mastered the Crusherguts – an ancient and feared belly flop technique – has weedier enemies at their mercy.
ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Carvalox Hide
ability.lore: Carvalox are colossal birds of prey found in the arctic regions of Ghur. They are favoured quarry of ogor Hunters, for their meat can be used to barter with the Yhetee clans while their feathered hides offer protection from magic.
ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**. It also has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

ability.name: Mantle of Entrails
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: This crown of guts, sinew and burned flesh was ‘woven’ by a vision-wracked Butcher over three restless nights. It is horrific to look upon, instilling a terror that seems to reach right into the beholder’s bowels.
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

ability.name: Tasty Morsels
ability.lore: Ogors hate wasting even a scrap of meat. Any foes they do not gobble down on the spot are hacked to pieces and saved for the Butcher’s pot.
ability.effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly **Mawpit**’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

ability.name: Prime Gutserver
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: This general has fed entire armies to the Mawpits.
ability.effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly **Mawpit**, gain 1 **tasty morsel**.

ability.name: Bloodthirsty Arrogance
ability.lore: Meatfist warriors take their status as the pre-eminent mawtribe seriously. Any who actually manage to hurt them are marked for grisly vengeance.
ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets a friendly **MEATFIST INFANTRY** unit that did not charge in the same turn, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Fleshy Stampede
ability.lore: The Meatfist do not care much for strategy or tactics; they charge headlong at their foes and trust in raw strength to sort things out.
ability.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for friendly **MEATFIST** units.

ability.name: Meaty Charge
ability.lore: The Meatfist win their battles through the most straightforward means. They have learned to harness the sheer bulk of their massed ogor warriors better than any other tribe, trampling their adversaries in a series of crushing charges
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MEATFIST** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this phase to be the target.
ability.effect: Make a meaty charge roll by rolling a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll made this turn for the unit using this ability. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability has more models than the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Rusty Leadbelcher Gun
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.lore: While many of the Meatfist abandoned their blastpowder cannons at the urging of the Mawseekers, this chieftain couldn’t let go of their faithful weapon. Its lethality has not dimmed…
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect:
Pick to load the gun with **Jagged Shrapnel** or **Lumpen Metal** **Scrap**, then apply the corresponding effect below:

***Jagged Shrapnel:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models were slain by that mortal damage, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

***Lumpen Metal Scrap:*** Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: A Clan of Hunters
ability.lore: Keepers of the ‘old ways’, the ogors of a Beastclaw clan are expert trackers, relentlessly running their prey to the ground.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Hunters with Sabrefangs** unit to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can use the ‘Through the Frosts’ ability even if another friendly **Hunters with Sabrefangs** unit has used that ability this battle.

ability.name: Grasp of the Everwinter
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: To wage war against an alfrostun is to battle the brutality of winter itself.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly **ALFROSTUN** units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Run 'Em Down
ability.lore: Beastclaw ogors relish the thrill of the chase. Enemies can flee, but for not long…
ability.effect:
Each time an enemy unit in combat with a friendly **ALFROSTUN** unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *This mortal damage is in addition to any mortal damage inflicted on that enemy unit by that* **RETREAT** *ability.*

ability.name: Fearsome Breed
ability.lore: The monsters of a Beastclaw alfrostun are creatures born of winter; they shake the earth with each step and attract the fiercest ice storms, leaving enemies rattled and disoriented.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of a friendly **ALFROSTUN MONSTER**. Subtract 2 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of a friendly **ALFROSTUN MONSTER** instead.

ability.name: Hard-Bitten Chieftain
ability.lore: As tough as old frozen meat, with ice running through their veins: such is how this venerable ogor warlord is described, and with good reason.
ability.effect: Other than the **Companion** ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit made by enemy units that charged in the same turn have no effect.

ability.name: Alvagr Rune-Tokens
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.lore: Said to be fashioned from ice chipped from the flanks of mighty Mount Alvagr, these charms – carved with Svoringar runes – deepen an ogor’s connection to the ancient ice.
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to chanting rolls for friendly **ALFROSTUN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Prepare the Feast
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.lore: The role of Feastmaster is a sacred one amongst the gollops, as it is this ogor who oversees the ravenous rites and doles out the latest creations of the maw-shamans.
ability.effect: If there is no friendly **Feastmaster** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GOLLOP HERO** to be the **Feastmaster** for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Ooh, That Looks Tasty...
ability.lore: As a gollop slaughters its way through its enemies, the ogors collect up tasty-looking morsels to gorge upon.
ability.effect:
Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, you gain a number of **raw ingredients**.

The number of **raw ingredients** yielded by a destroyed unit is the Health characteristic of that unit multiplied by the number of starting models in that unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *If a destroyed enemy unit had a Health characteristic of 2 and its starting size was 10 models, it would yield 20 raw ingredients when it was destroyed.*

ability.name: Gland Goulash
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.lore: Though the Butchers swear by the magical properties these glands give their creations, no one truly knows where they come from. For the best, really…
ability.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, when making casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

ability.name: Bone-Slurry Soup
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
ability.lore: This revitalising gruel is a favourite of ogor whelps; it brings a pang of nostalgia to any Mawseeker who eats it, numbing the pain of their wounds.
ability.declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.
ability.effect: **HEAL (D6)** each friendly **GOLLOP** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

ability.name: The Organ Platter
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.lore: To properly prepare a heaving platter of organs – some of which still seem to be pulsing with life – is a coup for any Feastmaster, and one that sees their followers struck with a divine mania.
ability.declare: Spend 20 **raw ingredients**.
ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feastmaster**, melee weapons used by friendly **GOLLOP** units have **Crit (Mortal)**.

ability.name: Gore-Offal Dumplings
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.lore: These small, dripping tangles of gut-meat are difficult to prepare and bless correctly. When eaten, though, they grant faithful ogors a surprise burst of energy.
ability.declare: Spend 10 **raw ingredients**.
ability.effect: Each friendly **GOLLOP** unit that is wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster** can immediately use a **CHARGE** ability as if it were your charge phase, but subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making the charge roll for that unit.

ability.name: Unwashed Innards
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
ability.lore: The ‘earthy’ flavour of these raw entrails fills ogors who consume them with vigour.
ability.declare: Spend 5 **raw ingredients**.
ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 4 to run rolls for friendly **GOLLOP** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to a friendly **Feastmaster**.

ability.name: Gristlegobbler
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.lore: This Tyrant’s appetite is renowned as voracious even for an ogor.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with your general to be the targets.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target. Then, **Heal (3)** your general.

ability.name: Along the Icepaths
ability.lore: Okar is a hoary old frost-mystic, whose connection with the wild elements allows him to open swift paths through fierce snowstorms.
ability.declare: Pick the **Huskard on Stonehorn** in this Regiment of Renown to chant this prayer, pick up to 3 visible friendly units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a chanting roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if the friendly **Thundertusk Beastriders** unit in this Regiment of Renown is wholly within 12" of this unit.
ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
•  Add 3 to run rolls for each target.
•  Each target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
•  Each time a target uses a **RETREAT** ability, no mortal damage is inflicted on it.

ability.name: Cling on Tight
ability.lore: If he judges it to be the will of winter, Okar will allow his ally’s troops to hitch a ride on a Thundertusk under his command.
ability.effect: Each time the **Thundertusk Beastriders** unit in this Regiment of Renown uses the ‘Plough the Icepath’ ability, you can pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of that **Thundertusk Beastriders** unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target instead of a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit.

ability.name: The Horns Hit Home
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.lore: Urrgar’s favourite tactic is to wait for the moment in battle when the arrival of his Maulerguts can have the bloodiest and most impressive impact.
ability.declare: Pick each friendly unit that is **preparing a flank attack** to be the targets.
ability.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of each other, wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: More Ogors, My Lord
ability.lore: Just when the enemy thinks they’ve stemmed the tide, heavy stomps and bellowing voices mark the arrival of more Gutbusters…
ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield so that every model is within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Scoff Down Fresh Flesh
ability.lore: Gutbusters are always thinking with their stomach; battle is a feast that only increases their eagerness to fight.
ability.declare: If an enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to use this ability.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly unit for the rest of the battle:

• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Add 1 to hit rolls for that unit’s combat attacks if it charged in the same turn.
• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks.
• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 3 to that unit’s control score.

ability.name: Brutish Barging
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
ability.lore: Charging ogors can shove most obstacles aside without slowing.
ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to be the target.
ability.effect: The target can move up to 2D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of that move but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Blinding Dust Clouds
ability.lore: The advance of armoured ogor warriors kicks up clouds of dust and grit that can obscure them from even the keenest eyes.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units that were set up in the same turn.

ability.name: Deathcheater
ability.lore: Despite being a loner by nature, this Tyrant seems to lead a charmed life.
ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (6+)** while they are more than 3" from all other friendly units.

ability.name: Lungburster
ability.lore: There’s nary an ogor in the land who can’t hear this Tyrant’s bellowed commands.
ability.effect: When making run rolls for friendly units wholly within 9" of your general, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.

ability.name: Frenzied Hunters
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
ability.lore: Desperate to sate their hunger, the Gorgers emerge from the darkness.
ability.effect: Set up this unit within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Wot? No Meat!?
ability.lore: The thought of an empty cooking pot is nigh heretical to a Butcher. Fortunately, battle provides them ample opportunities to fill it.
ability.effect: Your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron starts the battle **empty**.

ability.name: Chuck 'Em in the Pot
ability.lore: To a Butcher and their followers, any meat is good meat.
ability.declare: You must use this ability if an enemy unit was destroyed this turn.
ability.effect: Your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron becomes **full**.

ability.name: Dish Testers
ability.lore: These ogors are accompanying a Butcher who is experimenting with a new recipe. Those who provide the ingredients get to sample it.
ability.declare: If your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron is **full**, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target.
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn. Then, your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron becomes **empty**.

ability.name: Eager Procurers
ability.lore: There is no sight more blasphemous to a Mawseeker than an empty cookpot; the very thought sees them stomp forwards with bloody purpose.
ability.effect: While your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron is **empty**, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of your general.

ability.name: Generous Portions
ability.lore: No one can accuse this Butcher of being miserly with their ritual broths.
ability.effect: If your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron is **full**, **Heal (1)** each visible friendly unit wholly within 9" of your general.

ability.name: Hunger Pangs
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Movement Phase
ability.lore: These ogors have not eaten well for days – and this Butcher has made it clear that they expect more devotion…
ability.effect: Each friendly unit that is not in combat can move up to D3". Friendly units that are not in combat and are wholly within 9" of your general while their Butcher’s Cauldron is **empty** can move up to D6" instead. They cannot end those moves in combat.

ability.name: Ruthless Overseer
ability.lore: The magnates and warlords in service to Urak Taar are hungry to distinguish themselves and demand faultless discipline.
ability.effect: Each time a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

ability.name: Masked by the Endless White
ability.lore: When Beastclaw ogors gather in number, ice storms and hail shards swirl with savage vigour, obscuring the hunters from sight.
ability.effect: Friendly **ALFROSTUN** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" away.

ability.name: We'll Be There - If The Pay's Right
ability.lore: The Maulerguts arrive to battle in their own time – but no paymaster has ever been able to fault their savage efficacy…
ability.declare: Pick each unit in this Regiment of Renown to be the targets if none of them have been deployed.
ability.effect: Set up the targets in reserve **preparing a flank attack**. They have now been deployed.

ability.name: Trophy Rack
ability.lore: These gruesome trophies prove that an ogor has lived up to their many boasts, encouraging their tribemates to follow their lead.
ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:

• ***Squeezed Head***: **Anti‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**

• ***Smashed City Rubble***: **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**

• ***Torn Appendages***: **Anti‑CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**

ability.name: Disgusting Eater
ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a **CHARGE** ability for a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit.
ability.lore: This Butcher encourages eating habits so vile to behold that they can bring anyone up short.
ability.effect: Subtract D3 from the charge roll. If your general’s Butcher’s Cauldron is **full**, you can subtract 3 from the charge roll instead, but if you do so, their Butcher’s Cauldron becomes **empty** after that **CHARGE** ability has been resolved.

battle_formation_rule.name: Disciplined Hekatoi
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Crafted with specially selected soul-stuff from skilled officers, the Hekatoi of this legion exhibit an unusual degree of battlefield initiative.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
• The target’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Realm-chompers
battle_formation_rule.lore: The dokks and bosses of these orruks have devoured so many beast spirits that magical essence is devoured by their warpaint.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units while they are within the combat range of any friendly **BONESPLITTERZ HEROES.**

battle_formation_rule.name: Spiteful Dusk
battle_formation_rule.lore: Within the creeping darkness of Everdusk lurk hate-filled spites that seek every opportunity to hinder the foe’s efforts to coordinate their attack.
battle_formation_rule.effect: The first time each phase an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** uses a command, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after that command has been resolved. If that command was a reaction, instead inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit after the ability that command was a reaction to has been resolved.

battle_formation_rule.name: Postprandial Warfare
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Having slurped up their fallen enemies’ innards and picked their bones clean, these ogors rejoin the battle in search of their next repast.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** units that were in combat this turn with an enemy unit that was destroyed this turn to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Return 1 slain model to each target unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Lofty Louts
battle_formation_rule.lore: Whether because they insist that they are ‘just a bit taller’ or because they are simply insufferable bullies, these Mancrusher Gargants have an authority over the other Footsloggas that is close to absolute. So long as no one bigger is around, of course.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **Mancrusher Gargant** unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **GARGANT** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target and not wholly within 12" of any friendly **MEGA-GARGANT** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Final Frenzy
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: While in a state of ritualistic frenzy, not even a mortal wound can prevent a Khainite from spilling blood.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit contesting an objective to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.

battle_formation_rule.name: Strike as One
battle_formation_rule.lore: Symmetry is fundamental to aelven nature and culture. These warriors exemplify the concept, fighting in awe-inspiring synchrony.
battle_formation_rule.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units instead of 1. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

battle_formation_rule.name: Sorcerers of War
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These champions of Tzeentch bring the fires of change directly to their god’s foes, revelling in the infinite fractals of fate that spiral from the madness of a melee.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** that is in combat to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: The target can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, but only the caster or enemy units in combat with the caster can be picked to be the targets of that **SPELL** ability.

battle_formation_rule.name: Memories of the Fallen
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: As the spirit-song resounds with the memories of the recently slain, the Sylvaneth are driven to a vengeful fury.
battle_formation_rule.declare: For each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be a target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Arch-Despoilers
battle_formation_rule.lore: The rampaging creatures of the beastherds despise all aspects of civilisation, and they will tear down monuments with their bare hands if necessary.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

battle_formation_rule.name: Bloodgreed
battle_formation_rule.lore: Those beastmen in the throes of the bloodgreed who sate their cursed hunger for flesh are all but impossible to put down.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick each friendly **WARHERD** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: **Heal (3)** each target.

battle_formation_rule.name: Tide of Savagery
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Since Korghos Khul’s ascension to daemonhood, the Goretide are filled with renewed purpose, rushing into battle with ever greater vigour.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND HERO** and up to 2 other friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that are wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 2" to the targets’ Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Walk the Hidden Paths
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Sylvaneth can draw upon the magic of the Wyldwoods to open hidden passageways across the battlefield.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within 12" a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of another friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** and more than 9" from all enemies.

battle_formation_rule.name: More Stuff For Me Collection
battle_formation_rule.lore: These gargants are avaricious hoarders who love collecting all kinds of baubles and artefacts – even ones that are too small for them to use.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE SONS OF BEHEMAT HERO** that does not have an artefact of power.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from ‘Titanic Trophies’.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

battle_formation_rule.name: Wisdom of the Deep
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Isharann are born with a talent for harnessing arcane forces. This power is only amplified when these aelves convene an Isharann Council and head to war.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **ISHARANN** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **ISHARANN** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Bulwark of Molten Stone
battle_formation_rule.lore: Shrouded in the shimmering heat of the forge-temple, the Forge Brethren direct their magmapikes to form blazing  barricades of lava with sustained volleys of fire, before returning to blasting their enemies to ash.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within friendly territory.

battle_formation_rule.name: The Breath of Khaine
battle_formation_rule.lore: A blood-red mist billows across the battlefield, obscuring those Khainites consecrating ground in the Bloody‑Handed One’s name.
battle_formation_rule.effect: While each model in a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ancient Bloodlines
battle_formation_rule.lore: Among the most elite formations of the Fyreslayers are the mighty Scales of Vulcatrix. The proud and majestic Magmadroths in this formation are as venerated as those of their lodge’s royal family.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly **MAGMADROTH** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Git and Run
battle_formation_rule.lore: Even as Gitmob grots flee, they won’t turn down a prime opportunity for a stabbing.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **GITMOB** unit that is in combat to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with that **GITMOB** unit to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.
battle_formation_rule.effect: If you picked a target, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

battle_formation_rule.name: Like Snapping Hounds
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: When a noble commences a hunt, packs of serfs are sent ahead of the royal houses to savage prey out of hiding.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick each friendly **SERFS** unit in combat to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
•  Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Unholy Site
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Some gravesites have witnessed such horrors that the death magic suffusing them makes them even more difficult to cleanse of the undead’s influence.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: The target has **WARD (4+)** until the start of your next turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Prodigy of Excess
battle_formation_rule.lore: A narcissistic monstrosity, this follower of the Dark Prince possesses a grotesque surfeit of hedonistic qualities that inspire craven envy in their followers.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO** that has an artefact of power to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Give the target a heroic trait from the ‘Figureheads of the Dark Prince’ or ‘Hedonistic Obsessions’ tables.

**Designer’s Note**: *This heroic trait is given to the target during the deployment phase, not during army composition*.

battle_formation_rule.name: Krule Mockery
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These orruks have perfected the art of hurling biting insults at the enemy to taunt them and lure them into hidden traps.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the **Insult Hurla**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability and does not end that move closer to the **Insult Hurla** than it was at the start of that move, inflict D6 mortal damage on the target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

battle_formation_rule.name: Butchers of Nations
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON unit
battle_formation_rule.lore: When the daemonic hosts of Khorne join their Bloodbound followers in battle, they crush all before them in a storm of gore-splattered carnage.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Pick a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

battle_formation_rule.name: Claw-picked
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Stormvermin and Clanrats of a Verminus Claw‑horde are amongst the most ferocious of all ratmen.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VERMINUS** units that charged this turn to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Skryre Prototypes
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The fell contraptions wielded by these ratmen were created by the Clans Skryre’s most ingenious weaponsmiths.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **SKRYRE** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 -** ***Kaboom!***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**2-5 - *More Power!***
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

**6 - *More-more Power!***
In addition to the effect of ‘More Power!’, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: The Speed of Death
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Many vampires are capable of swiftly traversing nearly any terrain by assuming a different form or through the application of the sheer bestial strength and agility granted them by their curse.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY VAMPIRE HERO** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: The target can move up to 12" and has **FLY** when it does so. It cannot end that move in combat.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ferocious Predators
battle_formation_rule.lore: With the aid of the Embailors, the Akhelian Beastmasters are able to turn oceanic carnivores into truly terrifying weapons of war.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **AKHELIAN** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Raise the Banners
battle_formation_rule.lore: When an abhorrant royal family and their courtiers mass, many loyal knights and serfs inevitably follow.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time another ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit that is not in combat, after that ability has been resolved, if that unit is a **SERFS** unit, you can return 1 additional slain model to it, and if it is a **KNIGHTS** unit, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

battle_formation_rule.name: The Blessing of the Chalice
battle_formation_rule.lore: Eager to earn favour with their masters, the heroes compete to earn honourable trophies for their court.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** if they have destroyed a unit this battle.

battle_formation_rule.name: Cycle of the Storm
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Masters of the Reforging process, the most experienced members of the Sacrosanct chambers can focus their power to restore mortally wounded comrades before they are called back to Azyr, allowing them to continue the fight at hand.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER** unit that had models slain in this turn to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Cometh the Hour
battle_formation_rule.lore: As moment of preordained glory, these warriors attack with renewed zeal.
battle_formation_rule.effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Horror Unending
battle_formation_rule.lore: The never-ending waves of deathly minions summoned by a Legion of Shyish shatter all hopes of victory for those who stand against them.
battle_formation_rule.effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.

battle_formation_rule.name: Plentiful Bone
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Guarded supply lines provide this force with near-limitless bone reserves, allowing for swift repair of damaged constructs.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 visible friendly non-**FLY OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic equal to or less than the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Devotees of Ruin
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Though the Darkoath do not know the true significance of the Dark Gods’ runes, when armour-clad warriors bearing those same sigils arrive in their lands, these visitors are often hailed as divine crusaders sent to save them.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit. Then, pick up to 2 visible friendly **DARKOATH** units that do not have a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword and are wholly within 12" of that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the targets have the same **Pledge to Chaos** keyword as that **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Spirit of Gork
battle_formation_rule.lore: The roiling Waaagh! energy that emanates from the Weirdfist shamans fills nearby Ironjawz with the fighting spirit and hardiness of Gork.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Bouncing Fury
battle_formation_rule.lore: A veritable tide of vicious, impossibly hungry, fang-toothed monsters boing into enemy lines, biting, chewing and swallowing their victims whole.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time a friendly **SQUIG** unit charges, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Fang-filled Gobs**, **Massive Fang-filled** **Gobs** or **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: We'z Da Beastiest
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Boarboys of the Snaga Rukks love smashing into startled enemies, but having hunted the greatest of beasts, are no strangers themselves to being barrelled into by stampeding monsters.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **BONESPLITTERZ CAVALRY** units have **Anti-CHARGE (+1 Rend)**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Wardens of the Wolf
battle_formation_rule.lore: The might of Ulfenkarn marches forth from the shattered city, its graves emptied to bolster the tides of endless dead, as the howls of feral vampires echo across the battlefield.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time 1 or more slain models are returned to a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** or **BEASTS** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **Belladamma Volga, Radukar the Wolf, Radukar the Beast, Ivya Volga, Lady Annika, Kritza, Torgillius the Chamberlain, Gorslav the Gravekeeper or Watch Captain Halgrim**, add 1 to the number of slain models returned to that unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ancient Spirits
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The aelementor spirits that accompany this host are venerable indeed. They have weathered the march of aeons; they will not yield to the petty aggression of short-lived mortals.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS MONSTER** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of the target.

battle_formation_rule.name: Grim Sentinels
battle_formation_rule.lore: The borders of the Ossiarch Empire stretch across continents in every Mortal Realm, and they are ever expanding ...
battle_formation_rule.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ded Sneaky
battle_formation_rule.lore: Comprised of hobgrots and ‘yoofs’, the ladz of the Light Finga are in charge of ‘nikkin’ stuff and are skilled at sneaking up on the enemy.
battle_formation_rule.effect: You can use the ‘Sneaky Sneakin'’ **DIRTY TRICK** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Paragons of Darkness
battle_formation_rule.lore: Those who have long walked the Path to Glory and bear the scars and mutations to prove it are some of the most dangerous warriors in all the Mortal Realms.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-**MONSTER SLAVES TO DARKNESS HEROES**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Hideous Unpredictability
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Tzeentch’s strange blessings allow his malformed servants to outmanoeuvre and outflank their prey.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ironclad Onslaught
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: When a Chaos horde is on the march, the realms tremble. Hundreds of heavily armoured warriors desecrate all in their path as they roar oaths to the Dark Pantheon.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Place a **defiled token** next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly **defiled token**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: There Is No Escape
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Death Stalkers are spectral killers that relentlessly hunt down a chosen enemy. They are constantly on the move in pursuit of their quarry and nigh impossible to pin down.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• The target can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if it has used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

battle_formation_rule.name: Martial Pride and Stubborn Will
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Lords of the Lodge burn with a rage tempered by sacred oaths of war.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **FYRESLAYERS HEROES**. In addition, the control scores of **FYRESLAYERS HEROES** cannot be modified by enemy abilities.

battle_formation_rule.name: Squint-eye Taktiks
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Whether down to luck, feverishly launched volleys or the simple act of squinting one eye to ‘aim proppa’, this rukk’s Arrowboys have developed a knack for hitting targets where it hurts.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **Savage Orruk Arrowboys** units that target the target unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

battle_formation_rule.name: Vengeance of Azyr
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: The celestite weapons carried by the warriors of a Sunclaw Starhost are supercharged with the power of Azyr.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **SAURUS** or **KROXIGOR** units that are in combat to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.

• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Higher Purpose
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: These aelves fight with a purity of purpose that sees them fight on even in the face of the most horrendous carnage, heedless of their losses.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Return D3 slain models to each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Sound the Charge
battle_formation_rule.lore: Those foolish enough to stand before the cannibal courts’ knights are inevitably trampled beneath claw and foot.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **KNIGHTS** that charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES.**

battle_formation_rule.name: Denizens of the Garden
battle_formation_rule.lore: The beasts that dwell deep in Nurgle’s Garden carry the most virulent diseases.
battle_formation_rule.effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
battle_formation_rule.lore: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Synchronised Strikes
battle_formation_rule.lore: The core of a Thunderhead Host is often made up of fighters from the Warrior chambers; having trained relentlessly with the sworn brethren of their Stormhost, they operate like a well-oiled cogfort.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-**HERO** non-**BEAST STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that do not have the **WARRIOR CHAMBER** keyword.

battle_formation_rule.name: Greedy for Souls
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: A Nexus of Grief’s bricks fly apart and its metal rails extend outwards like a grasping claw, dragging it ever nearer to living, breathing victims.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target has a Move characteristic of 3". It can immediately move up to 3" and can move into combat but cannot end that move on a terrain feature or within 3" of an objective.

battle_formation_rule.name: Mightiest Destroyers
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Wherever the Megabosses lead from the front lines, the Ironjawz surge forward as an unstoppable tide of green muscle and heavy armour plates.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
If there are any friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.

If there are no friendly **Megabosses** on the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target when using the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability.

battle_formation_rule.name: Oncoming Storm
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: First to the fight, the Lightning Echelon is akin to a spear-thrust into the heart of the enemy. Deployed only in times of great need, they smash into the foe’s vanguard with the force of an oncoming tempest.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** unit that charged this turn.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Petrify
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The screams and wails of this procession's bloodthirsty champions are so terrifying that their foes often become rooted in place, ripe for the slaughter.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with the target.

battle_formation_rule.name: 'Ere We Come!
battle_formation_rule.lore: Once a grunta stampede gets going and the hogs are all riled up, there are few forces in the realms with the power to halt its momentum.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **MAW-GRUNTA** units, to a maximum of +4.

battle_formation_rule.name: Smog and Smoke
battle_formation_rule.lore: The heavy exhaust fumes billowing from the Helsmiths’ war machines envelops their warriors in an obscuring, pollutant-laden smoke.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINE.**

battle_formation_rule.name: Berserk Kindred
battle_formation_rule.lore: Filled with the fierce fighting spirit of Grimnir, the Warrior Kinband hurls itself at the foe. In their fury, they wield their glinting fyresteel axes so quickly that they appear as a blazing blur.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** units that charged in the same turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Rally The Tribes
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
