battle_formation_rule.lore: One of the horde’s commanders looses a terrifying battle cry, calling more of their blade-sworn warriors to their side.
battle_formation_rule.declare: If there is a friendly **DARKOATH HERO** on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**HERO** non‑**UNIQUE DARKOATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 3" from all enemy units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for an anointed unit
battle_formation_rule.lore: This sacrament calls for the anointed champion and their followers to commit murder of the most violent kind.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within that anointed unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.

battle_formation_rule.name: Vanish and Reappear
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These mercurial spirits are feared for their ability to dissolve into nothingness before suddenly reappearing elsewhere - often right behind their next targets' backs.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.

battle_formation_rule.name: Extra Rappel Anchors
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Grundstok Gunhaulers in this force have been fitted with extra ports to which privateers can tether themselves in order to hitch a ride in battle.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers** can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Kharadron Overlords Battle Traits).

battle_formation_rule.name: Entrenched Crews
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Arkanauts in this fleet are no strangers to ground-based combat. Once in position, they will make clever use of the terrain to stymie the attacks of the foe.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Arkanaut Company** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Lethal Rancour
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The gheists of this horde are drawn from haughty nobles and obsequious courtiers who refused to admit fault even at the very end. They rail constantly at their kingdom's doom, and their undying bitterness renders their spectral touch even more deadly against those they perceive as interlopers.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Strike! Hur Hur!
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These gargants are particularly enthusiastic participants of the game of Manskittles: seeing how many pipsqueaks they can knock down or squish by hurling bits of the landscape... or its inhabitants.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **MEGA-GARGANT** units within 3" of any terrain features and pick any friendly **GARGANT** units within 3" of any terrain features to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of each target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn. If the target has no ranged weapons, pick an enemy unit within 12" of the target instead and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Tireless Conquerors
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Bloodbound surge across the battlefield with blades held high, salivating and baying as they rip the enemy from their strongholds.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

battle_formation_rule.name: Blood In The Water
battle_formation_rule.lore: As the gore of the slain diffuses through the ethersea, ancient predators are drawn to battle.
battle_formation_rule.declare: If any friendly or enemy units were destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **Akhelian Allopex** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Extra Snappy
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The enterprising Gitmob grots of this tribe have equipped their Snarlfangs with sunmetal tooth-caps that absorb Hyshian magic as they pelt towards the foe, giving them a nasty bite indeed.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **GITMOB** units that charged this turn to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by the targets for the rest of turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Fixated on Feeding
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Once they have sighted a potential meal, it is nigh impossible to stop these ever-ravenous ogors from consuming their prize.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If it ended that move in combat, the target has charged

battle_formation_rule.name: Inevitable Ending
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: It is the duty of some simply to die, for their lifeblood will grease the ever‑turning cogs of fate.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.

battle_formation_rule.name: United in Darkness
battle_formation_rule.lore: The myriad forces of Chaos march to war under a common cause, led by warlords who have put aside their rivalries in the name of laying waste to the lands of a shared foe.
battle_formation_rule.effect: While there is at least 1 friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS HERO** and 1 other friendly **DAEMON HERO** or **DARKOATH HERO** on the battlefield, add 2 to the control scores of friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units while they are contesting an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

battle_formation_rule.name: Drawn to Carnage
battle_formation_rule.lore: Nothing can stop the thunderous onset of a Brass Stampede once it has begun to gain momentum.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add **X** to charge rolls for friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** units, where **X** is the number of friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY** or **MONSTER** units that have already charged this phase and that are wholly within 12" of the unit being rolled for.

battle_formation_rule.name: Eager Killers
battle_formation_rule.lore: Khorne's daemons care only for violence; any moment spent not slaying is a moment wasted.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit that has used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is not in combat can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

battle_formation_rule.name: Surge Forward
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Namarti are the lowest caste in Idoneth society, but when formed into a Namarti Corps and led to battle by their Akhelian masters, they strike swiftly and with devastating effect.
battle_formation_rule.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Nimble and Quick
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The skink warriors of a Shadowstrike Starhost outmanoeuvre their enemies at every turn.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **SKINK INFANTRY** or **SKINK CAVALRY** units that are not in combat to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each target can move D6". Each target cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

battle_formation_rule.name: Vectors of Contagion
battle_formation_rule.lore: These Nurglites are empowered by the presence of plague daemons.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 5 to the control scores of friendly non-**HERO ROTBRINGERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Far-killa Bolts
battle_formation_rule.lore: The many Deffspikerz of the Middul Finger often keep a limited supply of bolts fletched with bog-shryke feathers, which give their shots that extra bit of distance when needed.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man‑skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast-skewer** **Killbow** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.

battle_formation_rule.name: Twist of Fate
battle_formation_rule.lore: Those who dwell within the Silver Towers are suffused by an aura of fate‑altering magic.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Graceful Elusion
battle_formation_rule.lore: Years of combat in the gladiatorial arenas of the temple-cities have honed the survival skills of these aelves to near perfection.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units have **WARD (5+)** until they have used a **FIGHT** ability.

battle_formation_rule.name: Kill-Kill! Scurry-Flee!
battle_formation_rule.lore: A kill-pack has one purpose: slay the target. Once this goal has been achieved and the element of surprise lost, the Eshin agents must see to their own survival…
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the battle, if the target has been destroyed, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **ESHIN** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Overwhelming Hordes
battle_formation_rule.lore: As masses of crazed ghouls drag their foes to the ground, the horror and anger of the victims’ allies shifts into a disorienting delusion that leaves them paralysed by indecision.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that did not charge this turn and is in combat to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that **SERFS** unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Duff Up Da Big Thing
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The ladz get ready to bash some uppity git who thinks that being bigger than an orruk gives them some kind of advantage.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has a Health characteristic greater than its own.

battle_formation_rule.name: Corrupted Earth
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Clans Pestilens are relentless in advancing the spread of plague and corruption.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **PESTILENS** units that are in combat to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Special Procurement
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Endrineers Guild often charter expeditionary forces equipped with the most advanced inventions in the realms.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** that does not have an artefact of power. The target can be in reserve.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from the ‘Inventions of the Sky-ports’ or the ‘Ingenious Innovations.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*

battle_formation_rule.name: Trick of the Light
battle_formation_rule.lore: These Lumineth have journeyed to the far reaches of Hysh. The wild magic of that region has found purchase in them, occasionally surrounding them with prismatic distortions and mirages that confuse nearby foes as to their precise location.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if they have not charged this turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Bloody Competitors
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Where the mortal followers and daemons of Khorne fight next to one another, they compete to reap the most skulls in the name of their grim deity.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit and a friendly non-**HERO BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the targets are wholly within 12" of each other, add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ancient Aura
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Storm-charged energy ebbs and flows around the warriors of the Ruination chamber, surrounding them in a scouring aura of power. Finding purchase with a weapon on these ancient heroes can be a difficult task for even the mightiest of mortal foes.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit.
battle_formation_rule.effect: That unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Gritty Fortune-hunters
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Vongrim guilders in this expedition have almost depleted their current reserves of aether-gold. Their very existence depends on the success of this venture, and they’ll be damned if anyone tries to cheat them of their imminent windfall!
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** and **Vongrim Salvagers** units have **WARD** **(6+)** while they are contesting an objective.

battle_formation_rule.name: Tireless Trackers
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Brutal Rukks move at a relentless pace when hunting prey, appearing suddenly and giving the enemy no time in which to prepare.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Half the friendly non-**HERO BONESPLITTERZ INFANTRY** units on the battlefield (rounding up) can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

battle_formation_rule.name: Smashin' and Bashin'
battle_formation_rule.lore: The orruks of an Ironfist won’t be outdone by each other – when one mob duffs up the enemy, it inspires others to show them how to do it properly!
battle_formation_rule.effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **FIGHT** ability used by a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Filth-laden Daemonic Blooms
battle_formation_rule.lore: Nurgle’s influence has spread far and wide, invigorating his daemonic followers.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time you make a run roll for a friendly non-**MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit, you can change that roll to a 4.

battle_formation_rule.name: Prized Creations
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Moulder warbeasts are studded with warpstone crystals and pumped full of vile serums that spur their battle-rage – at the occasional cost of overtaxing their forms.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**HERO MOULDER** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Roll a dice for each target and apply the corresponding effect:

**1-2 - *Self-destructive Fury***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**3-4 - *Rabid Infusion***
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

**5-6 -** ***Blinded by Frenzy***
In addition to the effect of ‘Rabid Infusion’, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Grots Upon Grots
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: The lurking presence of the Moonclans and their constant, nerve-fraying cackling makes it difficult for the enemy to focus on their battle plans.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**SQUIG MOONCLAN** unit that is contesting an objective to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the control score of the target unit for each model in that unit that is not contesting any objectives.

battle_formation_rule.name: Feral Ruin
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: A Daemon Prince’s unholy radiance draws to them the most savage of chaotic creatures, abominations against nature that hunger to spill blood.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **Daemon Prince** to use this ability. Then, pick a visible non-**DAEMON** non-**UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Remove any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords the target has. Then, the target gains any **PLEDGE TO CHAOS** keywords this unit has.

battle_formation_rule.name: Natural Disaster
battle_formation_rule.lore: A mass of heavily armoured orruks and their bulky beasts of war, an Ironjawz Brawl hits the enemy line like a landslide if it gains enough momentum, leaving a trail of carnage and blazing ruin in its wake.
battle_formation_rule.effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**HERO IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Nadirite Wedge
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: As the attacking speartip of the Ossiarch legions drive home their charge, enemy defences quail and then shatter outright.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Meanest Beasts
battle_formation_rule.lore: The warbeasts ridden by the orruks of the Trophy Finga are particularly foul and belligerent specimens of their kind.
battle_formation_rule.effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Outflank The Enemy
battle_formation_rule.lore: Used to living on the periphery of society, these Idoneth are expert at blending into the shadows and using hidden paths to traverse the battlefield.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
While a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit if it has not charged this turn.
• Add 2" to the Move characteristic of that unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Fiends of the Wilds
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a friendly BRAYHERD unit
battle_formation_rule.lore: To the blasting of brayhorns come the roaming brayherds, stampeding from all directions to tear the enemy asunder.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Change one of the dice in the charge roll to a 4.

battle_formation_rule.name: Besieging Bulk
battle_formation_rule.lore: When a group of Mega-Gargants take to battle together, they are able to use each other’s enormous bulk to shelter themselves from harm.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **MEGA-GARGANTS** have **WARD (6+)** while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **MEGA-GARGANTS**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Arcane Focus
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Scinari mages in this host have collectively dedicated their lives to studying the magics of the realms.
battle_formation_rule.effect: **SPELL** abilities from the Lore of Hysh or the Lore of the Awakened Realms used by friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** **WIZARDS** have the **UNLIMITED** keyword. However, you cannot pick the same unit to be the target of the same **SPELL** ability in the same turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Backstabbing Allies
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly SKAVEN unit
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Skaven often form uneasy alliances between clans, but none of them want to suffer the brunt of the fighting when the enemy draws near.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKAVEN** units that are not in combat and are wholly within 13" of the unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command to be the targets. Each target must have at least one of the following keywords: **VERMINUS**, **SKRYRE**, **MOULDER**, **PESTILENS**, **ESHIN**. After that ‘Redeploy’ command has been resolved, each of the targets can immediately use the ‘Redeploy’ command in an order of your choice without any command points being spent.

battle_formation_rule.name: Unfaltering Pace
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **RUN** ability for a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit
battle_formation_rule.lore: The soldiers of the Ossiarch legions neither rest nor tire; their expansions are limited only to the availability of osseous matter with which to create fresh soldiers.
battle_formation_rule.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

battle_formation_rule.name: Plague Progenitor
battle_formation_rule.lore: Simply to be in the presence of this unwitting pathogen incubator is to see one’s body ravaged by disease.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be the **plague progenitor** for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Roll 2D3. On a 6, or if the roll equals or exceeds the **plague progenitor**’s Health characteristic, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.

In the first battle round, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to a **DISEASED plague progenitor**, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

Each time the **plague progenitor** is picked to be the target of the ‘Spread’ effect of the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within its combat range, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, in addition to the effect of that ability.

battle_formation_rule.name: Fade Like Mist
battle_formation_rule.lore: The Soul-raid Ambushers are experts in hit-and-run tactics, riding the currents of the ethersea to strike the foe from new directions.
battle_formation_rule.effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.

battle_formation_rule.name: Blades of Eternal Rust
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The weapons of these Nighthaunt constantly shed flakes of spectral rust that cause whatever physical substance they come to rest upon to corrode in moments.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Indulge, My Pretties
battle_formation_rule.lore: Abhorrants often toss their pet monstrosities choice cuts of flesh, resulting in a burst of strength and ferocity.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
While a friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTER** or **BEAST** is wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**:

•  That non-**HERO** unit can use a **RAMPAGE** ability on its warscroll even if that ability has already been used by another friendly **MONSTER** in the same turn.
•  If that non-**HERO** unit charged in the same turn and the unmodified charge roll was 9+, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Swamp Shroud
battle_formation_rule.lore: Before the warriors of a Kruleboyz Klaw strike, the shamans enact a mighty ritual to smother the battlefield in a thick, stinky mist that conceals them from the enemy.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.

battle_formation_rule.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Hordes of shambling Deadwalker Zombies flow around and over their victims like a rotten tide, bearing them to the ground through sheer weight of numbers before tearing them limb from limb.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEADWALKERS** units in combat to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Spreading Loonacy
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: When the worshippers of the Bad Moon gather, the energies of the Gloomspite surge through them like a tide, sending them frothing mad.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non‑**SQUIG MOONCLAN** or **SPIDERFANG** units in combat to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For each target:

• Make a pile-in move with the target.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: Amassed Legions
battle_formation_rule.lore: The hosts of the ziggurats march to conquer and claim, advancing into verdant lands and leaving them barren.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit with 3 **daemonic power points** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

battle_formation_rule.name: Scaly Monstrosities
battle_formation_rule.lore: The great beasts of the Seraphon are almost invincible when they march forth as a pack.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly **SERAPHON MONSTER** units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Fear of the Deepwoods
battle_formation_rule.lore: The flitting shadows of lurking spites and the cruel laughter of these malicious Sylvaneth instil paranoia in the enemy; clearly they are not welcome in this place.
battle_formation_rule.effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a **HERO** in their army’.

battle_formation_rule.name: Aristocracy of the Night
battle_formation_rule.lore: These vampires are expected to excel in all martial and mystical disciplines.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **VAMPIRE** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VAMPIRE** units that charged in the same turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Nature's Titans
battle_formation_rule.lore: The eldest beings of the glades are so saturated with the life-giving magic of Ghyran that their wounds swiftly gum up with sticky sap and seal over with knotted barkflesh.
battle_formation_rule.effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for **MONSTER** targets. Instead, **Heal (3)** each of those targets.

battle_formation_rule.name: Front-Line Leader
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The officars of this army are the stuff of Dawnbringer legend, hard-bitten veterans that stand with the troops through thick and thin. Their exemplary behaviour and courage inspires their soldiers to fight all the harder when the going gets tough.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO** to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly non-**HERO** **HUMAN INFANTRY** unit and up to 1 friendly **HUMAN WAR MACHINE** unit that are wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that **HERO**, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target **INFANTRY** unit’s melee weapons and the target **WAR MACHINE** unit’s ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Sacred Quarry
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: There can be no hunt without a quarry. Once the followers of Kurnoth have marked the enemy’s commander, they will stop at nothing until its blood stains their spears and claws.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **WARMASTER**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Experimental Munitions
battle_formation_rule.lore: In trying to control Chaos, duardin engineers have crafted all manner of eldritch ammunition for their war machines. In doing so, they have given the power of ruin even more destructive outlets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Heretic's Bane
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Enemy Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Hot blood pours from the eyes and mouths of any who dare counter the Khainites’ divine works with those of their own.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** on the battlefield to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Herd Healing
battle_formation_rule.lore: When troggoths gather in larger numbers, the sheer troggness of the herd serves as a catalyst for their regenerative abilities.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time a friendly **TROGGOTH** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** that unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Symbiotic Madness
battle_formation_rule.lore: Arcanites who battle alongside the daemons of their manipulative deity receive maddening glimpses of the twisting strands of fate, allowing them to take advantage of fleeting gaps in their foes’ defences in the press of combat.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Friendly **ARCANITE** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit.

battle_formation_rule.name: Bulls of the Ziggurat
battle_formation_rule.lore: When unleashed, those warriors and constructs shaped in Hashut’s image are relentless.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** and **MONSTER** units while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Peerless Manoeuvres
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These warriors are the precision weapon of the God-King, skilled at manipulating a battlefield in their favour by feinting from view and reappearing where they are needed most.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** unit that did not use a **MOVE** ability this turn and is not in combat.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Canny Crews
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The crews of these Great Cannons are so well trained they often fire the perfect shot, blasting off the heads of monsters or mowing down ranks of the enemy.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Ironweld Great Cannon** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.

battle_formation_rule.name: Arcane Dominance
battle_formation_rule.lore: Despite all that its pursuit costs them, the sorcerers of the ziggurats are ever lusting for greater power.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARDS** and **PRIESTS** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.

battle_formation_rule.name: Dominion Hexes
battle_formation_rule.lore: The armour of these Helsmiths has been imbued by the Daemonsmiths with hexes of subjugation that weaken the resolve of those who seek to stand in their way.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Double the Health characteristic of friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units for the purposes of the ‘Power Through’ command.


**Designer’s Note:** *The effect of this ability applies both when you use ‘Power Through’ and when your opponent uses ‘Power Through’.*

battle_formation_rule.name: Silent Empire
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: To invade the Ossiarch Empire is to enter a realm of doleful columns, grim architecture and deathly silence.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.

battle_formation_rule.name: Gangin' Up
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These orruks like to overwhelm their enemies with a flurry of strikes from all directions interspersed with sneaky stabs and low blows.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target. That unit must be in combat with an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit. **Kragnos** cannot be picked to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

battle_formation_rule.name: Ecstatic Revellers
battle_formation_rule.lore: The thrill of piercing the lands of their enemies like a hot needle through flesh gives strength to these avaricious revellers.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SYBARITE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly outside friendly territory.

battle_formation_rule.name: Revel in War
battle_formation_rule.lore: These boisterous gargants launch themselves into enemy lines, revelling in crushing the puny pipsqueaks below their feet.
battle_formation_rule.effect: You can pick 2 friendly **MEGA‑GARGANTS** or **GARGANT** units that have not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use the ‘Jump Up and Down’ ability instead of 1.

battle_formation_rule.name: Will of the Horned Rat
battle_formation_rule.lore: Although they tower over the rest of the swarm, Verminlords are as craven and cunning as any Skaven – in truth even more so – and will readily use their underlings as fodder to protect their own hides.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
While a friendly **SKAVEN DAEMON** is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:

• That **SKAVEN DAEMON** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **SKAVEN DAEMON**, allocate 1 mortal damage on a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within that unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved. (ward rolls cannot be made for these damage points).

battle_formation_rule.name: Big Mouth
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a friendly MEGA-GARGANT
battle_formation_rule.lore: Mancrusher Gargants are used to being bossed around by the colossal Mega-Gargants. The orders they are given usually boil down to ‘hit that thing’ or ‘squish them ones there’.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Pick a friendly **GARGANT** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

battle_formation_rule.name: Raging Storm
battle_formation_rule.lore: Lightning arcs down to the battlefield, imbuing the Thunderscorn with renewed vigour and smiting their enemies with lethal crackling energy.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick each friendly **THUNDERSCORN** unit on the battlefield to be the friendly targets, then pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly **THUNDERSCORN** units to be the enemy targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: **Heal (1)** each friendly target. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy target, if any. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.

battle_formation_rule.name: To the Last
battle_formation_rule.lore: Determined to safeguard all that they cherish, the Sigmarites charge into battle to reinforce wavering battlelines.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each time a friendly unit that is **under orders** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

battle_formation_rule.name: Throngs of the Faithful
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a FIGHT ability
battle_formation_rule.lore: All that remains in these Sigmarites’ hearts is a burning desire for vengeance against the reavers who slaughtered their loved ones.
battle_formation_rule.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SIGMARITE** units that target the enemy unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

battle_formation_rule.name: Masters of the Arcane
battle_formation_rule.lore: The battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane might be intimidating and occasionally aloof, but their sorcery perfectly supplements a fighting formation.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **WIZARDS** that are **under orders**.

**Designer's Note:** **WIZARDS** *in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.*

battle_formation_rule.name: Dawnbringer Crusade
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Pouring forth from the Cities of Sigmar, the Dawnbringer Crusades seek to reconquer and reconsecrate the Mortal Realms in the name of the God-King.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

battle_formation_rule.name: Godly Spoor
battle_formation_rule.lore: The merest trace of Slaanesh’s divine power sees these Hedonites hurtling along at pace.
battle_formation_rule.effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Amidst the Phantasmagoria
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Shooting Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: Where these revellers travel, their divine ecstasy breaks down the nature of reality; everything becomes as a twisted dream, through which the devotees of pain dance without warning.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_formation_rule.name: Prowling Predators
battle_formation_rule.lore: Ogors are surprisingly skilful trackers; they surround their prey, carefully avoiding retribution before striking with terrible savagery.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Celestial Translocation
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: In a flash of starlight, an Eternal Starhost arrives to enact the will of the Old Ones. Tapping into the celestial power that surrounds the slann, they teleport across the battlefield to catch the foe off guard.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON** unit wholly within 12" of a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to use this ability.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_formation_rule.name: I've Seen Worse and Killed Better
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: The duardin who battle for the Cities of Sigmar are as gruff and critical as they are loyal, courageous and bold. Little can move them once their mind is set or their feet planted.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: In Search of Sin
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Numbness dogging their heels, these Hedonites are always seeking new thrills.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move.

battle_formation_rule.name: Smash and Grab
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battle_formation_rule.lore: These rampaging ogor raiders crash through the enemy lines without stopping, always seeking more to eat and loot.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.

battle_formation_rule.name: Have No Mercy
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
battle_formation_rule.lore: Their mistress’s commands echoing in their minds, the aelves of the Darkling Covens are compelled to murder the foe with pitiless efficiency, their dark-hearted kin joining them in the slaughter.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF** units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

battle_formation_rule.name: Sadistic Tendencies
battle_formation_rule.lore: These Hedonites have given themselves to pleasures of the flesh – or rather, of torturing said flesh without limit.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit’s melee weapons.

battle_formation_rule.name: Feast of Bloodshed
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Monstrous by nature, ogors are never more energised than when tearing meat and guzzling down gore.
battle_formation_rule.declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.
battle_formation_rule.effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

battle_formation_rule.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
battle_formation_rule.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battle_formation_rule.lore: Guts roiling with a divine hunger, these fanatical ogors relish gulping down revitalising blood and offal.
battle_formation_rule.declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.
battle_formation_rule.effect: **Heal** (**D3**) each target.

battlepack.name: General's Handbook 2024-25
battlepack.description: The Mortal Realms have been wounded. Warpflame irrevocably scours the land, and those places not stripped to nothingness are overrun with starving rodents. Many are claiming a new era has been ushered in – the Second Age of Chaos. Only leaders with unshakeable hearts can hope to reunite these people fractured by fear.

battlepack.name: General's Handbook 2025-26
battlepack.description: Across the densely wooded isle of Neos, potent nexuses of life magic pulse. Armies now gather to battle under those vibrant boughs, slipping along hidden paths and seizing sites of Ghyranite power to preserve or turn to their own ends.

battlepack.name: General's Handbook 2026-27
battlepack.description: War spreads across the Great Parch of Aqshy like an unstoppable inferno. Skaven swarm out from the twisted hellscape of the Gnaw, eager to corrupt and despoil. The lands that border the Heartblood Sea are subjected to near-constant raids from blood-crazed killers, whilst the smoke from corpse-fires and ruined war engines rises over the Snow Peaks.

battle_tactic_card.name: Scouting Force
battle_tactic_card.lore: Focused tactics and small formations are key to triumph under the dense canopies of Neos.
battle_tactic_card.rulesText: At the start of the battle, pick each friendly non-**HERO INFANTRY** and non-**HERO CAVALRY** unit that was not set up in reserve using a Deploy ability to become a **scout** unit. You cannot complete these battle tactics with scout units that are in combat. Replacement units that replace scout units are also scout units.

battle_tactic_card.name: Master The Paths
battle_tactic_card.lore: The verdant innards of Neos resist the stamp of armies and conquerors. To slip along those paths takes woodsmen of great skill.

battle_tactic_card.name: Wrathful Cycles
battle_tactic_card.lore: Even in joyous Neos, nature can change without warning. Embody its mercilessness as you turn the tide.

battle_tactic_card.name: Intercept and Recover
battle_tactic_card.lore: There are many who would thieve Neos’s life-giving relics. Recover them – either for noble purposes or in furtherance of darker goals…
battle_tactic_card.rulesText:
•  If an ability would remove a unit that was carrying treasure from the battlefield and that unit is not set up again as part of the same ability (e.g. ‘Dark Apotheosis’ or ‘Red Ruin’), before removing that unit from the battlefield, your opponent must give the treasure it was carrying to another one of their units that does not have a Ghyranite treasure within 3" of that unit. If this is not possible, that unit counts as having been destroyed for the purpose of this battle tactics card.

• At the start of the battle, your opponent must pick 3 of their units on the battlefield to be carrying a Ghyranite Treasure. They cannot pick faction terrain features or **MANIFESTATIONS**. A unit can only carry 1 Ghyranite Treasure. If your opponent has fewer than 3 units on the battlefield, you automatically complete a number of these battle tactics, starting with the **Domination** battle tactic (followed by the **Strike** and then the **Affray**) until the number of remaining uncompleted battle tactics equals the number of enemy units on the battlefield.

• If you went second in the previous battle round and choose to go first in the current battle round, your opponent can remove 1 Ghyranite Treasure from one of their units at the start of the battle round.

battle_tactic_card.name: Attuned to Ghyran
battle_tactic_card.lore: The air of Neos is strangely febrile, as if the will of the realm crackles there. One could heed it, perhaps…

battle_tactic_card.name: Restless Energy
battle_tactic_card.lore: Do not rest upon your laurels. Expand. Grow. Conquer.

battle_tactic_card.name: Burning for Vengeance
battle_tactic_card.lore: The enemy’s outrages merit brutal punishment. Track them down and run them to ground.
battle_tactic_card.rulesText: At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, pick an enemy **HERO** on the battlefield or in reserve to be the **fugitive** for the rest of the battle.

battle_tactic_card.name: Blazing Onslaught
battle_tactic_card.lore: Ushered in with smoke and fire, the battle for control of a vital holdout begins in earnest.
battle_tactic_card.rulesText: At the start of the battle, after using all Deployment Phase abilities but before determining which player will take the first turn, your opponent must pick 1 non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature within their territory to be their **hideout**. The **hideout** cannot be removed from the battlefield at any point during the battle.

battle_tactic_card.name: Siege of Ashes
battle_tactic_card.lore: You have manned a stronghold barring the enemy’s path and will defend it to the death.

battle_tactic_card.name: Flanking Firestorm
battle_tactic_card.lore: The plan is simple: outflank and surround the enemy, and make sure not one of them escapes alive.

battle_tactic_card.name: Legend of the Parch
battle_tactic_card.lore: As raging fire and death threatens to consume all, a hero will arise and a legend will be born.

battle_tactic_card.name: Smokescreen
battle_tactic_card.lore: Draw the foe in by feigning weakness, concealing your true strength amidst the smoke of battle until the right moment.

battle_tactic.name: Daring Resurgence
battle_tactic.lore: Life always fights to endure. Draw upon that vitality now.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you are the underdog this battle round, there is at least 1 friendly unit on the battlefield and at least half of the friendly units on the battlefield (rounding up) used a **FIGHT** ability this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Stolen Seedpod
battle_tactic.lore: Plucked from the branches of one of the towering trees of Neos, this seed contains a core of raw potential.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if at least 1 enemy unit carrying a Ghyranite Treasure has been destroyed this battle.

battle_tactic.name: Envelop and Strangle
battle_tactic.lore: Ensure no corner of the Neosian undergrowth is beyond your reach.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if at least 3 different friendly units are each wholly within 9" of a different corner of the battlefield and only 1 of those corners is wholly within friendly territory. No more than 1 of those units can have been set up this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Invasive Species
battle_tactic.lore: Reach your vines and tendrils deep into the territory of the opposition.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control every objective that can be controlled within enemy territory. If there are no objectives within enemy territory, you complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control every objective that was controlled by your opponent at the start of your turn.

battle_tactic.name: Fey Strikes
battle_tactic.lore: Slip in and out of the melee like the cackling spites of the deep woods.
battle_tactic.rulesText:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if all the following are true:
• At least 2 friendly units moved as part of a **RETREAT** ability this turn. Those units are **lure** units.
• At least 2 other friendly units charged this turn and at least 1 of those units ended the charge move in combat with an enemy unit from which any lure **units** retreated.

battle_tactic.name: Master of Strategy
battle_tactic.lore: Victory blooms from victory, growing greater by the moment.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there is a different friendly unit wholly within each large quarter of the battlefield, you control more objectives than your opponent, and there are no enemy units contesting any objectives that you control.

battle_tactic.name: Seize The Paths
battle_tactic.lore: Open tunnels through the foliage are a vital boon. Force the enemy from them.
battle_tactic.rulesText:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are more friendly units in neutral territory than enemy units.

If there is no neutral territory in the battleplan you are playing, you complete this tactic at the end of your turn if there are no enemy units within friendly territory.

battle_tactic.name: All Roots Entwined
battle_tactic.lore: The cycle will only achieve its true potential when it is brought under your rule.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control every objective that can be controlled on the battlefield.

battle_tactic.name: Bold Explorers
battle_tactic.lore: Only the brave will plunge deep into the ever-seething heart of Neos.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 3 or more objectives or non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain features that you control, in any combination, are being contested by any friendly scout units. Those objectives and terrain features must be within enemy territory.

battle_tactic.name: Defiant Surge
battle_tactic.lore: Use the invigoration that floods you to overwhelm the enemy.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control more objectives than your opponent.

battle_tactic.name: Ley Line Taproot
battle_tactic.lore: Pulsing with the power of the ley lines, this root glows with the power to work wonders – or horrors.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if at least 3 enemy units carrying a Ghyranite Treasure have been destroyed this battle.

battle_tactic.name: Purification Rites
battle_tactic.lore: New birth sometimes demands a matching price in death…
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are no enemy units within friendly territory and no enemy units within neutral territory.

battle_tactic.name: Courageous Adventurers
battle_tactic.lore: The depths of the forest hold many secrets. Make sure they are yours.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if a friendly scout unit that was not set up this turn is contesting a non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature that you control, that is wholly within enemy territory, and that is more than 6" from friendly territory.

battle_tactic.name: Cut Off The Head
battle_tactic.lore: Fall upon the leaders of the foe without warning.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy **HERO** has been destroyed this battle.

battle_tactic.name: Sacred Centrality
battle_tactic.lore: Assemble at the heart of the field, as the druids once did around their holy henges.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are at least 2 friendly units within 3" of the centre of the battlefield that are not in combat.

battle_tactic.name: Water With Blood
battle_tactic.lore: Sometimes, red must help the green to flourish.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective that was controlled by your opponent at the start of your turn.

battle_tactic.name: Raiding Party
battle_tactic.lore: Ensure the foe knows you will brave their domains.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 3 or more friendly scout units wholly outside friendly territory.

battle_tactic.name: Contraband Aqua Ghyranis
battle_tactic.lore: The Oakenbrow zealously guard Neos’s many springs of Aqua Ghyranis, but their gaze cannot be everywhere…
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if at least 2 enemy units carrying a Ghyranite Treasure have been destroyed this battle.

battle_tactic.name: Master of Arms
battle_tactic.lore: A successful invasion requires skill in all aspects of war.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if the same enemy unit had at least 1 damage point allocated to it in 3 different phases this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Break Their Defences
battle_tactic.lore: The enemy cannot hide away for long…
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control the enemy **hideout**.

battle_tactic.name: No Survivors
battle_tactic.lore: Ensure that the only tales told of this battle are tales of your victory.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more enemy units were destroyed this turn and you control the enemy **hideout**.

battle_tactic.name: Form a Wall
battle_tactic.lore: A good defence begins with solid foundations.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units are wholly outside friendly territory, wholly within 6" of friendly territory and within 3" of each other.

battle_tactic.name: Outpost Resupply
battle_tactic.lore: A general must be precise as to where and when they assign reinforcements.
battle_tactic.rulesText:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective within enemy territory and that objective is contested by:
• At least 1 friendly unit that did not use a **MOVE** ability this turn
• At least 1 other friendly unit that charged this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Repel the Attackers
battle_tactic.lore: Unleash the fury within and scour the enemy from the field.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 3 or more friendly units within 3" of the centre of the battlefield that are not in combat.

battle_tactic.name: Surround the Enemy
battle_tactic.lore: Encircle the foe as the flames of a conflagration encircle the doomed.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more friendly units that were not set up this turn are each within 9" of a different corner of the battlefield and wholly outside friendly territory.

battle_tactic.name: Claim What's Yours
battle_tactic.lore: These lands are yours; force the enemy from them.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are more friendly units within enemy territory than enemy units and there is at least 1 friendly **HERO** wholly within enemy territory.

battle_tactic.name: Keep the Enemy Close
battle_tactic.lore: Keep your motives concealed and the enemy unaware of their role in your plans.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective that is contested by at least 1 enemy unit.

battle_tactic.name: Feign Weakness
battle_tactic.lore: Allowing the foe to have small victories keeps them distracted from the task at hand.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if more friendly units were destroyed this turn than enemy units.

battle_tactic.name: Execute the Plan
battle_tactic.lore: Bring your plan to fruition and watch as the enemy army goes down in flames.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control each objective within enemy territory.

battle_tactic.name: Search Every Inch
battle_tactic.lore: Whether lava field, ash-plain or humid jungle, leave no corner unexplored.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there is a different friendly unit wholly within each large quarter of the battlefield, those friendly units are more than 9" from the centre of the battlefield, and no more than 1 of those friendly units was set up this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Quick Pursuit
battle_tactic.lore: Having been spotted, time is running out for the fugitive.
battle_tactic.rulesText:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
•There are 3 or more friendly units that are not in combat and are within 12" of the enemy **fugitive**.
•There is no enemy **fugitive** on the battlefield.

battle_tactic.name: Bring Them In
battle_tactic.lore: Dead or alive, the fugitive will pay for their actions.
battle_tactic.rulesText:
You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 1 of the following is true:
• There are 3 or more friendly units in combat with the enemy **fugitive**.
• There is no enemy **fugitive** on the battlefield and 3 or more friendly units are contesting the same objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

battle_tactic.name: Daring Rescue
battle_tactic.lore: The most respected warriors are those who willingly aid their allies.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if an enemy unit that was in combat at the start of the turn was destroyed by a combat attack made by a friendly unit that charged this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Ambuscade
battle_tactic.lore: Send forth skirmishers to lie in wait for the enemy.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if 2 or more objectives or non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain features that you control, in any combination, are each contested by a different friendly unit that is more than 6" from friendly territory and was not set up this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Command From the Front
battle_tactic.lore: Commanders must work in tandem to fuel the machine of war.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if there are 2 or more friendly **HEROES** on the battlefield, all friendly **HEROES** are within 9" of a visible enemy unit and no friendly **HEROES** were slain this turn.

battle_tactic.name: Hero of Legend
battle_tactic.lore: To complete a grand quest is to see one’s name go down in the annals of history.
battle_tactic.rulesText: You complete this battle tactic at the end of your turn if you control an objective wholly outside your territory that you did not control at the start of the turn and a friendly **HERO** is contesting that objective.

lore_ability.name: Pressure of the Deep
lore_ability.lore: The wizard enfolds their victims in a shimmering bubble of crushing force.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Light of Chotec
lore_ability.lore: The wizard calls upon the sun god Chotec to energise an injured warrior with rays of invigorating solar magics.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SERAPHON** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 4+, **Heal (1)** the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Wildfire Taurus
lore_ability.lore: Wisps of flame develop into a roaring, charging beast of black smoke and wildfire.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wildfire Taurus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Wildfire Taurus** wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Final Act of Violence
lore_ability.lore: The spat invectives of this priest inspire their faithful to slaughter to their last breath.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Transformed to Spawn
lore_ability.lore: Tzeentch is the Changer of the Ways; to be in the presence of his minions risks being mutated into a Chaos Spawn.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain by this ability, you can pick a friendly **CHAOS SPAWN OF TZEENTCH** unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
lore_ability.lore: Mortisans imbue the Bonereapers' blades with deadly power, acting in concert to increase the weapons' lethality to truly fearsome levels.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
The target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If all of the target's non-**Companion** melee weapons had **Crit (2 Hits)** when they were picked to be the target of this ability, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.

Friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units can be affected by this ability multiple times.

lore_ability.name: Deranged Transformation
lore_ability.lore: The spellcaster causes the limbs of nearby ghouls to bulge and lengthen, allowing them to charge forwards at a furious pace and imbuing them with greater strength.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

lore_ability.name: Unstoppable Waaagh!-beats
lore_ability.lore: Warchanter’s manic percussion spreads a frenzy to their Gorkish and Morkish mates.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG WAAAGH! PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO BIG WAAAGH! INFANTRY** unit that is in combat and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Lava Storm
lore_ability.lore: The skies above burn a polluted red as globs of black lava are called to rain onto the enemy.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST PRIEST** to chant this prayer. Pick an enemy unit to be the target and roll 6 dice. For each 6, pick an additional enemy unit to be a target. Then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, pick an additional enemy unit to be a target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
lore_ability.lore: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.

lore_ability.name: Gitspeed
lore_ability.lore: Rubbing a bit of scavenged sunmetal between his clammy palms and spitting a curse that causes his tongue to sizzle, the caster imbues nearby Gitz with a dose of sneaky swiftness.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-**TROGGOTH GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

lore_ability.name: Gift of Disease
lore_ability.lore: The priest licks an oozing sore, savouring the tangy flavour of a ripe contagion, before coughing a phlegmy litany that wreathes them and their allies in a pain-inuring ague.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with the chanter. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, each enemy unit in combat with the chanter, excluding **MANIFESTATIONS** and terrain features, has the **DISEASED** keyword.

lore_ability.name: Lightning Blast
lore_ability.lore: The wizard releases pent-up storm energy into the foe, the tang of ozone and the stench of charred flesh filling the air as their enemies are burned and blasted by crackling arcs of lightning.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then pick the closest visible enemy unit to them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. If 2 or more visible enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Ravening Direflock
lore_ability.lore: Dark feathers borne on the wind coalesce to form the terrible shapes of the Ravening Direflock.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Ravening Direflock** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Ravening Direflock** wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Ravening Direflock** has 3 parts that must each be set up within 1" of at least 1 other part.

lore_ability.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
lore_ability.lore: Drawn from the twilight demi-realm between Hysh and Ulgu, the Geminids lash out with the raw magic of light and shadow, scouring flesh while filling minds with horrific lies and unbearable truths.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Geminids of Uhl-Gysh** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Geminids of Uhl-Gysh** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Mystical Unforging
lore_ability.lore: The magic of unmaking flies from the wizard’s outstretched hands.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Regal Authority
lore_ability.lore: Halos of lightning surround the wizard’s allies, casting them as resplendent and terrifying paragons of war.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Eldritch Strength
lore_ability.lore: The caster imbues their minions with supernatural might.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHANGE-CULT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
lore_ability.lore: Sweeping suddenly into existence like a reaper’s blade, the Aethervoid Pendulum cuts through armour, flesh and even the fabric of the realms themselves.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Aethervoid Pendulum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Aethervoid Pendulum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Dance of Doom
lore_ability.lore: The priest exhorts their followers to launch themselves into the fray and cut down the enemy in a display of lethal acrobatics.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, the target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Bladewind
lore_ability.lore: The caster calls upon their mastery of blood magic to conjure a twirling quartet of giant, blood-slick blades.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bladewind** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Bladewind** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Daemonic Speed
lore_ability.lore: Infernal winds blow at the back of these hordes, speeding them into battle against the enemies of the gods.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

lore_ability.name: Summon Vermintide
lore_ability.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
