lore_ability.name: Storm's Wrath
lore_ability.lore: The mage calls down a barrage of colossal lightning blasts that boom across the battlefield, blasting to ash clusters of the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 9" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

lore_ability.name: Elemental Push
lore_ability.lore: Carried upon a shifting patch of earth or sped by a benevolent zephyr, a group of Lumineth are carried to a more advantageous position by the spirits of the land.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of them that was not set up this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is in combat.
lore_ability.effect: The target can move up to 5". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

lore_ability.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
lore_ability.lore: Imbued with the healing powers of Ghyran, an Emerald Lifeswarm buzzes across the battlefield, seeking out the dead and dying and restoring their lives and vigour.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Emerald Lifeswarm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Emerald Lifeswarm** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
lore_ability.lore: The crystalline spars of the Prismatic Palisade are formed of pure light and hardened into a barrier that bathes those on the battlefield in the blinding rays of Hysh.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Prismatic Palisade** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Prismatic Palisade** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Rune of Petrification
lore_ability.lore: The caster calls forth a hovering sigil formed from the very crust of the realm.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Rune of Petrification** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Rune of Petrification** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Black Horror of Ulgu
lore_ability.lore: A writhing mass of shadowy tentacles emerges though a conjured portal to coil around the limbs of nearby foes, who suddenly feel as if they are wading through mud.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them, pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that point to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The targets cannot use **RUN** abilities until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Speed of the Righteous
lore_ability.lore: The warrior-priest calls upon Sigmar to speed their brethren with the winds aetheric so that they might enact his judgement with greater haste.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be a target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of the target for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Focused Erosion
lore_ability.lore: The caster calls upon nearby spirits of wind, water and stone, which work together to assail the weapons of the foe in a sentient storm that dulls blades and spoils ammunition.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Black Flames of Hashut
lore_ability.lore: Spitting the Bullfather’s contempt, the priest causes their enemies to be wreathed in abyssal fire – a worthy punishment for the weak.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

lore_ability.name: Frazzleblast
lore_ability.lore: With a wild gesticulation, the shaman imbues the Gitmobs' weapons with Frazzlegit's burning light.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DROGGZ'S GITMOB** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

lore_ability.name: Beacon of Hysh
lore_ability.lore: The caster imbues allies with an aura of brilliance that blinds their opponents.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non‑**MONSTER LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly with 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets that friendly unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

lore_ability.name: Jade Winds
lore_ability.lore: The caster draws ambient motes of Ghyranite magic unto them and shapes them into a form with solidity, identity and vicious intent.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Gladewyrm**
• **Spiteswarm Hive**
• **Vengeful Skullroot**
lore_ability.effect: If you picked a **Gladewyrm** or **Vengeful Skullroot**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Spiteswarm Hive**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
lore_ability.lore: The shaman takes a small mushroom and hurls it with all his might. When it lands, it sprouts impossibly quickly into a gigantic skullshroom, a fungus said to grow between Mork’s own toes.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mork’s Mighty Mushroom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Mork’s Mighty Mushroom** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Burning Head
lore_ability.lore: Formed from the fires of Aqshy, the Burning Head manifests as a blazing skull that scorches its way across the battlefield. Ranks of troops are incinerated and the rickety frames of war engines set ablaze by its passing.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **The Burning Head** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up **The Burning Head** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Grasp of Stone
lore_ability.lore: The Drazghar have observed Urak Taar’s ability to channel his curse. They attempt to replicate this via invocations, though Taar ensures that none learn too much…
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, the target also has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Siphon Strength
lore_ability.lore: The vampire draws on the life essence of the enemy to flood their limbs with strength and heighten their senses.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the caster.

lore_ability.name: Summon Bone-tithe Shrieker
lore_ability.lore: The caster conjures a four-headed, all-seeing monstrosity to hunt down those who would escape the Ossiarch tithe.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bone‑tithe Shrieker** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Bone-tithe Shrieker** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Bacterial Blessing
lore_ability.lore: The priest blesses their comrades’ weapons with colonies of bacteria.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Fists of Gork
lore_ability.lore: Great green fists rain down from the sky to pummel the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Epidermal Crustitis
lore_ability.lore: The caster grins widely as their skin hardens into a crusty layer.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used for attacks that target the caster.

lore_ability.name: Blazing Impetus
lore_ability.lore: The priest bellows a prayer that causes sparks to fly from their mouth, causing nearby Fyreslayers to leap into battle.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of them and that was not set up this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Fleshy Abundance
lore_ability.lore: The sorcerer generously bestows a growth spurt of the most repulsive kind upon their allies, causing their bodies to bloat with great wobbling mounds of grey-green fat.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
lore_ability.lore: The splintered echo of an ancient underworld deity, Lauchon the Soulseeker sails the swirling tides of death, drawn by the lure of powerful spirits. Spellcasters can join his macabre odyssey, if they are willing to offer a fitting sacrifice.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Lauchon the Soulseeker** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Lauchon the Soulseeker** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
lore_ability.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell's final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 9" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Runic Fyrewall
lore_ability.lore: At the command of a Zharrgrim priest, a Runic Fyrewall can be raised from the fiery chasms far beneath their sootstained feet. Glinting with runes, this scintillating barrier of gold and flame bars the enemy’s path and protects the flanks of the Fyreslayers’ fyrds as they press ever forward.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Runic Fyrewall** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Runic Fyrewall** wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Unseen Force
lore_ability.lore: Focusing on the balance of the cosmos, the caster turns the foe’s own aggression against them, channelling an invisible barrier to hold back their advance.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **RUN** abilities. In addition, if that enemy unit has already been picked to be the target of this ability this battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

lore_ability.name: Gaze of Glareface
lore_ability.lore: The caster redirects Frazzlegit’s fearsome glare at the enemy, forcing them to shield their eyes and stumble about blindly.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Halve the Range characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.

lore_ability.name: The Will of Nagash
lore_ability.lore: Eye sockets flaring with power, the wizard renders nearby gheists almost invulnerable to enemy attacks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if the unmodified hit roll or unmodified wound roll for an attack that targets the target unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

lore_ability.name: Summon Gork-Roara
lore_ability.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
lore_ability.lore: Imbued with grisly vigour, the undead beasts of a Corpsemare Stampede burst from the blood-soaked ground to trample across the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Corpsemare Stampede** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Corpsemare Stampede** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Molten Infernoth
lore_ability.lore: An elemental manifestation that personifies the blazing wrath of Vulcatrix, a Molten Infernoth can be drawn to battle by a Zharrgrim priest. Bursting out of the realm’s crust, the ferocious entity lumbers across the battlefield, inspiring Fyreslayers while blasting the enemy with raging torrents of lava.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Molten Infernoth** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Molten Infernoth** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Runes of Loathing
lore_ability.lore: With a guttural curse, the priest carves runes into their flesh that are antithetical to hated sorcery, which sympathetically manifest upon the armour of nearby followers.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (3+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS** (including **FIGHT** abilities). If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Canopy of Virulence
lore_ability.lore: Those who labour in the shadow of Nurgle’s orchards are empowered by this arcane rite.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaws**, ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units in combat with the target.

lore_ability.name: Slipstream
lore_ability.lore: The wizard deftly manipulates the surging currents of the ethersea to aid allies.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHORRILEUM** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

lore_ability.name: Reinforce Daemonsteel
lore_ability.lore: At a sorcerer’s chanting, the sigils inscribed on their minions’ armour glow with protective power.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit in each phase while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: The Hand of Gork
lore_ability.lore: A ghostly green hand carries a mob of gitz to where they are needed.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Infectious Surge
lore_ability.lore: As the power of Nurgle waxes, his followers gain the momentum of a spreading pandemic.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

lore_ability.name: Charnel Conviction
lore_ability.lore: Anointed with libations by their priest, ghouls believe themselves to be invincible warriors of faith.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+)**. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
lore_ability.lore: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.

lore_ability.name: Morrda's Embrace
lore_ability.lore: Sinister shadows converge above the priest's head before enveloping a foe in a deadly embrace.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain. If the chanting roll was 10+, roll 2D6 instead.

lore_ability.name: Goreflesh
lore_ability.lore: Glistening, steaming blood flows over the flesh of the priest’s followers before coagulating into a gruesome second skin that dulls the strikes of the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Wreathed in the Storm
lore_ability.lore: Lightning ripples across the armour of these warriors, delivering a lethal shock to enemies who approach them.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets the target unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Jade Winds
lore_ability.lore: The caster draws ambient motes of Ghyranite magic unto them and shapes them into a form with solidity, identity and vicious intent.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Gladewyrm**
• **Spiteswarm Hive**
• **Vengeful Skullroot**
lore_ability.effect: If you picked a **Gladewyrm** or **Vengeful Skullroot**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Spiteswarm Hive**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Spore Maws
lore_ability.lore: The caster causes the thick spores around them to coalesce into gnashing green mouths.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

lore_ability.name: Fury of Vulcatrix
lore_ability.lore: Eyes blazing white-hot, the priest fills their allies with the rage of the Ur-Salamander.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks, including those made with **Companion** weapons, until the start of your next turn.

In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Translocation
lore_ability.lore: The priest summons bolts of lightning to transport nearby warriors across the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

lore_ability.name: Summon Celestian Vortex
lore_ability.lore: The wizard casts a pair of ensorcelled hammers into the air, which begin to spin. As the vortex gets more intense, the hammers multiply to form a maelstrom of skull-crushing force.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Celestian Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Celestian Vortex** wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Weirdokk Dance
lore_ability.lore: Dancing to a rhythm only they can hear, this erratic beat causes havoc with enemy mystics.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer. Then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Subtract 1 from chanting rolls and casting rolls for enemy **PRIESTS** and **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of the chanter until the start of your next turn.

In addition, if the chanting roll was 11+, enemy **PRIESTS** within 18" of the chanter each lose D6 ritual points and enemy **WIZARDS** cannot use **UNBIND** abilities while they are within 18" of the chanter until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Vault of Souls
lore_ability.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vault of Souls** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Vault of Souls** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
lore_ability.lore: No spell inspires greater fear in the beholder than the Purple Sun of Shyish. The skull-faced orb drifts across the battlefield, its rays of death energy transmuting all they touch into amethyst statues.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Purple Sun of Shyish** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Purple Sun of Shyish** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Augury of Battle
lore_ability.lore: Perhaps Morai-Heg has foreseen the deaths of these warriors today. Or perhaps she has not.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+)**. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick up to 2 friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** units wholly within 18" of the caster instead of 1.

lore_ability.name: Prison of Grief
lore_ability.lore: Victims of this curse relive their tragedies, their will to fight replaced by overwhelming self-pity.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Dais Arcanum
lore_ability.lore: The wizard calls down a single bolt of lightning to strike the ground at their feet, leaving behind a perfect sigmarite disc for a chosen Stormcast to mount and be carried into the air.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Dais Arcanum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY HERO** that does not have **FLY** and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Dais Arcanum** within ½" of the target, visible to the caster and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and place it on the platform of that **Dais Arcanum**.

lore_ability.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
lore_ability.lore: A nightmarish fusion of bone and tortured spirit-stuff, a Soulscream Bridge disintegrates and consumes the souls of the fallen in order to tear open a makeshift pathway across reality.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Soulscream Bridge** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Soulscream Bridge** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A **Soulscream Bridge** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Summon Cadaverous Barricade
lore_ability.lore: With a word of command, the corpses of those who once served Ushoran rise up from the grave, dragging with them the detritus of a forgotten civilisation and clawing at the living.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Cadaverous Barricade** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Cadaverous Barricade** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Song of Persistence
lore_ability.lore: Memories of the unwavering courage of glades past permeate the spirit-song at the Sylvaneth’s will, stirring the noble souls of their kin and inspiring them to impossible acts of endurance.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN MONSTER** that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the effect of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, the target has **WARD (6+)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Spiteswarm Hive
lore_ability.lore: The air is filled with the buzzing of a thousand wings as a swarm of iridescent insects bursts from its hive.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Spiteswarm Hive** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Spiteswarm Hive** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Frothing Mucus
lore_ability.lore: The priest blesses their kin with a rancid layer of protective slime.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability has no effect on combat attacks that target the target. If the chanting roll was 6+, weapon abilities other than the **Companion** weapon ability have no effect instead.

lore_ability.name: Summon Zharrgron Flame-spitter
lore_ability.lore: By concentrating their magmic powers, a Zharrgrim priest can summon forth fiery heat from the bowels of the realm. With a rumble and a crack, an angry geyser opens up in the earth, bombarding the foe with molten death.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Zharrgron Flame-spitter** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Zharrgron Flame-spitter** wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
lore_ability.lore: Borne aloft on currents of Chamonic energy, the Quicksilver Swords fly across the battlefield in tight formations before fanning out to eviscerate and behead those in their path.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Quicksilver Swords** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Quicksilver Swords** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Soulstealer Carrion
lore_ability.lore: Soaring from its caster’s spread fingertips, the Soulstealer Carrion takes wing above the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Soulstealer Carrion** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Soulstealer Carrion** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
lore_ability.lore: As these pairs of cracked prisms of black stone orbit the battlefield, necromantic energy spills from their breached surfaces in a sickening stream, sapping the spirit and life force of all those they pass over.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Shards of Valagharr** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Shards of Valagharr** endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A **Shards of Valagharr** endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Hateful Fractures
lore_ability.lore: The sorcerer clenches a contemptuous fist, seeing firm ground beneath their foes suddenly splinter and crack.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Violent Consecration
lore_ability.lore: The priestess cries out to their divine patron, beseeching her to grace the arena with a display of bloodthirsty power.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a chanting roll of D6.

**• Bloodwrack Viper**
**• Bladewind**
**• Heart of Fury**
lore_ability.effect:
If you picked a **Bloodwrack Viper** or **Bladewind**, set it up wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Heart of Fury**, set it up wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick a second **MANIFESTATION** from the list above that is not on the battlefield and set it up as described above.

lore_ability.name: Speed of Huanchi
lore_ability.lore: With the grace and momentum of a prowling beast, the allies of the priestly mage are filled with a celestial haste.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SERAPHON** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
lore_ability.lore: Brief incantations in the Dark Tongue see these burning symbols of worship spark into reality.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Vicious Stranglethorns
lore_ability.lore: Twisting, thorn-covered vines erupt from the undergrowth to ensnare the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

lore_ability.name: Gorkamorka's War Cry
lore_ability.lore: The shaman takes a huge gulp of Waaagh! energy before letting out a world-shaking roar.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

lore_ability.name: Summon Heart of Fury
lore_ability.lore: The skies turn crimson as this bleeding icon descends upon the battle.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Heart of Fury** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Heart of Fury** wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Favoured Poxes
lore_ability.lore: With an overwide grin, the priest generously anoints some unwilling victims with a slew of debilitating contagions.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target. If the chanting roll was 10+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1, instead.

lore_ability.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
lore_ability.lore: Reaching an arm to the heavens, the wizard calls down a comet of pure Azyrite energy that crashes into the foe's ranks with devastating effect.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FIRST-FORGED WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Fixin' Beat
lore_ability.lore: The Warchanter pounds a restorative rhythm that gives the ladz a second wind.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3+3)** the target instead.

lore_ability.name: Bad Portents
lore_ability.lore: The caster raises their staff and loudly proclaims that other mystics have incorrectly predicted the aspect of the Bad Moon; in fact, at this time, the face of the bad moon is…
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On 1-2, nothing happens. On a 3-5, the face of the Bad Moon moves to the next face. On a 6, pick a new face of the Bad Moon for this battle round.

lore_ability.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
lore_ability.lore: A Malevolent Maelstrom is a swirling vortex of Shyishan magic, a tempest that sucks in sorcerous energies and the souls of the dead before exploding in a cataclysmic nova.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Malevolent Maelstrom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Malevolent Maelstrom** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
lore_ability.lore: The shaman transforms a loonstone statue into a huge glowing terror and lets it loose on the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Malevolent Moon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Malevolent Moon** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Reinforce Construct
lore_ability.lore: The Null Myriad are strengthened against the corrosive magic of the realms' wilds, and this endurance can be magnified to resist more terrestrial damage.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NULL MYRIAD WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Gork-Roara
lore_ability.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: The Earth Trembles
lore_ability.lore: With a focused pulse of will, the Starmaster sets the energy of the ley lines spiking until the ground is violently torn asunder.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them to be the target point, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Draw a straight line between the target point and the closest part on the caster’s base. Roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) that has models passed across by this line. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

lore_ability.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
lore_ability.lore: A spectral hourglass filled with shifting grave-sand takes shape, promising temporal grace or doom to mortal and immortal alike.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mortalis Terminexus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Mortalis Terminexus** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Comet's Call
lore_ability.lore: Their consciousness soaring up to the heavens, the wizard summons a celestial comet that plummets down into the enemy ranks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Fateweaver's Gift
lore_ability.lore: Kairos can bestow his extraordinary insight into the past and future upon those he considers worthy.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Change the Past:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the caster, that is in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. Roll either 4 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of unspent destiny dice you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
***Seize the Present:*** Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
***Predict the Future:*** Roll a dice. You must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll.

lore_ability.name: Da Loonking's Command
lore_ability.lore: With a puzzling gesture from the shaman, a greenish-yellow glow emanates from the best warriors of Da King’s Gitz, spurring them on to perform acts of even greater wickedness in Skragrott’s name.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KING’S GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by champions in the target unit.
•  If the target uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6.
•  Add 1 to the target’s control score.

lore_ability.name: Summon Vengeful Skullroot
lore_ability.lore: From the shadows comes a nightmarish form: the wretched husk of a tortured tree, the skeletal remains of past victims tangled among its writhing root mass.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **VENGEFUL SKULLROOT** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Vengeful Skullroot** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Excommunication!
lore_ability.lore: Having espied exiled warriors, the priest vociferously denounces them.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Storm of Obsidian Shards
lore_ability.lore: The sheer vitriol of this duardin priest is incarnated as a tumult of flesh-shredding stone splinters.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and subtract 3 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Mork's Mighty Mushroom
lore_ability.lore: The shaman takes a small mushroom and hurls it with all his might. When it lands, it sprouts impossibly quickly into a gigantic skullshroom, a fungus said to grow between Mork's own toes.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mork's Mighty Mushroom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Mork's Mighty Mushroom** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Bile-torrent
lore_ability.lore: The priest screeches with glowing green eyes as a torrent of bile sweeps over their foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.

lore_ability.name: Grimdokk Dance
lore_ability.lore: Stamping his feet hard on the ground, the Wardokk drives Gorky energy into nearby ladz, causing rent flesh to knit together, and broken bones to grind back into place.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BONESPLITTERZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: **Heal (3)** the target unit or return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3. If the chanting roll for this prayer was 9+, instead, **Heal (6)** the target unit or return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 6.

lore_ability.name: Virulent Agonies
lore_ability.lore: The priest calls forth a painful, nerve-burning malady to blight their foes.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within the target’s combat range. If the chanting roll was 7+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target instead of 1.

lore_ability.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
lore_ability.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell’s final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Shield of Blood
lore_ability.lore: A literal targe of dripping gore interposes itself between the aelven gladiators and incoming attacks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick up to 2 other eligible units to be additional targets. Each target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Raven's Flight
lore_ability.lore: Wings of jet black frame the priest as they summon a chill wind that speeds their allies.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, in addition, for the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they have used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

lore_ability.name: Da Black Pit
lore_ability.lore: The shaman taps his staff on the ground. Forking out from that spot, and surging towards a nearby foe, the earth turns into a noisome quagmire that sucks victims below its surface to their doom.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Get 'Em Beat
lore_ability.lore: A pounding rhythm is played by the Warchanter, inspiring nearby Ironjawz to wreak destruction and ruin upon their enemies.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

lore_ability.name: High Expectations
lore_ability.lore: In an effort to sort the weak from the strong among his stomp, this Mega‑Gargant encourages his followers to match their strength by seeing how much destruction they can wreak with their bare hands.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BRODD’S STOMP PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **BRODD’S STOMP** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic instead.

lore_ability.name: Speed of the Scáthborn
lore_ability.lore: The potential lurking in the blood of the Zainthar Kai can be unleashed with a sorcerous word.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
lore_ability.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Agonising Vomiting
lore_ability.lore: Presaged by a deep rumble within their distended guts, the priest belches forth a deluge of thick, corrosive vomit.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll 7 dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, add 2 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
lore_ability.lore: The spirits of the dead rise from the ground and surge forwards in a Suffocating Gravetide to smother the living, burying their victims and dragging their souls down to the Realm of Death.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Suffocating Gravetide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Suffocating Gravetide** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Untapped Mutation
lore_ability.lore: This wizard manipulates the warpstone melded into the flesh of their minions, pushing the limits of their physicality before they are inevitably destroyed.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible friendly **MUTATED MENAGERIE** units wholly within 13" of them that are affected by the 'More-more Mutation!' ability to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For each damage point allocated to the target at the end of this turn by the 'More-more Mutation!' ability, add 1 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Song of War
lore_ability.lore: The spirit-song becomes an angry, staccato beat that awakens something primal in the Sylvaneth, seeing them crush bones and twist steel with the latent strength in their barkflesh.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.

lore_ability.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
lore_ability.lore: Decrepit chains clatter and rusted manacles grind as the Soulsnare Shackles snap at their prey, seeking to clamp down on the spirits of their victims so that they can drag them back to the Great Oubliette in Shyish.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Soulsnare Shackles** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Soulsnare Shackles** endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A **Soulsnare Shackles** endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

lore_ability.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
lore_ability.lore: The wizard conjures forth a manifestation of the sacred cup held by Ushoran. This bone-wrought goblet is filled with the blood of those slain in its presence.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Chalice of Ushoran** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Chalice of Ushoran** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Foot of Gork
lore_ability.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Scáthscale
lore_ability.lore: Hissing syllables of vicious intent, the priestess causes the bare flesh of her sisters to shimmer with serpentine scales the hue of iron that turn the blades of their foes.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target of this ability instead.

lore_ability.name: Infernal Gateway
lore_ability.lore: The sorcerer opens a portal to the Realm of Chaos, pulling enemies to their doom.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll either 5 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of **fate points** you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
lore_ability.lore: The shaman summons a cruel, glowing swamp that channels memories of Gorkamorka’s past brawls.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Cowed and Broken
lore_ability.lore: The priest channels Khorne's seething hatred through a Gorechosen, causing the bones of foes who stand in the way of worthier targets to agonisingly twist and snap.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll 8 dice. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to each roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Uncontrollable Rage
lore_ability.lore: Opening their own veins while chanting hateful catechisms of worship, the priest spreads their own depthless fury to their allies.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability (see 'Blades of Khorne Battle Traits') apply to the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, ignore the effect of'Wild-eyed Brutality' on the target.

lore_ability.name: Starfall
lore_ability.lore: Gazing towards the heavens, the wizard hurls meteoric rain into the enemy's path, forcing them to turn an aggressive push into a cautious advance.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

lore_ability.name: Two Headz As One
lore_ability.lore: Shamans conveying the Twin-Headed God’s will spur the ladz to commit acts of kunnin’ brutality – or brutal kunnin’ – as necessary.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BIG WAAAGH! WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **BIG WAAAGH! INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the target is an **IRONJAWZ** unit, until the start of your next turn, add 3 to the target’s control score while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units.

If the target is a **KRULEBOYZ** unit, until the start of your next turn, add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ** units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
lore_ability.lore: A spectral hourglass filled with shifting grave-sand takes shape, promising temporal grace or doom to mortal and immortal alike.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mortalis Terminexus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Mortalis Terminexus** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Steed of Shadows
lore_ability.lore: A coal-black creature with wings of night materialises from the darkness and swoops across the battlefield, hastening the movement of the Khainites below.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

lore_ability.name: Wings of the Crone Goddess
lore_ability.lore: Morai-Heg grants the blessing of flight to her faithful as sable feathers burst from their limbs.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **FLY**.
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 6" to the target’s Move characteristic instead.

lore_ability.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
lore_ability.lore: Reaching an arm to the heavens, the wizard calls down a comet of pure Azyrite energy that crashes into the foe’s ranks with devastating effect.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Summon Hyshian Twinstones
lore_ability.lore: The caster calls forth two giant crystal teardrops that orbit around each other.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hyshian Twinstones** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Hyshian Twinstones** endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Spite-tongue Curse
lore_ability.lore: Uttering the foul syllables of the Dark Tongue until blood pours from their mouth, the caster beseeches the Chaos Gods to destroy their enemies – though such pacts carry with them a terrible cost…
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. If the casting attempt is unsuccessful or if the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Ashen Smog
lore_ability.lore: Clouds of choking ash seep from the sorcerer’s outstretched talon before settling across the lands as an impenetrable, blinding pall.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them that has a friendly **desolation token** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: That terrain feature has the ‘Obscuring’ ability (Terrain, 1.2) until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting the target terrain feature. On a 2+, inflict an amount of damage equal to the roll on that unit.

lore_ability.name: Summon Sanctum of Amyntok
lore_ability.lore: Triple manifestations of the rune Yngra form a protective barrier around the summoner.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanctum of Amyntok** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Sanctum of Amyntok** wholly within 12" of the caster and more than 3" from all enemy units. A **Sanctum of Amyntok** has 3 parts that must be set up touching each other so that they form a ring.

lore_ability.name: Prayer of Ash
lore_ability.lore: Borne on a gust of hot forge-winds, a circle of ash settles around the priest’s allies, protecting them from harm.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

If the chanting roll was 8+, also subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Shifting Manifestations
lore_ability.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**
lore_ability.effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
lore_ability.lore: Like the procession of the heavens, the rotations of the Chronomantic Cogs control the passage of time, allowing wizards to speed or slow the events that are unfolding around them.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Chronomantic Cogs** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Chronomantic Cogs** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: The Summerking's Favour
lore_ability.lore: The priest delivers a blistering sermon lionising the deeds of a courtly champion, marking them out as an Ushorite saint in their followers’ eyes.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6. You cannot pick **Nagash** to be the target of this prayer.
lore_ability.effect:
Resolve the effect of ‘Renowned Might’ below. If the chanting roll was 10+, resolve the effect of either ‘Renowned Might’ or ‘Righteous Tenacity’ instead.

***Renowned Might:*** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

***Righteous Tenacity:*** The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Furnace Blessing
lore_ability.lore: The priest pours burning scorn upon the daemonic essences bound in duardin steel, seeing the weapons of the Hashutites blaze in molten outrage.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, that unit’s melee weapons also have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Cloying Quagmire
lore_ability.lore: The sorcerer thrusts their hands into the soil, causing the ground beneath their enemies to putrefy into a sucking, grasping quagmire.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
•  Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
•  If the target’s Save characteristic is 3+ or better, subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Healing Storm
lore_ability.lore: The priest calls down cleansing bolts from the sky, their invigorating energies closing even the most grievous wounds.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

lore_ability.name: Munificent Blights
lore_ability.lore: This pestilential rite makes the Garden even more generous with gifts for its guests.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target by the ‘Putrescent Sap’ ability.

lore_ability.name: Soul-Claim
lore_ability.lore: The caster drains the spirit-essence from the foe, repurposing it to imbue their constructs with animus.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be a friendly target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. If any models are slain by this ability, pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (3)** the friendly target.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

lore_ability.name: Ethereal Grace
lore_ability.lore: The sorceress grants their fellow Scáthborn the swiftness of a fleeting shadow.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Fell Blades
lore_ability.lore: A malignant curse screeched to blackened skies coalesces on spectral blades, causing the weapons to glow with the magics of ending.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **FIGHT** ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Solarite Flares
lore_ability.lore: The caster conjures blasts of blinding, red-stained radiance to dizzy and disorient.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield that is visible to them, then pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point to be the targets. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Unearthly Aura
lore_ability.lore: The caster takes the powerful magical defences of the Null Myriad and inverts them, allowing their weapons to effortlessly cleave through magical defences.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NULL MYRIAD WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NULL MYRIAD** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Retcher
lore_ability.lore: As they cast this spell, the Butcher spews their stomach contents over their weaponry, giving their blades ‘extra bite’.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the caster’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Grasping Roots
lore_ability.lore: The caster commands the undergrowth to bind and slow the enemy.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• The target cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Subtract 1 from charge rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Gladewyrm
lore_ability.lore: The earth splits apart as a huge serpentine form heaves itself free of the earth, its eyes blazing with jade energy.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gladewyrm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Gladewyrm** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Skitterleap
lore_ability.lore: Vanishing in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, the verminkin reappear elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN HERO** wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Mindrazor
lore_ability.lore: The wizard summons spectral blades into their allies’ hands, weapons whose edges are honed by the wielder’s faith as much as the victim’s fear.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Invocation of Nulahmia
lore_ability.lore: This ancient spell, said to hail from the sun-blasted birthplace of necromancy, is wielded by each of Neferata’s chosen.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: You can return 1 slain model to that unit.

lore_ability.name: Summon Hexgorger Skulls
lore_ability.lore: Hexgorger Skulls are the physical manifestation of Khorne's hatred of the arcane arts. They drift across the battlefield, seeking to feed upon eldritch energy and those conjurers who attempt to use it.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Hexgorger Skulls** invocation has 2 parts that must be set up within 8" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Summon Bell of Doom
