lore_ability.lore: Invoking ancient creation myths, the spellcaster causes a great Bell of Doom to manifest upon the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bell of Doom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Bell of Doom** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Breath of Vulcatrix
lore_ability.lore: Fyreslayer priests awaken the divine energy within this Magmadroth’s boiling blood, causing the creature to unleash a torrent of sacred flame.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DROTHKEEPERS MAGMADROTH** wholly within 12" of them to be a target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Roaring Fyrestream** is 3 instead of D3.

lore_ability.name: Murderous Flock
lore_ability.lore: A flight of phantasmal ravens is summoned from the darkened skies, diving down into the enemy's ranks to peck out eyes and pierce throats.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **RUINATION BROTHERHOOD PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit for each 4+ instead.

lore_ability.name: Glowy Green Frenzy
lore_ability.lore: A swirl of green energy coalesces around the boyz, imbuing them with a terrifying ferocity that drives their strikes with primal strength.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn, including **Companion** weapons.

lore_ability.name: Flaming Weapons
lore_ability.lore: At a gesture, the cuneiform-inscribed weapons of the sorcerer’s host glow white-hot and ignite.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Waste Away
lore_ability.lore: The wizard causes the muscles of the foe to atrophy, robbing them of their strength.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

lore_ability.name: Call Forth the Forest
lore_ability.lore: The strongest Sylvaneth wizards have a potent spiritual connection to the wyldwoods and can coax forth these eldritch copses with the proper entreaties.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LORDS OF THE CLAN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: If there are fewer than 9 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** wholly within 24" of the caster, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 1" from all enemy units and other terrain features. If there are 9 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, **Heal (3)** each friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** instead.

lore_ability.name: Miasma of Madness
lore_ability.lore: The wizard calls forth a sanity-warping mist to engulf the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
lore_ability.lore: Savage, unrelenting and eternally hungry, the spell known as Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws is born from the essence of Ghur’s hunger and is capable of chomping through rank after rank of foes.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws** endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Ravenak’s Gnashing Jaws** endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Manifestations of Murder
lore_ability.lore: The wizard channels their power and calls one of the sacred manifestations of Khaine to the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Bloodwrack Viper**
**• Bladewind**
**• Heart of Fury**
lore_ability.effect: If you picked a **Bloodwrack Viper** or **Bladewind**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Heart of Fury**, set it up wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Divine Terror
lore_ability.lore: The inevitability of Nagash's return inspires utter dread, and it is a matter of little effort for the wizard to magnify that fear tenfold.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: The Green God's Hammer
lore_ability.lore: At the urging of the Weirdnobs, Waaagh! energy surrounding the Ironmongerz pounds like a hammer on an anvil.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

lore_ability.name: Zephyrspite Rush
lore_ability.lore: The caster calls on a swarm of zephyrspites to carry their allies swiftly into battle.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Gork-Roara
lore_ability.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
lore_ability.lore: From out a yawning portal looms a colossal skeletal arm, infused to its cursed marrow with the magic of Shyish.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Hand of Nagash** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Hand of Nagash** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Excommunication!
lore_ability.lore: Having espied unworthy warriors exiled from the Summerking’s court, the priest extends a finger and vociferously denounces them.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Tome of Eyes
lore_ability.lore: With a snap of the conjurer’s fingers, the Tome appears at their side from a spark of blue wyrdflame.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Tome of Eyes** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Tome of Eyes** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Bash 'Em Ladz!
lore_ability.lore: Pulsing waves of Waaagh! energy radiate from the shaman, boosting the fighting prowess of nearby Ironjawz.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Corpsemare Stampede
lore_ability.lore: Imbued with grisly vigour, the undead beasts of a Corpsemare Stampede burst from the blood-soaked ground to trample across the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Corpsemare Stampede** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Corpsemare Stampede** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Essence of the Chorrileum
lore_ability.lore: The powerful energies of an Idoneth soul-reef can heal flesh and mend shattered bones.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHORRILEUM** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the target is **NAMARTI**, you can return D6 slain models to it. Otherwise, **Heal (D3)** the target

lore_ability.name: Summon Darkfire Daemonrift
lore_ability.lore: Darkfire Daemonrifts are eldritch portals torn ajar by dark incantations. Once the veil has been sundered, raw magic seeping from the Realm of Chaos forms an opening for the horrors beyond to vent their spite, widened and empowered by spellcraft that draws upon the essence of Chaos.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Darkfire Daemonrift** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Darkfire Daemonrift** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Blood Boil
lore_ability.lore: Spitting ritualistic words of wrath into the air, the priest turns the blood coursing through the veins of the enemy red-hot, burning them from the inside out.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Vexing Spirits
lore_ability.lore: Shifting shingle, stinging winds or sudden fog, minor spirits of the land band together to bedevil and harass the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **AELEMENTIRI CONCLAVE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands.

lore_ability.name: Deafening Frenzy
lore_ability.lore: The caster enhances the clangour of the thirteen Warpshatter Bells in the minds of a nearby swarm, driving them to even greater heights of fury.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GNAWHORDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. The casting roll for this spell cannot be modified.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The target cannot use commands.

lore_ability.name: Summon Foot of Gork
lore_ability.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Scarlet Thirst
lore_ability.lore: At the wizard’s command, a fierce compulsion to feed flares up inside the vampiric court, who eagerly await the chance to indulge their blood hunger without restraint.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Summon Molten Infernoth
lore_ability.lore: An elemental manifestation that personifies the blazing wrath of Vulcatrix, a Molten Infernoth can be drawn to battle by a Zharrgrim priest. Bursting out of the realm’s crust, the ferocious entity lumbers across the battlefield, inspiring Fyreslayers while blasting the enemy with raging torrents of lava.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Molten Infernoth** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DROTHKEEPERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Molten Infernoth** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Thrall Drain
lore_ability.lore: Vampires are consummate and ruthless survivors; they will gladly drain the energy of their subordinates in order to heal their own wounds.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: D3 models in the target are slain. Then, remove all damage points from the caster.

lore_ability.name: Summon Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron
lore_ability.lore: The shaman whistles loudly, calling the squealing, bubbling Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron to their side.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Dark Cantrip
lore_ability.lore: Uttering blasphemous words in the Dark Tongue, the sorcerer calls forth bolts of black chaotic energy that strike the foe, searing flesh, melting armour and leaving them as a bubbling mass of tentacles.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-sigil
lore_ability.lore: Eightfold Doom-Sigils are icons of Chaos in all its glory, blazing symbols of pure ruin. To fall in the presence of such a sorcerous construct is to be damned, for these lingering spells hungrily suck souls into the Realm of Chaos for the gods to feast upon.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them

lore_ability.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
lore_ability.lore: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 3" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Rabid-tough
lore_ability.lore: The priest snarls and conjures a dense cloud of toxins that sends their followers into a frenzy that numbs them to pain.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Spectral Lashes
lore_ability.lore: With a rattling shriek, the caster causes spectral lashes to manifest around the ethereal steeds of the Clattering Procession, driving them forward with pitiless blows.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Horror of the Necropolis
lore_ability.lore: The Mortisans of the Null Myriad are masters in manipulating the horrors that inhabit the furthest reaches of the realms.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **NULL MYRIAD WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Soulstealer Carrion**
• **Bone-tithe Shrieker**
• **Nightmare Predator**
lore_ability.effect: Set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Vile Transference
lore_ability.lore: The caster siphons the animus from nearby enemies and uses it to restore their deathless form.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, **Heal (D3)** the caster.

lore_ability.name: Gift of Apoplexy
lore_ability.lore: Chanting words of carnage, the Slaughterpriest invokes a murderous rage in their enemies that will drive them to tear each other apart with hands and teeth should the opportunity to unleash violence on their foes not present itself.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **MOVE, CHARGE** or **FIGHT** ability, after that ability is resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

lore_ability.name: Filth-crust
lore_ability.lore: The Great Horned Rat heeds the call of this priest to encrust the weapons of their minions with irresistible contagions.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Charnel Feast
lore_ability.lore: The caster draws out the life essence of nearby foes and uses it to heal the injured warriors of the court.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell and pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target. You can also pick a friendly **SERFS** unit within 6" of the target to be the raised ranks. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each damage point allocated to the target by this ability, you can return 1 slain model to the raised ranks.

lore_ability.name: Bloated with Sickness
lore_ability.lore: The priest hawks a glob of green-black mucus into their palm, leaving fat, writhing parasites in their grasp. With a swift clench of their fist, they grant their followers a putrefying resilience.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**MONSTER MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Wrath of Vulcatrix
lore_ability.lore: The priest sets the runes pressed into a Magmadroth’s hide ablaze, and the colossal beast roars with fury.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGMADROTH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability has no effect on the target and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons.

If the chanting roll was 8+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons for every 4 damage points the target has instead.

lore_ability.name: Exultation of Murder
lore_ability.lore: Shrieking to the skies, the priestess draws upon a divine bloodlust that drives her sisters into a murderous rapture.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. In addition, if the chanting roll was 9+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

lore_ability.name: Devolve
lore_ability.lore: Delving into the minds of their enemies, the shaman magnifies the savage and animalistic parts of their foes’ psyches until they are little more than growling beasts.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy non-**HERO** unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• The target unit has a maximum control score of 1.
• The target cannot use commands.
• Each time the target moves, if the caster is on the battlefield, the target must end that move no further from the caster than it was at the start of the move.

lore_ability.name: Molten Metal
lore_ability.lore: A wave of hellish, liquid metal that strips armour and melts flesh surges forth into the enemy line.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified casting roll. Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each roll that equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic.

lore_ability.name: Bright Fright
lore_ability.lore: Sensing that the Gitz might be getting stuck in a bit beyond their depth, or maybe because they think a bit more battlefield anarchy might be in order, the caster summons a great scowling image of Glareface Frazzlegit to spook the horde into moving away from the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 friendly visible **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Each target can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it was your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by those **RETREAT** abilities.

lore_ability.name: Beam of Hysh
lore_ability.lore: Tracing the rune of Varinor in the air, the caster looses a brilliant lance of searing light.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this battle round to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting value of this spell for each time it has been successfully cast by a friendly **WIZARD** this turn.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3+**X** mortal damage on the target, where **X** is the number of times, to a maximum of 3, that this spell has previously been successfully cast by a friendly **WIZARD** this turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Bloodwrack Viper
lore_ability.lore: The caster weaves their outstretched hand in an elaborate pattern that mimics the structure of a monstrous snake drenched in blood.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bloodwrack Viper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Bloodwrack Viper** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Sigmar's Grace
lore_ability.lore: Shafts of golden light burst through the clouds to heal Sigmar’s wounded.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (2D3)** the target instead.

lore_ability.name: Realmshield
lore_ability.lore: Whether buffeting air spirits that hinder incoming attacks or minor earth aelementors that move to obstruct the Lumineth’s foes, the land around the caster is stirred to provide protection to the aelves.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
lore_ability.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell's final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 9" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Cradling Vines
lore_ability.lore: The caster calls upon the surrounding vegetation to envelop precious soulpods and draw them closer to the centre of the grove where they can be better protected.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly units while they are contesting the target objective.

lore_ability.name: Killa Beat
lore_ability.lore: The Warchanter drums a thumping beat that causes raw Waaagh! energy to course through the weapons of the orruks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Deathly Gale
lore_ability.lore: A foul wind carrying a stench of death and decay races across the battlefield, speeding the charge of the Knights of the Crimson Keep.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

lore_ability.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
lore_ability.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Auspicious Strike
lore_ability.lore: Morai-Heg imparts a brief vision of a deadly weapon thrust.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CRONESEER’S PARIAHS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the unmodified hit roll for an attack made against the target is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 1 mortal damage for each unmodified hit roll of 1-2 instead.

lore_ability.name: Eruption of Apoplexy
lore_ability.lore: The priest focuses the rage of all the battle's combatants into a single warrior, whose organs rupture under the strain - or whose entire body violently explodes in a magnificent shower of boiling gore and bone shrapnel.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them that is in combat with a friendly unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. If the target is destroyed, before removing the last model in that unit from play, inflict D3 mortal damage on every unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of that model, or D6 mortal damage instead if the chanting roll was 8+.

lore_ability.name: Immolating Flames
lore_ability.lore: The caster wreathes an Ossiarch cohort in dark, flaming magic that discharges in a burst of fiery energy should any of their number be felled.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Divine Rush
lore_ability.lore: The priestess’s oratory serves to invigorate their flock, lending them speed and agility in equal measure.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. For each target:

• If the target is not in combat, it can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile‑in move.

lore_ability.name: Summon Everblaze Comet
lore_ability.lore: Reaching an arm to the heavens, the wizard calls down a pure comet of Azyrite energy that crashes into the foe’s ranks with devastating effect.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Everblaze Comet** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Everblaze Comet** wholly within 18" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
lore_ability.lore: The Nightmare Predator is a looming conjuration of Shyishan magic that takes the form of a disturbing terror.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Nightmare Predator** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Nightmare Predator** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Deranged Transformation
lore_ability.lore: The spellcaster causes the limbs of a nearby pack to bulge and lengthen, allowing the creatures to charge forwards at a furious pace and imbuing them with greater strength.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

lore_ability.name: Call of the Arena
lore_ability.lore: The priestess urges their followers to sprint headlong into danger, all the better to savour the contest for as long as possible.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to run rolls for friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **CHAMPIONS OF THE ARENA** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter.

lore_ability.name: Right Gitz In Da Right Place
lore_ability.lore: While fiddling with a squig-skin pouch, the wild-eyed shaman mutters gobbledegook interspersed with the name of a hated enemy.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KING’S GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Catechism of Murder
lore_ability.lore: Khaine’s followers enter a killing frenzy that knows no bounds, lashing out in a slicing storm of razor‑sharp steel.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 7+, the target’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Sanctification
lore_ability.lore: Holy energies radiate from the cleric, disrupting the works of spellcasters who bear hostile intent.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DRACONITH SKYWING PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 30" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 12+, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** for the rest of the battle and friendly **PRIESTS** cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

lore_ability.name: Shroud in Darkness
lore_ability.lore: At the sorcerer’s bidding, unnatural shadows fall upon Be’lakor’s warriors, allowing them to move unseen.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat. In addition, until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units while they are more than 12" away.

lore_ability.name: Shadowstep
lore_ability.lore: Imbibing the blood of a sacrificed leathanam, the priestess calls upon the shadows themselves to speed her flock to where they are needed most.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Overwhelming Heat
lore_ability.lore: The caster summons the searing light and oppressive heat of the Hyshian deserts to sap their foes’ strength and inflict them with crippling thirst.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn, then roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

lore_ability.name: Piercing Refraction
lore_ability.lore: The caster looses a thin, burning ray of light that leaps between a group of foes in a dazzling series of perfectly straight beams, scorching minute holes through them that can prove instantly lethal.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Scuttletide
lore_ability.lore: The shaman grasps a small jade amulet in which a skullback spider is imprisoned and uses it to call forth a seething mass of the trapped creature’s kin.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Scuttletide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Scuttletide** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Da Great Big Green Hand of Gork
lore_ability.lore: A ghostly green hand picks up a mob of Ironjawz and plonks them back down where they are most needed.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Spittledrain
lore_ability.lore: The wizard coughs up a expanding wad of corrosive phlegm to spit at the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7.

lore_ability.name: Ichor of the Ur-Salamander
lore_ability.lore: The Magmadroth’s blood is blessed with the legendary lethality of its godbeast forebear.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS MONSTER** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if any damage points were inflicted on an enemy unit by the target’s ‘Volcanic Blood’ ability, after the damage sequence has been resolved, inflict 3 mortal damage on that enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 6+, inflict D3+3 mortal damage instead.

lore_ability.name: Summon Doomblast Dirgehorn
lore_ability.lore: Drawn from beneath the earth, animal bones are fused into the shape of a giant horn.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Doomblast Dirgehorn** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Doomblast Dirgehorn** wholly within 18" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Bashdokk Dance
lore_ability.lore: Thumping his feet in a hectic rhythm, the Wardokk gets the boyz ready to have a massive rukk.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BONESPLITTERZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls and run rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 7+, in addition, for the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Chalice of Ushoran
lore_ability.lore: The wizard conjures forth a manifestation of the sacred cup held by Ushoran. This bone-wrought goblet is filled with the blood of those slain in its presence.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Chalice of Ushoran** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Chalice of Ushoran** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
lore_ability.lore: Comprising a pair of shadowy mirrors, the Umbral Spellportal links two points on the battlefield, allowing wizards to cast their destructive magics and enchanting boons at a distance.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Umbral Spellportal** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Umbral Spellportal** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An **Umbral Spellportal** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Mork's Kunnin'
lore_ability.lore: The shaman channels the raw power of Mork to imbue their allies with uncanny cunning so they might evade enemy blows.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 12" of them, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to save rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Vermintide
lore_ability.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Drain Vitality
lore_ability.lore: This cursed spell saps a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Mighty 'Eadbutt
lore_ability.lore: The shaman headbutts the air, projecting a wave of green energy that seeks out enemies, especially spell-flingas, to nut.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a **WIZARD**, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.

lore_ability.name: Summon Wrath-Axe
lore_ability.lore: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne's otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing red-hot from the Blood God's rage. At signs of weakness or wizardry, such a blazing axe appears in the air, splitting reality with its downwards stroke.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Wrath-axe** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Daemonic Simulacrum
lore_ability.lore: The wizard draws upon their understanding of change-lore to create a temporary portal for this mirage to enter the fray.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Daemonic Simulacrum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD T**o cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Daemonic Simulacrum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Prayer of Grimnir's Fury
lore_ability.lore: A red rage fills the hearts of those blessed by this furious benediction.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HERO** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

If the chanting roll was 8+, also add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Foot of Gork
lore_ability.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BIG WAAAGH! WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Steed of Tides
lore_ability.lore: The wizard conjures an agile elemental to transport comrades through the ethersea.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Skin of Brass
lore_ability.lore: A shimmering skull manifests over a chosen champion, spilling gore upon them and granting their skin the hue and toughness of freshly forged brass.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GORECHOSEN CHAMPIONS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

lore_ability.name: Summon Horrorghast
lore_ability.lore: Arcane predators that feast upon fear, Horrorghasts haunt the deathly wilds of Shyish, taking on the appearance of whatever will most terrorise their prey – most often the pitiless gaze of Nagash, the Great Necromancer.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Horrorghast** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Horrorghast** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Mawmeat
lore_ability.lore: Chunks of meat glistening with ichor are flung into overgrown ruins and undergrowth to attract more Mawpits to the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, units on or within 1" of the target are **vulnerable to Mawpits**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.

lore_ability.name: Rank and Vile
lore_ability.lore: Slain foes are festooned with disease only to rise again amidst the Nurglite ranks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain, after removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 4+, return 1 slain model to a friendly non-**HERO CYCLE OF CORRUPTION INFANTRY** unit within 6" of the target.

lore_ability.name: Covenant of the Iron Heart
lore_ability.lore: The hearts of the Murder God’s followers become as cold and hard as iron, crushing their fears and doubts with a chilling contempt.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 10 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Bolster Creation
lore_ability.lore: Power flowing from their talons, the Mortisan hardens the osseous frames of their crafted soldiers.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase.

lore_ability.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-Sigil
lore_ability.lore: Eightfold Doom-Sigils are icons of Chaos in all its glory, blazing symbols of pure ruin. To fall in the presence of such a sorcerous construct is to be damned, for these lingering spells hungrily suck souls into the Realm of Chaos for the gods to feast upon.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-Sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-Sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Chains of Death
lore_ability.lore: With an unearthly howl, hundreds of spectral chains burst from the caster's billowing form, ensnaring their straining victim from head to foot.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
lore_ability.lore: The shaman summons a cruel, glowing swamp that channels memories of Gorkamorka’s past brawls.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Shield of Fate
lore_ability.lore: There is little better protection than to be guided by destiny itself and to be defended by the very hand of fate.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• ﻿﻿The target has **WARD (5+)**.
﻿﻿• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit.

lore_ability.name: Invigorate the Ranks
lore_ability.lore: The Mortisan pours energy into nearby soldiers, multiplying their combat prowess thricefold.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Thundershock
lore_ability.lore: The wizard unleashes the power of Sigmar's storm as a wave of pure force, leaving the foe stunned and disoriented.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
lore_ability.lore: The skies darken as screeching swarms of spectral bats descend upon the battlefield, hungry for blood.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanguine Swarm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Sanguine Swarm** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Sanguine Swarm** spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Wrench Souls
lore_ability.lore: With a clasped fist and a horrible twist, the caster drags a horde of gheists to their desired location.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO** **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

lore_ability.name: On Wings of Shadow
lore_ability.lore: With a flick of their wrist, the caster summons umbral tendrils that carry their allies away along paths unseen.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **ZAINTHAR KAI** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Song of Vengeance
lore_ability.lore: The grovekeeper cries out in vengeful fury, exhorting their forest kin to strike down the invading enemy and water the soil with their lifeblood.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SOULPOD GUARDIANS** unit that is wholly within 12" of them and not in combat or that is wholly within 12" of your **Soulpod Grove** to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. The target(s) can move up to 5" and can end that move in combat.

lore_ability.name: Morkish Mist
lore_ability.lore: Conjuring a slithering mist from rents in the earth, the shaman cloaks their advancing mobs.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **MURKVAST MENAGERIE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+)**.

lore_ability.name: Viletide
lore_ability.lore: A seemingly ceaseless wave of bile, gore and writhing insects crashes into the enemy.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use commands.

lore_ability.name: Wither
lore_ability.lore: The spellcaster hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Empowered Celestite
lore_ability.lore: Tapping into the ancient technologies within the weapons of the Coalesced, a light is birthed in each; for a few moments, every strike shatters armour in an explosion of sparks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SAURUS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Malevolent Moon
lore_ability.lore: The shaman transforms a loonstone statue into a huge glowing terror and lets it loose on the battlefield.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Malevolent Moon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Malevolent Moon** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Scumfall
lore_ability.lore: With murmured incantation, the caster coaxes forth a scummy dust from Nurgle’s orchards to blanket his followers in an obfuscating cloud.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **GARDENERS OF NURGLE** units that are wholly within 12" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** are not visible to units more than 9" away.

lore_ability.name: Fell Riders
lore_ability.lore: Words of power twist the air and ghostly green flames explode from the hooves of the Clattering Procession's steeds, giving them a deadly burst of speed.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick the caster and up to 1 other visible friendly **CLATTERING PROCESSION** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Warpgale
lore_ability.lore: Screeching in an unholy tongue, the caster parts the veil of reality and draws a ravening gale of unnatural energies forth.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Awakened Fury
lore_ability.lore: At the sorcerer’s gesture, hooves are wreathed in balefire and monstrous talons grow elongated and wickedly sharp.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Crimson Keep unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Companion** melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
lore_ability.lore: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster.

lore_ability.name: Jade Thorns
lore_ability.lore: The caster enhances the blades and claws of the Sylvaneth and their spite companions with spectral thorns that rake flesh and cause horrific ragged wounds.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons.

lore_ability.name: Summon Realmscourge Rupture
lore_ability.lore: Realmscourge Ruptures are not subtle weapons. When the necessary magical power has been channelled and released by a tribal shaman, the land itself writhes in the grip of Chaos, sharpened spikes surging forth like an accursed tidal wave to overwhelm anything in their path.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Realmscourge Rupture** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Realmscourge Rupture** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Dreadful Visage
lore_ability.lore: Inhaling draughts of hallucinogenic incense, the caster externalises their most unnatural desires in the form of a screaming daemonic visage.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Dreadful Visage** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Dreadful Visage** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Beacons of Protection
lore_ability.lore: Glowing with inner light, the Lumineth’s spellcasters envelop themselves and nearby allies in a radiant shield.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to friendly non-**MONSTER LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** units each phase while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD**. Add 3" to the range for each additional time this spell has been successfully cast by a friendly **WIZARD** this battle round.

lore_ability.name: Choking Mist
lore_ability.lore: The shaman summons a cloud of corrosive vapour that scorches the lungs of any caught within it.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Bolt of Tzeentch
lore_ability.lore: This spell manifests as a prismatic beam of raw magic that tears its victims apart in a display of multispectral colour.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Foot of Gork
lore_ability.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

lore_ability.name: Bless Weapons
lore_ability.lore: The priest imbues the weapons of their brethren with the pure essence of the storm.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 12+, this ability affects all visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units wholly within 12" of the chanter.

lore_ability.name: A Midsummer Mania
lore_ability.lore: The screeched canticles and gibberings of this Cardinal fill the ghouls with madness enough to shrug off fatal injury.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **EQUINOX FEAST PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Return D3 slain models to the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, return D3+3 slain models to the target unit instead.

lore_ability.name: Shackling Curse
lore_ability.lore: A daemonic hex of Urak Taar’s own devising is placed upon the foe, blunting their strikes.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GRAND FORGEHOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

lore_ability.name: Burn to Ash
lore_ability.lore: Twisted Zharralid cantrips ignite the land until it is blackened and withered.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the target has a Health characteristic, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on it. Then, if the target was not destroyed or does not have a Health characteristic:

• The target gains the ‘Obscuring’ terrain ability for the rest of the battle (Terrain, 1.2).
• If the target is **FACTION TERRAIN**, until the start of your next turn, abilities on that terrain feature’s warscroll have no effect.

lore_ability.name: Wyrdflame Haze
lore_ability.lore: The caster causes the smoke from arcane blazes to linger on the battlefield, obscuring those lurking within.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TEENTCH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was set up in the same turn.

lore_ability.name: Fold Reality
lore_ability.lore: The sorcerer contorts the very fabric of the cosmos, allowing their minions to slip from hither to thither in an eye-blink.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then you can pick a friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Set the target up in reserve **masked by illusion.** Then, you can pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up wholly within 12" of the caster or a friendly **Argent Shard** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Both parts of the effect are optional; you can carry out either part or both.*

lore_ability.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
lore_ability.lore: Those incarnates first encountered in the Krondspine Range of Ghur are terrifying entities, creations of bestial energy protected by monstrous bones and guided by ferocious intellect. Like all things of the Realm of Beasts, they are driven by the laws of predator and prey – and as thaumaphages, they prey upon other manifestations that roam the realm.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Summon Vault of Souls
lore_ability.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Vault of Souls** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **ETERNAL NIGHTMARE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Vault of Souls** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Ever Turning
lore_ability.lore: The priest beseeches Nurgle to bestow his gifts upon his Rotbringer followers.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CYCLE OF CORRUPTION PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: The next **CYCLE** ability in the sequence is ripe for the rest of the battle round instead of the current **CYCLE** ability. If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick which **CYCLE** ability is ripe.

lore_ability.name: Binding Damnation
lore_ability.lore: At the caster’s urging, tendrils of raw Chaos burst from the tortured ground, entwining the limbs of their enemies and rendering them easy prey.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Get 'Em, Gork!
lore_ability.lore: The bellowing and pounding of an Ironmongerz Warchanter can see Gork’s divine belligerence unleashed upon enemy battlements.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZOGGROK’S IRONMONGERZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the chanting roll was 5-9, pick a visible terrain feature wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 10+, pick a visible terrain feature wholly within 18" of the chanter instead. That terrain feature is **trampled by Gork** for the rest of the battle.

Roll a D3 each time an enemy unit ends a move within 6" of a terrain feature that is **trampled by Gork**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

lore_ability.name: Miasma of Madness
lore_ability.lore: The wizard calls forth a sanity-warping mist to engulf the foe.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **NEW SUMMERCOURT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Reverberating Ritual
lore_ability.lore: The priest chants in time with the tolling of the Warpshatter Bells, sonically shattering the last dregs of sanity from nearby ratmen and filling them with dreadful hunger.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GNAWHORDE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can move an extra 3" when it makes a pile-in move. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Wrath-axe
lore_ability.lore: A Wrath-axe is a manifestation of Khorne's otherworldly anger, its razor-sharp edges glowing from the heat of the Blood God's rage. As a chanting priest carves the ground open, these eldritch axes appear to tear the air in twain, reality set ablaze at its passage.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wrath-axe** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Wrath-axe** wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Searing Detonation
lore_ability.lore: The sorcerer grasps dark fire in their claws, crushing it into a dense and howling nova before unleashing it in a wave of devastation.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ZIGGURAT STAMPEDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick each enemy unit in combat with them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

lore_ability.name: Counter-Current
lore_ability.lore: The wizard summons a powerful current to hold their enemies at bay.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Crippling Despair
lore_ability.lore: With a sweep of their hand, the sorcerer imbues upon their victim with an overwhelming sense of hopelessness that renders them oblivious to their surroundings.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Song of Dread
lore_ability.lore: Discordant notes and eerie wails herald a sinister change in the spirit-song, causing the shadows to gather thick around a group of foes. It takes but a single misstep to discover what lurks within the dark…
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick an enemy unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a **MOVE** ability and ends that move within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict D3 mortal damage on that target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Summon Bleeding Icon
lore_ability.lore: A common sight in the crimson skies above Khorne's domain, a Bleeding Icon can be summoned to the Mortal Realms to signal the attention - and the displeasure - of the Lord of Battles.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Bleeding Icon** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Bleeding Icon** wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Blunting Blight
lore_ability.lore: The priest ‘improves’ their foe’s weapons, corroding their nasty sharp edges and dulling their horridly glinting points.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, the targets’ attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

lore_ability.name: Agonising Vomiting
lore_ability.lore: Presaged by a deep rumble within their distended guts, the priest belches forth a deluge of thick, corrosive vomit.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll 7 dice. If the target is **DISEASED**, add 1 to each roll. If the chanting roll was 7+, add 1 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

lore_ability.name: Speed of the Twin-Tailed Comet
lore_ability.lore: Banners blaze with ethereal fire and trail comet-like contrails as the Freeguilders hurl themselves forward to meet the enemy.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
