lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non‑**WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Benediction of the High Heavens
lore_ability.lore: The priest beseeches Sigmar to rain down restorative blessings upon his faithful, seeing lacerations heal and broken bones reknit.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick another visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

lore_ability.name: High Star's Light
lore_ability.lore: The mage summons a simulacrum of Sigendil, the High Star of Azyr, to inspire their allies to the greatest heights of valour.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

lore_ability.name: Holy Aegis
lore_ability.lore: A shimmering barrier manifests around the beneficiary, dulling the impact of enemy attacks.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.

lore_ability.name: Reckoning of Sinners
lore_ability.lore: Searing oratory causes enemies to be stricken by the weight of the sins and outrages they have committed against the God-King’s folk.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

lore_ability.name: The Chant of Iron
lore_ability.lore: The alliance between Grungni the Maker and Sigmar the God-King is writ large upon the priest’s brow as divine creation and celestial wrath combine.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly **IRON MARCH** unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If you picked an enemy unit:

• If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
•Subtract 2" from each target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

If you picked a friendly unit, **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **IRON MARCH** unit that is wholly 12" of the chanter and that has not been healed by this ability this turn instead.

lore_ability.name: Divine Mandate
lore_ability.lore: Sigmar’s quest to drive Chaos from reality and reconquer the Mortal Realms imbues his faithful with his dread aspect of war, that of a furious and all-conquering warrior king.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

lore_ability.name: These Realms are Ours
lore_ability.lore: The allies of Sigmar share a desire to restore civilisation and stability to the realms, whatever the cost.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective.

lore_ability.name: Song of the Lost
lore_ability.lore: The chanter alters the spirit-song to remind the Sylvaneth of the fallen, inspiring them with heroic resolve.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not a **MONSTER**, ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Curse of Scorched Metal
lore_ability.lore: The wizard causes the weapons of their foes to grow unbearably hot, searing their flesh to the bone.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an **ATTACK** ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that **ATTACK** ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Overwhelming Acquiescence
lore_ability.lore: The wizard engulfs the foe in an arcane haze of dreams and unattainable desires.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units for attacks that target that enemy unit, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

lore_ability.name: Last Ecstasy
lore_ability.lore: The caster induces such a state of mania that even death cannot stop a final revel.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the target unit is a **MONSTER**, roll 10 dice instead. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Hysterical Frenzy
lore_ability.lore: The wizard fires a sudden surge of ecstasy through nearby flesh, inspiring their minions into a maddened and cackling assault.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Summon Mesmerising Mirror
lore_ability.lore: Smashing a small glass mirror to the ground, the wizard uses magical energy to cause it to reform and grow in size.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Mesmerising Mirror** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Mesmerising Mirror** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Diverting Excruciation
lore_ability.lore: Sigvald’s pet mages know all sorts of magical means to enthuse, empower and revive their beloved lord.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DECADENT HOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Sigvald** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target.

lore_ability.name: Visions of Eternal Bliss
lore_ability.lore: One of the chief duties of Sigvald’s sorcerers is to stoke his eager sword-arm with mystic visions of his master’s sinful domain.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DECADENT HOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Sigvald** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target scores critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

lore_ability.name: Summon Manifestation of Depravity
lore_ability.lore: The god-spawn of Slaanesh and their chosen retainers are masters of the most extreme and decadent forms of magical conjuration.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Essence Transfusion
lore_ability.lore: Though bitter rivals, the Twins are ultimately born of the same godly stuff and can share strength between them if necessary.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **TWIN** to be the donor, pick another visible friendly **TWIN** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Allocate any number of damage points to the donor (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is double the number of damage points allocated to the donor by this use of this ability.

lore_ability.name: Sibilant Whispers
lore_ability.lore: The commands of the Twins are cast into the enemies’ minds, leaving them stumbling, uncertain and vulnerable.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly **TWIN** is visible to the target, halve the target’s Move characteristic. In addition, while 2 friendly **TWINS** are visible to the target, your opponent must roll 1 fewer dice, to a minimum of 1, when making charge rolls for it.

lore_ability.name: Ecstatic Furore
lore_ability.lore: The baser, bloodier aspects of Slaanesh’s nature are channelled through one of the Twins, filling their sycophants with rapturous murder‑lust.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **TWIN** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the target.

lore_ability.name: Shifting Manifestations
lore_ability.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly Manifestations below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**
lore_ability.effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Manifestations of Depravity
lore_ability.lore: There is no sort of spellcraft that Sigvald will not encourage his lackeys to pursue – no matter how vile.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DECADENT HOST WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

lore_ability.name: Summon Wheels of Excruciation
lore_ability.lore: Throwing a small multi-bladed knife into the air and channelling magical energy into it, the caster summons forth a storm of swiftly moving razor-sharp blades.
lore_ability.declare: If there is not a friendly **Wheels of Excruciation** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Set up a **Wheels of Excruciation** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

lore_ability.name: Cycle Manifestation
lore_ability.lore: With a deft gesture, the caster dismisses one manifestation and uses its power to summon another.
lore_ability.declare:
Pick a friendly **AELEMENTIRI CONCLAVE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

• **Sanctum of Amyntok**
• **Hyshian Twinstones**
• **Rune of Petrification**
lore_ability.effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them. If that **MANIFESTATION** is a **Sanctum of Amyntok**, it must instead be set up wholly within 12" of the caster, more than 3" from all enemy units, and with its 3 parts touching each other so that they form a ring.

lore_ability.name: Gift of Apoplexy
lore_ability.lore: The priest invokes a murderous rage in their enemies to which they must give vent... either against their foes or against each other.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses an ability that is not a **MOVE** or **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage o the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 3 mortal damage instead of D3.

lore_ability.name: Stoke The Flames
lore_ability.lore: The priest calls for their followers to slay and be slain as they channel the ire of Khorne.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• When resolving the damage sequence for enemy units in combat with the target, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
• If the target is destroyed, you gain 1 **rage dice**. If the chanting roll was 6+, you gain 2 **rage dice** instead.

lore_ability.name: Fetters of Blood
lore_ability.lore: Erupting from the ground by the enemy’s feet, these chains ensnare those who would flee the wrath of Khorne.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• The targets cannot use **RETREAT** or **RUN** abilities.
• The targets cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow them to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield or in reserve.

lore_ability.name: Febrile Advance
lore_ability.lore: Burning up with fever, the priest’s kin dive headlong into the fray in a twitching rush.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 3" to the distance each target can move when making pile‐in moves.

lore_ability.name: Ichor of the Ur-Salamander
lore_ability.lore: The priest blesses the warriors’ blood with the legendary lethality of Vulcatrix herself.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:

• If the target is a **MAGMADROTH**, each time its ‘Volcanic Blood’ ability would inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage instead.

• If the target is a non‐**MAGMADROTH** unit, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

lore_ability.name: Fury of Vulcatrix
lore_ability.lore: Eyes blazing white-hot, the priest fills their allies with the rage of the Ur-Salamander.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks, including those made with **Companion** weapons, until the start of your next turn.

In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Blazing Impetus
lore_ability.lore: The priest bellows a prayer, sparks fly from their mouth and nearby Fyreslayers leap into battle.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

lore_ability.name: Shincruncher
lore_ability.lore: The shaman strips the meat and splits the bone of a huge beast haunch; as they do so, the limbs of their enemies crack and splinter at the slightest movement.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved.

**Designer’s Note**: *The ‘Bull Charge’ ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.*

lore_ability.name: The Terrible Toes
lore_ability.lore: Yelling incomprehensibly, the priest jumps up and down. Nearby, enemies are squashed flat by invisible forces that leave massive footprints in the ground.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models are slain by this ability, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

lore_ability.name: Vocal Tectonics
lore_ability.lore: As the priest hums a single, low note, the earth shakes and buckles around them, staggering nearby enemies.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each target has **STRIKE-LAST**.

lore_ability.name: Itchy Nuisance
lore_ability.lore: The shaman covers the land in a bristly slime, the hairs of which cause unbearable itching.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are contesting the target objective.

lore_ability.name: Loonshrine Glow
lore_ability.lore: The wizard shines with the eerie light of the Bad Moon, drawing in troglodytic hordes.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, if a friendly **Bad Moon Loonshrine** uses the ‘Moonclan Lairs’ ability, you can set up the replacement unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units instead of wholly within 12" of that **Bad Moon Loonshrine**.

lore_ability.name: Puffballoons
lore_ability.lore: Bubble-like fungal growths appear all over nearby gitz that, when popped, shoot them into the air with a wet ‘thwip’.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an ability inflicts damage points on the target, after the ability has been resolved, the target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

lore_ability.name: Rock Bottom
lore_ability.lore: The priest dulls the gargants’ already monumentally low intelligence, turning them into primal beasts that cannot feel pain.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:

•  Ignore the effects of the ‘Battle Damaged’ ability on each target.
•  Each target has **WARD (6+)**.

lore_ability.name: Blood Feast
lore_ability.lore: The liver of a powerful beast is held high over the shaman’s head. Gore drips and runs down their face before they take a great bite from it, filling nearby ogors with a frenzied blood-lust.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

lore_ability.name: Tallowflage
lore_ability.lore: Smearing their flesh with sizzling, heated fat, the Butcher conjures a hazy shroud that conceals a band of nearby ogors from the enemy’s sight.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.

lore_ability.name: Freezing Tailwinds
lore_ability.lore: At the priest’s urging, the howling winds of the Everwinter blow with greater ferocity, biting at the ogors and speeding the horde onwards.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.

lore_ability.name: Pulverising Hailstorm
lore_ability.lore: The harsh bellowing of the priest summons a rain of fist-sized hailstones to pummel the enemy from above.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).

lore_ability.name: Fortifying Hoarfrost
lore_ability.lore: As the priest growls a command to winter itself, a glittering layer of ice starts spreading over the flesh of their followers, a mystical armour capable of turning blades.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

lore_ability.name: Keening Gale
lore_ability.lore: Marshalling the might of the Everwinter, the Huskard empowers their fellows to ride the freezing hurricane.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ALFROSTUN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **ALFROSTUN** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 2 to run rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to charge rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Terrors of the Old Ice
lore_ability.lore: At the Huskard’s gesture, the Everwinter swirls around a part of the battlefield. Primeval mirages dance in its embrace, sapping even the sternest courage.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ALFROSTUN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick an objective or terrain feature wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are contesting the target.

lore_ability.name: Avalanche Voice
lore_ability.lore: Bashing their weapon against their gutplate, the ogor priest inhales deeply before loosing a deafening bellow like an arctic wind roaring through a mountain pass. Enemies caught in the blast of sound are temporarily deafened and stunned, and it takes a while for them to regather their wits.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **ALFROSTUN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
lore_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent declares a command for the target, as a reaction, make a tremor roll of D6 for the target. On a 5+, unless they spend 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, add 2 to tremor rolls for the target.

lore_ability.name: Bonecruncher
lore_ability.lore: Chomping down on skulls, femurs and ribs, the Butcher mystically breaks the bodies of their enemies, ripe for harvesting.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GOLLOP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Gain a number of **raw ingredients** equal to the number of those damage points that are allocated to the target.

lore_ability.name: Bloodgruel
lore_ability.lore: The Butcher sucks the congealed blood, marrow and other juices from a specially preserved severed limb before belching it up in a magical cloud that invigorates other ogors.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GOLLOP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GOLLOP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:
• Return 1 slain model to the target.
• **Heal (D6)** the target.

lore_ability.name: The Cosmos Writhes
lore_ability.lore: The glottal spells of the Butchers tap into something beyond sane knowledge – a divine power that contorts the world like twisting guts, briefly breaking spatial law with its hunger.
lore_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GOLLOP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GOLLOP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
lore_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

terrain_ability.name: Obscuring
terrain_ability.rules:
This rule varies depending on the battlepack selected for your army:

**General's Handbook 2024-25**
A unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks made by enemy units that are not within its combat range if it is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless it has the **FLY** keyword.

**General's Handbook 2025-26**
While every model in a non-**MONSTER** non‐**WAR MACHINE** unit that does not have the **FLY** keyword is within 1" of this terrain feature, the following apply:
•That unit is only visible to enemy units that are within its combat range.
•The Range characteristic of that unit’s ranged weapons is halved (rounding down to the nearest inch).

**General's Handbook 2026-27**
While every model in a non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE** unit that does not have the **FLY** keyword is within 1" of this terrain feature, the following apply:
• That unit is only visible to enemy units that are within its combat range.
• The Range characteristic of that unit’s ranged weapons is halved (rounding down to the nearest inch).

warscroll.name: Vanguard-Hunters
warscroll.lore: Vanguard-Hunters are well suited for lifetimes spent in the wilds. Their short handaxes and weighted blades are as ideal for hacking through dense foliage as they are for carving apart flesh, while compact boltstorm pistols allow the Stormcasts to assail their prey even as they close in on them.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Vanguard Chamber

warscroll.name: Akhelian King
warscroll.lore: Akhelian Kings are the war leaders of the Idoneth enclaves. Mounted atop fierce and intelligent Deepmares, these inspiring commanders fight at the forefront of every battle, urging their Phalanxes forward as they wield their blades with deadly skill.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Cavalry, Fly, Order, Idoneth Deepkin, Aelf, Akhelian

warscroll.name: Yndrasta, the Celestial Spear
warscroll.lore: Yndrasta is Sigmar’s Huntress. Her spear, Thengavar, is steel-sister to the God-King’s own legendary polearm; when hurled, it seeks out her prey, piercing its monstrous heart before returning to Yndrasta’s grip. There are those who whisper that lifetimes of battle have hollowed out Yndrasta’s soul and replaced it with pitiless starfire, her divine aura so intense it can protect her even from the emanations of Chaos. Even other Stormcasts mutter a prayer as she hunts the deadliest prey in the realms, for her transformation into an unfeeling instrument of vengeance sparks unease. Yet she remains one of Sigmar’s greatest champions, and her might is questioned by none.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Fly, Ward (6+), Infantry

warscroll.name: Skink Starseer
warscroll.lore:
The highest-ranking skink priests are known as Starseers. They are renowned for their miraculous gifts of prophecy and foresight and for their deep connection to the workings of the heavens. Venerable creatures from a species not known for its longevity, the physically frail Starseers prefer to travel atop floating seats of power festooned with charms and astromantic tools – ancient devices that also act as powerful receptors for arcane energies.

From their perch, a Starseer surveys the battlefield, channelling the magic of the stars and manipulating it to destroy their enemies or grant boons to their allies. They wield tools befitting of their station, such as orbs of pure star glass, which they use to scry the near-future and foresee those rare and potent moments when the stars align and the patterns of fate reveal themselves. This insight they gift to their own servants, granting them protection from incoming attacks. In the same fashion, a Starseer can harness their deep connection to Azyr to subtly alter the patterns of fate, exposing their enemies to doom and disaster.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (2), Infantry, Fly, Order, Seraphon, Skink

warscroll.name: Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch
warscroll.lore: Tzeentch Chaos Spawn are, if anything, even more horrifically mutated than others of their kind. Altered at the whim of the Change God, they tear their prey limb from limb with their freakish array of claws, tentacles and hooked appendages.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Beast, Chaos, Disciples of Tzeentch

warscroll.name: Hobgrot Slittaboss
warscroll.lore: Slittabosses command the hobgrot kompanies that maraud across the realms in search of plunder. They are not only the most physically imposing and dark-hearted of their kind but also the canniest. Each is a master swindler and murderous in ripping loot from the battlefield, no matter who currently possesses it.
warscroll.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Mob Wrangler*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Destruction, Kruleboyz

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Anointed Sentinels
warscroll.lore: The zealous Anointed Sentinels keep vigil over the desolations wrought in Hashut’s name across the Great Parch and beyond, quoting diabolic scripture while goring and impaling any who draw near.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Chaos, Helsmiths of Hashut, Duardin

warscroll.name: Maulbeast Cavalry
warscroll.lore: Maulbeast Cavalry are unleashed when a Gutbuster warlord wants something properly and thoroughly savaged. The brutish beasts these veterans ride upon are far from intelligent, but they are always hungry and up for the hunt. When such mountains of frenzied meat crash into the foe, the mess left behind must be seen to be believed.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Gutbusters

warscroll.name: Leadbelchers
warscroll.lore: The blackpowder-obsessed gunners known as Leadbelchers lumber into battle, blasting away with their massive guns and utilising them as makeshift bludgeons should the foe be foolish enough to engage them in hand-to-hand combat.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Gutbusters

warscroll.name: Dais Arcanum
warscroll.lore: A Dais Arcanum is a machine-like conjuration capable of repelling a realmsphere’s gravity and travelling through the air at great speed. Its innate magic is attuned to the soul of the warrior who rides upon it: with a thought they can bid the Dais to glide out of the way of an oncoming attack or draw power from its gleaming wake to augment their spellcraft.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Fly, Order, Stormcast Eternals

warscroll.name: Abhorrant Gorewarden
warscroll.lore: A Gorewarden bears the keys to the kingdom and oversees the protection of their liege’s borderlands. They perch, gargoyle-like, atop toppled spires and battlements for days and nights on end, eyes blazing. Once they sight their prey, the vampire throws their head back, shrieking for the hunt. Clad in what they perceive to be great finery, the Gorewarden leads a flight of bloodthirsty predators to savage the unwary intruders.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard, Infantry, Fly, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Chaos Chariot
warscroll.lore: Swift Chaos Chariots thunder across the plains hunting for worthy foes. Drawn by corrupted steeds, the momentum of these constructs is a weapon of its own, and the charioteers take dark pleasure in crushing enemies beneath their spiked wheels, each as heavy as a boulder of iron. Once the chariot has smashed a hole through the enemy’s main formation, it will rampage among their back lines with impunity, its riders lashing and bludgeoning stragglers and any who try to flee with cruel abandon.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine

warscroll.name: Crypt Haunter Courtier
warscroll.lore: Masters of a kingdom’s knightly echelons, Crypt Haunters are amongst the most physically powerful of an abhorrant’s courtiers. They lead their misbegotten kin in bone-crunching charges and revel in tearing foes limb from bloody limb.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Ward (6+), Death, Flesh-eater Courts, Noble

warscroll.name: Mask of the Deceiver
warscroll.lore: The Changeling adopts one of its manifold masks to infiltrate the enemy ranks, spreading confusion and dismay whilst ensuring that the Change God’s schemes come to pass.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Wizard (2), Infantry, Ward (5+), Chaos, Disciples of Tzeentch, Daemon

warscroll.name: Soul Grinder
warscroll.lore: Sometimes, when a daemon is banished in an especially humiliating fashion, their bitterness will lead them to seek the insane overseers of the Forge of Souls. To these seekers is offered a bargain: an opportunity to re-enter the Mortal Realms far sooner than the terms of banishment typically allows in exchange for paying a tithe of souls to the forgemasters. Daemons who accept these stipulations are transformed; they become Soul Grinders, fusions of metal and raw Chaotic energy, unleashed upon the hapless realms.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Monster, Ward (6+), Chaos, Slaves to Darkness, Daemon

warscroll.name: Hexgorger Skulls
warscroll.lore: Hexgorger Skulls are the physical manifestation of Khorne’s hatred of the arcane arts. They drift across the battlefield, seeking to feed upon eldritch energy and those conjurers who attempt to use it.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Invocation, Fly, Ward (6+), Chaos, Blades of Khorne

warscroll.name: Ionus Cryptborn, Warden of Lost Souls
warscroll.lore: After several lifetimes in Sigmar’s service, Ionus has been called by the God-King to a higher purpose. He serves as his champion across every realm, reinforcing Stormhosts that have been repeatedly ground down and helping to guide their diminishing souls back towards the path of light. However, once a protracted campaign is finally shepherded to its end, he gathers up those Stormcasts barely clinging to their humanity and leads them to the Bleak Citadels of the Ruination chambers.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Monster, Priest (2), Fly, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Ruination Chamber

warscroll.name: Killaboss with Stab-grot
warscroll.lore: Killabosses are the warlords of the Kruleboyz. Each has wrested their position from rivals by being not only a potent warrior but also possessed of true Morkish kunnin’, willing to use anyone or anything to garner an advantage.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Mob Wrangler*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Destruction, Kruleboyz

warscroll.name: The Farstriders
warscroll.lore: Sanson Farstrider is one of the most experienced Hunter-Primes in the Hammers of Sigmar. He and his band of veteran rangers specialise in undertaking the most critical and death-defying of missions behind enemy lines.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Infantry, Champion, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Vanguard Chamber
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with a Boltstorm Pistol and a Stormwrought Weapon. The models in this unit are:***

• ***Sanson Farstrider** (champion)*
• ***Almeric Eagle-Eye***
• ***Elias Swiftblade***

warscroll.name: Gardus Steel Soul
warscroll.lore: Lord-Celestant Gardus is revered by many mortals as a warrior-saint, and since his second Reforging, a halo of gleaming light has surrounded him. His warriors believe this to be the purity of their Lord‑Celestant’s spirit made manifest, and they would follow him into the mouth of ruin itself if he so required.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Ward (5+), Order, Stormcast Eternals, Warrior Chamber

warscroll.name: Knight-Azyros
warscroll.lore: A winged herald borne aloft on wings of flame, the Knight-Azyros is a symbol of hope and faith to the followers of Sigmar. Each carries a sacred lantern the light from which guides and heals the righteous even as it sears the eyes of Sigmar's enemies.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Fly, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Ruination Chamber

warscroll.name: Fomoroid Crusher
warscroll.lore: Brutish creatures from a lost age, the Fomoroid Crushers now exist only to tear down and destroy. In battle they fly into a terrible rage, torturous memories of the creatures they once were lending their blows a maddened strength.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Monster, Chaos, Slaves to Darkness

warscroll.name: Scourge of Ghyran Kurdoss Valentian, the Craven King
warscroll.lore: Kurdoss Valentian is a malevolent spirit known to all as the Craven King. This mocking epithet belies a cunning mind, for few can rival Valentian’s grasp of strategy and ruthless will to win. His mistress, Lady Olynder, has demanded that Ghyran be drowned in terror and her word is Valentian’s command. Brandishing his great sceptre, he orders his gheist armies into battle, his traitorous legacy inspiring them to commit fell deeds of their own.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Fly, Ward (5+), Death, Nighthaunt

warscroll.name: Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors
warscroll.lore: Blue Horrors are grumbling daemons that despise existence and all who dwell within it, and they delight in burning it down. If they are destroyed, they transform into bounding Brimstone Horrors that continue to attack with mindless spite.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Ward (6+), Chaos, Disciples of Tzeentch, Daemon
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***This unit starts the battle with 10 Blue Horror models or, if it is a reinforced unit, 20 Blue Horror models.***

***Brimstone Horrors models can be added to this unit using the ‘Split Again’ ability.***

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Megaboss
warscroll.lore: Ironjawz respect strength and aggression, and the Megabosses have those qualities in abundance. Echoing across the Great Parch come bellows of ‘Waaagh!’ as these belligerent warlords lead their warclans into the fray.
warscroll.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Headstompa*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Destruction, Ironjawz

warscroll.name: Pusgoyle Blightlords
warscroll.lore: Elite Rotbringers mounted atop Rot Flies, Pusgoyle Blightlords thrum ahead of their kindred to sow panic and death. Their crushing tocsins and whistling scythes make short work of any who would slow the spread of decay.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Fly, Ward (6+), Chaos, Maggotkin of Nurgle, Rotbringers

warscroll.name: Megaboss
warscroll.lore: Clad in layers of thick iron and wielding massive weapons, Megabosses lead the charge of the Ironjawz warclans. The very act of fighting empowers these barbarous warlords. Once in the midst of combat, they are almost impossible to slay.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry

warscroll.name: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell
warscroll.lore: Of all the strange constructs fashioned by the Skaven, Screaming Bells are perhaps the most diabolical. From a rickety conveyance of wood hangs a great brass bell, studded with warpstone and marked with glowing runes. A Grey Seer, a prophet of the Horned Rat, scrabbles across the bell, hurling commands at their minions below and conjuring storms of magic from their bizarre pulpit. Then the device rings, and all hell breaks loose.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, War Machine, Wizard (2), Ward (5+), Chaos, Skaven, Masterclan

warscroll.name: Terradon Riders
warscroll.lore:
Terradon Riders are a force of lightning-swift, deadly aerial cavaliers who rely upon blistering speed and agility to defeat their enemies. In battle, they are often the first skink formations to do battle with the enemy. Urged on by their skink masters, the winged reptiles tuck their wings and dart past the despairing swipes of their quarry as their riders unleash a flurry of hurled javelins. Some even throw bolas strapped with naturally volatile sunleeches that burst upon impact, showering everything in the vicinity with liquid flame.

It is the Terradons themselves that carry the most devastating weapons, however. Clutched between their hind limbs they carry heavy spheres which they release from great heights. These orbs – chunks of meteoric rock enclosed in metal and marked with sigils of destruction – blaze through the skies like miniature comets, detonating in a burst of heavenly starlight. The force of this explosion shatters both sphere and stone, sending out a lethal hail of fragments that is especially deadly to warriors packed together in close proximity.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Fly, Order, Seraphon, Skink

warscroll.name: Lord-Terminos
warscroll.lore: A Lord-Terminos's axe culls their enemies in great measure, but so too does it take the heads of fellow Stormcasts. These grim figures do not seek out the afflicted like merciless angels of death, however: these damaged souls come forth willingly, knowing that their time in the Mortal Realms has come to its inevitable end.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Ruination Chamber

warscroll.name: Great Bray-Shaman
warscroll.lore: The Great Bray-Shamans are the soothsayers and mystics of the beastherds. What they lack in raw strength, they make up for with a mastery of Chaos magic that can reduce a foe to a writhing mass of corrupted flesh.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Chaos, Beasts of Chaos, Brayherd

warscroll.name: Slaughter Queen
warscroll.lore: It is a Slaughter Queen’s role to embody the aggressive martial prowess of Khaine himself. With blades in hand, the Slaughter Queen hacks and spins in the maelstrom of close combat while chanting blood-curdling battle rites
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest (1), Infantry, Ward (6+), Order, Daughters of Khaine, Aelf

warscroll.name: Maw-grunta Gougers
warscroll.lore: Having managed against the odds to acquire a Maw-grunta mount, Maw-grunta Gougers gather together into stampeding mobs, the monstrous hogs trampling enemies into the mud and crushing them to a bloody pulp beneath their cloven hooves.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Monster, Destruction, Ironjawz, Maw‑grunta

warscroll.name: Kragnos, the End of Empires
warscroll.lore: One of the most destructive races to have ever lived, the Drogrukh were centauroid warriors who built a great nation in the Realm of Beasts. From their number rose a champion so powerful that he ascended to godhood: Kragnos, the End of Empires. Having led his people in warfare against a draconic empire that le the Drogrukh all but extinct, Kragnos was sealed away for the protection of the realms – only to be freed centuries later.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Monster, Ward (5+), Destruction, Bonesplitterz

warscroll.name: Spiteclaw's Swarm
warscroll.lore: Skritch Spiteclaw is a particularly cunning Skaven warlord who has assembled an impressive horde of cut-throat vermin to serve his will. Though he prefers that his minions fight and die on his behalf, when cornered, Skritch becomes a whirling dervish of spiked steel and ripping claws. Skritch Spiteclaw entrusts the command and discipline of his verminous ranks to the sadistic taskmaster Krrk the Almost-trusted. Though for now he is content to spend Skaven lives at his master’s command, the foul-spirited Krrk has his own ambitious schemes for power.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Infantry, Chaos, Skaven, Verminus
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***The models in this unit are:***

• ***Skritch Spiteclaw** (armed with a Wicked Halberd)*
• ***Krrk the Almost-trusted** (armed with a Rusty Weapon)*
• ***The Lurking Skaven** (armed with a Rusty Weapon)*
• ***The Festering Skaven** (armed with a Rusty Weapon)*
• ***The Hungering Skaven** (armed with a Rusty Weapon)*

warscroll.name: Feculent Gnarlmaw
warscroll.lore: Wherever Nurgle’s armies gather, Feculent Gnarlmaws take root. These disgusting trees ring with the tolling of entropic chimes and shed rot- wet blossom to carpet the befouled earth beneath their boughs.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Faction Terrain, Ward (5+), Chaos, Maggotkin of Nurgle
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
**The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):**

**Cover, Impassable**

warscroll.name: Ungors
warscroll.lore: The most man-like of the gor-kin, Ungors are tormented and despised by their stronger cousins. They take out their bitterness on their enemies, spitefully thrusting their shortspears into throats and bellies and darting away before the foe can retaliate.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Chaos, Beasts of Chaos, Brayherd

warscroll.name: Lord-Vigilant on Morrgryph
warscroll.lore: A rare few Lord-Vigilants earn the trust and companionship of a Morrgryph, a creature sacred to the Bleak Raven. Their riders usually wield a long-hafted glaive for the reach it provides from their high saddle and its devastating power on the charge.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Fly, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Ruination Chamber

warscroll.name: Malevolent Moon
warscroll.lore: The Malevolent Moon is conjured when a shaman raises high a carved loonstone simulacrum of the Bad Moon and jabbers the right words. The statue swells into a cackling, glowing abomination that sweeps across the battlefield wreaking havoc.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Fly, Ward (6+), Destruction, Gloomspite Gitz

warscroll.name: Abhorrant Cardinal
warscroll.lore: Abhorrant Cardinals seek to spread the glory of Ushoran across every land. Having drunk from the Carrion King’s chalice, they have gained a measure of unwitting control over the delusion, using bloody rites to stoke their flock’s rabid fury.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest (1), Infantry, Ward (6+), Death, Flesh-eater Courts, Abhorrant

warscroll.name: Squigboss with Gnasha-Squig
warscroll.lore: Squigbosses command their fungal herds through the offering of prized mushrooms and occasional jabbings from their squig-krooks. Most are accompanied by loyal Gnasha-squigs, who gleefully chomp at anything that gets too close.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Moonclan Agitator*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Destruction, Gloomspite Gitz, Squig, Moonclan

warscroll.name: Gluttons
warscroll.lore: Ogor Gluttons are hulking, muscle-bound brutes driven entirely by an unending desire for food. They thunder into battle like a landslide of sweaty flesh, taking great bites out of their foes even as they bash and hack with crude clubs and cleavers.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/5), Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Gutbusters

warscroll.name: Steam Tank Commander
warscroll.lore: At the forefront of larger Steam Tank formations ride the Steam Tank Commanders, veterans of countless battles who are deft at coordinating shock assaults that leave the enemy shattered and reeling.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, War Machine, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Symbaresh Twinsouls
warscroll.lore: Even by the standards of the Sybarites, the Symbaresh are proud indeed. These former Myrmidesh have forged dark pacts with the lesser daemons of Slaanesh, sharing their mortal forms in return for a measure of otherworldly power.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit
warscroll.lore: Many Endrinmasters take to the skies in master-crafted dirigible suits, their aetherturbines allowing them to zoom through the air towards skyvessels in need of repair even as an in-built weapon array blasts their enemies into pieces.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Fly, Order, Kharadron Overlords, Duardin, Skyfarer

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Brutes
warscroll.lore: Charging across the Aqshian lava plains with bellicose glee, Brutes smash and bash their way through foe after foe, ever seeking to demonstrate that they are the smashiest and bashiest.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Destruction, Ironjawz, Brute
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Brute Weapons.***

• ***1/5 models can replace their Brute Weapons with a Gore-choppa.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapons.***

warscroll.name: Mortalis Terminexus
warscroll.lore: A looming, phantasmal hourglass, the Mortalis Terminexus can distort the very passage of time, its mere presence hastening the advance of the Nighthaunt processions. Should its flow be reversed, it can even undo harm done to the spectral forms of nearby gheists, much to the horror of their enemies.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Ward (6+), Death, Nighthaunt

warscroll.name: Liege-Kavalos
warscroll.lore: A Liege-Kavalos is a cavalry commander of uncanny skill and resilience. With a harsh order, they can drive their Bonereapers to redouble their attack, hacking into the enemy ranks even as they fell dangerous foes with their commander's blade.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Legion Subcommander*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Cavalry, Ward (6+), Relentless Discipline (6), Death, Ossiarch Bonereapers

warscroll.name: Cyreni's Razors
warscroll.lore: A true master of the abyss, Cyreni leads her guards through the most inhospitable of places in search of precious soulstuff. She wields the power of a Tidecaster with crushing pressure and an icy chill, having trained in the art of soul-magic in Ulgu’s depths. Cyreni’s guards are hand-picked from the most skilled of the Namarti warrior caste. Clad in thick armour, their wicked serrated glaives can tear the guts out of their foes. Alongside them swims Cephanyr, a creature of the deep capable of sensing soulstuff from great distances.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Infantry, Order, Idoneth Deepkin, Aelf, Akhelian, Namarti
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***The models in this unit are:***

• ***Cyreni of the Abyss** (champion, armed with Lanmari Weapons)*
• ***Alathyrr** (armed with Lanmari Weapons)*
• ***Renglaith** (armed with Lanmari Weapons)*
• ***Cephanyr** (armed with Cephanyr’s Tentacles)*

warscroll.name: Vanguard-Raptors with Hurricane Crossbows
warscroll.lore: Vanguard-Raptors are natural hunters, often scouting ahead of the main battle line to harry the enemy with deadly crossbow fire. Those who favour the close-ranged kill form into retinues armed with hurricane crossbows, ferocious weapons capable of stalling the most determined enemy advance with blistering quick-fire volleys.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Vanguard Chamber

warscroll.name: Dracothian Guard Fulminators
warscroll.lore: Aggressive and bold, there is no foe the Fulminators dare not charge. A surge of celestial energy builds before the ground-shaking impetus of their onset, a crackling war-cloud that travels like a bow wave before their lowered stormstrike glaives.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Extremis Chamber

warscroll.name: Sporesplatta Fanatics
warscroll.lore: Sporesplatta Fanatics careen towards the foe swinging Thwackwheezer Puffshrooms. The billowing clouds of spores spewed out by these fungi veil the grot hordes from sight, invigorating the followers of the Bad Moon whilst choking and blinding the foe.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Destruction, Gloomspite Gitz, Moonclan

warscroll.name: Scourge of Ghyran Abhorrant Ghoul King
warscroll.lore: Utterly deranged, the Abhorrant Ghoul Kings of the Everspring Swathe believe themselves to be good and just rulers of forest kingdoms, rather than the flesh-eating nightmares they truly are. Their cadaverous minions are equally deluded. Such is their devotion to their vampiric master that should the Ghoul King fall they will enter a berserk rage, ripping and tearing those responsible to shreds.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Ward (6+), Death, Flesh-eater Courts, Abhorrant

warscroll.name: Everblaze Comet
warscroll.lore: Everblaze Comets are nothing less than meteors plucked from the firmament and sent hurtling to the battlefield. They are an awe-inspiring sight to the followers of Sigmar, for they evoke the myth of his arrival in the Mortal Realms, borne through the void upon the core of the World-that-Was.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Ward (6+), Order, Stormcast Eternals

warscroll.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead
warscroll.lore: All living beings dread the name of Nagash, the God of Undeath. Cruel and tyrannical, the overlord of Shyish intends to conquer the Mortal Realms and transform them into a lifeless Necrotopia, in which not a speck of dust moves unless it is by his will.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Monster, Wizard (9), Fly, Ward (5+), Death, Soulblight Gravelords

warscroll.name: Killaboss on Great Gnashtoof
warscroll.lore: Particularly storied Killabosses are able to procure all manner of terrifying, swamp-dwelling mounts from the Beast-breakaz to show off their status. Great Gnashtoofs are one such monster, huge and vicious hounds whose swiftness is matched only by their ferocity.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Cavalry, Destruction, Kruleboyz

warscroll.name: Gothizzar Harvester
warscroll.lore: Gothizzar Harvesters are perhaps the most horrific of all Ossiarch constructs. From their maws leap bolts of killing baleflame, and their nadirite weapons are capable of inflicting horrendous carnage. Yet a Gothizzar Harvester’s true value to the Ossiarchs is the great hollow on its back and the bones contained therein; as the thing marches across the battlefield, it snatches up the remains of the dead, flensing the worthy and storing them for delivery to a necropolis. In extremis, a Harvester can even perform field repairs on fellow Ossiarchs, making it a formidable anchor in a legion’s battleline.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Monster, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Avatar of Khaine
warscroll.lore: Towering statues animated by blood magic, Avatars of Khaine march into battle hewing with their blazing swords, uncaring of any blow the enemy might land upon their scorching metal frames. Khainites rejoice to witness the carnage they leave in their wake.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Ward (6+), Order, Daughters of Khaine

warscroll.name: Daemonic Simulacrum
warscroll.lore: The twin-headed monstrosity known as the Daemonic Simulacrum is not a true daemon but a living mirage, a manifestation of the duplicity and cunning of the Lords of Change that guide their Arcanite puppets to war. Though ephemeral, when these illusory creatures bite, they can tear away the minds of the foe to leave them drooling imbeciles.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Fly, Ward (6+), Chaos, Disciples of Tzeentch

warscroll.name: Purple Sun of Shyish
warscroll.lore: The Purple Sun is a harbinger of annihilation. Fell magics coalesce into a glowing orb that floats with an eerie serenity, emanating rays of amethyst light that turn any they strike to lifeless crystal. Strong or mighty, craven or courageous: none are spared. All the while, a skeletal face leers out of the Purple Sun. Learned Necromancers say that this is the face of the mad god Xereus, whose name is invoked in rites of conjuring and who is said to be imprisoned within the Purple Sun as penance for ancient crimes.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Fly, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Zondara's Gravebreakers
warscroll.lore: Once a wise Ghurish wizard, Zondara Rivenheart delved into necromantic lore in an attempt to save her beloved Ferlain from a bestial curse. She now blends beast-magic with the energies of death, ransacking crypts, keeps and dungeons in search of a cure. Zondara’s shambling gravediggers are imbued with Ghurish magic, granting them a strength and ferocity beyond that of most animated corpses. They are led by the cursed beast Ferlain, Rivenheart’s illfated former lover, reduced to a frenzied brute who messily dismembers those who threaten his mistress.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Infantry, Champion, Ward (6+), Death, Soulblight Gravelords, Deadwalkers
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***The models in this unit are:***

• ***Zondara Rivenheart** (champion, armed with Graverobber’s Tools)*
• ***Pikk** (armed with Graverobber’s Tools)*
• ***Cracktomb** (armed with Graverobber’s Tools)*
• ***Toyle** (armed with Graverobber’s Tools)*
• ***Lost Ferlain** (armed with Rending Claws)*

warscroll.name: Pusgoyle Blightlords (1 model)
warscroll.lore: Elite Rotbringers mounted atop Rot Flies, Pusgoyle Blightlords thrum ahead of their kindred to sow panic and death. Their crushing tocsins and whistling scythes make short work of any who would slow the spread of decay.
warscroll.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Lord of Afflictions** in your army.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Fly, Ward (6+), Chaos, Maggotkin of Nurgle, Rotbringers

warscroll.name: Skywardens
warscroll.lore: Skywardens are elite formations of Arkanaut warriors whose duty is to safeguard their skyfleet’s vessels against attack. Granted the power of flight by portable aether-endrins, they soar alongside their metal wards, scanning the clouds and the ground below for potential threats. Should battle be joined, Skywardens will swoop from on high to skewer enemies upon long-hafted skypikes or hover at short range to incinerate them with vulcaniser pistols. Whenever the enemy gather close, they withdraw to fight anew, leaving behind floating mines that detonate to cover their escape.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Fly, Reinforcements
warscroll.wargearOptionsText: ***This unit has 2 Skywardens armed with a Vulcaniser Pistol and Skypike, and 1 Skywarden armed with an Aethermatic Volley Gun and Gun Butt.***

warscroll.name: The Crimson Court
warscroll.lore: Prince Duvalle claims descent from the Von Carstein lineage, and few are foolish enough to gainsay him to his face. He is adept at conjuring magical glamours and illusions, rendering his prey disoriented and vulnerable before striking. Duvalle’s Crimson Court are a clique of vampires obsessed with the hunt. Having slaked their thirsts the realms over, they now set their sights on the living mountain of Beastgrave and the warriors who battle within.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Wizard (1), Infantry, Champion, Ward (6+), Death, Soulblight Gravelords, Vampire
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with a Courtly Weapon. The models in this unit are:***

• ***Prince Duvalle** (champion)*
• ***Gorath the Enforcer***
• ***Vellas von Faine***
• ***Ennias Curse-born***

warscroll.name: Royal Decapitator
warscroll.lore: Viewed with unease even by fellow ghouls, the Royal Decapitators care only for the dealing of death. Dragging huge, tarnished axes behind them, they serve their lieges as gibbering executioners and delight in taking worthy heads.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Ward (6+), Death, Flesh-eater Courts, Noble

warscroll.name: Gossamid Archers
warscroll.lore: Gossamid Archers are afforded the power of flight by the zephyrspites that clasp their torsos. A gruesome fate awaits any struck by the shafts of these skirmishers, for the arrowheads contain voracious grubs that devour the target from within.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Fly

warscroll.name: Madcap Shaman
warscroll.lore: Black-clad Madcap Shamans caper into battle, chanting and jabbering madly. They stuff Madcap Mushrooms into their gobs, eyes crackling with power as they channel the Gloomspite into deadly magical attacks.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Destruction, Gloomspite Gitz, Moonclan

warscroll.name: Evocators on Celestial Dracolines
warscroll.lore: Dracolines are fearsome beasts of Azyr whose roars can unman even the staunchest foes. When their savagery is allied with the magical prowess of an Evocator, the result is a force to be reckoned with.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Sacrosanct Chamber

warscroll.name: Anointed Sentinels
warscroll.lore: Anointed Sentinels are chosen from the most zealous of the Bull Centaur herds. Flesh glistening with sacred blood-oils, they preside over the desolations wrought in Hashut’s name, quoting diabolic scripture while goring and impaling any who draw near. Within their gleaming Hashutaar masks swirl vapours that grant the Sentinels even greater focus in their devotion – at the cost of deadening imagination, independent will and, some say, their very souls.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Chaos, Helsmiths of Hashut, Duardin

warscroll.name: Kragnos, the End of Empires
warscroll.lore:
One of the most destructive races to have ever lived, the Drogrukh were centauroid warriors who built a great nation in the Realm of Beasts. From their number rose a champion so powerful that he ascended to godhood: Kragnos, the End of Empires. Having led his people in warfare against a draconic empire that left the Drogrukh all but extinct, Kragnos was sealed away for the protection of the realms – only to be freed centuries later. Though he currently wages a protracted war in the Realm of Life, Kragnos can still be drawn to battle by the most ferocious fighting, his arrival announced by the smashing of enemy lines and the crushing of foes under his thunderous hooves.

Already a natural disaster made manifest, Kragnos’s rampages are further augmented by his legendary armaments. The shield Tuskbreaker is said to have been cast aside by Gorkamorka himself, deity of the orruks and other brutish beings. The spells of enemy mages break instantly upon its surface, supposedly due to the residual divine essence that suffuses it. The Dread Mace, Kragnos’s massive studded club, is powerful enough to shatter walls of solid rock. Legends say that Kragnos retrieved the weapon’s head from an ancient geomantic nexus, and that it is infused with Ghur’s own destructive animus.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Monster, Ward (5+), Destruction, Sons of Behemat

warscroll.name: Dracothian Guard Concussors
warscroll.lore: Thunder cracks with every weighty blow delivered by the Concussors. Those foes not slain outright by bludgeoning strikes are battered into submission, stunned by the azure shockwaves released by those resounding impacts.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Extremis Chamber

warscroll.name: Vanguard-Palladors with Starstrike Javelins
warscroll.lore: In addition to a boltstorm pistol, some Vanguard-Palladors are equipped with starstrike javelins, weapons that can not only be used in close combat but can also be hurled an impressive distance. Palladors so armed are highly flexible in battle, able to harry a foe's flank from afar or focus fire on enemy leaders caught out of position.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Order, Stormcast Eternals, Vanguard Chamber, Vanguard-Palladors

warscroll.name: Sloppity Bilepiper, Herald of Nurgle
warscroll.lore: Sloppity Bilepipers caper through the ranks of Nurgle’s legions as they advance. Infected with a plague of mirth, they prance and quip, entertaining their fellow daemons even as they cause the enemy to literally die laughing.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Plague Scion*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Ward (5+), Chaos, Maggotkin of Nurgle, Daemon

warscroll.name: Mournfang Pack
warscroll.lore: Ogors mounted on Mournfangs wield clubs, blades and pistols, firing point-blank into their foes before laying about them with brutal abandon. Their foultempered beasts trample and gore anything that gets in their way.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Musician (1/4), Standard Bearer (1/4), Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Beastclaw

warscroll.name: Arch-Revenant
warscroll.lore: Arch-Revenants soar high over the battlefield, borne upon the wings of a companion zephyrspite. Swooping down to strike where the foe is most vulnerable, their majestic glaives weave a dance of death before they take flight once more, seeking out the next target to feel their wrath.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Forest Sentinel*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Fly, Order, Sylvaneth, Revenant

warscroll.name: High Gladiatrix
warscroll.lore: A High Gladiatrix is a living conduit of Khaine’s wrath. Striding at the head of their sisters’ advance, these paragons of combat eviscerate their opponents with breathtaking skill and cruelty, to the awed delight of watching Khainites.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Coven Matriarch*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Ward (6+), Order, Daughters of Khaine, Aelf

warscroll.name: Nexus Chaotica
warscroll.lore: True champions of Chaos recognise that the gods demand more than simple slaughter. The realms themselves must be laced with taint; the arcane ley lines must be inundated with corruption. This is the purpose of the Nexus Chaotica, a shrine raised at a geomantic confluence for the express purpose of withering it.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Faction Terrain, Chaos, Slaves to Darkness
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
**The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):**

**Cover, Impassable**

warscroll.name: Lord Executioner
warscroll.lore: Bearing the notched axes of their former trade, the Lord Executioners are sent to claim the lives of those who have escaped the justice of Nagash. The spirits of the wrongfully executed drift around these gheists, crying out their anguish even as they intercept blows meant to harm their slayer. Even in life these figures were held in fear, for their calling was that of the headsman, a role they performed with sadistic relish.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Cursed Soul*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Fly, Ward (5+), Death, Nighthaunt

warscroll.name: Gothizzar Harvester
warscroll.lore: The Gothizzar Harvester collects the remains of the slain, stripping them of flesh and storing them in a gaping cage of bone on its back. It bludgeons and cleaves those in reach of its primary arms even as its secondary limbs gather the dead.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine, Ward (6+), Death, Ossiarch Bonereapers

warscroll.name: Magister on Disc of Tzeentch
warscroll.lore: Magisters are powerful sorcerers in service to Tzeentch. Filled with eldritch energies as they ride their Disc of Tzeentch, they unleash a magical onslaught to annihilate the foe, channelling the surging energies of change in order to redouble their own warriors’ attacks.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Cavalry, Fly, Chaos, Disciples of Tzeentch, Arcanite

warscroll.name: Stormstrike Chariot
warscroll.lore: Stormstrike Chariots are potent linebreakers. When the clarion call to attack sounds, they thunder across even the most rugged terrain, with the archer in their carriage sending killing shafts from their great stormbow as they come. The chariot’s most devastating weapon, however, is its charge. As the charioteers build up speed, they draw the energies of Azyr to themselves until a crackling aurora surrounds them. Upon impact into the enemy lines, the Stormcasts unleash this energy in thunderous blasts even as they strike out with axe and blade.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine

warscroll.name: The Dread Pageant
warscroll.lore: Led by Vasillac the Gifted, a former warrior of the Myrmidesh who now seeks his own glory, the Dread Pageant have brought terrible suffering to the living mountain of Beastgrave. In battle, their manifold skills combine into one blinding storm of blades.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Infantry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Weapons of Excess. The models in this unit are:***

• ***Vasillac the Gifted** (champion)*
• ***Slakeslash***
• ***Hadzu***
• ***Glissete***

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Revenant Draconith
warscroll.lore: Rotted heirs of the godbeast Dracothion, Revenant Draconith are the decaying corpses of great drakes animated by necromancy. With a deep-seated animosity for all living things, they swoop down through the Aqshian skies to disgorge their flesh-melting breath over the enemy, lashing out with raking talons in a hate-filled frenzy.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Monster, Fly, Ward (6+), Death, Soulblight Gravelords

warscroll.name: Huskard on Stonehorn
warscroll.lore: Many Huskard Jorls and Huskard Eurls lead their warriors from atop the backs of formidable Stonehorns. Together, the beasts and their brutish riders are master linebreakers, using their impressive strength to batter their way through all obstacles.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Priest (1), Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Beastclaw

warscroll.name: Knight of Shrouds
warscroll.lore: Each Knight of Shrouds is an arch-traitor who abandoned their oaths and their people rather than fight an unwinnable war against the legions of Nagash. In return, the Great Necromancer bound them eternally in his service, making use of their vicious skill in warfare to further subjugate the living. Wielding the Sword of Stolen Hours that marks their rank, a Knight of Shrouds cuts down those they once swore to protect, each killing stroke accompanied by a fresh rush of self-loathing. Should the enemy mount a stalwart counter-attack, they will order their minions to discorporate entirely, the blades of the foe finding no purchase upon them until the danger is passed.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Fly, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Poxbringer, Herald of Nurgle
warscroll.lore: Poxbringers are veteran daemons amongst the Plaguebearer ranks who lead the tallybands into war. Doleful and relentless, they command their charges with a grim determination and wield the magics of plague as well as a corrupted balesword of dire virulence.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Plague Scion*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Ward (5+), Chaos, Maggotkin of Nurgle, Daemon

warscroll.name: Scourge of Ghyran Sporesplatta Fanatics
warscroll.lore: Filled to the brim with lethal mushrooms of all kinds, the jungles of the Everspring Swathe are a haven for the insane grots known as Sporesplatta Fanatics. These ’shroom-addled maniacs swing their fungal weapons in wild circles, splattering their foes with noxious spores that leave them dazed, sickened and choked with toxins.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Destruction, Gloomspite Gitz, Moonclan

warscroll.name: Crypt Flayers (2 models)
