warscroll.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Wardens
warscroll.lore: Auralan Wardens form the glittering spine of the Lumineth Realm-lords’ martial hosts. Armed with long pikes to engage the enemy at a distance, they fight with perfect precision and skill. They might find the human way of war cumbersome and inefficient, but they see the God-King’s folk as key allies in their campaigns against the Dark Gods.
warscroll.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf, Allies of the Free Cities

warscroll.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vulkyn Flameseekers
warscroll.lore: Vulkyn Flameseekers are strange duardin who roam the realms in search of Magmadroth eggs – a precious resource that holds both spiritual and practical significance in Fyreslayer society. Accompanied by hunting beasts and wielding a variety of deadly weaponry, they sometimes join Sigmarite crusades heading into enemy- held territories.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced. This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion (1/9), Ward (6+), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Duardin, Allies of the Free Cities
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Vulkyn Weapons.***

• ***1/9 models is a Kyndledroth and must replace their weapons with Kyndledroth’s Fangs.***
• ***The champion is a Vulkyn Runefather and cannot replace their weapons.***

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Iridan the Witness
warscroll.lore: Able to endure the horrors of the Gnaw for far longer than their brethren, Iridan the Witness leads the Stormcasts of the Ruination chambers into battle with the resurgent Skaven in the easternmost Great Parch. Champion of the death god Morrda, they ride atop the Morrgryph Ariax and seek to reawaken their companions’ memories of past glories.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Monster, Priest (1), Fly, Ward (6+), Order, Stormcast Eternals, Ruination Chamber

warscroll.name: Freeguild Cavaliers
warscroll.lore: The battlefield shakes as the heavy cavalry of the Sigmarite cities make their charge. No idle jousters these: theirs is a war of grinding, brutal attrition where man and steed alike are expected to fight for hours at a time without rest.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Standard Bearer (1/5), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Freeguild Fusiliers
warscroll.lore: Planting their pavises in the ground, Freeguild Fusiliers form up into a defensive line that is effectively a fortress battlement brought to the field. From this defensive position, they unleash continuous volleys of fire from their sturdy fusil-cannons amidst drifting clouds of blackpowder smoke.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Battlemage on Luminark of Hysh
warscroll.lore: Powerful Light Wizards from the upper echelons of the Collegiate Arcane sometimes ride to war upon a Luminark of Hysh, directing its searing beam of light to vaporise the direst threats of the enemy whilst deftly casting scouring sorceries of their own.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, War Machine, Wizard (1), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Scourge of Ghyran Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel
warscroll.lore: In Ghyran, Pontifex Zenestra is revered as an icon of stubbornness and faith, a living embodiment of the Life Realm’s ever-churning cycles. Several times she has appeared in lands corrupted by Chaos or wild magic, burning away the corruption with divine conjurations and cleansing it with the spilled blood of her faithful acolytes.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Priest (2), Infantry, Ward (4+), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Human

warscroll.name: Linebreaker Cogfort
warscroll.lore: The Linebreaker Cogfort is a hybrid assault and bombardment design that is intended to provide adaptability on the battlefield. The sheer recoil of a godbreaker cannon makes for an uncomfortable experience for the Freeguilders riding in the Linebreaker’s belly. It does at least assure that when they pour out of the hold to engage with the foe, most of their opposition has already been reduced to smoke and ashes.
warscroll.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Iron March Army of Renown
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, War Machine, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite, Iron March

warscroll.name: Fusil-Major on Ogor Warhulk
warscroll.lore: Forming the mobile watchtowers of the Castelite formations, Fusil-Majors borne by Ogor Warhulks use their vantage points to spy weaknesses in the enemy line and direct the fire of friendly forces. The obvious threat posed by their massive ogor carriers is usually enough to make foes think twice about storming their positions.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Freeguild Veteran.*
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Celestial Hurricanum
warscroll.lore: One of the most complex and deadly creations of the Collegiate, the Celestial Hurricanum is a gigantic arcane orrery that can summon a furious magical storm to lay waste to enemy warriors.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Freeguild Marshal on Griffon
warscroll.lore: A Freeguild Marshal mounted upon a noble griffon surveys the battlefield from on high. Identifying where their presence is most required, they descend like a speeding comet to lay waste to their enemies, inspiring their comrades with word and deed.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Fly, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Wildercorps Hunters
warscroll.lore: Trackers, scouts and outdoorsmen, the Wildercorps are experts in attacking from the cover of thick foliage and broken ground. Their hounds surge forward, sinking fangs into flesh even as skilled marksmen pick out their targets with crossbows.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion (1/11), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***•  The champion is a Wildercorps Warden and is armed with a Hunting Crossbow, Wildercorps Hunting Weapons and a Trailhound’s Ferocious Bite.***

***•  6/11 models in this unit are Wildercorpsmen and are armed with a Hunting Crossbow and Wildercorps Hunting Weapons.***

***•  4/11 models are Trailhounds and are armed with a Trailhound’s Ferocious Bite.***

warscroll.name: Gutter Runners
warscroll.lore: Gutter Runners are shadowy killers and saboteurs in service to the Clans Eshin. Trained in unique combat arts, they are fearsome close-quarters opponents, wielding lethal poisons and an array of rat-borne explosives to disorient and devastate foes.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Ward (6+), Chaos, Skaven, Eshin
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with a Punch Dagger and Blade.***
***1/10 models in this unit can be armed with Saboteur Bombs in addition to their other weapons***
***The champion cannot be armed with Saboteur Bombs.***

warscroll.name: Mortisan Soulreaper
warscroll.lore: The Soulreapers are the more destructive members of the Mortisan order. It is their role to cut the souls from the enemy with their magical scythes, using the harvested spirits to sap their enemies' strength or fuel a burst of deathly energy.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Fly, Ward (6+), Relentless Discipline (2), Death, Ossiarch Bonereapers

warscroll.name: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel
warscroll.lore: The Great Wheel turns, and the driving force is faith. As she gives her inspiring battlefield sermons, the raw celestial power of the God-King crackles out from Pontifex Zenestra’s sacred palanquin to incinerate enemy mages and heathens, whilst her acolytes bludgeon and hew any foolish enough to approach her without permission.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest, Infantry, Ward (4+)

warscroll.name: Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy
warscroll.lore: Freeguild Marshals who lead from the front are perhaps the most heroic of all. The respect they have won from their warriors is stronger than any shield, and their Relic Envoys ensure their orders always get to where they are needed. When battlelines clash, their skill with sword, hammer and pistol swiftly becomes clear.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry

warscroll.name: Freeguild Steelhelms
warscroll.lore: The Steelhelms are the weatherbeaten infantry at the heart of each Freeguild regiment. Inspired by the presence of Pontifex Zenestra, they march fearlessly into battle, hacking away at enemies that stray too close with swords, axes and mauls.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Reinforcements

warscroll.name: Freeguild Command Corps Whisperblade
warscroll.lore: Lurking in the shadows is the Whisperblade, who keeps the Freeguild Marshal apprised of dissent. They wear a cloak of Ulguan falsecloth that allows them to blend with the darkness – all the better to listen, learn and assassinate.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Stormstrike Palladors
warscroll.lore: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Musician (1/3),  Standard Bearer (1/3), Order, Stormcast Eternals, Warrior Chamber

warscroll.name: Flagellants
warscroll.lore: Entirely consumed by their zealous faith in the God-King, these holy warriors long for nothing more than to martyr themselves in battle. Armed with little more than clubs and flails, they leap upon their foes in a frenzied mob.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Battlemage on Griffon
warscroll.lore: When mounted atop a furious, twin-headed Ghurish griffon, a Battlemage of the Amber College can lay waste to their foes from afar or strike from on high in a vicious frenzy of stabbing beaks and ripping talons.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Wizard (1), Fly, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Irondrakes
warscroll.lore: Armed with a terrifying array of heavy weaponry, Irondrakes overwhelm their foes with torrents of f lesh-melting flame and volleys of high-explosive missiles, relying upon master-crafted gromril armour to fend off all retaliation.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Duardin

warscroll.name: Longbeards
warscroll.lore: Longbeards are the oldest and most experienced duardin warriors, as evidenced by their great, f lowing beards and tendency to grumble on relentlessly about their enemies and allies alike – even in the thick of battle.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Duardin

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Auric Runeson on Magmadroth
warscroll.lore: Heirs to the throne of their lodge, Auric Runesons are fearless duardin warriors who hunger for glory. Many of them are borne to battle by flame- spewing Magmadroths, giant reptiles that are quite at home among Aqshy’s volcanic peaks and lava plains.
warscroll.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as *Vulcatrix's Chosen*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin, Magmadroth

warscroll.name: Grell Firefist
warscroll.lore: If there is something someone needs killing, then Grell Firefist has likely killed its kind before - and taken a bite out of it too. This veteran mercenary has travelled all over the Mortal Realms, selling her skills with her beloved cannon Blastbelch to the highest bidder. Grell keeps a fondness for her ogor kin and can usually be convinced to join a passing raid - for the right price.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad.*
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Gutbusters

warscroll.name: Cogsmith
warscroll.lore: Grizzled combat engineers who know how to squeeze peak performance and killing power from any war machine, Cogsmiths are also proficient warriors capable of cutting down those who would interfere with their field repairs.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join a **Warden King**’s regiment. This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Duardin

warscroll.name: Dark Riders
warscroll.lore: For those marked by the Dark Riders, there is nowhere to flee. These cloaked killers gallop forth upon red-eyed shadowmares, levelling spears and repeater crossbows to deal a fatal blow to their quarry.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Musician (1/5), Standard Bearer (1/5), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Drakespawn Chariot
warscroll.lore: Drakespawn Chariots are elegant yet cruel war machines that are highly manoeuvrable thanks to their single-wheel design. Fitted with an array of scything blades and crewed by skilled Order Serpentis knights, they cause dreadful carnage as they plough into the enemy lines.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Dreadlord on Black Dragon
warscroll.lore: The feared warlords of the Order Serpentis delight in inflicting pain and terror upon their foes. They ride to war on obsidian-scaled dragons that can lay waste to entire armies with their dagger-like claws and foul, choking breath.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Fly, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Scourgerunner Chariot
warscroll.lore: Employed to chase down fast-moving prey, Scourgerunner Chariots are swift and deadly war machines armed with a harpoon launcher that can cripple even the most fearsome monster.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Sorceress
warscroll.lore: Despots who rule over the Darkling Covens with unquestioned authority and cruel cunning, Sorceresses wield dark and terrible magic that can blast the life from their foes or wrack them with unimaginable agony.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Darkshards
warscroll.lore: Armed with fast-firing repeater crossbows, formations of Darkshards unleash a withering hail of iron-tipped bolts into their enemies, each volley piercing eyes and puncturing hearts.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Dreadspears
warscroll.lore: Dreadspear shieldwalls form the armoured core of the Darkling Covens’ armies. Fully enthralled to the service of their masters, these cruel warriors fight and slay with unnerving focus.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Assassin
warscroll.lore: T here is no fortress, city or fortified war camp that the feared Shadowblade Assassins cannot infiltrate, and few foes can hope to survive the potent poisons delivered by their wicked daggers.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Sorceress on Black Dragon
warscroll.lore: Many Sorceresses go to war upon fearsome Black Dragons, delighting in the terror in the eyes of their enemies as the scaled beasts spit clouds of choking fumes and rip their prey apart with sword-sized talons.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Wizard (1), Fly, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Hammerers
warscroll.lore: Hammerers are traditionally tasked with guarding the Warden Kings in battle. The rhythmic rise and fall of their gromril mauls instils fear in their enemies just as it lifts the spirits of their fellow duardin.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Duardin

warscroll.name: Black Guard
warscroll.lore: These fanatical warriors guard the rulers of the Darkling Covens. Armed with ebon halberds and clad in ensorcelled plate, they present an impassable and deadly obstacle to any who threaten their wards.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Vulkyn Flameseekers
warscroll.lore: Vulkyn Flameseekers are beast-taming Fyreslayers who seek out Magmadroth eggs with pertinacity. It is no surprise that their quest has brought the duardin to the Realm of Fire, for the spawn of Vulcatrix are well suited to its magmatic environments.
warscroll.notes:
This unit cannot be reinforced.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion (1/9), Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Vulkyn Weapons.***

• ***1/9 models is a Kyndledroth and must replace their weapons with Emberteeth.***
• ***The champion is a Vulkyn Runefather and cannot replace their weapons.***

warscroll.name: Steam Tank
warscroll.lore: Clanking monstrosities of steel and iron, Steam Tanks rattle across the battlefield, blasting away at targets with their cannons and steam-spewing guns while grinding yet more to paste beneath their metal-clad wheels.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Tyrant on Glutthorn
warscroll.lore: Tyrants who really want to impress with size and status require a suitable mount, and few are seen as more suitable than the glutthorns. Bulky and bad-tempered, these beasts shake the earth with every step, snorting in simple annoyance at suffering apparently grievous wounds, while the Tyrant crushes skulls and bellows for tardy underlings to start pulling their weight.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Gutbusters

warscroll.name: Bleakswords
warscroll.lore: Bleakswords leap into the fray in a blur of flashing steel. Wielding their duelling swords with unnatural grace, they slice their foes to ribbons with an unstoppable flurry of strikes.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Freeguild Steelhelms
warscroll.lore: While the rank and file of the Freeguilds are often individually outmatched by the myriad threats they face in their mission to retake the realms, they have three things on their side: discipline, gutsy determination and their faith in Sigmar.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite
warscroll.wargearOptionsText: ***This unit’s musician and standard bearer are the same model.***

warscroll.name: Freeguild Command Corps Arch-Knight and Retinue
warscroll.lore: Freeguild Arch-Knights are mighty warriors uplifted from the ranks, outfitted with the finest arms and armour and expected to lead by example. Accompanied by their retinue of specialists, they smash and cleave their way through their foes, leading the rank and file to victory.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Reinforcements
warscroll.wargearOptionsText: ***This unit comprises 1 Arch-Knight, 1 Great Herald, 1 War Surgeon, 1 Soul Shepherd and 1 Mascot Gargoylian.***

warscroll.name: Shalaxi Helbane
warscroll.lore: Known as the Monarch of the Hunt, Shalaxi Helbane is Slaanesh’s weapon against the daemons of the other Chaos Gods. Able to discern the secrets of the Dark Prince’s foes through blended senses, this statuesque warlord has slain a thousand rivals and more.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Monster, Wizard (2), Ward (5+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon, Paragon

warscroll.name: Freeguild Grenadiers
warscroll.lore: Experts in close-quarters combat, the Freeguild Grenadiers are always the first into the breach. Outfitted with the finest blackpowder weapons, flame-hurlers and deadly polearms, they rely on overwhelming force to reduce their enemies to charred corpses and smouldering piles of ash.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite
warscroll.wargearOptionsText: ***1/10 models in this unit is a Cindergout. The champion cannot be a Cindergout.***

warscroll.name: Freeguild Command Corps Adjutants
warscroll.lore: A Freeguild officer's adjutants stand ready to assist them in their martial duties. Arch-Knights employ years of hard-won experience and ruthless skill to ensure that no foe gets within a dozen yards of their superior, while Great Heralds and Mascot Gargoylians embody the fighting spirit of the regiment, encouraging the rank and file to victory in Sigmar's name.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite
warscroll.wargearOptionsText: ***This unit comprises 1 Arch-Knight, 1 Great Herald and 1 Mascot Gargoylian.***

warscroll.name: Rat Ogors
warscroll.lore: Perhaps the most infamous creations of the Clans Moulder, Rat Ogors are flesh-grafted shock troops that fly into a terrifying frenzy when the stench of death fills the air.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry
warscroll.wargearOptionsText: ***This unit has 2 Rat Ogors armed with Claws, Blades and Fangs, and 1 Rat Ogor armed with a Warpfire Gun and Claws, Blades and Fangs.***

warscroll.name: Battlemage on Celestial Hurricanum
warscroll.lore: Celestial Battlemages harness the cosmic power of High Azyr to bring down storms and send arcs of lightning cascading through the ranks of the enemy, unleashing raw elemental power that is terrible to witness.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, War Machine, Wizard (1), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: The Masque
warscroll.lore: The Masque once entertained Slaanesh, but they were exiled upon displeasing him. Since then, the Herald has been cursed to dance across the Mortal Realms. Those drawn into this endless performance are doomed to a swift and spectacular death.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Ward (4+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Executioners
warscroll.lore: T hese skull-masked killers are the most feared warriors of the Darkling Covens. True virtuosos of slaughter, they have mastered the art of severing heads with every swing of their curved Executioner’s draichs.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Aelf

warscroll.name: Battlemage
warscroll.lore: Masters of the arcane arts, the grizzled Battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane summon lethal storms of magic to lay waste to their foes and shield their comrades from harm with protective enchantment.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Keeper of Secrets
warscroll.lore: A Keeper of Secrets is a greater daemon of Slaanesh, a consummate warrior and spellmaster of the Dark Prince’s hosts. Its four powerful arms move languidly as it slinks forwards, only to explode into lethal motion when its prey is in reach.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Wizard (2), Ward (5+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: The Thricefold Discord
warscroll.lore: Travelling together, the Thricefold Discord serve the toughest of punishments: each other’s company. A sorceress, an assassin and an indolent leader, these three daemons are constantly at odds – yet their rivalry destroys everything around them with surprising effectiveness.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Infantry, Champion, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Carnal Blades and Wicked Claws. The models in this unit are:***

• ***Vexmor, the Excessively Indolent** (champion)*
• ***Vashtiss the Coiled***
• ***Lascivyr, the Bladed Blessing***

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Blissbarb Seekers
warscroll.lore: Hurtling across the battlefield, Blissbarb Seekers deal death at a blistering pace. Astride their daemonic Exalted Steeds, such is these Sybarite archers’ obsession with speed that not even the lava‐fields of the Great Parch can slow them.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Daemonettes
warscroll.lore: Possessed of impossible grace and grotesque beauty, Daemonettes of Slaanesh bound across the battlefield with sadistic glee. They are in constant competition with one another to see who can inflict the most pain on the enemies of the Dark Prince.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Musician (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Shardspeaker of Slaanesh
warscroll.lore: Shardspeakers of Slaanesh are favoured sorcerers who have been gifted with a relic from the Temple of Twisted Mirrors. By tapping into the power of these artefacts, they can reduce a disciplined regiment to a pack of howling beasts ripe for the slaughter.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Seekers
warscroll.lore: Seekers of Slaanesh are the vanguard of the Dark Prince’s daemon armies, insatiable outriders who track their foes with unrelenting swiftness, feeding on the growing terror of their prey.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Musician (1/5), Standard Bearer (1/5), Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Sigvald, Prince of Slaanesh
warscroll.lore: Sigvald the Magnificent considers himself to be the favoured son of Slaanesh. Few would dare question this belief. In battle, the master of the Decadent Host fights as a golden blur, laughing cruelly as his elegant blade slices through rabble and champions alike.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Infantry, Ward (4+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite, Paragon

warscroll.name: Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh
warscroll.lore: Maestros of discordance, Infernal Enrapturesses fill the battlefield with screams of pain and unrestrained elation. They are virtuosos among Slaanesh’s infernal choirs, towards whom the Dark Prince’s daemonic legions are drawn.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Fiends
warscroll.lore: Horrific nightmares given bestial shape, Fiends of Slaanesh emit a harsh, trilling call as they race towards their prey. A dream-inducing scent hangs thick around the Fiends, reducing their foes to a stupor and sapping them of their will to fight.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Beast, Champion, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Contorted Epitome
warscroll.lore: Contorted Epitomes are a rare thing: a pair of Daemonettes who can abide one another’s company, rather than constantly seeking to humiliate and disgrace a rival. Such devilish duos are granted command over the accursed Mirrors of Absorption. These darkling relics slither forth on metallic tentacles, their shimmering glass soon enrapturing the weak-minded and dragging their souls into an eternity of torment.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Ward (4+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Lord of Hysteria
warscroll.lore: Lords of Hysteria are champions devoted to the Sacred Seduction of Paramountcy. Obsessed are they with being known as the greatest and grossest of revellers, they have sold their souls to powerful pleasure-daemons in exchange for both physical prowess and, more dangerously, the ability to plunge otherwise reasoning souls into fits of truly orgiastic violence.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist.*
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Thricefold Discord
warscroll.lore: The courts of the Palace of Pleasure are filled with wicked daemons known as Slaanesh’s Heralds. The choicest vices and most appalling perversions are theirs to command, and they are always eager to bring such delights to the realms. Heralds take to the battlefield in trios known as Thricefold Discords – an apt name, as for all their sorcerous and martial prowess, the real source of their power is their seething need to one-up their rivals.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Ward (5+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***Each model in this unit is armed with Carnal Blades and Wicked Claws. The models in this unit are:***

• ***Vexmor, the Excessively Indolent** (champion)*
• ***Vashtiss the Coiled***
• ***Lascivyr, the Bladed Blessing***

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh
warscroll.lore: Cutting through the roars of anger and screams of pain that fill the battlefields of Aqshy come the horrific melodies created by the Infernal Enrapturess as it plucks the tendinous strings of its living lyre.
warscroll.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Wheels of Excruciation
warscroll.lore: Wheels of Excruciation are sorcerous flocks of living, bladed discuses that tear mortals into slivers of bleeding flesh. They are a magical echo of the many devices that can be found in the torment-boudoirs of the Palace of Pleasure; they spin across the battlefield at terrible velocity, seemingly drawn to those whose screams will echo loudest and most delightfully.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Fly, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh

warscroll.name: Mesmerising Mirror
warscroll.lore: The wise know to swiftly avert their gaze when faced with the manifestations known as Mesmerising Mirrors, no matter the tearing sensation in their souls. Those who stare into the spell’s depths at first see visions of majesty, but as they look on, these turn to horrific displays. Entranced by the obscenities they witness, they cannot move away, even as Slaanesh’s rapacious warriors close in.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh

warscroll.name: Dreadful Visage
warscroll.lore: The Dreadful Visage is a manifestation conjured in one of the many likenesses of the Dark Prince, hooked and lash-like tongues flailing from its mouth. These serpentine appendages snare limbs and lance deep into flesh, tearing and mangling with a wild glee, leaving its victims both immobilised and agonised.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Manifestation, Endless Spell, Fly, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh

warscroll.name: Icebrow Hunter
warscroll.lore: An Icebrow Hunter is a cunning stalker who utilises their surroundings to launch ambushes with the aid of their Frost Sabres. Not only do they slay opponents with spear and bolt, they also have the power to breathe a killing blizzard over their foes.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad*. This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Destruction, Ogor Mawtribes, Ogor, Beastclaw

warscroll.name: Blissbarb Seekers
warscroll.lore: Blissbarb warriors who acquire for themselves an Exalted Steed of Slaanesh conduct war at a breakneck pace. Charging across the battlefield with astonishing speed, these Sybarites launch flights of cruel arrows with an incredible accuracy.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Lord of Hubris
warscroll.lore: Utterly enamoured with their own magnificence, the strutting peacocks known as Lords of Hubris swagger into battle, loudly demanding that the enemy’s finest face them in single combat. Those foolish enough to answer this challenge are cut to ribbons in a matter of seconds.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Myrmidesh Painbringers
warscroll.lore: The Myrmidesh are an elite warrior-cult who exemplify the pride of the Dark Prince. Each of their blade-sects considers their own favoured technique to be supreme, and on the rare occasions they are proved wrong, their spiteful rage is terrible to behold.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Slaangor Fiendbloods
warscroll.lore: When the madness of battle descends upon Slaangor Fiendbloods, the carnage left in their wake is truly sickening. These gangly beasts are frighteningly strong and swift, and they fight with a frenzied disregard for their own survival.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Hellflayer
warscroll.lore: Hellflayer chariots drive through the meadows of Slaanesh’s realm, dismembering those cursed to lie there in purgatory. On the battlefields of the Mortal Realms, they are roving weapons of war, their many scythes delivering gruesome death.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: War Machine, Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Bladebringer, Herald on Exalted Chariot
warscroll.lore: Some Heralds of Slaanesh become so intoxicated by the act of riding flesh-shredding chariots into the enemy that they demand ever larger and grander conveyances, the better to harvest the souls of mortals.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, War Machine, Wizard (1), Ward (6+), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Daemon

warscroll.name: Hellstriders
warscroll.lore: Devotees of torment, Hellstriders are mortals who have dedicated their lives to dealing out pain in return for power. They ride daemonic Steeds to war – indeed, they have no choice, for once they climb into the saddle, they can never dismount.
warscroll.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Musician (1/5), Standard Bearer (1/5), Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Seekers
warscroll.lore: Seekers of Slaanesh are the vanguard of the Dark Prince’s daemon armies, insatiable outriders who track their foes with unrelenting swiftness, feeding on the growing terror of their prey.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Thricefold Discord
warscroll.lore: The courts of the Palace of Pleasure are filled with wicked daemons known as Slaanesh’s Heralds. The choicest vices and most appalling perversions are theirs to command, and they are always eager to bring such delights to the realms. Heralds take to the battlefield in trios known as Thricefold Discords – an apt name, as for all their sorcerous and martial prowess, the real source of their power is their seething need to one-up their rivals.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Hero, Wizard, Ward (5+)

warscroll.name: Blood Hags
warscroll.lore: Clad in gleaming armour and wielding twin-pronged valthrai polearms, Blood Hags are the fighting elite of the Khainite aelves. They march into battle beside the war-shrines and warlords of the cult, messily executing any foes who dare come too close.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion (1/10), Standard Bearer (1/10), Ward (6+), Order, Daughters of Khaine, Aelf

warscroll.name: Blissbarb Archers
warscroll.lore: Blissbarb Archers are the lowest class of Sybarite, but they are no less deadly for it. Even when running pell-mell across the field, they fire with unerring accuracy, laughing with glee as their sharp and toxin-laced projectiles strike home.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Lord of Pain
warscroll.lore: Lords of Pain are champions of Slaanesh who have sampled countless vices and excesses. Armed with wicked soulpiercer maces, they lead warbands of devoted followers and are always eager to demonstrate their mastery of all forms of agony.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Slickblade Seekers
warscroll.lore: Slickblade Seekers believe themselves to be aristocrats of war, the chosen knights of the Dark Prince. They desire nothing more than to charge into the thickest portion of the fighting, their whistling glaives lashing out to neatly sever heads and limbs.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Champion, Chaos, Hedonites of Slaanesh, Sybarite

warscroll.name: Fiends
warscroll.lore: Horrific nightmares given bestial shape, Fiends of Slaanesh emit a harsh, trilling call as they race towards their prey. A dream-inducing scent hangs thick around the Fiends, reducing their foes to a stupor and sapping them of their will to fight.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Beast, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Daemonettes
warscroll.lore: Possessed of impossible grace and grotesque beauty, Daemonettes of Slaanesh bound across the battlefield with sadistic glee. They are in constant competition with one another to see who can inflict the most pain on the enemies of the Dark Prince.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Reinforcements, Ward (6+)

warscroll.name: Edmark Valoran, the Manticore Knight
warscroll.lore: Few warriors are more confident of their martial brilliance than Edmark Valoran. His bluster is not without merit, for his record of brave service in the God-King’s armies is undeniable. Yet after an incident saw his flesh riddled with shards of Aqshian realmstone and allies slain by his hand, he seeks to restore his honour. Should he be roused to anger, the Manticore Knight’s emberstone-pierced skin will flash red, and nearby enemies will be incinerated by a sudden burst of livid flames.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Bren Tylis, the Renegade Saint
warscroll.lore: Thief. Fugitive. Brigand. Bren Tylis has been all these and more in her life as a roving sellsword. Not for the first time, she finds herself on the run from Sigmar’s unforgiving clergy – but this time with just cause. She bears the relics of Saint Yondara, her fallen ancestor and a sworn guardian of the Everspring. That holy duty has now passed to Bren Tylis; through her own blessed skull, Yondara can commune with her living relative and guide Tylis’s hand.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Inara Sion, the Cleansing Blade
warscroll.lore: Few of Ghyran’s human populace are as venerable as Inara Sion. Kept in perfect health by draughts of pure Aqua Ghyranis, Sion has devoted her life to defeating the corruption that engulfed her former home. Inara learned her martial talents from the order of the Jade Circle, who sought to blend the mystical command of water with elegant sword-art. Eschewing armour, she moves with liquid grace, always seeming a step ahead of her clumsy foes.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Drasher Vorn, the Rampaging Beast
warscroll.lore: Chief of the Arak Klor, the hulking Drasher Vorn is a mighty warrior of inhuman strength. He wields the Ebon Claw, an artefact that grants his tribe bestial power at the cost of turning many of them into mindless berserkers. As he suffers wounds, the chieftain grows ever more wrathful, snarling and raking the Ebon Claw across his flesh. At the height of his rage, Vorn transforms in a blur of violence, crushing skulls and snapping spines as he hurls himself at his terrified foes.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Unique, Hero, Infantry, Ward (6+), Order, Cities of Sigmar, Sigmarite

warscroll.name: Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood
warscroll.lore: A Cauldron of Blood is a sacred war-shrine, its enchanted gore blessed by a Hag Queen. The presence of this relic inspires nearby worshippers and strengthens Khainite manifestations so that they are all but impossible to dispel.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest (1), War Machine, Ward (6+), Order, Daughters of Khaine, Aelf

warscroll.name: Morathi-Khaine
warscroll.lore: Proclaiming herself Khaine reborn, the goddess Morathi-Khaine bestrides the realms, holding aloft the Murder God’s Iron Heart and drawing power from its wrathful emanations. Endlessly cunning and depthlessly cruel, she is a master of manipulation and capable of inspiring her faithful to achieve the extraordinary.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Wizard (3), Infantry, Ward (4+), Order, Daughters of Khaine, Aelf

warscroll.name: Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood
warscroll.lore: Some Slaughter Queens go to battle atop great Cauldrons of Blood, channelling the innate sorcery of these bladed shrines to drive nearby Khainites into a frenzy of bloodletting.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest (1), War Machine, Ward (6+), Order, Daughters of Khaine, Aelf

warscroll.name: Auric Runemaster
warscroll.lore:
Auric Runemasters are revered high priests of a lodge’s Zharrgrim. It is they who craft the ur-gold runes that are hammered into Fyreslayer flesh, granting the bearer a sliver of the power of Grimnir. Auric Runemasters are attuned to their deity like no other and their ability to detect deposits of ur-gold is unmatched.

Unlike a Runesmiter, a Runemaster has tempered their fiery nature and draws upon their connection to Grimnir’s divine power to offer invaluable counsel to their Runefather. Not even the most rash of lodge leaders would make decisions on matters of ur-gold or war without first consulting their Runemaster. The role of spiritual advisor, however, does not mean that a Runemaster is a peaceful individual. Rather, they are able to think with a rational head while channelling emotions into manifestations of blazing magmic energy.

Each Runemaster carries a brazier-staff lit by the flames of his magmahold’s master forge. By slamming the base of their staff upon the ground, the battlefield cracks asunder and magma surges up to consume the foe. The Runemaster can also conjure walls of white-hot incandescence from the molten depths to block the advance of invaders.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest (2), Infantry, Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin

warscroll.name: Auric Runesmiter
warscroll.lore:
The prayers of an Auric Runesmiter are a war cry and their blessings are blazing coronas of flame. Within the thick of the fighting, their chants become burning energy made manifest, for battle is the domain of their ancestral god Grimnir. These members of the Zharrgrim priesthood are responsible for accruing ur-gold, and will take to the fore of battle to deliver their sermons to the warriors fighting to retrieve it. With shouted tales of ancestral heroics, their own battle-joy swells until divine energy sparks out from them in waves. Any warriors around the Runesmiters are inspired by their rumbling chants, filling them with vigour and righteous fury. This causes their ur-gold runes to blaze and sparkle as Grimnir’s essence responds in kind, filling their bearers with fell-handed power.

The Runesmiters have a deep knowledge of metal and rock thanks to their affinity with their holy fires. As a result, many have developed other, more elemental powers. They can control magmic forces, summon cinderstorms, and even cloak the claws of Magmadroths in flame. Most crucially, they can command the tide of battle by melting through solid rock and boring temporary tunnels for their Fyreslayer kin to charge through, allowing them to strike from an unexpected quarter.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Priest (1), Infantry, Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin

warscroll.name: Auric Runesmiter on Magmadroth
warscroll.lore:
The prayers of an Auric Runesmiter are a war cry and their blessings are blazing coronas of flame. Within the thick of the fighting, their chants become burning energy made manifest, for battle is the domain of their ancestral god Grimnir. These members of the Zharrgrim priesthood are responsible for accruing ur-gold, and will take to the fore of battle to deliver their sermons to the warriors fighting to retrieve it. With shouted tales of ancestral heroics, their own battle-joy swells until divine energy sparks out from them in waves. Any warriors around the Runesmiters are inspired by their rumbling chants, filling them with vigour and righteous fury. This causes their ur-gold runes to blaze and sparkle as Grimnir’s essence responds in kind, filling their bearers with fell-handed power.

The most powerful Runesmiters of the Zarrgrim Priesthood will ride to battle upon the backs of Magmadroths. These great salamanders are the descendants of Vulcatrix, the beast that died in battle with Grimnir centuries before. It is said only those who possess exceptional will and prowess can tame these creatures. Those that ride to war atop a Magmadroth command all attention on the battlefield and can single-handedly break apart enemy flanks with sheets of flame and arcing blows – even the superheated blood of the Magmadroth is a volatile threat should the enemy’s blades cut deep.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Priest (1), Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin, Magmadroth

warscroll.name: Auric Runeson on Magmadroth
warscroll.lore:
The fury of youth blazes in the blood of the Auric Runesons. Fyreslayer tradition maintains that when a Runefather perishes, the most capable of his offspring will inherit rulership of the lodge. An Auric Runeson must prove their worth constantly if they wish to outshine their many siblings. This ruthless hunger for glory leads them to recklessly seek out the part of the battlefield where the fighting is thickest – and their eagerness for the most challenging fights often leads them to plunge into danger with a fearlessness remarkable even for Fyreslayers.

Some Runesons will ride to battle upon the backs of flame spitting Magmadroths. These great salamanders are the descendants of Vulcatrix, the beast that died in battle with Grimnir centuries before. It is said only those who possess exceptional will and prowess can tame these creatures. Many Runesons raise their Magmadroths from infancy, seeing this as another way in which they can prove their worthiness as a potential leader. Those that ride to war atop a Magmadroth command all attention on the battlefield and can single-handedly break apart enemy flanks with sheets of flame and arcing blows – even the superheated blood of the Magmadroth is a volatile threat should the enemy’s blades cut deep.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as *Vulcatrix's Chosen*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin, Magmadroth

warscroll.name: Auric Hearthguard
warscroll.lore:
The warriors of the Auric Hearthguard are renowned for their steadfast bravery – holding ground no matter how dire the circumstances and facing even certain doom without abandoning their duty. They are tasked with guarding the forge-temple of their magmahold where ur-gold is stored and runes are forged. The absolute importance of this sacred site leads the Zharrgrim priesthood to handpick its guardians from the hold’s ranks, chosen for their implacability as much as their martial prowess. Small groups of them will often fight as bodyguards to the Zharrgrim priests, allowing their wards to safely retrieve more ur-gold deposits.

Of course, warriors of the Auric Hearthguard are as fiery and belligerent as any of their kin. However, they channel their battle-fury not into wild swings and reckless charges but into focusing the flaming devastation of their favoured weapon: the magmapike. These ornate hand-cannons spew a ceaseless barrage of superheated lava at their target, each blazing missile capable of melting through plate armour and igniting hair and flesh. Should any foes survive this ferocious hail of magma and engage the Auric Hearthguard in combat, they will be quickly dispatched with the blades affixed to the edges and hafts of these formidable weapons.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin

warscroll.name: Hearthguard Berzerkers with Berzerker Broadaxes
warscroll.lore:
The most skilled warriors of a magmahold are granted a place within the Hearthguard Berzerkers. These elite warriors are bodyguards to the royal family – the Auric Runefather and his Runesons. Hearthguard Berzerkers wield two-handed weapons, the better to keep the enemy at a distance from their ward. The deadly Berzerker broadaxe is a mighty weapon capable of splitting an ogor in two, while the flamestrike poleaxe features both a cleaving blade and a fiery brazier attached to the haft by a heavy chain.

Those deemed skilled enough warriors to join the Hearthguard Berzerkers are first invited to partake in ceremonial battles. Known as the Trials of Grimfyre, they involve the slaying of a gauntlet of beasts and monsters. Those who survive are allowed to pledge their oath of service, and in return are gifted their fireblessed weapon from the Runefather himself. The trials are a reflection of the challenges that await these warriors, for they must be prepared to lay down their lives unquestioningly for their lieges every time the Fyreslayers march to battle.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Ward (6+), Order, Fyreslayers, Duardin

warscroll.name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep
warscroll.lore: Volturnos is the last of the Cythai, a warrior whose cunning and prowess are legendary. Riding to battle atop Uasall, Prince of Deepmares, the High King carves a path through the foe, inspiring the Idoneth to ever greater deeds.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Cavalry, Fly, Order, Idoneth Deepkin, Aelf, Akhelian

warscroll.name: Akhelian Allopex
warscroll.lore: Allopexes are vicious predators of the deep, known for their voracious appetites. As Akhelian bond-beasts, they are more dangerous still, boasting scythed fins and deadly back-mounted harpoon launchers. Even the bravest fear these finned menaces.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Cavalry, Fly, Order, Idoneth Deepkin, Aelf, Akhelian
warscroll.wargearOptionsText:
***This unit is armed with Barbed Hooks and Blades, Allopex’s Ferocious Bite and 1 of the following options:***

• ***Razorshell Harpoon***
• ***Retarius Net Launcher***

warscroll.name: Namarti Reavers
warscroll.lore: Armed with silent‑firing whisperbows, Namarti Reavers are the fast‑moving scouts and archers of the Idoneth Deepkin Phalanxes. Despite their eerie and disturbing lack of eyes, they are uncannily accurate, using senses other than sight to pinpoint their targets.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Order, Idoneth Deepkin, Aelf, Namarti

warscroll.name: Aether-Khemist
warscroll.lore: Masters of alchemy and atmospheric analysis, Aether-Khemists not only augment their comrades’ weapons with a boost of aether-gold, but they can also turn their esoteric devices against their foes to drain the air from their lungs.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Order, Kharadron Overlords, Duardin, Skyfarer

warscroll.name: Codewright
warscroll.lore: With every artycle, every amendment and every footnote of the Kharadron Code learnt by heart, Codewrights are adept at not only citing obscure sections of the Code that can expedite the completion of their airfleet’s current objectives but also at adding ‘clarifications’ on the fly.
warscroll.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry, Order, Kharadron Overlords, Duardin, Skyfarer

warscroll.name: Vongrim Salvagers
warscroll.lore: Bonded by the shared trauma of lost ships and a sense of unity forged by hard times, Vongrim Salvagers go about their dangerous work with customary efficiency. With pistol, steel and cudgel, they cut down their foes and seize hold of profitable territory, refusing to give up their gains at any cost.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Fly, Order, Kharadron Overlords, Duardin, Skyfarer

warscroll.name: Ydrilan Riverblades
warscroll.lore: Leaping into battle with acrobatic finesse, Ydrilan Riverblades are swift and aggressive fighters. They attack with a relentless drive, surging forwards into the enemy with flowing lethality akin to the waterways their aelementiri temple has sworn to protect.
warscroll.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Infantry, Champion, Order, Lumineth Realm‑lords, Aelf, Ydrilan

warscroll.name: Lord Kroak
warscroll.lore:
Lord Kroak is the first of the slann, the guiding light of the Seraphon and the being chosen to oversee the completion of the Great Plan – the cosmic pattern ordained by the god-like Old Ones. Even the gods of Sigmar’s Pantheon are mere children to him, for Kroak was shaped by the Old Ones in the murky aeons of prehistory. Granted depthless wisdom and an unrivalled mastery of the aether, he has served his creators faithfully by defending reality against the malignant pull of Chaos at the cost of his physical form.

Though his body is now little more than a withered husk slumped upon a palanquin, Kroak’s formidable spirit clings to his mummified remains and coordinates the cosmos-spanning wars of the Seraphon. When fate demands it,the First Spawned takes to the field of battle wielding the powers of creation to restore order. With but a thought, Lord Kroak can summon a hail of burning meteors from the skies or imbue his cold-blooded kin with the very power of the stars. Yet his most fearsome magics are echoes of the devastating sorcery unleashed in the final moments of his life – an eruption of celestial force so powerful that it can shatter armies in an instant and reduce entire cities to dust.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Warmaster, Unique, Hero, Wizard (3), Fly, Ward (4+), Order, Seraphon, Slann

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Alarith Stonemage
warscroll.lore: Many are the Alarith Stonemages who journeyed to the Adamantine Chain to commune with the mountain spirits that dwell there. Having achieved true oneness with the earthbound aelementors, they are masters of geomantic and lithomantic magics.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Wizard (1), Infantry, Order, Lumineth Realm‑lords, Aelf, Alarith

warscroll.name: Saurus Oldblood on Carnosaur
warscroll.lore:
Oldbloods are veterans of a species bred solely for war, survivors of untold battles and the unrelenting annihilators of those who would defy their creator-gods. Taller and broader than their kin, their rough scales are criss-crossed with scars and old wounds, and they radiate a primal authority that all other Seraphon, save for the slann, intuitively defer to. Though not scholars of war, their instincts have been honed by centuries of killing; as a result, an Oldblood innately understands when to strike or when to roar for his warriors to close ranks and form an impenetrable wall of fangs and claws.

In battle, Saurus Oldbloods are death incarnate. Wielding relic weapons taken from the vaults of the Old Ones and sat astride apex predators known as Carnosaurs, they plunge into enemy ranks, hacking and tearing in a terrifying display of primal power. To hear the blood-chilling roar of a Carnosaur is enough to fill the hardiest warriors with mindless fear – but perhaps the beast’s most infamous features are its rending jaws. It is said that once these frenzied creatures scent blood, their bite carries with it enough strength to rip the head clean off a gargant.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, Order, Seraphon, Saurus

warscroll.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Daemonsmith on Infernal Taurus
warscroll.lore: Riding out from their ziggurat at the heart of the Adamantine Chain, the Daemonsmith is a terrifying sight. As their dreaded Infernal Taurus sends shockwaves rippling forth with every stamp of its hooves, the duardin sorcerer conjures unholy fire and drains arcane energies from the realm itself.
warscroll.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Monster, War Machine, Wizard (1), Fly, Chaos, Helsmiths of Hashut, Duardin

warscroll.name: Tyrant
warscroll.lore: The ferocious war-leaders of the Gutbuster warglutts, Tyrants are living mountains of iron and blubbery flesh. Despite their girth, they move with surprising speed, hacking their prey into bloody chunks for easier consumption. Tyrants are inveterate show‑offs, and maintaining their reputation is always forefront in their mind. They are inevitably extremely loud and crude, and they all want to prove their might by adopting ‘Big Names’ that speak to their deeds. Many Gutbusters borderline hero-worship their Tyrants and their feats, though only until a stronger rival comes along.
warscroll.referenceKeywords: Hero, Infantry

warscroll_ability.name: Echoes of the Vermindoom
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: As the bell rings in time with one of its counterparts in sacred Blight City, it releases a pulse of ruinous energies that invigorate the swarm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each friendly **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Shattered Gloom Globes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Thrallmasters carry globes that release dense clouds of shimmersmoke when shattered, choking the foe and masking the Cypher Lords’ advance.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ordered Cohorts
warscroll_ability.lore: Devoted servants of the Old Ones, Saurus Warriors are as intractable in defence as they are relentless upon the attack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Nullsuit
warscroll_ability.lore: A product of cutting-edge aethermatics, the nullsuit is designed to dampen magic and eliminate those who wield it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons for attacks that target **PRIESTS**, **WIZARDS** or **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: High Priest of the Zharrgrim
warscroll_ability.lore: The Zharrgrim order of every Fyreslayer lodge is led by an Auric Runemaster, a revered individual attuned to their deity like no other.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a **PRAYER** chanted by this unit is answered, this unit gains a **magmic power token**.

warscroll_ability.name: Smoke Bombs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Clans Eshin use smoke bombs to cause confusion and disorientate the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is in combat. Roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 4+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Lost in the Horde
warscroll_ability.lore: Gibbering and bound, Loonsmasha Fanatics are dragged or carried along by the general mass of grots until the time arrives to unrestrain them and pray to the Bad Moon that they head in the right direction.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lost in the horde**. This unit has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Duty Calls
warscroll_ability.lore: When duty demands it, an abhorrant monarch or their regent will descend from the throne to take up the sword.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this terrain feature has a Steward that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Steward on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward.

warscroll_ability.name: Attack From on High
warscroll_ability.lore: Terradons circle high in the sky, only darting down for a brief moment to launch a strafing run.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Nerve-shredding Screeches
warscroll_ability.lore: The shrill cries of a Terrawing flock can cause disarray across the enemy line.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Legion Quartermaster
warscroll_ability.lore: Though hardly quartermasters in the traditional sense, the Boneshapers of the Ossiarch legions are without peer when it comes to re-assembling their line warriors from shattered remains.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Martial Memories
warscroll_ability.lore: Tree-Revenants can draw on centuries of experience when they go to war.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit this phase:

***Memories of War:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit.

***Memories of Peace:*** Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Grasping Hands
warscroll_ability.lore: The animated corpses trapped in a Cadaverous Barricade grab at any living creature that comes too close.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Enemy units cannot use **RUN** or **RETREAT** abilities while they are within this **MANIFESTATION**’s combat range.
In addition, if an enemy unit is picked to use a **MOVE** ability while it is within this **MANIFESTATION**’s combat range, halve that unit’s Move characteristic (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Outrageous Carnage
warscroll_ability.lore: Where a Great Axe of Khorne strikes, lashes of flame erupt from the split earth to annihilate those nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 8" of it after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved (and continue the attack sequence).

warscroll_ability.name: No Respite
warscroll_ability.lore: Dying as they lived, Blood Warriors devote even their final moments to killing.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll 2 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Arise! Arise!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endless Legions’ ability and picked a friendly Deadwalkers unit to be the target
warscroll_ability.lore: With a rasping cry, the Gravekeeper beckons his freshly buried victims to rise as undead and defend the walls of Ulfenkarn.
warscroll_ability.effect: When resolving the effect of the ‘Endless Legions’ ability, set up the replacement unit wholly within 3" of this unit instead of wholly within 12" and more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", even if it is not your movement phase. The replacement unit can still use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Wardroth Beetle's Antlers** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Unnatural Edge
warscroll_ability.lore: The falchions carve through an enemy’s defences, and even powerful mystical enchantments are hewn asunder.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points are allocated to the target this phase by this **MANIFESTATION’**s combat attacks, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Gutless
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Drunken Revelry
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Centigors glut themselves on potent brews made of fermented blood and Chaos-infused oozes that they bring from their territories, sending them into a state of drunken bravado in which they are blind to fear and pain.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use this ability if it is not in combat. It has **WARD (4+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dormant Energies
warscroll_ability.lore: The Isharann aspect of an Eidolon of Mathlann seethes with suppressed energies that it can draw upon at need.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of the Hammerhands
warscroll_ability.lore: Vandus is a mighty champion of the Hammers of Sigmar and a consummate commander.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Coils
warscroll_ability.lore: The coils of the Bloodwrack Viper wrap around an enemy, pinning them in place.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Aviarch Spymaster
warscroll_ability.lore: The Aviarch Spymaster can use their spy network to disrupt the plans of Katakros’s enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bully of the First Degree
warscroll_ability.lore: Tyrants use abrupt violence to help them maintain an iron rule over their warglutt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the control score of the target until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Two Bodies, One Soul
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Should either the Shadow Queen or Morathi-Khaine be struck down, their shared soul ensures their mutual survival.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. If you have used the Blessings of Khaine ability 3 or more times this battle, pick a friendly **Morathi-Khaine** or **Shadow Queen** that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 3" of a friendly **Morathi-Khaine** or **Shadow Queen**.

warscroll_ability.name: Myrmidon Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: Every wound inflicted on a Myrmidon only serves to stoke its rage further.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Realmscribe
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Depict Rune’ ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Scinari Calligraves are the undisputed masters of the arcane art of tracing runes on the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Replace 1 instance of a rune on your **battle scripture** with 1 of the following:

**• Varinor, Rune of Strength**
**• Ydriliqi, Rune of the River**
**• Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain**
**• Oreali, Rune of the Wind**

warscroll_ability.name: The Eye of Sheerian
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Torn from the corpse of a mighty dragon, this artefact grants Archaon visions of future events.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. This roll replaces the priority roll of the next battle round. On a 1-3, your opponent must take the first turn of that battle round. On a 4-6, you must take the first turn of that battle round. This ability cannot be used if there is an enemy **Archaon** on the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Crush to Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gobsprakk’s mount, Killabeak, takes wicked delight in crushing smaller foes in its talons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Tornado of Magic
warscroll_ability.lore: The tempestuous air currents that swirl around a Celestian Vortex disrupt the aim of the enemy's ranged troops and the flight of the missiles they loose.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks made by enemy units while they are within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of Destiny
warscroll_ability.lore: Kairos sees both past and future, granting him unchecked power of the fate of his victims.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit has not already **engineered the outcome** this battle round, instead of making a casting roll, unbinding roll, banishment roll, hit roll, wound roll or save roll for a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, this unit can **engineer the outcome**.

If the roll would have been a D6 roll, you can use a value of 6 for it that cannot be modified. If the roll would have been a 2D6 roll, you can use a value of 9 for it that cannot be modified.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Castellan of Azyr
warscroll_ability.lore: Centuries spent commanding Sigmar’s prime Stormhost have sharpened Bastian’s tactical nous to a deadly edge. There are few warlords more adept than he in all the armies of Order.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike on the Move
warscroll_ability.lore: Namarti Reavers are experts at running out from cover to unleash a hail of deadly arrows.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Massive Horns** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: With Spell and Sword
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Curseling casts deadly spells even in the midst of blade-on-blade combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **UNLIMITED** keyword and as if this unit had not cast any spells this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Immolating Presence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: With a beat of its wings and a snort of its nostrils, an Infernal Taurus unleashes a wave of daemonic heat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Bind and Bite
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Bloodwrack Viper constricts, the victim is completely at the mercy of its deadly bite.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ if the target of those attacks has **STRIKE-LAST**.

warscroll_ability.name: Vicious Protectors
warscroll_ability.lore: As the fiercest of their kind, Tzaangor Enlightened are often tasked with protecting the leaders of the Arcanite Cults. Not only do they excel at slaying those who threaten their charges, but the disturbingly insightful taunts they constantly crow fill their foes with doubt, robbing their strikes of conviction.

warscroll_ability.name: Arch-Manipulator
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who dare face a Warpseer find themselves utterly pre-empted and outmanoeuvred.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Slavering For Sensation
warscroll_ability.lore: This Bladebringer encourages their chariot-mounted followers to plunge themselves into enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Hellflayer** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this unit and each target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gossamid Commander
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The winged Arch-Revenants often go to battle at the head of a flight of Gossamid Archers, who loose coordinated volleys of arrows as their leader plunges into the fight.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible friendly **Gossamid Archers** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of the attacks made as part of that **SHOOT** ability must target an enemy unit that is in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: Overwhelmed with bloodlust, the Gorger Mawpack launch themselves from their hiding place in a futile frenzy to end their eternal hunger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **lurking on the fringes**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Markin' Territory
warscroll_ability.lore: Giant Snarlfangs are extremely territorial and will ferociously attack trespassers on land marked with their scent.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lie of the Land
warscroll_ability.lore: The Beastflayers’ familiarity with their hunting grounds allows them to easily outflank their prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat and is wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
