warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, when it uses the 'Malfunctioning Leystone' ability, roll 1 dice instead of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Slashing Fins
warscroll_ability.lore: Screamers swoop from discoloured skies to slash at their foes, performing fly-by attacks and effortless manoeuvres.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that any models in this unit passed across this phase to be the target, then roll a dice for each model in this unit that did so.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Thricefold Savagery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Each head of a Chimera operates independently of the others, and though they are prone to violent disagreement as to which prey they should hunt, they are capable of working in terrifying concert.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 3 dice. For each 4+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Chimeric Heads** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sweeping Blows** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Wade and Smash
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Dankhold Troggoth rampages through the enemy lines, swinging its enormous club back and forth and sending enemies flying in all directions.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move 6" but must end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Corrupting Influence
warscroll_ability.lore: This giant construct bathes all in a thick billowing smog that is anathema to its enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Monstrous Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Light in the Dark
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: This warrior's celestial beacon serves as a guiding light to their fellow Prosecutors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Prosecutors** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• If the target is in combat, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
• If the target is not in combat, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: A Twisted Fate
warscroll_ability.lore: For some, their destiny is to become a mewling abomination – they just do not know it yet.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **masked by illusion**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Stomps
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At the command of the Stegadon Chief, the Stegadon crushes its enemies with its unstoppable bulk.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 2 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any, if this unit charged this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Grasping Tongue
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The massive pox maggoth Whippermaw lashes its tongue around its hapless victim, preparing to devour them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Hand of Dust
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Miasma of Pestilence
warscroll_ability.lore: Bloab Rotspawned completes a complicated gesture in the air and a vile mist rises from the ground around his target.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that friendly unit have no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: Call of Battle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Beastlords swiftly lead their underlings towards the foe, desperate to get to grips with the enemy so that the bloodletting can begin.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BRAYHERD INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Rolling Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: A Doomwheel will mercilessly crush anything in its path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. This unit can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

**Designer’s Note:** *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*

warscroll_ability.name: Scrolls of Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: The unlimited arcane knowledge held on these scrolls can conjure sorceries of perfect structure.
warscroll_ability.effect: The next time this unit uses a non‑**SUMMON SPELL** ability this phase, do not make a casting roll as part of that ability. Instead, roll a dice. On a 2+, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound.

warscroll_ability.name: Star-venom
warscroll_ability.lore: The blowdarts used by the Hunters of Huanchi are coated in deadly toxins.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Dartpipe** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Tendrils of Corruption
warscroll_ability.lore: Blighted roots worm their way underground as the Feculent Gnarlmaw slowly drags itself across the land.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the phase, this terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 3" and can immediately move 3". It cannot move through or end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units and it cannot end that move on an objective or another terrain feature.

**Designer’s Note:** *This terrain feature cannot use* **MOVE**, **RUN**, **RETREAT** *or* **CHARGE** *abilities.*

warscroll_ability.name: Guided by the Winds
warscroll_ability.lore: The Windchargers’ arrows are lofted by benevolent winds and sped toward to their targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you have 2 or more instances of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s Windcharger Bows.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnosaur’s Massive Jaws** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Justice From Azyr
warscroll_ability.lore: When the chance to eliminate her mark presents itself, Neave is merciless in bringing them to justice.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Whirlwind Axes** for attacks that target a **HERO**.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Radiant Transmogrification
warscroll_ability.lore: The Burning Sigil channels the energies of the Impossible Fortress; with each pulse comes a handful of blessings and curses as fickle as the bastion’s master.
warscroll_ability.declare: This **MANIFESTATION** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
1: No effect.
2-3:  **Heal (D3)** each friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
4: Friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **RUN** abilities.
5- Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
6- Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.

warscroll_ability.name: Lashing Tail
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Magmadroths can use their muscular spiked tails to pulverise lesser prey with a single swipe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of models in the target unit, inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Bloodthirsty Predators
warscroll_ability.lore: Allopexes are drawn towards the scent of freshly spilt blood.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Allopex’s Ferocious Bite** while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bolt of Change
warscroll_ability.lore: The Magister hurls a coruscating bolt of energy at the foe, causing their flesh to run like wax and remould into a form more pleasing to Tzeentch.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain by this ability, you can pick a friendly **Tzaangors** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and return 1 slain model to that **Tzaangors** unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Deintalos the Exile
warscroll_ability.lore: Deintalos does not take his exile lightly and hopes one day to develop his art to rival that of the Great Necromancer himself.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Deintalos the Exile** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**. While this unit’s **Prentice Marcov** is on the battlefield, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Duty Unto Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Hearthguard Berzerkers are sworn to protect their lodge and its masters until their dying breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Loyal Gryph-hound
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gryphhound that accompanies the Lord-Imperatant is the most faithful guard.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Gryph-hound** is a token. This unit has **WARD (5+)** while its **Gryph-hound** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-hound** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Wraithstorm
warscroll_ability.lore: Reikenor tears the souls from his victims and commands them to assail their allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain as a result of this ability, inflict a further D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Bilespurter’s Claws** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Feedin' Time
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Squigbosses possess a deep knowledge of all types of fungi and bring the most potent kinds into battle to feed to their squigs.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SQUIG** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Crimson Deffcap:*** Add 3" to the target’s Move characteristic.

***Yellow Lurka:*** The target’s **Fang-filled Gobs, Huge Fang-filled Gobs** or **Massive Fang-filled Gobs** have **Crit (Mortal)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Release the Fanatics!
warscroll_ability.lore: As the enemy approaches, the Loonsmashas are unleashed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **hidden among the mobs**. Then, pick a friendly **Moonclan Shootas** or **Moonclan Stabbas** unit that has 10 or more models to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Infernal Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: A sorcerer of Chaos can draw upon the bound daemons of the Nexus Chaotica to empower their spellcasting.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature has 3 or more **power points**, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove 3 **power points** from this terrain feature, then add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Prey of the Blood God
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Karanak hunts those who have earned the Blood God’s ire.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick an enemy **HERO** to be this unit's quarry. You can pick a **HERO** in reserve.

warscroll_ability.name: You Messin'?
warscroll_ability.lore: Most beings with half an ounce of common sense swiftly wither under the furious gaze of an orruk Brute who has marked their territory.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units with a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Omens of Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: Krethusa uses her connection to Morai-Heg to follow the twisting skeins of fate and glean a prophetic vision.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects. If the chanting roll was 10+, pick up to 2 different effects instead.

**Prophecy of Exile**: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 18" of this unit. Subtract 1 from that unit’s power level until the start of your next turn.

**Prophecy of Dark Wings:** Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit. That unit can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase and counts as having used a **RUN** ability this turn.

**Prophecy of Futile Endeavours:** Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: All Part of Da Plan
warscroll_ability.lore: Kruleboyz tend to be very impressed by a Killaboss’s kunnin’ feats – so long as the boss has a plan, they are willing to face down even the most unlikely odds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Plough the Icepath
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability for this unit in your movement phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Thundertusks are hardy creatures capable of shovelling through huge snowdrifts, and it is not uncommon for nearby ogors to hitch a ride by grabbing on to their shaggy hides.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of this unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target unit wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. The target cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: I'm Off!
warscroll_ability.lore: The orruk makes a quick exit.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shouty Boss.

warscroll_ability.name: Spirit-scouring Flames
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemies engulfed by Cthorak’s pale-flame breath feel their very souls begin to burn away.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Spirit‑scouring Flames** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has the **SOULBURNED** keyword for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Bestial Desecration
warscroll_ability.lore: As Pestigor herds use their own bodily waste to pollute the land in tribute to Father Blight, their filthy blades brim with all manner of fluid-borne pathogens.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is not within enemy territory.

warscroll_ability.name: Knell of Doom
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The ominous toll of the Harbinger's bell is enough to give pause to even the bravest warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is within 6" of a friendly **Sloven Knights** unit, you can roll a D6 instead. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Stuff 'Em In Me Bag
warscroll_ability.lore: Gargants are known to grab hapless warriors and stuff them screaming into their bags ‘for later’…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the roll is at least double the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Phantasmal Ruin
warscroll_ability.lore: Gloomtide Shipwrecks are apparitions of sunken vessels filled with ethereal creatures that strike out at those who stray too close.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Whirlpool's Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: An Ikon of the Storm is a vortex of rage, overwhelming enemies and inspiring their kin to fight ever harder.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

Friendly units that use a **RETREAT** ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Searing Desert Winds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sevireth is the lord of burning-hot and parching desert winds. If Sevireth whirls around a foe for long enough, only desiccated corpses are left in his wake.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 6" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Hexwraiths ride down their chosen prey, their targets are subject to the phantasmal cavalry’s life-leeching powers.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Go For Da Eyes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Dakko is one of the more accomplished archers in the warclans and can land a shot with surprising accuracy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Dakko Sharp-Stikka** is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Agonising Spasms
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who meet the Medusa’s gaze are stricken by bone-shattering spasms, leaving them prostrate in helpless agony.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks made as part of that **SHOOT** ability targeted the same enemy unit and any enemy models were slain by those attacks, roll a dice. On a 3+, that enemy unit has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Murder
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Darkoath Chieftains offer up the souls of enemy lords and champions in exchange for divine power.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit destroyed an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** this turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Alarielle's Song
warscroll_ability.lore: To the Sylvaneth, the sound that emanates from a Warsong Revenant’s flute is sweet and uplifting. To their foes, it is a sonic assault of devastating potency.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **SYLVANETH** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Bomb Racks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield below to obliterate ground targets.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3+1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood For The Blood God!
warscroll_ability.lore: A howling mass of Bloodreavers is never more dangerous than when seized by the frenzy of the charge.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gruesome Bombardment
warscroll_ability.lore: Piercing laughter and growls erupt from the Skull Cannon’s jaws before its grisly missiles strike home – a salvo that can shatter the will.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by a **SHOOT** ability used by this unit, subtract 3 from that enemy unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Man Da Tower!
warscroll_ability.lore: Orruk bosses know they look dead impressive when lording it up from an idol of their god.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss:

• The Shouty Boss cannot use **MOVE** abilities.

• Instead of measuring range or visibility to and from the Shouty Boss, measure to and from this terrain feature instead.

• All attacks that would target the Shouty Boss target this terrain feature instead.

• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shouty Boss. Then, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat.That unit is no longer the Shouty Boss. If it is not possible to set up the Shouty Boss, it is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Avatar of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Shields of the Legion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an **ATTACK** ability that targeted a visible **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit within this unit's combat range
warscroll_ability.lore: The Mortek Guard are the backbone of the Ossiarch legions, preventing enemy assaults from finding purchase wherever their nadirite shields are raised in tireless defence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability that target any friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Fleet of Hoof
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The wiry agility of the Ungors allows them to move with great speed while evading enemy attacks, making them difficult to pin down.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Light-footed Killers
warscroll_ability.lore: Blissbarb Archers can deliver pinpoint shots even while cavorting wildly across the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unholy Lodestone
warscroll_ability.lore: Deadwalker Zombies that are driven into battle like loathsome cattle are invigorated by the presence of nearby Corpse Carts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, its ‘Mindless Ferocity’ ability inflicts mortal damage on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike At The Heart
warscroll_ability.lore: Focusing upon their own cursed hunger, the Vampire Lord stokes the predatory urges of a formation of Blood Knights, whose lances and blades strike with great precision and force as they impact with the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s **Templar Weapons** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: 'Aye Aye, Captain!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Under orders of the ship’s Captain, the Endrinmaster attempts to squeeze every bit of power out of a vessel’s endrin.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Reflected Agony
warscroll_ability.lore: A pulsing wave of pain emanates from the Bloodwrack Shrine, repelling enemies and even arcane manifestations.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, enemy units and enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Implacable Advance
warscroll_ability.lore: This daemonic engine is utterly relentless in its desire to pay off the soul-tithe owed to its masters.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Enshrouding Fumes
warscroll_ability.lore: Choking, miasmatic clouds swirl around a Plaguepack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cling to the Shadows
warscroll_ability.lore: With quicksilver speed, these creatures scale terrain in a matter of moments, hiding in the shadows while they prepare to strike.
warscroll_ability.effect: While each model in this unit is within 1" of any terrain features, this unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Regenerating Terror
warscroll_ability.lore: Brood Terrors are a nightmare of mutation and overwhelming strength.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Iridan does battle where others cannot tread, fighting in lands transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on this shepherd of lost souls, their faith granting them near immunity to such impurities.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Forceful Command
warscroll_ability.lore: The Changeling imbues its orders with compelling enchantments so that none can disobey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target cannot use **MOVE** abilities.
• The target’s melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Spellmaster
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzeentch’s foremost mortal disciples are masters of magic, capable of absorbing powerful arcana to fuel their own spells.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: First of the Pack
warscroll_ability.lore: Where the Hound of Vengeance hunts, his bestial kin are sure to follow in pursuit, empowered by Karanak’s single-minded fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit, add 2 to charge rolls for this unit. In addition, while any friendly **Flesh Hounds** units are wholly within 12" of this unit, they can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: On Rotten Wings
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Hurling itself skyward, a Zombie Dragon descends on new and tantalising prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set up it again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Behemoth Brawler
warscroll_ability.lore: Beast‑smashers rely on their killer instincts when battling colossal creatures, fighting with the spirit of Gorkamorka and the ferocity of Behemat to overpower their prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of enemy **MONSTERS** while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Conquered Lands
warscroll_ability.lore: In desolating the lands they seize and garrison, the Infernal Cohorts extract a fell power.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective you control, pick a friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, give the target 1 **daemonic power** point.

**Designer’s Note:** *You cannot make more than one roll for each objective in each turn regardless of how many friendly units with this ability are contesting that objective.*

warscroll_ability.name: Bone Harvest
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Gothizzar Harvester fights, its vestigial appendages ceaselessly work to amass a grisly stockpile of bones.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each enemy unit that has been destroyed this battle. Add 1 to each roll if this unit used a **FIGHT** ability this turn. If any of the rolls are a 4+, this unit is **full.**

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of the Infected Legions
warscroll_ability.lore: Under the rheumy gaze of a Lord of Plagues, Rotswords will repel those foolish enough to try to break their diseased ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **Rotswords** units that did not charge this turn while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Waves of Mutation
warscroll_ability.lore: There is no limit to Tzeentch’s appetite for change.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit or the replacement of this unit is destroyed, set up a replacement unit in reserve **masked by illusion.** Each friendly **Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch** unit can be replaced any number of times.

warscroll_ability.name: First Among Akhelians
warscroll_ability.lore: Volturnos is the greatest Akhelian King to have ever lived. His supreme skill and vast experience serve as an inspiration to all members of the Idoneth’s warrior caste.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **AKHELIAN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Necromantic Limits
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Skeletal Talons** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Skeletal Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Steady Aim
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Bow-wielding Kurnoth Hunters are those of their kind who exhibit particular focus and patience. They take the time to carefully aim and line up a target before unleashing their arrows with deadly precision.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleash The Beast
warscroll_ability.lore: With bursts of primal energy, the Untamed Beasts chase down their enemies with relentless fervour.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Predatory Exemplar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Oldbloods lead through instinctual ferocity, trusting their saurus kin to follow in their wake.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SAURUS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Vulcha Dive
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Corpse-rippa crashes down into the enemy’s ranks from on high, tearing into reeling warriors with cruel relish.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Sloppklaw’s Bite and Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Kompany Taktikz
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Slittabosses drill their hobgrots without mercy – after all, the more decisively they strike, the better chance they have of grabbing up the loot.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: More-More Warpvolt Doom!
warscroll_ability.lore: This warpvolt weapon unleashes an all-consuming wave of sparking death that vaporises nearby enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's **Warpvolt Obliterator** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each other enemy unit within the target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Zephyrspites
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: These symbiotic winged spites offer their hosts unparalleled manoeuvrability, allowing them to swiftly reposition after loosing a deadly volley.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, this unit can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Come Then, Amuse Us
warscroll_ability.lore: Prince Duvalle and his courtiers scour every corner of the Mortal Realms in the hopes of finding worthy opponents. Alas, few measure up to the vampires’ lofty standards.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES**, roll a D3 and then pick a number of effects from the list below equal to the roll:

• Add 1 to save rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Bloodshed
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Though he is contemptuous of the gods, Gunnar is still Darkoath; he is not so foolish as to reject their boons should they seek to reward his murder-making.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if any enemy **HEROES** were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **GUNNAR’S OATHSWORN** units have **WARD (4+)** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: A Majestic Menagerie
warscroll_ability.lore: Magnificent are the courtly warbeasts, resplendent in glittering armour and utterly loyal to their noble masters.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** melee weapons used by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**.

warscroll_ability.name: Rise From The Depths
warscroll_ability.lore: Ancient wreckages adrift in the great currents of the ethersea provide a haven for Idoneth.
warscroll_ability.declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunters of Majestic Beasts
warscroll_ability.lore: With vindictive glee, wind spirits race across the battlefield in pursuit of mighty behemoths, seeking to lay them low with a well-placed shot.
warscroll_ability.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Bow of the Wind’s Vengeance** is 3 for attacks that target **MONSTERS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bring Every Gun to Bear!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At the Admiral’s order, the skyvessel is steered into position to deliver a devastating salvo.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Spending the Forge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In times of need, a Zharrgrim priest may expend all of the Magmic Battleforge’s power, igniting the ur-gold runes of their Fyreslayer kin and infusing the warriors with strength.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** within this terrain feature’s combat range to expend the power of the forge.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit on the battlefield. Once this ability has been used, this terrain feature cannot use the ‘Molten Blessing’ ability for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Still Their Breath!
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is Zandtos’s disdain for those who trespass in Shyish that those who fight beside him come to share it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If this unit is in combat, no **relentless discipline** points are spent. The target's melee weapons have **Charge (+ 1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Commanding Presence
warscroll_ability.lore: The presence of a Runefather in the Fyreslayer battleline bolsters the warriors’ already considerable will, ensuring that the doughty duardin will hold their ground and slog it out with any foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add the current battle round number to the control scores of friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Riders of Ruin
warscroll_ability.lore: Blood Knights trample clean over lesser foes to strike at more worthy challengers.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

warscroll_ability.name: Shock Gauntlets
warscroll_ability.lore: The electrical discharge created by shock gauntlets can trigger a series of linked explosions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s **Shock Gauntlets** scores a critical hit, that attack scores D6 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.

warscroll_ability.name: Unnatural Heat
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: An Exalted Flamer’s streams of warping fire melt armour to slag and devour defensive wards.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to the roll. On a 5+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Grappling Hooks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Night Runners are experts at scaling vertical terrain with their grapnels, either to ambush an unwary foe or retreat to where the enemy cannot follow.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit was not set up this turn, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Bitterness of the Soul
warscroll_ability.lore: The souls of Ylthari’s Guardians are chilled through by the frost of the Everdusk.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Enchanted Glade Weapons** for each model in this unit that is slain.

**Designer’s Note:** *Models that have been slain and returned to this unit do not count as being slain for the purposes of this ability.*

warscroll_ability.name: Memorian
warscroll_ability.lore: Memorians serve to remind soul-damaged Stormcasts of their humanity.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Memorian** is a token. Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units wholly within 12" of this unit while its **Memorian** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Memorian** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Morbid Detonation
warscroll_ability.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 **maelstrom points**. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Pall of Exhaustion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A cloud of gloom rests heavily on any who approach the Sloven Knights.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is in combat with any other friendly **ROTBRINGERS** units. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughterous Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne’s Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Ensnared
warscroll_ability.lore: The Akhelians are experts at ensnaring their prey with a well-placed harpoon or Retarius net.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** or **CAVALRY** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Will of the Horned Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: None among the Skaven clans may defy the commands of a Grey Seer – openly, at least…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, add the roll to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Roar of Domination
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Thanatorg is quick to put potential usurpers of Abraxia’s power in their place.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Attention Seekers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Beasts of Nurgle seek out playmates with an enthusiasm that is rarely reciprocated by the horrified source of their fascination.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Transport Capacity
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can transport up to 3 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

warscroll_ability.name: Galv-shields
warscroll_ability.lore: Thanks to their protective aura, the Ishlaen have greater staying power in prolonged combat than their spear-armed kin.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Raiders' Resolve
warscroll_ability.lore: The Akhelian King orders the warriors under their command to stand firm in the face of the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Shield Inviolate
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Starspawned
warscroll_ability.lore: The concentrated Azyrite magic radiating from the Sunblood imbues their warrior kin with incredible resilience.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to friendly **SAURUS** and **KROXIGOR** units each phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Gestalt Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Through combined worship, a cult of Acolytes can swell their arcane power to new levels of ferocity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Sorcerous Bolts** this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Ghurish Ferocity
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The twinheaded griffons of Ghur ridden by Amber Battlemages are alpha predators that prey upon other megafauna.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks** for attacks that target enemy **MONSTERS** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Chilling Onslaught
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gales of punishing cold drive before an oncoming Thundertusk, numbing or entirely freezing enemies’ limbs.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Storm of Shemtek
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Celestial Hurricanum can summon a magical storm to batter the foe with the fury of the heavens. As the battle rages, the tempest grows ever stronger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Vicious Snarls and Great Howls
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The lupine language of the Snarlfang Alpha drives their pack into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **GITMOB CAVALRY** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Pain-Induced Frenzy
warscroll_ability.lore: The pain caused by the Twistweald’s parasitic infestations reaches its zenith when their thoughts turn to imminent murder-making, driving them into an agonised fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Dark Master
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Many puppets dance on Be’lakor’s infernal strings. Few realise as much until their fate is sealed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use an ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that ability has no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: A Pact Maintained
warscroll_ability.lore: The undead mercenaries of Kos are as loyal to Radukar in death as they were in life.
warscroll_ability.effect: While a friendly **Radukar the Wolf** or **Radukar the Beast** is within this unit’s combat range, both that unit and this unit have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Tail Swipe
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The mighty Bastiladon swings its clubbed tail into the ranks of enemies, knocking them back with brutal force.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit, to a maximum of 8. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Berserkers
warscroll_ability.lore: These Brutes forego heavy armour, which means they can get stuck in to the fighting as quickly as possible.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleashed Savagery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Suppressing their savage spirit no more, these ferocious warriors hack at the foe in a bestial frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: One Stop, No Return
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Black Coach bears down upon its target at the appointed hour, flaming hoofprints burning the skies. Where it arrives, soul-numbing terror is brought with it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, they cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (hit rolls that would be critical hits score hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Protective Focus
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is this Battlemage’s unwavering concentration on one facet of their arcane arsenal that it renders them immune to the adverse effects of spellcasting.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a **SPELL** ability that this unit can use. For the rest of the battle, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit if it miscasts that spell.

warscroll_ability.name: Joyous Battle Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: Once Dexcessa begins to fight, they become invigorated by the glorious thrill of combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Impaling Talons** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Travel The Waterways
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Ydrilan are able to navigate the realms’ waterways in order to travel as fast as the flow of the rapids.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

If you picked to depict **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** on your **battle scripture** this battle round, you can instead set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruler of All They Survey
warscroll_ability.lore: A steward may become convinced of their own grandeur and bid troops sally forth in their glorious name.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature has a Steward, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can move D3". If the target was set up this turn, it can move D6" instead. It cannot move into combat during that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mawseeker Acolytes' Blades and Gorger's Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Rapid Approach
warscroll_ability.lore: Moving with liquid speed and uncanny agility, the Ikon is on its foes before they have a chance to react.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Steel and Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Black Guard are often charged with protecting heroes on the field of battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Crazed Flock
warscroll_ability.lore: A flock of snapping, screeching Raptoryx is capable of swiftly bringing down any prey should they catch them unawares.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Strangle Hex
warscroll_ability.lore: Coiling tendrils of magic burst from Gobsprakk’s outstretched hand, choking the life from the target.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Doomfang
warscroll_ability.lore: Though Doomfang offers the ageing Krittok martial power, he must constantly haggle with its daemonic occupant, a fact that can sometimes prove distracting.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn but it cannot use commands this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulbound Protectors
warscroll_ability.lore: Immortis Guard will use their own bodies to shield their rulers from harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (5+)** while they are within this unit's combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: The Surging Sea
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Ikon’s aura of calm yet fearsome power sweeps up nearby Idoneth, carrying them into battle like a racing current.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Lightning Pulse
warscroll_ability.lore: With electricity pulsing from her eyes, Astreia gathers the power of Azyr into herself and then releases it as a blinding, expanding dome of lightning.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you picked 1 unit, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target. If you picked 2 units, inflict 2 mortal damage on each target. If you picked 3 units, inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderstruck
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When a lightning hammer finds its mark, enemies are paralysed by crackling energy and a flash of blinding light.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Endless Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: The presence of Nurglings in the realms continuously draws more of their number from the Grandfather’s Garden, making their swarms extremely hard to eradicate.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: You Dare?!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Katakros narrows his focus to personally deal with a more immediate threat.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if at least half of the units from your starting army have been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle round:
• Add 5 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Inda-Khaat**.
• Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **The Shield Immortis**.
• This unit cannot use the 'Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions' ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The** **Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Stone Skeleton
warscroll_ability.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Battlebroth
warscroll_ability.lore: The contents of the Mawpot are suffused with strange magic; a single mouthful can restore an ogor’s vitality and stitch up their wounds.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the **Great Mawpot** is full, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of it. After you have done so, the **Great Mawpot** is **empty**.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Heritage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Some exceptional Draconith are able to awaken their kind's innate resistance to magic within their broodmates.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit or a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Axe of Khorne** is 4 .

warscroll_ability.name: Starstone Bolas
warscroll_ability.lore: A perfectly timed bola throw can ensnare an enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s **Starstone Bolas** this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: The End of Empires
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Rhinox Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: A rhinox’s double-horned skull can inflict considerable damage when the beast charges into the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Rhinox’s Sharp Horns** is 3 if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Crush the Unworthy
warscroll_ability.lore: The raw arrogance of the Bull Centaurs sees them crash through foes with wanton abandon.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for each **daemonic power point** it has.

warscroll_ability.name: Aethersight
warscroll_ability.lore: Aetheric Navigators can unpick enemy spells by harnessing the arcane jet streams.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wild Form
warscroll_ability.lore: This manifestation is notoriously wilful, resisting any effort by sorcerers to tame or banish it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this **MANIFESTATION** is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ghorrakos’s Horns and Hooves** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Tuskgor Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Spurred on by merciless whipping, Tuskgor Chariots barrel headlong into their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: The Slayer of Kings
warscroll_ability.lore: This ancient daemonblade thirsts for the souls of champions and warlords.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, if the unmodified wound roll for 2 or more attacks made with **The Slayer of Kings** that target the same **HERO** is 6, that **HERO** is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Sanctified Gongs
warscroll_ability.lore: The gongs borne by this unit have been sanctified with the blood of the Zharrdron’s hated cousins. The cursed resonance they produce fills the Helsmiths with spiteful vigour but occasionally causes their hobgrot bearers to expire.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gong Carriers** are tokens. There is 1 **Gong Carrier** for every musician in this unit. If this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, make 2 additional rally rolls of D6 for each **Gong Carrier** in this unit, but for each unmodified rally roll of 1, you must remove a **Gong Carrier** from this unit after the command has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Exsanguinating Glare
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Bloodwrack Medusa’s eyes blaze with pure hatred, and those who meet her gaze perish in agony as blood explodes violently from their every pore and orifice.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, if any enemy models were slain by that mortal damage, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to its Health characteristic.

warscroll_ability.name: Deadly Aura
warscroll_ability.lore: Wreathed in baleful death magic that induces a draining sense of dread, these forbidding edifices steadily repel outsiders.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Enemy units cannot be set up within **X**" of this terrain feature, where **X** is determined by the current battle round, as follows:

Battle Round - **X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"

warscroll_ability.name: Royal Bodyguard
warscroll_ability.lore: In battle, it falls to the tenacious Cryptguard to form a half-living shield for their vampiric overlords.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly non-**MONSTER** **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those **HEROES** have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardian and Mentor
warscroll_ability.lore: This indomitable duo has faced down some of the most grievous enemies the Mortal Realms has to offer.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit contains 2 models, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughterous Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne’s Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a crushing charge roll of D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Consecrated Revulsion
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaughter Queen’s fanaticism is so intense that her deity provides protection for her followers from the attacks of heathens and weaklings.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Curse of Stone
warscroll_ability.lore: Rumbling with laughter, Taar channels his curse into a billowing wave of power, seeing enemies gradually overcome with creeping petrification.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 9" of this unit, then pick a second point on the battlefield within 9" of the first point. Draw a line between the caster and the first point, and between the first and second points. Each enemy unit the lines pass across is a target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Alright, Listen Up
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Codewright’s fury at such blatant disregard for the precepts and carefully laid-out clauses of the Code is so infectious that nearby Kharadron unleash a barrage of hastily aimed ‘warning shots’, both to appease their surly charge and to force the enemy’s heads down.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** unit, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, choose to spend either 3 or 6 **vexed points**.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target for the rest of the turn:

• ***Do you see how fast they are going?!***: If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract D3 from the target’s Move characteristic. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• ***Those weapons are against regulation!***: If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: From the Depths of the Cauldron
warscroll_ability.lore: Redd’s cauldron never seems to run dry, and the bloody broths he prepares invoke primal murder-lust in other ogors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability as if it were the end of the turn and it were eligible to do so.

warscroll_ability.name: More-more Warp Energy!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and it has not used a MOVE ability this turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Engineer overcharges their weapon with volatile energy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of its **Warplock Musket** to 3 this phase. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Veins of Black Lightning
warscroll_ability.lore: Reborn in the Cursed Skies above the realms, Eternus’s soul is tethered to the Mortal Realms through the dark magics of his master; whenever he is struck down, a flash of black lightning sees him stand defiant once more.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderhead Crown
warscroll_ability.lore: Aventis’s helm taps into the Anvil of Apotheosis, renewing him even in the thick of battle.
