warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Murderer
warscroll_ability.lore: Stalking the shadows, the Assassin only reveals their position when they launch a killing strike.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that has 5 or more models and there are no enemy units within this unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Grip
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The vice-like grasp of Trugg can squeeze the life out of all but the largest opponent.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Keep Counting, I'm Watching You
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Spoilpox Scriveners are responsible for making sure that the Plaguebearers of the tallybands do not shirk their duties.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D6. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Tally of Blows:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
***Recorded Stamina:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Glorious Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Ever keen to earn the favour of their tribe, when the eyes of the fiercest fighters are upon them, these warriors will not go down without a fight.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **DARKOATH HEROES**, each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: False Serenity
warscroll_ability.lore: Myrmidesh take pains to appear unflappable.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has not charged this turn, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Calamitous Tail Sweep
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a sweep of his tail, Karazai can lay waste to enemy formations.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Transporting Vortex
warscroll_ability.lore: The caster calls upon a magnanimous whirlwind to sweep up allies and carry them to safety.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Divert Realmgate
warscroll_ability.lore: Whispering fell incantations, a Gaunt Summoner can temporarily divert the path of a realmgate, allowing malefic Chaos entities to storm the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Units set up this turn using this unit’s ‘Book of Profane Secrets’ ability can be set up wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units instead of the distances in the ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Three-headed Titan
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The greater daemons consumed by Dorghar imbue the Everchosen’s steed with unlimited power.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Filth-spewer:*** Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit and roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in that unit, to a maximum of 7. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

***Skull-gorger:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain and you can **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is that unit’s Health characteristic.

***Spell-eater:*** Pick a **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, it is banished and removed from play. In addition, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned it.

warscroll_ability.name: Roaring Idol
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Avatar of Khaine’s keen-edged malice strengthens bloody conjurations, making them harder to destroy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE MANIFESTATION** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot be picked to be the target of **BANISH** abilities used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: His Will Be Done
warscroll_ability.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Consecrate the Land
warscroll_ability.lore: Bellowing Sigmarite hymns, the Battle Priest who accompanies the Steelhelms purges the taint of Chaos from the land and consecrates it in the name of the God-King.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective you control that is not contested by any enemy models, roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, that objective is considered by you to be **consecrated**. Friendly units have **WARD (6+)** while they are contesting a consecrated objective. If your opponent gains control of a consecrated objective, it is no longer consecrated.

warscroll_ability.name: Lamentiri Life Energies
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The lamentiri recovered by Revenant Seekers from fallen Sylvaneth have powerful mystical properties that can be harnessed to benefit others of their kind.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Expert Trackers
warscroll_ability.lore: These soldiers are tasked with scouting ahead of the main advance.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Medium Bomb Racks
warscroll_ability.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Ancient Barrow Curse
warscroll_ability.lore: The weapons of the most powerful Wight Kings leave a scar on the soul that causes the victim to slowly crumble to dust.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If an attack made with this unit’s **King’s Relic Weapon** scores a critical hit, the target unit becomes **cursed** for the rest of the battle. Subtract 1 from save rolls for **cursed** units even if this unit has been destroyed.

**Designer’s Note**: *Multiple enemy units can become cursed by this ability but the same enemy unit cannot become cursed more than once.*

warscroll_ability.name: Fanatical Blademaster
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaughter Queen is a priest whose temple is the frenzied heartbeat between each blade strike, whose offerings are the opened throats of her enemies and whose screams of savage laughter are her ministrations to a fanatical following.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick a blessing from the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability that is not **active**. The effect of that blessing applies to the target until the start of your next turn as if it were **active**. If you have used the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability 3 or more times this battle, you can pick 2 blessings instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Dazzling Radiance
warscroll_ability.lore: Yndrasta’s god-touched brilliance casts a protective aura of light around nearby Stormcasts.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Black Dragon’s Jaws Claws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Mark Targets
warscroll_ability.lore: Experts in ballistics, Fusil-Majors can direct the fire of nearby Castelite formations to eliminate priority targets.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Thrashing Tail
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sloppklaw sweeps his tail through a group of foes, throwing them to the ground so that he can trample and gore them with impunity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than or equal to the number of models in the target unit, for the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses an **ATTACK** ability, if all of the attacks target that enemy unit, those attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Dromm, Wounder of Worlds
warscroll_ability.lore: Khorne’s burning attention has fallen upon the Wounder of Worlds and the Blood God expects great things from him – or else.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Dromm**, **Wounder of Worlds**, is on the battlefield, it has **PRIEST (1)** and can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Fighter Vessel
warscroll_ability.lore: Gunhaulers are built for speed and manoeuvrability, zipping around larger vessels in the fleet to identify and eliminate priority targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Sacred Gongs
warscroll_ability.lore: Borne by straining hobgrots, these gongs are holy relics to the servants of Hashut.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gong Carriers** are tokens. There is 1 **Gong Carrier** for every **MUSICIAN** in this unit. If this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, as a reaction, you can remove a **Gong Carrier** to make an additional rally roll of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-bonded
warscroll_ability.lore: Praetors are exemplary bodyguards, linked to their assigned wards at an arcane, spiritual level.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS HERO** to be this unit’s soul-bonded charge for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve.

warscroll_ability.name: Crystal Touch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The scáth touch of a Blood Sister can permanently transmute an enemy into an immobile – though still fully conscious – crystal statue.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Health characteristic, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Befouled Rainfall
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotigus is constantly surrounded by a monsoon of disease and foulness.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Skeletal Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulscent
warscroll_ability.lore: The whirling blades of this fearsome chariot mow down the enemy, transmuting their souls into an exhilarating incense that drives its riders into an ecstatic frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrathful Repulsion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The fierce oratory of the Hag Queen and the Cauldron of Blood’s mystical power combine to create an aura of furious defiance so strong that it makes enemies stagger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to be the target. If there are any friendly **Slaughter Queens on Cauldrons of Blood** on the battlefield, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The targets have **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Endrinworks Outpost
warscroll_ability.lore: The Endrin Dock continuously assembles new drones, a process that is expedited if a skilled endrineer is overseeing its operation.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** or replacement **AUTO‑ENDRIN** that has been removed from the battlefield to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a manufacturing roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Pick 'Em Off
warscroll_ability.lore: Boltboyz prefer to remain stationary to fire carefully aimed shots.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vile Poisons and Debilitating Toxins
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Festus is a master-mixer of deadly potions and virulent concoctions.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.
warscroll_ability.effect:
You and your opponent must roll off. Add this unit’s Control characteristic to your roll and the target’s Control characteristic to your opponent’s roll. If your roll is higher, apply the corresponding effect:

• If the target is a **HERO** or **MONSTER**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between your roll and your opponent’s roll.

• If the target is a non-**HERO** non‑**MONSTER** unit, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Slay the Trespassers!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Branchwych singles out a foe to suffer the full extent of the Sylvaneth’s vengeance.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to this unit and within friendly territory to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Attackers
warscroll_ability.lore: Blightlords descend from fume-choked skies to smash Nurgle’s most stubborn enemies to ruin.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Flyrider’s Arsenal** for attacks that target units contesting an objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Disciplined Advance
warscroll_ability.lore: Under Halgrim’s command, his warriors advance ceaselessly in regimented lockstep to crush the foes of Ulfenkarn.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make a run roll for a friendly **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, you can change that roll to a 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Mutation
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To stand near a Mutalith can have horrific consequences.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect below. If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH WIZARD**, you can roll 2 dice instead, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect below.

**1 - *Untouched***
No effect.

**2 - *Hideous Disfigurement***
Subtract 3 from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

**3 - *Troggbrains***
The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

**4 - *Gift of Mutations***
Subtract 1" from the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the battle.

**5 - *Horrific Absorption***
Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.

**6 - *Transmogrification***
Pick any other effect.

warscroll_ability.name: Wracking Gaze
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who look into the eyes of a Bloodwrack Medusa for more than a moment find themselves paralysed in agony as their blood begins to boil in their veins.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 15" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than that enemy unit’s Health characteristic, for the rest of the phase, you can re-roll failed hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pack Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: The howls of the Flesh Hounds sends these killers into a blood-mad frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with both this unit and a friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

warscroll_ability.name: Grim Justice
warscroll_ability.lore: Through his arcane powers, Reikenor can sense those who tamper with Nagash’s designs or commit any other sacrilegious act.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made with this unit's **Fellreaper** if the target is a **WIZARD** or a **PRIEST.**

warscroll_ability.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
warscroll_ability.lore: Blessed by Syll’Esske, nearby daemons and mortals fight with a synergy that defies comprehension.
warscroll_ability.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

warscroll_ability.name: Scrying Pool
warscroll_ability.lore: Within this pool of shimmering gore, the vampire foresees the shape of the battle to come.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that has not used a command this phase to use the ‘Redeploy’ command immediately after the first has been resolved (this is an exception to Commands, 1.2). No command point is spent the second time that command is used.

warscroll_ability.name: Mastery of Magic
warscroll_ability.lore: To master the arcane is to embody Tzeentch’s designs.
warscroll_ability.effect: When you make a casting roll for this unit, you can change the lowest D6 to match the highest D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadowy Killers
warscroll_ability.lore: Ulguan illusions and other tools of misdirection shroud Deathmasters in perpetual darkness, keeping them from harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Spreaders of Filth and Disease
warscroll_ability.lore: Possessed with a mad zealotry, Plague Monks in their death throes will bite, claw and scratch their foe, leaving wounds that quickly fester and rot.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: The Mortarch of Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Neferata has millennia of experience analysing and unpicking her foes’ ploys.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** or **DEADWALKERS INFANTRY** units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Razarak’s Ebon Claws** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Leeching Soil
warscroll_ability.lore: When blood is spilt upon this unhallowed ground, it is hungrily absorbed by the tainted earth and the withered roots running through it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain while it is within 9" of this terrain feature, **Heal (1)** this terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Refined Creations
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ossifectors are always looking to improve upon their work, wielding necrotic sorcery to augment their creations in battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Crawler, Gothizzar Harvester, Morghast Archai** or **Morghast Harbingers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Signal the Advance
warscroll_ability.lore: With a gesture of their blade, the Liege-Kavalos orders their warriors to ride forth.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Draconic Terror
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To behold such a majestic beast as a dragon in the grip of undeath evokes awe and abject terror in equal measure.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shield Bash
warscroll_ability.lore: The shields carried by Ardboyz are great slabs of iron festooned with spikes and metal teeth, making them deadly weapons in their own right.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a shield bash roll of D6 for each model in this unit that is within 3" of the target. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Frozen In Fear
warscroll_ability.lore: The self-inflicted mutilation performed by the Unmade is a sight disturbing enough to momentarily freeze even a veteran warrior in horror.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use the ‘Redeploy’ or ‘Rally’ commands while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tyrant of Battle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These towering monstrosities are the commanders of the seething hordes of Clans Verminus.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **VERMINUS INFANTRY** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: The targets can each use the ‘All-out Attack’ or ‘All-out Defence’ command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Careening Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Hurtling across the battlefield at death-defying speed, Sunsteala Wheelas careen straight through their enemies leaving behind trails of devastation.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 1 enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted for each model in this unit

**Designer’s Note:** *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Bomb Rats
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Bomb Rats skitter amidst the enemy lines, largely unnoticed in the confusion of battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit’s **Bomb Rats** are tokens. If there are fewer than 2 friendly **Bomb Rats** next to enemy units, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit that does not have a friendly **Bomb Rat** next to it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place this unit’s **Bomb Rat** next to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: I Got Dis, Boss
warscroll_ability.lore: Wolfgitz look out for their Snarlboss in battle, if only because it makes knifin’ him later easier once he’s let his guard down.
warscroll_ability.effect: While a friendly **Snarlboss** is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that **Snarlboss** have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Aggravate Wounds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The ornery and near-sighted Sloppklaw has developed a keen scent for weakness, and he will eagerly tear into wounded prey in a savage frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: The Mounted Skulls of the Fallen
warscroll_ability.lore: Some Daemon Princes revel in glory with each worthy foe slain by their hands.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has a **Trophy Rack**, its **Hellforged Weapons** also have **Anti‑HERO (+1 Rend)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Scorn of Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Slaughterpriests share their god’s hatred of sorcery and those who use it.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Glimpse of Delusion
warscroll_ability.lore: Ushoran pulls an enemy into his delusion, causing them to see friends as vicious monsters.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 18" of this unit to be the target, pick an enemy unit that is visible to the target and within the target’s combat range to be the victim, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can only pick the target’s unit to be the victim if that unit has 2 or more models.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.

warscroll_ability.name: Sorcerous Duplication
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Argent Shards do not obey the laws of reality. They can phase into and out of existence and split apart into two identical copies.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• If there is only 1 friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, set up another **Argent Shard** wholly within 12" of this terrain feature, more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.

• Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Swooping Descent
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gorewarden takes to the skies, swooping across the battlefield to secure a glorious treasure for the court.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either:
• Wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, or
• Within 3" of an objective you do not control.

warscroll_ability.name: Dancing Blades
warscroll_ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this **MANIFESTATION**’s attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Silver Monoliths
warscroll_ability.lore: The Jade Obelisk draw power from Argent Shards to augment their defence, seeing them as sacred monuments to their deity’s glory.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard**.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Chaos Chariots are at their most deadly on the charge, where their considerable bulk and bladed wheels can cause untold devastation.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Volcanic Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Born of fire and flame, Magmadroths pulse with the throbbing heat of the volcanic caverns in which they make their fyrenests.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: The King's Entreaty
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The message within the infected bone carried by a Marrowscroll Herald is an entreaty to madness and carnage; to reject it is to rouse the ire of the ghoulish throngs.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or reject the entreaty offered by this unit.

***Accept:*** The target has the **INFECTED** keyword for the rest of the battle.
***Reject:*** The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Flamescarred
warscroll_ability.lore: Those wounded by a Molten Infernoth are left scorched and writhing in pain.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this **MANIFESTATION**’s attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the end of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonfire Pistol
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The pistol carried by a War Despot can be wielded against the enemy or used to coerce their underlings into fighting harder.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.

If there is a friendly target, for the rest of the turn:

• It can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn. 
• Add 2" to the distance it can move when using **RETREAT** abilities.
• No mortal damage is inflicted on it by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Harrowing Shrieks
warscroll_ability.lore: The chilling cries of the Dreadscythe Harridans drive all hope from the hearts of their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Delightful Brews, Splendid Restoratives
warscroll_ability.lore: Festus relishes the chance to try out each of his new brews upon friends and foes, spreading bizarre and unnatural plagues swiftly through their ranks.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit, **Heal (D3)** the target. If the target is an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Warrior Mages
warscroll_ability.lore: Evocators are masters of the martial and the arcane.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Eternal Duel
warscroll_ability.lore: Skulltaker relishes single combat with the strongest fighters in existence. Claiming their skulls only stokes his hunger for even greater challenges.
warscroll_ability.effect: If an enemy **HERO** had any damage points allocated to it by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that **HERO** was destroyed this turn, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points this unit has.

warscroll_ability.name: Exit the Shrine
warscroll_ability.lore: The Guardian floats down to the battlefield to rejoin the fray.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian.

warscroll_ability.name: Brutal Power
warscroll_ability.lore: A Weirdnob Shaman channels the Waaagh! energy emitted by nearby orruk mobs.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while there are any friendly **IRONJAWZ** units that have 10 or more models wholly within 12" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Shocking Strikes
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemies struck with shock handaxes reel in pain as electricity courses through their veins.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit’s **Shock Handaxes**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for that enemy unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Trial of Skulls
warscroll_ability.lore: The looming threat of failing the Trial of Skulls lends the Skullreapers a manic determination in battle,for nothing could be worse than the horrible consequences should they appear weak in the eyes of their wrathful god.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 8 to this unit's control score while it is in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Hand of Dust
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Restless Dead
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash denies the gift of eternal rest to those who defied his will.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cloud of Flies
warscroll_ability.lore: Plaguebearers are surrounded by a cloud of swarming flies that feast on their rotting bodies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Taros
warscroll_ability.lore: In battle, Luxa Stormrider is aided by her aetherwing companion, Taros, who harries the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Taros** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place **Taros** next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Lightning Strikes
warscroll_ability.lore: Vanquishers utilise a stance that allows them to make a flurry of rapid strikes against a numerous foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Celestial Greatswords** for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Aethershock
warscroll_ability.lore: The Stormcoven unleash their stored energies across the battlefield, bolstering their allies or blasting enemies to the ground.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is a friendly unit, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. If the target is an enemy unit, it has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: 'Bring Me Their Skull!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Axe held aloft, this warlord orders one of his Gorechosen forward.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **BLOODBOUND INFANTRY HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Celennar
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who bathe in the lambent glow of Celennar find themselves lifted to new heights of erudition, and Teclis is no exception.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

In addition, this unit can use Spell abilities from the Lore of Hysh, the Lore of the Awakened Realms and the warscrolls of all friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARDS** on the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: More-more Warp Energy!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a MOVE ability this turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Engineer overcharges their weapon with volatile energy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Warplock Musket** to 3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Grasping Tendrils
warscroll_ability.lore: The Incarnate reaches out across the ethersea to conjure tendrils of freezing, coiling water.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn. On a 4+:

•  You can remove 1 friendly **Abyssal Tendril** from the battlefield.
•  If there are fewer than 2 friendly **Abyssal Tendrils** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Abyssal Tendril** wholly within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Revivifying Energies
warscroll_ability.lore: The cosmic energies emanating from an astrolith protect nearby Seraphon, sealing the most grievous wounds in flashes of cerulean light.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **SERAPHON INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. If a unit already has **WARD (6+)**, it has **WARD (5+)** instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Mollog's Mob
warscroll_ability.lore: A strange assortment of squiggly beasts accompany Mollog to battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Bat Squig**, **Spiteshroom** and **Stalagsquig** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its tokens next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Veiled Threat
warscroll_ability.lore: Slaangors can move as smoothly and soundlessly as silk before bursting out into a bleating, bellowing charge.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Windrider
warscroll_ability.lore: Neave Blacktalon has a natural talent at translocating in a blur of lightning to ride the winds aetheric.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units and wholly within the combat range of a friendly **THE BLACKTALONS** unit that is not in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Furious Indictment
warscroll_ability.lore: The Scriptor of the Sentence howls crimes and secrets long thought buried – and none are immune to the harrowing charges brought against them
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is **condemned** until the start of your next turn.

While a unit is **condemned**:

• Halve that unit’s Move characteristic.
• That unit cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for that unit, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Goin' Somewhere?
warscroll_ability.lore: This Loonboss will not tolerate ill-timed cowardice from his underlings and will have his ravenous pet make an example of any grots who look ready to leg it.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **MOONCLAN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6. However, friendly **MOONCLAN INFANTRY** units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Irresistible Demand
warscroll_ability.lore: Sekhar locks eyes across the battlefield with her victim, who falls hopelessly under her control, lashing out wildly even as their allies struggle to hold them down.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Petrifying Gaze
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army,) Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Cockatrice surges forwards, its eyes begin to glow with warping energy, transfixing foes where they stand.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Throw 'Em In
warscroll_ability.lore: The bludgeoned and hacked remains of dead foes are thrown into the bubbling cauldron to thicken the stew.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This Great Mawpot is either **full** or **empty**. It starts the battle **full**.

If an enemy model is slain within 12" of this **Great Mawpot** while it is **empty**, it becomes **full**.

warscroll_ability.name: Trogg-Guts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: By wolfing down the thick guts of a troggoth, a Butcher can mystically imbue fellow ogors with greater resilience. Or, sometimes, they just get indigestion.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **WARD (6+)** until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **MAWSEEKERS** unit, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Fight and Fly
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Arch-Revenants have perfected the art of mobile warfare, diving down to slay their targets before swiftly retreating to the skies before the foe can muster a reprisal.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit can move up to 2D6" after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved. It cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: His Will Be Done
warscroll_ability.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Verdurous Harmony
warscroll_ability.lore: The wizard plucks reviving motes of magic from the air and uses them to renew the broken forms of fallen warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 7+, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit. If you picked a **Tree‑Revenants** unit, you can return D3 slain models instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadowfast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Vyrkos Blood-born move with savage swiftness.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use a **MOVE** ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Idolarc
warscroll_ability.lore: Fashioned from crystal and given life by dark ritual, Idolarcs are the messengers of the Speaker in the Stone.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Idolarc** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Idolarc** next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Feed On Pestilence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a friendly PESTILENS unit wholly within 13" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Plague Priests are empowered by the spread of disease, drawing upon the foulness propagated by their zealous throngs to power their rites.
warscroll_ability.effect: Give this unit 1 ritual point.

warscroll_ability.name: Threshing Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: The wail of an approaching Hellflayer sees enemy infantry diving for cover.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

warscroll_ability.name: Impaling Strikes
warscroll_ability.lore: On the charge, the blade of a stormstrike glaive can impale several foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Force of a Falling Star
warscroll_ability.lore: As Annihilators build up momentum, their charge turns the shockwave of their arrival into a deadly bludgeoning assault.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Steward of the Realm
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who sit upon a Charnel Throne rule over all they survey, but they must be wary of foes who would see them violently cast down.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Steward:

• The Steward cannot use **MOVE** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Steward, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Steward target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Steward. Then, set up the Steward on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward. If it is not possible to set up the Steward, it is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Cleaving Blow
warscroll_ability.lore: A single swing of a thunderaxe can carve through several foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Thunderaxes** if the target unit has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Shield Bash
warscroll_ability.lore: The shields carried by Ardboyz are great slabs of iron festooned with spikes and metal teeth, making them deadly weapons in their own right.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a shield bash roll of D6 for each model in this unit that is within 3" of the target. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Lurid Light
warscroll_ability.lore: To the maniacal grots of the Gloomspite Gitz, one cackling lunar entity streaking through the sky is much like another.
warscroll_ability.effect: While friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** units are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation they are affected by all four faces of the Bad Moon (Grinnin’, Scowlin’, Sulkin’ and Cacklin’).

warscroll_ability.name: Empowered Through Excruciation
warscroll_ability.lore: Krulghast Cruciators draw power from the suffering of those around them, becoming beacons of death magic that make nearby Nighthaunt more difficult to banish.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Rousing Accompaniment
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You made an unmodified chanting roll of 1 for a **SYLVANETH PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The harmonies played by the Warsong Revenants entwine with and enhance the spirit-song.
warscroll_ability.effect: Re-roll that chanting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
warscroll_ability.lore: An Eidolon in its aspect of the sea radiates an aura of unnatural tranquillity, calming any fears that nearby Idoneth may harbour.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Sun Acolytes
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sun Acolytes that accompany a Spawn of Chotec carry out complex tasks upon the battlefield safe in the knowledge that the salamander serves as a deadly deterrent to would be attackers.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a crew of 3 **Sun Acolytes** that are tokens. Add 1 to this unit’s control score for each **Sun Acolyte** it has. If this unit has no **Sun Acolytes**, it has a maximum control score of 1. Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Sun Acolytes** from the battlefield after the Attack ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of Undeath
warscroll_ability.lore: Corpse Carts are wellsprings of necromantic power that bestow greater vigour upon the resurrected corpses of the freshly slain.
warscroll_ability.effect: Melee weapons used by other friendly **DEADWALKERS** units have **Crit (Auto-wound)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Mindless Ferocity
warscroll_ability.lore: Heedless of pain and knowing nothing of fear, Deadwalker Zombies are relentless in their efforts to slay the foe, and they will continue to hack, claw and bite even as they meet their final end.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Gnaw Through Reality
warscroll_ability.lore: The Grey Seer focuses their energy to keep open a tear in reality from which fellow Skaven can pour.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly **Gnawhole** for the purposes of the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’, ‘Tunnels Through Reality’ and ‘The Endless Vermintide’ abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: The Admiral's Flagship
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Every Admiral designates one of their vessels in the airfleet to be their flagship.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLAGSHIP** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Trusted Lieutenant
warscroll_ability.lore: Radukar has granted Torgillius the resources with which to continue his research. In return, the Chamberlain offers his necromantic expertise and the secrets gathered for him by his vermin spies.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability even if a different friendly unit has already used it this turn, but units that have already been picked to be targets of that ability this turn cannot be picked to be targets.

warscroll_ability.name: Blazing Impact
warscroll_ability.lore: Annihilators arrive upon the field with devastating force, twin tailed trails streaking behind them as an earth-shattering shock-wave blasts apart the foes of Sigmar.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: More Meat for the Pot
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The more bloody ingredients a Butcher tosses into their sacred cauldron, the more their arcane power seems to grow.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit this turn by this unit’s combat attacks or by combat attacks made by a **MANIFESTATION** summoned by this unit, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Altar of the Great Corruptor
warscroll_ability.lore: This giant construct is venerated by the swarms of pox-ridden rats that flock to its side.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **PESTILENS** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Scare Taktikz
warscroll_ability.lore: Gutrippaz use all manner of means to unnerve and soften up their foes before the first blow is struck, from gruesome ‘skareshields’ to ululating battle cries that echo from the boggy mists.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by non-**HERO** units that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of Assassins
warscroll_ability.lore: Crixxit is one of the most feared assassins of the Clans Eshin, if not the realms entire.
warscroll_ability.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy **HERO**.

warscroll_ability.name: Biovoltaic Blast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of energy when the time is right.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Healing Light
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord-Arcanum gathers aetheric energy and uses it to revitalise the depleted life energies of nearby Sacrosanct warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER** unit that is not in combat and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is damaged, **Heal (D6)** the target. If the target is not damaged, return a slain model to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Nagadron’s Claws** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Coven Guard
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors are trained to wait for the perfect moment before thrusting their spears into the hearts of their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Windleap
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hurakan Windmage calls upon the wind spirits to give nearby allies a helpful push in the right direction.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
On a 6+, for the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use **RETREAT** abilities and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Ascend The Altar
warscroll_ability.lore: Chanting, the priest mounts this fell altar.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature does not have an **Invoker,** pick a friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE INFANTRY PRIEST** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now an **Invoker** (see 'Words of Hate').

warscroll_ability.name: Speed of the Spider God
warscroll_ability.lore: With a shriek, the shaman calls upon the Spider God to imbue its worshippers with preternatural speed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SPIDERFANG** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can use a **RUN** ability this turn and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Chitinous Legs** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: The Gaze of Khorne
warscroll_ability.lore: Khorne’s gaze follows Valkia; the Blood God’s warriors strive all the harder to please him when she is nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6. However, friendly **BLOODBOUND** units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Protection of the Everqueen
warscroll_ability.lore: The Lady of Vines shields her fellow Sylvaneth with the purifying power of her goddess mother.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **SYLVANETH** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Necromantic Goad
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Corpsemasters are experts at directing the mindless efforts of the recently deceased.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Avatar of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Skewered
warscroll_ability.lore: Beast-skewer bolts are designed to inflict horrendous wounds on monstrous quarry.
warscroll_ability.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Beast-skewer Bolts** is 6 instead of D6 if the target is a **MONSTER**.

warscroll_ability.name: Immortal Conqueror
warscroll_ability.lore: A mighty general in life, in undeath, the endless need to wage war and conquer the lands of the living lingers on in this ancient wight as a thirst that can never be quenched.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units while they are wholly within 6" of that objective or terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Ka-Boom!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Tik Tik carries an explosive charge that makes a mockery of armour and carefully planned charges alike.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Tik Tik** is a token. If this unit’s Tik Tik is on the battlefield, remove it from the battlefield and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrathful Dominance
warscroll_ability.lore: Bloodthirsters of the Third Circle establish their battlefield superiority by hunting down the enemy's strongest champions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add I to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target an enemy **HERO.**

warscroll_ability.name: Ward-smashing Choppa
warscroll_ability.lore: A strike from this choppa shatters not only skulls but also arcane wards and other mystical forms of protection.
warscroll_ability.effect: If an attack made with this unit’s **Ward-smashing Choppa** scores a hit, the target has the **WARD‑SMASHED** keyword for the rest of the battle. Ward rolls cannot be made for a **WARD-SMASHED** unit even if this unit has been destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Tallyman of Nurgle
warscroll_ability.lore: Epidemius keeps an endless tally of Nurgle’s diseases, and as the count rises higher, the Plague God’s minions grow stronger.
warscroll_ability.effect:
You gain a number of **tally points** equal to the current battle round number.

During the battle round, you can spend your **tally points**. For each **tally point** you spend, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 save roll or 1 ward roll for a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

At the end of the battle round, any unspent **tally points** are lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunters of Mystics
warscroll_ability.lore: The terrible baying and howling of Flesh Hounds inspires an instinctive, primal fear in those attuned to the arcane or the divine, making it difficult for them to focus on their spells and rituals.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the casting roll for an enemy **WIZARD** within 12" of this unit contains 2 or more results of 1 or 2, the spell is miscast.

If the chanting roll for an enemy **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit is an unmodified 2, the prayer fails and its effect is not resolved. In addition, your opponent cannot give that **PRIEST** any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Leaden Limbs
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gaunt Summoner turns the bones of their foes to heavy lead, slowing them to a pained crawl.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• The effects of the ‘Fly’ ability do not apply to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunter's Instincts
warscroll_ability.lore: Royal Beastflayers believe themselves to be the finest monster-slayers in all the land. Certainly, they possess a knack for hindering and ensnaring their prey before moving in to make the kill.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
In addition, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy **MONSTERS** and **BEAST** units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Strength From Victory
warscroll_ability.lore: The more fights a Megaboss wins, the stronger they become.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.

Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.

warscroll_ability.name: Destined Quarry
warscroll_ability.lore: Skyfires often select a target to utterly obliterate and erase from the tapestry of fate.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s attacks this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARFLOCK** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ordered Cohorts
warscroll_ability.lore: Devoted servants of the Old Ones, Saurus Warriors are as intractable in defence as they are relentless upon the attack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Empowered By Memory
warscroll_ability.lore: Lotann draws on the accumulated memories of his people to grant his allies supernatural strength and resolve.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Metamorphosis
warscroll_ability.lore: With a fierce glare, Alarielle’s foes are wracked with creaking contortions as they violently transform into twisted effigies of living wood.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target would be destroyed by this spell, before removing any models, pick the closest terrain feature to the target that does not have a friendly **overgrown token** and give it a friendly **overgrown token**. If all terrain features on the battlefield already have a friendly **overgrown token**, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 6" of the target instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Contortions
warscroll_ability.lore: While not shamans themselves, the gastromantic practices of the Gutseers twist the flow of magic around them.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for visible enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

Add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **MAWSEEKERS WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Starving Nightmare
warscroll_ability.lore: Unable to contain her hunger any longer, Lady Annika springs forth from hiding, eager to glut herself on the blood of the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **lying in wait**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit wholly within enemy territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Secret Tunnels
warscroll_ability.lore: Rabble-Rowzas have a knack for locating hidden passages through the depths.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **in a secret tunnel**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Get Bashin'!
warscroll_ability.lore: Shields are made for krumping in the eyes of a Big Boss, who makes sure their boys are using them the ‘propa way’.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to shield bash rolls for friendly **Ardboyz** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Stalwart Defenders
warscroll_ability.lore: Liberators fiercely guard the lands brought into Sigmar’s domain.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it contests an objective wholly within friendly territory.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hunters of Huanchi can blend in with their surroundings and vanish from sight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Coils of the Shadow Queen
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Shadow Queen can grasp individuals in her deadly coils and utterly crush the life from them.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any enemy units are **constricted**, they are no longer **constricted**. Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target is **constricted** while it is in combat with this unit.

This unit’s combat attacks that target a **constricted** enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

warscroll_ability.name: Necromantic Limits
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Draconic Claws** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Anger the Hive
warscroll_ability.lore: As enemies draw closer to the hive, the spites attack with heightened ferocity to protect their home.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** was not set up this turn, add 10 to the Attacks characteristic of this **MANIFESTATION**’s ranged weapons for the rest of the phase, but all of the shooting attacks it makes this phase must target an enemy unit within 9" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Threshing Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: The wail of an approaching Hellflayer sees enemy infantry diving for cover.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

warscroll_ability.name: Protection of the Dark Gods
warscroll_ability.lore: Worshippers of the Ruinous Powers gather around these shrines in the hope of receiving divine protection.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ravening Hunger
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Dorghar’s Claws and Tails** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnarlrod** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Conduits of Gut Magic
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gutseers’ faith and grisly acts of divination make them conduits of the gastromantic magic of the Butchers, who can channel their power through these disciples of the Maw.
warscroll_ability.effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** that is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit from this unit instead of that **WIZARD**. This unit is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’.

warscroll_ability.name: King of Shambling Bones
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In the presence of their sovereign, the footsoldiers of the Deathrattle kingdoms assume a sliver of their former warlike vigour.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Royal Retinue
warscroll_ability.lore: Auric Runefathers go to battle flanked by the most skilled warriors in the lodge, who are sworn to protect him from harm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the royal retinue.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, while the royal retinue is wholly within 6" of this unit, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the royal retinue and this unit has **WARD (4+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wild Form
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this **MANIFESTATION** is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Weapon Team
warscroll_ability.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

warscroll_ability.name: Unbreachable Will
warscroll_ability.lore: Having each survived punishing trials, Freeguild Gallants break before no foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons for attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tear Limb From Limb
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Mirebrute Troggoths take great delight plucking foes from the enemy ranks and pulling off their limbs one by one.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Piston-driven Legs and Daemonic Blade or Claw** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Herald of Trampling Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The earth shatters under the metal hooves of a Skullmaster and its fellow daemonic cavalry, a wave of living brass that crushes all before it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Bloodcrushers** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
