warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by this unit and the target have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Overgrowth of Flesh
warscroll_ability.lore: For all his endless grumbling, Ethrac Glott is not miserly in doling out Nurgle’s bountiful gifts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, to a maximum of 7 mortal damage. If any mortal damage was inflicted on the target, and the target was not a Manifestation or terrain feature, it has the **DISEASED** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Piston-driven Carnage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The mechanical lower limbs of a Soul Grinder crush, stamp and impale without mercy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit can move 6". During that move, it can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Great Snarlin' Howl
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The howls of this boss’s Snarlfang Alpha drive its pack into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and another friendly unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic and the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Sound the Pursuit!
warscroll_ability.lore: With a howl that echoes like a winding horn, the Gorewarden infuses their minions with a feverish desire to hunt and feast.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, until the start of your next turn, when making charge rolls for the target, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Vectors of Foulest Contagion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through the use of rancid corpse-totems and other such gifts from the Grandfather, a Lord of Afflictions spreads death wherever they travel.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: In Their Element
warscroll_ability.lore: Morgok and his mob hunt down the most fearsome monsters in Ghur, growing more ferocious and belligerent with each such creature they smash and hack to bits.
warscroll_ability.effect: The first time an enemy **MONSTER** is destroyed by this unit, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Peal of Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: The ominous tolling of a Screaming Bell resounds above the clamour of battle, crying out ‘Doom! Doom! Doom!’
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 - *Magical Backlash***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

**2-4 - *Wall of Unholy Sound***
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.

**5-6 - *Apocalyptic Doom***
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 13" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Get Stuck In, Ladz
warscroll_ability.lore: The roared commands issued by a Megaboss encourage the Ironjawz under their command to fight all the harder.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ylthari
warscroll_ability.lore: The mellifluous sound of Sylvaneth magic is both beautiful and terrifying to those upon whom it is unleashed.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Ylthari** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Timberrrrr!
warscroll_ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of this unit. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Tripletongue’s Claws** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Greater Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: As it gets to eat all the best mushrooms, a Troggboss’s regenerative capacity is more pronounced than that of the average troggoth.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Trails of Astral Light
warscroll_ability.lore: The aetheric glow that trails in a Tauralon’s wake guides the spells of nearby Stormcasts.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Disciplined March
warscroll_ability.lore: The warriors of Hashut march with fell purpose in the name of their dark deity.
warscroll_ability.effect: When making run rolls for this unit, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Earn an Honourable Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Lord-Terminos accompanies their Ruination chamber, the Stormcasts seeking to earn their final rest by proving themselves one last time in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadow Leap
warscroll_ability.lore: Shadowstalkers can vanish and reappear at will as they navigate the Umbral Web.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Foul Elixirs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Swampcalla Shamans brew up disgusting but life-saving elixirs, which they distribute to their Kruleboyz mates to aid them in battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Cavernous Jaws
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The enormous maw of a Stardrake can bite a foe in half.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Necromantic Limits
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Draconic Claws** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Honour to Grimnir!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Grimhold Exiles exhort their fellow duardin to fight with the vigour of their fallen god.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Banner of the Reforged
warscroll_ability.lore: When the Knight-Vexillor plants their banner, the fortifying energy that emanates from it hardens flesh and seals sundered armour, empowering the faithful with new resolve.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to each target’s control score for the rest of the turn. In addition, **Heal (D3)** each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Scouting Companion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: A Castigator’s Gryph-hound can be sent out into the fray to identify the enemy’s weak points.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the **SHOOT** ability is resolved, add 3" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Thunderhead Greatbows** and add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks. Remove this unit’s **Gryph-hound** from the battlefield after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Scuttle Away!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Masters of feigned flight and other such sneaky tactics, the Scuttleboss orders his Spider Riders to flee to a more advantageous position.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Spider Riders** unit that is in combat and wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: The targets can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on them.

warscroll_ability.name: Truebone Mastery
warscroll_ability.lore: If needed, Thanatek can make highly effective use of the truebone his warriors have gathered in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Spend any number of this unit’s **portions of truebone**. For each portion spent, pick 1 of the effects below. Each effect can be picked multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

• Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.
• Add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.
• Gain 1 **relentless discipline** point.
• Return 1 slain model to this unit

warscroll_ability.name: Captain of the Aelsling
warscroll_ability.lore: The *Aelsling* is manned by a motley crew of ne’erdo-wells with many a tale of daring combat to tell.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an **Arkanaut Frigate** in this unit’s regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has the **AELSLING** keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Boarding Weapons** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Verdian Crown
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The invigorating power of the Everqueen herself radiates from the ornate jade crown borne by the Lady of Vines.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit that does not have a friendly **overgrown token** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Give the target a friendly **overgrown token**.

warscroll_ability.name: Musicians, Play!
warscroll_ability.lore: On the Archregent’s signal, the court musicians strike up an exhilarating tune to which the joyful revellers begin to dance.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO**.

warscroll_ability.name: Eye of the Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spirit of the Wind surrounds itself with a powerful cyclone that obscures nearby allies and disrupts the attacks of their enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Impaling Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: A charging Chaos Knight is capable of spitting several enemies at once with the point of their ensorcelled polearm.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its **Cursed Lances**.

warscroll_ability.name: Windleap
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Windmages often accompany Windchargers into battle, allowing the cavalry archers to perform soaring leaps right over the heads of their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **HURAKAN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Fecula Flyblown
warscroll_ability.lore: Through vile sorceries are the unnatural plagues of Nurgle spread.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Fecula Flyblown** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Verminous Court
warscroll_ability.lore: Kritza believes himself an appreciator of the finer things in undeath, and his rodent servants are adept in snatching away trinkets and treasures for his collection.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick an artefact of power that the target has.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulburned
warscroll_ability.lore: Once an enemy has been burnt by Cthorak’s scouring flames, their soul ignites deep within their body.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick any number of **SOULBURNED** enemy units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Grimwrath Oaths
warscroll_ability.lore: Before battle, each Grimwrath Berzerker swears a sacred oath to Grimnir that they will fulfil a certain deed in his honour that day.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following oaths for this unit to swear:

***‘I will guard them with my life!’:*** While this unit is wholly within 6" of another friendly **FYRESLAYERS HERO**:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks.
• Add 1 to ward rolls for this unit.

If a friendly **FYRESLAYERS HERO**  wholly within 6" of this unit is destroyed, this effect no longer applies.

***‘I will not be stopped!’:*** Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit, and add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is in combat. If this unit uses the ‘Retreat’ or ‘Rally’ abilities, this effect no longer applies.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Fourfold Slayers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Stalkers lethally wade into the fray, their fourfold quadrarch masks allowing them to attack from several directions at once and annihilate even massed opponents with chilling indifference.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If this unit has 3 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Onslaught
warscroll_ability.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne's Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the unmodified charge roll for this unit is 8+:

• For the rest of the phase, this unit can pass through models in enemy units.
• Enemy **CAVALRY** units passed through by this unit in this phase cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Creepers
warscroll_ability.lore: Riding on top of King Brodd, these creatures will leap upon enemy predators and distract them while Brodd deals a killing blow.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot be picked to be the target of enemy **RAMPAGE** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Warpstone Snipers
warscroll_ability.lore: Having set up the Warplock Jezzail in position, the gunner can wait for the perfect moment to fire their shot.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Warplock Jezzails** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ker-Splat!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Mangler Squigs produce an impact that is nothing short of spectacular, sending severed body parts and splashes of gore skywards.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
warscroll_ability.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is within a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Boneripper Rampage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Thanquol’s monstrous Rat Ogor, Boneripper, pulverises enemies that dare stray too close.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3-5, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Veteran Skirmishers
warscroll_ability.lore: Kreel has trained his ragtag soldiers well, emphasising speed and surety of foot over headlong sprints.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic but it cannot use **RUN** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Judge, Jury and Executioner
warscroll_ability.lore: With a mere flick of a quill, sentenced souls are doomed to be dragged to the underworlds by gheists hungry for vengeance.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, if all of its attacks target the same **SENTENCED** enemy unit, that friendly unit's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for that **FIGHT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Prowling Ash Panther
warscroll_ability.lore: Thexa prowls the shadows, waiting for the right moment to pounce.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit has the **Thexa** token, give that token to an enemy unit within 6" of this unit.

If an enemy unit has the **Thexa** token, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit. Then, give this unit the **Thexa** token.

warscroll_ability.name: Aetheric Deflection
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: From their high perch, the Lord- Arcanum can locate enemy casters and turn the target’s spells back upon them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** that used a **SPELL** ability this phase and is within 30" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll **X**+1 dice, where **X** is an amount equal to the target’s power level. For each 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: 'Oo's Under The Heel Now?
warscroll_ability.lore: The mob of gargants crash into the enemy in unison, wreaking havoc among the enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Gargant Charge’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any, for each model in this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Discharge Armour
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Morghast releases the arcane energy in their armour to overpower nearby magic users.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Prowling the Flanks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Killaboss lurks at the edges of the battle looking for weaknesses in the enemy’s lines.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Witchbrew
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Witchbrew drives the imbiber into such an ecstasy of destruction that they will fight on in the face of impossible odds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Royal Approval
warscroll_ability.lore: These mordants will always do their utmost to attract the attention of their sovereign.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **NOBLES** or **ABHORRANTS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Festering Feast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Vengorians bid their monstrous broods indulge in gory feasts even as battle rages.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points were allocated to enemy units by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and each other friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Whipped To Fury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The ferocious bite of a Bloodstoker’s lash reminds every Khorne follower of the bloody dues their master expects.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BLOODBOUND** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Star Falcon
warscroll_ability.lore: Farstrider’s loyal companion can swoop from the skies to strike the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Sanson Farstrider** is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Ghostly Howl
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: There is no describing the shrieking wail of the Banshee; it is so horrific that its sound alone can pierce the soul of any who hear it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Piercing Scream** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Attention Seekers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Beasts of Nurgle seek out playmates with an enthusiasm that is rarely reciprocated by the horrified source of their fascination.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. During that move, this unit can move into combat and can pass through models in the target unit, but it must end that move within 1" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Borne On Wings Of Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Soaring upon the winds of war, Valkia awaits the worthiest of foes before plunging into battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **soaring above the battlefield**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-forged Guardians
warscroll_ability.lore: Praetors will protect their soul-bonded charges with every ounce of their being.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s soul-bonded charge is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Scry the Stars
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: By drawing upon the energies of the heavens, the Starseer peers along the tangled weave of fate, gleaning insight that can be used to prepare their servants.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 3+, pick a friendly **SERAPHON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. That unit has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Mask of Shadowed Mirrors
warscroll_ability.lore: This mask shows attackers a haunting visage that chills them to the bone.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampaging Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

warscroll_ability.name: Frazzlemist
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Snaking plumes of sparking, crackling smoke issue forth from the shaman’s staff, spiralling across the battlefield in search of lungs to scorch and eyes to burn.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 9" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Harrying Aetherwing
warscroll_ability.lore: Guided by Luxa Stormrider’s rune-etched arrows, Taros flies across the battlefield, harrying the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any attacks made with this unit’s **Stormcaller Bow** scored a critical hit this phase, pick an enemy unit targeted by those attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, place **Taros** next to the target. While **Taros** is placed next to an enemy unit, that enemy unit cannot use commands.

warscroll_ability.name: Destined Quarry
warscroll_ability.lore: Skyfires often select a target to utterly obliterate and erase from the tapestry of fate.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s attacks this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARFLOCK** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampaging Charge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaughterbrute crashes into the enemy’s ranks in a frenzy of destruction.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target unit is **INFANTRY**, double the amount of mortal damage inflicted.

warscroll_ability.name: Navigators of the Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Vigilors move swiftly beneath dark thunderclouds, the Grungni-forged arrowheads of their stormcaller bows give off flickers of lightning that reveal the location of their targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: If an enemy unit had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Charge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Leviadon charges into battle, it crushes the foe with its sheer mass.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Gaping Maw
warscroll_ability.lore: This horrific creature bites a great chunk out of its prey – or even swallows it whole.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s **Fanged Maw** scores a critical hit, that attack inflicts 6 mortal damage on the target unit and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Capricious Wyrdflame
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The mutagenic fires expelled by Flamers are most drawn to those already ablaze with the potential for change.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has the **BURNING** keyword for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Gift of Foresight
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The arrival of fresh reinforcements precisely when and where they are needed appears fortuitous to their fellow warriors. Krethusa knows better. In a way, she always has.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Avatar of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Hunter's Endurance
warscroll_ability.lore: As the spirit-song intensifies and the magic of life surges across the battlefield, Kurnoth Hunters are gripped with a sacred fervour of the chase that sees them shrug off wounds.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Tentacular Grip
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotigus’s arm tentacles are slow but incredibly powerful; should they take hold of an enemy, the victim will endure a crushing, slimy fate.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: She Can Handle It!
warscroll_ability.lore: Captain Flynt understands the *Aelsling* and its capabilities better than he does his own kin.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the **AELSLING** while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
warscroll_ability.lore: Blessed by Syll’Esske, nearby daemons and mortals fight with a synergy that defies comprehension.
warscroll_ability.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non‑**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**HERO** **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampaging Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

warscroll_ability.name: Strangling Grasp
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Treelord’s tendrils coil around a chosen foe, crushing the life out of them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Retchling
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Accompanying Fecula into battle is her loyal Retchling. This plague-ridden familiar is a powerful locus of plague sorcery.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit’s **Fecula Flyblown** is on the battlefield, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gunhauler Overwatch
warscroll_ability.lore: At the last moment, the Gunhauler’s crew loose a hasty fusillade at a charging group of foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Conduit
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly SERAPHON WIZARD wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: An astrolith is empowered by celestial magic in the vicinity
warscroll_ability.effect: If that spell is successfully cast, for the rest of the turn, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **SERAPHON** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Astral Compass
warscroll_ability.lore: The Vanguard-Hunters use their astral compass to track their enemies across the Mortal Realms.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has the **HUNTED** keyword for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Disruptive Song
warscroll_ability.lore: Fiends of Slaanesh let out a keening song that disturbs the concentration of spellcasters who hear it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Brutal Momentum
warscroll_ability.lore: The ferocity of Gorebeasts is terrible to behold as they carve a path of bloody destruction through the enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add 3" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: All Shall Burn
warscroll_ability.lore: Hungry flames spread through the enemy’s ranks and engulf their war machines as the Scions bombard the foe with burning projectiles.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Flameburst Pots and Infernal Fires** for attacks that target **WAR MACHINES** or **INFANTRY** units with 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Ashigaroth's Hunger
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Mannfred’s dread abyssal is afflicted by a hunger as indiscriminate as it is unending, and it strikes with lightning-fast speed to attempt in vain to satiate that hunger.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Elite Guardians
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Cryptguard will gladly give their lives to protect their liege from any who might do them harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** but ward rolls cannot be made for it.

warscroll_ability.name: Bringers of Desolation
warscroll_ability.lore: Chaos Warriors fight with relentless ferocity in those places consecrated to the Dark Gods.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Rune-etched Weapons** while it is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Jaws of Fate
warscroll_ability.lore: The more potent the aura of Tzeentchian magic, the more terrifyingly corporeal the Simulacrum’s teeth become.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.

warscroll_ability.name: Crush the Unworthy
warscroll_ability.lore: The raw arrogance of the Bull Centaurs sees them crash through foes with wanton abandon.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for each **daemonic power point** it has.

warscroll_ability.name: Knights of the King
warscroll_ability.lore: Buried alongside their liege in ancient times, these deathly knights are still bound by arcane ward and ancient oath to ride into battle at their side.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Fateful Reverse
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzeentch’s oracle invades his enemies’ minds with false visions of victory, causing them to charge willingly to their doom.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target charged in the same turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units in combat with the target have Strike‑first.
• The target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **CHARGE (+1 DAMAGE)** weapon ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Maim and Tear
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: As champions of the Seraphon hosts, Scar-Veterans and their especially bloodthirsty mounts pursue the greatest enemy warriors, falling on them with vicious brutality.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift Attackers
warscroll_ability.lore: As they close in on the enemy at frightening speed, these skilled horsemen are nigh impossible to hit with missile fire.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Aurelias
warscroll_ability.lore: Vizier to Neferata herself, Aurelias is a learned necromancer who lends his arcane expertise to aid Cado in battle – so long as doing so aligns with the Mortarch’s interests as well…
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability while its **Aurelias** is on the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
•  Each time a casting roll is made for this unit, you can re-roll 1 of the dice.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Frazzleburned Scrap
warscroll_ability.lore: After the boss, Snarlpack Cavalry often get first dibs on loot, and they have an eye for the scrap and wotsits with the best light-absorbing properties. In battle, they have learned how to unleash these energies from their weapons at just the right moment, dazzling the enemy as their charge hits home.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Repair Construct
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Harvester uses a portion of its morbid crop to restore the forms of fellow Ossiarchs.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is **full,** pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Return 1 slain model to the target unit. If the target has a Health characteristic of 1 return 3 slain models to it instead. Then, this unit is **empty.**

warscroll_ability.name: Rip 'Em Ta Bits
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Whether inspired by the Grand Snarlboss’s cruel example or just worried what will happen if they don’t follow suit, the Gitmobs join Droggz in tearing into the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **GITMOB** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Berserk Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: No Fyreslayer will easily accept death’s embrace while their kin are still fighting.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike From The Shadows
warscroll_ability.lore: From an unseen quarter, these agile warriors race forward to cut down the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **lurking in the shadows**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Driven by Destiny
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Willing pawns in the Change God’s schemes, Kairic Acolytes are driven by the winds of fate to wherever they can cause the most bloodshed and confusion.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, it can move **X**", where **X** is the number of **fate points** you have. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Malfunctioning Leystone
warscroll_ability.lore: Trugg can unwittingly channel powerful magic through the contraption on his back.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 3 dice. You must pick 1 of those dice and apply the effect that corresponds to its value. Effects 2-6 persist until the start of your next turn.

***1 - Glyph of Shyish:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

***2 -  Glyph of Ghur:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **TROGGOTH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

***3 -  Glyph of Aqshy:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **TROGGOTH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

***4 - Glyph of Hysh:*** This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

***5 - Glyph of Ulgu:*** Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **TROGGOTH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

***6 - Glyph of Chamon:*** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
warscroll_ability.lore: Hell Pit Abominations are notoriously difficult to slay and can even regrow severed limbs.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Choking Spore-Clouds
warscroll_ability.lore: Those not of Gittish kind who inhale too many Puffshroom spores are wracked by violent coughing fits as their bodies rebel against the sudden fungal invasion.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Mountain of Loathsome Flesh
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotigus is a corpulent abomination; when he goes on a rampage, enemies caught in his path are often swallowed up and crushed between his great rolls of blubber.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Evocation of Death
warscroll_ability.lore: The dormant occupant feeds upon the energies of death and uses them to bring spectral champions back from the underworlds.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE NIGHTHAUNT HERO** that has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit. The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Searing Beam of Light
warscroll_ability.lore: As interlocking lenses of aetherquartz click into place, a beam of blinding white light shoots forth to incinerate all before it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit attacks with its **Searing Beam of Light**, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit’s base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Elegant Greatblade** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Protection of the Void
warscroll_ability.lore: The powerful magic-quashing aura of null-gas causes spells and incantations to sputter and die.
warscroll_ability.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **SKYFARER** units have **WARD (5+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Captured Soul Energy
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spirit Torment of a Cursed Shacklehorde uses the souls captured in their padlock to imbue their minions with deathly might.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Myari Lightcaller
warscroll_ability.lore: With his deep wisdom and arcane prowess, few can withstand Myari’s might.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Myari Lightcaller** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)** and the **SCINARI** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Enrage the Spites
warscroll_ability.lore: Drycha shares a special kinship with the flitting, scuttling lesser spirits of the forest, who are stirred into a frenzy when her ire is raised.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that are visible to and within 12" of this unit or that are within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Cruel Commander
warscroll_ability.lore: The Clawlord strikes down one of their underlings to show their cruel power and then, with shrieks and hissed threats, commands their swarming underlings to overrun the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO VERMINUS INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 5 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is channelled by Ishlaen Guard into a crackling luminescent energy field that protects them from harm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: On the Winds Aetheric
warscroll_ability.lore: Gryph-chargers can move faster than the eye can follow along the winds aetheric.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Sludgeraker Venom
warscroll_ability.lore: The underbelly of a Sludgeraker Beast is coated in rotting detritus, encrusted marsh-slime and the beast’s own secretions – a highly virulent mixture that is used by nearby Kruleboyz to coat their weapons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: That unit has the **SLUDGERAKER VENOM** keyword for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Alpha Predator
warscroll_ability.lore: Aggradons instinctively know that where an alpha Carnosaur treads, carnage ensues.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **Aggradon Lancers** do not lose **rage tokens** at the end of the turn while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Staring Death In The Face
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The unwavering stare of a Lord Executioner seems to penetrate the victim's very soul.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the target is a **HERO**, subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Reservoir of Power
warscroll_ability.lore: The Twinstones glow brighter with each spell cast, forming a reservoir from which the Lumineth can draw greater power.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time a unit (friendly or enemy) successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**, give this **MANIFESTATION** 1 **arcane charge point.**

This **MANIFESTATION** can have a maximum of 6 **arcane charge points**.

warscroll_ability.name: Killer of Kings
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: A Deathbringer slays without pause or relent.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit and **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit to be a target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, 1 model from that unit is slain or, if the target is a **MANIFESTATION,** it is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Titanic Duel
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spirit of Durthu stamps down hard with one of its trunk-like legs, shaking the earth as well as the enemy’s wits.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy non-**FLY INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Attack From on High
warscroll_ability.lore: Terradons circle high in the sky, only darting down for a brief moment to launch a strafing run.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Blooming Plague
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gardeners sow foulsome seeds throughout the battlefield, infecting the very land itself.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target is **seeded with rot** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Klaq-Trok
warscroll_ability.lore: A warrior unparalleled in his primal ferocity and strength, Klaq-Trok crushes any who would defy the will of the Old Ones.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Klaq-Trok** is on the battlefield, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Tunnels Through Reality
warscroll_ability.lore: The Skaven can move through gnawholes to invade any corner of the Mortal Realms.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of another friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
warscroll_ability.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Knights of Chaos
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: At the head of a charge, this Chaos Lord leads their cavalry to crush any foe before them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Fortitude of the Earth
warscroll_ability.lore: When the Stoneguard adopt this unyielding martial stance, even the most ferocious assaults cannot break them.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you have 2 or more instances of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**, this unit’s Save characteristic is 3+.

warscroll_ability.name: Inescapable Reach
warscroll_ability.lore: From a yawning rift in the fabric of reality, a colossal arm of eldritch bone emerges.
warscroll_ability.declare: This **MANIFESTATION** can only use this ability if it has not been set up this turn.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this **MANIFESTATION** from the battlefield and set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, this **MANIFESTATION** can move a number of inches equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Coordinated Strike
warscroll_ability.lore: The warriors of the Vanguard chamber train relentlessly to fight in perfect unison.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's **Hurricane Crossbows** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Headshot
warscroll_ability.lore: When given time to take careful aim, a Vanguard-Raptor can find their mark even amidst the roiling mass of battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, for the rest of the turn, this unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking targets for its shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Warp Lightning Bolts
warscroll_ability.lore: Coruscating bolts of warp lightning leap outwards from the Warp Lightning Vortex, obliterating those nearby.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** was not set up this turn, pick each enemy unit within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Unholy Chorus
warscroll_ability.lore: The shrieks of a Crypt Flayer pack leave their enemies disoriented and harrowed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract an amount from the target’s control score equal to the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Bomb Rats
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Many Gutter Runners are experts in the use of improvised explosives, using skittering Bomb Rats to rush the enemy and detonate amongst them in a burst of warpstone-fuelled fury.
warscroll_ability.declare: You can only use this ability if this unit has a **Bomb Rat** token. Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 1-2, remove this unit’s **Bomb Rat** token from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: No Shortage of Volunteers
warscroll_ability.lore: When your choices are potentially dying at the hands of the enemy or being eaten alive by a hungry ogor, most Gnoblars are willing to take their chances with the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tunneling Team
warscroll_ability.lore: Zikkit’s Tunnelpack often turn up when least expected
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **drilling beneath the surface**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Bounding Haste
warscroll_ability.lore: Three times the height of a man and with supernatural strength and reflexes, a Vargskyr covers ground with terrifying speed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3. In addition, when this unit uses a **CHARGE** ability, it can pass through terrain features and enemy models as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Infected
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability for an INFECTED unit
warscroll_ability.lore: As they start to lose their grip on reality, the infected find tasks that were previously second nature to them increasingly difficult.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 5+:

•  If they declared a command, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
•  If they declared a **SPELL** or **PRAYER** ability, that spell or prayer fails.

This reaction can be used more than once per phase but only once per command, **SPELL** ability or **PRAYER** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Blot Toad
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Ripperdactyl flock takes flight, the Seraphon will seed creatures known as blot toads across the battlefield. These loathsome amphibians emit a pervasive stink that is unpalatable to all cold-blooded creatures, but especially the Ripperdactyls.
warscroll_ability.declare: You receive 1 **Blot Toad** token for each **Ripperdactyl Chief** or **Ripperdactyl Riders** unit in your army, to a maximum of 3 tokens. Pick a number of enemy units equal to the number of **Blot Toads** you have to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place a **Blot Toad** next to each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Tiny Braggarts
warscroll_ability.lore: While the foe is engaged with Gorlok, his minions run rings around his enemies, hindering their every step.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of this unit’s tokens that is on the battlefield and roll a dice. On a 1, remove that token from the battlefield. On a 2+, apply its effect for the rest of the turn:

***Peggz:*** The abilities of enemy artefacts of power that target this unit have no effect on this unit.

***Kagey:*** This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.

***Mange:*** Each time an unmodified hit roll for a combat attack that targets this unit is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

***Shreek:*** Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit have no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Lust For Violence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Viceleaders bid their fellow Daemonettes enter the fray and join them in the bliss of combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Daemonettes** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Brutal Blows
warscroll_ability.lore: Kroxigor swing their weapons in wide arcs, smashing aside a multitude of foes with each blow.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Oathbound
warscroll_ability.lore: A Doomseeker chooses their quarry and shouts a vow to Grimnir that they will either destroy the enemy or die trying.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be this unit’s quarry. You can pick a unit that has been deployed in reserve.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by this unit that target its quarry.
If this unit is destroyed while it is in combat with its quarry, inflict 3 mortal damage on this unit’s quarry immediately after the ability that destroyed this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Runic Empowerment
warscroll_ability.lore: With a sonorous chant, the Runesmiter draws forth the power of the ur-gold runes set into the flesh of their Fyreslayer kin.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Siphon Souls
warscroll_ability.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model from a friendly or enemy unit is slain within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION,** give this **MANIFESTATION** a **soul point,** to a maximum of 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Attackers
warscroll_ability.lore: Blightlords descend from fume-choked skies to smash Nurgle’s most stubborn enemies to ruin.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Flyrider’s Arsenal** for attacks that target units contesting an objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Retribution or Salvation
warscroll_ability.lore: Cado’s quest for both vengeance and self-control manifests as two forms of sorcery: bolts of killing judgement and an aura of regal authority that augments nearby undead.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

If the target is a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash is the undisputed master of all undead creatures.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Will of the Horned Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: None among the Skaven clans may defy the commands of a Grey Seer – openly, at least…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, add the roll to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Reality-Splitting Axe
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: A rift to the Realm of Chaos can be carved wide open with a single sweep of this axe, causing the souls of those who have felt the bite of its edge to be dragged into that hellish dimension, never to be seen again.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick an enemy **HERO** that was allocated any damage points by this unit’s **Axe of Khorne** this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Time Ta Scarper
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for a unit wholly within 9" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Droggz knows exactly when to get his gitz out of a sticky situation so that they can come back for ‘anuvver go’ once the odds are in their favour again.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the unit using that **FIGHT** ability can move 2D6"  after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved. It can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Troglodon’s Jaws** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Peerless Among Daemonsmiths
warscroll_ability.lore: Urak Taar carries with him ancient knowledge said to have been imparted upon him by Hashut himself. Such closely guarded secrets grant him arcane mastery otherwise unheard of among daemonsmiths.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP - Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Shot and Shell
warscroll_ability.lore: The engineers of the Ironweld Arsenal have developed different ammunition for the Great Cannon to fire.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **Shoot** ability, choose either the **Cannonball** or **Grapeshot** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Great Cannon. The Cannonball can only be chosen if this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability that turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Iron Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: At a barked command from their Dominar, the Iron Golem snap into an impenetrable shieldwall.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not used a **MOVE** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dark Mist
warscroll_ability.lore: Neferata summons tendrils of penumbral mist to coil around her minions, rendering their corporeal forms as insubstantial as smoke.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non‑**MONSTER SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Grinderfist Tunnellers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Grinderfists can be used to create underground tunnels.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the tunnels below** and includes any models armed with **Grinderfists**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Trail of Crimson
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Shordemaire ploughs into the enemy’s lines, its giant jaws tearing huge chunks from monsters or swallowing smaller foes whole.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can make a pile-in move (even if it is not in combat). Then, if this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Demands of the Witness
warscroll_ability.lore: Iridan understands better than any that the most assured way to avoid the incremental erosion of the flaw in the Reforging process is to avoid being cut down, and so they exhort their charges to vanquish their foes quickly, mercilessly and without hesitation.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons. If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

warscroll_ability.name: Oracular Visions
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A sorcerer can temporarily bestow the gift of foresight upon their allies, helping them ward against enemy blows.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Scything Talons
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Vengorian Lord crashes into the foe, it lays about itself with frenzied sweeps of its huge talons, cutting down droves of lesser foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Wicked Predator
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In life, Terrorgheists were cruel and spiteful monsters, dark instincts driving them to terrify prey into submission. Little has changed in death.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons**, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Vision of Damnation
warscroll_ability.lore: The sorcerer conjures a vision of excess so intense that reality itself shimmers and distorts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, roll 6 dice. For each 4+, you receive 1 **depravity point**.

warscroll_ability.name: Master Contaminator
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Pust has tainted countless freshwater tarns, ancient forests and fertile arable fields.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target is considered by you to be **POLLUTED** for the rest of the battle.
