warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash is the undisputed master of all undead creatures.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Advisory Role
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With the right tome at their fingertips, a shrewdly worded recommendation from a Codewright can have as much of an impact on a battle as a direct order from an Admiral.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKYFARERS** units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:

***Seek New Prospects:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.

***Don’t Argue with the Wind:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

***There’s No Trading With Some People:*** The target can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Loyal Companion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord-Castellant’s Gryph-hound will protect its master to the bitter end.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit has **WARD (4+)**. Remove this unit’s **Gryph-hound** from the battlefield at the end of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Awakening Slumbering Spirits
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Sylvaneth reclaim parts of the realms, the spirit-song calls out to tree spirits that are deep in slumber to rejoin the glades.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token** and is within 12" of this unit. Then, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KURNOTHI** or **Treelord** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with 1 model from the target unit wholly within 6" of that terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, remove the friendly **overgrown token** from that terrain feature. If the target was a **Treelord**, allocate 10 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: For The Kingdom!
warscroll_ability.lore: Brave nobles lead the thunderous charge of the court’s knights and royal warbeasts, but none are as inspirational as this abhorrant.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly Knights units and friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES**.

Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **KNIGHTS** units and friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** instead while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **Abhorrant Ghoul Kings on Royal Zombie Dragons**.

warscroll_ability.name: Runes of Spellbreaking
warscroll_ability.lore: Runelords dampen the magic of their enemies with ancient sigils of unbinding.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Cacophony of Sorrow
warscroll_ability.lore: The piercing scream of the Tomb Banshee amplifies the discordant shrieks of Myrmourn Banshees, breaking the resolve of even the bravest of soldiers.
warscroll_ability.effect: While there are any visible friendly **Myrmourn Banshees** units within this unit’s combat range, ignore positive modifiers to the control scores of enemy units within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Fate
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzeentch’s chosen disciples can affect the destiny of those around them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **ARCANITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Heralds of Nagash
warscroll_ability.lore: The Morghast are the embodiment of Nagash's will and require no commander to function with utmost efficacy as a result.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to discipline rolls for this unit while it is not wholly within 12" of your general.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Shipwrecka Warclub** is 3 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Molten Rockbolts
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemies struck by magmapike bolts find their movements become increasingly sluggish as the burning rock cools and rapidly solidifies on their armour and flesh.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s unmodified Move characteristic below half.

warscroll_ability.name: Atmospheric Isolation
warscroll_ability.lore: An Atmospheric Anatomiser can create a localised vacuum steals the breath from an advancing enemy or depletes the arcane currents that impel foes of unnatural origin.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Shrapnel Blast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The gunner thrusts a few handfuls of rusty iron shards into the barrel of the cannon.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the phase:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons.
• This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Long in the Planning
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Carefully prepared deceptions and illusions pave the way for a merciless Arcanite assault.
warscroll_ability.declare: Spend 2 **fate points**. Then, pick a visible friendly Arcanite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time an enemy unit ends a charge move within 3" of the target, you can remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

warscroll_ability.name: Heroes' Bane
warscroll_ability.lore: Khorne’s eternal champion seeks out the worthiest of foes and demands they face him in single combat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** but all of its combat attacks must target that enemy **HERO.**

warscroll_ability.name: Pot-grot
warscroll_ability.lore: This little grot is given the important role of ‘stirrin’ da pot’.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Pot-grot** is a token. Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit while its **Pot-grot** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less for this unit, remove its **Pot-grot** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Axe of Khorne** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bloated with Corruption
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a Great Unclean One be wounded, the noxious effluvia within its swollen body will burst forth in a flesh-melting spray.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is damaged, pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Subduing Shots
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With eagle-eyed aim, Judicators can hit enemy beasts exactly where it hurts the most.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **MONSTER** that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Carve a Path
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The job of the hakkin’ krew is to clear a path through packed enemies to ensure the Maw-grunta maintains its momentum.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

Then, pick each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit gains 2 **momentum points**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Shield Inviolate
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike From the Shadows
warscroll_ability.lore: Maleneth waits for her allies to create a distraction before darting out from cover to engage the enemy and complete her deadly mission.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in hiding**. Then, pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that has 5 or more models to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target. If you do so, this unit must be set up in combat and has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. On a failed roll, this unit remains **in hiding** but you automatically pass the roll the next time you use this ability.

warscroll_ability.name: The Adevore
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Should Nagadron sense the impending doom of a foe wounded by the Dagger of Jet, it will fall upon them and hungrily feast on their soul.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit’s **Akmet-har** this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Firestealer Hammers** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.

Each part of this **MANIFESTATION** is armed with **Leeching Bites**.

warscroll_ability.name: Deliver Judgement
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Lord-Vigilant orders their soul-hollowed brethren to deliver Sigmar's wrath unto their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-eater
warscroll_ability.lore: Feeding off the swirling winds of magic, Cygors pose an incredible threat to spellcasters.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Each time this unit unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Vassal
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Slann Starmaster can channel the power of a spell through one of their followers.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKINK WIZARD** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by this unit this phase from the target instead of from this unit.

The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’ or ‘The Earth Trembles’.

warscroll_ability.name: Legion Quartermaster
warscroll_ability.lore: Though not quartermasters in the traditional sense, Boneshapers are without peer when it comes to reassembling their line warriors from splintered remains.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Imprisonment
warscroll_ability.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Realmweb Lurker
warscroll_ability.lore: Skitterstrand Arachnaroks stalk their prey through the arcane paths that connect the realms.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **skittering through tunnels in reality**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Feast Upon Their Bones
warscroll_ability.lore: The nightmarish sight of a Khorgorath crunching upon the bones of their allies is enough to send enemy ranks into a frenzy of panic.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy non-**MONSTER** units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Disruption
warscroll_ability.lore: The emanations from an Everblaze Comet disrupt the magical abilities of nearby wizards.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Manglers of Metal
warscroll_ability.lore: The weapons of the Zharrdron can be infernally empowered until they burn and blast clean through armour.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Nurglings
warscroll_ability.lore: Nurglings follow their mortal champion into battle with boundless enthusiasm.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While any friendly **Nurglings** units are wholly within 12" of this unit:
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to that **Nurglings** unit each phase.
• That **Nurglings** unit can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Regenerating Terror
warscroll_ability.lore: Brood Terrors are a nightmare of mutation and overwhelming strength.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Drawn to Magic
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These eldritch creatures like to feast upon arcane manifestations, which they hungrily pursue on sight.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of the Raider
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Before battle, Fellriders swear oaths to harry the enemy without mercy, showing no mercy to those stragglers who fall beneath their axes.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this phase and is only in combat with 1 enemy unit, and that enemy unit is only in combat with this unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s weapons for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Doomfire
warscroll_ability.lore: The Doomfire Warlocks hurl bolts of blazing black flame at their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Mortarch of Sacrament
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 18" of this uni
warscroll_ability.lore: Arkhan the Black is the master of the Null Myriad and privy to some of the most powerful mystical secrets in existence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound, its effect is not resolved and that **SPELL** ability cannot be used by enemy units until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Drench With Hate
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere presence of an Eidolon in its warrior aspect is enough to imbue nearby Idoneth with a fierce and bitter hate.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Momentum
warscroll_ability.lore: Once a Maw-grunta begins its charge, it can only stop by crashing into something, and it becomes ever more deadly as its speed increases.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **CHARGE** ability, it gains **1 momentum point**.

Each time it uses a **RUN** ability, it gains **2 momentum points**. It can have a maximum of **3 momentum points** at once.

Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Compendium of Dark Knowledge
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Tome flicks through its endless pages, it peers into the minds of nearby mages and gives knowledge to the loyal.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The target can immediately use a **SPELL** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.

**Designer’s Note:** *That spell does not count towards the number of* **SPELL** *or* **BANISH** *abilities the target can use this phase.*

warscroll_ability.name: Tsunami of Terror
warscroll_ability.lore: With a wave of its sceptre, the Eidolon sends forth invisible waves of fear that cause even the bravest of opponents to cower.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadowblood Cloak
warscroll_ability.lore: Crixxit’s cloak grants him the ability to melt into the darkness and instantly strike wherever a pack of his many agents cast their slinking shadows.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **ESHIN** unit that has 2 or more models and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the target. This unit can be set up in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Earth's Grip
warscroll_ability.lore: Spars of rock shoot up from the ground to grasp the legs of a foe, holding them in place unless they manage to free themselves.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle, the target is **gripped** until this unit is destroyed, the target **breaks free** or you pick a different target for this spell.

While the target is **gripped**, each time it uses a **MOVE** ability, your opponent must roll a dice as a reaction and add their **fury level** to the roll. On a 7+, the target **breaks free**. Otherwise, that **MOVE** ability has no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: One With The Forest
warscroll_ability.lore: Dryads seamlessly blend in with the surrounding foliage; in overgrown environments, the attacks of their opponents are as likely to strike unfeeling wood as they are the Sylvaneth themselves.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wyrdflame of Tzeentch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Lurid gouts of wyrdflame immolate the enemy when Flamers of Tzeentch are brought to the fore.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target that unit. In addition, if every shooting attack made by this unit this phase targets that enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.

Each part of this **MANIFESTATION** is armed with **Tendrils of Light and Shadow**.

warscroll_ability.name: Shattering Charge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Bloodthirster of Insensate Rage is an avatar of supreme carnage upon the battlefield, shattering formations with the force of its descent.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is **INFANTRY**, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnosaur’s Massive Jaws** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Monstrous Challenge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Though not strictly holding the rank of knight, the Drakesworn Templars fulfil a similar role within the Extremis chambers, charging off to face the greatest threats in single combat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** for attacks that target that enemy **MONSTER**.
• If that enemy **MONSTER** is also a **HERO**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Templar Weapon** for attacks that target that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Prophet of the Horned Rat
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Vizzik endlessly schemes to extend his god's influence - alongside his own.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll chanting rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn

warscroll_ability.name: Solia, The Tutor
warscroll_ability.lore: Teacher and tutor to Cado when he was a mortal prince, the spirit of Solia is now bound to one of his iron rings, offering him guidance on his path.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability while its **Cado Ezechiar** is on the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• This unit’s **Ezechiarian Greatsword** has **Crit (Mortal)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Pulverising Strike
warscroll_ability.lore: A Gatebreaker may swing its fortcrusha flail hard and bring it down in a single pulverising strike.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can make a pile-in move. Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 4D6 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Havin' A Good Old Rukk
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: As the boss gets stuck in, the boyz nearby can’t help but get involved.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO BONESPLITTERZ INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Drawn By Blood
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Enemy Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Skulltaker stalks the greatest heroes in the Mortal Realms, often appearing in the midst of battle to slay them before they can strike back.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: I'm Da Boss
warscroll_ability.lore: Loonbosses are terrible bullies and braggarts with a wicked talent for coercing other grots.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Moonclan Stabbas** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Get Back ’Ere!***: If the target is not in combat, you can return D6 slain models to it.

***Stab ’Em Good!***: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shardslash
warscroll_ability.lore: This majestic blade slices through armour and arcane wards alike as if they were the thinnest silk.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Grind Them to Dust
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a barked command, the Liege-Kavalos orders their fellow charioteers to press further into the melee and crush the foe beneath their wheels.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly **Kavalos War Chariots** wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For each target:
• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Beacon of Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Spreading his arms, Kairos saturates the area with magic.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

In addition, if a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit unbinds a spell, no command points are spent for that **WIZARD** to use the ‘Magical Intervention’ command in that phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Vial of Secrets
warscroll_ability.lore: Maleneth wears a vial of blood around her neck that contains the soul of her former mistress, whose whispered secrets grant her an uncanny awareness.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Enshrouding Fumes
warscroll_ability.lore: Choking, miasmatic clouds swirl around the Plague Censer Bearers.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Devastating Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Thundering across the battlefield, the Cavaliers build up momentum before smashing deep into the enemy’s ranks, laying about themselves with blade, axe, hammer and flail.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Instinctive Advance
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaangors are drawn to the screams of the battlefield as a hungering predator is drawn to wounded prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move up to 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. That move can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, and can end in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Keeper of the Corpse-gardens
warscroll_ability.lore: In battle, Gorslav can call upon his Deadwalker minions to throw themselves into enemy attacks and blunt their blades.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Hurricane Winds
warscroll_ability.lore: The arrows of the Spirits of the Wind are followed by a blast of wind, throwing enemies to the ground.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Crest of the Wave
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Riding the momentum of the ethersea, the Akhelian King leads a glorious charge to shatter the enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Flailing Fists** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Living Battering Ram
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A charging Wardroth Beetle tramples all in its path.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Stoked Fanaticism
warscroll_ability.lore: Better to endure grievous wounds unflinching, so say the Zharrdron, than falter under the gaze of Hashut’s hateful priests.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly non‑**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit each phase while it is wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.

warscroll_ability.name: Trespassers!
warscroll_ability.lore: When intruders are sighted, a Gorewarden and their flock make haste towards them, shrieking bloody murder
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **patrolling the borders**, then pick an enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit more than 6" from the target and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the units that were **patrolling the borders** with this unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Ordained Quest
warscroll_ability.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.

warscroll_ability.name: Guided by Lightning
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With the aid of their enchanted stormcaller baton, a Lord-Imperatant can direct the arrival of their brethren with the utmost precision.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units wholly within 12" of this unit that were set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can immediately move D3". The targets cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Step Into The Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: Stormreach Portals are used in battle to redirect the warriors of the Stormcast Eternals to where the fighting is fiercest.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Consecrated Revulsion
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaughter Queen’s fanaticism is so intense that her deity provides protection for her followers from the attacks of heathens and weaklings.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Magmadroth’s Claws and Horns** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Madness
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who gaze upon a Jabberslythe are soon overcome by a babbling madness, rendering them easy prey for the creature.
warscroll_ability.declare: Roll a D3. On a 2+, pick up to a number of enemy units equal to the roll that are within 9" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the unmodified hit roll for a combat attack made by the target is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Sloppklaw’s Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Zealous Counter-Attack
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Anointed Sentinels are furious, eager combatants that use their sheer size to meet charging armies head on.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Running Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Deathmasters lead only the nimblest Eshin agents to war.
warscroll_ability.effect: While friendly **ESHIN** units are wholly within 13" of this unit, they can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Attendants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The spectral attendants of the Black Coach bear potent artefacts, usually the possessions with which the occupant was interred. These can greatly empower the coach itself or imbue it with an aura of death magic that invigorates nearby Nighthaunt.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Noble Blade:*** This unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (Mortal)** instead of **Crit (Auto-wound)**.

***Unholy Grail:*** Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit. Each time that unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

***Tome of Undead Lore:*** This unit has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Fates Converge
warscroll_ability.lore: As the paths of Tzeentch’s endless plots cross, the Magister imbues their warriors with a sense of destiny.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you have 6 or more **fate points**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **ARCANITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Eager Death-dealers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The enthusiasm with which this faceless monster swings its cairnoch scythe is such that it drives nearby Grimghast Reapers into an unholy whirlwind of death.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Grimghast Reapers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dazzling Light
warscroll_ability.lore: Myari conjures a ball of blinding light, forcing foes to avert their gaze.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective that you do not control that is within 18" of and visible to this unit’s **Myari Lightcaller**, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that are contesting that objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Seeker of Truebone
warscroll_ability.lore: Thanatek is on a mission to source truebone, a material of surpassing quality for the creation, maintenance and reinforcement of the Bonereaper legions.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can be picked to be the target of the ‘Immortal Elite’ ability as if it had the **HERO** keyword.

Each time a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit is destroyed, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit gains 1 **portion of truebone**. Each time a visible friendly non-**BEAST OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is destroyed, this unit gains 1 **portion of truebone**.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Fangz of Da Bad Moon
warscroll_ability.lore: As Skragrott tells it, a single shrieked invocation from him – arms raised high into the air – can compel the Bad Moon to belch a rain of fiendishly accurate loonstone fangz over the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified casting roll. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Cinderblast Bomb
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This weapon explodes in a burst of shrapnel and flame.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Disruption
warscroll_ability.lore: Fiends of Slaanesh let out a keening chorus that shreds the sanity of spellcasters who hear it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: The Thinning Veil
warscroll_ability.lore: As heads roll and blood flows, more daemons from beyond the veil are summoned forth to partake in the slaughter.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, you can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Toad Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere scent of a blot toad sends Ripperdactyls into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Ripperdactyl’s Tearing Jaws** while it is in combat with any units that have a **Blot Toad**.

warscroll_ability.name: Iron-willed Champion
warscroll_ability.lore: This champion of Chaos demands that their warriors give no quarter.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice. You cannot pick this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Dutiful Gryph-hound
warscroll_ability.lore: Each Lord-Castellant is accompanied by a Gryph-hound trained to fight alongside them.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gryph-hound** is a token. If this unit’s **Gryph-hound** has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Gryph-hound’s Beak** and it cannot use the ‘Loyal Companion’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Counter-blow
warscroll_ability.lore: Retributors are experts in close combat. Once an enemy has made the fatal mistake of engaging them, they will be shattered by the Paladins’ answering blows.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is damaged or if any models in this unit were slain this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Pack
warscroll_ability.lore: His voice redolent with supernatural power, Radukar the Wolf barks the command to charge and his undead minions hurl themselves at the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-shaking Roar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Defiant in the face of any foe, Krondys issues an ear shattering roar at those who dare face him.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Clarity of Thought
warscroll_ability.lore: Meditating upon the purity of Hysh, the Enlightener dispels all doubt and distraction from the minds of allies, granting them clarity of thought and deed that allows them to perceive and avoid the worst attacks of the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target that friendly unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Timber!
warscroll_ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where – and on whom – their body will fall.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this model is slain, before removing it from the battlefield, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield up to 3" from this model. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 2" of that point. This model is then removed from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Transport Capacity
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can transport up to 3 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Titanic Boulderclub** is 3 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Bone-deep Savagery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The impure materials used in the creation of the Teratic Cohort has lent them an innate savagery that is all but impossible to truly control in the heat of battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move 3 ". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all of its parts are removed from play.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** moves, each of its parts must end within 1" of at least 1 other part.

Each part of this **MANIFESTATION** is armed with **Murderous Beaks**.

warscroll_ability.name: Just A Little Closer...
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
warscroll_ability.lore: It is the job of a Mantrapper’s pets and cronies to lure prey into the ogor’s snares.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to this unit, pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place 1 of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** next to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Spellmaster
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
warscroll_ability.lore: Magisters are attuned to magical energy and can harness the raw essence of Chaos. There are those however, that delve too deep into this source of power.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Carriage
warscroll_ability.lore: Unimpeded by physical obstacles due to its phantasmal form and carried upon spectral winds, a Black Coach hurtles towards its victims with horrifying swiftness.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: On The Hunt
warscroll_ability.lore: Unlike most undead, Dire Wolves have lost almost none of the swiftness they possessed in life and are forever hungry for warm flesh.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wind of Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Mannfred conjures a howling gust of spectral wind that tears the souls from the bodies of those who feel its chilling bite.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of the caster, pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of that point and visible to the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Deadly Cargo
warscroll_ability.lore: Terradons carry heavy boulders hewn from meteoric rock and carved with sigils of destruction. When these are dropped upon enemy lines, those not immediately crushed are sent flying in all directions.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each model in this unit, and add 2 to each roll if this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **Terradon Chief** units. For each 5+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• If any damage points are allocated by this ability and the target does not have **FLY**, the target cannot use **RUN** abilities until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vice-Like Grip
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Morrgryph pounces on an enemy leader, pinning them in the grip of its talons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy non-**MONSTER HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 2D6. If the result exceeds the target's Health characteristic, for the rest of the turn:

• The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
• The target cannot use commands.

warscroll_ability.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Gryph-crows are sensitive to spiritual corruption and immediately alert their masters whenever unholy energies are nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Gryph-crow** is a token. This unit has **WARD (5+)** while its **Gryph-crow** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-crow** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Sniffer Spite
warscroll_ability.lore: Zarbag has captured and imprisoned a sniffer spite which he has ‘persuaded’ to track down potent magic fungi.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit’s **Zarbag** is on the battlefield and within 3" of a terrain feature, roll a dice. On a 4+, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Breath of the Mire-drakes
warscroll_ability.lore: Belcha-bannas are typically built around the severed tongue of a mire-drake, creatures so vile that even after death, their remains belch forth clouds of soulshrivelling gas.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 1, this ability has no effect. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Up We Go!
warscroll_ability.lore: The orruk hauls themselves up to the idol’s platform.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shouty Boss, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY HERO** that is not in combat and is within 3" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shouty Boss (see ‘Man da Tower!’).

warscroll_ability.name: Incoming!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The skyvessel fires a close-range fusillade at a foe bearing down upon it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Tunnelpack Ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: With a deafening crack, the earth splits and the Tunnelpack scurry forth into battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **drilling beneath the surface**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Vortemis the All-seeing
warscroll_ability.lore: No greater practitioners of the arcane arts are there than the Magisters of Tzeentch.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Vortemis the All-seeing** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Fervour
warscroll_ability.lore: Witch Aelves hurl themselves at the enemy with no fear of death, cutting down foes in a whirlwind of blades.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chambers are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dance of Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sisters of Slaughter delight in frustrating foes with acts of incredible acrobatics and martial skill.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Blissbarb Shafts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Barbed arrows speed through the air, guiding the Dread Pageant to vulnerable enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Hadzu** is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is **blissmarked** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Nasty Traps And Tricks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These cunning creatures specialise in fighting dirty and laying all manner of lethal and cunning traps.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Deafening Drone
warscroll_ability.lore: Revenant Seekers circle over the melee, cutting throats and piercing skulls with swipes of their sickles. The buzzing roar of their dragonspites’ wings soon disorientate enemies who engage them in protracted combat.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Pitiless Trampling
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Taar contemptuously crashes through all those he considers inferior without even a sidewards glance.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance up to the value of the roll. During that move, this unit can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Jolly Gutpipes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a parp and a honk from their gutpipes, a Sloppity Bilepiper entertains their fellow daemons while ensuring their foes remain a captive audience.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If you picked a friendly unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

If you picked an enemy unit to be the target, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, until the start of your next turn, while this unit is on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target:

• Each time the target ends a move further from this unit than it was at the start of the move, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.
• Each time the target is removed from the battlefield and set up again on the battlefield further from this unit than it was before it was removed, after the ability used by the target has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Bone Spirit
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Maniak Weirdnobs are followed closely into battle by other boarboys, their wild cries riling the ornery hogs as much as it gets the ladz raring for a fight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BONESPLITTERZ CAVALRY** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Cornered Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: A Clawlord in fear for their life fights with rabid ferocity.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Blade**.

warscroll_ability.name: The One True King
warscroll_ability.lore: News of Ushoran’s mighty deeds spreads like wildfire through the Flesh‑eater ranks, inspiring his subjects to carry out their duties with greater vigour.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While you believe this **DELUSION**:

•  Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units.
•  Subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for enemy units.
•  The melee weapons used by friendly **SERFS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within friendly territory and did not charge in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of the Marches
warscroll_ability.lore: A Gorewarden is responsible for patrolling the borders of their liege’s territory, leading flights of warriors to ambush their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units in this unit’s regiment that have not been deployed to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up the target units in reserve **patrolling the borders**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Faithful Gryph-hounds
warscroll_ability.lore: A Knight-Judicator is often accompanied into battle by a pair of these loyal beasts of Azyr.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place both **Gryph-hounds** next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Scumboil Pox
warscroll_ability.lore: Festus has mastered a spell that inflicts a choking curse upon a foe, their throat breaking out into oozing pustules and their tongues swelling to twice the size.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Masked in Plain Sight
warscroll_ability.lore: Few can see through the Changeling’s disguise.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Set up this unit in reserve **incognito**. It has now been deployed.

Friendly **incognito** units are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Crashing Upon The Foe
warscroll_ability.lore: The Eidolon surges up into the sky before crashing down like a tidal wave, reforming to dive again and again until nothing is left of the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT**  abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Impossible to Destroy
warscroll_ability.lore: It is almost impossible to kill a Hydra, for they regenerate wounds and regrow severed heads with alarming speed.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll 6 dice. Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled for each **destroyed head token** this unit has.

If any of the rolls are a 5+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit for each 5+. Finally, give this unit 1 **destroyed head token.**

warscroll_ability.name: Calamitous Crash
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Magmadroth raises its forelegs and brings them smashing down, causing a rippling eruption of earth and flame that sends lesser foes tumbling into magma-filled lacerations in the ground.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Weapon Curse
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Heralds known as Changecasters summon the lurid flames of Tzeentch to engulf their foes. These screaming, living torches are thus marked as the next targets to be annihilated by the Change God’s faithful.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target was set up this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that unit have no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: Repair Routines
warscroll_ability.lore: Auto-Endrins can be used to assist with combat repairs.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Chitinous Legs** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: The Reliquary
warscroll_ability.lore: When the amethyst magics that thrum through a Mortis Engine reach a crescendo, its Corpsemaster custodian can unleash them as a lethal bow wave of power.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit is set up for the first time, place a **stored energy dice** beside it with the ‘1’ facing up. Each time a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this unit, increase the value of the **stored energy dice** beside this unit by 1 (to a maximum of 6).

warscroll_ability.name: Rhythm of the Chase
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Belthanos relentlessly harries his quarry before deftly closing the distance to deliver the killing strike
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll, then you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Ghastly Descent
warscroll_ability.lore: The axe of a Lord Executioner descends pitilessly on all foolish enough to commit the crime of standing against Nagash's dark justice.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY HERO** that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **SENTENCED** unit. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Heralds of Righteousness
warscroll_ability.lore: Prosecutors cross the battlefield in a blur of light.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift and Nimble
warscroll_ability.lore: Though not physically powerful, skinks are fleet of foot, able to rapidly redeploy and outmanoeuvre the enemy at a single chirruped command.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, when determining the distance this unit can move, you can roll 2 dice instead of 1 and pick either result.

warscroll_ability.name: Molten Mending
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A learned Daemonsmith can suture ensorcelled plate and stoke the daemon furnaces anew.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINE** wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3+X)** the target, where **X** is the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has.

warscroll_ability.name: Behemoth's Bane
warscroll_ability.lore: Ivya has spent centuries roaming the forests of Shyish and beyond, and she has triumphed over some of the most heinous beasts imaginable.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 2 from the Attacks characteristic of enemy **MONSTERS’** melee weapons while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Deathrider Commander
warscroll_ability.lore: A Liege-Kavalos's force of will drives the undead cavalry they command onwards without pause.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit and visible friendly **Kavalos Deathriders** units wholly within 12" of this unit can move 12" instead of 10" when they use the 'Deathrider Wedge' ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Apex Predator
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: It is a point of pride to a Manticore rider that they and their steed are the apex predators of the battlefield. They seek out the strongest foes and do not rest until they have proven their supremacy with a vicious kill.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that **MONSTER** for the rest of the turn. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Huntmaster's Strike
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The battlefield is the hunting ground and until his god returns, Belthanos is the prime hunter.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again more than 6" from all enemy units and wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Atavistic Nightmares
warscroll_ability.lore: The trauma of the burning soul-essence is so horrifying that those who witness it are paralysed by dread.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While any of this unit's **Balefire Braziers** are next to an enemy unit, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units within that enemy unit's combat range.

If an ability would heal or return slain models to an enemy unit while any of this unit's **Balefire Braziers** are next to it, that ability does not heal or return any slain models to it. Instead, place those **Balefire Braziers** next to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Star-fated Arrow
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Whispering the name of a powerful foe, the Knight-Venator looses an arrow destined to end that enemy’s life.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is a non-**MONSTER** unit, inflict D6 mortal damage on it. If the target is a **MONSTER**, inflict D6+3 mortal damage on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Scorched Remains
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The grim aftermath left behind by the Helsmiths’ flamehurlers is enough to shake even the most stolid warrior to their very core.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy **INFANTRY** unit, that enemy unit is the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shield of Azyr
warscroll_ability.lore: These golden armoured warriors will willingly put themselves in mortal danger in order to protect Neave and Lorai.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **THE BLACKTALONS HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Dark Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sorceress draws power from the blood spilled by her Black Dragon.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each **dark sorcery token** it has.

warscroll_ability.name: Blot Toad
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Ripperdactyl flock takes flight, the Seraphon will seed creatures known as blot toads across the battlefield. These loathsome amphibians emit a pervasive stink that is unpalatable to all cold-blooded creatures, but especially the Ripperdactyls.
warscroll_ability.declare: You receive 1 **Blot Toad** token for each **Ripperdactyl Chief** or **Ripperdactyl Riders** unit in your army, to a maximum of 3 tokens. Pick a number of enemy units equal to the number of **Blot Toads** you have to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place a **Blot Toad** next to each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Predator Knights
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Though they lack the power of true flight, nightshriekers can leap clean over obstacles and the heads of the foe, allowing the Morbheg Knights to strike and disengage at will.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Comet Trail
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The flight of a Tauralon is accompanied by sparkling Azyrite energies that serve as a beacon to keen-eyed Sigmarite warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Primal Hex
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a bellow and vigorous shaking of his Bonebeast Stikk, the Wardokk makes it clear that any ‘messin’ about’ will not go well for the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD** within 24" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **SPELL** or **UNBIND** ability, this unit gains 1 ritual point.

warscroll_ability.name: Warp Lightning Blast
warscroll_ability.lore: A Warp Lightning Cannon fires massive bolts of warp lightning that disintegrate any who are struck by them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each attack made with this weapon in a single phase must target the same enemy unit. Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: First of the Vyrkos
warscroll_ability.lore: Belladamma is the matriarch of the Vyrkos bloodline, and she commands their conquests with calculating efficiency.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **Radukar the Wolf**, **Radukar the Beast**, **Ivya Volga**, **Lady Annika** and **Kritza** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Paragon of Slaughter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: High Gladiatrixes carry a fearsome reputation, and their mere presence ignites a fervour in the Daughters of Khaine that no other can emulate.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunters Unleashed
warscroll_ability.lore: Unable to hold back any longer, these feral constructs rush forward to engage their prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Staff of Abjuration
warscroll_ability.lore: The blessed light that shines from this staff can banish even the most potent sorceries.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bringers of Desolation
warscroll_ability.lore: Paragons of the Dark Gods, Chaos Warriors cut a swathe through the enemy lines, leaving nothing but blood and ruin in their wake.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleash The Critters!
warscroll_ability.lore: Each of the unusual creatures that remain close to Mollog can unleash nasty surprises of their own.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Spore Cloud:*** Remove this unit’s **Spiteshroom**. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

***Bat Squig Attack!:*** Remove this unit’s **Bat Squig**. Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

***Rock-hard Skin:*** Remove this unit’s **Stalagsquig**. Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative) for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Terror
warscroll_ability.lore: This terrifying monstrosity strikes fear into the hearts of its foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pah! Unworthy!
warscroll_ability.lore: Seeing other possessed warriors fall merely convinces surviving Symbaresh of their own superiority.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is damaged or has fewer than half its starting models, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Heart of the Inferno
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Exalted Flamer causes the fires of its lesser kin to reach truly horrific levels of intensity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 2 visible friendly **FLAMERS OF TZEENTCH** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast Handler
warscroll_ability.lore: Horticulous is accompanied by romping packs of Beasts of Nurgle, who look to him like hounds do their master and whose foolishness he always forgives.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Beast of Nurgle** unit that has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Berserk Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: No Fyreslayer will easily accept death’s embrace while their kin are still fighting.
