warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Strength From Victory
warscroll_ability.lore: The more fights a Megaboss wins, the stronger they become.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.

Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.

warscroll_ability.name: Blot Toad
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Ripperdactyl flock takes flight, the Seraphon will seed creatures known as blot toads across the battlefield. These loathsome amphibians emit a pervasive stink that is unpalatable to all cold-blooded creatures, but especially the Ripperdactyls.
warscroll_ability.declare: You receive 1 **Blot Toad** token for each **Ripperdactyl Chief** or **Ripperdactyl Riders** unit in your army, to a maximum of 3 tokens. Pick a number of enemy units equal to the number of **Blot Toads** you have to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place a **Blot Toad** next to each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Empowered By Atrocity
warscroll_ability.lore: The souls of those slain in the presence of an Eightfold Doom-Sigil are absorbed by the magical manifestation, feeding the Dark Gods’ eternal hunger and inspiring their servants to battle all the harder, even as their own lives are offered in tribute.
warscroll_ability.effect: If 2 or more units (friendly or enemy) were destroyed this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Mork Sez No!
warscroll_ability.lore: As enemy wizards foolishly attempt to weave their magics, Gobsprakk summons tapewyrm sguigs into their guts and fills their minds with so much Waaagh! energy that they sometimes explode!
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster. If the unbinding roll was 10+, inflict D6 mortal damage on the caster instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Ambush from Beyond
warscroll_ability.lore: Legs first, then bulbous body, the Skitterstrand drags itself out of a tear in reality.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **skittering through tunnels in reality**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-guide
warscroll_ability.lore: The Soulmason empowers and focuses the souls that animate a nearby regiment of Ossiarch warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Strength
warscroll_ability.lore: When empowered with a surplus of daemonic energy, Dominator Engines are made faster and deadlier still.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For each **daemonic power point** this unit has:
•  Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Reaped Like Corn
warscroll_ability.lore: The scythes wielded by these ghostly warriors can be swung in great sweeping arcs, cutting down whole ranks of enemy warriors.
warscroll_ability.effect: Combat attacks made by this unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ if the target unit has 5 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Festering Bulwark
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Heavy shield planted in the mud, a Lord of Blights orders their warriors brace for the enemy attack.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly **Putrid Blightkings** unit within 3" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Gathoblyt’s Fanged Maw** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Saint of Slaughter
warscroll_ability.lore: Under the fierce scrutiny of Prince Vhordrai, vampires revel in displaying their martial skill.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER VAMPIRE** unit that destroyed a unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to a unit once.

warscroll_ability.name: Lash and Tangle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The whipping tendrils that shoot from the Treelord’s palm ensnare enemies and keep them at bay with their frantic thrashing.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Strangleroots** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is within the **creeping overgrowth**. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Chilling Horde
warscroll_ability.lore: When the enemy is frozen in fear, the Chainrasps effortlessly drag to the underworlds any who face their assault.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by this unit if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Devourer of Magics
warscroll_ability.effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** destroyed any enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** this turn, **Heal (6)** this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Harbinger of Horror
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this **MANIFESTATION**’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Keep Up!
warscroll_ability.lore: Mancrusher Gargants run as fast as they can so as not to be left out behind when their bigger brethren charge into battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **MEGA-GARGANT**, this unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Read the Winds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Navigators can signal to nearby Kharadron airships, helping them to steer into prevailing currents.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **AUTO-ENDRIN** within this unit’s combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **SKYVESSEL**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Aetheric Manipulation
warscroll_ability.lore: This wizard can manipulate the aetheric energies of the realms, channelling them into powerful spells to summon manifestations.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **SUMMON** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Icon of the Blood God
warscroll_ability.lore: The massive brass-and-bone icons hefted by the Bloodsecrators inspire the Bloodbound to fight until their last, gore-flecked breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Stalk the Prey
warscroll_ability.lore: Karanak's quarry is relentlessly and mercilessly run to the ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat unless it was in combat at the start of that move and, if there is an enemy **quarry** on the battlefield, it must end that move closer to the **quarry.**

warscroll_ability.name: Brutal Blows
warscroll_ability.lore: Kroxigor swing their weapons in wide arcs, smashing aside a multitude of foes with each blow.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** if the target unit has 5 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Heartrender** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Sacred Gongs
warscroll_ability.lore: Borne by straining hobgrots, these gongs are holy relics to the servants of Hashut.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gong Carriers** are tokens. There is 1 **Gong Carrier** for every **MUSICIAN** in this unit. If this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, as a reaction, you can remove a **Gong Carrier** to make an additional rally roll of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Ripe Pastures
warscroll_ability.lore: Rot Flies buzz across the battlefield, consuming their enemies before moving on to fresh targets, their retreat covered by a repulsive cloud of decaying flesh.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Fires of Retribution
warscroll_ability.lore: Vengeance burns blinding and everlasting in Karazai’s soul.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 5-9 damage points, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. 

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Infantry Overseer
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Each Knight of Shrouds was a mighty general in mortal life and still retains the ability to spur their soldiery to great feats of arms.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hrothgorn's Mantrappers
warscroll_ability.lore: The Icebrow Hunter is accompanied to battle by a band of Gnoblars and his loyal Frost Sabre, Thrafnir.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Bushwakka**, **Bushwakka’s Trap**, **Quiv**, **Luggit** and **Thwack**, and **Thrafnir** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all of its tokens except for its **Bushwakka’s Trap** next to it. Then, pick an objective or terrain feature and place its **Bushwakka’s** **Trap** next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Gryph‑crows are sensitive to corruption and immediately alert their masters whenever unholy energies are nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Gryph-crow** is a token. Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units within 12" of this unit while its **Gryph-crow** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-crow** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Darkness of the Soul
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Scinari Cathallars wield the negative energy locked in aetherquartz as a weapon, afflicting the enemy with a soul-shrivelling despondency that dulls them to their superiors’ orders.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunting Beast
warscroll_ability.lore: Masked in the swirling blizzards of the Everwinter, Thrafnir ruthlessly hunts its prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Thrafnir** is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, remove **Thrafnir** from the battlefield. On a 2+, place **Thrafnir** next to the target. Until the start of your next turn, the target is being **stalked by** **Thrafnir**. While a unit is being **stalked by Thrafnir**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Trap Launcher** for attacks that target that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Light Endrinpacks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The aether-powered backpacks worn by the Vongrim allow them to travel light and swift.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Nightmare Lantern
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The cursed light of Nagashizzar bound within a nightmare lantern invigorates the dark souls of any Nighthaunt it illuminates.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Light A Pyre
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Arcane loci are set ablaze by the Pyregheists, who direct those deadly witchfires with terrible efficacy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add a number equal to the roll to this unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Righteous Avengers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord-Celestants inspire their brethren to mete out Sigmar’s justice; nearby Stormcasts strike the instant they are given the order.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO EXTREMIS CHAMBER CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Jagged Harpoon
warscroll_ability.lore: Upon piercing the enemy’s flesh, the serrated edges of a First Fang’s harpoon shred vital organs; the more the target thrashes about, the more severe the internal damage.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit includes a **First Fang**, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. If the target is a **BEAST** or **MONSTER**, roll a dice instead. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Weapon Team
warscroll_ability.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Utter Contempt
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash is disgusted by the rabid mania of the Flesh-eaters, but their usefulness to his goals is beyond doubt.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit ignores the effects of **DELUSION** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: The Endless Vermintide
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Swarms of vermin scurry forth from the gnawhole, overwhelming the enemy lines.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of a friendly **Gnawhole** and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Supernatural Speed
warscroll_ability.lore: Lady Annika’s near-permanent state of starvation drives her ahead of the main battlelines, ready to pounce as soon as prey draws near.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lying in wait**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Gor Stampede
warscroll_ability.lore: Gors gather in massive droves before charging their enemies, seeking to overwhelm them with superior numbers and brutish aggression.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy non-**HERO INFANTRY** unit that has fewer models than this unit and is within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Calculated Trajectory
warscroll_ability.lore: The warhosts of the Chaos duardin revel in overwhelming their foes with excessive, punishing firepower.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit with 5 or more models that is more than 12" from this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Warning Cry
warscroll_ability.lore: It is said that it is impossible to sneak up on a Gryph-hound.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit that was set up this turn. Then, pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units armed with ranged weapons that are within 12" of that enemy unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: If I Cannot Rule, None Shall Rule!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: In the presence of Kurdoss Valentian’s all-consuming bitterness and the cruel malice of his heralds, the commands of enemy generals turn to dust in their mouths even as they issue them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ashigaroth’s Claws** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Nullifier Auto-Endrin
warscroll_ability.lore: This Auto-Endrin carries a gigantic null-field emitter for dispelling magic.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is a **Nullifier Auto-Endrin** and is in combat with any enemy **MANIFESTATIONS**, pick each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a **banishment roll** of 3D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the **banishment value** on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied by Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: The scent and taste of freshly spilled blood drives Carnosaurs into a killing frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Time-Swallower's Maw
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Though Sekhar is loath to let Ouboroth feast upon souls, sometimes, needs must.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Serpentine Agility’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the roll and its Move characteristic.

warscroll_ability.name: Bard of the Lodge
warscroll_ability.lore: Standing defiant in front of the enemy, a Battlesmith recites tales of the lodge’s glorious history, rallying the warriors around them.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Cloud of Flies
warscroll_ability.lore: Plaguebearers are surrounded by a cloud of swarming flies that feast on their rotting bodies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit while it is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Shock Gauntlets
warscroll_ability.lore: Sometimes the electrical discharge created by a pair of shock gauntlets triggers a series of linked explosions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s Shock Gauntlets scores a critical hit, that attack scores **D6 hits** instead of 1 (make a wound roll for each hit).

warscroll_ability.name: Scything Assault
warscroll_ability.lore: The War Chariot's incredible momentum sees it crash straight through the enemy front lines with shocking force.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mighty Axe of Khorne and Bloodflail** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Foster Competition
warscroll_ability.lore: Krittok has created a system in which his armoured swarms are so desperate to earn his favour that they spend only some of their time plotting his overthrow.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **Stormvermin** units while they are wholly within 13"of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Stalwart Defenders
warscroll_ability.lore: Liberators fiercely guard the lands brought into Sigmar’s domain.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective wholly within friendly territory.

warscroll_ability.name: Relic Censer
warscroll_ability.lore: The censers of the Relictor temple emanate purifying incense that can burn through the very fabric of heretical falsehoods and mystical hexes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls made by the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Primal Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere taste of enemy blood whips an Aggradon into a battle frenzy and sends the beast on a violent rampage.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit must use this ability each turn.

If this unit used any **FIGHT** abilities this turn, place a **rage token** next to it, to a maximum of 3. If this unit did not use any **FIGHT** abilities this turn, remove all **rage tokens** it has.

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons for each **rage token** it has until the end of the next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunter's Endurance
warscroll_ability.lore: As the spirit-song intensifies and the magic of life surges across the battlefield, Kurnoth Hunters are gripped with a sacred fervour of the chase that sees them shrug off wounds.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Call to Battle
warscroll_ability.lore: The enchanted battle horn of the Knight-Heraldor can be heard in distant Azyr, summoning reinforcements from the storm itself.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Spiritual Locus
warscroll_ability.lore: Vyne can focus his magic through Wisper.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **Jacobus Vyne** uses a **SPELL** or **SHOOT** ability, you can measure range and visibility from this **MANIFESTATION** instead of from that friendly unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Be Mine Eyes
warscroll_ability.lore: Felgryn and his favoured ‘falcon’, Grype, are adept at rooting out hidden prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit’s **Grype** is a token. If this unit’s **Grype** is not next to an enemy unit, pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place this unit’s **Grype** next to the target. If the target is destroyed while this unit’s **Grype** is next to it, remove this unit’s **Grype** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Attack Squadron
warscroll_ability.lore: Groups of Gunhaulers range ahead to clear the way for larger skyvessels.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used the ‘Run’ ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Ethersea
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Tidecaster can manipulate the ethersea like no other.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Creeping Mist:*** Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.

***Surging Stream:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.

***Spiteful Riptide:*** Each time an enemy unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Thrashing Desperation
warscroll_ability.lore: Only the bravest and most determined of charges can get within striking range of the veritable wall of thrashing blades that are the Bladegheist Revenants.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit contests an objective you control, enemy units cannot end a charge move within ½" of this unit unless the unmodified charge roll was 5 or more.

warscroll_ability.name: Take Up Their Arms
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Highly trained, Helsmith infantry are proficient in the use of many weapons and can take up the arms of a nearby unit that has sustained losses, if so commanded.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another visible friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit, **Deathshrieker Rocket Battery** or **Tormentor Bombard** within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Remove up to 3 models from this unit. Then, if the target is an **INFANTRY** unit, return a number of slain models to the target equal to the number of models you removed from this unit. If the target is a **WAR MACHINE**, heal a number of damage points allocated to the target equal to the number of models you removed from this unit.

Models removed from this unit by this ability cannot be returned to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Brimstone Horror
warscroll_ability.lore: If the Blue Horror is slain, it transforms into a pair of capering Brimstone Horrors.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Brimstone Horror** is a token. When this unit’s **Blue Horror** is slain, place this unit’s **Brimstone Horror** on the battlefield. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Mighty Sorcerous Bolt** while its **Brimstone Horror** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove this unit’s **Brimstone Horror** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Memorian Descendants
warscroll_ability.lore: Reclusians are accompanied by Memorians who serve to remind them of their humanity.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Memorians** are tokens. There are 2 **Memorians** for every 3 models in this unit. While any of this unit’s **Memorians** are on the battlefield, add 1 to this unit’s resistance rolls when using the ‘Ruination Chamber’ ability.

Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Memorians** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Magmadroth’s Claws and Horns** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-**CORE** ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Vengeance of Khorne
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Wrath of Khorne Bloodthirsters deliver destruction to those who draw the ire of the War God.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 8 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Eldritch Raiders
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzaangors plunge into enemy lands, desperately seeking the arcane trinkets and treasures they crave – as well as victims to be transformed in their own bird-like image.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is wholly within enemy territory.

warscroll_ability.name: Shield of the Manticore
warscroll_ability.lore: Valoran’s gleaming shield is an impressively resilient piece of defensive equipment.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **INFANTRY HEROES** while those friendly units are within 3" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughterous Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne’s Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Direct The Assault
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Surveying the battlefield, the Lord-Vigilant perceives a weak point in the enemy lines and orders their brethren to follow them into the breach.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 5 to the target's control score.

warscroll_ability.name: Uglug the Troggoth
warscroll_ability.lore: Despite his smaller size, Uglug still has the remarkable resilience of his larger cousins.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit includes **Uglug**, ignore the first damage point allocated to it each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Hurricane Winds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The arrows of the Spirits of the Wind are followed by a blast of wind, throwing enemies to the ground.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Pater Filius
warscroll_ability.lore: The Brethren of the Bolt are led by Pater Filius, a Sigmarite priest who is as crazed as he is pious.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Pater Filius** is on the battlefield, it has **PRIEST (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Creeping Summons
warscroll_ability.lore: The Broodmasters of the Eightfold Watcher have a strange and dark symbiosis with the swarms of venomous spiders that accompany them, calling forth an ever-growing horde that can overwhelm the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, you can return D3 slain **Spider Swarms** to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cleansing Rituals
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature
warscroll_ability.lore: These shrines are instrumental to the Lumineth’s efforts in purging Chaos from the Mortal Realms.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian, you can re-roll the casting roll for that spell.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash is the undisputed master of all undead creatures.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Specialist Grundstok Ammunition
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gruncorps outfits its soldiers with the latest in experimental munitions.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick **Shieldbreaker** ammunition or **Thunderdrakk** ammunition.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that **SHOOT** ability target the same enemy unit, after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that **SHOOT** ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:

***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Mutilating Blades
warscroll_ability.lore: A Slaaneshi chariot inflicts carnage when it ploughs into the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Nimbus of Power
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Dark magic lends the vehicle blurring speed that allows it to disappear, only to reappear in a more advantageous position.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Resonance
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who go through the agonising ritual of the Slith-onóir become creatures of supreme arcane might.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **SUMMON** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Regalia Fulmentarus
warscroll_ability.lore: A symbol of the Draconith–Stormcast alliance, this mastersmithed mantle enhances Krondys’s arcane strength to even greater heights.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Verdant Growth
warscroll_ability.lore: Perfectly attuned to the nature of Ghyran, Vyne can cause structures to become overgrown in an instant.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective or visible non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 3" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Cometstrike Sceptre
warscroll_ability.lore: Blazing with celestial might, the Celestant-Prime raises his sceptre high before letting it fall, causing comets to rain from above.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit attacks with its **Cometstrike Sceptre**, if the attack scores a hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Minions of the Silver Tower
warscroll_ability.lore: The warped fortresses of the Gaunt Summoners are infested with their thrall hosts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target is set up in reserve **in a Silver Tower**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Passage Through The Underworlds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A master of navigation, Awlrach can drift through the ethereal plane to new locations at will. By the time the foe has discovered his arrival, it is all too late to stop the spectral cargo that made the journey with him.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit and the target from the battlefield, then set them up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of each other and more than 7" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Lightning Strikes
warscroll_ability.lore: Vanquishers utilise a stance that allows them to make a flurry of rapid strikes against a numerous foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Celestial Greatswords** for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 5 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: On Winged Steeds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Crypt Flayers** unit that used the ‘To Our Liege!’ ability this turn and is wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can immediately move D3" but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Soaring Terror
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Zombie Dragon soars over the enemy warriors, scouring those below with its corrosive breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Watery Clutch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Just as an ocean current seizes a helpless creature and drags it down to its doom, so too do the Incarnate’s tendrils ensnare and drown their victims.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, the target is **ensnared** for the rest of the turn.

A unit cannot use commands while it is **ensnared**.

warscroll_ability.name: Deadly Cohesion
warscroll_ability.lore: Raptadon Hunters pepper enemy lines with volleys of starstone javelins, exposing weak points for Raptadon Chargers to exploit.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Raptadon Chargers** unit that charged this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase. It must target a visible enemy unit in combat with the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Wheel About
warscroll_ability.lore: The Kavalos Deathriders plunge through the enemy ranks, disengaging before the enemy can strike back.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Rain of Stone
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Boulders crash down from the Spirit of the Mountain, crushing foes under the avalanche.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. Add 2 to the roll if the target charged this turn. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Curse of Years
warscroll_ability.lore: Tracing a spiteful gesture in the air, Arkhan curses the enemy to age at an incredible rate.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 10 dice. For each 6:

• Give the target 1 **necrotic withering** point.
• Roll an extra dice.

For each 5+ on those extra dice, repeat the above bullet points, Then, do the same for each 4+ and then each 3+. Finally, for each 2+, give the target 1 **necrotic withering** point (do not roll any extra dice).

After a roll, if the target has 8 or more **necrotic withering** points, it is automatically destroyed. Otherwise, after the last roll, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the number of **necrotic withering** points it has. Then, those **necrotic withering** points are lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Thrashing Desperation
warscroll_ability.lore: Only the bravest and most determined of charges can get within striking range of the veritable wall of thrashing blades that are the Bladegheist Revenants.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit contests an objective you control, enemy units cannot finish a charge move within ½" of a model in this unit unless the unmodified charge roll was 7 or more.

warscroll_ability.name: The Light of Sigmar
warscroll_ability.lore: With its shutters closed, the lantern of a Knight-Azyros soothes nearby allies. Opening it wide blinds the enemy with the full majesty of Sigmar’s light.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• **Heal (D3)** each friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Decisive Commander
warscroll_ability.lore: In the face of the oncoming enemy, Freeguild Marshals employ rousing oratory to inspire their soldiers to stand strong in the name of Sigmar.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Freeguild Steelhelms** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect:
On a 2+, pick 1:

***On Your Feet!***: If the target unit is not in combat, you can return D3 slain models to it.

***Yield No Quarter!***: Add 3 to the target unit’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Corrupt The Realms
warscroll_ability.lore: These diabolical constructs use harnessed daemonic power to corrupt the geomantic energy of the Mortal Realms.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature has 9 or more **power points**, pick an objective or terrain feature within 24" of this terrain feature to be the source. Then, pick any number of enemy units within 3" of the source to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove 9 **power points** from this terrain feature, then roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Purulent Profusion
warscroll_ability.lore: With a wave of his staff, Shaman Foulhoof causes an enemy’s flesh to blister and curdle, ejecting vast quantities of sticky, foul-smelling pus.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Blinding Bolts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Starshard Ballista can be loaded with special bolts that explode with blinding light when they strike a target.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by all of this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Brass Stampede
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Nothing forged of mortal flesh and bone can prevent a charge from a unit of Bloodcrushers.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through models in the target unit and must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Icon of Grimnir
warscroll_ability.lore: The Battlesmith raises his icon of Grimnir, inspiring his allies so that they fight until the bitter end.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tectonic Splintering
warscroll_ability.lore: Hissing invocations of ruin and collapse, the Verminlord compels the earth to break and belch forth hostile warpgales, leaving their enemies staggering.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Bone-deep Savagery
warscroll_ability.lore: The impure materials used in the creation of the Teratic Cohort has lent them an innate savagery that is all but impossible to truly control in the heat of battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move 3". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Deliver on Fate
warscroll_ability.lore: When on the back foot, the Enlightened use the knowledge they have of their enemy’s past battles to predict their movements, taking great satisfaction in running their destined prey to ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit while you are the underdog.

warscroll_ability.name: Too Horrible To Die
warscroll_ability.lore: As it twitches in its shuddering death throes, there is a chance that either the Abomination’s unholy metabolism will restart one of its many foul hearts or its carcass will disgorge the revolting tide of parasitic rats that had been gnawing upon its innards.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 - *Dead***
This unit is destroyed.

**2-4 - *The Rats Emerge***
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Then, this unit is destroyed.

**5-6 - *It’s Alive!***
This unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ever Growing
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
warscroll_ability.lore: A wyldwood roused by the Sylvaneth will spread its roots deep, inundating its surroundings with life.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick the closest terrain feature to this terrain feature that does not have a friendly **overgrown token** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is not controlled by your opponent, give the target a friendly **overgrown token**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wandering Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: You can’t expect Gork to stand still when there’s fighting about.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a part of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part of this **MANIFESTATION**.

Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 3" of the target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• That unit has the **STOMPED** keyword until the start of your next turn.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for **STOMPED** units, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Plague Censer** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Evocation of Death
warscroll_ability.lore: The dormant occupant feeds upon the energies of death and uses them to bring spectral champions back from the underworlds.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit's combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE NIGHTHAUNT HERO** that has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 12" of this unit. The replacement unit can only be set up in combat with enemy units that are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Reinforcements
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The slann summons Seraphon warriors to the battlefield to bolster their forces and ensure the Great Plan is made manifest.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERAPHON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Down to the Ironguts
warscroll_ability.lore: It is not often that a mawtribe’s battleline falters, but if it does, the Tyrant will call upon their Ironguts to turn the battle back in their favour.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to this unit’s control score.

warscroll_ability.name: Linebreakers
warscroll_ability.lore: The thick hides of Mournfangs protect them from incoming missile fire as they charge headlong into the enemy’s battleline.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Burst From The Shadows
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Verminlord Deceiver is shrouded in darkness and dread, leaping through the aether to strike at its foes in the blink of an eye.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 4+, you can pick a point on the battlefield within 13" of this unit and within 1" of any enemy units. Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point.

**Designer’s Note:** *This ability allows the unit to set up in combat with a new enemy unit.*

warscroll_ability.name: Brace for Impact
warscroll_ability.lore: Annihilators brace behind their mighty shields to hold off even the most ferocious charge.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. If any of the rolls are a 6, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Violent Offerings
warscroll_ability.lore: Esske will go to great lengths to please Syll, delicately prising magical trinkets from severed heads and limbs to gift to the source of his obsession.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Twilight's Allure
warscroll_ability.lore: Neferata cloaks her minions in perpetual gloom.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cursed Stele
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn {Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As these carven polyhedrons obliterate the foe, rendering their remains unusable, the ever-practical Ossiarchs have begun to use this ammunition to breach enemy fortifications instead.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• This unit's ranged weapons have **Anti-FACTION TERRAIN (+1 Rend).**
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit's ranged weapons for attacks that target faction terrain features.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul Energy of the First Host
warscroll_ability.lore: Astreia Solbright can enhance the soul energy of nearby Sacrosanct warriors, allowing them to perform extraordinary deeds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Explosive Payload
warscroll_ability.lore: Nothing is more satisfying to a Bombardier than seeing their doomrocket go off in the midst of a tightly packed swarm of enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Immortal Bulwark
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the immovable shieldwall of the Ossiarch legions, the Immortis Guard can stand fast against any foe, no matter how vicious or savage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Harrowing Shrieks
warscroll_ability.lore: The chilling cries of the Dreadscythe Harridans drive all hope from the hearts of their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Creed of the Askurga Renkai
warscroll_ability.lore: Faithful to the teachings of ancient masters long slain, Trueblades test themselves against the most powerful adversaries, feasting solely on monstrous blood to bolster their strength and speed.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **MONSTERS** that target this unit.

Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target enemy **MONSTERS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Rigged Odds
warscroll_ability.lore: Skumdrekk never takes a bet unless the outcome is heavily swayed his way.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The first time you fail a dirty trick roll each turn, give this unit 1 **betting chip**.

Each time you make a dirty trick roll for an ability that targets a unit wholly within 12" of this unit, you can spend any number of **betting chips** after seeing the result of the roll. For each **betting chip** you spend, add 1 to that dirty trick roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect:
When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** moves, both its parts must end within 8" of each other. Each part of this **MANIFESTATION** is armed with a **Stream of Molten Blood**.

warscroll_ability.name: No Rest for the Wicked
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Should the spectral forms of her minions be banished, Lady Olynder will wrench their souls back from the underworlds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units on the battlefield to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each target, you can return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3+3.

warscroll_ability.name: Ride The Winds Aetheric
warscroll_ability.lore: Gryph-chargers can move faster than the eye can follow along the winds aetheric.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, you can pick up to 2 friendly **VANGUARD-PALLADORS** units that are not in combat to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit and the targets (if any) from the battlefield. Set this unit up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Brawlerguts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You delcared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Combining brutish strength with devastating bulk, the Tyrant leads other ogors into combat like the crown of an avalanche.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpfire Braziers** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Zarshia Bittersoul
warscroll_ability.lore: Zarshia mastery over sorcery fuels her dark ambitions.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Zarshia Bittersoul** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Forest Fighters
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors fight in loosely scattered formations, the better to navigate the dense terrain of their arboreal domains.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Speed Of An Avalanche
warscroll_ability.lore: Despite their formidable size, Dragon Ogors can move as swift as an avalanche, often surprising enemies who foolishly charge them.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Equal Prodigies
warscroll_ability.lore: On the battlefield, one twin will take the lead to aid their allies while the other stands guard.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick whether Ellania will take the lead or Ellathor will take the lead.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If Ellania takes the lead, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to this unit’s power level and it has **WARD (4+)**.

If Ellathor takes the lead, until the start of your next turn, add the current battle round number to the Damage characteristic of **Altairi**.

warscroll_ability.name: Hail Kurdoss! King of Nothing!
warscroll_ability.lore: Forever bitter at their liege for being dragged into eternal torment alongside him, the Craventhrone Guard will attempt to deny Valentian even the minuscule solace he derives from crushing foes with his mace.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick a friendly **Craventhrone Guard** unit that is not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase, but all of its attacks must target an enemy unit in combat with this unit. The target cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Off With Their Head!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: A Royal Decapitator’s axe hungers to cleave through necks in one fell swing.
warscroll_ability.effect: Immediately after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood Sacrifice
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Slaughterpriest knows better than any that Khorne cares not from where the blood flows…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) within this unit's combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit gains 1 ritual point.

warscroll_ability.name: Hatred of Sorcery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: No spell may spark before Khorne's altar.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature has an **Invoker,** pick up to D3 enemy **ENDLESS SPELLS** within 18" of this terrain feature to be the targets(s) and make a **banishment roll** of 2D6 for each target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Resolve the effect of the 'Banish Manifestation' ability for each target. If any **ENDLESS SPELLS** are banished by this ability, you gain 1 **blood tithe** point.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood of Molten Varanite
warscroll_ability.lore: Any who wound the Thanatorg risk being splashed by its highly mutative blood.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stegadon's Horns and Jaws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: The Death Frenzy
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is the force of Vizzik's screeching oratory that the verminous hordes froth and spasm under his influence as mere mortals unravel to visions of their inevitable doom.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13"of this unit or a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

If the target is a friendly unit, it can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Champion of Sigmar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Forged by Sigmar’s own hand, Yndrasta is protected by a divine aura so potent that swords and arrows simply rebound off her.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Big Name
warscroll_ability.lore: Tyrants are fond of assuming crudely grandiose titles that speak of their monstrous deeds.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick an effect that has already been picked for another friendly **Tyrant**.

• ***Neck-wringer***: Enemy **INFANTRY** units that have a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

• ***Steed-eater***: Enemy **CAVALRY** units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

• ***Giant-wrestler***: Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Blackpowder Squire
warscroll_ability.lore: When ammunition runs low, Blackpowder Squires bring fresh supplies to the line and relay orders.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has a **Blackpowder Squire** token, this unit's ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat.**

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Coil
warscroll_ability.lore: Once the tendril has its victim, it begins to squeeze with bone-splintering strength.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN MANIFESTATIONS** that target an **ensnared** enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Invocation of Nagash
warscroll_ability.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Duty Unto Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Hearthguard Berzerkers are sworn to protect their lodge and its masters until their dying breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: While your general is wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and your general have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Breath of the Mire-drakes
warscroll_ability.lore: Belcha-bannas are typically built around the severed tongue of a mire-drake, creatures so vile that even after death, their remains belch forth clouds of soul-shrivelling gas.
warscroll_ability.declare: Roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 1, nothing happens. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit. On a 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Unrivalled Velocity
warscroll_ability.lore: Slickblade Seekers are obsessed with high-speed kills, tearing towards the foe with relentless haste.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Staying Useful
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hunter's companions are handy spotters and trackers.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While any of this unit's **Gnoblar** or **Frost Sabre** tokens are on the battlefield, this unit has **WARD(5+).**

Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, remove 1 of this unit's tokens from the battlefield.

If this unit's **Frost Sabre** token has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Frost Sabre's Fangs**

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Equilibrium
warscroll_ability.lore: The slann’s form seems to shimmer and fade as it draws links between their allies and the turnings of the stars.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to casting rolls made for other friendly **SERAPHON WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Glory-Seekers
warscroll_ability.lore: All of the warriors that make up an Arkanaut Company are eager to win recognition for daring deeds.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit that target a unit contesting an objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of the Bloodbound
warscroll_ability.lore: With bellowed commands and sworn vows of bloodshed, this mighty warlord commands their warriors to charge down the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for friendly **BLOODBOUND INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Diversionary Assault
warscroll_ability.lore: At a swift signal, be it a twitch of his tail, a deft claw-swipe or a hissed threat, Crixxit directs a group of his agents to launch a blistering diversionary attack to distract the guard of his intended target.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Gutter Runners** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Whirling Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: Doom-Flayers crash into the foe with hellish results, leaving a trail of gore in their wake.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Nerve-shredding Screeches
warscroll_ability.lore: Despite their small stature, the shrill cries of a Terrawing flock can cause disarray across the enemy line as orders are drowned out by the cacophony.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Crushing Pressure
warscroll_ability.lore: Mathaela subjects their foes to the devastating pressure of the deepest trenches, causing bones to shatter and metal to crumple like paper.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Phantasmal Discorporation
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Dreadblade Harrows are able to disappear in a spectral mist.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall of Blades
warscroll_ability.lore: When Auralan Wardens stand shoulder to shoulder, they present a bristling wall of pikes to the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if that enemy unit is **CAVALRY**. On a 3+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Mire Kelpies
warscroll_ability.lore: Drawn to the Nurglites’ abhorrent nature, Mire Kelpies wetly follow Pox-Wretches wherever they roam.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Mire Kelpies** are tokens. There are 6 **Mire Kelpies** for every 14 models in this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Code of Honour
warscroll_ability.lore: Delusions of chivalry and honourable combat swirling, the Ghoul King issues direct challenges to enemy champions.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-**UNIQUE FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES** for attacks that target an enemy **HERO**.

warscroll_ability.name: Biovoltaic Blast
warscroll_ability.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of energy when the time is right.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Spearhead of the Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Atop their mighty Carnosaur steeds, Oldbloods lead their saurian brethren into battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **SAURUS** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Roaring Warlord
warscroll_ability.lore: An ogor who values their life knows better than to slack under the gaze of a Tyrant.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift Attackers
warscroll_ability.lore: As they close in on the enemy at frightening speed, these skilled horsemen are nigh impossible to hit with missile fire.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Triumph or Perish, You Vermin!
warscroll_ability.lore: A War Despot will relentlessly tyrannise their underlings to extract every last drop of effort from them.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has any **daemonic power points**, friendly non‑**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units, excluding **War Despots**, with 0 **daemonic power points** count as having 1 **daemonic power point** while they are wholly within 9" of and visible to this unit.

Add 3" to the range of this ability while this unit has 2 **daemonic power points**. Add 6" to the range of this ability instead while this unit has 3 **daemonic power points**.

**Designer’s Note:** *If a friendly unit with 0 daemonic power points is affected by this ability and subsequently gains 1 or more daemonic power points, this ability would stop affecting that unit. Also, Urak Taar’s ‘Master of Daemonic Power’ ability has no effect on units affected by this ability.*

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Infernadine’s Leonine Jaws** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: The Staff of Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Monster Grapple
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gordrakk’s Maw-krusha, Bigteef, is strong and mean enough to wrestle even the most gigantic rivals into the dirt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s weapons. You must pick a **Companion** weapon if it has any. Halve the Attacks characteristic of that weapon (rounding up) for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Force of a Falling Star
warscroll_ability.lore: As Annihilators build up momentum, their charge carries the same force as the impact of their arrival.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
