warscroll_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Cavalry Overseer
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: In life, the Knight of Shrouds commanded legions of devoted soldiers. In death, they turn their military genius to the command of shrieking spirits and vengeful phantasms.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT CAVALRY** or **WAR MACHINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of Nurgle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Great Unclean calls upon Grandfather Nurgle to tear a rift in reality through which loathsome, foetid daemons can spill.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 6" of this unit or a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Alpha Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: A Doombull is a living, snorting siege engine, and their headlong charge can shatter entire enemy formations.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Call to Murder
warscroll_ability.lore: The Shrine of Dark Tribute is a locus of sorcerous energy for the Daughters of Khaine and a keystone of their bloody rituals.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick a blessing from the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability that is **active**. That blessing is no longer **active**. Then, pick a blessing that is not **active**. That blessing is now **active**.

**Designer’s Note:** *When you use this ability, you are not using the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability.*

warscroll_ability.name: Impaling Talons
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Lauka Vai thrusts her massive talons into her prey with lethal precision, inflicting horrendous wounds upon them.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Charging Volley
warscroll_ability.lore: Vanguard-Palladors unleash a deadly volley of missiles as they charge into their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase, but all of its attacks must target that enemy unit. In addition, unit's **Starstrike Javelins** have **Shoot in Combat** this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Glory-seeker
warscroll_ability.lore: To earn the favour of their patron, these formidable warriors ruthlessly hunt down enemy monsters and champions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target **HEROES** or **MONSTERS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bestial Leap
warscroll_ability.lore: Scyla is capable of great, bounding leaps that take him over the heads of lesser foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this phase, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6" as if it had **FLY** but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: The Blood Must Flow
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Rallied by bloody example, Khorne’s lesser daemons leap into combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Bloodletters** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit and that friendly **Bloodletters** unit.

warscroll_ability.name: More-more Doom!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a MOVE ability this turn
warscroll_ability.lore: An extra doomrocket warhead can be attached to the payload if the wielder dares.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of its **Doomrocket** to D3+3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pack Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: The unearthly howls of Flesh Hounds send these killers into a blood-mad frenzy that sees them rip up and bite their enemies like a pack of dogs.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH HOUNDS** unit or a friendly **Karanak,** this unit's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

warscroll_ability.name: Skeleton Legion
warscroll_ability.lore: As necromantic energies blanket the battlefield, long-dead warriors stagger to their feet once more, eye sockets aglow with killing light.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Balefire Braziers
warscroll_ability.lore: These cauldrons are filled with tormented, blazing soul-matter with which the Triaxes augment their ammunition.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit's **Balefire Braziers** are tokens. There are 2 **Balefire Braziers** for every 10 models in this unit. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Balefire Braziers** next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Runic Power
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Doomseeker gets closer to their fate, they call upon the power of their many ur-gold runes, ensuring either their victory or that they go down in a final blaze of glory.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit has 1 damage point. Add 2 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons instead while this unit has 2 or more damage points.

warscroll_ability.name: Keeper of Mortality
warscroll_ability.lore: A Mortalis Terminexus is a catalyst of deathly magic that invigorates surrounding Nighthaunt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for target for the rest of the turn.
• **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Draconic Onslaught
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To reclaim their old empire, the Draconith and their riders fight together as a single furious whole, savaging any who cross their path.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Plant the Icon
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Battlesmith slams the pommel of his icon into the earth, setting the urgold runes of nearby allies ablaze.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Terror
warscroll_ability.lore: This terrifying monstrosity strikes fear into the hearts of its foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Dead for Innumerable Ages
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord Kroak is no longer truly alive; his form is preserved only by his indomitable spirit. As a result, he is immune to all but the most devastating attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit must use this ability each turn while it is damaged. Roll 3D6 and add the number of damage points this unit has to the roll. On a 20+, this unit is destroyed. Otherwise, **Heal (18)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunt With Conviction
warscroll_ability.lore: With a righteous fervour, Hexbane’s Hunters track the profane and blasphemous creatures that threaten mortal kind.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **WIZARD** to be **hunted by the Order**. You must pick a **WIZARD HERO** if there is one in your opponent’s army.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to the damage inflicted by this unit’s attacks that target the unit picked to be **hunted by the Order**.

**Designer’s Note:** *You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.*

warscroll_ability.name: Nightmare's Miasma
warscroll_ability.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cleansing Fires
warscroll_ability.lore: Erupting forth from the Lord-Veritant’s brazier, a torrent of holy fire engulfs the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hatred of Heroes
warscroll_ability.lore: A Beastlord reserves their prodigious strength and fury for the greatest of the enemy’s champions, calling upon their followers to witness and join the butchery.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES**, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** units wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Power of Kragnos
warscroll_ability.lore: When the energy of the Waaagh! hangs thick in the air, the Belcha-banna channels the mighty power of Kragnos himself, emboldening the Kruleboyz around it and warding off harmful sorcery.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: The Flames of Hope
warscroll_ability.lore: The billowing flames borne by Iridan are instantly recognisable by all of Sigmar’s greatest warriors, even those who have lost nearly every part of themselves in his name.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/ or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Favour of Chaos
warscroll_ability.lore: The Shrinemaster invokes the Dark Pantheon to bless nearby followers with their favour.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply 1 of the following effects to the target for the rest of the turn:

• ***Undivided***: When the target uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
• ***Khorne***: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks.
• ***Tzeentch***: The target has **WARD (5+)**.
• ***Nurgle***: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
• ***Slaanesh***: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick up to 2 eligible units to be the targets instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Gobbled Up
warscroll_ability.lore: This especially bloated and gluttonous squig is known to devour enemies whole if it gets the chance.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Betentacled Maw** is 8.

warscroll_ability.name: Bloodthirsty Predators
warscroll_ability.lore: Allopexes are drawn towards the scent of freshly spilt blood.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Allopex’s Ferocious Bite** if it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or if it is within 6" of any enemy units that have had any models slain in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall of Meat
warscroll_ability.lore: Bulky and stubborn, Gluttons are remarkably hard to shift.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Feed on Flesh
warscroll_ability.lore: Having been appeased with sacrificial blood, this creature may bestow dark blessings upon its kin.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain within 12" of this unit, give this unit a **sacrifice point**, to a maximum of 6. If there are more than 1 friendly **Darkoath Wilderfiend** units within 12" of the slain model, only 1 of them can be given a **sacrifice point** for that slain model.

warscroll_ability.name: Wild Enthusiasm
warscroll_ability.lore: Between their own flagrant disregard for self-preservation and their hogs’ nigh uncontrollable rampages, Savage Boarboys often barrel right into and through even the most dangerous enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if it has not charged this turn. In addition, when you pick a target for that command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Thaumaturge Hunger
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The ogroid senses the coalescence of arcane motes and charges forth in search of this brewing power.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move 6". It can move into combat and must end that move closer to the caster. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Turned to Crystal
warscroll_ability.lore: The touch of an Ironscale can permanently transmute an enemy into a crystal statue.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 1" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Man-skewer Crossbows
warscroll_ability.lore: Boltboyz either unleash quick volleys at nearby foes or take careful aim at far-off targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, pick either the **Hasty Shot** or **Aimed Shot** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Man‑skewer Crossbows**.

warscroll_ability.name: Gather the Aether
warscroll_ability.lore: A Stormcoven can harness the aetheric energies from the ley lines that criss-cross the Mortal Realms, ready to be unleashed at a moment’s notice.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while it is contesting an objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Mutant Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: This unnatural abomination is invigorated by the raw power of Chaos.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Selfless Protectors
warscroll_ability.lore: The Saurus Guard stand as a living shield between the leaders of the Seraphon and their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **SLANN** units are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those **SLANN** units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Weapon Team
warscroll_ability.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit's combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

warscroll_ability.name: Keep 'Em In Line
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘All-out Attack’ command for a friendly KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY unit
warscroll_ability.lore: With a threatening glare and barked commands, the Killaboss keeps their boyz in formation.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of the unit using the ‘All-out Attack’ command, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by that unit for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Head of the Stampede
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At the forefront of a grunta stampede rides the Tuskboss, racing to be the first to the fray.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick up to 3 friendly **MAW‑GRUNTA** units wholly within 12" of this unit that charged this turn to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 momentum point to each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Heavy-scaled Skin
warscroll_ability.lore: The scales of the Warspawned are especially thick and craggy, easily capable of repelling an arrow or musket ball.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Warriors of the Woods
warscroll_ability.lore: The Tree-Revenants comprise the formal warrior class of the Sylvaneth. It is their duty to engage and hold the enemy’s battleline, and it is one they perform with exceptional ability. Once they have the foe’s measure, they become even more dangerous, overwhelming their opponents with their relentless martial skill.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Anticipated Strike
warscroll_ability.lore: When Auralan Wardens stand shoulder to shoulder, they present a bristling wall of pikes to the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, ignore the effect of the **Charge (+1 Damage)** ability for combat attacks made by enemy units that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Volley
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ungor Raiders are capable of unleashing devastating volleys of arrows from the safety of canopies and vantage points. By the time the foe knows where the attacks are coming from, the Raiders have already moved on.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in reserve **in ambush**, pick a non-**HERO** enemy unit within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, in your next movement phase, set up this unit on the battlefield using the ‘Beastherd Ambush’ ability. If it is not possible to do so, it is destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Serpent Staff
warscroll_ability.lore: Channelling cosmic power through their twin-headed staff, a Starpriest causes their allies’ weapons to drip with deadly venom.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SERAPHON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Personal Enforcers
warscroll_ability.lore: Ironguts are the bodyguards and cronies of the tribe’s toughest leaders.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY HEROES**, both this unit and those **HEROES** have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Displays of Might
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ironguts love any opportunity to remind everyone watching of just how violent they can be.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability even if another friendly unit has used it this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift As The Wind
warscroll_ability.lore: Singri’s horsemanship is unrivalled by any of the Darkoath. She weaves deftly across the battlefield, avoiding enemy fire and loosing deadly accurate shots with her bow in return..
warscroll_ability.effect: Only critical hits score successful hits for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Celennar’s Moonbright Talons** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: The Looncourt's Quest
warscroll_ability.lore: It only takes a word from Grinkrak to send these gitz out on some ill-advised quest.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory to be the **object of this unit’s quest**.

warscroll_ability.name: Dracoline Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: Predators by nature, Dracolines prefer to roam and hunt rather than be held back in defence, ferociously tearing into those marked as prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, it has **STRIKE-FIRST**.

warscroll_ability.name: Harbingers of Dark Omens
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who hear the cawing of these fell creatures experience terrifying visions of their own impending doom.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: 'Neh Neh Na-Neh Neh! Can't Catch Me!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With an infuriating taunt, the Rabble-Rowza riles up a lumbering beast, sending it into a blood-mad frenzy. A cunning trick, as long as the Rabble-Rowza isn’t close enough to get caught!
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **MONSTER** or **BEAST** unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn, but each time it uses a **MOVE** ability, it must end the move closer to this unit. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the first time the target ends a move within this unit’s combat range, inflict D6 mortal damage on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast-binding Webbing
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As enemy beasts attempt to close the distance with an Arachnarok, they become tangled in its webbing.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Grin of the Grandfather
warscroll_ability.lore: To look upon Pust’s ever-smiling visage is to glimpse the face of Nurgle – a sight that is hard to stomach.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• Subtract 1 from the target’s Control characteristic.

warscroll_ability.name: Quest to Slay the Monster
warscroll_ability.lore: Under the command of Duke Crakmarrow, these ghouls believe themselves to be noble knights charged with slaying a great beast that threatens their kingdom.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while this unit is in combat with any enemy **MONSTER** or **BEAST** units, it has **STRIKE-FIRST**. However, for the rest of the turn, while it is in combat with any enemy **MONSTER** or **BEAST** units, all of this unit’s combat attacks must target an enemy **MONSTER** or **BEAST** unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Echoes of the Watch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Beneath the sightless gaze of Halgrim, the long-dead garrison of Mournhold act with a disturbing semblance of the martial training they prided themselves on in life.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Deathrattle Skeletons** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: The Briar Queen
warscroll_ability.lore: The Briar Queen and her lieutenants once ruled the criminal underworld of Shadespire with a magical fist.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Briar Queen** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Armour-Bane Curse
warscroll_ability.lore: The Tretchlet mutters an arcane hex, transforming the enemy’s armour into a molten, dripping ruin.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Draw Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Constructed at confluences where magical ley lines converge, a Nexus Chaotica can draw power from the realms and into a floating crucible.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Give a number of **power points** to this terrain feature equal to the roll. This terrain feature can have a maximum of 12 **power points** at once.

warscroll_ability.name: Book of Profane Secrets
warscroll_ability.lore: Using this arcane tome, the Gaunt Summoner calls forth minions from their Silver Tower.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit **in a Silver Tower** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up the target on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Bounding Leaps
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Adapted to an environment of plunging chasms and sheer cliffs, Icefall Yhetees possess long limbs with corded strength that see them close the distance to their prey in a single mighty bound.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Descend The Altar
warscroll_ability.lore: Sometimes, the slaughter calls too loudly...
warscroll_ability.effect: If this terrain feature has an **Invoker** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Invoker** on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an **Invoker.**

warscroll_ability.name: Immortal Champion
warscroll_ability.lore: Those favoured enough to ascend to daemonhood are among the most deadly servants of the Ruinous Powers.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Chameleon Ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hunters of Huanchi emerge from hiding and pepper their enemies with projectiles.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in ambush**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Deluge of Nurgle
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotigus has an affinity with the plagued downpours that spill from Nurgle’s cauldron, and he is able to influence where the blighted rains fall.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy targets, then pick each friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit within 18" of this unit to be the friendly targets. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy target and **Heal (1)** each friendly target.

Then, until the start of your next turn, if an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while they are within 18" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Tricksy Footing
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who stagger into these eldritch quagmires must use all their strength simply to avoid being pulled under.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Momentum
warscroll_ability.lore: Once a Maw-grunta begins its charge, it can only stop by crashing into something, and it becomes ever more deadly as its speed increases.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **CHARGE** ability, it gains **1 momentum point**.

Each time it uses a **RUN** ability, it gains **2 momentum points**. It can have a maximum of **3 momentum points** at once.

Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks**. At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardians of the King
warscroll_ability.lore: The Barrow Guard stand alongside the liege lord to whom they are bound.
warscroll_ability.effect: While your general is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and your general have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: A Reputation For Cunning
warscroll_ability.lore: Krittok's laboriously crafted reputation for deviousness sees his thralls obey him without question.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can pick 2 different eligible units to use the 'Always Three Clawsteps Ahead' ability this phase instead of 1, but at least 1 of those units must have the **VERMINUS** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Minions of the Silver Tower
warscroll_ability.lore: The warped fortresses of the Gaunt Summoners are infested with their thrall hosts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target is set up in reserve **in a Silver Tower**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: In Dark Communion
warscroll_ability.lore: Those Khainites who worship under the shadow of this fell shrine can hear the heartbeat of their merciless deity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target is in **dark communion** until this terrain feature uses this ability again or until this terrain feature is removed from the battlefield, whichever comes first. While the target is in **dark communion**, you can re-roll 1 casting roll or 1 chanting roll for the target each turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Atavistic Tempest
warscroll_ability.lore: Wielding the power of Azyr alongside the lost magics of the Draconith empire, Krondys barrages the enemy with elemental storms.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target until the start of your next turn:

***Blinding Gales:*** Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.

***Meteor-hail:*** Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s weapons.

***Flash-freezing Blizzard:*** Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Stomping Marauders
warscroll_ability.lore: Ironguts love any opportunity to remind everyone watching of just how violent they can be.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to the this unit’s control score if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of Cavalry
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: A Liege‑Kavalos rides at the very tip of the cavalry spearhead, driving deep into the enemy’s vitals and smashing open a breach for their Deathriders to exploit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Kavalos Deathriders** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Slithering Serpents
warscroll_ability.lore: Creatures of the Coiling Ones, a tangle of venomous snakes accompanies the Splintered Fang into battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Serpents** are on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 1, remove this unit’s **Serpents** from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Riders of Ruin
warscroll_ability.lore: Blood Knights barge through lesser foes to strike at more worthy challengers.
warscroll_ability.effect: Models in this unit can pass across enemy **INFANTRY** models as if this unit had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Unrivalled Velocity
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Slickblade Seekers are obsessed with high-speed kills, tearing towards the foe with relentless haste.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Fjul's Retinue
warscroll_ability.lore: The bravest of warriors are hand-picked by Fjul-Grimnir to serve as his bodyguard in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Fjul-Grimnir** is on the battlefield, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Pit Master
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Myrmidons are given governance over the gladiatorial pits of the Varanspire, and all who have fought there willingly follow them into the fray.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Ogroid Theridons** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: End Given Form
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **MANIFESTATION** passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Fearless Leader
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Warden Kings are often first into the fray, with their oathsworn kin following closely in their wake swinging gromril hammers and settling grudges.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Vulcharc
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Some Kairic Acolytes train to see through the eyes of Vulcharcs, Tzeentch-touched avians that feed upon magic. These birds are often dispatched by their handlers to spy out a foe’s weaknesses, secrets that are duly shared with their fellow cultists to give them the advantage once battle is joined.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Kairic Acolytes** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Lurelight
warscroll_ability.lore: Isharann Soulrenders possess a mystical lure that is used to draw unto them the souls of slain opponents so that they can be captured. Should the Soulrender act quickly enough, the stolen essence can be repurposed to resurrect fallen Namarti mid-battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **NAMARTI** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Expendable Munitions
warscroll_ability.lore: Auto-Endrins are designed to be one-shot weapons, though they are so cheap and easy to manufacture that there are always more to throw at the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The following apply to this unit:

•  This unit has a maximum control score of ‘-’.
•  When this unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield, it does not count as being destroyed for the purposes of other rules (such as scoring battle tactics).
•  This unit cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-**CORE** abilities used by other friendly units unless the ability specifies **AUTO-ENDRIN**.
•  Ignore this unit for the purposes of friendly and enemy battle tactics.

warscroll_ability.name: Commanding View
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly Gutrippaz unit wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: From his position high above the battlefield, a Killaboss riding a Corpse-rippa Vulcha can keep a careful eye on the battle, guiding the movements of their ladz.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Chosen by the Stone
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Jade Obelisk loose a cursed arrow at a chosen foe, marking them out to the Idolarc as a potential sacrifice to the Speaker in the Stone that must be detained.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, place the **Idolarcs** of all other friendly **Jade Obelisk** units next to their respective units. Then, place this unit’s **Idolarc** next to the target.

While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit’s Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit’s Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.

warscroll_ability.name: Kixi-Taka the Diviner
warscroll_ability.lore: Though only a lowly priest in the complex rungs of the skink hierarchy, Kixi-Taka is looked upon with favour by his slann masters.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Kixi-Taka, the Diviner**, is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Weapon Team
warscroll_ability.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Ebon Claw
warscroll_ability.lore: By drawing their own blood with the Ebon Claw, the Arak Klor can shift their bodies and take on the forms of mighty predators.
warscroll_ability.effect: Allocate D3 damage points to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, add the number of damage points allocated to this unit by this ability this turn to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Toxic Stash
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Slittaboss’s swindling talents are used to secure choice poisons that can overwhelm even a stamping ogor.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Shock and Gore
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The impact and ferocity of a Maulbeast Cavalry charge inevitably leave any survivors staggered and shaken.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Decimating Blow
warscroll_ability.lore: A single swing of a thunderaxe can carve through several foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Decimator Thunderaxes** if the target unit has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Polluting Aura
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Pust corrupts the land, the air is thick with disease – inimical to enemies but life-giving to the Maggotkin.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit is wholly within 6" of a **POLLUTED** terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, add 1 to the number of damage points healed.

While an enemy unit is within 6" of a **POLLUTED** terrain feature, each time that unit uses or is the target of an ability that would heal 1 or more damage points, subtract 1 from the number of damage points healed, to a minimum of 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Blighted Stampede
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: At a signal from his brothers, the usually ponderous Ghurk launches into an earthshaking counter-charge. Nearby Maggotkin are quick to take advantage of the enemy’s shock at his sudden turn of speed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick up to 2 friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. After the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit charged, each of the targets can immediately use the ‘Counter‑charge’ command in an order of your choosing without any command points being spent.

warscroll_ability.name: Phantasmal Discorporation
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Dreadblade Harrows are able to disappear in a spectral mist.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Dawnrider Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The Dawnriders speed across the battlefield like the rays of Hysh spilling over the horizon, their sunmetal weapons empowered by the swiftness of their onset.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Dawnrider Lances and Blades** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Boss Snarlfang
warscroll_ability.lore: Like their riders, Snarlfangs follow the lead of the strongest and meanest of their number. When their Alpha scents prey, the grots can do little to restrain their loping chase.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **GITMOB CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Strength from Spite
warscroll_ability.lore: Having absorbed the dark and bitter energies permeating the cursed earth of the Hamadrithil, Drycha’s talons easily shred defences both mundane and magical.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this unit’s attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Summon Daemons of Tzeentch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To challenge the fractal plans of the Architect of Fate is to face strange daemons born from chaotic sorcery itself.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non‑**HERO DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Barge Through
warscroll_ability.lore: Infantry who do not have the common sense to move out of the way of an armoured grunta ridden by an Ironjaw orruk are easily barrelled aside by these hefty cavalry.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end the move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

warscroll_ability.name: Glorious Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Ever keen to earn the favour of their tribe, when the eyes of the fiercest fighters are upon them, these warriors will not go down without a fight.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking model, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Let's Get Bouncin'!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: As their Giant Cave Squig leaps and bounds towards the enemy lines, the Loonboss signals the command for other squig-riders to join the fight and get stabbin’!
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MOONCLAN CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Scare Taktikz
warscroll_ability.lore: Gutrippaz use all manner of means to unnerve and intimidate their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit this phase. This ability has no effect on attacks made by **HEROES**.

warscroll_ability.name: Lingering Burns
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Wyrdflame clings to the enemy, near impossible to quench as it agonisingly devours their bodies and souls.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick any number of **BURNING** enemy units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 1, the target no longer has the **BURNING** keyword. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: On Da March
warscroll_ability.lore: The drummer that rides with a snatcha-krew beats out a powerful rhythm upon his kettle drum that inspires the Kruleboyz around them to race headlong toward the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Skarbrand's Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: Skarbrand’s infamous fury cannot be quenched. Attacking him only serves to stoke his anger.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, or if it did not use a **FIGHT** ability last turn, the effects of the 'Blood-drenched' ability apply to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Drag 'Em Out
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Killaboss picks the toughest-looking git and has their Gnashtoof drag them away from their allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. Then, if possible, your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cyreni of the Abyss
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Tidecaster, Cyreni can draw upon the swirling currents of the ethersea in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Cyreni of the Abyss** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Beast Will Out
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: In his hulking bestial form, Radukar is a frenzied abomination concerned only with tearing apart everything in his path.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move into combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Lord of Tides
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At the High King’s command, his warriors will attack with unrelenting fury.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Fleet and Fell
warscroll_ability.lore: Borne swiftly upon huge, tattered wings, Fell Bats are able to swoop down upon and break away from their prey with impunity, their frenzied flapping making it difficult to pin them down.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Nexus of Death Energy
warscroll_ability.lore: Mortis Engines are constructed around the remains of a slain Necromancer, who acts as a locus for the magics of the underworlds.
warscroll_ability.effect: When a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is picked to be the target of the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability, add D3 to the number of damage points that can be healed or the combined Health characteristic of models that can be returned.

warscroll_ability.name: Blackpowder's Buccaneers
warscroll_ability.lore: Gorlok’s minions scurry between his legs or over his broad shoulders, scampering out to maim or loot the ogor’s foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Peggz**, **Kagey**, **Mange** and **Shreek** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its tokens next to it.

warscroll_ability.name: Bolt From the Blue
warscroll_ability.lore: The skies darken above the Brethren of the Bolt, crackling with holy power that rains down upon them and their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: You can pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn. If a target was picked, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Storm Wave
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Lord-Arcanum channels thunderous Azyrite force through allied cavalry just as they impact with the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER CAVALRY** unit that charged this phase and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Elite Bodyguard
warscroll_ability.lore: Every ratman of rank knows the value and prestige of Stormvermin bodyguard – they are even almost loyal…
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** while they are within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Banner of the Reforged
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Banner of Apotheosis is planted, its energies heal flesh and restore armour.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target. In addition, add 3 to that unit’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Tribal Warleader
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: With strength and fierce purpose, the rulers of the Darkoath tribes lead those sworn to their banners into the fray to fulfil their oaths.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DARKOATH INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
warscroll_ability.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is channelled by Ishlaen Guard into a crackling luminescent energy field that protects them from harm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The End of Empires
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Spinning Loons
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Though they swing bizarre fungi rather than iron wrecking balls, Sporeplattas are still given a wide berth by those around them as they wildy spin amidst the melee.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was not set up this phase, this unit can move 2D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can finish that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Groundshaker
warscroll_ability.lore: The earth quakes as the Treelord stamps down hard, shaking the enemy’s wits.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Nimbus of Power
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Dark magic lends the vehicle blurring speed that allows it to disappear, only to reappear in a more advantageous position.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood for the Blood God!
warscroll_ability.lore: A howling mass of Bloodreavers is never more dangerous than when seized by the frenzy of the charge.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Skewering Bolts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When sighting a particularly large target, the crew load vicious skewering bolts that can tear through even the mightiest of beasts.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Beast-skewer Bolts** is 6 if the target is a **MONSTER**.

warscroll_ability.name: Yondara's Guidance
warscroll_ability.lore: Guided by the wisdom of her forebear, Tylis is determined to finally achieve something glorious after a career of ignoble bloodshed.
warscroll_ability.effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (5)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: 'Fight, You Scum!"
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: A Despot demands a tireless, pitiless aggression from their underlings.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Brutish Rampage
warscroll_ability.lore: A charging Karkadrak is an almost unstoppable force, capable of smashing straight through even the most determined shieldwall.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick up to 3 enemy units within 1" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Voidstorm Scroll
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Each Knight-Incantor bears a scroll infused with potent void magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: The spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Detonate
warscroll_ability.lore: Many Gutter Runners are experts in the use of improvised explosives, deploying skittering Bomb Rats to rush the enemy and detonate amongst them in a burst of warpstone-fuelled fury.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed Pick each enemy unit that has a friendly **Bomb Rat** token to be a target
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within a target’s combat range On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll Then, remove the target’s **Bomb Rat**.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanhel's Danse Macabre
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The undead are filled with magical energy that causes them to jerk forwards and attack with tireless, unnatural speed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The End of Empires
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Cleaving Blow
warscroll_ability.lore: A single swing of a thunderaxe can carve through several foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Thunderaxes** if the target unit has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of the Murder God
warscroll_ability.lore: As the faithful look upon a Heart of Fury, they are imbued with Khaine’s undying rage, a wrath so all encompassing that not even pain can penetrate it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Champion of the Undivided
warscroll_ability.lore: Abraxia’s fell reputation inspires her followers to embark on murderous rampages to gain her attention – perhaps even her approval. Such success is rare, but the resulting carnage is unquestionable.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that does not have a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by the target while they are contesting an objective you do not control.

warscroll_ability.name: Starlight Mantle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At a command from its rider, the Tauralon spreads its wings to shed celestial motes that settle upon nearby Stormcasts, providing them with a lingering mantle of protective force.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick each visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit within its combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the targets have **WARD (5+)** and this unit has **STRIKE-LAST.**

warscroll_ability.name: No Slacking!
warscroll_ability.lore: The Icebrow Hunter that leads the Mantrappers gets his followers in line with a menacing snort.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice On a 3+, add the result to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Consume Endless Spell
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Cygor perceives mystic evocations as they are being formed, swallowing manifested spells as easily as the wizards that summoned them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an **ENDLESS SPELL** within 9" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Banishment characteristic:

• The target is banished.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: The End of Empires
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Zephyrspites
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: These symbiotic winged spites offer their hosts unparalleled manoeuvrability, allowing them to swiftly reposition after loosing a deadly volley.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, this unit can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Vengeful Waves
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When threatened, the Eidolon causes the ethersea to crash around it, overwhelming its enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Clarion of the Forest Prince
warscroll_ability.lore: Kelthannor’s war-horn blasts clear and loud as he controls the battle from afar.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**WAR MACHINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can move 3". It can move through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that it was in combat with at the start of that move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Let's Get Stabbin'!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Loonbosses rarely get stuck in without a big group of ladz around them to act as a distraction.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO MOONCLAN INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: The Scent of Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: These savage warriors roam ahead of the advancing army, seeking out the enemy so that they can be the first to draw blood.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Herding Squigs
warscroll_ability.lore: While they have a thankless and frankly dangerous job, Squig Herders do their best to keep their frenzied squigs together as a rough pack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each **Squig Herder** in this unit. For each 2+, you can return D3 slain **Cave Squigs** to this unit. For each 1, 1 **Squig Herder** in this unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Deathrider Wedge
warscroll_ability.lore: The Kavalos Deathriders plunge through the enemy ranks, slashing as they quickly disengage before a reeling enemy can mount a defence.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **Liege-Kavalos** within this unit's combat range to be the friendly target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. Inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the enemy target if you picked a friendly target. Then, this unit and the friendly target (if any) can move 10". They can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sludgeraker’s Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Sir Felgryn is Abroad!
warscroll_ability.lore: Felgryn’s roguish example and affinity with animals make him beloved of commonfolk and creature alike, each resisting all the more fiercely when he takes to the field.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **SERFS** units or any friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTER** or **BEAST** units.

warscroll_ability.name: Heralds of Righteousness
warscroll_ability.lore: Prosecutors speed across the battlefield in blurs of light.
warscroll_ability.effect: When you make a charge roll for this unit, roll 1 additional dice.

warscroll_ability.name: Stalwart Defenders
warscroll_ability.lore: Liberators fiercely guard the lands brought into Sigmar’s domain.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective wholly within friendly territory.

warscroll_ability.name: That's Ours, Ya Gitz!
warscroll_ability.lore: Kruleboyz are raiders by nature, and the Killabosses are expert at getting the boyz all worked up when they see territory or loot that they’d love to get their dirty hands on.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tempered By Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: Until the horns for battle are sounded, Skullgrinders are known to work on their craft ceaselessly, tempering the weapons of their fellow warriors so that they glow red-hot with the rage of Khorne.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **BLOODBOUND HERO** within 8" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Titanic Boulderclub
warscroll_ability.lore: A Warstomper will drive straight into the midst of the enemy, swinging their titanic boulderclub to smash foes in all directions.
warscroll_ability.effect: If all of the attacks made with this unit’s **Titanic Boulderclub** target the same enemy unit, for every 5 models in the target unit, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Drothmasters
warscroll_ability.lore: Vulkyn Flameseekers are skilled at dominating monstrous wild beasts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract D3 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s **COMPANION** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Magical Resistance
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: The realmstone-infused mushrooms that Dankhold Troggoths consume make them naturally resistant to the effects of magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Breaka-harness
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Breaka-boss enters combat, they yank their Mirebrute Troggoth’s harness savagely to get the beast good and angry!
warscroll_ability.effect:
Make a breaka-roll of D3.

•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on this unit equal to the breaka-roll.
•  Double the breaka-roll and add that value to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Mirebrute’s Clubs** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Sudden Translocation
warscroll_ability.lore: Should Ellathor use Altairi for too long, he will start to be overwhelmed by its arcane power and Ellania will be forced to transport him away from the battle, lest he be transformed into a creature of blazing fury.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit’s combat attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit. Then, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Voice of Nagash
warscroll_ability.lore: The sheer force of Vokmortian’s oratory fills even the boldest commanders with doubt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any **non-CORE** abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Whispers of Treachery
warscroll_ability.lore: The Changeling spreads thoughts of betrayal amongst the enemy, inciting a bitter spree of bloodshed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Rust-Maw
warscroll_ability.lore: Crunching down on a severed head that has been carefully sealed and cured in its own rusty helmet, the Butcher curses enemy weapons to rapidly corrode and snap.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Giant Boing!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Mangler Squigs use their momentum to spring up into the air, crashing into the enemy lines beyond.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 3D6" but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Discorporate
warscroll_ability.lore: This spectral overseer gives the order for their warriors to flicker between the realms of the living and dead.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Scything Blade
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see ‘The Pendulum Swings’). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this **MANIFESTATION** passed across during that move or that are within 1⁄2" of it to be the targets. Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Ordained Quest
warscroll_ability.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.

warscroll_ability.name: Hatred's Edge
warscroll_ability.lore: The supernatural blade scrapes along the ground, its razor edge cutting in half those too slow to get out of the way. It then rises in the air before smashing down with deadly force upon Khorne's enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit with a starting size greater than 1 that is in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Desecrating Blood Runes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Ritualist carves blasphemous runes into the earth with their gore-slickened dagger, bringing down a rain of gore that drives Khorne’s faithful into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, add I to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Plague Wind
warscroll_ability.lore: With a satisfied belch, the greater daemon unleashes a gust of putrid air that smothers the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Heavy Bomb Racks
warscroll_ability.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Power of Da Great Green God
warscroll_ability.lore: Channelling the raw energies of the Waaagh! with his ‘bashin’ tools’, Zoggrok can empower the weapons of orruks gathered around him.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a forgin’ roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is armed with **Grunta-tongs**. On a 4+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Warpstone Fumes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The belching, flesh-twisting smoke that clings to a Brood Terror obscures the clawpacks from view.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Sentenced to Eternal Torment
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
