warscroll_ability.lore: Once the true name of a judged enemy is recorded, their unending punishment is all but inescapable.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and the target has the **SENTENCED** keyword until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Purest Aetherquartz
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord Regents carry a reserve of fine aetherquartz that burns with the brilliance of Hysh.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks and subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderstruck
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When a lightning hammer finds its mark, enemies are paralysed by crackling energy and a flash of blinding light.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Death on Tattered Wings
warscroll_ability.lore: The Revenant Draconith circles above the arrayed armies, eye sockets aglow with unholy energy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **high above the battlefield**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemon Flies
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The whirling fly-storm that surrounds Bloab protects him from harm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Massive Impaling Talons** is 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Easy Meat
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Showing weakness to a Kruleboy, even for a moment, is a death sentence.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of the Host
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Each Lord-Celestant is a renowned and respected leader – their very presence steels the souls of those under their command who fight nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of other friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: First Rule of Grungsson
warscroll_ability.lore: When Brokk Grungsson leads his warriors into battle, he reminds them of his first and most significant commentary on the Code.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKYFARER** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Butcher's Cauldron
warscroll_ability.lore: The remains of enemies bubbling away in a pot is a powerful focus for gut-magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit’s Butcher’s Cauldron is **full**, roll a D3. On a 1, this unit’s Butcher’s Cauldron becomes **empty**. On a 2+, you can add 2 to the casting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Volatile Ground
warscroll_ability.lore: Crackling warp lightning skitters around the ruptured rocks that ring this tear in reality.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Wandering Minds
warscroll_ability.lore: The dark enchantments woven by Syll and the domineering aura of Esske cause mystical wards and mental defences to slip away like silk sliding from burnished silver.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE INFANTRY** unit and up to 1 visible friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON INFANTRY** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you picked a **SYBARITE** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **DAEMON** target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shriek of Terror
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The soul-rending shriek of a Terrorgheist is enough to stop a warrior’s heart.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gimme All Da Light
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Frazzlegit Shaman absorbs the ambient light around them, the surrounding area becomes dark and dank – perfect for the Gitmobs to hide in.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **GITMOB** units that are not **Frazzlegit Shamans on War-Wheelas** cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Stone Skeleton
warscroll_ability.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Ravagers of the Mortal Realms
warscroll_ability.lore: The profane acts of Khagra’s Ravagers are rewarded by the Dark Gods, who seek nothing more than the desecration of the Mortal Realms themselves.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Hail of Bolts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: After shooting, the area around a Judicator’s target is riddled with stray bolts and corpses, creating obstacles for the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **INFANTRY** unit that does not have **FLY** and that had any models slain this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Holy Blades of Bone
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Crypt Horrors wield huge, monstrous femurs – as well as other grisly relics – as if they were blessed weapons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is **CAVALRY**. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: The Staff of Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Vulcha’s Talons and Beak** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Boneshaper
warscroll_ability.lore: When osseous matter and the souls of the slain are in ample supply, the Boneshapers can restore raise entire formations of Mortek Guard mid-battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Cultivating the Garden of Nurgle
warscroll_ability.lore: Wherever Horticulous slimes around in the Mortal Realms, daemonic foliage pokes through the cracks in reality and swiftly takes root.
warscroll_ability.effect: If there is no more than 1 friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** on the battlefield, you can set up a **Feculent Gnarlmaw** wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Star-venom
warscroll_ability.lore: The blowdarts used by the Hunters of Huanchi are coated in deadly toxins.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Dartpipe** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spirit of the Wind
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Spirit of the Wind never remains in one place for long.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**. It cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnelian Greatspite’s Mandibles** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: The Bell Tolls
warscroll_ability.lore: With a swing and a clang, the bell doth peal; Skaven march and man-things squeal!
warscroll_ability.effect: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly **SKAVEN** unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pack Alpha
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord-Arcanum on Dracoline can urge their mount to issue a great roar to its loyal pack-mates, stoking their rage and ferocity to untold heights.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick this unit and up to 1 other visible friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER CAVALRY** unit within its combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Arrest Those Miscreants!
warscroll_ability.lore: Should an enemy break Ushoran’s laws, Gormayne is quick to condemn them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** while it is in combat with any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES** and any friendly **SERFS** or **KNIGHTS** units.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike on the Move
warscroll_ability.lore: Namarti Reavers are experts at running out from cover to unleash a hail of deadly arrows.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleashed Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: Brute Ragerz waste no time in venting their pent-up rage when they get within striking distance of the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Voice of Gork
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a WAAAGH! ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Gordrakk’s bellow carries the elemental force of his god; it inspires Ironjawz to surge toward the enemy, hacking, bludgeoning and stomping with furious abandon.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Monstrous Hunger
warscroll_ability.lore: The Ghoul King imposes their will upon the creatures of the court’s menagerie, awakening a glimmer of predatory hunger in long-dead senses.
warscroll_ability.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTERS** can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Glorious Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gorewarden launches into battle alongside their trusted knights.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Knights unit and has charged this turn, this unit has **WARD (5+)** and its **Gory Talons and Fangs** have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Ancient Warlord
warscroll_ability.lore: An Oldblood commands their saurian brethren with relentless focus and drive.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Lord of the Bonereaper Legions
warscroll_ability.lore: An Ossiarch force personally led by Katakros is said to be worth ten identical forces led by his generals.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that is in combat and has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Spend a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the target's Health characteristic. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend an additional **relentless discipline** point. The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target cannot use **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** abilities for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Retribution From On High
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Celestant-Prime descends from Azyr into the thickest fighting, Ghal Maraz glowing with power as it smites the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the Celestial Realm**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract the current battle round number from 10 to determine this unit’s strike zone. Set up this unit on the battlefield more than a number of inches equal to its strike zone from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Masterflame Rune
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Flamekeeper’s sacred symbol of office can harness the power within ur-gold runes of fallen warriors to bestow blessings of Grimnir upon their brethren.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any friendly units have been destroyed during the battle, pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of **FYRESLAYERS** units that have been destroyed during the battle, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Grimnir’s Grit:*** The target has **WARD (5+)**.

***Grimnir’s Resolve:*** Add 2 to charge rolls for the target.

***Grimnir’s Vengeance:*** Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardians of the Deep
warscroll_ability.lore: Shoals of small sea creatures infest this wreck, instinctively swarming out to shield Idoneth Deepkin that are nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Necrotic Blast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Soulreaper sends a surge of deathly energy across the battlefield that can see nearby foes wracked with soul deep agony.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: A Taste for the Arcane
warscroll_ability.lore: The flesh of shamans and other cunning folk is a prized delicacy to the Cleavers, and so they will lay into mystically attuned enemies with terrifying vigour.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** while it is in combat with an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood Boil
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting ritualistic words of wrath into the air, the Slaughterpriest turns the blood coursing through the veins of the enemy red-hot, burning them from the inside out.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 16" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the number after its **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Venomous Tail Strike
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The barbed tail of a Manticore secretes a paralysing toxin that can stun an enemy long enough for the Manticore to tear into them with impunity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rot-Blossom
warscroll_ability.lore: Nurgle’s mortal warriors revel in the decaying blossoms that fall from a Feculent Gnarlmaw.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **ROTBRINGERS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this terrain feature

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Seething Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: Clanrats overwhelm their enemies with their seemingly endless numbers – biting, stabbing and trampling their own fallen beneath their bloody claws.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Archmage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Teclis’s knowledge of magic is such that weaving spells and denying the efforts of enemy mystics comes to him as easily as breathing.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:

***Magical Supremacy:*** Instead of making a casting roll for the next **SPELL** ability used by this unit this turn, you can use a value of 12 for the roll that cannot be modified.

***Drain Power:*** Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 18" of this unit to be the target. Subtract 1 from the target’s power level, to a minimum of 0, until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Supremacy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: By the will of the gods, this warrior leads her barbarous horde into the lands of the enemy, allowing none to oppose them.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is wholly within enemy territory and charged this phase, for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DARKOATH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Sweeping Blows
warscroll_ability.lore: Lanmari can cut through weaker opponents as an Allopex cuts through a shoal of Scryfish, or they can be used to inflict grievous wounds on larger enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Lanmari** for attacks that target an enemy **MONSTER**.

warscroll_ability.name: Gore-grunta Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Even by the destructive standards of the Ironjawz, the carnage caused by a Gore-grunta charge is horrific to behold.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted (if any) if the target is **CAVALRY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnashing Teeth and Flailing Fists** is 8.

warscroll_ability.name: To Our Liege!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: There are many ghoulish legends of Crypt Flayers winging down to join their lieges upon the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Stuff 'Em In Me Bag
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gargants are known to grab hapless warriors and stuff them screaming into their bags ‘for later’…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Skink Coordination
warscroll_ability.lore: A Skink Chief mounted on a Stegadon is in the perfect position to direct the efforts of nearby skink warriors and warbeast handlers, amplifying their destructive power.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly non-**MONSTER SKINK** unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, no command points are spent.

warscroll_ability.name: Roar of Kragnos
warscroll_ability.lore: The massive horn carried by Hurrk da Howla emits a booming blast that leaves the Stab-ladz’ enemies disorientated.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Hurrk da Howla** is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul Reaper
warscroll_ability.lore: A Shyish Reaper is always on the hunt for souls, sweeping through its prey to cleave flesh and rip away the spirit, sending it screaming into the underworlds.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this **MANIFESTATION**'s **Almighty Reap** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Flamewood Stakes
warscroll_ability.lore: Carved from Aqshian flamewood, these stakes violently combust when they pierce the armour of their target.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 1 to the damage inflicted (if any) on the target if it has the **DEATH**, **DAEMON** or **WIZARD** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulreaper
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere presence of a Soulreaper will sap a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Sigil of Yngra
warscroll_ability.lore: The sanctum creates a protective shield around the Lumineth.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a friendly unit with a Health characteristic of 10 or less is wholly inside the ring formed by this **MANIFESTATION**:

•  That unit is not visible to enemy units that are not within its combat range.
•  Enemy abilities that would target that unit must target this **MANIFESTATION** instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Exquisite Agony
warscroll_ability.lore: The Wheels of Excruciation deliver death by a thousand exquisite cuts to those who get in their way.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Hungering Flames
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The alchemical Hashu-Zharr flames yearn to consume. The more obstinate the prey, the better.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit's **Hashu-Zharr Rockets** is 5 if the target is a **MONSTER** or a **WAR MACHINE**.

warscroll_ability.name: Consecrate the Land
warscroll_ability.lore: Bellowing Sigmarite hymns, the priest purges the taint of Chaos from the land and consecrates it in the name of the God-King.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective within 12" of this unit, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, friendly units have **WARD (5+)** while they are contesting that objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Akhelian Insights
warscroll_ability.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.
warscroll_ability.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **NAMARTI** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Nadirite Assault
warscroll_ability.lore: The weapons of the Ossiarch legions can siphon souls with a single cut, stealing the foe’s life force.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, this unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Greater Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: After centuries spent bathing in the focused healing energies of Ghyran, Trugg is almost impossible to kill, even by troggoth standards.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleash the Stab-grot!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Stab-grot isn’t just good for stabbin’ – they double up as an effective living shield when things get dicey.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

After resolving either effect, remove this unit’s **Stab-grot** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Sanguine Blur
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: By the time this vampire’s prey notices the crimson streak heading towards them, it is far too late.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**HERO** units and more than 3" from all enemy **HEROES**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bestial Onslaught
warscroll_ability.lore: With primal savagery, the Slaangor Fiendbloods take to the battlefield, ready to surround their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **waiting in ambush**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Infernal Empowerment
warscroll_ability.lore: Zuldrakka’s retinue are equipped with weapons of dark potency.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect(s) below that correspond with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has. These effects are cumulative.
**DPP - Effect**
1+  Add 1" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
2+  Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
3  Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Bone Cage
warscroll_ability.lore: Tasked with collecting and flensing the corpses of the recently slain, Gothizzar Harvesters carry their osseous bounty inside the cages on their backs.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit is either **full** or **empty.** It starts the battle **full.**

warscroll_ability.name: Overwhelming Fire
warscroll_ability.lore: Large enemy formations are decimated by the sheer volume of fire a Ratling Warpblaster unleashes upon them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: World Banner
warscroll_ability.lore: This mighty standard is replete with symbols of great importance to the Lumineth, filling them with profound resolve and a hope for a brighter future for all the realms.
warscroll_ability.effect: While a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit, it can use the ‘Rally’ command even if it is in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Bigteef’s Fists and Tail** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Nebulous Sea-fog
warscroll_ability.lore: A hazy mist coalesces into a thick, obscuring fog around Lorai.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly **THE BLACKTALONS** unit is wholly within 6" of this unit, if the unmodified hit roll for a shooting attack that targets that unit is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Temporal Manipulation
warscroll_ability.lore: Lords of Change can alter the very flow of time, calling minions to their side in the blink of an eye.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase, but it must end that move closer to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Flailing Tentacles
warscroll_ability.lore: Gutrot grabs his opponents with his melange of slimy tentacles, rendering them helpless as he swings his rusted axe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bestial Hunger
warscroll_ability.lore: Gorgers are so crazed that they will often charge without orders.
warscroll_ability.effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and there are any enemy units within 12" of it, this unit must use the ‘Charge’ ability, and if the charge roll would allow it to end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit, it must do so.

warscroll_ability.name: Manglers of Metal
warscroll_ability.lore: The weapons of the Zharrdron can be infernally empowered until they burn and blast clean through armour.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Alpha Cavalry
warscroll_ability.lore: Those Mournfangs that have risen to the top of the fighting pits have done so by repeatedly charging equally massive rivals head-on and coming out on top.
warscroll_ability.effect: The **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability has no effect on attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Babbling Wand
warscroll_ability.lore: This jabbering wand, said to be topped with the skull of the great prophet Kaloth, channels the voices of Skragrott’s imprisoned scryers through clacking teeth.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **MOONCLAN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, no command points are spent.

warscroll_ability.name: Go-Go, Hunt Them Down
warscroll_ability.lore: Crixxit dispatches his Gutter Runners to pounce on unsuspecting prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Gutter Runners** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Assault
warscroll_ability.lore: The presence of the enemy drives these crazed warriors into a terrible rage.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged in the same turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shining Example
warscroll_ability.lore: The inspiring words and deeds of the Vanari Lord Regent instil a determination in their warriors never to yield.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Devotion
warscroll_ability.lore: When fighting in the presence of their leaders, these warriors fight until the bitter end.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is within 8" of your general, you can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Commander Of Tyrants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Daemons of lesser rank are compelled to follow the orders of these bellowing greater daemons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another visible friendly non-**UNIQUE BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Mutilating Blades
warscroll_ability.lore: A Slaaneshi chariot inflicts carnage when it ploughs into the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Finder of Ways
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability or the ‘Steed of Tides’ ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Soulscryers are the Idoneth’s navigators, helping them divine hidden paths through the realmseas.
warscroll_ability.effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: All-Out Slaughter
warscroll_ability.lore: The Melusai Ironscale exhorts their warriors to commit acts of terrible bloodshed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Catalogue of Souls
warscroll_ability.lore: The Soul Wardens keep records of the souls that are harvested by the phalanxes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a **soul‑quota token**.

warscroll_ability.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: You control the target objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Avalanche of Flesh
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Hell Pit Abomination can rear up to its fullest height before crashing back to the ground, crushing foes beneath its sickening bulk.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: I'm Off!
warscroll_ability.lore: The orruk makes a quick exit.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shouty Boss.

warscroll_ability.name: Troglodon Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troglodons are able to mend injured flesh almost as soon as they are harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pulled to the Grave
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this **MANIFESTATION** passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Magmadroth’s Claws and Horns** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Magmic Tunnelling
warscroll_ability.lore: A Runesmiter standing upon stone can command the rock to allow them passage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and any number of other units in its regiment if none of those units have been deployed to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **underground**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Seething Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: Sweeping forward in a chittering mass, Clanrats overwhelm their enemies with their seemingly limitless numbers, biting, stabbing, screeching and trampling their own fallen beneath their bloody claws.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruin-blessed Conqueror
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Warqueen heeds the whispers of the gods, ravaging lands in their name and drawing their gaze onto her warrior hordes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective that this unit is contesting.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, friendly **DARKOATH** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are contesting that objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Runaway Coach
warscroll_ability.lore: This nightmare‑drawn carriage crushes any who attempt to withstand its momentum.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Trampled Underfoot
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Corpsemare Stampede charges across the battlefield, it tramples over anything that gets in its way.
warscroll_ability.declare:
This **MANIFESTATION** can use this ability even if it is in combat.

Pick a point on a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, make a stampede roll of 2D6. Add 1D6 to the roll for each battle round that this **MANIFESTATION** has been on the battlefield and has not been banished. For example, the stampede roll would be 2D6 in the turn in which it was summoned, 3D6 in your next turn, and so on.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This **MANIFESTATION** can move a distance up to the value of the stampede roll in a straight line directly towards the target. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end that move in combat unless it ends that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, this **MANIFESTATION** has charged.

Roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this **MANIFESTATION** passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

In addition, if this **MANIFESTATION** charged this turn, add the value of the stampede roll to the Attacks characteristic of this **MANIFESTATION**’s **Corpsemare Trample** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Roaring Rune-fire
warscroll_ability.lore: The leaping flames of a Runic Fyrewall act as a barrier that only creatures born of fire can pass.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 3 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bone Harvest
warscroll_ability.lore: As a Gothizzar Harvester fights, it works to amass a grisly stockpile of bones.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an enemy model in combat with this unit is slain, this unit gains 1 **bone-tithe point**. It can never have more than 6 **bone-tithe points**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Skritter
warscroll_ability.lore: Skritter carries shards of warpstone that can be consumed to lend the Plaguepack’s prayers more frothing urgency.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Skritter** is a token. If you make a chanting roll of 1 for this unit while its **Skritter** is on the battlefield, you can remove its **Skritter** from the battlefield and then re-roll that chanting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Focused Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: Lyrior channels his anger and the aetherquartz within his master-crafted panoply responds, imbuing him with the speed of Hysh.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 2 to the roll if this unit is in combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Reaped Like Corn
warscroll_ability.lore: The scythes wielded by these ghostly warriors can be swung in great sweeping arcs, cutting down whole enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that is within the combat ranges of 5 or more models in this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the target unit has 20 or more models, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 5+ instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Empower
warscroll_ability.lore: Evocators can draw magic from the sky itself, charging those around them with Azyr’s fulminating lightning and empowering weapons with thunderous energy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective you control, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Sniper-master
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: No enemy is safe from the warp-laced bullets of a Warlock Engineer and his underlings.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit and friendly **Warplock Jezzails** units wholly within 13" of this unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking the target for their shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Pestilential Beachhead
warscroll_ability.lore: To the creak of rotting timbers and the waft of rancid brine, the Slime Fleet makes land.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **aboard the Slime Fleet**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield, wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then set up every other friendly unit that is **aboard the Slime Fleet** on the battlefield wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 7" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Ordered Cohorts
warscroll_ability.lore: Devoted servants of the Old Ones, Saurus Warriors are as intractable in defence as they are relentless upon the attack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Prayer of the Witness
warscroll_ability.lore: Iridan serves as a beacon of light that guides the souls of those in the Ruination chambers, giving their actions purpose and calming the storm that churns within each of them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, each time a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved:

• **Heal (D3)** that unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (3)** that unit instead.
• That unit has **WARD (6+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Star-marked
warscroll_ability.lore: Those tracked by the Vanguard-Hunters can be sensed from great distances.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while a **HUNTED** enemy unit is on the battlefield. In addition, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks that target a **HUNTED** enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Whippermaw’s Claws** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Propa Wonky
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As nearby Ironjawz see the Wrekkaz wildly whirling through the enemy ranks heedless of danger, they are inspired to fight with similar reckless abandon.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Pull of the Nadir
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Savage Hordes
warscroll_ability.lore: Savage Orruks are the backbone of their warclan, going to battle in great mobs that become wild and intractable once the fighting gets going.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 10 to the control score of this unit while it is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Chitinous Legs** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Avatar of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Tunnel Skulkers
warscroll_ability.lore: A Warp-Grinder can be used to tunnel through reality, allowing the Skaven to strike from unexpected quarters.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly non-**MONSTER SKAVEN** unit if those units have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **in the tunnels below**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Repair Construct
warscroll_ability.lore: The Harvester uses a portion of its morbid crop to restore the forms of fellow Ossiarchs.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. Then, roll a dice for each **bone-tithe** **point** this unit has.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each 4+, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit. Then, reset this unit’s **bone-tithe points** to 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Whirlwind of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: With the light of Grimnir burning in their eyes, these impetuous warriors hurl themselves into the fray.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Deathly Barrage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The grisly ammunition of a Mortek Crawler can leave even the most stoic souls staggering.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Mortisan Ossifector**, and add 1 to the roll if any other friendly **Mortek Crawlers** picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Awful Refashioning
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The spirits locked within the Nexus of Grief are agonisingly transformed into cackling gheists, their dreadful wails a brief and bitter balm for nearby Nighthaunt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Nexus of Grief**, then pick up to 3 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be a target of this ability more than once per phase.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For each target:
• If the target is damaged, **Heal (D3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to D3.

warscroll_ability.name: Ride for Vengeance
warscroll_ability.lore: As Stormcast casualties increase and the battle seems poised upon a knife’s edge, an armoured wedge of Stormstrike Palladors crashes into the enemy lines. Driven by a desire to avenge their fallen brethren, these warriors and their avian mounts unleash the fury of the storm on the God-King’s foes.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units have been destroyed this battle:

• You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shoddy Wing-Like Gizmos
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a bit of frantic flapping and ‘leanin’ into da wind’, Doom Divers can attempt to correct their trajectory mid-flight, though doing so slows their momentum somewhat.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks this turn, but for each hit roll that is re-rolled, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Doom Diver** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gnoblar Minions
warscroll_ability.lore: Hrothgorn tolerates the constant bickering of his Gnoblar companions only for as long as they remain useful.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s **Trap Launcher** while this unit’s **Bushwakka**, **Quiv** or **Luggit** and **Thwack** are on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of those tokens from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Ghostly Howl
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: There is no describing the shrieking wail of the Banshee; it is so horrific that its sound alone can pierce the soul of any who hear it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Marking Your Territory
warscroll_ability.lore: Rippa is out to make a name for himself, and what better way then grabbin’ a big pile of loot and keeping it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Wolfgit** **Weapons** while it contests an objective you control that is not contested by any other friendly units.

warscroll_ability.name: Hold the Shieldwall
warscroll_ability.lore: The Vindictor retinues form the unyielding shieldwalls upon which the forces of ruin shatter.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: With the Force of a Landslide
warscroll_ability.lore: The Alaithi rune imbues mountain spirits with increasing power.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Firestealer Hammers** for each instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

warscroll_ability.name: Conduits of Gut Magic
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gutseers’ faith and grisly acts of divination make them conduits of the gastromantic magic of the Butchers, who can channel their power through these disciples of the Maw.
warscroll_ability.effect: The next time the ‘Rust-maw’ ability is used by your general, measure the range and visibility of that ability from this unit instead of your general.

warscroll_ability.name: Vicious Spiteswarms
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a unit within 18" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Swarms of Flitterfuries and Squirmlings pour forth from the hives within Drycha’s towering barkflesh form.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Your opponent must pick 1 of the following:

***Avoid the Swarm:*** Subtract D3 from the charge roll. In addition, if your opponent re-rolls that charge roll, subtract D3 from that roll.

***Charge Through the Swarm:*** Subtract 1 from hit rolls for that unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn, and add 1 to hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Invocation of Nagash
warscroll_ability.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Plague Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: Plague rats carry shards of warpstone that can be consumed to lend the Plaguepack’s prayers more frothing urgency.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Plague rat** is a token. If you make a unmodified chanting roll of 1 for this unit while its **Plague rat** is on the battlefield, you can remove its **Plague rat** from the battlefield and then re-roll that chanting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Cracks Call
warscroll_ability.lore: Harnessing the thunderous peals of the Screaming Bell, the Grey Seer channels a sorcerous blast into the ground beneath the foe’s feet. Gaping chasms yawn wide, sending screaming victims vanishing into the depths.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and is within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the casting roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the casting roll and its Move characteristic.

warscroll_ability.name: Divine Matriarch
warscroll_ability.lore: Having ascended to godhood, Morathi-Khaine’s sorcerous power knows no bounds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** or **WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sweeping Blows** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Smoke Bombs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Clans Eshin use smoke bombs to cause confusion and disorientate the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s) Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Scry the Filth
warscroll_ability.lore: Globules of bloody mucus in Belga’s cauldron coalesce into misshapen masses that Belga uses to divine Nurgle’s will.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE WIZARDS** while they are within 3" of this unit.
• Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE PRIESTS** while they are within 3" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Seething Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: Clanrats overwhelm their enemies with their seemingly endless numbers – biting, stabbing and trampling their own fallen beneath their bloody claws.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Oracular Visions
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A sorcerer can temporarily bestow the gift of foresight upon their allies, helping them ward against enemy blows.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: In For The Kill
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With their target in sight, the Assassin bursts from the shadows and unleashes a flurry of attacks upon the unsuspecting victim.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Soulpiercer** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Raider Captain
warscroll_ability.lore: Thrallmasters are often among the first of the Idoneth’s forces to arrive on the battlefield, leading Namarti scouting parties to establish forward positions from which they can launch their raid.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 3 friendly **Namarti Thralls** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Mutative Aura
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who strike a Tzaangor Shaman are oft reduced to bubbling pools of twisted flesh.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 7+, until the start of your next turn, each time an unmodified hit roll for a combat attack made by the target is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Azyr Unleashed
warscroll_ability.lore: The impact of a Stormstrike Chariot on the charge can obliterate even the most durable of shieldwalls.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Shrieking Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: Wherever Iyva goes, a flight of screeching bats accompanies her.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunter's Endurance
warscroll_ability.lore: As the spirit-song intensifies and the magic of life surges across the battlefield, Kurnoth Hunters are gripped with a sacred fervour of the chase that sees them shrug off wounds.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Grizzled Buccaneers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Arkanauts learn to fight with cutlass and pistol, combining the two to fearsome effect.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
•  This unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
•  For the rest of the phase, this unit’s **Privateer Heavy Weapons** have **Shoot in Combat**.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Predator
warscroll_ability.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this **MANIFESTATION**, to a maximum of 3", while it is within 18" of any enemy **MANIFESTATIONS**, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within ½" of an enemy **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Call to the Hunt
warscroll_ability.lore: With an exultant howl, Radukar leads the charge, his surge of bloodlust filling nearby undead minions with unholy impetus.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Otapatl's Dartpipe
warscroll_ability.lore: The Starblood Stalkers are bolstered by the Chameleon Skink Otapatl, who lurks unseen and fires poisoned darts at unsuspecting foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Otapatl** is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Drawn to War
warscroll_ability.lore: When the champions of the Nighthaunt muster their processions for battle, Spirit Hosts flock to join their cause, serving as useful fodder for the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY HEROES** have **WARD (4+)** while they are wholly within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Mobile Repairs
warscroll_ability.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: The Court of the Lost
warscroll_ability.lore: The iron rings worn by Cado hold the spirits of souls from his past. In times of need, he summons their ethereal forms to aid him.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.

• This unit has a Move characteristic of 12".
• Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.
• This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bloodthirsty Dominance
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Vampire Lord and its monstrous mount single out worthy prey, tearing into them with relentless fury.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Rune of Enthlai
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **UNLIMITED SPELL** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Enlightener draws on the duality of this rune’s power to conjure sorceries with doubled potency.
warscroll_ability.effect: If that spell is successfully cast, roll a dice. On a 4+, after resolving the effect of that spell, this unit can immediately cast that spell a second time using the same casting roll. Do not count the second spell towards the number of **SPELL** abilities this unit can use this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Power Leech
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ephilim has the ability to drain magical power from their minions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. Allocate a number of damage points to this unit equal to the roll (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Watch Out!
warscroll_ability.lore: Mangler Squigs are capable of great destruction even in their wildly bouncing death throes
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each enemy unit within this unit’s combat range. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Agent
warscroll_ability.lore: Maleneth is master of stealth, concealing herself amongst allies and waiting for the perfect time to strike.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not been deployed, set up this unit in reserve **in hiding**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Attendants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The spectral attendants of the Black Coach bear potent artefacts, usually the possessions with which the occupant was interred. These can greatly empower the coach itself or imbue it with an aura of death magic that invigorates nearby Nighthaunt.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Noble Blade:*** This unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (Mortal)** instead of **Crit (Auto-wound)**.

***Unholy Grail:*** Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit. Each time that unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

***Tome of Undead Lore:*** This unit has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Strength
warscroll_ability.lore: When empowered with a surplus of daemonic energy, Dominator Engines are made faster and deadlier still.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For each **daemonic power point** this unit has:
•  Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Swordmaster
warscroll_ability.lore: The Light of Eltharion is a consummate warrior and one of the greatest swordmasters of all time.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks. In addition, ignore negative modifiers to the characteristics of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Iron-fisted Commander
warscroll_ability.lore: No Ardboy would dare quit the fight with the boss around.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **Ardboyz** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Storm of Shemtek
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Celestial Hurricanum can summon a magical storm to batter the foe with the fury of the heavens. As the battle rages, the tempest grows ever stronger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

warscroll_ability.name: 'I'll Get There Myself'
warscroll_ability.lore: Gotrek is renowned for his legendary stubbornness.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot be set up in reserve and cannot be targeted by abilities that would remove it from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Altar of the Horned Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: Throngs of rat-thralls swarm around this mighty construct in battle and will sell their lives to see it from harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Dance of Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sisters of Slaughter delight in frustrating foes with acts of incredible acrobatics and martial skill.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Puckish Misdirection
warscroll_ability.lore: The Changeling uses illusion and misdirection to mask the movements of its accomplices.
warscroll_ability.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units can use the ‘Redeploy’ command even if they were set up in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Red Ruin
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Tearing free of the press with talons and teeth, the Revenant Draconith leaves a trail of gory destruction behind as it takes to the skies once more, searching for fresh prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  **Heal (X)** this unit where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
•  This unit can be removed from the battlefield and set up in reserve **high above the battlefield**.

warscroll_ability.name: Careening Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Lurching uncontrollably across the battlefield at death-defying speed, Sunsteala Wheelas careen straight through their enemies leaving behind trails of devastation.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 1 enemy **INFANTRY** unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**Designer’s Note:** *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Absorption
warscroll_ability.lore: Ogroid Thaumaturges feast upon the eldritch power of those they slay.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:

• **Heal (7)** this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Terror
warscroll_ability.lore: This terrifying monstrosity strikes fear into the hearts of its foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 2 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Keeper of the Pandaemonium
warscroll_ability.lore: With a flick of their wrist, Ephilim can summon those daemons they have catalogued to their side in an instant.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Aetheric Destabilisation
warscroll_ability.lore: Expert summoners all, Knight-Incantors can detect and disable similar spells cast by their enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: While they are within 30" of this unit, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy units when they use **SUMMON** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadowy Killers
warscroll_ability.lore: Ulguan illusions and other tools of misdirection shroud Deathmasters in perpetual darkness, keeping them from harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Shield of the Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: Attacks are deflected by the Protectors’ weaving glaives.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Necrotic Vortex
warscroll_ability.effect:
Give this **MANIFESTATION** 1 maelstrom point each time:

• This **MANIFESTATION** is set up.
• A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
• A model is slain within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

This **MANIFESTATION** can have a maximum of **6 maelstrom points** at once

warscroll_ability.name: Destructive Bulk
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Maw-krusha is an unstoppable avalanche of ill-tempered muscle that turns all in its path into pulverised meat.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the D3 roll. If that enemy unit is **INFANTRY**, double the mortal damage inflicted.

warscroll_ability.name: Vengeful Forest Spirits
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The spirits within a Sylvaneth wyldwood are easily angered by trespassers into their domain.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit within 3" of this terrain feature to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Death's Descent
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Vargheists swoop down upon their victims from the sky, suddenly overwhelming them in a flurry of claws and fangs.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: On a Tear
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
