warscroll_ability.lore: The bellowing jeers of the boarboys and the squealing roars of their ferocious mounts as they pelt towards their targets makes for a bowel-shuddering sight.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnosaur’s Massive Jaws** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Under a Killing Moon
warscroll_ability.lore: Beneath the light of a blood moon, Volga’s wolves attack with mad-eyed ferocity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **Dire Wolves** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons (including **Companion** weapons).
• The targets can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: The Shield Inviolate
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Berserkers
warscroll_ability.lore: These Brutes forego heavy armour, which means they can get stuck in to the fighting as quickly as possible.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: From the Tainted Earth
warscroll_ability.lore: Where the lands have been utterly contaminated, there can the Cankerborn manifest at will.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 3" of:

• An objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **Pestilent Pollutant**, or

• A **POLLUTED** terrain feature (see Gelgus Pust’s warscroll), or
• An objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Blazing Impact
warscroll_ability.lore: Annihilators arrive upon the field with devastating force, twin tailed trails streaking behind them as an earth-shattering shock-wave blasts apart the foes of Sigmar.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Murder Incarnate
warscroll_ability.lore: When a grand ritual of murder approaches completion, a deep-red, pulsing glow begins to emanate from where the Avatar’s heart would be, and its wrath becomes incandescent as it crashes through the enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** is affected by the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability as if it were a unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Colossal Blight Weapons** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Cloud of Flies
warscroll_ability.lore: Plaguebearer tallybands are surrounded at all times by blinding swarms of daemon-flies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Roar of Total Rage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When Skarbrand roars, heads explode and blood boils in the veins of his victims.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll either 3 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of damage points this unit has. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Visions of Glory
warscroll_ability.lore: Godspeakers use their powers of divination to scry the future and see what glory awaits their kin.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit includes a **Godspeaker**, roll 8 dice. For each 4+, until the start of your next turn, you can reroll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 run roll or 1 save roll for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Frazzlegit's Flame Stream
warscroll_ability.lore: The rear of the Snarlboss’s ride is fitted with jars filled with loondust mixed with Hyshian energies. When uncorked and ignited by a torch-wielding snotling, they produce jetting flames that give the chariot a boost of speed and scorch enemies as it ploughs their ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 1 enemy **INFANTRY** unit that this unit passed across during that move to be the target. Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

**Designer’s Note:** *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*

warscroll_ability.name: Eternal Light
warscroll_ability.lore: Should he be vanquished, such is Eltharion’s mythical resolve that his spirit can re-manifest on the battlefield to fight once more alongside the Lumineth.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is destroyed and if a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** successfully casts a **SUMMON** spell, instead of resolving the effect of that **SUMMON** spell, you can set up a replacement unit for this unit more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of the unit that used that **SUMMON** spell. This ability is still in effect even if this unit is not on the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Overseers of the Enginecovens
warscroll_ability.lore: The Arch-Warlocks of the Clans Skryre command their enginecovens with a blend of deadly efficiency and overt sadism.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **SKRYRE** unit wholly within 13" of this unit uses the 'Covering Fire' command, no command points are spent.

warscroll_ability.name: Sneaky Little Devils
warscroll_ability.lore: Chaos Furies are spiteful creatures that utterly loathe the idea of engaging in a fair fight, much preferring – where possible – to stab distracted enemies in the back.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Emerge From The Deep
warscroll_ability.lore: The Kraken-eater emerges from the depths of the ocean in an explosion of ocean spray and bellowing anger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **beneath the waves**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge.

warscroll_ability.name: Tentacle Trap
warscroll_ability.lore: Ghurk wraps his boil-covered appendage around an unfortunate enemy hero.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn:

• The target cannot move and cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up elsewhere on the battlefield.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Virulent Concoctions
warscroll_ability.lore: The hideous diseases formulated by the Rotmire Creed rapidly transmit from one uninfected body to another.
warscroll_ability.effect: When picking an enemy unit to be the target of the ‘Infect’ effect of the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability, you can pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s shooting attacks this turn to be the target, even if that unit is not within 7" of any friendly **MAGGOTKIN** **OF NURGLE** units. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Khornate Hound
warscroll_ability.lore: Kannat is a savage, corrupt beast.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Kannat** is a token. Each time you declare a **FIGHT** ability for this unit while its **Kannat** is on the battlefield, as a reaction, you can remove its **Kannat** from the battlefield and then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Bloodied Weapons** for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Inescapable Mockery
warscroll_ability.lore: There is no respite from the unrelenting harassment afforded to Kurdoss by his hated attendants. The only satisfaction that remains to this embittered conqueror is the spectacularly petty obliteration of any lesser enemies he finds himself face-to-mask with.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has a lower Control characteristic than this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Warding Lantern
warscroll_ability.lore: Filled with holy energies, a warding lantern either imbues nearby Stormcast Eternals with power or burns their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are contesting the target.
• Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy units while they are contesting the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Man Da Tower!
warscroll_ability.lore: Orruk bosses know they look dead impressive when lording it up from an idol of their god.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss:

• The Shouty Boss cannot use **Move** abilities.
•Instead of measuring range or visibility to and from the Shouty Boss, measure to and from this terrain feature instead.
•All attacks that would target the Shouty Boss target this terrain feature instead.
•If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shouty Boss. Then, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Shouty Boss. If it is not possible to set up the Shouty Boss, it is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Drive The Legions Forward
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Mounted atop a mighty Karkadrak, the Chaos Lord signals the charge.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-**HERO** non-**CAVALRY WARRIORS OF CHAOS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Toad Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere scent of a blot toad sends Ripperdactyls into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Ripperdactyl’s Tearing Jaws** while it is in combat with any units that have a **Blot Toad**.

warscroll_ability.name: Looncap Mushrooms
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Looncaps that sprout beneath the Bad Moon’s glare are harvested by Sneaky Snufflers and have an intoxicating effect on any grots that ingest them. Sometimes a particularly potent fungus is found – and that’s when the real carnage starts…
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **MOONCLAN** unit wholly within 12" of it and visible to it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the face of the Bad Moon is **Cacklin’** this turn. On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn. On a 6+, also add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Reigning Champion
warscroll_ability.lore: A trusted member of the court may sit the throne in the absence of their liege-lord, though they must abdicate immediately on their return.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Steward, pick a friendly **FLESH‐EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now the Steward (see ‘Steward of the Realm’).

warscroll_ability.name: Capricious Wyrdflame
warscroll_ability.lore: The lurid fires of change spread as though they were possessed of a malign, mischievous sentience.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit if the target unit has 5 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Omens of Decay
warscroll_ability.lore: Harbingers of Decay are diseased prophets, able to divine omens through grisly rites and observing the spread of sickness.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract twice the current battle round number from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, this ability affects all enemy units within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Obelisk of Tor Crania** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: One Stop, No Return
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Black Coach bears down upon its target at the appointed hour, flaming hoofprints burning the skies. Where it arrives, soul-numbing terror is brought with it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, they cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (hit rolls that would be critical hits score hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Hand of Dust
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: The Dreaded Thirteenth Spell
warscroll_ability.lore: The twisting power of the Great Horned Rat transforms men into rat-mutants that swiftly join the evil throng.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 13 dice. For each 5+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• You can return 1 slain model to a friendly **Clanrats** unit wholly within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood Ritual
warscroll_ability.lore: Communing with Morai-Heg, Krethusa scries events yet to pass in the spilt ichor of a recent victim.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Prophecy of Tyranny:*** Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target.

***Prophecy of Shelter:*** Other than the **COMPANION** ability, weapon abilities used by enemy units while they are in combat with the target have no effect.

***Prophecy of Retribution:*** Subtract 1 from ward rolls made for damage points inflicted by the target’s combat attacks.

If the chanting roll was 9+, all of the above effects apply.

warscroll_ability.name: Louder and Louder
warscroll_ability.lore: The maddening blast of this foul magic grows ever more deafening until all within a dozen leagues can hear it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Increase the range of this **MANIFESTATION**’s ‘Booming Cacophony’ ability by 6". This effect can be applied multiple times to this **MANIFESTATION** and is cumulative. If this **MANIFESTATION** is removed from play, this effect no longer applies.

warscroll_ability.name: Sigmar's Will
warscroll_ability.lore: As a vessel of the God-King’s celestial power, Pontifex Zenestra can scour the taint of corrupting magic from the earth around her.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6. If the roll is an unmodified 1, you can re-roll the dice.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects. Pick up to 2 different effects instead if the chanting roll was 10+:

***Hallowed Ground:*** Until the start of your next turn, enemy units using the ‘Normal Move’ ability cannot end that move within 5" of a friendly **CITIES** **OF SIGMAR HUMAN** unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.
***Fervent Prayers:*** Until the start of your next turn, each time a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN** model is slain by a combat attack while it is wholly within 12" of this unit and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved.
***Salvation:*** Pick 1 friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN** unit that is more than 12" from this unit and not in combat to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. That unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Winged Reconnoitrer
warscroll_ability.lore: The screeches of Felgryn’s twisted ‘falcon’ act as a beacon to other cannibal hunters.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Grype** is next to an enemy unit, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on that enemy unit by combat attacks made by this unit and friendly **SERFS** units.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Griffon’s Razor Claws and Deadly Beak** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Banishing Liturgy
warscroll_ability.lore: The solemn sacraments of a Cardinal and their faithful congregation can nullify the most hostile magics.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While you believe this **DELUSION**:

•  Add 2 to banishment rolls for friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units.
•  Friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units have **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrest From the Realms
warscroll_ability.lore: Zondara will tear what she needs from the bones of the realms itself, if necessary.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in a **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** army, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit, then roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect. You cannot pick the same terrain feature more than once per battle.

**1 *Cruel Hope*:** No effect.

**2-4 *Cursed Flesh*:** You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

**5-6 *Borrowed Power*:** Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit that does not have an artefact of power. You can pick an artefact of power from the Soulblight Gravelords faction rules that no other friendly **HERO** has and give it to that **HERO**.

warscroll_ability.name: Hallucinogenic Fungus Brews
warscroll_ability.lore: Gobbapalooza shamans drink hallucinogenic fungus brew before the battle begins, making them almost impervious to pain. However, as the battle progresses, the effects start to wear off.
warscroll_ability.effect: In the first battle round, this unit has **WARD (4+)**. In the second battle round, this unit has **WARD (5+)**. In the third and subsequent battle rounds, this unit has **WARD (6+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of Command
warscroll_ability.lore: Granted a fraction of Tzeentch’s authority, Changecasters anchor the battleline with their stern presence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Stormbolt Tempest
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a foe charge their position, Sacristan Engineers can loose a quick-fire volley at close range.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: You Messin'?
warscroll_ability.lore: Most beings with half an ounce of common sense swiftly wither under the furious gaze of an orruk Brute who has marked their territory.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy models with a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Skeleton Legion
warscroll_ability.lore: As necromantic energies blanket the battlefield, long-dead warriors stagger to their feet once more, eye sockets aglow with killing light.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each slain model from this unit, make a **legion roll** of D6. For each 6, return 1 slain model to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Chilling Horde
warscroll_ability.lore: Surging forward in a shrieking, wailing mass, Chainrasps are often the first wave of Nighthaunt to assail the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Chainrasps** units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can move 6" but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrack and Ruin
warscroll_ability.lore: Mortal Maggotkin who ride Rot Flies act as brutal linebreakers, using their sheer bulk to smash enemy formations asunder.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Under the Shadow of Black Wings
warscroll_ability.lore: Dreadlords send in the cavalry to weaken the enemy before swooping down to deliver the killing blow.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Screams of the Penitent
warscroll_ability.lore: The agony inflicted on the souls trapped in a Nexus of Grief is awful to bear witness to.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of this terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Ensnaring Webbing
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Arachnarok singles out a target, temporarily immobilising it with looping strands of sticky webbing.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Hurl Scry-orb
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Warpseer throws its scry-orb into the midst of the foe, where it explodes in a shattering cloud of madness and destruction.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Divine the Future’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Enhancement
warscroll_ability.lore: A Stormcast blessed to be borne upon a Dais Arcanum feels the celestial energies of Azyr course through them.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While the unit that was picked to be the target of the 'Summon Dais Arcanum' ability is on the platform of this **MANIFESTATION**:

• That unit has **WARD (5+)** and **FLY**.
• If that unit is a **WIZARD**, add 1 to that unit's power level.
• That unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities and remains on this **MANIFESTATION** each time it moves.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to and from that unit, measure to and from this **MANIFESTATION** instead.
• This **MANIFESTATION** cannot be picked to be the target of abilities other than **BANISH** abilities.
• If that unit is picked to make a pile-in move, move this **MANIFESTATION** instead.

If this **MANIFESTATION** is banished, before removing it from the battlefield, set up the unit on its platform on the battlefield within 3" of it. That unit can only be set up in combat with units it was already in combat with when this **MANIFESTATION** was banished. If it is not possible to set up that unit, it is destroyed.

If the unit on the platform is removed from the battlefield, immediately remove this **MANIFESTATION** from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Offering of Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: A Blood Throne is a sanctified altar of Khorne.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For the rest of the turn, add 1 to this unit's power level, to a maximum of 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Command the Fleet
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Brokk’s preferred strategy is to instruct his fleet before leading his Skyriggers on bold manoeuvres to vanquish the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKYVESSELS** wholly within 24" of this unit that are not in combat to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Great Cauldron
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Lashed to a Slaughtermaster is a great cauldron containing the remains of foes, which the ogor gobbles down in order to unleash gastromantic powers.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s cauldron is **filled with grisly remains**, pick a visible friendly **MAWSEEKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s cauldron is now **empty**. Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Bloodgruel***: The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
***Spinemarrow***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood Frenzy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Carnosaur that senses an injured predator will not hesitate to assert its dominance in combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat with any damaged enemy **MONSTERS**, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Cursed To Rise Once More
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Necrotic flames wreathe the shattered remains of an undead knight, compelling them to rejoin the battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return 1 slain model to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderous Roar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The sheer concussive force of an alpha Carnosaur’s bellow can temporarily stun its prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Hateful Hail
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Carnage unfolds in the wake of a Grizmalok salvo, suppressing even the most rampant aggression.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, that enemy unit is the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of enemy models in the target unit slain by attacks made by this unit this turn. If the result is 6+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: You control the target objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Horrific Opponent
warscroll_ability.lore: So terrifying are the Brothers Glott that enemy lines are sent into disarray at the very sight of them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Disposable Lackeys
warscroll_ability.lore: Herded before the duardin advance, hobgrots serve to blunt the foe’s killing edge.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: The Loonking's Entreaty
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘The Faces of the Bad Moon’ ability
warscroll_ability.lore: The captive seers and prophets of Skragrott’s asylum can sometimes predict when the Bad Moon will accelerate or slow in its erratic orbits of the Mortal Realms. Skragrott uses this information to convince his followers that the Bad Moon listens when he entreats it to halt or move to a specific location.
warscroll_ability.effect: The face of the Bad Moon stays in its current position this battle round instead of moving to the next face in the sequence.

warscroll_ability.name: Harbingers of Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Morghast Harbingers hurl themselves at the foe with unbridled ferocity.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Sevenfold Slaughter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord of Plagues drives their warriors to keep hacking at the foe until they are reduced to nothing more than twitching, filth-streaked offal.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Rotswords** unit that did not charge this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Ruined Master-crafted Weapons** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vessel of the Gulping God
warscroll_ability.lore: Swirling gastromantic fumes emanate from the Great Mawpot when it is full to the brim.
warscroll_ability.declare: If the **Great Mawpot** is **full**, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** within 3" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Fervour
warscroll_ability.lore: Witch Aelves hurl themselves at the enemy with no fear of death, cutting down foes in a whirlwind of blades.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Furious Retribution
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord‑Celestants lead their brethren in assaults upon the enemy lines, breaking the foe beneath their immortal fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Bloody Incitement
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hag Queen drives her followers into a violent rage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.

If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Sequitor Aetheric Channelling
warscroll_ability.lore: Sequitors can use their knowledge of the arcane arts to channel aetheric energy into their weapons or shields.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is contesting an objective you control, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit have no effect.
• This unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

warscroll_ability.name: More-more Warp Lightning!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Warlock Engineer can increase the power output of a Warp Lightning Cannon at the risk of harming the weapon and its crew.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **SKRYRE HERO**, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Warp Lightning Blast** for the rest of the turn.

However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit’s **Warp Lightning Blast**, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Deliver Judgement
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This warrior orders Sigmar’s wrath to be delivered unto their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Strength
warscroll_ability.lore: When empowered with a surplus of daemonic energy, Dominator Engines are made faster and deadlier still.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For each **daemonic power point** this unit has:

•  Add 1" to its Move characteristic.
•  Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Acid-fuelled Flame
warscroll_ability.lore: The fiery secretions belched up by the Spawn of Chotec melt armour and flesh long after they have hit their targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, you must pick either its **Glob of Flame Acid** or its **Stream of Fire** ranged weapon.

In addition, after resolving shooting attacks made with this unit’s **Glob of Flame Acid**, if any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by those attacks, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Primal Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: Though bestial, Darkoath Wilderfiends possess innate powers of sorcery.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Mind Shroud:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. If any of the rolls are a 5+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

***Warping Balefire:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

***Dark Might:*** **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of sacrifice points this unit has.

After applying the effect you picked, reset this unit’s **sacrifice points** to 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Heavy Sky Ordnance** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Sun Acolytes
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sun Acolytes that accompany a Spawn of Chotec carry out complex tasks upon the battlefield safe in the knowledge that the salamander serves as a deadly deterrent to would be attackers.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit has a crew of 3 **Sun Acolytes** that are tokens.

Add 1 to this unit’s control score for each **Sun Acolyte** it has. If this unit has no **Sun Acolytes**, it has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the battle.

Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Sun Acolytes** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Passage
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WIZARD** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The next time the target uses a non-**SUMMON** **SPELL** ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this **MANIFESTATION** instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this **MANIFESTATION** instead of to the caster for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Voice of Thunder
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord‑Commanders are among the few faithful who can commune with Sigmar in the heat of battle. Their words are like booming thunderclaps, each order ringing across the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command, no command points are spent.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ghurk’s Tentacle** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruinous Bombardment
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who survive the initial unmaking wave of raw Chaos energy laid down by a Tormentor Bombard are left addled and disoriented.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, that enemy unit is the target. Then, you can pick a number of enemy units within 6" of the target equal to the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has to be additional targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 3 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Always Take What You Are Owed
warscroll_ability.lore: Following the decrees of the Code, the Admiral directs their fleet in the pursuit of profit and glory.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Vengeful Terrors
warscroll_ability.lore: Wherever this rogue spirit drifts, creeping ominously through the air, its roots churn open the shallow graves of battles past, dragging grotesque remains to the surface that chill the hearts of the forest’s foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Tome
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: This arcane tome holds scriptures of ancient incantation that allows a brief mastery of the Herald’s chosen spell lores.
warscroll_ability.effect: Re-roll 1 of the dice in the casting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Aquatic Illusions
warscroll_ability.lore: Lorai conjures liquid figures out of the ethersea that mystify and confuse nearby enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Another Link in the Chain
warscroll_ability.lore: Chainghasts act as conduits for Spirit Torments, ensuring all nearby Nighthaunt are invigorated by deathly energies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Spirit Torments.** On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Mutilating Blades
warscroll_ability.lore: A Seeker Chariot inflicts carnage when it ploughs into the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Fortcrusha Flail** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: All Part of Da Plan
warscroll_ability.lore: Kruleboyz tend to be very impressed by a Killaboss’s kunnin’ feats – so long as the boss has a plan, they are willing to face down even the most unlikely odds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Squig Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: As Mangler Squigs are wounded in battle, they become even more irate and violent.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Squigs Gone Wild
warscroll_ability.lore: Squigs don’t always know when they’re dead…
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Parasitic Infestation
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who approach Pust risk being contaminated with the wriggling parasites that infest his swollen body.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Royal Companions
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Mounted Wight Lords fight accompanied by their most skilled cavaliers, tearing through enemy battlelines.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Book of Profane Secrets
warscroll_ability.lore: Using this arcane tome, the Gaunt Summoner calls forth minions from their Silver Tower.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit **in a Silver Tower** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up the target on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Frazzleburned Scrap
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: After the boss, Snarlpack Cavalry often get first dibs on loot, and they have an eye for the scrap and wotsits with the best light-absorbing properties. In battle, they have learned how to unleash these energies from their weapons at just the right moment, dazzling the enemy as their charge hits home.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it has has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Armour of the Night
warscroll_ability.lore: With a mere thought, Radukar the Beast summons wisps of pure darkness to form a penumbral shield around his body, protecting him from harm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Redemptor Casket
warscroll_ability.lore: Each redemption stave incorporates a casket for the containment of malicious spirits.
warscroll_ability.effect: Models cannot be returned to enemy units within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Heroic Guard
warscroll_ability.lore: Steelheart’s Champions stand impervious and unyielding in the face of the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is in combat with any enemy units that charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Leechlord's Curse
warscroll_ability.lore: The unfortunate victim finds themselves host to parasitic leeches that drain the vitality from their very soul.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit gains 1 **leech point** for the rest of the battle. Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **CORE** ability or command, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any damage points were allocated to the target by this ability, **Heal (1)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Wicked Wardens
warscroll_ability.lore: The Blood Hags take sadistic pride in keeping the war-shrines full to the brim with liquid gore that they violently drained from the veins of worthy enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Hag Queen on Cauldron of Blood**, **Slaughter Queen on Cauldron of Blood** or **Shrine of Dark Tribute**, this unit’s melee weapons have **Anti‑charge (+1 Rend)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hunters of Huanchi can blend in with their surroundings and vanish from sight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Aethershot Overwatch
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Woe betide those who charge a Grundstok gunline.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike the Gongs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Borne by straining hobgrots, these gongs are holy relics to the servants of Hashut.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gong Carrier** (if any) is a token. You can remove its **Gong Carrier** from the battlefield and return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrath of the Draconith
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At their champion's command, the Stormdrake Guard bring to bear the full power of their mounts when the foe least expects it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of both this unit’s and the target’s **Draconith’s Fangs and Talons** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Defenders of the Kingdom
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gorewarden and their sworn swords quickly repel any intrusion over the kingdom’s borders.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While you believe this **DELUSION** and this unit is on the battlefield, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO**. Add 2 to charge rolls instead if they were also set up in the same turn.

When using the ‘A Kingdom Deluded’ ability, you can pick this **DELUSION** even if this unit is **patrolling the borders**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **the Thanatorg’s Claws and Fangs** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Warherd Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: When a warherd charges, the enemy is sent flying through the air by the force of the impact.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. For each 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Eldest of Elders
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Treelord Ancient imparts its ancient wisdom through the spirit-song to the members of its circle, enlightening them on how best to deal with these particular enemies of the forest.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each friendly **FOREST ELDER** within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for that target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Nightmare's Miasma
warscroll_ability.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Riddled With Disease
warscroll_ability.lore: The vapours emanating from a Feculent Gnarlmaw are laden with plagues and disease that further empower the Garden’s denizens.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 1 additional rally roll of D6. If that unit is a non-**HERO** unit, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Azyr Unleashed
warscroll_ability.lore: The impact of a Stormstrike Chariot on the charge can obliterate even the most durable of shieldwalls.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Rage of Khorne
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Bloodsecrator slams his banner into the ground, flooding the battlefield with the violent energies of Khorne’s hellish domain.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of friendly **BLOODBOUND** units' melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulbound Shield
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: This shield can shelter the wielder against even the most potent magical attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Word of Pain
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sorceress utters a forbidden name, wracking her foes with unbearable pain.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Trampling Bones
warscroll_ability.lore: The knights who ride alongside a Wight Lord will be the most trusted and skilful of all their housecarls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Warpstone Shards
warscroll_ability.lore: Grey Seers consume potentially lethal shards of warpstone to enhance their spellcasting.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The next time you make a casting roll for this unit this phase, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6. This roll cannot be rerolled or modified.

If the casting roll is 13, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound. After the effect of that spell has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

If the casting roll is not 13, remove 1 dice of your choice from the casting roll and use the remaining 2D6 as the casting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Boneshaper
warscroll_ability.lore: The Boneshaper uses their arcane arts to form shattered bones into new Ossiarch constructs.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Mortek Guard** or **Mortek Triaxes** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Cursed Flames
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Mortek Triaxes set foes ablaze, the tortured flames seek out other souls, and the panic spreads...
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit's attacks targeted the same enemy unit and this unit has any **Balefire Braziers** next to it, place 1 of those **Balefire Braziers** next to that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Heroic Retribution
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Should the need arise, the Knight-Questor will call upon their Soulsworn brethren to make the God-King’s justice a reality.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Questor Soulsworn** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of the Brass Stampede
warscroll_ability.lore: Carnage erupts as the full force of a mounted Khornate warhorde collides with the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast-breaking Strike
warscroll_ability.lore: Beast‑smashers can shatter the ribcages and crack the skulls of even the most ferocious adversaries with a single mighty strike.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can make a pile-in move. Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 5D6 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: The Right Motivation
warscroll_ability.lore: A shrewd judge of character, Morga knows how to get the most from those she commands - even if the occasional threat is needed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply:

•  While the target has not had any damage points allocated to it this phase, each time the unmodified hit roll for a combat attack that targets it is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

•  If the target has had any damage points allocated to it this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Auxiliary Skyhook
warscroll_ability.lore: Drekki’s axe is custom-fitted with a small skyhook that can skewer beasties that stray too close.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Flesh-grafting
warscroll_ability.lore: These burly commanders are the breeders, mutators and healers of the Clans Moulder.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Killabeak’s Talons and Beak** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Guided by the Future
warscroll_ability.lore: The attacks of these warriors are directed by glimpses of the future.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampant Defilement
warscroll_ability.lore: Shaman Foulhoof’s mere presence sends his bestial flock into a frenzy of despoliation.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Pestigors** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Boing! Smash!
warscroll_ability.lore: Mobs of Boingrot Bounderz smash into their enemies like toothy meteors.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase,  pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns** **and Hooves** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Stone Skeleton
warscroll_ability.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Sweeping Blows
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: A Namarti Thrall’s aggressive swiping strikes are intended to knock their enemies off their feet.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Staff of Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Borgit's Masterplan
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Cunning and unscrupulous in equal measure, Borgit uses his minions as bait, luring enemy beasties out into the open whereupon he and Uglug can deliver the killing blow.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if any models in this unit have been slain.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
• This unit’s attacks must target an enemy **MONSTER** or **BEAST**.

warscroll_ability.name: Last of the Lodge-fire
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In desperate need, a Grimhold Exile can draw upon the embers of the Zharrkhul by striking their hammer-faces together, setting a powerful foe ablaze with the flames of Grimnir’s wrath.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnarlrod** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardians of the Scinari
warscroll_ability.lore: It is the duty of the Bladelords to safeguard the Lumineth’s spellcasters, allowing their charges to weave conjurations free from the distraction of physical combat.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **SCINARI HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Crashing Impact
warscroll_ability.lore: On the charge, Kurnoth Hunters use their great size and durability as a weapon, delivering powerful strikes driven by their momentum and trampling smaller foes underfoot.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is in combat with the target. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Pyroelectric Blast
warscroll_ability.lore: By combining the magic of Aqshy and Azyr, Aventis can channel a blast of power that can melt even solid stone.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target, then inflict 1 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Crest of Horns
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Stegadon prepares to face a charging enemy by turning its mighty head and bracing for impact, impaling the enemy and blunting their attacks with its thickly scaled crest.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to save rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Cthorak’s Ancient Claws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Switch Aspects
warscroll_ability.lore: Stalkers are imbued with a powerful skill by whichever of their skulls faces the foe, switching from defence to offence in the blink of an eye.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Blade-parry Aspect:*** Subtract l from hit rolls for combat attacks that target this unit.

***Destroyer Aspect:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this unit's combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Aetheric Augmentation
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: An Aether-Khemist can use their Anatomiser to augment the weapons of nearby skyfarers.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: I'm Watching You
warscroll_ability.lore: Squinting and scowling, the Codewright watches with hawkish scrutiny for any breaches of the Code.
warscroll_ability.effect: Give this unit D3 **vexed points**.

warscroll_ability.name: Death Incarnate
warscroll_ability.lore: Even when destroyed, the nightmare predator reforms to continue tormenting its enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** was destroyed or banished this turn and the unit that summoned it is on the battlefield, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any enemy models were slain by this **MANIFESTATION'S** combat attacks this turn. On a 4+, set up this **MANIFESTATION** again, wholly within 12" of the unit that summoned it and more than 9" from all enemy units. That unit has summoned that **MANIFESTATION.**

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless as the Driving Current
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: An Ydrilan warrior keeps surging forwards, their movements fluid and bewilderingly fast as they embody the momentum of rushing water.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Stampede
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Stegadons are nigh unstoppable as they crash through the midst of battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can move 2D6". This unit can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of the Hungering One
warscroll_ability.lore: Redd claims to have seen the Gulping God, and his manic fervour suggests he does not lie – a fact that inspires awe in other ogors.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While they are wholly within 12" of this unit:

•  Friendly non-**MAWSEEKERS OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)**.

•  Friendly **MAWSEEKERS** units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bone-crushing Strikes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Larger beasts feel the full brunt of the Skullgrinder’s anvil as it crashes into their flank, shattering ribs and sending them sprawling.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gather the Aether
warscroll_ability.lore: A Stormcoven can harness the aetheric energies from the ley lines that criss-cross the Mortal Realms, ready to be unleashed at a moment’s notice.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while it is contesting an objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Herald of Redemption
warscroll_ability.lore: In Tornus, the troubled warriors of the Ruination chambers see a kindred spirit and heed his rallying call in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Alchemy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a chilling cackle, the Lord Vitriolic prepares a specifically abominable elixir to inflict on their unwilling victims, or they spitefully hurl whatever is to hand into the ranks of their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects or roll two dice and apply both corresponding effects in an order of your choosing, including duplicate effects:

**1 *Phantasmal Solvent:*** If the target has a Move characteristic of'-', inflict 6 mortal damage on the target.

**2 *Acidic Fug:*** Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

**3 *Fling Concoctions:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Hurled Vial this phase but all attacks made by this unit this phase must target that enemy unit.

**4 *Choking Vapours:*** If the target is a **WIZARD**, subtract 1 from its power level until the start of your next turn.

**5 *Fear-laced Hallucinogen:*** If the target is a **PRIEST**, remove D3 ritual points from it.

**6 *Unholy Prescription:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Strength From Victory
warscroll_ability.lore: The more fights a Megaboss wins, the stronger they become.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, give this unit a **Waaagh! token**, to a maximum of 3.

Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s weapons for each **Waaagh! token** it has.

warscroll_ability.name: Gorbolga the Accurs'd
warscroll_ability.lore: A ‘gift’ from the Everchosen, Gorbolga is a varanite spear that carries a potent mutative curse – but should its wielder’s will slip, they too will learn of its hunger…
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

***1 - Uncontrollable Power:***
Allocate 1 damage point to this unit.

***2 - The Spear Slumbers:***
No effect.

***3-5 - White-hot Varanite:***
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Gorbolga** for the rest of the turn.

***6 - Rampant Mutation:***
The effect of ‘White-hot Varanite’ applies and this unit’s **Gorbolga** has **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Fight For Glory
warscroll_ability.lore: In battle, the Spire Tyrants seek the favour of powerful warlords and will fight harder in their presence.
warscroll_ability.effect: The first time each turn that this unit is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability in the combat phase, if this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS HEROES**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Leeching Bites
warscroll_ability.lore: Although arcane in nature, these magical creatures still feed on the blood of the living.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an attack made by this **MANIFESTATION** scores a critical hit, **Heal (1)** this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Barrier of Water
warscroll_ability.lore: Inara directs Aqua Ghyranis to form a shimmering wall, its purity barring passage to any who would harm her.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a **MOVE** ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, the target cannot end that move closer to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Gigantic Nurgling-kin
warscroll_ability.lore: Morbidex has come to resemble the Nurglings physically and has gained much of their unnatural resilience.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is half the number of damage points this unit has (rounding up).

warscroll_ability.name: Supernatural Grace
warscroll_ability.lore: Whether they turn blows aside or simply dodge out of harm’s way, it is extremely difficult to pin down a Keeper of Secrets.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Hit-and-Run Tactics
warscroll_ability.lore: The Namarti Thralls strike at their foes before using the ethersea to fall back to a safer position.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: A Prod in the Right Direction
warscroll_ability.lore: As battle begins, grots like to give the Sporesplattas a helpful prod towards the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall Crawler
warscroll_ability.lore: The Spiderfang’s arachnid allies can skitter up and down vertical surfaces as if they were flat ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Lunatic Demise
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a Pink Horror be slain, it is capable of bursting into two smaller daemons or else detonating in a blast of wyrdflame.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Split:*** Pick a visible friendly **Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors** unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain **Blue Horror** models to that unit.

***Petty Vengeance:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Drawn to Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Even cursed with their hideous and twisted form, Chaos Spawn still covet the boons of the Dark Gods and are drawn to those most favoured by their patron.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Daemon Prince**, you can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for this unit’s Move and Attacks characteristics.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Thanatorg’s Claws and Fangs** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Menhir Club** is 3 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Fleshy Abundance
warscroll_ability.lore: The sorcerer generously bestows a growth spurt of the most repulsive kind upon their allies, causing their bodies to bloat with great wobbling mounds of grey-green fat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn

warscroll_ability.name: Iron-willed Overlord
warscroll_ability.lore: Manticores are berserk killers, and any Chaos Lord who rides one to battle displays such obvious dominance that none would dare deny their orders.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to the control scores of friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Victory Feast
warscroll_ability.lore: Varghulf rampages through the enemy’s ranks at will, its wounds sealing with unholy rapidity as it guzzles the flesh of the savaged foe.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any models were slain by this unit this turn:

• **Heal (D6)** this unit.

•  If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

•  If this unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Acrobatic Bloodshed
warscroll_ability.lore: As they flip and twist across the battlefield, the Arenai sever arteries and slash exposed throats, leaving any enemies left alive completely disorientated.
