warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while this unit is in combat with the target, its combat attacks must target that enemy unit. In addition, if any of this unit’s attacks score a critical hit on the target this phase, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Defend the Banner
warscroll_ability.lore: While Vanari battle beneath the sacred standard carried by the Bannerblade, their ranks tighten and enemy attacks are deflected with relentless skill and determination.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **VANARI INFANTRY** units while they are contesting the same objective as this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Brass Collar of Khorne
warscroll_ability.lore: Like all great gifts of the Blood God, the spiked collar that encircles Scyla’s neck is anathema to magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Eldritch Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: Gladewyrms are magical creatures, and their prey of choice is similarly arcane in nature. During battle, they burrow beneath the surface, reemerging to devour spellcasters and other mystics, whom they sense with greater clarity than other beings.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**WIZARD** non-**PRIEST** units and more than 3" from all enemy **WIZARDS** and enemy **PRIESTS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Sweeping Tusks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a deafening bellow, the Thundertusk swings its huge frost-wreathed tusks from side to side, sending enemies flying.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: The Maw Opens
warscroll_ability.lore: As Redd guzzles down his own gory concoctions and babbles ranting invocations, other ogors nearby are overcome by a wave of insane blood-hunger unlike anything they have ever known. None endure it unchanged.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is not in combat, it can move up to D3+3" but must end that move no further from the nearest enemy unit that is visible to it. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

If the target is in combat, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then **Heal (D3)** the target. If the target is a **MAWSEEKERS** unit, instead inflict 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Leap Into the Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: Windchargers can leap great heights and ride the winds to a more advantageous position.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the **leeward** battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Swallow Whole
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The huge, cavernous maw of a Ghorgon can swallow a man whole – a grisly fate for any warrior.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic:

• 1 model in the target unit is slain.
• **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Scurrying Retreat
warscroll_ability.lore: Just when a foe has him cornered, Kritza transfigures into a swarm of scurrying rats, only to rematerialise elsewhere and drive his blade into an enemy’s back.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Long-line Slings
warscroll_ability.lore: Specialised harnesses allow Kharadron to rapidly deploy from fast-moving vessels.
warscroll_ability.effect: When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Virulent Downpour
warscroll_ability.lore: With a guttural chant, Rotigus magnifies the storm, spreading Nurgle’s corruption across greater swathes of the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 3" to the range of this unit’s ‘Befouled Rainfall’ ability for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy unit within range of that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Grashrak Fellhoof
warscroll_ability.lore: For Grashrak, it is not enough to despoil the land – the air itself must writhe with the power of anarchy.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Grashrak Fellhoof** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Spread the Inferno
warscroll_ability.lore: The Fateskimmer’s fiery determination to burn reality to ashes incites nearby daemons to a murderous frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Companion weapons used by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Gather the Skulls!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Kamandora and her disciples seek skulls to raise new monuments to the Blood God.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain and you earn 1 blood tithe point.

warscroll_ability.name: Call of the Winds
warscroll_ability.lore: In the presence of Sevireth, the winds awaken to give aid to their allies.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a visible friendly **HURAKAN** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Skeleton Legion
warscroll_ability.lore: As necromantic energies blanket the battlefield, long-dead warriors stagger to their feet once more, eye sockets aglow with killing light.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Timberrrrr!
warscroll_ability.lore: A dying gargant is a weapon of ruin in its own right, though it is anyone’s guess where their body will fall.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, the players must roll off. The winner picks a point on the battlefield within 3" of this unit. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that point that has a lower Health characteristic than this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Command Underlings
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The cold-hearted rulers of the Darkling Covens wield absolute control over their ensorcelled underlings, commanding them to do their bidding unquestioningly.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3" to the Move characteristic of each target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bilewood Stilts
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotmire Creed use their stilts to cover ground more quickly.
warscroll_ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit when it uses **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Searing Beam of Light
warscroll_ability.lore: As interlocking lenses of aetherquartz click into place, a beam of blinding white light shoots forth to incinerate all before it.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit attacks with its **Searing Beam of Light**, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit’s base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.

warscroll_ability.name: Gas Clouds
warscroll_ability.lore: Poisoned wind globes are crystal orbs filled with deadly warp-gas that can engulf and lethally transmute an enemy regiment.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Poisoned Wind Globes** for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Apex Maw** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Reknit Construct
warscroll_ability.lore: This Mortisan has the power to remake and renew that which has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that is not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** the target. If the target unit is not damaged, you can instead return a number of slain models to it that have a combined Health characteristic of D3 or less.

warscroll_ability.name: Twisted Spirit-Song
warscroll_ability.lore: Disharmonious and laced with anger, Drycha’s spirit-song fills her allies with rage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks, including those made with **Companion** weapons.

In addition, if the target is non-**KURNOTHI**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristics of the target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Corpse Candles
warscroll_ability.lore: When preparing to cast a spell by snuffing out the flame of a corpse candle, Reikenor can drain his own or a victim’s essence to help fuel his sorcery.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick either this unit or a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If you picked this unit, allocate 1 damage point to this unit and add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

If you picked an enemy unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit and for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit's power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Keep Up!
warscroll_ability.lore: Mancrusher Gargants run as fast as they can so as not to be left out behind when their bigger brethren charge into battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **MEGA-GARGANT**, this unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ensnaring Soul-Drain
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a **MOVE** ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this **MANIFESTATION**, the effects of the ‘Fly’ ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Deafening Drone
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Revenant Seekers circle over the melee, cutting throats and piercing skulls with swipes of their sickles. The buzzing roar of their dragonspites’ wings soon disorientate enemies who engage them in protracted combat.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bringer of Plenty
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotigus is a masterful sorcerer, able to bind the energies of decay with a wave of his gnarled wand. His spells inspire grotesque fecundity and flesh-growth, stimulated through the arcane deluge.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Unbreakable Bulwark
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Lumineth who fight in Avalenor’s shadow need not fear; as long as he stands, they will come to no harm.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while that enemy unit is in combat with this unit, all attacks made by models in that enemy unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Magical Mending
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord-Arcanum can reknit structures formed from magic with their incantations, allowing them to repair nearby arcane conjurations.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **MANIFESTATION** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
warscroll_ability.declare: For each part of this **MANIFESTATION**, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Aviarch Sentry
warscroll_ability.lore: This ethereal monstrosity invokes terror as it swoops over enemy battlelines, causing the foe’s resolve to waver.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Enfeeble Foe
warscroll_ability.lore: With a series of hissed incantations, Be’lakor instils visions of loss and despair in the minds of his enemies to drain them of their fighting spirit.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls from the target’s combat attacks.
• The target’s combat attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: King of Shambling Bones
warscroll_ability.lore: In the presence of their sovereign, the footsoldiers of the Deathrattle kingdoms assume a sliver of their former warlike vigour.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Withering Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Nadja spits a vile curse in the Dark Tongue, drawing unnatural shadows to coil around an enemy champion and sap their life force.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampaging Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

warscroll_ability.name: Plaguemaster
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Hideous parasites and diseases made flesh spill from a Verminlord Corruptor to spread their sickness.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Give this unit 1 ritual point.

warscroll_ability.name: To Our Liege!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: There are many ghoulish legends of Crypt Flayers winging down to join their lieges upon the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Carnosaur’s Massive Jaws** is 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Holy Blades of Bone
warscroll_ability.lore: Crypt Horrors wield huge, monstrous femurs – as well as other grisly relics – as if they were blessed weapons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Masters of Order
warscroll_ability.lore: The slann are amongst the greatest wizards in existence, and they shape the very stars with their magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit can use an **UNBIND** ability if an enemy **WIZARD** anywhere on the battlefield uses a **SPELL** ability instead of an enemy **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit, and when using the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, this unit can pick a manifestation anywhere on the battlefield instead of within 30" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Debilitating Shockwave
warscroll_ability.lore: The vicious spikes that erupt from an onrushing Realmscourge Rupture impale those unfortunate enough to be struck by them even as the tremors that accompany them send those nearby staggering.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any models in the target unit are slain by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Uncanny Shot
warscroll_ability.lore: Gunnar Brand has been saved on more than one occasion by a well-placed arrow from Singri.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Singri’s Warbow** for attacks that target enemy units that are within 6" of a friendly **Gunnar Brand**.

warscroll_ability.name: Whirling Death
warscroll_ability.lore: One might as well try to catch a cannonball as to get the jump on a spinning Fanatic.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST.**

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP - Effect**
**1** - This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2** - This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3** - This unit has **WARD (5+)** and you ignore the first damage point allocated to this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Maw-krusha’s Fists and Tail** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Spirit of the Wind
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Spirit of the Wind never remains in one place for long.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**. It cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Fires of Vengeance
warscroll_ability.lore: Should one of the elders of the lodge be harmed while under the protection of Hearthguard Berzerkers, they are sent into such a vengeful rage that they become nigh unstoppable.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any damaged friendly **FYRESLAYERS HEROES**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Eldritch Raiders
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzaangors plunge into enemy lands, desperately seeking the arcane trinkets and treasures they crave – as well as victims to be transformed in their own bird-like image.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is wholly within enemy territory.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Blaze
warscroll_ability.lore: The Stormstrike Chariot smashes through lesser foes in a blaze of celestial power.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add D6" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Emergence
warscroll_ability.lore: The ground opens up to reveal the Runesmiter and their entourage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **underground**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other units that were set up **underground** with it (if any) wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: The Kings Court
warscroll_ability.lore: Ghoul Kings are often surrounded by their personal attendants, courtiers and royal family, who fight passionately to compete for their liege’s approval and whose loyalty fires the blood of their monarch in turn.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly non-**MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each other friendly non-**MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of +3.

warscroll_ability.name: Crown of Serpents
warscroll_ability.lore: The snakes that adorn the Shadow Queen's brow are magical creatures with a deadly sentience all of their own. Their poisons are many and varied, each serving a nefarious purpose.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 5 dice. Add 2 to each roll if the target is **constricted**. For each 5+, pick 1 of the following effects. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per turn.

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
• Random characteristic rolls for the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons are treated as unmodified rolls of 1 for the rest of the turn.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• The target cannot be healed or have slain models returned to it for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Paralysing Strikes
warscroll_ability.lore: Those struck by the blades of the Splintered Fang may find their limbs turning leaden and their thoughts becoming clouded as the cult’s venoms work their way into the blood.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, if its attacks score 2 or more critical hits against the same enemy unit, that unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Barbed Arrows
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The deadly missiles fired by the Blood Stalkers are designed so that they are not easily removed from the target’s flesh, inflicting debilitating agony even if the victim manages to survive.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any other friendly **Blood Stalkers** units picked that enemy unit to be the target of all of their shooting attacks this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Hexgorgers
warscroll_ability.lore: Hexgorger skulls exist purely to destroy magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each part of this **MANIFESTATION** that is within 8" of a **WIZARD** (friendly or enemy), subtract 1 from casting rolls for that **WIZARD**.

warscroll_ability.name: Magma Blast
warscroll_ability.lore: At the beck of a Zharrgrim Priest, the Zharrgron Flamespitter hurls forth a fiery orb that arcs across the sky before detonating in an explosion of flame amidst the enemy lines.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this **MANIFESTATION**’s shooting attacks if the target unit has 10 or more models. Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls instead if the target unit has 15 or more models.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Insular Contemplations
warscroll_ability.lore: A Cardinal’s ability to bend reality with their ranting is all the more potent when there are no questioning ‘heretics’ nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Aim Fer Its Eyes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Arrowboys loose shots at the eyes of their bestial prey, causing them immense pain and fouling their attacks.
warscroll_ability.declare: If all of the attacks made with this unit’s **Stinga Bows** this turn targeted the same enemy unit, pick that enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **BEAST** or **CAVALRY** unit, or add 2 to the roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. On a 4+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Threshing Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: Hellflayers were created to messily plough through screaming victims without slowing. Few beings possess the willpower to stand in their path or the strength to stop them in their tracks.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

warscroll_ability.name: Earth-shattering Charge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemies are crushed and trampled beneath the unstoppable ferocity of a Frostlord upon a charging Stonehorn.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and then roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Bringer of Plenty
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotigus is a masterful sorcerer, able to bind the energies of decay. His spells inspire grotesque fecundity and flesh-growth, stimulated by the arcane deluge that follows him.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE**  units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Invocation of Nagash
warscroll_ability.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• If the target was not set up this turn and is not in combat, it can move up to 3". It cannot move into combat.

warscroll_ability.name: The Red Angel of Slaughter
warscroll_ability.lore: Valkia swoops to the battlefield on bloodstained wings, launching her spear into the heart of the enemy lines moments before she charges in and begins the slaughter.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **soaring above the battlefield**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 10" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Shipwrecka Warclub** is 3 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Scryhawks
warscroll_ability.lore: The scryhawks that accompany Auralan Sentinels have been trained to circle above distant foes, marking them out as potential targets for Starshard Ballista crews.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Starshard Bolts** while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Vanari Auralan Sentinels** units.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of Rot Flies
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord of Afflictions leads a swarm of Rot Flies that act as brutal linebreakers, using their sheer bulk to smash enemy formations asunder.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **Pusgoyle Blightlords** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ **Rot Fly’s Mouthparts and Sting** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Indomitable Loreseekers
warscroll_ability.lore: The thick tomes carried by Knight-Arcanums are filled with the magical secrets they have learnt, including how to resist the raging sorcerous energies of the realms.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **SUMMON** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

Enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot pass through or end any move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.

This unit has **WARD (4+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Voracious Predator
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Young Arachnarok Spiders are swift hunters despite their immense size, with an unquenchable hunger for living prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 1" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadow Leap
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Shadowstalkers can vanish and reappear at will as they navigate the Umbral Web.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: The Mortarch of Night
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Mannfred’s ancient cunning is rightly feared throughout the Mortal Realms.
warscroll_ability.effect: The unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command can move into combat when using that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: The Light of Truth
warscroll_ability.lore: Annihilating beams of white light lance forth from Teclis’s brow, effortlessly scything through the ranks of the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick any number of different visible enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Incoming!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The skyvessel fires a close-range fusillade at a foe bearing down upon it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Champion of the Lord Phoenix
warscroll_ability.lore: As a member of Tyrion’s inner circle, Lyrior has led countless armies to victory in the name of the Lord Phoenix and inspires all those around him as a result.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a visible friendly **VANARI** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Varinor, Rune of Strength** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Varinor, Rune of Strength** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

warscroll_ability.name: Cealith, the High King's Shield
warscroll_ability.lore: Cealith is said to have been crafted by Teclis himself. However it was created, the mystical aura it projects guards the bearer against malign magics.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities or abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Victory Feast
warscroll_ability.lore: A Varghulf rampages through the enemy’s ranks at will, its wounds sealing with unholy rapidity as it guzzles the flesh of the savaged foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any models were slain by this unit this turn, **Heal (D6)** this unit, and this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Avatar of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Mutating Spores
warscroll_ability.lore: The spores ejected by Mork’s Mighty Mushroom cause those they touch to burst in a profusion of gruesome fungal growths.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each target, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in that unit that are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Unholy Stampede
warscroll_ability.lore: An Infernal Taurus inevitably forms the horn-tip of Hashut’s trampling hosts.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:

•  That unit can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on that unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Trophies of Glorious Deaths
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 8" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The sight of mighty champions reduced to nothing more than a Deathbringer's grisly trophies is enough to make the staunchest warrior baulk and falter.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On an 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost. This reaction cannot be used more than once per command.

warscroll_ability.name: Forest Fighters
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors fight in loosely scattered formations, the better to take advantage of the terrain in their arboreal domains.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: More-more Warpstone Bullets!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Under the dubious supervision of the Warlocks of Clans Skryre, the gunner cranks up the Ratling Warpblaster’s velocity to the max.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **SKRYRE HERO**, this unit’s **Hail of Warpstone Bullets** has an Attacks characteristic of 6D6+3 instead of 3D6+3 for the rest of the turn.

However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit’s **Hail of Warpstone Bullets**, inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Network of Spies
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Eternus commands a legion of agents and operatives to ensure he is always one step ahead of his enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the enemy unit is in combat with a friendly **Chaos Legionnaires** or **Chaos Furies** unit. On a 5+, that command has no effect. The command still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Unerring Hunters
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These spectral hunters will hound their prey until the very end of existence itself.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time this unit makes a pile-in move, add 3" to the distance it can move.

warscroll_ability.name: Crackling with Faith
warscroll_ability.lore: The half-sane Brethren of the Bolt draw the power from the Azyrite thunderstorms above to charge their weapons and smite the foes of Sigmar.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a combat attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, you can pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit that was not the target of that combat attack. Inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Rhythm of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: With each enemy skull caved in by the Warchanter’s Gorkstikk and Morkstikk, the febrile energy of the Waaagh! begins to build.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit’s combat attacks, give this unit D3 ritual points.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadow Form
warscroll_ability.lore: Be’lakor can shift his physical form to be as insubstantial as the mists of Ulgu – and just as hard to land a telling blow upon.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderous Pounce
warscroll_ability.lore: After years of commanding Dracolines, Astreia’s orders can send an entire pack sprinting into battle without hesitation, her own mount Kazra leading the charge.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Thrice-ripened Death's Heads
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These blessed death’s heads are projectiles ripe with disease and hurled at incoming foes to spread the plagues festering within.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit or with a friendly **Plague Drones** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll D3. On 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Timed Charges
warscroll_ability.lore: Skywardens are practised at striking hard and then retreating quickly amidst timed explosions to cause massive damage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target, and this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Freezing Aura
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Winter storms gather about this Huskard, freezing and slowing those foolish enough to remain in their presence for long.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Acid Ichor
warscroll_ability.lore: Whenever Orghotts’s flesh is cut open, a gout of daemonic ichor spews out with shocking force. Its vitriolic potency is enough to burn through steel and dissolve the flesh beneath.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Loons
warscroll_ability.lore: Gibbering and bound, Loonsmasha Fanatics are dragged or carried along by the general mass of grots until the time arrives to unrestrain them and pray to the Bad Moon that they head in the right direction.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **hidden among the mobs**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Hurled Body
warscroll_ability.lore: Warstompers wade into the thick of battle and pick up smaller opponents to hurl at other enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain and you can pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the target’s Health characteristic.

warscroll_ability.name: Tactical Insight
warscroll_ability.lore: The vampire and their acolytes employ their divinatory abilities to manipulate and aid their undying servants.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Endless Swarm
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The presence of Nurglings in the realms continuously draws more of their number from the Grandfather’s Garden, making their swarms extremely hard to eradicate.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Lofted Shots
warscroll_ability.lore: To strike a distant target, these warriors point their bows to the sky before launching a volley up high.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Auralan Bows** but subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Bait and Trap
warscroll_ability.lore: The Monsta‑killaz have perfected the art of baiting even the most fearsome monsters into debilitating traps.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is damaged. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Prime Cuts
warscroll_ability.lore: With cuts and swipes of surprising precision, the Skinnerkin’s foes unwittingly find themselves the main ingredient of the upcoming feast.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a combat attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, give 1 **prime cut point** to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Exsanguinating Glare
warscroll_ability.lore: The Bloodwrack Medusa’s eyes blaze with pure hatred, and her victim's blood explodes violently from their every pore.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. Otherwise, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, if any enemy models were slain by that mortal damage, inflict an additional 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Storm of Blades
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Channelling the frothing violence of a maelstrom, the Ikon of the Storm lashes out again and again.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Airborne Horror
warscroll_ability.lore: Carried aloft by ragged leathery wings, this favoured champion of the Chaos Gods will bring ruin wherever they descend.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has **Wings**, it has a Move characteristic of 10" and has **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Emerge from the Depths
warscroll_ability.lore: The Rabble-Rowza emerges from a little-known tunnel network beneath the battlefield, ready to stir up trouble.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in a secret tunnel**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Skirmishers
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors fight in a dispersed formation.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Ritual of the Creeping Mist
warscroll_ability.lore: This ritual beckons the chilling fogs of the ethersea to blind the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Release The Auto-Endrins
warscroll_ability.lore: Automated defence drones spill from the dock like wasps from a nest.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a friendly **Nullifier Auto‑Endrin**, **Stuncloud Auto‑Endrin** and **Grudgeblast Auto‑Endrin** (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Chaos Chariots are at their most deadly on the charge, causing devastation with their bladed wheels and hurtling mass.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Vengeance Unleashed
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Vandus inspires nearby members of the Warrior chambers to strike forth and deliver justice in the God-King’s name.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gaze of the Gnaw
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To catch Vizzik's gaze is to be driven from one's mind by agonising raptures.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:

• If this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Impaling Strikes
warscroll_ability.lore: On the charge, the blade of a stormstrike glaive can impale several foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: A Tough Grot To Swallow
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a RAMPAGE ability for an enemy MONSTER within 6" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The spiky-armoured Klutcha-grot is usually gobbled up by the Monsta-killaz’ prey, causing it to choke, retch and vomit up the little git. Of course, sometimes the grot just gets eaten, which the orruks find equally hilarious.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, that **RAMPAGE** ability has no effect. On a 1, remove this unit’s **Klutcha-grot** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Get Orf Me Land!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kraken-eaters hate intruders and trespassers, and they do not take kindly to people who decide to fight battles on their land.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective within 1" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, move the target 2D6" to a new position on the battlefield more than 1" from all models, terrain features and other objectives. That objective is treated as if it were in the same territories as it was when it was first set up on the battlefield for the purposes of the battleplan.

warscroll_ability.name: Born of Slaughter
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Khainites’ slaughterous worship reaches its apex, the Bloodwrack Medusa conjures forth a manifestation of murder and death.
warscroll_ability.declare: If there are fewer friendly **Avatars of Khaine** on the battlefield than there are friendly **Bloodwrack Shrines** on the battlefield, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up an **Avatar of Khaine** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Saurian Ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: Scar‐Veterans are feared across the Mortal Realms for their swift, silent and utterly merciless ambushes.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve. Pick each friendly unit that is **stalking the prey** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Multiple Parts
warscroll_ability.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Mutative Spear
warscroll_ability.lore: Gorbolga the Accurs’d causes rampant mutation in its victims, their twisted, mewling remains a source of absolute horror to their surviving allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Carve a Path To Glory
warscroll_ability.lore: Ruthless in battle, Gunnar Brand closes in on the enemy’s champions, claiming skulls and earning glory with each swing of his axes.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is in combat with an enemy **HERO**.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. When using the second **FIGHT** ability, this unit must pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target of all of its attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Kountin' Krew
warscroll_ability.lore: Swampboss Skumdrekk keeps his hobgrot lackeys, known as his ‘Kountin’ Krew’, close to hand. So close, in fact, that it is they who get first dibs on the toxic sludge that coats the underbelly of his Sludgeraker.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target’s **Slitta-knives** have **Crit (Mortal)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Fiery Death From Above
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Burning Chariot barges through enemy lines, spreading flaming ruin in its wake.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 1, gain 1 **fate point**. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stegadon’s Horns and Jaws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: The Prime Huntress
warscroll_ability.lore: Celestial strength, lifetimes of experience and the power of the spear Thengavar see even the most behemothic of terrors swiftly fall before Yndrasta’s fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Thengavar** for attacks that target **MONSTERS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Firing from the Belly
warscroll_ability.lore: An ogor’s sturdy frame easily absorbs the recoil of even cannon-sized weapons.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks if it has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Executioner's Entourage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Though Royal Decapitators are often shunned by their fellow ghouls, when the blood starts flying, these sinister figures can attract quite the following.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Discs of the Aelementiri
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Battle Round
warscroll_ability.lore: These sacred artefacts are a vital component of the Mage God’s deep connection with the elements of the Hysh-Mhensa. Their innate magic allows Lumineth to draw more readily upon the power of their own runic scriptures.
warscroll_ability.declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Depict a rune of your choice on your **battle scripture**.

**Designer’s Note:** *This allows you to have that rune depicted earlier in the **battle scripture** for the purposes of other abilities. Do not resolve the effect of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability as part of this ability.*

warscroll_ability.name: Way of the Vortex
warscroll_ability.lore: The riptide’s undertow pulls allies from harm, a hidden bulwark against the enemy’s raging storm. Within its grasp, Namarti endure, shielded by the Akhelian’s unwavering stance.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit and friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Terrible Madness
warscroll_ability.lore: Thanquol can inflict madness on his enemies, causing them to lash out at close allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn. In addition, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Bait and Switch
warscroll_ability.lore: The Changeling swaps places with a temporary ally.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability if it is **incognito**. Pick this unit and a friendly **INFANTRY HERO** to be the targets. One target must be **incognito** and the other must be on the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Set up the **incognito** target wholly within 6" of the other target and not in combat. Then, remove the other target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **incognito**.

If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, set up the friendly **incognito** unit wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and not in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Hangman's Knot
warscroll_ability.lore: The noose on a talúnhook can be used to ensnare a victim, ensuring they cannot escape their doom at the hands of the Soulrender.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Bound Retinue
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Fatemaster’s Twistwing relays the locations of favoured followers, and when the uprising breaks out, it is these chosen blades who form an honour guard for their master.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick up to 1 other friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Heavy Skyhook** is 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Dominate Mind
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Sphiranx can manipulate the actions of its enemies with a simple glance.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughterous Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne’s Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Lightning Tempest
warscroll_ability.lore: Ionus calls upon Sigmar to unleash the wrath of Azyr.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be struck by lightning, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit, then roll a dice. On a 1-2, the sequence ends. On a 3+, pick another enemy unit within 3" of that unit to be struck by lightning and inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another enemy unit within 6" of that unit instead of 3". Keep rolling dice in this way until the sequence ends or there are no other enemy units eligible to be struck by lightning. A unit cannot be struck by lightning more than once per turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wave of Power
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With arms held aloft, the Corpsemaster discharges the energy stored within the Mortis Engine, searing the life force from those nearby.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the value of this unit’s **stored energy dice**. Then, change the value of the **stored energy dice** back to 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Contagious Catarrh
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Disease-laden, phlegmy beasts squelch alongside the Pox-Wretches, happily infecting all those who come into contact with them.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has any **Mire Kelpies**, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** or terrain feature.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick any number of this unit’s **Mire Kelpies** and remove them from the battlefield. Then, roll a dice, adding 1 to the roll for each **Mire Kelpie** you removed this phase. On an unmodified roll of 1, this ability has no effect. On a 6+, the target has the **DISEASED** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Timed Charges
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Skywardens hurl explosive devices that shred the enemy and provide cover for their own retreat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadow Lariat
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: From the periphery of battle, the Shadowstalkers send tendrils of darkness wrapping around an enemy warlord, drawing the unwitting victim towards them into the gloom.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY HERO** that has no more than 1 model and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is more than 3" from all other enemy units, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Engine of Domination
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemy champions are frozen in dread by this daemon engine’s glare before being pulverised by its cursed mauls.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy **HEROES**, it can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase and can only be picked to use a second **FIGHT** ability if it is still in combat with any enemy **HEROES**.

warscroll_ability.name: Expert Ranger
warscroll_ability.lore: Decades of survival out in the wilds have given Drolf the tools to navigate even seemingly impenetrable terrain.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 3" of the target and not in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: The Hunt is On
warscroll_ability.lore: Sensing the time is right, the Icebrow Hunter and their Frost Sabre companions launch their ambush.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **outflanking the prey**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each **Frost Sabres** unit that was set up **outflanking the prey** with this unit wholly within 12" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Mantle of the First Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: Bastian’s armour is among the first of its kind, laboured over by Grungni himself and charged with the same holy energies as the Anvil of Apotheosis. It is a symbol of, and potent boon to, the Thunderborn’s already legendary willpower.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (4)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Warp-amulet
warscroll_ability.lore: Thanquol wears a thrumming green warpstone amulet, the mutating magics of which serve to meld and rapidly heal his, or Boneripper’s, flesh.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Acrobatic Leaps
warscroll_ability.lore: In a dizzying display of agility, the Cypher Lords somersault towards the foe before cutting them to ribbons with their exotic blades.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Klutcha-grot
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Klutcha-grot** is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the ‘A Tough Grot to Swallow’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Slashing Fins
warscroll_ability.lore: A pack of Screamers travelling at great speed can slash and eviscerate an enemy formation to ribbons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that passed across the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Da Final Fling
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a Big Stabba team be slain before they get a chance to ‘give ’em a stabbin’’, they will use their last moments to hurl their Gorktoof spear at the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is not in combat, each time a model in this unit is slain by a shooting attack and that model was within 12" of the attacking unit, roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if the attacking unit was a **MONSTER**. On a 4+, inflict D6 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Deathrider Wedge
warscroll_ability.lore: Kavalos Deathriders can charge in a deadly arrowhead formation that bursts through the enemy’s defences.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The following effects apply this phase:

• Models in this unit can pass across enemy **INFANTRY** models as if this unit had **FLY**.
• After this unit has charged, you can pick an enemy unit that it passed across and roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Blinding Light
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Direct the Gyrocorps
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With phosphorescent munitions, Cogsmiths can direct bombing runs and counterattacks by the gyro-machines of the Ironweld Arsenal.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **Gyrocopter** or **Gyrobomber** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks.
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.

warscroll_ability.name: Rituals of Prophecy
warscroll_ability.lore: Though blind, the Crone Goddess Morai-Heg sees all. Gifted with a fragment of her oracular powers, the Knives of the Crone are able to navigate the vagaries of battle with uncanny perspicuity by reading fate in the spilled entrails of their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 6 dice:

• For each 1, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
• For each 3, add 1" to this unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
• If any of the rolls are a 6, add 1 to save rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spiterider Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Lance-armed Spiteriders train to inflict the greatest damage possible on the charge, destroying chosen targets in a series of blistering attacks.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is the enemy **quarry**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Vassal
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Slann Starmaster can channel the power of a spell through one of their followers.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKINK WIZARD** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by this unit this phase from the target instead of from this unit.

The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’ or ‘The Earth Trembles’.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardian of the Glades
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: While they answer to no single glade, the Spirits of Durthu have sworn solemn oaths to safeguard all of Alarielle’s children. In battle, they will stand in defence of the wargrove’s commanders, and their wrath is terrible to behold should those under their protection be imperilled.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to the charge roll but this unit must end that charge move within ½" of an enemy unit that is in combat with another friendly **SYLVANETH HERO**.

warscroll_ability.name: Ancient Strategies
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Death does not rob a Wight King of their strategic genius, and they direct their undead thralls with great skill.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: That Which Should Not Be
warscroll_ability.lore: To behold such a majestic beast as a dragon in the grip of undeath evokes awe and abject terror in equal measure.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Stolen Hours
warscroll_ability.lore: The bearer of a Sword of Stolen Hours can steal vital energy from a foe and use it to increase their own power.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to enemy units by combat attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Enter the Shrine
warscroll_ability.lore: Worthy Lumineth take up position within a Shrine Luminor to help to cleanse the realms.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shrine Guardian, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM‐LORDS INFANTRY HERO** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shrine Guardian (see ‘Shrine Guardian’).

warscroll_ability.name: Terrifying Monstrosity
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord Skreech has a malevolent and horrific visage that can shatter the enemy’s resolve.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
• Subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hedkrakka, Gob of Gork
warscroll_ability.lore: The self-proclaimed Gob of Gork claims to hear the voice of Gorkamorka through his pet squig-snake.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Hedkrakka, Gob of Gork**, is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Killers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Varanguard have slaughtered foes beyond counting, butchering their way across the battlefields of the Mortal Realms without mercy.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: A Taste for the Arcane
