warscroll_ability.lore: The flesh of shamans and other cunning folk is a prized delicacy to the Cleavers. Simply being in the presence of those who are mystically attuned, be they friend or foe, whets their palate for carnage, seeing them lay into the enemy with terrifying vigour.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If a friendly or enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** is within 6" of this unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

• If this unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardians
warscroll_ability.lore: Bladelords are tasked with protecting the Scinari from harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: While your general is wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and your general have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Tireless Hunter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This determined warrior never stops moving in pursuit of their prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Lend a Claw
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In a horrifying bout of lucidity and multiple flailing appendages, the remains of the Master Moulder who was stitched into this abomination exert a degree of control over the other creatures in its menagerie before swiftly falling back into a pit of insanity.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 4 other friendly non-**SKRYRE MOULDER** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Loosely Attached Bladed Limbs** for the rest of the phase for each target picked. Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets’ attacks for the rest of the phase, including those made with **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Quest's End
warscroll_ability.lore: Loonknights that succeed in their quest become even more emboldened.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if you control the **object of this unit’s quest** and this unit is contesting it.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** and **WARD (4+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Aethershock
warscroll_ability.lore: The Stormcoven unleash their stored energies across the battlefield, bolstering their allies or blasting enemies to the ground.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is a friendly unit, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. If the target is an enemy unit, it has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Overwhelming Volleystorm
warscroll_ability.lore: The Tempestors fire charged crossbow bolts into the foe, weakening their defences and leaving them open to a follow-up assault.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Volleystorm Crossbows** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use the ‘All-out Defence’ command in the following combat phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Runaway Coach
warscroll_ability.lore: This nightmare‑drawn carriage crushes any who attempt to withstand its momentum.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Trapped!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The jaws of an ogor trap can hobble even the most belligerent of prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Make a **trapped roll** of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll for each friendly **Mantrapper accomplice** next to the target. If the roll is less than the target’s Save characteristic, until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

• The target does not have **FLY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Words of Hate
warscroll_ability.lore: Curses spat from a Skull Altar gain a dark power.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this terrain feature has an **Invoker:**

• Add 1 to chanting rolls for the **Invoker.**
• The **Invoker** cannot use **MOVE** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the **Invoker,** measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the **Invoker** target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Invoker.** Then, set up the **Invoker** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer an **Invoker.** If it is not possible to set up the **Invoker,** it is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Knightly Exemplar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Witnessing a Crypt Haunter Courtier’s frenzied, blood-spraying assault sends the warriors in their pack into a murderous frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Crypt Horrors** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Invasion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Demonstrating its legendary ferocity, the Thanatorg smashes through the ranks of the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Mortal Contract
warscroll_ability.lore: Vokmortian binds an enemy to a deadly mystical contract.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a **CORE** ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that **CORE** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Broken Nadja
warscroll_ability.lore: Broken Nadja wields the energies of ruin itself through dark incantations.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Broken Nadja** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Severing Strike
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Heads roll and crimson arcs of hot blood spurt into the air as these warriors swing their deadly blades.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Kyazu’s Greatblade and Mutants’ Claws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Failing Fortitude
warscroll_ability.lore: Ruthlessly targeting his prey’s weaknesses, Torgillius hurls bolts of enervating energy to drain their strength and resilience.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Slime Fleet
warscroll_ability.lore: Gutrot’s Slime Fleet haunts the oceans of the Mortal Realms, fighting alongside and transporting warriors that the Lord of Tentacles judges to share his aims.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a regiment led by this unit to be the target if no units from that regiment have been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each unit in the target regiment is set up in reserve **aboard the Slime Fleet**. Those units have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadow Leap
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Shadowstalkers can vanish and reappear at will as they navigate the Umbral Web.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Booming Cacophony
warscroll_ability.lore: In the terrible blasting of the Dirgehorn can be heard the bestial growls of a thousand beastherds.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this **MANIFESTATION** is set up, the range of this ability is 6". Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within range of this **MANIFESTATION**’s ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Moonfire Flask
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The High Warden carries a flask filled with a burning silvery liquid that can be hurled at the incoming enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Whipped Into A Frenzy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The leaders of a beastherd often goad gargants so as to send them into a berserk rage.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is within 6" of any friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS HEROES**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Moonclan Lairs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gloomspite Gitz use Moonclan-dug tunnels to reach nearby Loonshrines. In battle, reinforcements emerge from these echoing subterranean passages.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** non‑**WAR MACHINE GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Imbued With Arcane Fire
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Magister sets their allies’ blades ablaze with deadly wyrdflame that can melt through steel.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Plan the Attack
warscroll_ability.lore: With honed tactical skill, the Lord-Vigilant orders a vital position to be taken.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units that target enemy units contesting that objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Deliverance
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord Kroak’s palanquin quivers with barely contained force before unleashing ruination on the enemies of the Seraphon.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Blade of Shadows** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Dauntless Assault
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Eager to prove themselves in battle, Auric Runesons are at their best leading from the front lines alongside their allies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Obliterating Blast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The sheer size of an Ironblaster means that collateral damage is effectively guaranteed – not that the ogors care.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target. Then, draw a straight line between the closest points on the bases of this unit and the target. Each other unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across is a **collateral damage target**.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on each **collateral damage target**.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Carriage
warscroll_ability.lore: Unimpeded by physical obstacles due to its phantasmal form and carried upon spectral winds, a Black Coach hurtles towards its victims with horrifying swiftness.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Drain Vitality
warscroll_ability.lore: This cursed spell saps a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunters of the Frozen Wilds
warscroll_ability.lore: The pale coats of Frost Sabres act as a natural camouflage in the bleak wilderness.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit is not visible to enemy units while it is within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Division Commander
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: From atop the turret, the commander directs the other tanks in their division upon the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Steam Tank** units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by this unit and by each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Hamstring
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Mean-eye can find the soft spot in the toughest foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Mean-eye** is on the battlefield and not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 15" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is damaged. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Death's Construction
warscroll_ability.lore: Through the subtlest arcane suggestion, Sekhar implants her will in vulnerable minds – supplanting their former purpose with the undying will of Nulahmia.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units cannot be picked to be the target of abilities used by the target other than **FIGHT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Quickblood
warscroll_ability.lore: Vhordrai calls upon the power of the curse running through his veins to strike with impossible speed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Long-planned Strike
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzaangors are fearsome agents of change on the attack, pushing their longplanned assault into enemy territory with impressive skill and strength.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is wholly within enemy territory, its melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits**).

warscroll_ability.name: Duty Unto Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Hearthguard Berzerkers are sworn to protect their lodge and its masters until their dying breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Captured Soul Energy
warscroll_ability.lore: The chains and padlocks carried by Spirit Torments can capture spirits and reshape them into raw amethyst power to aid their minions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: No Escape
warscroll_ability.lore: There is no hope for the enemy when a Bone-tithe Shrieker is nearby.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Biovoltaic Blast
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of force when the time is right.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each 4-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. For each 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cornered Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: A Clawlord in fear for their life fights with rabid ferocity.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Halberd**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Madcap Mushroom
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This mushroom enhances the eater’s magical capabilities – as long as it does not turn out to be a deadly poisonous Madcap Toadstool…
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• If 2 or more dice in a casting roll for this unit have the same value, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit after the **SPELL** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: The Goddess of Life
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: So long as Ghyran endures, so will the Everqueen.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with 8 damage points allocated to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points) wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Volcanic Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Born of fire and flame, Magmadroths pulse with the throbbing heat of the volcanic caverns in which they make their fyrenests.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Netters
warscroll_ability.lore: Moonclan grots use throwing nets to capture Cave Squigs and entangle their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Vile Transference
warscroll_ability.lore: The Vampire Lord siphons the animus from nearby enemies and uses it to rejuvenate their ageless form.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and **Heal (1)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Deadly Trap
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Dark Master delights in lethal reversals of expectation and fate.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, that target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This device is equipped with a precision charge for demolition work.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is a **Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Keepin' Up Wiv Da Boss
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Sunsteala Wheela grots closely follow their boss into battle - after all, if he has an 'accident', they are in with a good chance of taking over as the new boss!
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Sunsteala Wheelas** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Transport Capacity
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughter At Any Cost
warscroll_ability.lore: When stirred by the excesses of battle, Fiendbloods waste no time in hunting down their victims.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability if any damage points were allocated to it this turn.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Bounteous Healing
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Morgwaeth the Bloodied
warscroll_ability.lore: As coldly ambitious as any of Morathi-Khaine’s priestesses, the ruthless Hag Queen Morgwaeth the Bloodied travels the realms in search of precious Khainite treasures.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Morgwaeth the Bloodied** is on the battlefield, it has **PRIEST (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Thrillseeking Cavalcade
warscroll_ability.lore: A Bladebringer has no patience for minions who dally in the search for new sensation.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Seeker Chariot** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit and the targets for the rest of the turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, when this unit and the targets use the ‘Mutilating Blades’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted (if any).

warscroll_ability.name: Flattened Into The Mud
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a foe miraculously survive the impact of a charging Maw-grunta, it will take some time for them to regather their wits!
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice and add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the roll. On a 5+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Boing! Boing! Boing!
warscroll_ability.lore: Squig Hoppers can cause considerable damage simply by bouncing on top of their foes as they make their way across the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that passed across the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Moustache-mounted Aetherblasters
warscroll_ability.lore: These custom aetherblasters deal short-range volleys of devastating fire.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Marshal of the Peasantry
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Leading from the front, the Crypt Ghast Courtier inspires the lowliest warriors of a kingdom to new heights of murderous ‘valour’.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Crypt Ghouls** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Averon Stormsire
warscroll_ability.lore: Averon can summon forth a storm of celestial lightning of unmatchable ferocity.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Averon Stormsire** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Dinner is Served
warscroll_ability.lore: A grisly platter of splintered bones, rotten meat and spilled entrails is offered up to the nobility.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is the number of **prime cut points** this unit has. Then, reset this unit’s **prime cut points** to 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Flinger
warscroll_ability.lore: This crude catapult hurls a heavy ball of corded spider-silk at the enemy, engulfing victims in a mass of sticky webbing.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any attacks made with this unit’s **Flinger** score a hit, after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 2+, halve the Move characteristic of the target unit until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Cloudweaving Skyfarers
warscroll_ability.lore: *It is not only the Kharadron’s vessels that prowl the skies: one-duardin endrinsphere harnesses grant their wearers the power of flight, making them manoeuvrable troops indeed.*
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Transport Capacity
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

warscroll_ability.name: Kurnothi War-horn
warscroll_ability.lore: The sounding of Belthanos’s war-horn brings forth a surging response from the hunt.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **KURNOTHI** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Blissbrew Homonculus
warscroll_ability.lore: These imps carry censers that belch sickly incense that tricks the senses and blinds hostile eyes.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** are tokens. There is 1 **Blissbrew Homonculus** for every 10 models in this unit.

This unit has **WARD (6+)** while it has any **Blissbrew Homonculi**. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Piercing Bloodroar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The shrill war cry of a mighty griffon can shatter the enemy’s resolve.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Zarbag
warscroll_ability.lore: Leading the Gitz is a powerful shaman who can call upon the powers of the Bad Moon in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Zarbag** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Sow Confusion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To the disciples of Be’lakor, subterfuge and lies are as keen as any blade.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleashed Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: Brute Ragerz waste no time in venting their pent-up rage when they get within striking distance of the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Total Dominance
warscroll_ability.lore: With a swift and precise gesture, Ivya exerts her powerful influence over nearby monsters.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **MONSTERS** while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Masters of Combat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Bladelords have long meditated upon the rune of Varinor to improve their martial prowess.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Sunmetal Blades** for each instance of **Varinor, Rune of Strength** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

warscroll_ability.name: Warrior Mages
warscroll_ability.lore: Evocators are masters of the martial and the arcane.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Merciless Sentinels
warscroll_ability.lore: The Emberwatch have stalked the mines of Embergard so long that they have become tenacious and unforgiving in pursuit of their mission.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while it contests an objective that is wholly outside friendly territory.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Assassins
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly ESHIN INFANTRY unit wholly within 13" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The skulking warriors of the Clans Eshin move like swift smoke in a Verminlord Deceiver’s presence.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruptured Cysts
warscroll_ability.lore: Belga intones a chant that triggers a chain reaction of agonising, pus-filled eruptions in the bodies of sickened foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible **DISEASED** enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on each other **DISEASED** enemy unit within 3" of the target. If the chanting roll was 9+, you can also pick a friendly **PLAGUEBEARERS** unit within 12" of the target. For each enemy **INFANTRY** model slain by this ability this turn, you can return 1 slain model to that friendly unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Primal Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere taste of enemy blood whips an Aggradon into a battle frenzy and sends the beast on a violent rampage.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit must use this ability each turn.

If this unit used any **FIGHT** abilities this turn, place a **rage token** next to it, to a maximum of 3. If this unit did not use any **FIGHT** abilities this turn, remove all **rage tokens** it has.

Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons for each **rage token** it has until the end of the next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Runic Axes
warscroll_ability.lore: As enemies close in around him, the runes on Drolf’s twin axes glow bright, granting his strikes even greater lethality.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is in combat with 2 or more enemy units, this unit’s **Runic Axes** have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Seething Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: Sweeping forward in a chittering mass, Clanrats overwhelm their enemies with their seemingly limitless numbers, biting, stabbing, screeching and trampling their own fallen beneath their bloody claws.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Fury of the Wildlands
warscroll_ability.lore: Drasher’s animalistic wrath is fuelled by violence.
warscroll_ability.declare: You must use this ability.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any enemy models have been slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, until the end of the next turn:

• This unit cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Gnarlmaw Whisperer
warscroll_ability.lore: With a little gentle coaxing, the daemonic trees of the Garden will uproot themselves and lumber to the Grand Cultivator’s side.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Feculent Gnarlmaw** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 3" from all enemy units, objectives and other terrain features.

warscroll_ability.name: Glory In Battle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Under the command of their warlord, the warriors sworn to them waste no time in slaying the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Crimson Offerings
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Cruel twists of the Blood Hags’ valthrai send fountains of blood gushing into the air – a generous tribute for the Murder God.
warscroll_ability.effect: If an enemy unit was destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, when resolving that ability, you can pick 2 blessings instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Surrender to the Sea
warscroll_ability.lore: If the Incarnate is driven back from the enemy, its tendrils slink back into the ethersea too.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this **MANIFESTATION** is removed from play, each friendly **Abyssal Tendril** on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Unfeeling Fortitude
warscroll_ability.lore: Many have found, to their cost, that injuries that would instantly kill another opponent do not even slow the Arcwalkers.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Conquest
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Heeding their Godspeaker’s proclamations, these warriors seek to earn glory by driving back the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you control that is wholly within enemy territory, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Cornered Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: A Clawlord in fear for their life fights with rabid ferocity.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Halberd**.

warscroll_ability.name: Hungry Crypts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The haunted crypt tears itself apart, only to reassemble itself moments later.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 3" of a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all terrain features and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

warscroll_ability.name: Despoilers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared the ‘All-out Defence’ command for a unit within 6" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Bestigors reserve the greatest part of their hatred for those who rally under the banners of civilisation.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Aggressively Bossy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Commands and insults bellowed from around this tower seem to carry extra weight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss. On a 4+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target until the start of your next turn:

***Dat’s Ours, Ya Git!:*** Subtract 3 from the target’s control score.

***Zog Off Wiv Ya Magic!:*** Subtract 1 from casting rolls and/or chanting rolls for the target.

***Oi! Hold It!:*** Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Curse of Loyalty
warscroll_ability.lore: Dreadblade Harrows are spectral knights who serve as cursed vassals for the commands of their masters.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 3 to the control scores of friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Word of the God-King
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Zenestra can channel the divine will of Sigmar with but a single utterance, smiting heretical priests and practitioners of proscribed magic, as well as their conjurations.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD, PRIEST** or **MANIFESTATION** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
•If the target is a **MANIFESTATION**, it is banished and removed from the battlefield.
•If the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Royal Bodyguard
warscroll_ability.lore: In battle, it falls to the tenacious Cryptguard to form a half-living shield for their vampiric overlords.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to ward rolls for friendly **HEROES** that are wholly within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Epicentre of Delusion
warscroll_ability.lore: In fleeting moments of near lucidity, Ushoran has a small degree of control over the delusion believed by the cannibal army.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make a delusion roll, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Shields of the Legion
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: A friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WAR MACHINE** or **WIZARD** within this unit’s combat range was targeted by an **ATTACK** ability.
warscroll_ability.lore: Mortek Guard are the mainstay of the Ossiarch legions, repelling attacks on more valuable constructs wherever their nadirite shields are raised in defence.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Surge of Hatred
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Shadow Queen rages, Morathi- Khaine binds that anger and unleashes it, magnifying it tenfold or imbuing a nearby cultist with a sliver of divine frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick either a friendly **Shadow Queen** wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat or a visible friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is a friendly **Shadow Queen**, it can immediately use a **FIGHT** ability as if it were your combat phase. Otherwise, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Void Drum
warscroll_ability.lore: A void drummer rides on the back of every Akhelian Leviadon. The mesmerising rhythm that they beat out sends rippling currents through the air, distorting the outlines of the drummer’s comrades and making them hard to see.
warscroll_ability.effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Murderous Paragon
warscroll_ability.lore: To Wrathmongers, Skarr Bloodwrath is an exemplar of mindless carnage, and like him, they fight to the death hoping to be reborn to kill again.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Wrathmongers** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Noxious Roar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These creatures bring the roul stench of their swampland homes to battle, their noxious breath reeking all the worse when they roar in anger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Trampled to Dust
warscroll_ability.lore: Infantrymen who find themselves in the Blood Knights’ path are crushed beneath the hooves of their Nightmare steeds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Toad Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: The mere scent of a blot toad sends Ripperdactyls into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Ripperdactyl’s Tearing Jaws** while it is in combat with any units that have a **Blot Toad**.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Purifying Blast
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord-Exorcists specialise in the dissolution of fell rituals, disrupting them with the scouring light of Azyr.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **PRIEST** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 2+:

• If the target has any ritual points, remove a number of ritual points from it equal to the roll.
• If the target has no ritual points, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Razor-tipped Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Chameleon Ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hunters of Huanchi emerge from hiding and pepper their enemies with projectiles.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in ambush**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Swordmasters
warscroll_ability.lore: Vanari Bladelords adopt different fighting styles depending upon the nature of their opponents.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, you must pick either the **Perfect Strike** or **Flurry of Blows** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Sunmetal Greatblade. In addition:

Do not use the attack sequence for an attack made with **Perfect Strike**. Instead, roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Total Eclipse
warscroll_ability.lore: Ellania gestures towards a lunar body and causes a shadow to draw across it, distracting the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time an enemy unit within 18" of this unit uses a command, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Turn to Stone
warscroll_ability.lore: Foes who remain too close to this hovering sigil will find their flesh hardening and turning into stone until they are nothing more than lifelike statues.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll. If an enemy unit has at least 3 mortal damage inflicted on it by this ability this turn, it has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampaging Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

warscroll_ability.name: Combat Engineers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Endrinmasters are trained in combat and possess a natural flair for command – bad news for would-be attackers.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Endrinriggers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Strike and Fade
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Spiterider Lancers seek to avoid drawn-out combat, preferring instead to launch blistering attacks from cover and annihilating their target in a furious charge, before disengaging and seeking  a fresh direction from which to attack.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Deffcap Mushroom
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Fungoid Cave-Shamans claim that eating Deffcaps allows them to commune with those who have passed on to the ‘Great Green’. Though such is debatable, the mushroom’s effect on the shaman’s spellcasting abilities is beyond doubt.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Stuff 'Em In Me Net
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kraken-eaters are constantly putting things into the nets they carry ‘ for later’, including unlucky opponents and other tasty-looking morsels.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Fearless Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Fearless and bold, Auric Runesons show their devotion to Grimnir with daring assaults and furious charges.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Torrent of Flame
warscroll_ability.lore: The flames spewed by a Firebelly are perfect for incinerating packed formations of infantry.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Fire Breath** if the target is **INFANTRY**.

warscroll_ability.name: Black-hearted Conqueror
warscroll_ability.lore: Those sworn to serve beneath a Despot must offer them conquest and tribute or suffer the consequences…
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.

warscroll_ability.name: Grind Their Bones, Seize Their Skulls
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemy skulls shorn by the Bloodletters atop the Skull Cannon are used as fiery munitions.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any enemy models are slain by a **FIGHT** ability used by this unit, after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, this unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Favoured of the Pantheon
warscroll_ability.lore: The gods watch this warlord’s deeds particularly closely.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, you can roll on the Eye of the Gods table for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: No Respite
warscroll_ability.lore: Dying as they lived, Blood Warriors devote even their final moments to killing.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Black-hearted Lackeys
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These villainous souls unleash a volley of close-range spectral bolts, forcing their opponents backwards as they slink away from combat in good order.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Once More, for Sigmar, Charge!
warscroll_ability.lore: Gavriel’s unshakeable devotion to Sigmar sees his warriors charging straight into the front lines, no matter the dangers before them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and another visible friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit within 3" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for the targets, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Volcanic Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Born of fire and flame, Magmadroths pulse with the throbbing heat of the volcanic caverns in which they make their fyrenests.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Outmanoeuvre
warscroll_ability.lore: Doomfire Warlocks are the light cavalry of the war covens, worrying the enemy’s flanks and engaging unprotected targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance this unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Ancestral Grudgebearer
warscroll_ability.lore: Every Warden King knows the names of those who wronged their forebears. As they march out to defend or reclaim their holds, they seek to settle those grudges.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in your opponent’s army to bear a grudge against. You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** units that target that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Siren Song of the Abyss
warscroll_ability.lore: More attuned to the heartbeat of the ocean than any Isharann, Mathaela can stir the seas to thrashing life with but a gesture.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Transport Capacity
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

warscroll_ability.name: Emberstone-riddled Flesh
warscroll_ability.lore: Empowered by his rage, the emberstone embedded in Edmark’s skin causes his body to erupt into livid flames, burning those nearby who would do him harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
warscroll_ability.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lithe and Swift
warscroll_ability.lore: Charging Daemonettes can riddle an enemy with a quicksilver flurry of claw-strikes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Ravaging Claws** for the rest of the turn if this unit charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spotter's Flaregun
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Firing this flaregun sends a message to all nearby Kharadron: this place is claimed and must be defended.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SKYFARER** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.

warscroll_ability.name: Brass Stampede
warscroll_ability.lore: Nothing can stop the thunderous onset of Khorne’s Juggernauts once they have scented the blood of the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Screamin' Mandrakk
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: The awful sound this plant emits wreaks havoc on the concentration of enemy wizards.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit uses the ‘Unbind’ ability but the unbinding roll is 3D6 instead of 2D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Stampede of Iron
warscroll_ability.lore: The Horns of Hashut wage war with brutal, overwhelming violence, crashing into enemy lines with ferocious impact before delivering bone-crushing strikes from their fell-forged weapons.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is within the target’s combat range. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more mortal damage is inflicted on the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Relictor Soulguide
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Knight-Relictor who accompanies the Soulsworn uses the winds of Sigmar’s Tempest to translocate the Questors to where they are most needed.
warscroll_ability.declare: You can pick a friendly **Knight‑Questor** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if you picked a target, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again within this unit’s combat range and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Gut-wrenching Howl
warscroll_ability.lore: The howl of a Curseblood resounds with the force of long-repressed bloodlust finally finding release, staggering even the bravest souls.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit’s **Curseblood** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Cinder and Ash
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Freeguild Grenadiers carry specialised gear to reduce dug-in enemies to a panicked, screaming bonfire of melting flesh and charred hair.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 1 terrain feature contested by this unit and up to 1 objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units also contesting them to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Been There, Done That
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Having travelled the realms and eaten every conceivable foe, Maneaters just laugh off the puny tricks and magics of their enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: The Croneseer
warscroll_ability.lore: Krethusa’s gifts of foresight are legendary, empowered further still by sacrifice and burnt offerings.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time you perform a blood rite, immediately after the ability that destroyed a unit has been resolved, give this unit 1 **prophecy token**.

• While this unit has 2 or more **prophecy tokens**, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of shooting attacks or **SPELL** abilities used by enemy units.

• While this unit has 3 or more **prophecy tokens**, you can re-roll unmodified chanting rolls of 1 for this unit.

• While this unit has 4 or more **prophecy tokens**, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Thrallmaster
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **NAMARTI THRALLS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: A Promising Concoction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sanguinarchs are obsessed with crafting the finest ichorous blends, and they can further refine such rich pickings to bolster their strength and that of their lackeys.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VAMPIRE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Battle Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: Once Gotrek has started to fight, he continues to do so with a relentless fury that abates only when all his opponents lie slain.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lightning Master
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: None are better than a Warlock Galvaneer at engineering storms of electrical carnage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Warpvolt Scourgers** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Warpvolt Scourgers** to 10 for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Undead Minions
warscroll_ability.lore: Necromancers are obsessed with staving off death and will sacrifice any number of their resurrected servants to protect themselves.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Divine The Future
warscroll_ability.lore: The swirling scry-orbs of the Warpseer can show it glimpses of the future.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, add 2" to the distance friendly units can move when using the ‘Always Three Clawsteps Ahead’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Entropic Lodestone
warscroll_ability.lore: As the corrupting influence of the herdstone spreads, buildings, armour and other trappings of civilisation begin to crumble to dust, allowing even the crude weapons of the Beasts of Chaos to cut through their defences with ease.
warscroll_ability.effect:
From the second battle round onwards, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** units while they are wholly within 24" of this terrain feature.

If this terrain feature is wholly within 18" of the centre of the battlefield, this ability affects all friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** units on the battlefield instead of those wholly within 24" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Warp Vortex
warscroll_ability.lore: The sheer destructive anarchy that surrounds a Warp Lightning Vortex slows the progress of warriors caught in its midst.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 2 from run rolls and charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**. In addition, if an enemy unit passes across this **MANIFESTATION** and/or the round-cornered triangle formed by drawing a line around all the bases of the **MANIFESTATION**’s parts, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of Shyish
warscroll_ability.lore: A palpable aura of death lingers over these ancient burial sites, dormant necromantic energy that can be harnessed by Shyishan practitioners.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** casts a **SUMMON SPELL** from the ‘Manifestations of the Grave’ lore, you can measure the range and visibility from this terrain feature instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Sigmarite Thundershield
warscroll_ability.lore: When struck with sufficient force, thundershields unleash stored storm energy to blast those attempting to attack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Heavy Bomb Racks
warscroll_ability.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Nadirite Bow
warscroll_ability.lore: With grim efficiency, the warrior Nohem fires shot after shot into the enemy lines with his nadirite bow, felling foes left and right.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Nohem** is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Infuse With Bestial Vigour
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Raw chaotic energy emanates from the Bray-Shaman, imbuing surrounding beastmen with unnatural speed.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Endless Terrors
warscroll_ability.lore: Bolstered by the presence of an Arachnarok, the arcanely blessed spiders of the Scuttletide will spill forth without cease, making them near impossible to get rid of.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **ARACHNAROK** units.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Magmadroth’s Claws and Horns** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruination Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: All Too Predictable
warscroll_ability.lore: The Enlightened are able to glimpse snapshots of their enemy’s past battles, giving them a vital edge in combat.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this turn, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit’s **Tzeentchian Spear and Vicious Beak** has **Crit (2 Hits)**.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Tzeentchian Spear and Vicious Beak**.

warscroll_ability.name: More-more Rats
warscroll_ability.lore: An endless tide of unholy vermin pours through the cracks in reality, their eyes aglow and their fangs unnaturally sharp.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D6)** this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Shrine Guardian
warscroll_ability.lore: Protected from attacks, the Shrine Guardian can move the metalith with but a fleeting thought.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian:

•  This terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 6" and can use non‑command non-**CHARGE MOVE** abilities as if it were a unit. It cannot end a **MOVE** ability within the combat range of an enemy unit.
•  The Shrine Guardian cannot use **MOVE** abilities and remains on this terrain feature each time it moves.
•  Instead of measuring range and visibility to the Shrine Guardian, measure to this terrain feature instead.
•  All attacks that would target the Shrine Guardian target this terrain feature instead.

If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shrine Guardian. Then, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian. If it is not possible to set up the Shrine Guardian, it is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Stuff 'Em In Me Bag
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gargants are known to grab hapless warriors and stuff them screaming into their bags ‘ for later’…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Heartwood Hunting Horn
warscroll_ability.lore: Grown in the forests of Kurnotheal, this horn emits a bold note that sends the thrill of the hunt rushing through the veins of their warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, when determining which effects of the ‘Song of the Hunt’ ability apply to the target, you count as having 1 additional chord.

warscroll_ability.name: Pick 'Em Off
warscroll_ability.lore: Boltboyz prefer to remain stationary to fire carefully aimed shots.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks if has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Fleeting Dance of Death
warscroll_ability.lore: Dexcessa rarely stays locked in combat in one place for long, flitting swiftly all over the battlefield and bringing death wherever they alight.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it is in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Feed On Mangled Remains
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is the appetite and metabolism of a Razorgor that it can consume a slain warrior, armour and all, in a matter of seconds and still remain unsatisfied.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Sneaky Infiltrators
warscroll_ability.lore: Night Runners are masters of stealth and can sneak up on almost anyone.
warscroll_ability.effect: While each model in this unit is within 1" of a terrain feature, this unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Fire, Blood and Vengeance
warscroll_ability.lore: Should their sire be imperilled, an Auric Runeson will fly into a berserk rage. Their mount echoes their fury, for the Magmadroth’s own progenitor is likely to be in just as much danger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Auric Runefather on Magmadroth** on the battlefield to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, while the target is in combat, damaged or destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Enshrouding Fumes
warscroll_ability.lore: Choking, miasmatic clouds swirl around a Plaguepack.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Utter Defilement
warscroll_ability.lore: The Cankerborn corrupt the land around them until it is so saturated with toxins and pathogens as to be nigh unrecognisable.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** are tokens. This unit has 2 **Pestilent Pollutants**. Pick an objective or terrain feature within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place 1 of this unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** next to the target. If both of this unit’s **Pestilent Pollutants** are already on the battlefield, pick 1 of them, remove it from the battlefield and place it next to the target instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Marshal of the Legions
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Not only formidable combatants, Centaurion Marshals lead the forces of the First Prince into battle with an iron fist.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAEMON** or **Chaos Legionnaires** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spawn of Sotek
warscroll_ability.lore: Should any of the Serpent God’s devoted skink acolytes come to harm, Kroxigor Warspawned are overcome with a terrifying rage.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **SKINK INFANTRY** or **SKINK CAVALRY** units in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Smash Down
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gatebreakers have a deep loathing of settlements, which they see as symbols of those who killed Behemat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is **FACTION TERRAIN**, inflict D3+3 mortal damage on it. Then, roll a D3 for each non-**MONSTER** unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of the target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Sonic Assault
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a barrage of ear-piercing shrieks, the Terrorgheist drops from the sky to savage its stunned prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each model in the target unit.

If 3 or more of the dice have the same value, for the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.

If 6 or more of the dice have the same value, for the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** and the target cannot use commands.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Runes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared an UR-GOLD RUNE ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Drawing upon the divine power released by sacred battle, Runemasters are able to awaken the full potential of their ur-gold runes.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Remove 3 of this unit’s **magmic power tokens**. If you do so, apply the effect below that corresponds to the **UR‑GOLD RUNE** ability that was used:

***Rune of Fury:*** For the rest of the battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units while they have **STRIKE-FIRST**.

***Rune of Fiery Determination:*** Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units for the rest of the battle round.

***Rune of Relentless Zeal:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units for the rest of the battle round.

***Rune of Searing Heat:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units for the rest of the battle round.

***Rune of Farsight:*** Increase the range of the ‘Rune of Farsight’ ability to 16".

warscroll_ability.name: Mortis Priest
warscroll_ability.lore: Though all mortals chosen by the God-King demonstrate their martial strength, those selected to become Lord-Relictors possess a rare wisdom that sets them apart.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Warlord of the First Circle
warscroll_ability.lore: Abraxia commands the Swords of Chaos with relentless brutality.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **Varanguard** unit uses the ‘Relentless Killers’ ability while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, that unit does not have **STRIKE-LAST** as a result of that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Captive Audience
warscroll_ability.lore: The Masque’s hypnotic movements make it nigh impossible for a viewer to focus their attention elsewhere.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
warscroll_ability.lore: Maulbeasts are always hungry; they do not let foes get close without leaping to attack.
