warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Bet-master
warscroll_ability.lore: Skumdrekk and his hobgrot Kountin’ Krew take bets at the start of a battle as to which of the enemy will be first to die.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be **the bet**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit and friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** units that target **the bet**.

warscroll_ability.name: Mortarch of Grief
warscroll_ability.lore: Those foolish enough to confront Lady Olynder soon find their will to fight faltering, replaced with an all-consuming sorrow and despair at the futility of their defiance.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll or unmodified wound roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Bellowing Waaagh!-Cries
warscroll_ability.lore: Spurred on by the carnage sweeping the battlefield, the Gork-Roara spews out great drifts of Waaagh! energy that orruks tap into – knowingly or otherwise.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** or **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick either 1 or 2 to add to casting rolls or chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number picked. For each 1-2, allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For each 5+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** or **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

Friendly units can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulscent
warscroll_ability.lore: The whirling blades of this fearsome chariot mow down the enemy, transmuting their souls into an exhilarating incense that drives its riders into an ecstatic frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Agony
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The aura that surrounds this malefic engine can be enhanced to nullify enemy hexes and resist even the most perfidious spellcraft.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• Enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot be set up within 12" of this unit.
• This unit has **WARD (4+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Well Travelled
warscroll_ability.lore: As a roaming sword-for-hire, Bren has a knack for finding her way into the best positions.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: The Queen's Dictat
warscroll_ability.lore: Lauka summons an arcane blood-mist that drives a beast among her brood into a terrible frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. If the target has any **Companion** melee weapons, you must pick 1 of those. Add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ripperdactyl Assault
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Ripperdactyl Chief is as ferocious as their mount, inspiring nearby Ripperdactyl Riders to attack with unbridled fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Moonstone Warspears** used by friendly **Ripperdactyl Riders** units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Da Glare of Frazzlegit
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: At a yell from the Snarlboss, the Wheela crews release the Hyshian light absorbed by the metal in their chariots.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• ﻿﻿Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **Sunsteala Wheelas**.
• ﻿﻿Add 6" to the Move characteristic of this unit and friendly **Sunsteala Wheelas**.

warscroll_ability.name: Bubonic Barrage
warscroll_ability.lore: A Plagueclaw hurls great globs of diseased filth at its targets that can send large formations into disarray.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. If the result is equal to or less than the number of models in that enemy unit that were slain by attacks made by this unit’s **Plagueclaw Catapult** this phase, that enemy unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP - Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: I'm Da Boss
warscroll_ability.lore: Loonbosses prefer to make their minions do all the fighting.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Moonclan Stabbas** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1:

***Beckon the Loonatic Hordes:*** If the target unit is not in combat, you can return D6 slain models to it.

***Stab ’Em Good!:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Tyrannical Packmaster
warscroll_ability.lore: Master Moulders use pain and terror to drive their fighting beasts into a battle frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **MOULDER** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Guardian Sword** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Butchering Blades** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Seeds of Rot
warscroll_ability.lore: Those that draw close to the Gardeners’ horticultural horrors are bound to be infected by rotsome blooms.
warscroll_ability.effect: When using the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability, if you choose to infect an enemy unit, you can pick an enemy unit that is contesting an objective that is **seeded with rot**.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Mortarch of the Necropolis
warscroll_ability.lore: As master of the Ossiarchs, Katakros instils in his legions the insatiable will to conquer and extend his dominion.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units that have used any **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** abilities this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Excess of Blades
warscroll_ability.lore: An Exalted Chariot inflicts horrendous carnage when it ploughs into the foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, the target suffers 1 mortal damage.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Invocation of Nagash
warscroll_ability.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rise Again
warscroll_ability.lore: The Tyrant’s Crown fulfilled Morlak’s desire for an eternal lineage – though not in the form he imagined.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit’s **King Morlak Velmorn** is on the battlefield, roll a dice for each slain model from this unit. On a 4+, you can return 1 slain model to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Lofted Shots
warscroll_ability.lore: To strike a distant target, these warriors point their bows to the sky before launching a volley, the soft sound of their loosed bowstrings like a breath of anticipation before the foe meets their doom..
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Auralan Bows** but subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Terror of the Deep Woods
warscroll_ability.lore: When faced with Drycha’s fury, even the most seasoned warriors feel like young rabbits frozen beneath the gaze of a hungry wolf.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use **RUN** or **RETREAT** abilities while they are within 9" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Impaling Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: A charging Chaos Knight is capable of spitting several enemies at once with the point of their ensorcelled polearm.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Cursed Lances** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Discomfiting Stench
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: So disturbing is the Blightkings’ odour that it can cause those with arcane or divine might to lose their focus.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice.

• If the target is a **WIZARD** and the roll exceeds the target’s power level, until the start of your next turn, each time a casting roll for the target includes 2 or more rolls of 1, 2 or more rolls of 2 or 2 or more rolls of 3, the spell is miscast.

• If the target is a **PRIEST** and the roll exceeds the target’s power level, until the start of your next turn, each time your opponent makes an unmodified chanting roll of 1 or 2 for the target, the prayer fails, its effect is not resolved and your opponent must remove D3 ritual points from the target. In addition, your opponent cannot give that **PRIEST** any ritual points for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Stuff 'Em In Me Bag
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gargants are known to grab hapless warriors and stuff them screaming into their bags ‘for later’…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is at least double the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Killing Blow
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Warbringers drive their spike-fists into already wounded enemies, exploiting the slightest gap in their foe’s defences to deliver a bloody coup de grâce.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a damaged enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of damage points the target has, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Vying for Glory
warscroll_ability.lore: Runesons seek their father’s favour in battle by slaying the most fearsome enemy creatures.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit destroys a **MONSTER**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Ancestral Weapons** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Stalk The Prey
warscroll_ability.lore: Karanak’s intended quarry is relentlessly and mercilessly run to ground.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s quarry is on the battlefield, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Flesh Hounds** unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield more than 6" from this unit’s quarry and more than 9" from all other enemy units. If picked to be a target, the unit of **Flesh Hounds** must also be set up wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Retribution or Salvation
warscroll_ability.lore: Cado’s quest for both vengeance and self-control manifests as two forms of sorcery: bolts of killing judgement and an aura of regal authority that augments nearby undead.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can cast this spell while its **Cado Ezechiar** is on the battlefield. Pick a visible unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Smouldering Braziers
warscroll_ability.lore: With each swing of a flamestrike poleaxe, the brazier chained to it arcs towards the foe, sparks and fire trailing in its wake.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of Impossibility
warscroll_ability.lore: The aura of maddening instability surrounding Tzeentch’s greatest daemons fuels their own power whilst ensuring that foes can scarcely land a telling blow.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Violent Despoilers
warscroll_ability.lore: Grashrak’s gor-kin leave a trail of wanton destruction in their wake, for they hate the trappings of civilisation with a bestial vehemence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is wholly outside friendly territory.

warscroll_ability.name: The Shield Inviolate
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleashed Warp-fury
warscroll_ability.lore: The warpstone hammered into the flesh of these creatures crackles with volatile energies, driving them into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Emergency Field Repairs
warscroll_ability.lore: Endrinriggers conduct intricate repair work even as battle rages around them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, **Heal (1)** the target. For each 6, **Heal (2)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Fount of Willpower
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **ISHARANN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is Lotann’s obsessive commitment to his duty that his willpower bleeds out into the ethersea, a potent magical force that can be drawn upon to empower his fellow Isharann.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **soul-quota tokens**. Then, you can re‑roll the casting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Stupefying Sneezes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The thick mucus ejected by a Spoilpox Scrivener is so revolting that those hit by it are overwhelmed by disgust.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Gobbapalooza Know-Wotz
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: From casting petty spells to scaring the other grots with bizarre performances, the Gobbapalooza is always up to something.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Glareface Dance:*** Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit within this unit’s combat range. Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for that unit until the start of your next turn.

***Nasty Poisons:*** Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ** unit within this unit’s combat range. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

***Mesmerise:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. Until the start of your next turn, that unit cannot use commands.

warscroll_ability.name: Debilitating Shot
warscroll_ability.lore: Kelthannor sends a steady stream of arrows whipping through the air to both maim and impede his quarry.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Empowered By Magic
warscroll_ability.lore: Kairic Acolytes absorb power from roving arcane manifestations to strengthen their own bodies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit is wholly within 12" of any **MANIFESTATIONS** (friendly or enemy).

warscroll_ability.name: Marked for Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who oppose the masters of these loyal beasts hear doom approaching in the beating of celestial wings.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** units if the target is within 9" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Icon of Slaughter
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaughter Queen calls out in a forbidden tongue and her acolytes surge to their feet, their exhaustion, injury and fear forgotten in an blur of bloodletting madness.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6. In addition, if there are any friendly **Hag Queens on Cauldrons of Blood** on the battlefield when that command is used, you receive D3 additional rally points.

warscroll_ability.name: Forest Fighters
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors fight in loosely scattered formations, the better to take advantage of the terrain in their arboreal domains.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Blessed Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: The blood of their liege grants these Flesh-eaters a supernatural regenerative capacity.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Bull-Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: The galloping charge of the Bull Centaurs tramples lesser beings beneath their hooves.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. Add the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has to each roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Sigils of Domination
warscroll_ability.lore: By carving runes of domination into a Slaughterbrute’s back and driving cursed blades of binding into its flesh, the monster’s will can be bound to a champion of Chaos.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO** within this unit’s combat range to be this unit’s master.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle, while this unit is within its master’s combat range:
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
• This unit can ignore the effects of the **Companion** weapon ability on its weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Saintly Assault
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Calling upon the celestial grace of Sigmar, the lords of the Steel Souls engage the foe with zealous wrath.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** units wholly within 6" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the targets.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Conquest
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Heeding Theddra Skull-scryer’s proclamations, the Godsworn Hunt seek to earn glory by driving back the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you control that is wholly within enemy territory, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Summon Wisper
warscroll_ability.lore: Focusing intently, Jacobus summons his spirit ally to aid him in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: If there is not a friendly **Wisper** on the battlefield, set up a friendly **Wisper** wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wolfguard
warscroll_ability.lore: Belladamma’s lupine allies will unthinkingly sacrifice themselves to protect their savage mistress.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire Wolves** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Shordemaire’s Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Festering Wounds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: A Sludgeraker’s talons and fangs are so coated with toxins and grime that wounds they inflict swiftly turn foul and gangrenous.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn by attacks made by this unit or a friendly unit with the **SLUDGERAKER VENOM** keyword to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the end of the next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Cosmic Engine
warscroll_ability.lore: The Engine of the Gods is an ancient device capable of disrupting the natural laws of the universe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick if this unit will harness or reserve the power of its cosmic engine.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If it will reserve the power, place a **cosmic power token** next to this unit.

If it will harness the power, roll a dice and add the number of **cosmic power tokens** this unit has to the roll. Then, remove all **cosmic power tokens** this unit has and pick 1 of the following effects (if possible).

***Healing Light:*** On a 3+, you can **Heal (D3)** all friendly **SERAPHON** units wholly within 12" of this unit.

***Starlight Summons:*** On a 5+, you can pick up to 3 friendly **SERAPHON** units wholly within 12" of this unit. Return 1 slain model to each unit.

***Time Slows:*** On a 6+, you can pick up to 3 friendly **SERAPHON** units wholly within 12" of this unit. Those units have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Unleashed Warp-Fury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Any Combat Phase, Once Per Battle
warscroll_ability.lore: The warpstone hammered into the flesh of these creatures crackles with volatile energies, driving them into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Raging Inferno
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Throwing back its head, a Magmadroth can spew a wave of flaming bile that scorches through enemy armour.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ensnaring Lash
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Lash of Khorne wraps around an enemy, stripping flesh as they try to pull away.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is in combat with this unit when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability:

• It must pick this unit to be the target of the pile-in move (Core Rules, 15.3).
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability against this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Call of the Mountains
warscroll_ability.lore: In the presence of Avalenor, the mountains awaken to give protection to their allies.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a visible friendly **ALARITH** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

warscroll_ability.name: Blazing Weapons
warscroll_ability.lore: The weapons of the Warforger's allies glow red-hot with magical power.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shepherd of Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Dankhold Troggboss bellows so loudly that the beasts of its herd come dangerously close to actually focusing their brutish efforts.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **TROGGOTH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Deathly Passage
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this **MANIFESTATION** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Holy Blades of Bone
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Crypt Horrors wield huge, monstrous femurs – as well as other grisly relics – as if they were blessed weapons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is **CAVALRY**. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Mobile Repairs
warscroll_ability.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Sacred Amphora
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The vessel that Inara carries contains pure, life-giving liquid that was taken from the Everspring long ago.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (2D3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Unflagging Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: When blood is scented, nothing will keep a Flesh Hound from its prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadowcreep
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Spite-Revenants have an affinity with the oppressive dark of the deepwood. They are able to dissolve into the shadows at will, creeping along the spirit paths before emerging once more where the enemy least expect it.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wither
warscroll_ability.lore: The Grey Seer hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Stolen Hours
warscroll_ability.lore: The bearer of a Sword of Stolen Hours can steal vital energy from a foe and use it to increase their own power.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to enemy units by combat attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Beckon The Hunt
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The air shudders and convulses with each crack of the Bloodthirster's whip as it drives those in its shadow to bring slaughter and bloodshed in the name of Khorne.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE BLADES OF KHORNE DAEMON** unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, when making charge rolls for the target, roll 1 additional dice, to a maximum of 3, and discard 1 dice of your choice.

warscroll_ability.name: Warrior-Kings
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With discipline and zeal in equal measure, the Runefather inspires his warriors to bring down the wrath of Grimnir upon any who oppose them.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of Daemonic Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Taar is ancient and learned beyond measure and he can control the ebb and flow of the daemonic energy coursing through his army at will.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove up to 3 **daemonic power points** in total from any combination of friendly units wholly within 18" of this unit. Then, allocate them to a different friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 18" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Lifebloom
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Just as the Burgeoning follows Everdusk, the restorative energies of Ghyran heal Alarielle’s wounds with cyclical inevitability.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (2D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Captain of the Plague Legions
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Poxbringers lead their fellow Plaguebearers into battle and ensure that the orders of the Great Unclean Ones are followed to the letter.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Charge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Zandtos drives his attack home, enemy formations crumble and counter-attacks stall.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: The targets have **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Attack from on High
warscroll_ability.lore: Terradons circle high in the sky, only darting down for a brief moment to launch a strafing run.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Squig Rage
warscroll_ability.lore: As Mangler Squigs are wounded in battle, they become even more irate and violent.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** is 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Fissures In Reality
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who resist Vizzik's will are swallowed by fang-mouthed fissures that wrench open in his presence.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Entropy Endures
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is the Cankerborn’s resilience that they are almost impossible to banish back to the Garden.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has 2 models and would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, 1 model in this unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood Sacrifice
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaughterpriest answers their god’s call for blood by sacrificing one of their own.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and you gain 1 **blood tithe point**.

warscroll_ability.name: Incoming!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The skyvessel fires a close-range fusillade at a foe bearing down upon it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Lest You Forget...
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or CHARGE ability for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Sekhar’s presence is a tangible reminder of hidden obligations to the vampiric nation of Nulahmia, causing foes to deliberately foul their own forces’ efforts so that their clandestine allegiances remain undiscovered.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick 1 dice from the charge roll or casting roll for that ability. Your opponent must re-roll that dice.

warscroll_ability.name: The Shield Inviolate
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Envoys of the Everqueen
warscroll_ability.lore: Kurnoth Hunters can channel a fraction of their goddess’s divine power through those sites that resonate with the realmroots.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective, friendly units contesting that objective have **WARD (6+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Burning Vengeance
warscroll_ability.lore: An Everblaze Comet smashes into the battlefield with tremendous force, its glowing remnants radiating a corona of deadly Azyrite energies.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** was summoned this phase, pick any number of enemy units within 6" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: The Thirteen-headed One
warscroll_ability.lore: Lord Verminking can call upon his extensive knowledge of the Skaven clans.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per battle.

***Master of Dire Sorcery:*** Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **MASTERCLAN WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Commander of Vermin:*** Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **VERMINUS** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Knower of Warp-tech:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **SKRYRE** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Deliverer of Weeping Blades:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **ESHIN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Bringer of Plagues:*** Add 1 to chanting rolls for friendly **PESTILENS PRIESTS** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Shaper of Fleshcraft:*** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tanglethorn Thickets
warscroll_ability.lore: Scythe-wielding Kurnoth Hunters have developed the technique of summoning carpets of thorned vines that snare and shred foes who approach without caution.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that is in combat with the target. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Howl of Blood-Curdling Savagery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Mighty Lord of Khorne leads whole tribes into battle from the front lines. Their ferocious bellows are as much a call to arms as they are a threat not to be caught shirking in the sacred duty of committing murder and slaughter in the Blood God’s name.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly **BLOODBOUND** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1⁄2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the target has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Wit of Beasts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Shaman curses the enemy with an atavistic madness, causing them to see themselves as the beasts they ride – or as the beast within.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **MONSTER** or **CAVALRY** unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target’s melee weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of the Marauder
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These bloodthirsty tribal warriors loudly declare vows of violence and slaughter as they race after their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s weapons for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Outrunners of Chaos
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Packs of Chaos Warhounds close upon their prey with unnatural quickness.
warscroll_ability.effect: Change one of the dice in the charge roll to a 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Allow Me to Remind You...
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: As Neferata’s premier agent in the Mortal Realms, Sekhar’s authority and near matchless powers of hypnotism ensure few have the willpower to resist her demands.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Da Frazzlefangz
warscroll_ability.lore: Glareface Frazzlegit’s reflected gaze angrily beams out from Droggz’s flashy back-banner, blinding nearby enemies so he can crack their skulls while they can’t see.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit:

•  Subtract 1 from hit rolls for that enemy unit’s attacks.
•  That enemy unit cannot use the ‘All-out Attack’ command.

warscroll_ability.name: The Doom of Traitors
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The dread abyssal Razarak bears Arkhan into battle, seeking out those who have stoked the ire of the Great Necromancer.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. Add 1 to the roll if the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST.** On a 2+, add an amount equal to the roll to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Razarak's Ebon Claws** for the rest of the phase, but while this unit is in combat with the target, all attacks made with that weapon this phase must target that enemy unit.

**Designer's Note:** *If the target is a* **WIZARD** *or* **PRIEST,** *this ability cannot fail; however, you still need to roll to determine the number of extra attacks it generates.*

warscroll_ability.name: Zondara Rivenheart
warscroll_ability.lore: Zondara infuses savage Ghurish magic into her minions, granting them bestial strength even in their undeath.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Zondara Rivenheart** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Phase Ink
warscroll_ability.lore: Cephanyr emits a cloud of ink as black as the abyss that shrouds the enemy and sows confusion.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Cephanyr** is on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rain of Scrap
warscroll_ability.lore: Salvaged weapons and shards of metal rain down upon the enemy, forcing them to take cover or dodge out of the way.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any models slain this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughterer's Call
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A feral roar by the Doombull alerts the warherd to the scent of flesh on the wind, sending them into an attacking frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **WARHERD** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Burning Up
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time this **MANIFESTATION** uses a **SHOOT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this **MANIFESTATION** (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

warscroll_ability.name: Avian Swiftness
warscroll_ability.lore: The Shaman invests nearby allies with avian speed, allowing them to close with the foe in moments.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ferocious Advance
warscroll_ability.lore: Volleys of enemy fire do nothing to dissuade these bestial warriors from running down the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Unending Will To Conquer
warscroll_ability.lore: Abraxia once consumed the flesh of the High Anointed of the Temple of the Ur-Phoenix, an act swiftly followed by her desecration of the sacred flame at the shrine’s heart. Now, when the thrill of battle ignites within her, the power of rebirth sees her wounds rapidly heal over as if they had never occurred.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you do not control. **Heal (D6)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pulled Into The Depths
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The viciously barbed crulhook can ensnare unfortunate foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dark Flight
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: A hapless foe is crushed in the talons of Ariax before the Morrgryph takes flight once more with a beat of their ebon wings.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic:

• 1 model in the target unit is slain.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted upon it.

warscroll_ability.name: Unstoppable Momentum
warscroll_ability.lore: Once a Maw-grunta begins its charge, it can only stop by crashing into something, and it becomes ever more deadly as its speed increases.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time this unit has charged as a result of using a **CHARGE** ability, it gains 1 **momentum point**.

Each time it uses a **RUN** ability, it gains 2 **momentum points.** It can have a maximum of 3 **momentum points** at once.

Add the number of **momentum points** this unit has to the Damage characteristic of its **Maw-grunta’s Tusks.** At the end of each battle round, subtract 1 from its **momentum points**, to a minimum of 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Driven by Hunger
warscroll_ability.lore: Gutbusters cannot wait to meet and eat the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Horrific Predators
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Khorgoraths are nightmarish beasts, given form only to harvest skulls.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ferocious Hunger
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Assailed by visions of the glorious feast to come, the abhorrant’s steed is filled with a hunger-driven impetus.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ancient Master of War
warscroll_ability.lore: Karazai has seen countless battles over the heady span of his life, and the reptilian fury he displays can overpower any foe.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Grasping Gunge
warscroll_ability.lore: The arcane protoplasm of a Morkspit Marsh seizes limbs tight, dragging at those who draw too close.
warscroll_ability.effect: Enemy units cannot use **RUN** abilities while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Alpha Roar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Aggradons ridden by Scar-Veterans are the most violent examples of a brutal species. When they throw back their heads to unleash a earsplitting roar, their kin soon follow suit.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and each friendly **Aggradon Lancers** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, place a **rage token** next to each target, to a maximum of 3 per unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunting Hounds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Knight-Judicator sends one of their Gryph-hounds to harass an enemy unit.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit was not set up this turn and any of this unit’s **Gryph‑hounds** are on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, remove 1 of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** from the battlefield. On a 2+, pick 1 of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** that is next to this unit or next to an enemy unit and place it next to the target instead.

While any of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are next to an enemy unit, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target that unit.

If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are next to it, place those **Gryph-hounds** next to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Seasons of War
warscroll_ability.lore: Alarielle and her children are fundamentally intertwined with the shifting of the seasons, and their abilities and temperaments alter accordingly. It is within the power of the goddess to temporarily manipulate this state of being, should she wish it.
warscroll_ability.declare: You must use this ability.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle round. You cannot pick the effect that you picked in the previous battle round.

***The Burgeoning:*** Each time a friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** uses the ‘Ever Growing’ ability, you can pick any terrain feature your opponent does not control to be the target rather than the closest.

***The Reaping:*** Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **SYLVANETH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

***The Dwindling:*** Friendly **SYLVANETH** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on those units when they use **Retreat** abilities.

***Everdusk:*** Each time you use the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability this battle round, you can pick up to 3 targets instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Vassals, to Arms!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Standing tall in the midst of the melee, this regal lord swiftly delivers an impassioned speech that inspires nearby serfs.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Keep Counting, I'm Watching You
warscroll_ability.lore: Spoilpox Scriveners are responsible for making sure that the Plaguebearers of the tallybands do not shirk their duties
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Plaguebearers** unit wholly within 14" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following. The effect lasts until the start of your next turn.

***Tally of Blows:*** Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s melee weapons.

***Recorded Stamina:*** Add 1 to save rolls for the target unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Slicing Fervour
warscroll_ability.lore: As the blissbarb arrows dig deep, the Dread Pageant follow up in an ecstatic frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it is in combat with a **blissmarked** unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Endrinmaster Extraordinaire
warscroll_ability.lore: This Endrinmaster’s rig bristles with tools and gizmos that allow them to perform battlefield repairs with great haste.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit with the **FLY** keyword that is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** the target where **X** is equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Lord of Great Plagues
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: If the raving prayers of Pestilens priests reach fever pitch across the battlefield, the Verminlord Corruptor can cause one of the legendary Great Plagues to temporarily manifest.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the unmodified chanting roll for a friendly **PESTILENS PRIEST** this phase was 6, pick 1 of the following effects to apply:

***Crimsonweal Curse:*** Pick an enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the battle, each time the target uses a **MOVE** ability, inflict D3 mortal damage on it after the **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

***The Neverplague:*** For the rest of the battle, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly **PESTILENS PRIESTS**.

***Undulant Scourge:*** Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target. Inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Crimson Haze
warscroll_ability.lore: A frenzy-inducing cloud of blood and gore fills the air wherever Wrathmongers swing their flails.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **BLOODBOUND** units, excluding **Wrathmongers** units, while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Kiss of the Blade Proboscian
warscroll_ability.lore: This pitted and corroded blade should not endure – and yet, it does. The same cannot be said for anything scratched by its mouldering point.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Supremacy
warscroll_ability.lore: By the will of the gods, this warrior leads her barbarous horde into the lands of the enemy, allowing none to oppose them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Scaled Protectors
warscroll_ability.lore: Ro-Tak and So-Kar know no other purpose than to follow and protect Kro-Jax until their dying breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Kro-Jax** is on the battlefield, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Ruinous Bombardment
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who survive the initial unmaking wave of raw Chaos energy laid down by a Tormentor Bombard are left addled and disoriented.
warscroll_ability.declare:
If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, that enemy unit is the target.

Then, you can pick a number of enemy units within 6" of the target equal to the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has to be additional targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, that unit cannot use commands until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Slaughterborn
warscroll_ability.lore: Skarr Bloodwrath has been killed on battlefields beyond count, but each time he has been reborn amidst the clash of blades and the screams of the dying.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Fierce Guardians
warscroll_ability.lore: The defenders of these ancient edifices will stop at nothing to see any intruders driven back.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SAURUS** or **KROXIGOR** units that target an enemy unit while that enemy unit is within 9" of this terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Staff of the Horned Rat
warscroll_ability.lore: Said to be crafted from scrap thieved from the Horned Rat’s lair, Thanquol’s staff thrums with malign potency.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Can't Stop!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Blackpowder Squire dashes to another unit amidst the mayhem of battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **Freeguild Fusiliers** unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit's **Blackpowder Squire** token from the battlefield, then give it to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Lead the Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: Mounted Lord Regents are not passive strategists who command from positions of safety; they are bold tacticians who lead from the front, inspiring courage in those around them.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Release Arcane Charge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** or **UNBIND** ability for a **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS WIZARD** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**
warscroll_ability.lore: The Lumineth draw out the power absorbed by the twinstones.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add this **MANIFESTATION’**s **arcane charge points** to the casting roll or unbinding roll. Then, reset this **MANIFESTATION’**s **arcane charge points** to 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Ark of Sotek
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: So numerous are the snakes unleashed by an Ark of Sotek that some will find their way past the foe’s defences to deliver a lethal venomous bite.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 different enemy units within 9" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Fleet of Foot
warscroll_ability.lore: Skaeth’s Wild Hunt advance on their foes with the speed of an autumn gale.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Scaled Protectors
warscroll_ability.lore: The saurus bodyguard know no other purpose than to follow and protect their Sunblood leader until their dying breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit includes a **Sunblood,** ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase and add 1 to this unit's control score.

warscroll_ability.name: Fuelled By Sorcery
warscroll_ability.lore: A Darkfire Daemonrift absorbs magical power, widening and expelling ever more gouts of ruinous sorcery as it hungrily devours arcane energies.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time a spell is successfully cast by a unit within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**, give this **MANIFESTATION** 1 **ruinous energy point**, to a maximum of 6.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** uses a **SHOOT** ability, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Darkfire Torrent** for each **ruinous energy point** it has.

If this **MANIFESTATION** is removed from play, all of its **ruinous energy points** are lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Watch Out!
warscroll_ability.lore: Mangler Squigs are capable of great destruction even in their wildly bouncing death throes.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice for each enemy unit within this unit’s combat range. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Spell-eaters
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: These spirits were once wizards, but they failed to pay proper respect to Nagash and are now cursed to agonisingly withstand the magic of others.
warscroll_ability.effect: If a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, this unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1).** Add 1 to the unbinding roll for that ability. If the spell is unbound, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

warscroll_ability.name: Scaled Protectors
warscroll_ability.lore: The saurus bodyguard know no other purpose than to protect their Sunblood leader until their dying breath.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative and positive modifiers to save rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Wails of the Damned
warscroll_ability.lore: Unnerving howls follow this macabre carriage wherever it roams.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Another Link in the Chain
warscroll_ability.lore: Chainghasts act as conduits for Spirit Torments, ensuring all nearby Nighthaunt are invigorated by deathly energies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **Spirit Torments.** On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Master of Order
warscroll_ability.lore: The slann are amongst the greatest wizards in existence, but Lord Kroak is mighty even in comparison to others of his kind.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls, and add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit can use an **UNBIND** ability if an enemy **WIZARD** anywhere on the battlefield uses a **SPELL** ability instead of an enemy **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit, and when using the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, this unit can pick a manifestation anywhere on the battlefield instead of within 30" of it.

warscroll_ability.name: Heralds of Ruination
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Paragons of the Dark Gods, Chaos Chosen cut a swathe through the enemy lines, leaving nothing but blood and ruin in their wake.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Power of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The primordial power of Behemat clings still to King Brodd, his favoured son.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects. If the chanting roll was 10+, pick 2 instead:

***Shatter the Mountains:*** Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** units for the rest of the turn.

***Might of the Earth:*** **Heal (D3)** each friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** unit.

***Pummel All to Dust:*** For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the **Obelisk of Tor Crania**, **Menhir Club**, **Fortcrusha Flail**, **Shipwrecka Warclub**, **Titanic Boulderclub** and **Massive Club** used by friendly **SONS OF BEHEMAT** units.

warscroll_ability.name: Attention Seekers
warscroll_ability.lore: Beasts of Nurgle seek out playmates with an enthusiasm that is rarely reciprocated by the horrified source of their fascination.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Overwhelming Storm
warscroll_ability.lore: Few can stand before the unleashed power of the Sacrosanct chambers.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is contesting an objective that you control, pick a friendly non-**HERO STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Cavalry Warleader
warscroll_ability.lore: The Darkoath Chieftain leads the cavalry swiftly into the enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **DARKOATH CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Beneath The Tempest
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Dark clouds gather above the battlefield, threatening to unleash the fury of the tempest.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll. Then, roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadow-lurkers
warscroll_ability.lore: The Corvus Cabal favour stalking their prey and striking from unexpected angles.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lurking in the shadows**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Up We Go!
warscroll_ability.lore: The orruk hauls themselves up to the idol’s platform.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shouty Boss, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY HERO** that is not in combat and is within 3" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shouty Boss (see ‘Man da Tower!’).

warscroll_ability.name: Sarrakkar Blackwing
warscroll_ability.lore: Sarrakkar channels the howling fury of the beast-spirits to power his sorcery.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Sarrakkar Blackwing** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Croneseer
warscroll_ability.lore: Chosen by Morai-Heg, Krethusa is the vessel through which the aelven goddess implements her plans.
warscroll_ability.effect: Give this unit D3 ritual points.

warscroll_ability.name: A Traitor's Legacy
warscroll_ability.lore: The continued declaration of Valentian’s horrifically wicked deeds in life can often give nearby gheists particularly grim inspiration of what horrors to inflict upon the living.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Regicide and Kinslaying:*** The target’s melee weapons have **ANTI‐HERO (+1 REND)**.

***Usurpation and Larceny:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.

***Sedition and Betrayal:*** Enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with the target.

warscroll_ability.name: The Staff of Spirits
warscroll_ability.lore: Khenash-an, the Staff of Spirits, grants Arkhan the power to absorb the souls of his foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. Each time this unit successfully casts a spell, **Heal (1)** this unit after that **SPELL** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Fuel for the Flames
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Even the blazing ruin of its own kind serves a Fateskimmer’s ends, each death fuelling the spreading fires.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, before removing it from play, gain 1 **fate point**.

warscroll_ability.name: Inescapable Wrath
warscroll_ability.lore: No one is safe from Skarbrand’s rampages.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Feed on Eldritch Energy
warscroll_ability.lore: As predators of preternatural threats, Gladewyrms readily devour the energies that the enemy draws upon to fuel their spells and rituals.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls, unbinding rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this **Manifestation**.

warscroll_ability.name: Restored Vigour
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (3)** this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Magical Resistance
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: The realmstone-infused mushrooms that Dankhold Troggoths consume make them naturally resistant to the effects of magic.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Step Away From The Maw
warscroll_ability.lore: The Head Butcher descends from the platform in search of fresh meat.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**.

warscroll_ability.name: Fight and Flight
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Khinerai are masters of the hit-and-run strike; Lifetakers bleed and maim their victims before darting away.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 12". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Drawn to War
warscroll_ability.lore: When the champions of the Nighthaunt muster their processions for battle, Spirit Hosts flock to join their cause, serving as useful fodder for the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Your general has **WARD (4+)** while they are within 1" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: The Light of Sigmar
warscroll_ability.lore: With its shutters closed, the lantern of a Knight-Azyros soothes nearby allies. Opening it wide blinds the enemy with the full majesty of Sigmar's light.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• **Heal (D3)** each friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit within this unit's combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Power Unleashed
warscroll_ability.lore: The waves of power that spread from an activated Realmshaper Engine bring the surrounding landscape to violent life.
warscroll_ability.declare: If there are any friendly **SERAPHON WIZARDS** within 3" of this terrain feature, pick another terrain feature within 24" of this terrain feature, then pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If that terrain feature has a Health characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Cruel Sacrifice
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sorceress shows no mercy as she slits the throat of a nearby thrall and draws power from the blood that gushes forth.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF** unit wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn. Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Bite Da Moon!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a manic shriek, the Loonboss drives nearby squigs into an even greater frenzy, goading them to chomp through the enemy’s lines with all haste so that they can continue their pursuit of the Bad Moon.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and all friendly **SQUIG** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with the targets’ **Fang-filled Gobs,** **Massive Fang-filled Gobs** and **Huge Fang-filled Gobs** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Black-hearted Conqueror
warscroll_ability.lore: Those sworn to serve beneath a Despot must offer them conquest and tribute or suffer the consequences…
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has any **daemonic power points**, friendly units with 0 **daemonic power points** count as having 1 **daemonic power point** while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit. For each **daemonic power point** this unit has, add 3" to the range of this ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Dead 'Ard
