warscroll_ability.lore: Whether through natural hardiness or sheer belligerence, Ironskull and his boyz fight on through the most grievous wounds, hollering and cheering as they batter their foes into the ground.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Wall of Blades
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Vanari Lord Regent is a master of anticipating where the enemy will strike and preparing their warriors accordingly.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **VANARI AURALAN WARDENS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the wall of blades. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the wall of blades to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the wall of blades that is within 3" of the target. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Bitey Distractions
warscroll_ability.lore: The pesky beasts that flock to Mollog often prove to be an unwelcome distraction to the troggoth’s foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while any of its tokens are on the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: 'For Glory! For Blood!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Vampire Lord and their retinue of favoured knights charge into the fray, driving deep into the enemy lines.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. Then, before the charge move is made, you can pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of this unit and has not used a **CHARGE** ability this turn to be the target. If this unit charges, then, immediately after the **CHARGE** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: On Wings of Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ariax swoops over the heads of the foe, wrong-footing charging enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield within 1" of the target.

• If the target charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bloodfury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The maddening blood-vapour that surrounds Wrathmongers can plunge their foes into a self-destructive rage.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Both players roll off. If you win the roll-off, pick a melee weapon that the target is armed with. Your opponent must pick a visible unit in their army within 3" of the target (they can pick the target's own unit, and even if it is a single-model unit).

Your opponent must resolve combat attacks for the target using the melee weapon you picked against the unit they picked.

warscroll_ability.name: Magical Focus
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Argent Shards act as channelling foci through which Tzeentch’s spellcasters can launch their devastating arcane bombardments.
warscroll_ability.effect: The next time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses a **SPELL** ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from this terrain feature instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to this terrain feature instead of to the caster for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: The Scent of Gore
warscroll_ability.lore: The taste of hot blood on the tongue sends these abominations into a killing mania.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit that target a damaged unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Wurrgog Mask
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The shaman taps into the power of their mask, unleashing the full might of their deadly green bolts – but if they stare too long, their head may explode!
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Deadly Green Bolts** is 12 instead of D6.
• For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a shooting attack made by this unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Assault Boat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Frigate is designed to deliver warriors directly into the fray.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, that are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:

• Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
• This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another **CORE** ability this phase.
• Pick up to 1 of the targets to have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Whirlwind of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: With the light of Grimnir burning in their eyes, these impetuous warriors hurl themselves into the fray, leaving a trail of death in their wake.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if this unit charged this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Deranged Transformation
warscroll_ability.lore: Wielding the power of their curse, the abhorrant causes the limbs of a nearby pack to bulge and lengthen, allowing the creatures to charge forwards at a furious pace.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, until the start of your next turn, add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic and add 1 to wound rolls for its attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Grief-stricken
warscroll_ability.lore: Lady Olynder’s incantations can cause a pall of misery and utter desolation to descend upon her enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore positive modifiers to the target's control score and to hit rolls, wound rolls and save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: I Got Dis, Boss
warscroll_ability.lore: Wolfgitz look out for their Snarlboss in battle, if only because it makes knifin’ him later easier once he’s let his guard down.
warscroll_ability.effect: While a friendly **Snarlboss** is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that **Snarlboss** have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Scrap Away!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The enemy’s manoeuvres are disrupted as a hail of scrap pummels them from above.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. In addition, on a 5+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Klonk
warscroll_ability.lore: This rockbrow squig’s headache is only relieved by a bash on the head, making it the perfect portable anvil.
warscroll_ability.effect:
**Klonk** is a token. You can re-roll forgin’ rolls for this unit while this unit’s **Klonk** is on the battlefield. 

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove this unit’s **Klonk** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

warscroll_ability.name: Noxious Vomit
warscroll_ability.lore: The bilious digestive fluids chucked up by a Fellwater Troggoth can swiftly corrode even sigmarite plate.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit’s **Noxious Vomit**, that unit is **drenched in vomit** until the start of your next turn.

While a unit is **drenched in vomit**:
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for that unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Budding Forests
warscroll_ability.lore: Once awakened, a wyldwood will rapidly grow into an entire forest in a matter of days, should the Sylvaneth successfully repel those who would threaten its flourishing.
warscroll_ability.effect: When this terrain feature is set up, give it a friendly **overgrown token**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrath of Khaine
warscroll_ability.lore: Khaine’s subjects channel their faith through this bladed idol of the Murder God, allowing it to carry out acts of monstrous carnage.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add **X** to the Attacks characteristic of this **MANIFESTATION**’s melee weapons, where **X** is the number of times you have used the ‘Blessings of Khaine’ ability this battle, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulscent
warscroll_ability.lore: The whirling blades of this fearsome chariot mow down the enemy, transmuting their souls into an exhilarating incense that drives its riders into an ecstatic frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lead Da Brutes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Megabosses stride into battle flanked either side by the toughest and meanest Brutes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **BRUTE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Extremis Chamber
warscroll_ability.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Graceful Leaps
warscroll_ability.lore: The agility and deer-like lower bodies of these Kurnothi allow them to leap right over the heads of the foe in the middle of combat.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time this unit makes a pile-in move:
• Add 3" to the distance this unit can move.
• This unit can pass through models in enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Wave Rider
warscroll_ability.lore: When an Akhelian King charges the foe, they hit with the power of a crashing wave.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Akhelian Royal Weapons** for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Dark Sacrifice
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sarrakkar Blackwing spits forth a vile curse, pledging to offer up the souls of his enemies and thereby quench the thirst of the Dark Gods.
warscroll_ability.effect: If an unmodified casting roll for this unit this phase was 8+, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Ogor Breacher
warscroll_ability.lore: With their masterforged armour and unwavering spirit, an **Ogor Breacher** can weather all manner of blows.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit includes an Ogor Breacher, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Tide of Nurglings
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Morbidex’s pox maggoth bellows out a gurgling roar that drives nearby swarms of Nurglings into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Nurglings** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+:
• If the target is not in combat, it can move a number of inches equal to the roll but cannot end that move in combat.
• If the target is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.

warscroll_ability.name: Light Bomb Racks
warscroll_ability.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Aethermatic Anatomiser
warscroll_ability.lore: Thundrik harnesses the power of his Aethermatic Anatomiser to obscure the loot so they can safely recover the plunder beneath the noses of their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Bjorgen Thundrik** is on the battlefield, pick an objective within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is controlled by either player, that player loses control of that objective.
• The target cannot be contested until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Pick 'Em Off
warscroll_ability.lore: Once set up in position, the Beast-skewer Killbow takes its time to line up every shot with deadly results.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Stab-grot
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Stab-grot** is a token. If this unit’s **Stab-grot** has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Stab-grot’s Shiv** and it cannot use the ‘Unleash the Stab-grot!’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Purity
warscroll_ability.lore: Gardus’s faith is so strong when he is in full flow that even Nurgle’s garden was unable to corrupt him.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Scion of the Primordial Storm
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
warscroll_ability.lore: The untrammelled fury of the primordial storm flows through this creature, a fulminating power so intense that it can render malevolent sorceries harmless.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit or a friendly **Dragon Ogors** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Trail of Destruction
warscroll_ability.lore: Warriors are sent sprawling, set aflame and trampled underhoof as the Wildfire Taurus charges headlong through their ranks.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Chief's Deadly Cargo
warscroll_ability.lore: Terradons carry heavy boulders hewn from meteoric rock and carved with sigils of destruction. When these are dropped upon enemy lines, those not immediately crushed are sent flying in all directions.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice and add 2 to the roll if this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **Terradon Riders** units. On a 5+:

• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• If any damage points are allocated by this ability and the target does not have **FLY**, the target cannot use **RUN** abilities until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrath of the Seraphon
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Oldblood directs nearby saurus to act upon their savage instincts.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SAURUS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Soporific Musk
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Fiend exudes a pervasive and oily musk that numbs a foe to all but the most extreme of stimuli.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bewilderblast Rounds
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These specialist rounds emit a riot of light and sound, severely disrupting the targets’ cohesion.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract D6 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Mir Kainan
warscroll_ability.lore: Mir Kainan is a master of necromancy as well as a formidable fighter.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Mir Kainan** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**, **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE (2)** and can be picked as the target of the ‘Immortal Elite’ ability as if it had the **HERO** keyword.

warscroll_ability.name: Vanguard Chamber
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Treacherous Bond
warscroll_ability.lore: By creating a psycho-conductive link, the Blue Scribes can siphon the worst of any harm that befalls them to allies nearby.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make an unmodified ward roll of 1-3 for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle-fury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Hewing left and right with their greataxe, a Grimwrath Berzerker enters a state of singleminded frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Cold-blooded Unity
warscroll_ability.lore: The blasts unleashed by Raptadon Chargers’ sacred lances are all the more effective when targeting enemies suppressed by javelins from a Hunter cohort.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks if they target an enemy unit that was targeted by shooting attacks made by a friendly **Raptadon** **Hunters** unit in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Grutta's Horn and Hooves** is 5

warscroll_ability.name: Wall of Meat
warscroll_ability.lore: Bulky and stubborn, Gluttons are remarkably hard to shift.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: A Promising Concoction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The gory contents of the Coven Throne’s scrying bowl can be consumed by its riders and other vampires nearby, giving them a flush of power.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VAMPIRE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: The Staff of Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bushwakka's Trap
warscroll_ability.lore: With a satisfying snap, this crude iron trap springs up on the legs of an unwitting enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect: The first time an enemy unit finishes a move within 1" of the objective or terrain feature with this unit’s **Bushwakka’s Trap** next to it, remove that **Bushwakka’s Trap** from the battlefield, then roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Latching Paraspites
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Twistweald are riddled with horrific parasitic plants and fungi that latch onto others nearby, draining them of their vitality.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has the **INFESTED** keyword for the rest of the battle. **INFESTED** enemy units cannot move more than 6" when using non‑**CHARGE MOVE** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: The Sword of Unholy Power
warscroll_ability.lore: Gheistvor drinks deep of its victims’ souls, bolstering the power of Mannfred’s risen minions.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has slain any enemy models this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Regeneration
warscroll_ability.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Icon of Grimnir
warscroll_ability.lore: The Battlesmith raises their icon of Grimnir and recounts tales of past glories, inspiring their allies and setting their ur-gold runes ablaze so that they might fight until the bitter end.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **FYRESLAYERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Squiggly Curse
warscroll_ability.lore: The shaman transforms an enemy into a tiny squiggly beast. Scooping up the indignant creature, the shaman bags himself a new squeaky wotsit that he can squeeze to boost his spells.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is destroyed by this spell, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Stuncloud Auto-Endrin
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Stuncloud spews an alchemical substance that stuns and disorients.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is a **Stuncloud Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is equal to or lower than that target’s Health characteristic, subtract 10 from the control score of that target for the rest of the turn. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Grisly Trophies
warscroll_ability.lore: Garrek delights in brandishing grim souvenirs to stoke his warriors’ bloodlust.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in a **Blades of Khorne** army and any enemy models were slain this turn by this unit’s attacks, you gain 1 **blood tithe point**.

warscroll_ability.name: Necromantic Limits
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Mechanisms of Time
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.effect:
If there are any friendly **WIZARDS** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Increase Time Flow***: Until the start of your next turn, you can re roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

***Decrease Time Flow***: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Countless Servants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a chilling shriek, the Archregent summons some of their most trusted warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SERFS** or **KNIGHTS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is a **SERFS** unit, you can return up to 3 slain models to that unit.
• If the target is a **KNIGHTS** unit, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Hand of Dust
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Volcanic Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Born of fire and flame, Magmadroths pulse with the throbbing heat of the volcanic caverns in which they make their fyrenests.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: The Starseer harnesses their deep connection with Azyr to subtly shift the alignment of the stars above, altering the path of fate and spelling doom for those who stand in the way of the Great Plan.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wave Rider
warscroll_ability.lore: When an Akhelian King charges the foe, they hit with the power of a crashing wave.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Scuttling Terror
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Arachnarok uses its terrifying speed to its advantage, scuttling over and sinking its fangs into the enemy before they have a chance to react.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it must end that move in combat.

Then, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Fire and Flight
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Khinerai are masters of the hit-and-run strike; Heartrenders loose volleys of sharpened projectiles before darting away.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Accusations of Regicide
warscroll_ability.lore: Of the many crimes Gormayne is empowered to punish, few stir his jury to a frenzy more than an attempt to harm the nobility.
warscroll_ability.effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SERFS** and **KNIGHTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES** that had any damage points allocated to them in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Extract Power
warscroll_ability.lore: The hateful chanting of Hashut’s priesthood rips energy from the realms.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, a **Place of Power**, or a terrain feature and that objective, **Place of Power** or terrain feature has a friendly desolation token, give this unit 1 ritual point.

warscroll_ability.name: On Wings of Brilliance
warscroll_ability.lore: Yndrasta soars across the battlefield to strike at the heart of Sigmar’s enemies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Attackers
warscroll_ability.lore: Blightkings grind through the battlelines of lesser foes, shattering their morale and hacking down the stunned survivors with contemptuous ease.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target and roll a dice for each model in this unit that is within the target unit’s combat range.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each roll that exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict 1 mortal damage on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Savage Bellow
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sunblood looses a fearsome bellow, inspiring a fearsome savagery in his warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, the target's weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn, including **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Serpentine Agility
warscroll_ability.lore: Sekhar moves as a blinding blur, her unnatural speed obscuring her form from even the keenest gaze.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Karthaen
warscroll_ability.lore: With a blast of his horn, the air itself comes to the aid of Karthaen.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Karthaen**, **Huntcaller**, is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Catchweb Spidershrine
warscroll_ability.lore: This ramshackle altar to the Spider God shimmers with malevolent arcane energy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **SPIDERFANG WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul Eruption
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a Vault of Souls glut itself too greedily, the captured spirits within will burst free, tearing at those nearby in their desperation to escape.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** has 6 **soul points,** pick any number of enemy units within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 6 dice for each target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, reset this **MANIFESTATION**'s **soul points** to 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Elathain's Lurelight
warscroll_ability.lore: Like all Isharann Soulrenders, Elathain possesses a mystical lure that can trap the souls of slain opponents so that they can be used to resurrect fallen allies.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to this unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Cursed To Rise Once More
warscroll_ability.lore: Necrotic flames wreathe the shattered remains of an undead knight, compelling them to rejoin the battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can return 1 slain model to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stegadon’s Horns and Jaws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispersed Formation
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: The End of Empires
warscroll_ability.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: The Red Work
warscroll_ability.lore: In a tight formation of muscle, horseflesh and metal, the Freeguild Cavaliers continue the red work of axe, bludgeon and blade as they grind their way through the ranks of the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal** or **Freeguild Marshal on Griffon** within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if there are fewer models in this unit than the total number of enemy models in units that are in combat with this unit. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, the targets count as having charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Blood Marked
warscroll_ability.lore: The gore sigils on the Blood Throne protect it from enemy magics.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS.**

warscroll_ability.name: Mind-shattering Cacophony
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Crypt Infernal Courtier directs their retinue to focus their death screams on an enemy, the resulting discordant soundwaves can fell the mightiest of foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Piercing Death Screech** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **Crypt Flayers** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Valorous Intervention
warscroll_ability.lore: The Light of Eltharion manifests alongside his allies in their time of greatest need.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat. Pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit that is in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target, within 1" of an enemy unit and in combat. This unit has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Engineer
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Lord-Ordinator is a scryer of possibilities. Those under their command gain insights into the movements of the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SACROSANCT CHAMBER WAR MACHINE** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Call to the Hunt
warscroll_ability.lore: With an exultant howl, Radukar leads the charge, his surge of bloodlust filling nearby undead minions with unholy impetus.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Venomite Swarm
warscroll_ability.lore: Lethal venom drips from the fangs and claws of Sotek’s Venomites.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Sotek’s Venomites** is a token. If this unit’s **Sotek’s Venomites** is on the battlefield, roll a D3. On a 1, remove this unit’s **Sotek’s** **Venomites** from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Calculated Trajectory
warscroll_ability.lore: The warhosts of the Chaos duardin revel in overwhelming their foes with excessive, punishing firepower.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit with 5 or more models that is more than 12" from this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Tainted Sorceries
warscroll_ability.lore: Rotbringer Sorcerers hold that there is nothing they cannot corrupt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was picked to be the target of a spell that was successfully cast by this unit this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Refined Creations
warscroll_ability.lore: Ossifectors are always looking to improve upon their work, wielding necrotic sorcery to augment their creations in battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 5+, the target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ebon-wrought Armour
warscroll_ability.lore: The Morghast’s armour is threaded with spells that protect them against arcane assault.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Warp Lightning Blast
warscroll_ability.lore: A Warp Lightning Cannon fires massive bolts of warp lightning that disintegrate any who are struck by them.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each attack made with this weapon in a single phase must target the same enemy unit. Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Predator's Pounce
warscroll_ability.lore: Though they lack the power of true flight, Nightshriekers can leap clean over obstacles and the heads of the foe, allowing Morbheg Knights to strike and disengage at will.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit when it uses **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stoneheart Worldhammer** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Necrocaches
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Mortis Reapers hurl their necrocaches to the ground, releasing the flesh-withering grave-sand contained within and vanishing in the resulting cloud like phantoms.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this unit can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Chill Grasp
warscroll_ability.lore: A deathly chill seizes the hearts of the foe, leaving them petrified with fear.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 4+, the following effects apply until the start of your next turn:

•  While the target is within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, the target has a maximum control score of 1 that cannot be modified.
•  While the target is within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Morboy Fury
warscroll_ability.lore: When Morboys charge into battle, the sheer mass and impetus of their charge can crumple battlelines and disrupt the coordination of even the finest warriors.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, enemy units cannot use commands while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Forest Fighters
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors fight in loosely scattered formations, the better to take advantage of the terrain in their arboreal domains.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".

warscroll_ability.name: Troglodytic Lurkers
warscroll_ability.lore: Gorgers are shunned and reviled creatures. When a mawtribe goes to war, they often lurk on the edge of the battlefield, waiting to strike.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lurking on the fringes**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Phantasmal Translocation
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a part of this **MANIFESTATION**, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Watch Them Burn
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit
warscroll_ability.lore: To be in the vicinity of a Hashu-Zharr rocket as it strikes its target is to risk a fiery, agonising demise.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of **daemonic power points** this unit has for each other enemy unit within the combat range of the target of this unit's shooting attacks. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy unit being rolled for.

warscroll_ability.name: Feed on Life Force
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Black Dragon tears into the enemy, spilling copious blood as the Sorceress completes her dark ritual.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, place a **dark** **sorcery** token next to this unit for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of 3 tokens.

warscroll_ability.name: Netters
warscroll_ability.lore: Moonclan grots use throwing nets to capture Cave Squigs and entangle their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulnet
warscroll_ability.lore: A soulnet can be used to ensnare a victim, ensuring they cannot escape their doom at the hands of the Soulrender.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit’s **Elathain Ill-fated** is on the battlefield, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Blessings of the Cauldron
warscroll_ability.lore: Scrapskuttle’s Arachnacauldron grants great arcane power to the one brave or mad enough to call upon its aid.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **GLOOMSPITE GITZ WIZARD** within 1" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the target’s power level until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Can't Catch Us
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Snarlfang Riders encircle the enemy, keeping their distance and filling their targets with arrows before they finally close in for the kill.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: The Pendulum Swings
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** cannot use **CHARGE** or **FIGHT** abilities. In addition, when this **MANIFESTATION** moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Imprisonment
warscroll_ability.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. For the rest of the battle, that unit cannot be picked to be the target of an ability that allows a replacement unit to be set up.

warscroll_ability.name: Boing! Boing! Boing!
warscroll_ability.lore: Squig Hoppers can cause considerable damage simply by bouncing on top of their foes as they make their way across the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that any models in this unit passed across this phase to be the target, then roll a dice for each model in this unit that did so.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Cursed Destroyers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Once skilled masons, these creatures have been cursed by the Everchosen to now live only to destroy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 1" of this unit, then pick each other unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Toll of Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: The dreadful ringing of the Bell of Doom fills the minds of the Skaven’s foes with a deep despair.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 13" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Molten Blessing
warscroll_ability.lore: Drawing upon the powerful elemental energies of the Magmic Battleforge, a Zharrgrim priest casts clouds of cinders into the air, imbuing those of their sacred order with burning power.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **FYRESLAYERS PRIEST** within this terrain feature’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. In addition, the target can use the ‘Unbind’ ability this turn as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Horns and Hooves** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Venomite Swarm
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Beloved of the serpent god Sotek, the fangs of the Venomites drip with toxins that can inflict near-instant death.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit’s **Venomites** token is on the battlefield, roll a D3. On a 1, remove this unit’s **Venomites** token from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Theddra Skull-scryer
warscroll_ability.lore: Through fell energies do the Darkoath find communion with the Chaos Gods.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Theddra Skull-scryer** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Masterful Charioteer
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As they plough through the enemy's ranks, the Liege-Kavalos leads the War Chariots in complex manoeuvres that prevent the foe from landing telling blows.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat and has charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly **Kavalos War Chariots** that have charged this turn, that are wholly within 12" of this unit and that are in combat to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Castigator Aetheric Channelling
warscroll_ability.lore: Castigators can use their knowledge of the arcane to channel aetheric energy, making their weapons more accurate.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, this unit’s shooting attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Drifting on Spectral Tides
warscroll_ability.lore: Little can prevent the Drowner's passage as he drifts throughout the Mortal Realms, seeking fresh victims.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Draconic Onslaught
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: To reclaim their old empire, the Draconith and their riders fight together as a single furious whole, savaging any who cross their path.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Sons of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Whirling Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Fanatics are hurled out of Moonclan units, swiftly spinning up into living tornadoes that cause absolute carnage as they careen through the enemy ranks.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **lost in the horde**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield wholly within 3" of a friendly **Moonclan Stabbas** or **Moonclan Shootas** unit. Then, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through enemy models and their combat ranges and can end that move in combat. Then, roll a dice for each enemy unit in combat with this unit or that this unit passed across as part of that move. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. If this unit ended that move in combat, it has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Lurking Beneath The Waves
warscroll_ability.lore: Kraken-eater Mega-Gargants are infamous for keeping their heads just below the waterline, ready to emerge from the depths in a roaring tempest of fury at those who dare trespass in their territory.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **beneath the waves**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Rampaging Destruction
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).

warscroll_ability.name: Sinister Stare
warscroll_ability.lore: Kruleboyz find it hilarious to subject foes under the insidious influence of a Skaregob Totem’s hallucinogenic fogs to a host of nasty surprises.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to dirty trick rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 12" of this terrain feature or for enemy units within 12" of this terrain feature. If this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss, add 1 to dirty trick rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 18" of this terrain feature instead of wholly within 12" or for enemy units within 18" of this terrain feature instead of within 12".

warscroll_ability.name: Long Live the King
warscroll_ability.lore: The death of a member of the royal family sends shockwaves through the cannibal court, sending them into an impassioned rage.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, friendly non-**UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS** units wholly within 12" of this unit become **enraged** until the start of your next turn. Melee weapons used by friendly enraged units have **Crit (Auto-wound)** and score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+, even if this unit has been destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Darkness of the Soul
warscroll_ability.lore: Cathallars wield the negative energy locked in aetherquartz as a weapon.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 3+, subtract D6 from the control score of the target unit this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderblast
warscroll_ability.lore: The strident peal of a battlehorn can summon a localised tempest above an enemy structure, hammering it with repeated lightning strikes and fist-sized hailstones.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible faction terrain feature within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Dependable Gryph-hound
warscroll_ability.lore: Some Castigators are accompanied by Gryph-hounds trained to aid them in battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Gryph-hound** is a token. If this unit’s **Gryph-hound** has been removed, it cannot use the ‘Scouting Companion’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Masters of Ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: Always on the move, Icebrow Hunters range ahead of the main ogor force alongside packs of trained Frost Sabres.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **Frost Sabres** units if those units have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **outflanking the prey**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardians of the King
warscroll_ability.lore: The Barrow Guard stand alongside the liege lord to whom they are bound.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Heartseekers
warscroll_ability.lore: The bloodblessed arrows loosed by these Melusai unerringly seek out the enemy’s vital organs.
warscroll_ability.effect: Shooting attacks made by this unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ if this unit did not use a **MOVE** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Deadly Cargo
warscroll_ability.lore: Terradons carry heavy boulders hewn from meteoric rock and carved with sigils of destruction. When these are dropped upon enemy lines, those not immediately crushed are sent flying in all directions.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each model in this unit, and add 2 to each roll if this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **Terradon Chief** units. For each 5+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• If any damage points are allocated by this ability and the target does not have **FLY**, the target cannot use **RUN** abilities until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Scrap-bang
warscroll_ability.lore: By detonating their scrap-grenades at the feet of the foe, Hobgrot Slittaz can scarper off to a safe distance.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: With the Force of a Landslide
warscroll_ability.lore: The Alaithi rune imbues mountain spirits with increasing power.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Stoneheart Worldhammer** for each instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**.

warscroll_ability.name: Wither
warscroll_ability.lore: The Grey Seer hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: On a 6+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Shroudcage Fragment
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Madness pulses from the gem in Ushoran’s crown, overwhelming those who draw too close.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **INFANTRY WIZARD HERO** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This **MANIFESTATION** can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Arch-Deceiver
warscroll_ability.lore: None can detect the veil of the Changeling. Assuming the form of an ally, it sows arcane discord before vanishing.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick a model in a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can immediately use a **SPELL** ability. When it does so, measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from the target. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities such as ‘Unbind’.

warscroll_ability.name: Netters
warscroll_ability.lore: Moonclan grots use throwing nets to capture Cave Squigs and entangle their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Puffshroom Frenzy
warscroll_ability.lore: Puffshroom spore-clouds send the followers of the Bad Moon into a violent frenzy while choking and blinding enemies caught within them.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **MOONCLAN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: No Escaping the Tithe
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Mortis Reapers are utterly unrelenting in their pursuit of those who would dare attempt to shirk the bone-tithe.
warscroll_ability.declare: If there are no enemy units within 6" of this unit, pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Loathsome Descent
warscroll_ability.lore: The Revenant Draconith plunges into battle with a roar, slamming into its prey with bone-shattering force.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **high above the battlefield**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Wicked Predator
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In life, Terrorgheists were cruel and spiteful monsters, dark instincts driving them to terrify prey into submission. Little has changed in death.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Skeletal Talons**, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Overwhelming Volleystorm
warscroll_ability.lore: The Tempestors fire charged crossbow bolts into the foe, weakening their defences and leaving them open to a follow-up assault.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Volleystorm Crossbows** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use the ‘All-out Defence’ command in the following combat phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Oath of Murder
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Darkoath Chieftains offer up the souls of enemy lords and champions in exchange for divine power.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit destroyed an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** this turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Web Slingshot
warscroll_ability.lore: The Webspinner Shaman conjures a sheet of webbing that they then use to launch themselves across the battlefield.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SPIDERFANG** unit or terrain feature within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Shadowy Killers
warscroll_ability.lore: Ulguan illusions and other tools of misdirection shroud Deathmasters in perpetual darkness, keeping them from harm.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

warscroll_ability.name: Dominating Roar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The Flame-scale Youngbloods ridden by Auric Runesons are fiercely territorial when faced with a monstrous challenger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has fewer damage points than the target, subtract 10 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Catechisms of Violence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Hag Queen drives her followers into a blood-soaked fury, drawing power from their every impalement and evisceration.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, you can pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit. That **PRIEST** gains 1 ritual point.

warscroll_ability.name: Consecrate the Land
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Bellowing Sigmarite hymns, the Mallus Forgepriest purges the taint of Chaos from the land and consecrates it in the name of the God-King.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you control that this unit is contesting to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If there are no enemy units contesting the target objective, it is considered by you to be **consecrated**. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target objective is considered by you to be **consecrated**.

While they are wholly within 6" of a **consecrated** objective and **under orders**:
• Friendly non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units have **WARD (5+)**.
• Friendly **SIGMARITE WAR MACHINES** have **WARD (6+)**.

If your opponent gains control of a **consecrated** objective, it is no longer **consecrated**.

warscroll_ability.name: Prowling Ash Panther
warscroll_ability.lore: Thexa lurks in the shadows before pouncing, ripping at the foe’s hamstrings, throats and other vital areas.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit’s **Thexa** is a token. If this unit’s **Thexa** is not on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place this unit’s **Thexa** next to the target, then roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed while this unit’s **Thexa** is next to it, remove this unit’s **Thexa** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Harrying Attacks
warscroll_ability.lore: At her master’s command, Thexa dogs her prey’s footsteps, harrying them endlessly with attacks that impede their every strike.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Thexa** is next to an enemy unit, that enemy unit’s attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Fluid Combat Style
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit or a non-**HERO SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Ranger-Colonel and his troops use the conventional fighting style of the Wildercorps, one that emphasises speed over armour and adaptability over rigid formations.
warscroll_ability.effect: Immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that unit has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 6" of this unit and more than 3" from all units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features. Remove the unit that used the **FIGHT** ability from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of that point and not in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Feed the Maw
warscroll_ability.lore: The new Head Butcher ascends the platform above the Mawpit.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a **Head Butcher**, pick a friendly **Butcher** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a **Head Butcher** (see 'Hungry Sinkhole').

If this terrain feature is demolished, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Head Butcher**. Then, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**. If it is not possible to set up the **Head Butcher**, it is slain.

warscroll_ability.name: The Four Corners of the Realms
warscroll_ability.lore: Guided by potent wayfaring magic, Erasmus swiftly traverses the Mortal Realms.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 9" of a corner of the battlefield and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Deathly Candlelight
warscroll_ability.lore: The Knellmage channels so much Shyishan energy through their Reikenorian candle that they wreathe themselves in an eerie, disconcerting witchlight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Ominous Presence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Knellmage heightens the intensity of their Reikenorian candlelight, taking on an even more dreadful aspect.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the ‘Deathly Candlelight’ ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

warscroll_ability.name: Hungry Sinkhole
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The appearance of a Mawpit is irrefutable evidence of the Gulping God’s eagerness to feast upon the land itself, a hunger that only becomes more ravenous wherever the ogors roam.
warscroll_ability.declare:
Pick this **Mawpit** to be a **sinkhole**. Then, you can pick another terrain feature within 12" of this **Mawpit** and that you have not already picked to be a **sinkhole** this battle to be a **sinkhole** for the rest of the turn.

Then, pick each enemy unit within 3" of the **sinkhole(s)** to be the targets.

From the second battle round onwards, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 3" for each previous battle round. If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher**, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 6" for each previous battle round instead of 3".
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: The Flames of Aqshy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Pyrocaster turns their body into a living conduit for Aqshian magic, heightening their fiery spellcasting.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the ‘Incandescent Incineration’ ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

warscroll_ability.name: Realmsphere Mastery
warscroll_ability.lore: Erasmus’s mastery of realm-magic is such that he can trap and control manifestations with ease.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and that was not set up this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s banishment value, set up an **ENDLESS SPELL** that can be summoned using a **SUMMON** spell that this unit can cast within 1" of the target and more than 3" from all enemy units and other enemy **MANIFESTATIONS**. If that **ENDLESS SPELL** has multiple parts, both parts must be set up within 1" of the target. This unit has summoned that **ENDLESS SPELL**. If there is already a friendly **ENDLESS SPELL** of the same type on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play before being set up as described above. Then, the target is banished and removed from play

warscroll_ability.name: Incandescent Incineration
warscroll_ability.lore: The Pyrocaster’s wand glows white hot as they unleash an incendiary assault, the arcane flames creating a veritable bonfire of bright magic for them to tap into.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target was not **incandescent** when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is **incandescent** for the rest of the battle.

If the target was **incandescent** when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
•Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• The target is no longer **incandescent**.

warscroll_ability.name: Lantern of All-Knowledge
warscroll_ability.lore: This mystical artefact emits powerful light of varying magical wavelengths.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is wholly within 9" of a corner of the battlefield, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Searing Brilliance:*** Friendly **SIGMARITE** units are not visible to enemy units more than 6" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit.

***Lambent Aura:*** Add 1 to this unit’s power level. 

***Luminous Authority***: Add 2 to arcane manipulation rolls for this unit.

***Prismatic Diffusion:*** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Rod of Radiance** and set its Damage characteristic to 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Weapons of Banishment
warscroll_ability.lore: The quartermasters of the Order of the Vault ensure that the Ven Densts can arm their comrades with whatever they need to deal with arcane threats.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s weapons for combat attacks that target enemy **WIZARDS**, **PRIESTS** and **MANIFESTATIONS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Freeguild Adjutants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The adjutants’ trumpets and bellowed speeches are a clarion call to victory for hard-pressed Freeguilders.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Add 5 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Seize the Souls
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Soul Shepherd can trap enemies’ souls, preventing them from being forcibly returned to life should they fall.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit contains a **Soul Shepherd**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot be healed or have slain models returned to it until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lurking Spymaster
warscroll_ability.lore: Whisperblades are adept at remaining hidden amongst ranks of Freeguilders, striking out only when necessary.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit cannot use or be picked to be the target of the ‘Form Up!’ ability.

While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit that has 3 or more models and there are no other friendly **Whisperblades** within that unit’s combat range, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of shooting attacks or combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Supreme Swordmaster
warscroll_ability.lore: The Light of Eltharion is a consummate warrior and one of the greatest swordmasters of all time.
warscroll_ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
