warscroll_ability.name: Break Them Upon the Walls
warscroll_ability.lore: The sight of Freeguild Gallants bringing wrath and ruin to enemy attackers rouses their fellows to bloody deeds.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is **under orders**, the melee weapons of other visible friendly **SIGMARITE** units, excluding **Freeguild Gallants** units, have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Cinders and Ashes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Freeguild Grenadiers carry specialised gear that allows them to reduce a dug-in enemy to a panicked, screaming bonfire of melting flesh and charred hair.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit contains a **Cindergout**, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Field Surgery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: With a deft hand and careful eye, the War Surgeon patches up those under their care.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat and contains a **War Surgeon**, pick a visible friendly non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is a non-**HERO INFANTRY** unit, return D3 slain models to it.
• If the target is a non-**HERO CAVALRY** unit, return 1 slain model to it.
• If the target is a **HERO** or **MONSTER**, **Heal (D3)** the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Not One Step Back
warscroll_ability.lore: The elite infantry of the Cities of Sigmar lead defensive positions against all manner of terrible foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Full Power!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Castellan-Captain orders their crew to push the Cannonade Cogfort to its absolute limits.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Launch Countermeasures!:*** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly **SIGMARITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are **under orders**.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Calculate Firing Solution!:*** For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re‑roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon**.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Overheating
warscroll_ability.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.
warscroll_ability.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Power!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.

warscroll_ability.name: Special Ammunition
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: At a word, the Cogfort’s crew swiftly load specialised ammunition into the godbreaker cannon.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects.

***Nullshot:*** Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase. 

***Heavy Shot:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.

***Grapeshot:*** After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of the attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** targeted the same enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within that enemy unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: All Aboard!
warscroll_ability.lore: The warriors clamber aboard the Conqueror Cogfort and ready themselves for battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non‑**HERO SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Fury of the Faithful
warscroll_ability.lore: Should their beloved memorial be threatened by the enemy, Freeguild troops have been known to enter a terrible rage, displaying a sudden savagery and ruthlessness that takes the foe by surprise.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this terrain feature is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Full Charge!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Cogsmith kicks the arco-combustor into high gear, causing the Cogfort to surge forwards and allowing the crew to obliterate the enemy.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Breaching Assist!:*** If this unit uses the ‘Sally Forth’ ability this turn, melee weapons used by the targets of that ability have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Repel Boarders!:*** For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters** and **Crushing Iron Feet**.

***4 Disengage Safeties!:*** For the rest of the turn, the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Sally Forth
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The warriors aboard the Conqueror Cogfort hurl themselves into battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** ability this turn, pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within ½" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.

warscroll_ability.name: Aggressive Defenders
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gate Gargants are too large and belligerent for enemies to easily ignore; their allies take advantage of this to retreat in good order.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 other visible friendly **SIGMARITE** units in combat with any enemy units that are in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by **RETREAT** abilities for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Open the Gates
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Gate Gargants part their tower shield, allowing nearby units to hurl themselves forward and wreak havoc on the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Hauled to War
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared the ‘Normal Move’ ability for a **CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY** unit within 3" of this terrain feature
warscroll_ability.lore: The chains attached to the Dawner’s Triumph allow nearby soldiers to haul it from battlefield to battlefield.
warscroll_ability.effect: After that ‘Normal Move’ ability has been resolved, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of the unit that used that ability and within 6" of this terrain feature. Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of that point and more than 3" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Power to Maximum!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Castellan-Captain orders their crew to push the Immolator Cogfort to its absolute limits.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Load Triple Shot!:*** This unit’s **Breacher Cannon** has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***1 Go, Go, Go!:*** When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

***2 Get Us In There!:*** This unit’s **Crushing Iron Feet** have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

***3 Load Chain Shot!:*** Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by attacks made with this unit’s **Breacher Cannon**, for each model slain by those attacks, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.

***4 Disengage Safeties!:*** The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.

warscroll_ability.name: Overheating
warscroll_ability.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.
warscroll_ability.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Charge!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.

warscroll_ability.name: Overheating
warscroll_ability.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.
warscroll_ability.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Output to Maximum!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.

warscroll_ability.name: Venture Forth
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The warriors aboard the Linebreaker Cogfort hurl themselves into battle.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not used a Run ability this turn, pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within ½" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.

warscroll_ability.name: Output to Maximum!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Few are the Linebreaker commanders who will not use every last shred of fuel and ammunition to destroy whatever hated monsters their enemies hurl at them.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 or more of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Trample Them to Dust!:*** This unit’s **Crushing Iron Feet** have **ANTI‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**.

***1 Go, Go, Go!:*** When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

***2 Get Us In There!:*** This unit’s **Crushing Iron Feet** have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

***2 Load Heavy Shot!:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon**, but all of this unit’s attacks made with that weapon this turn must target the same enemy unit.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** This unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

warscroll_ability.name: Lava-Encrusted
warscroll_ability.lore: Enemies struck by the allied duardin’s magmapike bolts find their movements becoming increasingly sluggish as the rock cools and rapidly solidifies on their armour and flesh.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is **under orders**, each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn (this effect is cumulative). This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s Move characteristic below half its starting value.

warscroll_ability.name: Allied Drothmasters
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sigmarites’ Vulkyn allies are skilled at dominating monstrous wild beasts.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Protective Pike-Wall
warscroll_ability.lore: Standing shoulder to shoulder with their allied comrades, the Wardens present a bristling wall of pikes to the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is **under orders** and has not charged this turn, ignore the effect of the **Charge (+1 Damage)** ability for combat attacks made by enemy units that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Fire Lofted Shots
warscroll_ability.lore: When the order is given, the Sentinels point their bows to the sky before firing a volley at a distant target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, for the rest of the turn:

• Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Auralan Bows**.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Ride to Glory
warscroll_ability.lore: The warriors climb aboard the Cogfort, praying for the strength and resolve they know will be sorely needed in the hours to come.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **IRON MARCH INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non‑**HERO IRON MARCH INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Mercenary Attitudes
warscroll_ability.lore: How allies interact with outlaw Cogforts varies. Feral enthusiasts may enter a frenzy or rush ahead of the war machine, eager not to lose a meal or an opportunity to get their divine patron’s attention. Others may use it as a protective shelter or draw strength and courage from its presence.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly non-**UNIQUE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:

• You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
• Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
• The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
• Add 10 to the target’s control score.

warscroll_ability.name: Everyone Aboard!
warscroll_ability.lore: The outlaw Cogfort can be used to transport anyone on foot, be they human, orruk, gheist or ghoul.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non-reinforced, non‑**HERO INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: This is Your Stop Maggots!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The ramp slams down and the forces of disorder race forward, eager to spill blood on behalf on whoever may be watching.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. In addition, the targets’ melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lead From The Front
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The loyalty Vedra commands from her soldiers is unwavering, and the sight of her at the forefront of the assault inspires them to fight all the harder.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick each visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Paralysing Venom
warscroll_ability.lore: Infernadine's scorpid tail darts forth a dozen times in a heartbeat, injecting a paralysing venom that quickly takes hold.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target's Health characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Combat Tactician
warscroll_ability.lore: Vedra can plug a gap in her battleline or exploit a weakness in the enemy’s with a bellowed command.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 18" of it and that is not in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, the target is **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.

warscroll_ability.name: The Great Wheel Turns
warscroll_ability.lore: Zenestra’s followers defend her with a strength that can cow even a follower of the Dark Gods. Even those who profess no membership of the Cult of the Wheel inevitably find themselves caught up in a frenzy of zealotry that borders on madness.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a model in a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, make a number of zealotry rolls of D6 equal to that model’s Health characteristic. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: 'For Sigmar! For Glory!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Raising their blade, the Marshal signals the Cavaliers’ counter-charge and hurls themselves into battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO SIGMARITE CAVALRY** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit, is not in combat and has not used a **RUN** ability this turn to be the target. After the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit is in combat, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability as if it were your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Vessel of Sigmar
warscroll_ability.lore: Channelling the divine might of the God-King, Pontifex Zenestra is a powerful beacon of faith, blasting the enemy and granting those that battle within her blazing aura protection and might in equal measure.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6. If the roll is an unmodified 1, you can re-roll the dice.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects. Pick up to 2 different effects instead if the chanting roll was 10+.

***Sanctified Ground***: Until the start of your next turn, visible enemy units that use a **CHARGE** ability while they are within 9" of this unit have **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

***Ardent Prayers:*** Add 1 to zealotry rolls for friendly **SIGMARITE** units until the start of your next turn.

***Cast Out Evil***: Roll a D3 for each visible enemy **WIZARD** and **PRIEST** on the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Attendant Relic Envoy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: It is a great honour for a Relic Envoy to serve beneath a Freeguild Marshal. Their duties include hand- delivering messages to the soldiers of the line.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit’s **Relic Envoy** is a token. Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and not **under orders** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place this unit’s **Relic Envoy** next to the target. While this unit is **under orders** and on the battlefield and this unit’s **Relic Envoy** is next to the target, the target is **under orders**.

warscroll_ability.name: Blackpowder Squire
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and this unit is in combat
warscroll_ability.lore: Blackpowder Squires ensure their fellows are well prepared to deliver point-blank volleys as the enemy closes.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s **Blackpowder Squire** is a token. Remove this unit’s **Blackpowder Squire** from the battlefield, then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Prepared Arrival
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Wildercorps lead an advance force deep into the enemy’s flank, prepared to wreak havoc and confusion.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **scouting ahead**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit **scouting ahead** wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Bestial Instincts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Drakespawn tear apart their prey, the scent of fresh gore sends them into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Drakespawn’s Ferocious Jaws** while it is in combat with any enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this phase or that had any models slain this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Front-Line Commander
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: In the face of the oncoming enemy, the Marshal stands alongside their fellows in the front lines, bellowing orders and coordinating attacks.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is **under orders**, pick a friendly **SIGMARITE** **INFANTRY** or **MONSTER** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit or has this unit’s **Relic Envoy** next to it and that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Runic Crucible
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The hefty crucibles carried by these arcane metallurgists harness the elemental magics of Chamon and can be used to give the weapons of their allies a white-hot molten edge.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Right Tools For The Job
warscroll_ability.lore: Callis and Toll have sacred blade oils prepared for particularly deadly foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy **mark**.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Hunters
warscroll_ability.lore: Toll, Callis and their companions often arrive at a battlefield in pursuit of an enemy whose existence threatens the safety of a Sigmarite city.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it is **in the shadows**. If there is no enemy **mark**, pick an enemy **HERO** on the battlefield to be the target. If there are no enemy **HEROES** on the battlefield, pick an enemy non‑**HERO** unit on the battlefield to be the target instead.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target is the **mark** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Emerge from the Shadows
warscroll_ability.lore: Their mission imperative, these agents only reveal themselves when they are poised to bring down Sigmar’s judgement upon their quarry.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the shadows**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 6" from the enemy **mark** and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the friendly **Callis and Toll** unit **in the shadows** wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 6" from the enemy **mark** and more than 9" from all other enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Hidden Agents
warscroll_ability.lore: A locked door is to be picked, a high wall is to be scaled and the shadows are to be embraced.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and a friendly **Callis and Toll** unit if those units have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **in the shadows**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Saviours of Cinderfall
warscroll_ability.lore: These companions have endured through thick and thin, watching each other’s backs and holding back the tides of darkness.
warscroll_ability.effect: While a friendly **Callis and Toll** unit is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that friendly unit have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Storm of Steel
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Putting the spurs to their war-steeds, the Freeguild Cavaliers plunge into the fray, taking their enemies by surprise with this sudden burst of speed.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that it is in combat with and up to 1 friendly **Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal** within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below. 

This unit and the friendly target can use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase and even if those units are in combat. Both friendly units must end that move in combat with the enemy target.

warscroll_ability.name: Fortified Position
warscroll_ability.lore: Heavy pavises are slammed into the dirt, forming a wall of oak and iron as strong as a fortification.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is **under orders**:

• This unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Bombardment
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ironweld gunners can relentlessly pour fire down into oncoming enemies, slowing their advance if not outright stopping it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is **under orders**. On a 3+, subtract 2 from charge rolls and run rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Expert Pathfinders
warscroll_ability.lore: These soldiers are tasked with reconnaissance, setting off ahead of the main advance and ensuring that the paths are clear.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units if none of them have been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up those units in reserve **scouting ahead**. They have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Black Dragon’s Claws** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Ironscale's Fury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The doctrine of the Melusai Ironscales is simple: every Khainite death must be answered with immediate and shockingly violent vengeance.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time a model in a target unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a dice. If that unit is a **Blood Sisters** or **Blood Stalkers** unit, roll 2 dice instead. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Relic Envoy
warscroll_ability.lore: Relic Envoys relay orders from the Freeguild Marshal to the soldiers of the line.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While a friendly unit other than this unit has the **Relic Envoy** token, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit’s combat attacks.

If this unit is destroyed, remove the **Relic Envoy** token from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Marshal's Orders
warscroll_ability.lore: The Relic Envoy rushes across the battlefield to hand-deliver a message.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit’s **Relic Envoy** token from the battlefield, then give it to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Vessel of Sigmar
warscroll_ability.lore: Channelling the divine might of the God-King, Pontifex Zenestra is a powerful beacon of faith who bolsters the righteous and smites the corrupt.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly or enemy units to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• If it is a friendly target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
• If it is an enemy target, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Forewarned is Forearmed
warscroll_ability.lore: The Whisperblade is both master spy and deadly assassin combined: the ultimate opportunist.
warscroll_ability.effect: While it is your turn, this unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST**.

warscroll_ability.name: Fanatical Followers
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is the zealous frenzy that fills these warriors that even after suffering mortal wounds, they will drag themselves to their feet and continue to fight.
warscroll_ability.effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Split Again
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a Blue Horror meet its end at the hands of the enemy, it is capable of splitting itself into two lesser daemons.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each **Blue Horror** model in this unit that is slain. For each 3+, if there are fewer **Brimstone Horrors** models in this unit than its starting size, you can add 1 **Brimstone Horrors** model to this unit. 

**Designer’s Note:** *Dice are only rolled for Blue Horror models that are currently slain – models that have been slain and returned to this unit do not count until they are slain once more. When adding Brimstone Horrors to this unit, do not count slain Brimstone Horrors towards the maximum.*

warscroll_ability.name: Immolation
warscroll_ability.lore: Brimstone Horrors are ephemeral things, swiftly self-immolating in an eye-searing blaze after a few delightful moments causing lethal mischief.
warscroll_ability.effect: Slain Brimstone Horrors cannot be returned to this unit. When setting up a replacement unit for this unit, Brimstone Horror models are ignored when determining the number of models in this unit, and you cannot pick them to be set up.

warscroll_ability.name: Annelid Engorgement
warscroll_ability.lore: Gathoblyt swells as it gorges itself on the festering remnants of fallen warriors.
warscroll_ability.effect: For each enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn and was destroyed this turn, this unit gains D3 **leech points** for the rest of the battle. Until the end of the next turn, add 1 to this unit’s Control characteristic for each **leech point** it currently has.

warscroll_ability.name: Hand of the Everqueen
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Thrusting her tendrils into the ground, the Lady of Vines wields the power she inherited from Alarielle to channel her magic through root and mycelium to reach a distant target.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit that has a friendly **overgrown token** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The next time this unit uses a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from the target terrain feature instead of from this unit, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to the target terrain feature instead of to this unit for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Oathsworn
warscroll_ability.lore: These warriors are oathsworn to protect their liege.
warscroll_ability.effect: While any friendly **Warden Kings** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly **Warden Kings** have **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Sow Havoc
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The speed and discipline of the Dark Riders is unmatched, allowing them to charge the enemy’s weak points and retreat before the foe can react.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

warscroll_ability.name: Regenesis
warscroll_ability.lore: Freshly grown forest spirits leap from the amniotic pods of the Grove Guardian’s genesis tree, ready to join the Everqueen’s war.
warscroll_ability.declare: Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to and wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. If a target is a non-**HERO REVENANT INFANTRY** or **Dryads** unit, return up to D3 models to the target unit. Otherwise, **Heal (3)** that target.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulshriek
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Should a Revenant be slain in their presence, a Grove Guardian can trigger a spiritual backlash through the fallen’s lamentiri fuelled by the collective trauma of generations, stilling the heart of their killer in a sudden burst of soul-shock.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each friendly non-**HERO REVENANT** unit wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, each time a model in a target unit is slain by a combat attack, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit.

warscroll_ability.name: More Pressure!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Pumping pressure into the valves and pistons of a Steam Tank can improve its performance – but risks a catastrophic backfire.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn:

***Power the Wheels:*** This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

***Power the Guns:*** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Steam Gun**.

warscroll_ability.name: Glorious Martyrs
warscroll_ability.lore: While led by leaders of their faith, Flagellants will hurl themselves into battle with reckless fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: While a friendly **SIGMARITE PRIEST** is wholly within this unit’s combat range, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Protection
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Luminarks of Hysh have a protective magical aura that can be activated in times of need.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (6+)** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Aura of Protection
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Luminarks of Hysh have a protective magical aura that can be activated in times of need.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (6+)** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Forgefire
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Calling upon the latent power of runic engravings, Runelords imbue the weapons of their kin with ancient might.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Grudgebuster Bombs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Gyrobombers swoop over the enemy lines, dropping a lethal payload onto the hapless warriors below.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit used a **MOVE** ability this phase, pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Tactical Bombing:*** Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

***Drop It All!:*** Make 2 rolls of D3. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) within the target’s combat range that does not have **FLY**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Once the ‘Drop It All!’ effect of this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Guild Bombs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Every Gyrocopter goes to battle with a single payload of these volatile blackpowder explosives.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit used a **MOVE** ability this phase, pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Gromril Shieldwall
warscroll_ability.lore: Once formed up into a shieldwall, a line of gromril-clad Ironbreakers is nigh impenetrable.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Portents of Battle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Celestial Hurricanums leak magical energy, granting nearby soldiers visions of the imminent future that allow them to land their blows with uncanny accuracy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: 'I Thought Duardin Were Made Of Sterner Stuff!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A disgruntled look from a grumbling Longbeard is often enough to galvanise the spirits of younger duardin and keep them in the fight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **Longbeards** unit.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn

warscroll_ability.name: Indiscriminate Slaughter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The cruel rituals involved in raising Black Dragons curse them with sadistic urges, causing them to revel in slaughter just as much as their Dreadlord riders.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Six-headed Strike
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Stoked into a killing rage by their handlers’ goads and whips, War Hydras lumber forward into battle, each of their six heads lashing out to strike the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: 'At Them, You Curs!'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Under the gaze of their Fleetmaster, Scourge Corsairs slaughter the enemy without mercy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **Black Ark Corsairs** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Scythed Runners
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Vicious blades are fitted to this chariot, carving apart anything that gets in its way.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Prize Specimens
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Having sighted monstrous beasts whose innards fetch a particularly high price on the black market, the aelves will not rest until the monsters’ corpses are in their possession.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target enemy **MONSTERS**.

warscroll_ability.name: Abyssal Howl
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: These creatures let loose spine-chilling roars when they scent the blood of their prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Goaded and Whipped
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Kharibdyss’s handlers lash the creature into a murderous frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Storm of Iron-tipped Bolts
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The skies darken moments before the enemy is shredded by a volley of iron bolts.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Master‑crafted** **Repeater Crossbows** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Merciless Conquerors
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: While the Dreadspears hold the line, the Bleakswords are tasked with seizing objectives, viciously cutting down any opponents in a storm of flashing steel.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.

warscroll_ability.name: More Pressure!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Pumping pressure into the valves and pistons of a Steam Tank can improve its performance – but risks a catastrophic backfire.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn:

***Power the Wheels:*** This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

***Power the Guns:*** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Steam Gun**.

warscroll_ability.name: Steel of Helm and Heart
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Steelhelms force enemy attention on themselves in a heroic effort to blunt attacks on their allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has 5 or more models, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. On a 4+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability:
• This unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Run Down The Foe
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Cavalier-Marshals are experts in leading decisive charges on enemy positions and trampling the foe underfoot.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly non‑**HERO SIGMARITE CAVALRY** units that charged this turn and are wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Talented Champions
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You used a command
warscroll_ability.lore: Each member of the Command Corps has their own special skills to be employed.
warscroll_ability.effect:
After that command has been resolved, return the card to your hand.

**Designer’s Note:** *This allows you to either use the command a second time or score the battle tactic on that card as well.*

warscroll_ability.name: Coordinate Attacks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Fusil-Majors can direct the attacks of nearby Sigmarites to eliminate priority targets.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **SIGMARITE** units that are **under orders** that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Swift Shots
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the enemy bears down upon them, the Corsairs flick their repeater handbows out from beneath their cloaks and fire them point blank at the surprised foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must be in combat with this unit and have charged this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: The Iron Heart of Khaine
warscroll_ability.lore: As blood is spilt in his name, the Iron Heart is drained by Morathi-Khaine to further swell her powers.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Each time you perform a blood rite, immediately after the ability that destroyed a unit has been resolved, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Until the start of your next turn, this unit is only visible to enemy units while those units are within its combat range.
• **Heal (D6)** this unit or a friendly Shadow Queen.
• A friendly **Shadow Queen** can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ or ‘Retreat’ ability as if it was your movement phase even if it has already used that ability or another **CORE** ability this phase.
• Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
• For the rest of the turn, set this unit’s Control characteristic to 5 and a friendly **Shadow Queen’s** Control characteristic to 15.

**Designer’s Note:** *If the Shadow Queen retreats with the ‘Iron Heart of Khaine’ ability, she cannot subsequently use the ‘Fight’ ability in the same combat phase.*

warscroll_ability.name: All Must Burn!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who approach a Dominator earn but one end – death by unclean fire.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick 2 or more visible enemy units within 8" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Immolation Cannons** for each unit picked to be the target of this ability, but each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, it must target each of those units with at least 3 of its attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Overheating
warscroll_ability.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.
warscroll_ability.effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Power to Maximum!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.

warscroll_ability.name: Tactical Acumen
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Those Freeguild Marshals who have earned the right to ride a griffon into battle not only are skilled warriors but also possess shrewd tactical minds.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Portents of Battle
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Celestial Hurricanums leak magical energy, granting nearby soldiers visions of the imminent future that allow them to land their blows with uncanny accuracy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Paramount Hunter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a HERO within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Shalaxi will permit none save themselves the honour of striking down their chosen quarry.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately move up to 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but it must end that move within ½" of that **HERO**. If it does so, this unit has charged, and that **HERO**’s **CHARGE** ability has no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: An Exquisite Trophy
warscroll_ability.lore: Shalaxi Helbane delights in making examples of the enemy's greatest champions, redoubling their aggression to ensure victory and shatter enemy morale.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Supernatural Grace
warscroll_ability.lore: Whether they turn blows aside or simply dodge out of harm’s way, it is extremely difficult to pin down a Keeper of Secrets.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Locus of Slaanesh
warscroll_ability.lore: With violence and excess, the walls of reality can be made thin enough to draw forth reinforcements of Slaaneshi daemons.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and has been destroyed to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Cacophonic Choir
warscroll_ability.lore: The Keeper of Secrets unleashes a sanity-shattering chorus of magical sound.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick any number of visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the casting roll for each target you picked after the first.
warscroll_ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Refine Senses
warscroll_ability.lore: Shalaxi draws upon sensory magics to sharpen their followers' instincts and render them more decisive hunters.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting roll if this unit is the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: You! Amuse Us!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Cruel Dexcessa is patron to many warrior-champions, and they expect these favoured souls to prove their worth.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly **PARAGON** that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range and visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Whispers of Desire
warscroll_ability.lore: Synessa whispers words that reveal the enemy’s darkest urges, breaking their concentration and causing them to falter in their attack.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Enthralling Splendour
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A mere glance at Synessa’s magnificence leaves those nearby captivated.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit with a lower Control characteristic than this unit, that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Seductor
warscroll_ability.lore: Those with some mystical aptitude are especially vulnerable to Synessa’s wiles; the Voice relishes unpicking their minds, working plots to steal their power for itself.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. If the roll is higher than the target’s power level, for the rest of the battle round, while the target is within 18" of this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units while they are within 18" of this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.

warscroll_ability.name: Unholy Symbiosis
warscroll_ability.lore: The dark enchantments woven by the twin entity Syll’Esske can offer power to both mortal and daemon alike – though there must always be a balance, a reflection of their own wicked union.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit and up to 1 visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If you picked a **SYBARITE** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **DAEMON** target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Violent Offerings
warscroll_ability.lore: Esske will go to great lengths to please Syll, delicately prising magical trinkets from the severed heads and limbs of the enemy to gift to the source of his obsession.
warscroll_ability.effect: If any damage points were allocated this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to an enemy **WIZARD**, **PRIEST**, **UNIQUE** unit or unit with an artefact of power, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Sublime Harmonies
warscroll_ability.lore: The cacophony unleashed by Vashtiss allows the Thricefold Discord to synchronise their weaving of dark magics.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit’s **Vashtiss** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time you make a casting roll for this unit, you can spend any number of **indulgence points** it has. For each point spent, add 1 to the casting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Indulgence Given Form
warscroll_ability.lore: The Thricefold Discord are a sinister example of all of one’s vices and virtues taken to excess.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a command while it is within 12" of this unit, give 1 **indulgence point** to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

warscroll_ability.name: Spell-Shredding Symphony
warscroll_ability.lore: The vile tunes of torture strummed by these daemon-heralds are so unpalatable that even magic comes undone at their vibrations. So too, as it happens, do the casters.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster and each time this unit successfully banishes a **MANIFESTATION**, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned that **MANIFESTATION**.

warscroll_ability.name: Biggest-Game Hunter
warscroll_ability.lore: A Bloodpelt Hunter’s arsenal is tailored to the killing of the largest prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Skullshatter Crossbow and Impaling Spear** is 4 if the target is a **MONSTER**.

warscroll_ability.name: Maestros of Discordance
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: An Infernal Enrapturess can play music so dissonant that it causes physical harm to enemies while captivating other daemonic entities beyond the veil of reality.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick another visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the enemy target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy target.

Then, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• **Heal (X)** the friendly target, where **X** is the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target unit with a total Health characteristic equal to or less than the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.

warscroll_ability.name: The Mirror's Depths
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When a warrior stares into a Contorted Epitome’s mirror, they see all their hopes and fears reflected there and cannot tear their eyes away.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Lithe and Swift
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Daemonettes move so fast that the mortal eye almost cannot follow; they vault, twirl and leap through enemy ranks like some marvellous troupe of performers, though their laughter soon turns savage as their claws go to work.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move D3+3". It can pass through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Quicksilver Speed
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The thrill of the chase is everything to the daemonic Seekers; if no prey lies before them, their steeds will simply keep powering onwards, tongues flicking out as they search for soul- traces of new, enticing quarry.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn, it can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

warscroll_ability.name: Swallow Energy
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: A Contorted Epitome’s mirror absorbs the most deep-seated conceits of those who look into it, channelling those fantasies back to Slaanesh’s Temple of Twisted Mirrors, where they can be blended into delicious torments.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. 

The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **SUMMON** ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Disharmonious Song
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The trilling song of the Fiends is hideous to perceive, breaking and twisting the mind. For those with arcane gifts or a divine connection, it is even more excruciating.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick each visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit that did not use a **CHARGE** or **FIGHT** ability this turn to be a target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. You can re-roll the dice if the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Gorge on Excess
warscroll_ability.lore: Glutos’s followers grow strong on acts of gross indulgence.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (6)** the target or return a number of slain models to the target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Atrocious Ministrations
warscroll_ability.lore: To be the subject of a Lord of Pain’s monstrous arts is always energising for a true Hedonite – provided they survive the experience…
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Masters of the Zephyr
warscroll_ability.lore: The Windmage Thyrielle and her disciples have formed a bond with Tzul, a minor aelementor from the Realm of Light.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Tzul** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Tzul** next to it.
• While this unit’s **Tzul** is next to it, it has **FLY**.
• While this unit’s **Thyrielle** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Living Gale
warscroll_ability.lore: Though small compared to the mightiest aelementors of the wind, Tzul can still summon buffeting gales.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit with this unit’s **Tzul** next to it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Place this unit’s **Tzul** next to this unit.
• You can move the target up to D3".
• Then, if this unit is within 6" of the target, you can move this unit up to D6". It cannot end that move in combat.

Add 2" to the distance each unit can move for each instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your battle scripture.

**Designer’s Note:** *If your opponent would prefer to move their own models, pre-measure the distance and indicate where they should move their models to.*

warscroll_ability.name: Crippling Famishment
warscroll_ability.lore: With a snap of his fingers, Glutos afflicts his prey with debilitating hunger pangs that see them double over and stumble in bouts of sudden weakness.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• Halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Gaze Upon My Magnificence and Weep
warscroll_ability.lore: It is said that to look upon Sigvald is to have one’s mind stolen. Those who resist are cut down by outraged fellows – much to the petulant prince’s delight.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will **adulate** or **reject** Sigvald.

***Adulate:*** Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.

***Reject:*** Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Bargain with the Mist-Daemons
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The entities bound into the mists that surround a Shardspeaker can offer power – but one must take caution in dealing with such spiteful creatures...
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 2 mortal damage on this unit. On a 3+, add 2 to the casting roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Paragon of Vainglory
warscroll_ability.lore: Sigvald is the epitome of vainglory, one of Slaanesh’s favourite sins. So great is his sense of superiority that few can stand before his prideful assaults.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ , for the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Shardslash** is equal to the unmodified charge roll.
• Melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Slaughterous Celebrants
warscroll_ability.lore: Those Hedonites who follow a Lord of Hysteria have been stoked into such an inferno of depraved and mindless revelry that to approach them is to be dragged into a pit of wild, slavering animals and soon ripped to shreds.
warscroll_ability.effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, melee weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Revels
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Empowered by the lordly daemon that shares their soul, a Lord of Hysteria knows many means by which to inspire a wild frenzy in their followers.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick a visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is a **PARAGON**, apply the following effect to the target. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effect to the target:

• For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Truths of the Twisted Mirror
warscroll_ability.lore: When flushed with the favour of Slaanesh, a Shardspeaker can use their sorcerous ability and cursed mirror to show an enemy a reflection of their darkest and most unspeakable desires, lowering their guard at a crucial moment.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is a **PARAGON**, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Share The Pain
warscroll_ability.lore: Lords of Pain have mastered every kind of torment; they shrug off agony as if it were nothing, all while doling out the same hideous sensations to their foes.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is in combat. In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit for a damage point inflicted by a combat attack, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Veiled Threat
warscroll_ability.lore: Slaangors can move as smoothly and soundlessly as silk before bursting out into a bleating, bellowing charge.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: One With the Wind
warscroll_ability.lore: Tzul follows the swift advance of the Zephyrites – but he is a mischievous spirit, always looking for unsuspecting foes to menace.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Place this unit’s **Tzul** next to the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sweeping Blows** is 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Dark Temptations
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a flourish and an ecstatic sigh, the Keeper of Secrets alters its scent to elicit the desired effect in its victims and plunge itself into a blissful state of combat euphoria.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following musks. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn.

***Alluring Musk***:
• This unit’s weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.

***Psychotropic Musk***:
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Gutless
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Allow Me To Demonstrate
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: For all their boasting and crushing arrogance, Lords of Hubris truly are astounding to behold in combat – a fact that inevitably galvanises their devoted sycophants.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Bestial Onslaught
warscroll_ability.lore: With primal savagery, the Slaangor Fiendbloods take to the battlefield, ready to surround their enemies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit if it is **waiting in ambush**.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Instinctive Advance
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Slaangors are drawn to the screams of the battlefield as a hungering predator is drawn to wounded prey.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can move 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

warscroll_ability.name: Dance of the Wailing Blade
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Myrmidesh are masters of a martial form known as the Dance of the Wailing Blade – a sword-kata that emphasises quick, cruel and painful counter-attacks.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Ego-Driven Excess
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Symbaresh have twisted their very souls in the hope of standing paramount amongst warriors. Nothing infuriates them more, therefore, than the sight of a potentially worthy rival.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has a higher Control characteristic than this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: The Thrill of Combat
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The sensory bombardment of a nearby melee gives the Blissbarbs a heady surge of adrenaline, heightening their reactions and the accuracy of their bowfire.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat** and they also have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Adrenaline Archers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Blissbarb Seekers live in such a heightened sensory state that enemies seem to move in slow motion; they weave to and fro through the most vicious combats, loosing arrows all the while.
