warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities this turn even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Irresistible Lure
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **MOVE** ability for a unit within 18" of and visible to this **MANIFESTATION**
warscroll_ability.lore: The Mirror lures mortals as a candle draws moths to its light. Those strong enough to turn away feel knives of anguish and loss driven into their hearts.
warscroll_ability.effect: If that enemy unit does not end that move closer to this **MANIFESTATION** than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the **MOVE** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Flensing Tongues
warscroll_ability.lore: Opening its soul-sucking maw, the Dreadful Visage lets fly a plethora of hooked tongues that lash and flense the flesh of those nearby.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until this **MANIFESTATION** is banished or destroyed, the target is **tongue-tied** while it is within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**. While the target is **tongue-tied**:

• It cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Your opponent must roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target when it uses a **RETREAT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Gifts of Pain and Pleasure
warscroll_ability.lore: When working in concert, the daemons of a Thricefold Discord can harness the magics of their chosen debaucheries to wrack enemies with torment or offer boons to diverting allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick either a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the target is a friendly unit, add 2" to its Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. If the target is an enemy unit, inflict **X** mortal damage on it, then **Heal (X)** this unit. **X** is equal to the number of models in this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Thricefold Court
warscroll_ability.lore: Though bound by pact and sin, the daemons of a Thricefold Discord are all potent in their own right.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each model in this unit is treated as an individual unit when determining the effect of the ‘Favour Most Fickle’ battle trait.

warscroll_ability.name: Dispensers of Favour
warscroll_ability.lore: Heralds of Slaanesh may hand out boons to servants who please or amuse them.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to **X** different friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets, where **X** is the number of models in this unit. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
On a 6+, apply the relevant effect to each target:

• **Daemonettes**: The target’s weapons have **Anti‑charge (+1 Rend)** until the start of your next turn.
• **Seekers**: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
• **Fiends**: Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Thricefold Court
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The daemons of a Thricefold Discord are exalted creatures, each steeped in a particular Sacred Seduction and determined to prove that its favoured sin is the most ensnaring.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects that you did not pick in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:

***Sins of Soul***: While an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** is visible to this unit, add 1 to this unit’s power level.

***Sins of Flesh***: This unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodifed hit rolls of 5+.

***Sins of Mind***: Each time a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

warscroll_ability.name: Soulgorgers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The grandest Bladebringers excel in stoking fits of manic violence in their fellow daemonic chariot crews and their steeds.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non‑**UNIQUE HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WAR MACHINES** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Soporific Musk
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Fiend exudes a pervasive and oily musk that numbs a foe to all but the most extreme of stimuli.
warscroll_ability.declare:
If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 9" of it to be the target.

If this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Maiming Charge
warscroll_ability.lore: As they crash into the melee, the cruel wounds inflicted by the Hellstriders not only cause horrible carnage but leave any survivors shocked and agonised.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy **INFANTRY** units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Gnash-gnaw On Their Bones!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: At a Clawlord’s command, their minions hurl themselves at the foe.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO VERMINUS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Lithe and Swift
warscroll_ability.lore: Charging Daemonettes can riddle an enemy with a quicksilver flurry of claw‑strikes.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Piercing Claws** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Quicksilver Speed
warscroll_ability.lore: Seekers of Slaanesh are daemonic hunters who are swift beyond belief.
warscroll_ability.effect: When making run rolls for this unit, if you roll a 1-3, you can use a value of 4 instead.

warscroll_ability.name: Sweat-Soaked and Reeking
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Rotswords’ clammy stench is a weapon in its own right, seeing foes recoil in horror the moment it reaches their nostrils.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Pinning Attacks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Whether by javelin, arrow or sheer terror, the victims of the Kavalos War Chariot find themselves rooted in place.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Clinical Efficiency
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase, Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit.
warscroll_ability.lore: With a sharp gesture, the Liege-Mortek orders his cohorts to unleash a deadly assault.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick a visible friendly **Mortek Guard, Mortek Triaxes** or **Mortek Crawler** unit that has not used an **ATTACK** ability this phase and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use either a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase or a **FIGHT** ability. If it is picked to do so:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.
• The target's ranged weapons (if any) have **Shoot in Combat** for the rest of the turn.
• If the target uses a **SHOOT** ability and is not in combat, all of its shooting attacks must target units in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Draw on Power
warscroll_ability.lore: The necromantic energy of this long-perished vampire can be siphoned by their kind for sustenance or drawn upon to grant a temporary rush of power.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Then, this **MANIFESTATION** is banished and removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: Warp-ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Warp-Grinder's tip tears open the realms, Skaven warriors burst forth shrieking and with blades drawn.
warscroll_ability.declare: You can only use this ability if this unit is **in the tunnels below**.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice and pick one of the following effects.

•  On a 4+, pick an enemy unit that is more than 6" from all other enemy units. You can set up this unit on the battlefield in combat with that enemy unit and not in combat with any other enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up **in the tunnels below** with the ‘Tunnel Skulkers’ ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit, in combat with that enemy unit, and not in combat with any other enemy units.

•  You can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up **in the tunnels below** with the ‘Tunnel Skulkers’ ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Merciless Ambush
warscroll_ability.lore: Despite her size and terrifying presence, Drycha stalks silently through hidden realm-root passageways, emerging without warning to fall upon her prey.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat and has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn, make a charge roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within ½" of an enemy unit and wholly within X" of a terrain feature that has a friendly **overgrown token**, where X is equal to the charge roll. If you do so, this unit has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Drawn to Slaughter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You or your opponent declared the 'Eruption of Fury' ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: As battle rages and pent-up wrath is explosively unleashed, more Bloodletters rip through the veil between worlds, keen to join the massacre.
warscroll_ability.effect: Return 1 slain model to this unit. If your opponent declared that ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability and the unit using the ability is in combat with this unit, return 3 slain models to this unit instead.

warscroll_ability.name: No Respite
warscroll_ability.lore: Blood Warriors excel in the wild melee of battle, preferring to take the fight to key points in the enemy defences where the slaughter will be most prevalent.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, it has **WARD (5+).**

warscroll_ability.name: Paragon of Gluttony
warscroll_ability.lore: None embody gluttony better than Glutos, who is ever craving new, extreme and excessive delicacies.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following delicacies for Glutos to savour. You cannot pick a delicacy that you picked in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:

***Heart of a Shadow Daemon***: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**MONSTER** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

***Blood of an Aelven Princeling***: Each time a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **RUN** ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

***Crushed Incarnate’s Core***: Add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.

***Unspeakable Viscera***: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Damned Conduit
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The corruptive energies of Slaanesh and his daemonic courtiers emanate from a Fane, undermining and perverting the virtues of those nearby.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, while the target is within **X"** of this terrain feature, the target’s weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability, where **X** is determined by the current battle round as follows:

**Battle Round - X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"

warscroll_ability.name: Only The Worthy
warscroll_ability.lore: As the weakest are culled from the Blood Warriors’ ranks, the survivors receive Khorne’s dark blessings, granting them ever greater ferocity and strength.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The following cumulative effects apply depending on the number of models in this unit that are slain.

**1+** Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
**4+** Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
**8+** Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
**16+** Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons and this unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

warscroll_ability.name: The Endless Dance
warscroll_ability.lore: The Masque is master of every breed of quickstep, pivot and sauté imaginable – and many that appear to defy both imagination and the limits of the flesh.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

***The Dance of Dreaming***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

***The Pavane of Slaanesh***: This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

***The Waltz of Lethargy***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: You First, I Insist...
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: So confident is this champion of excess that they allow their foe a futile swipe for free.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Your opponent must decide whether the target will **accept** or **decline** this unit’s challenge:

If they **accept**, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.

If they **decline**, for the rest of the turn:
• The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Ceaseless Violence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As heads roll and blood flows, these daemons become more desperate to partake in the slaughter.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 3". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Imperilling Slashes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Screamers’ sharp fins and horns slice apart shields and armour as if they were parchment, leaving the foe vulnerable to attack.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
warscroll_ability.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.
warscroll_ability.effect:
While this unit is within a friendly non‐**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: Strength of Stone
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Stonemage focuses upon the stoic majesty of their guardian mountain, imbuing a nearby group of Alarith with its immovability and might.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **Alarith Stoneguard** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
• The target cannot make pile-in moves.

warscroll_ability.name: Raise the Earth
warscroll_ability.lore: With a great rumbling and the grinding of stone upon stone, the caster turns an area of clear ground into a jumble of clefts, scree and jagged terrain that is extremely perilous for warriors to traverse.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a non-**FLY** unit (friendly or enemy) that is contesting the target objective uses a **MOVE** ability, inflict D6 mortal damage on that unit after that ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Elemental Endurance
warscroll_ability.lore: Alarith Stonemages can draw on the power of the sigils to impart a measure of their stone-like resilience to their allies.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, for the rest of that battle round, when resolving the damage sequence for a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool on a 2+ instead of a 3+.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Discovery
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Scinari Loreseekers study all aspects of the realms to uncover hidden founts of power.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a non-**FACTION TERRAIN** terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to casting rolls for units (friendly and enemy) while they are within 3" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Independent Operative
warscroll_ability.lore: Loreseekers venture deep into unfamiliar lands searching for arcane artefacts and are adept at operating on their own without support.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Nullification
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Scinari Loreseekers can temporarily nullify powerful magical artefacts in order to facilitate their retrieval from the hands of less responsible beings.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit is in combat with the target, the corresponding effect below applies until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the corresponding effect below applies until the start of your next turn:

***Holder of Forbidden Treasures***: If the target has an artefact of power, that artefact of power has no effect.

***An Insignificant Underling***: If the target does not have an artefact of power, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: Leashed Fury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Embracing the Tyrionic side of their training, the Loreseeker funnels the raging emotions of the Aqshian landscape into their bladecraft.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn:

• Each time this unit is picked to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, if you spend 1 **rage dice** as part of that ability, it counts as 3 **rage dice**.
• This unit can be picked to use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability even if you have already used it this turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Customised Nullsuit
warscroll_ability.lore: Additional pipes have been welded to the Null-Khemist’s suit that constantly vent excess nullstone gas around them in a magic-dispelling cloud.
warscroll_ability.effect:
• This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Diligent Researcher
warscroll_ability.lore: A Null-Khemist does not stay still for long; after all, one cannot conduct proper field testing by remaining in one place.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time your opponent spends any **rage dice** as part of the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, if this unit is not in combat, it can move up to **X**D6", where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. It cannot end that move in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: We're Working Here!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Burdened with the dangerous job of repairing skyvessels on the move, an Endrinrigger wants nothing more than to focus on the task in hand; engaging them in combat is a surefire way to garner their anger.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

**1+ *Irked***: This unit’s **Aethermatic Saws** have **Crit (Auto-wound)**.
**4+ *Exasperated***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**7 *Incensed***: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: Prowling the Flanks
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Killaboss lurks at the edges of the battle looking for weaknesses in the enemy’s lines.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

warscroll_ability.name: Drag 'Em Out
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Killaboss picks the toughest-looking git and has their Gnashtoof drag them away from their allies.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. Then, if possible, your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Just Keep Stabbin'
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Killaboss angrily kicks their luckless Stab-grot towards an enemy, where the little git does what they do best.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Add 1 to each roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Jump 'Em, Ladz, Or Else!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The Killaboss knows just how to motivate their boyz: threats, intimidation and a very real demonstration of what will happen to them if they don’t get stuck in.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick a friendly **Gutrippaz** or **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Indolent Bludgeoning
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ever unwilling to expend too much effort, these Sloven Knights are far more deadly when their allies are carrying out the bulk of the red work.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with both this unit and another friendly **MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE** unit, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Putrescent Piety
warscroll_ability.lore: Presenting a humble and devout persona to their flock, these Rotbringers seek to spread not only the Garden of Nurgle but also the word of the Grandfather himself.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has **PRIEST (1)** for the rest of the battle.

warscroll_ability.name: Disgustingly Devoted
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: These Blightkings channel the fury of the Bright Realm to further deepen their faith – rage is not so far removed from despair, after all.
warscroll_ability.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, give this unit D3 ritual points.

warscroll_ability.name: Hunter's Endurance
warscroll_ability.lore: As the spirit-song intensifies and the magic of life surges across the battlefield, Kurnoth Hunters are gripped with a sacred fervour of the chase that sees them shrug off wounds.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Vital Rangers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: As the energies of Ghyran surge, the sapblood of these aggressive Kurnothi sings with the thrill of the hunt, carrying them ever forth.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It must end that move within the **creeping overgrowth** and not in combat.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Osmosis
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This elder Treelord sends their roots deep into the earth, questing for more jade magic to drink in.

warscroll_ability.name: Jade Abjuration
warscroll_ability.lore: The Treelord weaves the energies of life into a wall of viridescent light that disrupts and repels hostile magics.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit or a visible friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

•  Ignore the effects of enemy **SPELL** abilities on units (friendly and enemy) while they are within 6" of the target.
•  Weapons used by enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 1 while they are within 6" of the target

warscroll_ability.name: The Bell Tolls
warscroll_ability.lore: With a swing and a clang, the bell doth peal; Skaven march and man-things squeal!
warscroll_ability.effect: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly **SKAVEN** unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Pealing Portal
warscroll_ability.lore: The Grey Seer channels dark sorceries to rip open a gnawhole at the base of their hellish contraption.
warscroll_ability.declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly **Gnawhole** for the purposes of the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’, ‘Tunnels Through Reality’ and ‘The Endless Vermintide’ abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Echoes of the Vermindoom
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: As the bell rings in time with one of its counterparts in sacred Blight City, it releases a pulse of ruinous energies that invigorate the swarm.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKAVEN** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.

warscroll_ability.name: Foetid Features
warscroll_ability.lore: No two Corruptors are alike; each has its own repulsive attributes that further augment its noxious presence.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:

***Noisome Halitosis***: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Plague Breath**.

***Pestilential Seepage***: While this unit is damaged, you can re-roll chanting rolls for friendly **PESTILENS PRIESTS** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.

***Curdled Miasma***: While they are within 6" of this unit, enemy units are not visible to other enemy units more than 3" from them.

warscroll_ability.name: Seething Blight
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This plague sees victims enter an apoplectic frenzy that cannot be quelled; howling with rage, they lash out again and again until the sheer exertion causes their hearts to give out.
warscroll_ability.declare: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the battle:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

• If the target is replaced and the replacement unit has 1 model, allocate damage points to that replacement unit equal to half **X** (rounding up), where **X** is its Health characteristic minus the number of damage points allocated to it (if any).

• If the target is replaced and the replacement unit has more than 1 model, half the models in that replacement unit (rounding up) are automatically slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Slaughter
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As battle literally rages, the Ironscale leads Khaine’s faithful in massacring the foe without restraint or mercy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If this unit is in combat, you can re-roll the dice. If the roll is lower than your **fury level**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by this unit and the target until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Demands of the Witness
warscroll_ability.lore: Iridan understands better than any that the most assured way to avoid the incremental erosion of the flaw in the Reforging process is to avoid being cut down, and so they exhort their charges to vanquish their foes quickly, mercilessly and without hesitation.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.

warscroll_ability.name: The Flames of Hope
warscroll_ability.lore: The billowing flames borne by Iridan are instantly recognisable by all of Sigmar’s greatest warriors, even those who have lost nearly every part of themselves in his name.
warscroll_ability.effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: On Wings of Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Ariax swoops over the heads of the foe, robbing them of their will to fight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target charged this turn, apply the effects below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effects below:

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-**CORE** ability
warscroll_ability.lore: Iridan does battle where others cannot tread, fighting in lands transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on this shepherd of lost souls, their faith granting them near immunity to such impurities.
warscroll_ability.effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Lightning Quick
warscroll_ability.lore: One of the swiftest and most agile mounts in the realms, Gryph-chargers deftly speed their riders away from danger.
warscroll_ability.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Magmadroth’s Claws and Horns** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Like Nails on a Chalkboard
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared the 'Eruption of Fury' ability for a unit within 12" of and visible to this unit.
warscroll_ability.lore: The jarring, discordant sounds emanating from the Enrapturess’s lyre are enough to drive anyone over the edge of sanity.
warscroll_ability.effect: You and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, pick a unit (friendly or enemy) other than the enemy unit using the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability within that enemy unit’s combat range. That unit is now the target of that ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability. Your opponent must spend as many **rage dice** as possible as part of that ability, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Volcanic Blood
warscroll_ability.lore: Born of fire and flame, Magmadroths pulse with the throbbing heat of the volcanic caverns in which they make their fyrenests.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Seeing Red
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As it reaches boiling point, the hot-blooded Magmadroth lets loose a furious bellow that serves either as a precursor to a violent rampage or as a means to therapeutically
warscroll_ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Channelled Ire***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

***Cathartic Release***: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. For each 4+, **Heal (1)** this unit.

***Shield of Anger***: This unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Fire, Blood and Vengeance
warscroll_ability.lore: Should their sire be imperilled, an Auric Runeson will fly into a berserk rage. Their mount echoes their fury, for the Magmadroth’s own progenitor is likely to be in just as much danger.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **Auric Runefather** **on Magmadroth** on the battlefield to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, while the target is in combat, damaged or destroyed.

warscroll_ability.name: Fiery Disposition
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: By channelling the volatile spirit of the Magmadroths they so venerate, the Flameseekers are imbued with a portion of Vulcatrix’s power.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn, where **X** is equal to your **fury level**.

***Vigour of the Ur-Salamander***: Add **X**" to this unit’s Move characteristic.

***Fiery Determination***: Add **X** to this unit’s control score.

***Kyndlewrath***: Add **X** to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Emberteeth**.

warscroll_ability.name: Numbing Toxins
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Some Blissbarbs dip their arrows in substances that deprive those they strike of sensation, dulling their reactions.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target cannot use reactions or be picked to be the target of reactions used by your opponent or by units in your opponent’s army for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Delightful Defeatism
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who see how willingly the Herald’s ‘instrument’ submits to torment are struck by the realisation that fighting the Dark Prince’s followers is a futile endeavour.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each time a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, your opponent must make 3 fewer rally rolls of D6.

warscroll_ability.name: Shock Cavalry
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Stormstrike Palladors are masters at performing devastating charges into the unguarded flanks of enemies already engaged in combat.
warscroll_ability.declare:
If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with both of the following units to be the target:
• This unit.
• A friendly unit that did not charge this turn.
warscroll_ability.effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Horns and Hooves** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1 -** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2 -** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3 -** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS, PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Leech Realm-Magic
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Daemonsmith rips arcane energies from a nearby ley line. The more devastated the land around them, the more power they can drain.
warscroll_ability.effect:
• Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn.

• You can pick an objective or terrain feature that has a friendly **desolation token** and that this unit is contesting. If you do so, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle, then remove that **desolation token** from the battlefield. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: Zealous Acolytes
warscroll_ability.lore: Those who disturb the Anointed Sentinels as they protect or claim Hashut’s sacred ground quickly discover their mistake.
warscroll_ability.effect:
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.
• Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective you control.

warscroll_ability.name: Get in There and Wallop 'Em!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: This Megaboss takes it as a personal affront if any of their ladz are not well and truly stuck in to the fighting.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that was not set up this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, when you use the ‘Mighty Destroyers’ ability, you can pick that friendly unit to be a second target.

warscroll_ability.name: You Ain't Gonna Show Me Up
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Should the first hit fail to lay the enemy low, the Megaboss will make sure the second does. And the third, and the fourth...
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability this turn, spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Boss-choppa** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

warscroll_ability.name: You Call Dat a Punch?
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability that targeted this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: There’s nothing a Brute loves more than showing someone how much ’arder than them they are.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Brimming with Rancour
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Revenant Draconith turns towards a foe, the witchlights of its eyes flickering. Radiating pure malevolence, the enemy dares not approach its mouldering form.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot end moves made as part of a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability within **X**" of this unit, where **X** is equal to your current **fury level**.

warscroll_ability.name: Calamitous Shockwave
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Rearing up, the Infernal Taurus slams its hooves into the ground, causing the earth around it to buckle and staggering nearby foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is lower than your **fury level**, for the rest of the turn:

• The target cannot use the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability.
• When resolving the damage sequence for the target, your opponent cannot spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Daemonic Resilience
warscroll_ability.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Hunt Begins
warscroll_ability.lore: The Scar-Veteran leads a cohort of mounted Seraphon in outflanking the enemy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **SERAPHON CAVALRY** unit if those units have not been deployed.
warscroll_ability.effect: Set up that friendly **CAVALRY** unit in reserve **stalking** **the prey**. Then, either set up this unit in reserve **stalking the prey** or set up this unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. Those units have now been deployed.

warscroll_ability.name: Volatile Animus
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The furious energies of Aqshy combine with the forces animating the Revenant Draconith to make it highly unpredictable.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Retaliatory Posture***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this phase.

***Unrelenting Ferocity***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.
• Add 1 to the Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this phase

warscroll_ability.name: Nightmare's Miasma
warscroll_ability.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.
warscroll_ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Reptilian Instincts
warscroll_ability.lore: The warbeasts of the Seraphon are quick to perceive threats; their riders give them their head as they close in on their prey.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve. Pick each friendly unit that is **stalking the prey** to be the targets.

After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, set up each target on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and within 18" of the unit that used the **SHOOT** ability.

Then, you can spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If you do:
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
• Each target can move up to **X**", where **X** is the number of **rage** **dice** spent. It must end that move no further from the unit that used the **SHOOT** ability than it was at the start of the move.

Then, for the rest of the turn, each time a target uses a **CHARGE** ability, it must end that charge move in combat with the unit that used the **SHOOT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Indignant Outburst
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Filled with self-loathing and seething resentment, once the Vengorian Lord has a target for their simmering ire, they let their outrage boil over.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is in combat, gain 1 **rage dice**.

warscroll_ability.name: Cometary Alignment
warscroll_ability.lore: The slann can predict when specific celestial bodies will appear in the skies above Aqshy, their relative positions influencing the emotions of those fighting below.
warscroll_ability.effect: Pick a battle round. At the start of that battle round, set you and your opponent’s **fury levels** to 7. Then, at the start of the battle round after the one you picked, set your and your opponent’s **fury levels** to 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Celestial Unmaking
warscroll_ability.lore: The Starmaster manipulates the foe’s weapons, briefly rendering them as insubstantial as starlight.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s attacks have no effect.

warscroll_ability.name: Frenzied Surge
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Vengorian Lord tears through the press of combat to sate their desperate hunger, nearby undead find themselves swept along by their rabidity.
warscroll_ability.declare: You can pick another visible friendly non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** or **MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit and the target (if any) can move up to **X**+D3", where **X** is your **fury level**. They can move through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units during that move and must end that move in combat.

If you picked a target, after moving, this unit and the target must be in combat with the same enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Arcane Aureole
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The corona of celestial magic that surrounds the Starmaster’s palanquin pulses outwards in a radiant burst, imbuing a nearby spell-form with heightened arcane potency.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **MANIFESTATION** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, add **X** to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent.

warscroll_ability.name: Ferocious Influence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When a Karkadrak enters a blood frenzy, other creatures are swept up in its bloody mania, ripping chunks of flesh from limbs and torsos and caving in skulls with their hooves.
warscroll_ability.declare: You can only use this ability if this unit charged this turn. Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS CAVALRY** and **WAR MACHINE** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: One Stop, No Return
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Black Coach bears down upon its target at the appointed hour, flaming hoofprints burning the skies. Where it arrives, soul-numbing terror is brought with it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, attacks made by those units cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Wrathful Abandon
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Imbued with the eager fury of battle, the Chaos Lord and their warriors are and swiftly fall upon their foes.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
warscroll_ability.effect: Each target can move a number of inches equal to your **fury level**. If a target was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with all of the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move. It cannot move into combat with units it was not already in combat with at the start of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Fortcrusha Flail** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

warscroll_ability.name: Longshanks
warscroll_ability.lore: Mega-Gargants tower high above the battlefield; with their long legs, they can step over most obstacles.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can pass through models in non-**MONSTER** units and parts of terrain features that are less than 4" tall.

warscroll_ability.name: Son of Behemat
warscroll_ability.lore: The Sons of Behemat are nearly as difficult to kill as their mighty progenitor.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

warscroll_ability.name: For the Glory of the Dark Gods
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The more these warriors embrace the fervour within, the greater the favour that is bestowed upon them by the Ruinous Powers.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

***1+ Riled***: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

***4+ Seething***: This unit’s melee weapons have **Anti‐charge (+1 Rend)**.

***7 Enraged***: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it has not charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: It's Goin' Down
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Narrowing their eyes at a particularly bothersome example of a pipsqueak construction, the Gatebreaker cracks their neck, rolls their shoulders, tucks a giant boulder under their arm and takes off running towards it.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• This unit has a Move characteristic of 4D6".
• While this unit is within 1" of a terrain feature, the Attacks characteristic of its **Hurled Boulder** is D6 instead of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Beast
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

warscroll_ability.name: Fill the Pot
warscroll_ability.lore: As enemies are cut down by the ogors, the Slaughtermaster collects their remains to fill his cauldron.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit’s cauldron is either **filled with grisly remains** or **empty**. It starts the battle **empty**. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit’s cauldron is **empty**, it becomes **filled with grisly remains**.

warscroll_ability.name: Off in a Huff
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: In a fit of pique, the Gatebreaker storms off, showing wanton disregard for anything that might happen to be in their path.
warscroll_ability.effect: You and your opponent must roll off. Each player adds their **fury level** to their roll. Then, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat unless you won the roll-off.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Carriage
warscroll_ability.lore: Unimpeded by physical obstacles due to its phantasmal form and carried upon spectral winds, a Black Coach hurtles towards its victims with horrifying swiftness.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: The First Shot's Mine
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Glory-seekers all, Bloodpelt Hunters insist on shooting first. Their example and confidence inevitably inspires other ogors to follow suit.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **BEASTCLAW** units that target that enemy unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Statue Tossing
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: When throwing rocks gets a bit monotonous, Mancrushers seek out weighty sculptures to lob at the enemy instead – turns out smashing the foe with their own statuary is a great way to let off steam.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Throwin’ Rocks** is 3 instead of D3.

Then, you can spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If you do:

•  For each **rage dice** spent, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Throwin’ Rocks** for the rest of the turn.
•  If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

warscroll_ability.name: Ogor-Made Ammunition
warscroll_ability.lore: Anything that could even slightly be considered as ammunition is shoved into Grell’s pilfered cannon.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the phase:
•  All of this unit’s shooting attacks must target that enemy unit.
•  The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Blastbelch** is D6+2 instead of D3+2.

warscroll_ability.name: Winter's Cruelty
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Huskard Torr can compel the Everwinter to blast cowardly foes with its full, icy disdain.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of damage points allocated to the target by attacks made with this unit’s **Ice Blast** this phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Mantrapper's Accomplices
warscroll_ability.lore: Mantrappers are accompanied by motley gaggles of gnoblars and hunting beasts.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Sabrefang**, **Gnoblars** and **Trap** are **Mantrapper accomplice** tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all its tokens next to it.

If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to it, remove those **Mantrapper accomplices** from the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Unquenchable Faith
warscroll_ability.lore: Such is her unyielding devotion to the God-King that should the Pontifex be laid low, her final act is to beseech Sigmar to empower her followers so that they might fight on for his glory.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, this unit can immediately use the ‘Sigmar’s Blessing’ ability below as if it were your hero phase. If it does so:

• That prayer does not count towards the number of **PRAYER** abilities this unit can use this phase.
• Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, you must use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified.
• The effect of that prayer applies for the rest of the battle instead of until the start of your next turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Heads on Pikes
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: The severed heads of leaders sentenced to death by the Decapitator are put on display as effective deterrents.
warscroll_ability.declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **HERO** by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy **HERO** has been destroyed, pick an objective or terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the target objective or terrain feature.

warscroll_ability.name: Crucible of Rage
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Warforger harnesses the elemental fury of the Bright Realm to enhance their own spellcasting and empower their fellow mages.
warscroll_ability.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Executioner and Enforcer
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Royal Decapitator acts as a grim reminder to their fellow ghouls that cowardice is a high crime in Ushoran’s court.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick another friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain. Then, until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: The Howling Saint
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Varghulfs are the holiest servants of Ushoran, their blessed presence serving to deepen the faith and amplify the conviction of nearby clerics.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS PRIEST** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
The next time the target uses a **PRAYER** ability this phase:

• When picking targets for that prayer, you can measure range and visibility from this unit instead of from the chanter.
• Add 1 to the chanting roll for that prayer.

warscroll_ability.name: Cowed Into Inaction
warscroll_ability.lore: Temporarily possessing and channelling his voice through a nearby enemy warlord, Vokmortian intimidates their warriors until they are paralysed with fear.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
warscroll_ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time an enemy unit within the target’s combat range uses a command, unless your opponent spends 1 **rage dice** to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are lost.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Snow Plough
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Thundertusks are massive creatures whose broad frames and long, scooping tusks allow them to crash through snow drifts and enemy formations with equal ease.
warscroll_ability.effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it is in combat. If the charge roll is 2 or less when it does so, it does not count as having charged.

warscroll_ability.name: Cold Fury
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Reaction: You declared the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: The elemental energies of the Everwinter and the Realm of Fire combine within the Thundertusk to explosive effect.
warscroll_ability.effect:
When resolving attacks as part of that ability:

• For each unmodified hit roll of 6, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.
• For each unmodified hit roll of 1, allocate 1 mortal damage to this unit instead of D3 (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point.

warscroll_ability.name: Sigmar's Blessing
warscroll_ability.lore: Zenestra calls upon the God-King to grant her flock greater strength and protection should they surge into the fray with his name on their lips.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:

• The target’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.
• If the chanting roll was 10+, the target has **WARD (5+)** if it charged in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Thunderous Diversion
warscroll_ability.lore: Ogors who have fought alongside Grell for any length of time learn to take advantage of the distraction caused by the blasting mayhem she wreaks to avoid more troublesome foes, freeing them up to pursue easier meat.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is in combat with an enemy unit that had any damage inflicted on it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: The target can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase and can still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn. No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **RETREAT** ability.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves** is 4.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Bone-Tithe
warscroll_ability.lore: To reject Vokmortian’s demands is folly, yet to acquiesce to them involves no small degree of sacrifice...
warscroll_ability.effect:
Your opponent must pick 1 of the following effects:

***Pay the Tithe:*** Your opponent must pick a unit in their army on the battlefield to be the target. They cannot pick a **MANIFESTATION** Or terrain feature. Then:
• Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
• Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot be healed, have slain models returned to it or be replaced.

***Deny the Ossiarchs their Rightful Due:*** Pick 1 of the following effects:
• You gain 4 **relentless discipline** points.
• Pick an objective you do not control. For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the control scores of friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units while they are contesting that objective.
• For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic and add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Gaze of Death**.

warscroll_ability.name: The Coldness of Death
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: By taking down the enemy’s greatest warriors, so too do the Mortis Reapers sap them of their battle fury.
warscroll_ability.effect: If an enemy **HERO** was destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, your opponent must reduce their **fury level** to 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Terminate Their Command
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Creeping unseen through the enemy ranks, the Mortis Reapers quickly close in on their real target.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is more than 3" from all other enemy units, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

warscroll_ability.name: Slice and Soar
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Sunsteala Wheelas come hurtling into the melee, their scythe-like blades can slice through limbs and puncture armour. Such is their speed that it only takes a small patch of uneven terrain to see the chariots rocketed skywards – something the daredevil drivers often intentionally seek out.
warscroll_ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it charged this turn. Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. If there are 2 models in this unit, add 1 to each roll. If there are 3 or more models in this unit, add 2 to each roll. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Then, you can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

warscroll_ability.name: Cool Tempers
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: So bitterly cold is the aura that surrounds a Thundertusk that it can even extinguish the fires of rage that burn within those who fight in the Bright Realm.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is wholly outside friendly territory and not in combat, your opponent must reduce their **fury level** by 1, to a minimum of 0.

warscroll_ability.name: Gut-Wrenching Stench
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Little smells worse than a Fellwater Troggoth, except maybe a riled-up, overheating Fellwater Troggoth slick with rancid sweat. To experience this unique odour up close is to see your stomach violently try to leave your body in protest.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. You can spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Add **X** to the roll, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent.

• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, on a 5+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Attendants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The spectral attendants of the Black Coach bear potent artefacts, usually the possessions with which the occupant was interred. These can greatly empower the coach itself or imbue it with an aura of death magic that invigorates nearby Nighthaunt.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Noble Blade:*** This unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (Mortal)** instead of **Crit (Auto-wound)**.

***Unholy Grail:*** Each time a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

***Tome of Undead Lore:*** This unit has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: One Stop, No Return
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: A Black Coach bears down upon its target at the appointed hour, flaming hoofprints burning the skies. Where it arrives, soul-numbing terror is brought with it.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an objective you do not control to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, while enemy units are contesting the target objective, attacks made by those units cannot score critical hits while this unit is also contesting it (treat them as regular hits instead).

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Attendants
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The spectral attendants of the Black Coach bear potent artefacts, usually the possessions with which the occupant was interred. These can greatly empower the coach itself or imbue it with an aura of death magic that invigorates nearby Nighthaunt.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Noble Blade:*** This unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (Mortal)** instead of **Crit (Auto-wound)**.

***Unholy Grail:*** Each time a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Rally' command, you receive 3 additional rally points.

***Tome of Undead Lore:*** This unit has **WIZARD (1)**.

warscroll_ability.name: Spectral Carriage
warscroll_ability.lore: Unimpeded by physical obstacles due to its phantasmal form and carried upon spectral winds, a Black Coach hurtles towards its victims with horrifying swiftness.
warscroll_ability.effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.

warscroll_ability.name: Terrifying Spectres
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: So utterly petrifying are the Spirit Hosts that the foe cannot take their eyes off their dreadful forms, granting other gheists the opportunity to land a telling blow.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** in combat with the enemy target to be the friendly target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by the enemy target that do not target this unit.
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls for the enemy target’s attacks.
• If you picked a friendly target, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of its melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy target.

warscroll_ability.name: Draughts of Delusion
warscroll_ability.lore: The contents of Ushoran’s chalice will warp the minds of those who drink from it, although to refuse to toast the Summerking risks affronting his subjects.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

***Drink Deep from the Chalice:*** Other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks made by the target have no effect.

***Turn Aside and Suffer the Consequences:*** Combat attacks that target that enemy unit score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.

warscroll_ability.name: Master of the Ethersea
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Tidecaster channels and manipulates the deep-sea magic of the ethersea in order to empower and defend their kin.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
If the target is **NAMARTI**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.

***Torrent of Blows***: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. That weapon has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***Protection of the Waves***: While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have **WARD (5+)**.

***Frenzy of the Ethersea***: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that friendly unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
