warscroll_ability.name: Merciless Hunters
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Namarti Reavers can fire arrows with such accuracy as to impair any defence, no matter how strong.
warscroll_ability.effect:
After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Everwinter's Ire
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: As the Everwinter rages, the Huskard draws power from its icy embrace.
warscroll_ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:

•  While your opponent’s **fury level** is equal to or up to 2 levels below your **fury level**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
•  While your opponent’s **fury level** is 3 or more levels below your **fury level**, add 2 to chanting rolls for this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Sigil of Doom
warscroll_ability.lore: Shedding gore as it hovers menacingly in the air, the Bleeding Icon is a fearsome portent of doom.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **BLADES OF KHORNE** unit wholly within 8" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target. Then, pick a passive **BLOOD TITHE** ability that you have not unlocked this battle.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the **blood tithe points** cost of the chosen ability, until the start of your next turn, the effects of that ability apply to the target as if it had been unlocked.

warscroll_ability.name: Redolence of Violence
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
warscroll_ability.lore: Should Dexcessa fall into a truly ecstatic rampage, very little can hope to survive the whirling, spiteful onslaught that they unleash – let alone remain in one piece.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2D6. If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to the roll. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target is automatically slain. If the target is a **MANIFESTATION** and the roll exceeds its banishment value, it is banished and removed from play.

warscroll_ability.name: An Ogor's Ogor
warscroll_ability.lore: Morga is a firm believer in embracing the wild heart of her race, and she makes no effort to hide her ravenous nature.
warscroll_ability.effect: More than 1 effect of the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability can apply to this unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to this unit once.

warscroll_ability.name: A Light Snack
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Morga and her loyal mount Grutta will happily take a bite out of enemies mid-brawl.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.

warscroll_ability.name: Been There, Ate That
warscroll_ability.lore: Morga has travelled across the Ghurish Hinterlands, and there is very little she has not dared to gorge herself on.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects:

• If any enemy non-**MONSTER** models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

• If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **MONSTER** unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy **MONSTER** has been destroyed, **Heal (D3+3)** this unit.

warscroll_ability.name: Battle Damaged
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves** is 5.

warscroll_ability.name: Oi! Pay Attention, Slobs!
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Grell’s many mercenary adventures have taught her how to counter many tactics – though sometimes, other ogors need heavy-handed ‘encouragement’ to listen…
warscroll_ability.effect: You must allocate D3 damage points to another visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit within 3" of this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that command has no effect and still counts as having been used, but the command points spent to use it are regained by your opponent.

warscroll_ability.name: Firing from the Belly
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: An ogor’s sturdy frame easily absorbs the recoil of even cannon-sized weapons.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Powder Gnoblars
warscroll_ability.lore: When assisted by a Gnoblar minion, Leadbelchers can cause even more carnage.
warscroll_ability.effect:
This unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** are tokens. There are 2 **Powder Gnoblars** for every 4 models in this unit.

Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, for each of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** that are on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 hit roll of 1 but if that attack misses, remove 1 of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** from the battlefield after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.

warscroll_ability.name: Pitiless Warlord
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for an **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
warscroll_ability.lore: Anyone caught slacking under the gaze of a Tyrant is sure to regret it; better to put the effort in before they notice.
warscroll_ability.effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.

warscroll_ability.name: Glutthorn Stampede
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Glutthorns are heavy and ponderous beasts, and when they pick up momentum on the charge, the very earth shakes at their onset. Any foes who avoid being gored or trampled in the initial impact are sent sprawling, and it takes crucial moments for them to regather themselves.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is **INFANTRY**. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Shock and Gore
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The impact and ferocity of a Maulbeast Cavalry charge inevitably leave any survivors staggered and shaken.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.

warscroll_ability.name: Primal Bellow
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The Huskard drives their Stonehorn to unleash a mighty roar that sends nearby monsters into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target or pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 4+:

•  If the target is a friendly unit, its **Companion** weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

•  If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Enraged Roar
warscroll_ability.lore: The ear-splitting enraged roar of a Stonehorn sends the beasts of the Mawpath into a frenzy.
warscroll_ability.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are within this unit’s combat range.

warscroll_ability.name: Blessed of the Old Ice
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: The chilling presence of a Frostlord and the freezing breath of their Thundertusk mount invigorates Beastclaw warriors.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability in the same turn.

warscroll_ability.name: Rain of Scrap
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Salvaged weapons, shards of metal and the odd screaming gnoblar rain down upon the enemy, forcing them to take cover or dodge out of the way.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Until the start of your next turn, subtract **X**" from the target’s Move characteristic (to a minimum Move characteristic of 1"), where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks.

Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **RUN** or **RETREAT** abilities and cannot use or be picked to be the target of abilities that would allow it to be set up on the battlefield.

warscroll_ability.name: Through the Frosts
warscroll_ability.lore: Despite their size, Hunters are skilled in the art of the ambush, advancing under the cover of lingering icy mists.
warscroll_ability.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.

warscroll_ability.name: Ferocious Sabrefangs
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Sabrefangs are apex predators in their natural environment. Suffering no competitors, they will meet any aggression towards them with terrifying savagery.
warscroll_ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect: Roll 2 dice for each **Sabrefang** in this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

warscroll_ability.name: Relentless Predators
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Maulbeast Raiders are ever on the move, pursuing their quarry with impressive stamina and determination in even the harshest conditions.
warscroll_ability.effect: If this unit is more than 9" from all enemy units, it can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

warscroll_ability.name: Stonehorn Avalanche
warscroll_ability.phaseDetails: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
warscroll_ability.lore: Stonehorns will headbutt mountains without flinching. Needless to say, lesser edifices and foes in the path of their charge are crushed with practical impunity.
warscroll_ability.declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit or an enemy faction terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.
warscroll_ability.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is a unit, inflict 3 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is a faction terrain feature, inflict 6 mortal damage on it.
